title: A World Model of Radiologist Reading for Medical Image Representation Learning
summary: Radiologist eye-tracking data provide a rich record of how experts search, compare, and accumulate evidence during image reading; yet, existing methods exploit this signal only partially, either as a static spatial prior or as an auxiliary prediction target decoupled from diagnosis. We propose GazeWorld, a medical imaging world model that treats the image as the world and the radiologist's fixation sequence as a trajectory through it. GazeWorld autoregressively predicts the latent representation of the next fixated patch from all previously visited ones, while a spatial-completion branch covers unvisited regions. At inference, GazeWorld generates a sequence of patch representations from the image alone without requiring real gaze data. Frozen GazeWorld features achieve state-of-the-art diagnostic accuracy across all nine supervised settings on CheXpert, RSNA Pneumonia, and SIIM-ACR Pneumothorax, as well as the highest zero-shot accuracy on all three benchmarks. On the GazeSearch benchmark, a generic decoder trained on the same frozen features outperforms the purpose-built LogitGaze-Med by over 16\% in ScanMatch and 22\% in SED, despite not being explicitly trained to predict gaze. GazeWorld demonstrates that modeling how experts read, not just what they conclude, offers a promising pretraining paradigm for medical imaging AI.

AI.tldr: GazeWorld提出了一种新的医学影像预训练范式，通过自回归预测放射科医生的注视轨迹（将图像视为世界，注视序列视为轨迹），同时结合空间补全分支覆盖未访问区域，无需真实注视数据即可生成patch表征，在诊断准确率和注视预测基准上均达到SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有方法仅将眼动追踪数据作为静态空间先验或辅助预测目标，未能充分利用专家阅读过程中的时序搜索、比较和证据积累信号。
AI.method: 将图像视为世界，放射科医生的注视序列视为轨迹；采用自回归方式从已访问的patch预测下一注视patch的潜在表征，同时使用空间补全分支处理未访问区域。推理时仅需图像本身，无需真实注视数据。
AI.result: 在CheXpert、RSNA肺炎、SIIM-ACR气胸三个基准的9个有监督设置中达到SOTA诊断准确率，零样本准确率最高；在GazeSearch基准上，使用冻结特征的通用解码器在ScanMatch和SED上分别比专用模型LogitGaze-Med高出16%和22%。
AI.conclusion: 建模专家如何阅读（过程）而非仅关注其结论（结果），为医学影像AI提供了一种有前景的预训练范式。

title: Nano World Models: A Minimalist Implementation of Future Video Prediction
summary: World models have become a central paradigm for learning predictive simulators that support generation, planning, and decision-making. Yet, despite rapid progress in industry-scale interactive video generation, the broader research community still lacks compact, reproducible, and easily extensible implementations for studying the design choices underlying modern world models. We introduce Nano World Models, a minimalist codebase for future video prediction centered around diffusion forcing. Nano World Models provides a unified interface for generative objectives, model scales, action-conditioning mechanisms, latent observation spaces, datasets, evaluation protocols, and long-horizon rollout procedures. This design enables controlled studies of world-modeling components that are often entangled across separate implementations. Through experiments across simple control environments, game simulation, and real-robot data, we examine how prediction parameterization, architecture scale, action injection, sampling budget, and domain complexity affect video prediction quality and autoregressive rollout behavior. By releasing code, configurations, evaluation scripts, and pretrained checkpoints, Nano World Models aims to provide a compact yet extensible experimental substrate for open, reproducible, and scientific world-model research.

AI.tldr: Nano World Models 是一个基于 diffusion forcing 的极简代码库，为未来视频预测提供统一接口，支持生成目标、模型规模、动作条件化、潜在观测空间、数据集、评估协议和长程 rollout 等模块的可控研究，并在简单控制环境、游戏模拟和真实机器人数据上验证了各设计因素对视频预测质量的影响。
AI.motivation: 尽管工业级交互式视频生成发展迅速，但研究社区仍缺乏紧凑、可复现且易于扩展的实现来系统研究现代世界模型的设计选择。
AI.method: 基于 diffusion forcing 框架，构建模块化代码库，统一生成目标、模型规模、动作条件化机制、潜在观测空间、数据集、评估协议和长程 rollout 等接口，支持各个组件的可控消融实验。
AI.result: 在简单控制环境、游戏模拟和真实机器人数据上，系统考察了预测参数化、架构规模、动作注入、采样预算和领域复杂度对视频预测质量和自回归 rollout 行为的影响。
AI.conclusion: 通过开源代码、配置、评估脚本和预训练检查点，为开放、可复现和科学的世界模型研究提供了一个紧凑且可扩展的实验平台。

title: RAW: Robust Avatar Watermarking -- Benchmarking and Baseline
summary: Digital avatar watermarking presents unique challenges: avatars are routinely post-processed with background replacement, reframing, and format conversion before deployment. We introduce \textbf{RAW} (Robust Avatar Watermarking), a benchmark comprising 50 synthetic avatar videos from 5 commercial providers and 6 attacks simulating real-world avatar workflows. Evaluating 7 existing methods reveals that avatar-specific attacks such as background removal significantly degrade watermark recovery. We propose \textbf{WALT} (Watermarking Avatars with Learned Textures), which embeds watermarks in UV texture space via 3D face reconstruction. WALT achieves the highest robustness to zoom attacks (92.4\%) while maintaining strong performance on background removal (95.6\%). We release our benchmark to facilitate research into avatar-specific watermarking.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RAW基准测试和WALT方法，用于解决数字人像水印在背景替换、重新构图等实际工作流中的鲁棒性问题。WALT通过3D人脸重建在UV纹理空间嵌入水印，在缩放攻击（92.4%）和背景移除（95.6%）中取得优异表现。
AI.motivation: 数字人像水印面临独特挑战：人像在部署前常经历背景替换、重新构图和格式转换等后处理，现有水印方法在这些实际工作流中的鲁棒性不足。
AI.method: 提出RAW基准测试（含50个合成人像视频，来自5家商业供应商，6种攻击类型），评估7种现有方法；提出WALT方法，通过3D人脸重建在UV纹理空间嵌入水印。
AI.result: WALT在缩放攻击中鲁棒性最高（92.4%），在背景移除攻击中表现优异（95.6%）。
AI.conclusion: 发布RAW基准以促进人像专用水印研究，WALT方法在实际人像工作流中具有强鲁棒性。

title: Task-Aligned Self-Supervised Learning for Medical Image Analysis: A Systematic Review and Practical Design Guidelines
comment: This manuscript is 31 pages with 4 tables and 3 figures
summary: Self-supervised learning (SSL) has emerged as a promising paradigm for addressing the annotation bottleneck in medical imaging by learning representations from unlabeled data. However, its effectiveness depends heavily on the design of the pretext task and its alignment with the downstream clinical objective. We present a systematic, task-oriented review of SSL in medical imaging, examining how different pretext-task formulations influence performance across classification, segmentation, detection, and other tasks. Following PRISMA guidelines, we analyze 75 studies published between 2017 and 2025 and organize them into four paradigms: contrastive, non-contrastive and predictive, generative and reconstruction-based, and hybrid learning. Rather than cataloguing methods by architecture, we map each paradigm to the downstream objectives it best supports. Our analysis shows there is no universally optimal SSL strategy; instead, performance is governed by the alignment between the pretext task, the imaging modality, and the target task. Contrastive methods learn global discriminative features and align well with classification, but may overlook subtle pathological patterns. Generative and spatial prediction-based approaches better preserve local anatomical structure, making them more suitable for segmentation and other dense prediction tasks, while hybrid methods offer the most balanced performance. We further show that modality-specific design is critical and that SSL provides its greatest benefit in low-label and few-shot regimes. Finally, we distill these findings into practical design guidelines and outline open challenges, including pathology-aware pretext task design, resource-efficient training for high-dimensional data, and standardized evaluation protocols. This work offers practical guidance for designing more effective and clinically relevant SSL frameworks in medical imaging.

AI.tldr: 本文系统综述了2017-2025年间75项研究，将医学影像中的自监督学习分为对比、非对比/预测、生成/重建和混合四种范式，分析了不同预文本任务与下游任务（分类、分割、检测等）的对齐关系，发现无普遍最优策略，性能取决于预文本任务、成像模态和目标任务的匹配度，并给出了实用设计指南。
AI.motivation: 自监督学习在医学影像中具有解决标注瓶颈的潜力，但其有效性高度依赖预文本任务的设计及其与下游临床目标的对齐，而现有研究缺乏系统性、任务导向的综述来指导框架设计。
AI.method: 遵循PRISMA指南，分析了2017至2025年间发表的75项研究，将SSL方法组织为对比、非对比/预测、生成/重建和混合学习四种范式，并按照预文本任务与下游目标的映射关系进行分析，而非按架构分类。
AI.result: 对比方法学习全局判别特征，适合分类但可能忽略细微病理模式；生成和空间预测方法保留局部解剖结构，适合分割等密集预测任务；混合方法性能最均衡；模态特定设计至关重要，SSL在低标注和小样本场景下收益最大。
AI.conclusion: 不存在通用的最优SSL策略，性能由预文本任务、成像模态和目标任务的对齐决定；提出了实用设计指南，并指出了病理感知预文本任务设计、高维数据的高效训练、标准化评估协议等开放挑战。

title: RED: Adaptive Real-Time DAG Scheduling for Robotic Inference under Environmental Dynamics
summary: Robots deployed in dynamic environments must contend with environment-driven changes that reshape computation at runtime: new tasks may appear, precedence relations can shift, and overall workload structure evolves, all of which degrade performance, especially when multi-task inference is required under tight resource and real-time budgets. We present RED, a real-time scheduling framework for multi-task deep neural network workloads on resource-constrained robotic platforms that adapts to Robotic Environmental Dynamics (RED) while preserving end-to-end timing guarantees under modeling assumptions. The core of RED is a deadline-aware scheduler that assigns intermediate sub-deadlines, allowing it to accommodate evolving computation graphs and asynchronous inference induced by unpredictable conditions. The framework also supports flexible deployment of MIMONet (multi-input multi-output neural networks), commonly used in multi-tasking robots to alleviate memory pressure through weight sharing. RED explicitly leverages this shared-parameter property via a workload refinement and graph-reconstruction procedure that aligns MIMONet structure with schedulability requirements, improving compatibility and efficiency. We implement RED on NVIDIA Jetson family platforms and on an Apple M-series MacBook and evaluate it on navigation-oriented workloads representative of real robotic scenarios. Experiments show consistent gains over existing methods in throughput, deadline satisfaction, robustness to interference, adaptability, and runtime overhead.

AI.tldr: RED是一个面向资源受限机器人平台的实时调度框架，通过截止时间感知调度器、MIMONet权重共享特性利用和工作负载重构，适应动态环境变化，保障多任务DNN推理的端到端时序约束。
AI.motivation: 动态环境中机器人面临运行时计算图重构、新任务出现、优先级关系变化等环境驱动变化，导致多任务推理在资源受限和实时约束下性能严重下降，现有方法缺乏有效的自适应实时调度方案。
AI.method: 1) 提出截止时间感知调度器，为中间任务分配子截止时间以适应动态计算图和非同步推理；2) 利用MIMONet的权重共享特性，通过工作负载精炼和图重构过程对齐网络结构与可调度性需求；3) 在NVIDIA Jetson和Apple M系列MacBook上实现并评估。
AI.result: 在导航类机器人工作负载上，RED相比现有方法在吞吐量、截止时间满足率、干扰鲁棒性、适应性和运行时开销方面均表现出一致性提升。
AI.conclusion: RED框架有效解决了动态环境下机器人多任务DNN推理的实时调度难题，通过显式利用MIMONet的共享参数特性和子截止时间分配机制，在保障时序保证的同时实现了高效自适应调度。

title: Algometrics: Forecasting Under Algorithmic Feedback
summary: In algorithmic markets, predictive models become part of the data-generating process they aim to forecast. Once their outputs are converted into trades, allocations, execution schedules, or risk controls, they change the future data on which they are evaluated. I introduce algometrics, a framework for time series whose evolution depends on the predictive algorithms forecasting them. The framework distinguishes historical risk, measured under passive forecasting, from deployment risk, measured when forecasts drive actions. I prove three results. First, deployment risk is not identifiable from passive historical data alone: even in a one-step linear feedback model, infinitely many algorithm-mediated environments induce the same historical law while implying different deployment risks for the same forecaster. Second, historical model rankings can invert under crowding, so a predictor with lower passive error can have higher deployment error once similar algorithms are adopted. Third, randomized or instrumented actions identify short-horizon linear feedback, and I derive a finite-sample bound for deployment-risk estimation. These results suggest that time-series benchmarks in algorithmic markets should report feedback sensitivity alongside predictive accuracy.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"算法计量学"(algometrics)框架，研究当预测算法影响自身预测对象时的时间序列问题，区分了历史风险（被动预测）与部署风险（预测驱动行动），并证明了三个核心定理：部署风险无法仅从被动历史数据识别、历史模型排名在拥挤交易下可能反转、随机化或工具化行动可识别短视线性反馈。
AI.motivation: 在算法市场中，预测模型成为其预测对象的数据生成过程的一部分——模型输出转化为交易、分配、执行计划或风险控制后，会改变评估这些模型所依赖的未来数据。这种反馈循环使得传统的被动预测评估方法失效，需要新的理论框架来理解和量化部署风险。
AI.method: 作者提出了algometrics框架，通过严格区分被动预测下的历史风险与预测驱动行动下的部署风险，在线性反馈模型下进行理论分析，并推导了部署风险估计的有限样本界。
AI.result: (1) 部署风险无法仅从被动历史数据识别，即使在一阶线性反馈模型中，无穷多种算法介导的环境可生成相同的历史分布但具有不同的部署风险；(2) 历史模型排名在拥挤下会反转，被动误差低的预测器在类似算法被采纳后可能具有更高的部署误差；(3) 随机化或工具化行动可识别短视线性反馈，并给出了部署风险估计的有限样本界。
AI.conclusion: 算法市场的时间序列基准应同时报告预测准确性和反馈敏感性，以更好评估模型在真实部署环境中的表现。

title: Brain-to-Image Retrieval and Reconstruction via Multimodal EEG Alignment
summary: We present a brain-to-image system that decodes visual stimuli from EEG signals recorded during natural image viewing. Our system addresses two tasks: (1) EEG-to-image retrieval, which ranks the correct stimulus image among 200 candidates given an EEG segment, and (2) EEG-to-image reconstruction, which generates an image consistent with the perceived stimulus. For retrieval, we implement a multi-level blurring approach improved with biologically inspired EVNet features and trained with the InfoNCE loss. Evaluated over 10 random seeds for a single subject, the retrieval model achieves a mean final-epoch Top-1 accuracy of 86.30% and Top-5 accuracy of 98.55%. For reconstruction, we implement CognitionCapturerPro, which aligns EEG representations to multi-modal CLIP embeddings, including image, text, depth, and edge embeddings, and synthesizes images with SDXL-Turbo conditioned via IP-Adapter. Averaged over 10 seeds, the reconstruction model achieves a CLIP score of 0.903 using ViT-H-14, a CLIP score of 0.870 using ViT-L/14, and an SSIM of 0.409. These results demonstrate the feasibility of decoding rich visual representations from EEG signals using modern multi-modal alignment and generative modeling techniques.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于EEG信号的脑-图像解码系统，采用多级模糊检索（Top-1准确率86.30%）和多模态对齐生成重建（CLIP得分0.903）方法，实现了从自然图像观看时的脑电信号中检索和重建视觉刺激。
AI.motivation: 探索从非侵入式EEG信号中解码丰富的视觉表征的可行性，以弥补脑信号与视觉图像之间的语义鸿沟。
AI.method: 检索任务采用多级模糊方法结合EVNet特征和InfoNCE损失；重建任务采用CognitionCapturerPro将EEG表示与多模态CLIP嵌入（图像、文本、深度、边缘）对齐，并通过IP-Adapter条件结合SDXL-Turbo生成图像。
AI.result: 检索：Top-1准确率86.30%，Top-5准确率98.55%；重建：CLIP得分0.903（ViT-H-14）/0.870（ViT-L/14），SSIM为0.409。
AI.conclusion: 利用现代多模态对齐和生成建模技术，从EEG信号中解码丰富视觉表征是可行的。

title: MASt3R-Nav: WayPixel Navigation in Relative 3D Maps
comment: 2026 IEEE International Conference on Robotics & Automation (ICRA)
summary: Visual navigation ability is strongly tied to its underlying representation of the world. Unlike classical 3D maps that require globally-consistent geometry, image- or object-relative topological graphs almost entirely do away with geometric understanding. But, this comes at the cost of navigation capability, often limiting it to merely teach-and-repeat. In this work, we propose a novel map representation in the form of pixel-relative connectivity, which is geometrically accurate but does not require global geometric consistency. Inspired by recent progress in 3D grounded image matching, we construct a map from an image sequence through inter-image connectivity based on pixel correspondences in the relative 3D coordinate systems of individual image pairs. We then use this pixel-level graph to perform global path planning by approximating and sparsifying intra-image pixel connectivity. Through this, we derive a ''WayPixel Costmap'' representation and train a controller conditioned on it to predict a trajectory rollout. We show that this dense pixel-level costmap based on relative geometry is a more accurate conditioning variable for control prediction than its image- and object-level counterparts. This enables a highly capable navigation system, as validated on four types of navigation tasks in the simulator and through real world demonstrations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于像素级相对连接性的地图表示方法（WayPixel Costmap），该表示兼具几何精确性且无需全局几何一致性，通过图像间像素对应关系构建连接图，并利用该稠密代价地图进行路径规划与控制，在仿真和真实世界的四项导航任务中验证了其优越性。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉导航方法中，经典3D地图需要全局一致的几何信息，而拓扑图虽无需几何一致性但导航能力受限（如仅能实现"教-复现"模式）。作者希望构建一种兼具几何精确性与无需全局一致性的地图表示，以提升导航系统的能力。
AI.method: (1) 基于3D接地图像匹配，通过图像对间的像素对应关系在各自相对3D坐标系中建立跨图像连接，构建像素级连接图；(2) 通过近似和稀疏化图像内像素连接性，推导出WayPixel Costmap表示；(3) 训练一个以该代价地图为条件的控制器来预测轨迹展开。
AI.result: 在仿真和真实世界的四项导航任务中，基于稠密像素级代价地图的控制预测相比图像级和物体级对应方法更为精确，验证了所提导航系统的高性能。
AI.conclusion: 像素级相对几何代价地图是一种比图像级、物体级表示更精确的控制预测条件变量，能够实现高效的视觉导航系统。

title: Parameter Efficient Multi-Class Intelligent Scheduling for Multimodal Online Distributed Industrial Anomaly Detection
summary: Industrial anomaly detection has attracted significant attention as a fundamental challenge in industrial systems. The rapid advancement of heterogeneous industrial sensors has driven industrial anomaly detection from unimodal to multimodal paradigms. However, existing methods are primarily designed for centralized and offline settings, overlooking the distributed and continuously generated data characteristic of real-world industrial environments. With the advancement of edge intelligence, modern edge devices are increasingly capable of not only data acquisition but also distributed model training, enabling collaborative intelligence across the system. Industrial anomaly detection represents a critical application in this context. Motivated by these challenges, we propose a novel framework termed Multimodal Online Distributed Industrial Anomaly Detection (MODIAD). We first present a comprehensive workflow for MODIAD and then formulate a Multi-class Intelligent Scheduling (MIS) problem to coordinate cross class model updates by balancing data sufficiency and class update frequency. To efficiently solve this problem, we design a Sequential Marginal Gain Greedy (SMG) algorithm that enables effective multi-class training under resource constraints. Furthermore, to improve the computational and communication efficiency during training, we propose an Resource Efficient Class-Wise Low Rank Adaptation (REC-LoRA) strategy, which significantly reduces system overhead while preserving detection performance. Extensive experiments on two representative multimodal industrial anomaly detection datasets, MVTec 3D-AD and Eyecandies demonstrate that the proposed approach achieves superior performance and efficiency under the MODIAD scenario.

AI.tldr: 论文提出MODIAD框架，解决多模态工业异常检测在分布式、在线场景下的挑战，通过多类智能调度（MIS）问题建模、序列边际增益贪心（SMG）算法和资源高效类级低秩适配（REC-LoRA）策略，实现资源受限下的高效分布式训练，在MVTec 3D-AD和Eyecandies数据集上取得优异性能。
AI.motivation: 现有工业异常检测方法主要面向集中式、离线场景，忽视了真实工业环境中数据的分布式和持续生成特性。随着边缘智能发展，需要利用边缘设备的分布式训练能力实现协同智能，但目前缺乏针对多模态、在线、分布式工业异常检测的解决方案。
AI.method: 1) 提出MODIAD框架，定义多模态在线分布式工业异常检测的完整工作流；2) 构建多类智能调度（MIS）问题，通过平衡数据充分性和类别更新频率来协调跨类模型更新；3) 设计序列边际增益贪心（SMG）算法求解MIS问题；4) 提出资源高效类级低秩适配（REC-LoRA）策略，降低训练中的计算和通信开销。
AI.result: 在两个多模态工业异常检测数据集MVTec 3D-AD和Eyecandies上的实验表明，所提方法在MODIAD场景下实现了优越的性能和效率。
AI.conclusion: MODIAD框架有效填补了多模态工业异常检测在分布式、在线场景中的空白，通过智能调度和资源高效训练策略，实现了边缘设备协同下的高效异常检测，为实际工业部署提供了可行方案。

title: IVR-R1: Refining Trajectories through Iterative Visual-Grounded Reasoning in Reinforcement Learning
summary: Multimodal large language models via reinforcement learning (RL) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in complex visual reasoning tasks, yet they remain limited in long-horizon multimodal scenarios, often suffering from visual hallucination and logical error. Current methods typically pre-encode high-dimensional visual scenes into discrete textual proxies to facilitate downstream reasoning. As the reasoning chain unfolds, however, the inherent information asymmetry between text and visual scenes tends to erode visual grounding, resulting in misguided reasoning and erroneous outputs. To address this issue, we introduce IVR-R1 (Iterative Visual-grounded Reasoning), a novel RL training framework that facilitates dynamic visual re-alignment that actively rectifies reasoning trajectories to guide policy optimization. Specifically, by leveraging a reward-driven screening mechanism to identify flawed rollouts, IVR-R1 executes a fine-grained, step-level error attribution within the multimodal context. By iteratively cross-referencing intermediate reasoning states against pristine visual priors, a Re-Reasoning Loop enables automated trajectory rectification, effectively synthesizing expert-level demonstrations that serve as high-fidelity reasoning templates for the policy model. Our experiments across diverse multimodal benchmarks demonstrate that IVR-R1 consistently outperforms existing reinforcement learning methods, establishing a superior paradigm for maintaining logical and visual consistency in complex multimodal reasoning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出IVR-R1，一种基于迭代视觉接地推理的强化学习训练框架，通过奖励驱动的筛选机制和重新推理循环，在长程多模态推理中动态对齐视觉信息与推理轨迹，有效缓解视觉幻觉和逻辑错误，在多个基准上超越现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态大语言模型在长程推理场景中存在视觉幻觉和逻辑错误，根本原因在于文本与视觉场景之间的信息不对称随推理链展开而加剧，导致视觉接地逐渐退化。
AI.method: IVR-R1框架包含三个核心组件：(1) 奖励驱动的筛选机制，识别有缺陷的推理轨迹；(2) 细粒度逐级错误归因，在多模态上下文中定位错误；(3) 重新推理循环，通过交叉引用中间推理状态与原始视觉先验，自动修正轨迹并合成专家级推理模板用于策略优化。
AI.result: 在多种多模态基准测试上，IVR-R1一致优于现有强化学习方法，在复杂多模态推理中保持了更好的逻辑一致性和视觉一致性。
AI.conclusion: IVR-R1通过动态视觉重对齐机制有效解决了长程多模态推理中的视觉信息退化问题，为维护复杂推理中的逻辑与视觉一致性建立了新的范式。

title: Anisotropic Diffusion-Driven Ergodic Coverage in Multi-Robot Systems
summary: We consider the problem of combining potential field and ergodic search on multi-robot systems. Traditional ergodic search algorithms use metrics for ergodicity that account for the desired distribution at different scales. Recently, a heat equation-driven ergodic approach was proposed, which adds flexibility to the smoothing of the ergodic metric. However, such an approach, as it is an isotropic diffusion, propagates the error uniformly in all directions, regardless of changes in the desired distribution. We introduce a general class of anisotropic diffusion formulation of the ergodicity problem, which generates a potential field for the ergodic search. We demonstrate that this approach generalizes previous results, which consider radial basis functions and the solution of the heat equation to represent the difference between the goal density distribution and the covered trajectories. In our solution, the agent movement is directed using the gradient of the solution of the Perona-Malik diffusion, and our formulation includes the heat equation as a special case. We demonstrate the methodology with a series of simulations in different scenarios.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种基于各向异性扩散（Perona-Malik方程）的遍历搜索方法，用于多机器人系统的势场与遍历搜索结合问题，将热方程作为特例，并通过仿真验证了有效性。
AI.motivation: 传统遍历搜索算法使用各向同性扩散（热方程）处理遍历性度量，导致误差在所有方向均匀传播，无法适应目标分布的变化。作者希望引入各向异性扩散来提升灵活性。
AI.method: 将遍历性问题的各向异性扩散公式化，利用Perona-Malik扩散方程的解生成势场，引导智能体沿其梯度方向运动；该公式将径向基函数和热方程解作为特例。
AI.result: 通过一系列不同场景的仿真展示了该方法的有效性，验证了各向异性扩散相比各向同性（热方程）方法的优势。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的各向异性扩散公式推广了现有遍历搜索方法，能更灵活地指导多机器人系统的运动，热方程是其特例。

title: CAFD: Concept-Aware DNN Fault Detection using VLMs
summary: Fault detection for Deep Neural Networks (DNNs) has received increasing attention in recent years. While more advanced hybrid approaches have been proposed to combine multiple sources of information and outperform earlier techniques, they often incur substantial computational overhead, limiting scalability and practicality in real-world settings. In this paper, we introduce Concept-Aware Fault Detection (CAFD), a learning-based approach that achieves superior fault detection performance by effectively integrating multiple information sources while maintaining practical efficiency. Specifically, CAFD is trained using a carefully selected set of informative features, including model-based signals derived from the DNN's outputs, distance-based features, and a novel concept-based feature, called Concept Failure Ratio (CFR). CFR leverages Vision-Language Models (VLMs) to extract textual concepts from images and quantify the likelihood that their presence is associated with DNN failures. By incorporating this feature, CAFD benefits from complementary semantic information, enabling more effective fault detection. Our results demonstrate that CFR serves as an effective indicator for DNN fault detection. We conduct an extensive empirical evaluation of CAFD, comparing it against five state-of-the-art baselines across three subject DNN models and datasets, including ImageNet. Across a wide range of constrained selection budgets, CAFD consistently outperforms all baselines in Fault Detection Rate (FDR), achieving average FDR improvements of 18.3% across all investigated subjects and budget sizes.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Concept-Aware Fault Detection (CAFD)，一种基于学习的 DNN 故障检测方法，通过整合模型输出信号、距离特征和基于 VLM 的概念故障比（CFR）特征，在保持实用效率的同时实现优越的故障检测性能。实验表明，CAFD 在多个模型和数据集上平均 FDR 提升 18.3%。
AI.motivation: 现有 DNN 故障检测方法中，混合方法虽能整合多种信息源并超越早期技术，但计算开销大，限制了可扩展性和实际部署。需要一种既能有效融合多源信息又能保持高效的方法。
AI.method: CAFD 是一种基于学习的方法，使用精心选择的特征集：1) 基于 DNN 输出信号的模型特征；2) 距离特征；3) 新颖的概念特征 CFR（Concept Failure Ratio），利用视觉语言模型（VLM）从图像中提取文本概念并量化其与 DNN 故障的关联概率。
AI.result: 在三个 DNN 模型和数据集（包括 ImageNet）上，与五种 SOTA 基线相比，CAFD 在多个约束选择预算下持续优于所有基线，平均 Fault Detection Rate (FDR) 提升 18.3%。
AI.conclusion: CFR 是有效的 DNN 故障检测指标，通过整合语义信息提升了检测效果；CAFD 在保持实用效率的同时实现了更优的故障检测性能。

authors: Guang Lin Haoyang Zheng Runzhe Zhang Guang Lin
title: Diff-Instruct with Diffused Reward: Towards Principled One-step Generator RL
summary: Recent advances in one-step text-to-image generation have enabled real-time synthesis with remarkable efficiency and quality. Previous reinforcement learning methods for one-step generators combine image-space reward optimization with diffusion noisy-space distribution matching. This paradigm brings challenges due to a mismatch between terminal reward optimization and the underlying generative dynamics. As a result, optimization tends to exploit stochastic degrees of freedom, often improving reward at the expense of image fidelity. To address this issue, we propose Diff-Instruct with Diffused Reward (DIDR), a data-free trajectory-level alignment framework derived from Integral KL minimization. DIDR propagates the RLHF-optimal reward-tilted clean-image distribution across all noise levels along the diffusion trajectory. We show that this objective admits the same minimizer as clean-image RLHF, while naturally inducing the Diffused Reward Score (DRS), which acts as a reward-driven correction to the reference score function. To make this practical, we further introduce the Diffused Reward Proxy (DRP), an efficient estimator of DRS based on differentiable short-step denoising. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DIDR consistently Pareto-dominates existing one-step SDXL baselines. Moreover, when transferred to a 6B DiT backbone (Z-Image), DIDR surpasses its 50-step teacher in preference alignment while requiring only a single generation step.

AI.tldr: 提出DIDR框架，通过扩散奖励传播解决一步文生图模型中奖励优化与图像保真度之间的权衡问题，在单步生成中实现了超越多步教师的偏好对齐效果。
AI.motivation: 现有一步式文生图模型的强化学习方法存在终端奖励优化与生成动力学不匹配的问题，优化过程倾向于利用随机自由度，在提升奖励分数的同时牺牲图像保真度。
AI.method: 提出DIDR，一种基于积分KL最小化的无数据轨迹级对齐框架。通过将RLHF最优的奖励倾斜清晰图像分布沿扩散轨迹传播到所有噪声水平，推导出扩散奖励分数（DRS）作为参考分数函数的奖励驱动校正，并引入可微短步去噪的扩散奖励代理（DRP）进行高效估计。
AI.result: 在SDXL基线上实现帕累托主导的全面超越；在6B DiT骨干（Z-Image）上，单步生成即可超越50步教师的偏好对齐效果。
AI.conclusion: DIDR通过轨迹级对齐有效解决了一步式生成中奖励优化与图像保真度的矛盾，实现了高效且高质量的单步文生图。

title: Investigating the Effect of a Series Elastic Actuation Retrofit to Black-Box Actuators
summary:
In robotic applications, actuators are typically designed to be stiff with minimal backlash to ensure precision and repeatability. However, this limits compliance, leading to potential damage and poor force control in uncertain environments. Series Elastic Actuation (SEA) introduces compliance to enhance disturbance rejection and enable force measurement via Hooke's Law but reduces system bandwidth.
  A custom Series Elastic (SE) element was retrofitted to a black-box actuator to mitigate non-linearities like backlash and static friction. Integrating the SE element enabled high-fidelity force measurements, improving force control bandwidth and performance.
  A torsional SE element was designed through Finite Element (FE) analysis, yielding a stiffness of 2155.4 Nm/rad. Open-loop force control bandwidth was measured for the original motor and the SEA-integrated configuration, while closed-loop bandwidth was assessed using feedback from the SEA and a commercial force sensor. The SEA module increased bandwidth from 10.32 Hz to 30.32 Hz, a 2.93X improvement. Additionally, it outperformed the commercial sensor by 7.63% despite costing 25 GBP, a fraction of the price.

AI.tldr: 本文通过在黑箱执行器上加装定制的串联弹性（SE）元件，实现了低成本（25英镑）的高保真力测量，将力控制带宽从10.32 Hz提升至30.32 Hz（2.93倍），且性能优于商用传感器7.63%。
AI.motivation: 传统刚性执行器在不确定环境中缺乏顺应性，易导致损坏且力控制性能差。SEA可引入顺应性并实现力测量，但会降低系统带宽，且现有SEA方案难以直接适配黑箱执行器。
AI.method: 在未知内部结构的黑箱执行器上，加装定制的扭转SE元件（通过有限元分析设计，刚度为2155.4 Nm/rad），利用胡克定律通过弹簧形变实现高保真力测量，并分别进行了开环和闭环力控制带宽测试。
AI.result: 安装SEA模块后，开环力控制带宽从10.32 Hz提升至30.32 Hz（提升2.93倍）；闭环测试中，SEA力传感器性能优于商用传感器7.63%，且成本仅25英镑。
AI.conclusion: 通过低成本定制的串联弹性元件可有效提升黑箱执行器的力控制性能，在带宽和力测量精度上超越昂贵商用传感器，具有高性价比和实用价值。

title: Towards Verifiable Transformers: Solver-Checkable Circuit Explanations
summary: Mechanistic interpretability often identifies circuits inside Transformer models, but explanations of those circuits are usually validated through examples, ablations, and manual reasoning. This leaves a gap between finding a plausible circuit and proving what the circuit does. We introduce Verifiable Transformers, a framework for converting task-localized Transformer circuits into bounded, solver-checkable claims. Given a behavior, a finite task domain, and a candidate-token projection, we extract a task circuit and verify properties such as projected functional equivalence, edge necessity, task-relevant invariance, and final-residual robustness. Direct verification encodes the extracted circuit itself into an SMT solver. When a circuit contains operators that are not exactly or tractably encodable, surrogate-mediated verification fits an SMT-encodable surrogate, validates it against the extracted circuit over the bounded domain, and verifies symbolic explanations against the surrogate. We instantiate direct verification with a GPT-style architecture using Signed L1 BandNorm, sparsemax attention, and LeakyReLU. On small symbolic sequence tasks, we train an SMT-representable Transformer, extract sparse circuits for quote closing and bracket type tracking, and exhaustively verify projected functional equivalence, content invariance, edge necessity, and final-residual robustness. At GPT-2 scale, the same operator stack trains stably on OpenWebText, although naive direct SMT verification remains intractable. We also demonstrate surrogate-mediated verification on task-localized circuits with hard-to-encode attention, showing both verified symbolic explanations and solver-generated counterexamples. The goal is not full-model verification, but a concrete path for turning mechanistic circuit explanations into formal propositions that can be proven or refuted.

AI.tldr: 本文提出可验证Transformer框架，通过将局部电路编码为SMT可检查的命题，实现电路行为的正式验证。包括直接验证（使用SMT可编码算子）和代理中介验证（对难以编码的算子拟合可编码代理）。在小规模符号任务上验证了GPT风格架构，并在GPT-2尺度上展示了代理验证的可行性。
AI.motivation: 机械可解释性通常识别Transformer中的电路，但解释往往通过示例、消融和人工推理来验证，缺乏从发现合理电路到证明电路实际功能的桥梁。本文旨在将任务局部化的Transformer电路转化为有界、求解器可检查的正式声明，从而实现可证明或可反驳的机械解释。
AI.method: 提出两种验证模式：(1) 直接验证：将提取的电路直接编码为SMT公式进行验证；(2) 代理中介验证：当电路包含难以或不可精确编码的算子时，拟合一个SMT可编码的代理模型，在有界域内验证代理与提取电路的行为一致性，再对代理进行符号解释验证。架构采用Signed L1 BandNorm、sparsemax注意力和LeakyReLU。
AI.result: 在小规模符号序列任务上，训练了SMT可表示的Transformer，提取了引号闭合和括号类型追踪的稀疏电路，并穷举验证了投影功能等价性、内容不变性、边必要性和最终残差鲁棒性。在GPT-2规模下，相同算子栈在OpenWebText上可稳定训练，但直接SMT验证计算上不可行。代理中介验证成功应用于难以编码的注意力电路，产生了可验证的符号解释和求解器生成的反例。
AI.conclusion: 本文的目标并非全模型验证，而是提供一条具体路径，将机械可解释性中的电路解释转化为可被形式化证明或反驳的命题，弥合了因果解释与形式验证之间的鸿沟。

title: Remote sensing data imputation using deep learning for multispectral imagery
summary: Remote sensing techniques have been increasingly utilised in aquatic applications in recent years. A common challenge in using optical satellite data is the presence of missing observations due to cloud cover. These data gaps can lead to missed detection of critical events, such as algal blooms, in lakes of high interest to water authorities. As a result, enhancing the completeness of optical satellite datasets is crucial for improving the monitoring and prediction of algal blooms. In this study, we compared a traditional data imputation method (i.e., linear interpolation) with deep learning models for reconstructing missing spectral bands across four lakes with historical records of algal blooms. The deep learning models adopted include CNN-based architectures (i.e., CNN, Inception Resnet, and Autoencoder) and CNN-LSTM-based architectures (i.e., CNN-LSTM, Resnet-LSTM, and Autoencoder-LSTM). Our results demonstrated that deep learning models substantially outperformed the baseline linear interpolation method in imputing spectral band values within artificially masked regions. Among these models, CNN delivered the best performance across most lakes. Furthermore, we evaluated the performance of algal bloom indices (i.e., Green/Red and NDCI) derived from the imputed imagery by comparing them with the observed data. Our results demonstrate that deep learning models are effective for imputing missing data in PlanetScope SuperDove imagery, enabling more reliable applications in water monitoring.

AI.tldr: 本研究比较了线性插值与多种深度学习模型（CNN、Inception Resnet、Autoencoder、CNN-LSTM、Resnet-LSTM、Autoencoder-LSTM）在重建四个有藻华历史记录湖泊的缺失光谱波段上的表现。结果表明，深度学习模型显著优于线性插值，其中CNN在大多数湖泊中表现最佳。基于重建影像的藻华指数（Green/Red和NDCI）与观测数据吻合良好，证明了深度学习方法在PlanetScope SuperDove影像缺失数据插补中的有效性，可提升水监测应用的可靠性。
AI.motivation: 光学卫星数据常因云覆盖导致观测缺失，这可能导致高关注度湖泊中藻华等关键事件的漏检。因此，提高光学卫星数据集的完整性对于改善藻华的监测与预测至关重要。
AI.method: 研究比较了传统数据插补方法（线性插值）与深度学习模型（基于CNN的CNN、Inception Resnet、Autoencoder，以及基于CNN-LSTM的CNN-LSTM、Resnet-LSTM、Autoencoder-LSTM），在四个有藻华历史记录的湖泊中重建缺失光谱波段。通过人工掩膜区域评估插补性能，并基于插补影像计算藻华指数（Green/Red和NDCI）与观测数据对比验证。
AI.result: 深度学习模型显著优于基线线性插值方法；其中CNN在大多数湖泊中表现最佳。基于插补影像计算的藻华指数（Green/Red和NDCI）与观测数据具有良好一致性。
AI.conclusion: 深度学习模型能有效插补PlanetScope SuperDove影像中的缺失数据，从而支持更可靠的水体监测应用。

title: Afford-VLA: Action-Aligned Visual Planning via Internalized Affordance
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have shown strong potential for generalist robot manipulation, yet they remain limited by insufficient spatial reasoning, particularly in determining where to interact in complex visual scenes. While recent efforts introduce various forms of visual planning to address this issue, existing approaches either rely on global geometric cues, symbolic intermediate representations, or externally generated visual signals, which are often weakly coupled with downstream action prediction. In this work, we revisit visual planning in VLA systems and argue that effective planning should be local, visually grounded, internally generated, and directly aligned with action. Based on this insight, we propose Afford-VLA, a unified framework that internalizes task-conditioned affordance as an explicit visual planning interface within VLA models. Concretely, we introduce learnable <AFF> tokens to query task-relevant interaction regions, decode affordance masks from multimodal features, and convert them into compact embeddings that directly condition action generation. This design enables affordance to be both generated and utilized within the VLA, forming a tightly coupled perception-action pathway. To further support this integration, we adopt a training strategy that allows the affordance pathway to be jointly optimized with action prediction, improving its effectiveness for downstream control. We evaluate our method on multiple simulation benchmarks, including LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus, and SimplerEnv, achieving consistent state-of-the-art performance, along with strong real-world results. These findings demonstrate that internalizing affordance as action-aligned visual planning provides a powerful paradigm for improving VLA systems.

AI.tldr: Afford-VLA通过在VLA模型内部引入任务条件化的可学习<AFF>令牌来生成与动作直接对齐的局部视觉可供性表示，从而增强机器人的空间推理和操作能力，在多个仿真和真实世界基准上取得最优结果。
AI.motivation: 现有的VLA模型在复杂视觉场景中的空间推理能力不足，难以确定交互位置；已有的视觉规划方法要么依赖全局几何线索、符号中间表示或外部生成的视觉信号，与下游动作预测耦合较弱。
AI.method: 提出Afford-VLA框架：引入可学习<AFF>令牌查询任务相关的交互区域，从多模态特征中解码可供性掩码，并将其转换为紧凑嵌入直接条件化动作生成；采用联合训练策略使可供性通路与动作预测共同优化。
AI.result: 在LIBERO、LIBERO-Plus、SimplerEnv等多个仿真基准上取得一致的最优性能，并在真实世界实验中表现优异。
AI.conclusion: 将可供性内化为与动作对齐的视觉规划接口，为改进VLA系统提供了一种有效的范式。

title: Iterative Refinement Neural Operators are Learned Fixed-Point Solvers: A Principled Approach to Spectral Bias Mitigation
comment: 47 pages; accepted to ICML 2026 as a Spotlight
summary: Neural operators serve as fast, data-driven surrogates for scientific modeling but typically rely on a monolithic, single-pass inference procedure that struggles to resolve high-frequency details, a limitation known as spectral bias. We introduce the Iterative Refinement Neural Operator (IRNO), which augments pre-trained operators with a learned refinement module iteratively applied via fixed-point iteration. IRNO decomposes the prediction into a coarse initialization followed by successive residual corrections, paralleling classical numerical solvers. Under local assumptions, we establish contraction of the induced operator, ensuring convergence to a unique fixed point. To explicitly target high-frequency errors, we propose a progressive spectral loss that adaptively increases penalty on high-frequency components over refinement steps during training. Across physical systems, IRNO consistently lowers error, with up to 56.05% improvement on turbulent flow. On Active Matter, spectral analysis reveals that, relative to base operator, the normalized error ratios decrease to 27.72-36.10% in low-, 5.07-6.68% in mid-, and 1.48-2.04% in high-frequencies, remaining stable beyond the trained iteration count. Code is available at https://github.com/xiaotianliu-dartmouth/Iterative_Refinement_Neural_Operator

AI.tldr: IRNO通过固定点迭代的细化模块增强预训练神经算子，结合渐进谱损失，有效解决高频细节的谱偏差问题，在多个物理系统上取得显著误差降低，尤其在高频区域表现优异。
AI.motivation: 传统神经算子作为数据驱动的科学代理模型，采用单次推理过程，存在难以解析高频细节的谱偏差限制。
AI.method: 提出迭代细化神经算子（IRNO），在预训练算子基础上增加可学习的细化模块，通过固定点迭代循环应用。将预测分解为粗初始化与后续残差校正，类比经典数值求解器。在局部假设下建立算子压缩性保证收敛到唯一不动点。提出渐进谱损失，在训练过程中随细化步数自适应增加高频成分的惩罚。
AI.result: 在湍流流动上误差降低高达56.05%。在活性物质系统中，相对于基础算子，归一化误差比在低频降至27.72-36.10%，中频降至5.07-6.68%，高频降至1.48-2.04%，且超越训练迭代次数后仍保持稳定。
AI.conclusion: IRNO有效缓解了神经算子的谱偏差问题，通过迭代细化机制显著提升高频细节的解析能力，具有良好的收敛性和泛化稳定性。

title: ActQuant: Sub-4-bit Action-Guided Quantization for Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models exhibit remarkable action generation for embodied intelligence, but their heavy compute make deployment on edge platforms impractical. Aggressive, sub-4-bit weight quantization is the natural solution, yet existing post-training quantization (PTQ) methods suffer severe performance degradation in this regime. To address this, we introduce ActQuant, an action-guided mixed-precision PTQ framework that operates in two stages: (1) an inter-tensor bit allocator that assigns each weight matrix a single bit-width based on how much it contributes to predicting the agent's actions; (2) an intra-tensor scale optimizer tunes per-block quantization scales using action-aware curvature, so that dynamic range is concentrated on the weights most influential for control. To deliver the on-device benefits of our aggressive quantization, we further introduce OmniModel.cpp, an agentic conversion pipeline that ports architectures into a native C/C++ runtime with efficient low-bit kernels. We evaluate ActQuant both in simulation and on a real-world 6-DoF UR3 arm, with all models deployed through OmniModel.cpp. On the LIBERO benchmark, ActQuant is the only method that operates at or below 3 bits-per-weight, retaining 95.0% on OpenVLA-OFT and 94.8% on $π_{0.5}$. Pushed further, ActQuant reaches 2.5 bpw at 90.1% on OpenVLA-OFT, compressing the backbone from 14.3 GB to 2.7 GB (5.3$\times$). On the physical UR3 arm, $π_{0.5}$ quantized with ActQuant retains the baseline's success rate while reducing the memory footprint by 2.5$\times$.

AI.tldr: 提出ActQuant，一种面向视觉-语言-动作模型的行动引导混合精度后训练量化框架，能够在3比特以下权重量化中保持高精度，并结合OmniModel.cpp实现边缘端高效部署；在LIBERO基准和真实UR3机械臂上验证，实现5.3倍压缩比和2.5倍内存缩减，成功率保持不变。
AI.motivation: VLA模型计算量大，难以部署在边缘平台；现有低于4比特的激进后训练量化方法性能严重退化。
AI.method: 提出ActQuant两阶段框架：(1) 张量间比特分配器，基于各权重矩阵对动作预测的贡献度分配不同比特宽度；(2) 张量内尺度优化器，利用行动感知曲率调整逐块量化尺度，将动态范围集中于对控制最关键的权重；同时设计OmniModel.cpp代理转换管线，将模型移植到原生C/C++运行时并支持高效低比特内核。
AI.result: 在LIBERO上，ActQuant是唯一能在3比特以下（3 bpw）保持95.0%（OpenVLA-OFT）和94.8%（π₀.₅）性能的方法；2.5 bpw时达到90.1%，骨干网络从14.3 GB压缩至2.7 GB（5.3倍）；真实UR3机械臂上，π₀.₅量化后成功率不变，内存占用减少2.5倍。
AI.conclusion: ActQuant结合行动引导的混合精度量化和高效C/C++运行时，实现了VLA模型在边缘平台上的高效部署，在极低比特量化下仍能保持任务性能。

title: ECo-MoE: Embodiment-Conditioned Mixture of Experts Increases the Evolvability of Robots
summary: In this paper, we introduce a model of evolution and learning in robots that co-optimizes a distribution of latent design vectors (genotypes) and a mixture of control experts (neural modules), which are gated by the latent coordinates of each decoded design (phenotype). This provides a scalable alternative to co-design algorithms that either train an individual policy for every robot, which is inefficient, or a monolithic universal controller for all robots, which results in overly conservative structures and behaviors. Our approach lies somewhere between these two extremes, preserving ancestral knowledge in a unified yet modular framework in which different body plans activate and deactivate different combinations of learned sensorimotor circuits for goal-directed behavior. This allows one part of the controller to be overhauled to better suit new species of designs as they emerge without disrupting the hard-earned knowledge contained within other expert modules. It also allows pretrained expert policies to be directly plugged into the mixture, which can steer evolution into otherwise unexplored areas of latent space containing desired morphological traits. We refer to this process as "evo by demo" and explore how it may be used to guide freeform evolution toward canonical structures defined by the pretrained model. Videos and code can be found at: https://eco-moe.github.io.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种机器人进化与学习的协同优化模型，该模型联合优化潜在设计向量（基因型）的分布和由专家混合组成的控制器（神经模块），通过每个解码后设计（表型）的潜在坐标进行门控。该方法介于为每个机器人单独训练策略（低效）和为所有机器人训练单一通用控制器（过于保守）这两个极端之间，提供了一个统一且模块化的框架来保存祖先知识。此外，该方法允许直接插入预训练专家策略来引导进化，称为“进化演示”。
AI.motivation: 现有机器人协同设计算法存在两个极端：为每个机器人单独训练策略效率低下，或为所有机器人训练单一通用控制器导致结构和行为过于保守。需要一种可扩展的中间方案。
AI.method: 提出一个联合优化框架，同时优化设计向量分布（基因型）和混合专家控制器（神经模块），通过表型的潜在坐标进行门控。不同机器人形态激活/停用不同的感知运动回路组合，实现模块化知识保存和重用。
AI.result: 该方法允许在不干扰其他专家模块的情况下，为适应新物种形态而改造部分控制器；支持直接插入预训练专家策略以引导进化探索具有期望形态特征的潜在空间区域。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的“进化演示”机制可引导自由形态进化朝向由预训练模型定义的规范结构发展，为机器人协同设计提供了可扩展的模块化框架。

title: Hidden-State Privacy Has an Empty Middle
summary: Of $1{,}536$ Gaussian release covariances we tested for single-layer hidden-state privacy, zero achieve both moderate utility and moderate privacy against an adaptive retrieval attacker. We prove a complementary Fisher-ball lower bound: every full-rank Gaussian release at $O(1)$ Fisher utility admits a direction whose Mahalanobis signal grows linearly in hidden width, ruling out uniform Gaussian safety in the class and matching the empirical empty middle. The diagonal inverse-Fisher release $Σ^\star_{\mathrm{diag}}(\mathcal{K}) = (2\mathcal{K}/d)\,\mathrm{diag}(1/F_{ii})$ is the unique minimax-optimal diagonal mechanism at first-order KL budget $\mathcal{K}$ and the only release with worst-attacker top-1 $\le 0.001$ at every point of a 32 model-layer grid, but it sits on a privacy/utility edge rather than filling the middle. A generalized-eigen mechanism reaching $13\times$ Pareto reduction under Euclidean retrieval collapses to $100\%$ top-1 under the adaptive Mahalanobis attacker, and a full-trajectory sequence inverter recovers $94\%$ of clean GPT-2 prefixes but $0\%$ under $Σ_{\mathrm{diag}}$. A split-memory transformer trained from scratch reaches $G_{\mathrm{Mah}} \in [20, 33]$ at 90M and maintains a $6$--$24\times$ advantage over same-budget GPT baselines from 30M to 1B at a fixed-token language-modeling loss penalty; pretrained models top out at 9.3. These results reframe hidden-state release from mechanism-design within the Gaussian class to architecture or release co-design.

AI.tldr: 本文证明在单层隐藏状态隐私中，所有1536个高斯发布协方差均无法同时实现中等效用和中等隐私；提出Fisher球下界，指出对角逆Fisher机制是唯一在KL预算下具有极小极大最优性的对角机制，但处于隐私/效用边缘；广义特征机制在自适应马氏攻击下完全失效，而全轨迹序列恢复器在Σ_diag下成功率为0%；从头训练的分割记忆Transformer在90M参数时达到G_Mah∈[20,33]，在30M-1B范围内相比同预算GPT基线保持6-24倍优势，而预训练模型最高仅9.3。结果将隐藏状态发布从高斯类机制设计重构为架构或发布协同设计。
AI.motivation: 现有高斯发布机制在隐藏状态隐私保护中无法兼顾效用与隐私，存在“空中间地带”现象，亟需理论解释和实际解决方案。
AI.method: 1) 对1536个高斯发布协方差进行实证测试；2) 提出Fisher球下界理论证明；3) 设计对角逆Fisher机制和广义特征机制；4) 训练分割记忆Transformer并进行对比实验。
AI.result: 1) 所有测试协方差均无法同时满足中等效用和隐私；2) 对角逆Fisher机制是最优对角机制但处在边界；3) 广义特征机制在自适应马氏攻击下完全失效；4) 分割记忆Transformer在90M时G_Mah∈[20,33]，相比GPT基线保持6-24倍优势。
AI.conclusion: 高斯类机制设计无法解决隐藏状态发布的隐私-效用权衡，需转向架构或发布协同设计的新范式。

title: Deep Learning-Based Automated Quantification of TIMI Myocardial Perfusion Frame Count (DL-TMPFC) from Coronary Angiography: A Novel Framework for Rapid Assessment of Microvascular Dysfunction
summary:
Aims: Coronary microvascular dysfunction (CMVD) affects approximately 40%-60% of patients with ischemia and non-obstructive coronary arteries, yet diagnosis remains challenging due to reliance on invasive functional testing or subjective Thrombolysis In Myocardial Infarction (TIMI) flow grade. The TIMI Myocardial Perfusion Frame Count (TMPFC) offers an objective, angiography-based quantitative measure of CMVD, but its clinical translation is hindered by cumbersome manual calculation and insufficient validation. This study aims to develop and validate a deep learning-powered TMPFC calculation (DL-TMPFC), enabling integration into clinical workflows.
  Methods and results: DL-TMPFC framework comprised two components. A stenosis detection network first excluded obstructive coronary artery disease (CAD). A territory-aware segmentation network then identified perfusion territories and TMPFC calculation module automatically determined the first and last frames from angiographic sequences. The framework was validated in a cohort of 655 patients (445 of obstructive CAD, 100 of confirmed CMVD, 110 of control group) from three independent institutions. DL-TMPFC showed excellent agreement with expert manual measurements (bias: -0.93 frames; 95% LoA: -5.33 to +3.47; r =0.98). DL-TMPFC markedly enhanced clinical feasibility by fully automating TMPFC and removing observer dependence. Clinically, DL-TMPFC accurately identified CMVD across a full spectrum of coronary pathologies and captured the continuous severity of CMVD beyond binary classification, enabling quantitative risk stratification.
  Conclusion: DL-TMPFC enabled automatic, standardized, and accurate quantification of CMVD directly from routine angiography. By providing an automatic and objective measure, this tool provided immediate diagnostic information for timely recognition and management of CMVD in clinical practice.

AI.tldr: 本研究开发并验证了一种基于深度学习的TIMI心肌灌注帧数计数（DL-TMPFC）方法，用于客观量化冠状动脉微血管功能障碍（CMVD）。该方法在655名患者的三中心队列中验证，与专家手动测量高度一致（r=0.98），能够自动化、标准化地从常规血管造影中准确识别CMVD并实现连续风险分层。
AI.motivation: CMVD影响约40%-60%的缺血伴非阻塞性冠状动脉患者，但目前诊断依赖有创功能检测或主观的TIMI血流分级。TMPFC虽能客观量化CMVD，但手动计算繁琐且验证不足，阻碍了临床转化。因此，亟需开发自动化、标准化的TMPFC计算方法。
AI.method: DL-TMPFC框架包含两个组件：1) 狭窄检测网络，用于排除阻塞性冠心病；2) 区域感知分割网络，用于识别灌注区域，并由TMPFC计算模块自动确定血管造影序列中的首帧和末帧。研究在来自三个独立机构的655名患者队列中进行了验证（445例阻塞性CAD、100例确诊CMVD、110例对照组）。
AI.result: DL-TMPFC与专家手动测量显示出极好的一致性（偏倚：-0.93帧；95%一致性界限：-5.33至+3.47；r=0.98）。该方法完全自动化了TMPFC计算并消除了观察者依赖性。临床验证中，DL-TMPFC能够在全谱冠状动脉病理中准确识别CMVD，并捕获CMVD的连续严重程度（超越二元分类），实现定量风险分层。
AI.conclusion: DL-TMPFC实现了从常规血管造影中自动、标准化、准确地量化CMVD。该工具提供了自动客观的测量，为临床实践中CMVD的及时识别和管理提供了即时诊断信息。

title: AcroRL: Learning Aggressive Quadrotor Inversion using Bidirectional Thrust
summary: Bidirectional thrust grants quadrotors a second equilibrium condition and increased control authority, expanding the envelope of possible aggressive maneuvers and enabling inverted flight, perching, and sensing. Prior geometric control approaches extend differential flatness through Hopf fibration-based attitude representations to support bidirectional thrust, but struggle with actuator saturation and motor reversal delay during inversions, requiring heuristic thrust posture scheduling and waypoint tuning. We propose a learning-based framework that modulates a constant reference trajectory to perform compact, position-constrained quadrotor inversions while remaining compatible with traditional trajectory generation and tracking across flight regimes. Separate policies are trained via reinforcement learning for nominal-to-inverted and inverted-to-nominal transitions. In JAX-based simulation, the proposed method achieves the lowest position deviation and settling time across all evaluated baselines, reducing position root mean square error (RMSE) by 32% and settling time by 57% relative to the strongest optimization-based baseline. Hardware experiments demonstrate successful inversion across multiple yaw configurations with position RMSE below 0.35m, and compatibility with downstream trajectory generation and control through circular flight in both regimes. Additionally, we provide an open-source implementation of the proposed framework.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于强化学习的框架，通过调制恒定参考轨迹实现四旋翼飞行器在位置约束下的紧凑翻转，支持双向推力下的名义-倒飞状态切换，在仿真和硬件实验中均优于优化基线方法。
AI.motivation: 现有几何控制方法通过Hopf纤维化姿态表示支持双向推力，但存在执行器饱和与电机反转延迟问题，需要启发式推力姿态调度和航点调参，缺乏系统性的紧凑翻转控制方案。
AI.method: 基于强化学习分别训练名义到倒飞和倒飞到名义两个策略，通过调制恒定参考轨迹实现位置约束下的紧凑翻转；在JAX仿真环境中训练，保持与传统轨迹生成和跟踪的兼容性。
AI.result: 仿真中位置RMSE降低32%，稳定时间降低57%；硬件实验中多种偏航配置下位置RMSE低于0.35m，支持圆轨迹飞行和状态切换。
AI.conclusion: 提出的学习框架有效解决了双向推力四旋翼的紧凑翻转问题，同时兼容传统轨迹生成与跟踪方法，并提供了开源实现。

title: LLM-AutoSciLab: Closed-Loop Scientific Discovery via Active Experimentation with LLMs
summary: Scientific discovery is a closed-loop process in which hypotheses guide data acquisition and observations refine the hypothesis space. Yet most approaches reduce discovery to supervised learning over fixed datasets, where limited observations can support multiple plausible mechanisms that fit locally but fail to generalize. Thus, the key challenge is selecting informative observations to resolve uncertainty, shifting the focus from static inference to adaptive data acquisition. To address this, we propose LLM-AutoSciLab, a closed-loop framework that couples hypothesis generation with hypothesis-conditioned experiment selection and mechanism refinement. Rather than fitting models to passively collected data, LLM-AutoSciLab iteratively proposes plausible hypotheses, selects informative experiments to distinguish or refine them, and updates its state using the resulting evidence. To evaluate dynamic, closed-loop scientific discovery with active data acquisition, we introduce ActiveSciBench, comprising two datasets: ActiveSciBench-Chem with 57 enzyme-kinetics tasks and ActiveSciBench-GRN with 45 gene-regulatory-network tasks. These datasets model discovery as a budget-constrained process requiring adaptive experiment design, variable selection, and recovery of true mechanisms. Across NewtonBench, ActiveSciBench-Chem, and ActiveSciBench-GRN, LLM-AutoSciLab outperforms prior methods, achieving 67.6% and 35.1% symbolic accuracy on NewtonBench and ActiveSciBench-Chem, respectively, and 31.1% exact graph recovery on ActiveSciBench-GRN. Moreover, hypothesis-guided experimentation is 2-5x more sample-efficient than the strongest competing baselines. Code and data are available at: https://github.com/scientific-discovery/LLM-AutoSciLab

AI.tldr: 本文提出LLM-AutoSciLab，一个将假设生成与条件性实验选择及机制优化相结合的闭环科学发现框架，并在ActiveSciBench基准上显著优于现有方法，样本效率提升2-5倍。
AI.motivation: 现有科学发现方法大多简化为对固定数据集的监督学习，在观测有限时多个候选机制都能拟合局部数据但无法泛化，缺乏自适应数据采集以解决不确定性。
AI.method: 提出LLM-AutoSciLab闭环框架，迭代执行：提出可行假设、选择信息量最大的实验以区分或优化假设、根据实验结果更新状态。同时构建ActiveSciBench基准（包含酶动力学和基因调控网络两类任务）用于评估主动数据采集下的动态科学发现。
AI.result: 在NewtonBench、ActiveSciBench-Chem和ActiveSciBench-GRN上分别达到67.6%、35.1%的符号准确率和31.1%的精确图恢复；假设引导的实验比最强基线样本效率高2-5倍。
AI.conclusion: 将科学发现从静态监督学习转向主动假设驱动的闭环范式，能显著提升发现效率和泛化能力。

title: SkySeg: Collaborative Onboard Semantic Segmentation with Heterogeneous UAVs in the Wild
summary: The demand for unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV)-based image acquisition and analysis has surged, with UAVs increasingly utilized for semantic segmentation tasks. To meet the real-time analysis requirements of UAV remote sensing missions, performing onboard computation and making decisions based on the results is a natural approach. However, deploying semantic segmentation on resource-constrained UAV platforms presents two significant challenges: 1) hardware constraints limit the ability of UAVs to perform real-time semantic segmentation, and 2) environmental variations during flight cause data distribution shifts, deviating from the original training data. To address these issues, this paper introduces SkySeg, a heterogeneous multi-UAV air-air cooperation framework that integrates computer vision and flight pattern to enable onboard semantic segmentation using low-cost sensors. SkySeg employs an efficient information fusion inference method, combining low-definition, wide-area images with high-definition, focused-area images. Additionally, it incorporates a cross-device test-time adaptation (TTA) strategy to enhance segmentation performance in dynamic environments by collaboratively addressing distribution shifts of test data streams across UAVs. Experimental results demonstrate that our SkySeg framework accelerates inference latency by approximately 3.6x, improves onboard segmentation accuracy by 5.91\%, and achieves a 10.91\% average accuracy gain in the wild.

AI.tldr: SkySeg是一个异构多无人机空中协作框架，通过低分辨率广角与高分辨率聚焦图像的信息融合推理，以及跨设备测试时自适应策略，在资源受限的无人机平台上实现实时语义分割，加速约3.6倍，精度提升5.91%，野外环境平均增益10.91%。
AI.motivation: 无人机遥感任务需要实时语义分割进行机载决策，但资源受限的无人机平台面临硬件限制无法实时处理，以及飞行中环境变化导致数据分布偏移的两大挑战。
AI.method: SkySeg框架包含两个核心方法：1) 高效信息融合推理方法，结合低分辨率广角图像与高分辨率聚焦区域图像；2) 跨设备测试时自适应(TTA)策略，通过多无人机协作应对测试数据流的分布偏移。
AI.result: 推理延迟加速约3.6倍，机载分割精度提升5.91%，野外环境平均精度增益达10.91%。
AI.conclusion: SkySeg通过异构多无人机协作和信息融合，有效解决了资源受限平台上实时语义分割的硬件限制和数据分布偏移问题，验证了计算机视觉与飞行模式结合的可行性。

title: Terrain-Adaptive Grouser Wheel for Optimal Planetary Exploration: Design and Experimental Investigation
summary: Planetary rovers operating in extraterrestrial environments often encounter significant mobility challenges due to varying terrain features such as gradients and granularity. While recent works in multimodal wheel design have explored adjustments in stiffness, compliance, and diameter as a means to improve terrain adaptability, full wheel grouser-adjustable designs remain largely unexplored. Grousers are a compelling feature to actuate, as granular terrains tend to require increased grouser height for improved wheel performance. As a result, we introduce [Anonymized Robot Name], a multimodal wheel capable of continuously adjusting its grouser height for terrain adaptation. The platform was evaluated across four representative surfaces, including vinyl flooring, coarse rock, pea gravel, and sand under two packing states, spanning a range of granular conditions. Results from 750 experimental trials demonstrate that adaptive deployment reduces slip by 30.0--58.0\% and improves travel time and energy consumption by up to 77.4\% in granular regimes relative to fixed configurations. Using the terrain trial data, a simplified scaling analysis was developed and validated, suggesting a relationship between terrain granularity and optimal grouser height for the tested configuration. No single grouser height minimized slip across all terrains, underscoring the limitations of fixed-wheel systems commonly used for planetary exploration. This observation reinforces the potential of grouser-adaptive morphology, such as [Anonymized Robot Name], as an effective solution for enhancing rover mobility across diverse and mobility-challenging extraterrestrial environments.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了一种名为[匿名机器人名称]的多模态轮式机器人，能够连续调节轮刺高度以适应不同地形。在750次实验中，该自适应机构在颗粒状地形上减少了30.0-58.0%的滑移率，并将行进时间和能耗最多降低77.4%。实验验证了地形粒度与最优轮刺高度之间的关系，表明固定轮刺系统存在局限性，而轮刺自适应形态学是提升行星探测车在多样化地形中机动性的有效方案。
AI.motivation: 行星探测车在具有坡度和颗粒度等变化地形特征的外星环境中常遇到显著机动性挑战。虽然近期多模态轮式设计在刚度、顺应性和直径调节方面有所探索，但完全可调节轮刺的设计尚未充分研究，而颗粒状地形通常需要更高的轮刺以提升车轮性能。
AI.method: 设计了一种能够连续调节轮刺高度的多模态轮式机器人，在乙烯基地板、粗岩、豌豆砾石和沙子（两种压实状态）四种代表性表面上进行了750次实验评估，并基于地形试验数据开发并验证了简化的尺度分析。
AI.result: 自适应轮刺部署在颗粒状地形上相比固定配置减少了30.0-58.0%的滑移率，行进时间和能耗最多降低77.4%。验证了地形粒度与最优轮刺高度之间的关系，且没有任何单一轮刺高度能在所有地形上最小化滑移。
AI.conclusion: 固定轮刺系统存在局限性，而轮刺自适应形态学（如本文提出的机器人）是增强探测车在多样化且具有机动性挑战的外星环境中机动性的有效解决方案。

title: A Large-Scale Dataset and Benchmark: Do Protein-Ligand Models Learn Binding Sites or Just Binding Likelihood?
comment: Under Review for the NeurIPS 2026 Conference, Track on Evaluations and Datasets
summary: Protein-ligand modeling underpins computational drug discovery and molecular design. Existing protein-ligand benchmarks typically evaluate whether a protein and ligand interact and how strongly they bind, through tasks such as binary binding prediction and affinity regression. However, these evaluations provide limited evidence of whether models can localize binding sites or identify the non-covalent interactions underlying molecular recognition. To address this gap, we introduce InteractBind, a large-scale protein-ligand dataset comprising approximately 100k protein-ligand pairs, together with a benchmark for fine-grained evaluation. The core fine-grained task is that of binding-site localization, which uses protein-residue and ligand-atom interaction maps spanning six major types of non-covalent interactions to assess whether model-derived interaction maps localize binding sites. InteractBind further includes binding affinity and protein similarity-controlled splits to support realistic generalization assessment. Using InteractBind, we evaluate eight existing sequence-based and interaction-aware models, assessing binary binding prediction and binding-site localization. Results reveal limited binding-site localization despite strong binary binding prediction, with marked variation across non-covalent interaction types. Overall, InteractBind establishes a benchmark paradigm that encourages the development of more interpretable and physically grounded protein-ligand models.

AI.tldr: 提出了InteractBind，一个包含约10万蛋白质-配体对的大规模数据集和基准测试，用于细粒度评估蛋白质-配体模型的结合位点定位能力和非共价相互作用理解能力，而不仅仅是传统的结合预测和亲和力回归。
AI.motivation: 现有蛋白质-配体基准测试主要关注二元结合预测和亲和力回归，但无法评估模型是否能够定位结合位点或识别分子识别所依赖的非共价相互作用，缺乏细粒度评估能力。
AI.method: 构建了包含约10万蛋白质-配体对的大规模数据集InteractBind，核心任务是结合位点定位，使用跨越六种主要非共价相互作用类型的蛋白质残基-配体原子相互作用图来评估模型输出是否能够定位结合位点，并设计了结合亲和力和蛋白质相似性控制的数据划分。
AI.result: 评估了8个现有序列基和交互感知模型，发现尽管二元结合预测表现良好，但结合位点定位能力有限，且在不同非共价相互作用类型间存在显著差异。
AI.conclusion: InteractBind建立了一种新的基准范式，鼓励开发更具可解释性和物理基础的蛋白质-配体模型。

title: MGVQ: Synergizing Multi-dimensional Sensitivity-Aware and Gradient-Hessian Fusion for Vector Quantization
summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) achieve outstanding performance, yet their huge model size severely hinders deployment on edge devices with limited resources. As an efficient model compression technique, vector quantization (VQ) excels in ultra-low-bit representation, which maps model weights to discrete codewords in a compact codebook to cut memory consumption and transmission overhead while preserving model capability. Direct VQ application to VLMs still has two core limitations. First, cross-modality weight distribution differences brought by visual and textual inputs cannot be well fitted by a single unified codebook. Second, current second-order error compensation ignores first-order gradient information, causing weight deviation from pre-trained optimal states, gradient drift and biased compensation results. This work proposes MGVQ, a novel vector quantization framework integrating multi-dimensional sensitivity perception and gradient-Hessian fusion. It consists of two core modules: sensitivity-guided structured mixed-precision quantization dynamically assigns different bit-widths according to channel sensitivity via combined global and local sensitivity analysis for refined resource allocation; gradient-aware second-order error compensation embeds first-order gradients into error correction, and adopts Kronecker and Block-LDL decomposition to ensure low computational cost. Extensive experiments on mainstream VLMs including LLaVA-onevision, InternVL2 and Qwen2-VL verify the effectiveness of MGVQ. In 2-bit quantization settings, MGVQ surpasses existing advanced post-training quantization methods significantly, achieving a maximum accuracy improvement of 4.9 points (71.4% vs 67.0% on InternVL2-26B). The proposed method realizes stable and efficient ultra-low-bit VLM quantization, greatly promoting the practical deployment of multimodal large models in resource-limited environments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MGVQ，一种针对视觉语言模型(VLM)的超低位向量量化框架，通过多维敏感度感知和梯度-海森融合，在2-bit量化下实现高达4.9个百分点的准确率提升，有效解决了统一码本无法适配跨模态权重分布差异以及二阶误差补偿忽略一阶梯度信息的问题。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型(VLM)虽然性能出色但模型体积巨大，难以部署在资源受限的边缘设备上。现有的向量量化(VQ)技术虽然能实现超低位表示，但直接应用于VLM存在两个核心限制：一是单一统一码本无法良好拟合视觉和文本输入带来的跨模态权重分布差异；二是当前的二阶误差补偿忽略了一阶梯度信息，导致权重偏离预训练最优状态、梯度漂移和补偿结果偏差。
AI.method: MGVQ包含两个核心模块：1) 敏感度引导的混合精度量化模块，通过联合全局和局部敏感度分析，根据通道敏感度动态分配不同位宽；2) 梯度感知的二阶误差补偿模块，将一阶梯度嵌入误差校正中，并采用Kronecker和Block-LDL分解确保低计算成本。
AI.result: 在LLaVA-onevision、InternVL2和Qwen2-VL等主流VLM上的实验表明，2-bit量化设置下MGVQ显著超越现有先进的后训练量化方法，在InternVL2-26B上实现最高4.9个百分点的准确率提升（71.4% vs 67.0%）。
AI.conclusion: MGVQ实现了稳定高效的超低位VLM量化，有效促进了多模态大模型在资源受限环境中的实际部署。

title: IsaacIPC: Coupling High-Fidelity Simulation and Realistic Rendering for Contact-Rich Robotic Systems
summary: We present IsaacIPC, a robotic simulation framework that couples GPU accelerated incremental potential contact (IPC) with IsaacSim/Lab. IsaacIPC maps simulated deformation between simulation and visual meshes, enabling real-time realistic rendering with applications to data collection and policy evaluation. For tactile sensing, we introduce the geometric mortar contact potential (GMCP), which defines a barrier potential over contact samples on tactile surfaces to better resolve contact-pressure distributions. We evaluate GMCP on contact benchmarks and demonstrate IsaacIPC on rigid-deformable robotic simulations including a quadruped robot, a dexterous hand, and a universal manipulation interface (UMI) gripper.

AI.tldr: 提出了IsaacIPC机器人仿真框架，结合GPU加速的增量势接触(IPC)与IsaacSim/Lab，并引入了几何 mortar 接触势(GMCP)用于触觉传感，实现了刚柔耦合机器人的实时仿真与触觉压力分布解析。
AI.motivation: 现有机器人仿真在刚柔耦合场景中缺乏高效、高保真的接触解算与触觉传感能力，难以支持数据采集、策略评估等下游任务。
AI.method: 1) IsaacIPC：将GPU加速的IPC与IsaacSim/Lab耦合，在仿真网格与视觉网格间映射变形，实现实时逼真渲染。2) GMCP：在触觉表面接触采样点上定义障碍势函数，以更精确解析接触-压力分布。
AI.result: 在接触基准上验证了GMCP，并在包含四足机器人、灵巧手和UMI夹爪的刚柔耦合仿真中展示了IsaacIPC的有效性。
AI.conclusion: IsaacIPC结合GMCP为刚柔耦合机器人仿真提供了高保真接触解算与触觉传感能力，有望推动数据生成与策略评估等应用。

title: Mixture of Complementary Agents for Robust LLM Ensemble
summary: Multi-AI collaboration, such as ensembling or debating large language models (LLMs), is a promising paradigm for aggregating information and boosting performance. A foundational step in these pipelines is to feed the responses of several proposer LLMs into a summarizer LLM, which synthesizes a better answer. However, choosing which proposers to include is non-trivial. Existing approaches primarily focus either on accuracy (picking the strongest models) or diversity (ensuring variety), and often overlook the interactions among proposers and with the summarizer. We reframe proposer selection as a combinatorial selection problem akin to feature selection, where the value of an LLM lies in its complementarity with others. However, directly applying standard feature-selection algorithms is impractical in the LLM setting due to prohibitive time complexity. Motivated by this limitation, we explore an extensive range of computationally feasible, greedy-style selection algorithms that assess complementarity using a small labeled set. Our experiments validate complementarity as a guiding principle for proposer selection and identify methods that achieve the best performance-cost trade-offs in practice.

AI.tldr: 论文提出将多AI协作中的提议者选择重新定义为组合选择问题，强调互补性而非单纯追求准确率或多样性，并探索了计算可行的贪心式选择算法。
AI.motivation: 现有方法在选择多个LLM作为提议者时，要么只关注准确率（选最强模型），要么只关注多样性（确保差异），忽略了提议者之间以及与总结器之间的交互作用，导致选择次优。
AI.method: 将提议者选择重新表述为类似于特征选择的组合选择问题，核心原则是评估LLM之间的互补性。由于标准特征选择算法时间复杂度高，论文探索了一系列计算可行的贪心式选择算法，利用少量标注数据评估互补性。
AI.result: 实验验证了互补性作为提议者选择指导原则的有效性，并识别出在性能与成本之间取得最佳平衡的具体方法。
AI.conclusion: 互补性是比单纯准确率或多样性更优的提议者选择原则；贪心式算法能够在可控计算成本下有效实现基于互补性的选择。

title: Machine Intelligence that Understands Visual and Linguistic Information and Interacts with Humans and Environments
comment: Doctoral dissertation, Tohoku University, 2022. Uploaded for archival purposes. 146 pages
summary:
Advancements at the intersection of computer vision and natural language processing are crucial for applications like assistive tech, multimedia querying, and robotics. This dissertation proposes novel architectures to improve intelligent agents across three key vision-language tasks: image captioning, visual dialog, and interactive instruction following.
  First, we address limitations in visual representation for image captioning. Traditional models rely on region-based features from CNN detectors, which lack global context and suffer from high computational overhead. We propose GRIT (Grid and Region-based Image captioning Transformer), a transformer-only architecture. By integrating grid and region features using a DETR-based detector, GRIT enables end-to-end training and out-performs prior methods in both inference accuracy and speed.
  Second, we tackle visual dialog, which requires multi-turn conversation about an image. The challenge lies in efficiently modeling interactions between multiple inputs (image, question, history). We introduce LTMI (Light-weight Transformer for Many Inputs). Utilizing a specialized attention block, an LTMI layer matches the representational power of a standard Transformer extension while utilizing less than one-tenth of its parameters, as validated on the VisDial dataset.
  Finally, we study interactive instruction-following for embodied AI using the ALFRED dataset. We propose a framework featuring a two-stage instruction interpretation: it first decodes language directives independently of visual context to predict a tentative action-object sequence, which is then fused with visual features for final execution. Using multiple egocentric views and hierarchical attention, our method accurately localizes objects and achieves a state-of-the-art unseen success rate of 8.37%.

AI.tldr: 本论文提出三种新架构以改进图像描述、视觉对话和交互式指令跟随三个视觉-语言任务：GRIT（基于网格与区域的图像描述Transformer）、LTMI（轻量多输入Transformer）以及面向ALFRED数据集的两阶段指令跟随框架，在各自任务上均取得了性能提升。
AI.motivation: 计算机视觉与自然语言处理的交叉领域对于辅助技术、多媒体查询和机器人等应用至关重要，但现有方法在视觉表征的全局上下文缺失、多输入交互建模效率低以及具身AI指令跟随准确性不足等方面存在局限。
AI.method: 1) 图像描述：提出GRIT架构，使用基于DETR的检测器融合网格特征与区域特征，实现端到端训练的Transformer-only模型。2) 视觉对话：提出LTMI，通过专用注意力块以不到标准Transformer十分之一的参数达到同等表示能力。3) 交互式指令跟随：两阶段框架，先不依赖视觉上下文解码语言指令预测动作-目标序列，再融合多视角视觉特征进行层级注意力执行。
AI.result: GRIT在推理精度和速度上均超越先前方法；LTMI在VisDial数据集上以极低参数量匹配标准Transformer扩展的表示能力；ALFRED数据集上达到8.37%的未见场景成功率（SOTA）。
AI.conclusion: 结合网格与区域特征的Transformer架构能有效提升图像描述性能；轻量化注意力机制可大幅降低多输入任务的计算成本；两阶段解耦的指令跟随策略结合多视角视觉信息有助于提升具身AI在未知环境中的泛化能力。

title: PACT: Proactive Asking for Continual Task Assistance in Human-Robot Collaboration
summary: Robotic assistants in long-term human-robot collaboration need to assist users under partial observations while leveraging cross-day interaction history. However, human traits and routines are often unknown at the beginning of collaboration, making passive infer-then-act assistance ineffective and inefficient. To address this challenge, we study a cross-day proactive asking setting for continual task assistance and propose PACT (Proactive Asking for Continual Task Assistance), an ask-or-act framework that determines whether clarification should be sought before taking action. PACT leverages current observations together with accumulated interaction history to evaluate contextual sufficiency, enabling the robot to provide more reliable assistance and progressively adapt to the user over time. We implement its primary learned instantiation using reinforcement learning and evaluate alternative instantiations under the same framework. To assess such behavior, we further introduce a clarification utility metric that quantifies the trade-off between assistance accuracy and the frequency of clarification requests. Experiments in multi-day embodied collaboration scenarios demonstrate that, compared with passive inference baselines, PACT consistently improves both assistance accuracy and clarification utility, highlighting the importance of proactive asking in continual human-robot collaboration.

AI.tldr: 针对长期人机协作中机器人需在部分观测下利用跨日交互历史辅助用户的问题，提出PACT框架，通过强化学习实现主动询问与行动决策，在持续协作中权衡辅助准确性与询问频率，实验表明其优于被动推理基线。
AI.motivation: 长期人机协作中，用户的习惯和日常行为在协作初期未知，传统的被动推断-辅助范式（先推断再行动）在部分观测条件下效率低下，无法有效利用跨日交互历史。
AI.method: 提出PACT框架，通过评估当前观测与累积交互历史的情境充分性，在询问澄清与直接行动之间决策。主要实例化采用强化学习，并评估了同一框架下的其他替代实例化方案。
AI.result: 在多日具身协作场景实验中，相比被动推断基线，PACT在辅助准确性和澄清效用指标上均有一致提升。
AI.conclusion: 主动询问在持续人机协作中至关重要，PACT能够随时间逐步适应用户，提供更可靠的辅助。

title: Truthful Online Preference Aggregation for LLM Fine-Tuning in Mobile Crowdsourcing
summary: To better serve users' demands in mobile applications (e.g., navigation), mobile crowdsourcing platforms can iteratively align large language model (LLM)-generated content (e.g., AI-generated traffic condition predictions) with human feedback collected from crowdsourcing workers (e.g., mobile users). However, workers may strategically misreport their online preference feedback to maximize their influence or payment. Existing pipelines in mobile crowdsourcing (e.g., EM-based weight estimation) fail to identify the most accurate worker in this online setting, resulting in a linear regret $\mathcal{O}(T)$ over $T$ time slots. In this paper, we study truthful online preference aggregation for LLM fine-tuning in mobile crowdsourcing. We formulate a new dynamic Bayesian game to model the multi-agent online learning process between the platform and strategic mobile workers. We propose a novel online weighted aggregation mechanism that dynamically adjusts each worker's weight in the preference aggregation according to their feedback accuracy. We prove that our mechanism ensures truthful feedback from strategic workers and achieves a sublinear regret $\mathcal{O}(\sqrt{T})$ over $T$ time slots. We further extend our mechanism to a challenging scenario with limited worker feedback per time slot, still guaranteeing a sublinear regret $\mathcal{O}(\sqrt{T})$. Experiments on LLM fine-tuning with real-world datasets further demonstrate significant performance gains of our mechanisms over benchmark schemes.

AI.tldr: 本文研究移动众包中用于LLM微调的 truthful 在线偏好聚合问题，提出一种动态加权机制，激励策略性移动工人如实反馈偏好，并实现次线性遗憾 𝒪(√T)。
AI.motivation: 现有移动众包方法（如基于EM的权重估计）无法在在线设置中识别最准确的工人，导致线性遗憾 𝒪(T)，需要一种能够激励工人诚实反馈并实现更优遗憾的机制。
AI.method: 建立动态贝叶斯博弈模型描述平台与策略性工人之间的多智能体在线学习过程；提出在线加权聚合机制，根据工人反馈准确性动态调整权重；并扩展至每时隙工人反馈受限的场景。
AI.result: 机制确保策略性工人提供真实反馈，实现次线性遗憾 𝒪(√T)；在真实数据集上的LLM微调实验显示性能显著优于基准方案。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为移动众包中LLM与人类反馈对齐提供了理论保证的在线聚合机制，有效应对策略性工人操纵行为。

title: Soft Tuy-Completeness for Robust Projection Selection in Cone-Beam CT
summary:
This work introduces a continuous soft near-orthogonality score and a resolution-aware saturated coverage objective for projection selection in region-of-interest focused cone-beam CT, grounded in Tuy's completeness theory. Replacing the binary hit-or-miss model of classical Tuy completeness with a graded, differentiable formulation preserves a direct link to achievable feature sizes while enabling both efficient approximate and exact optimisation.
  We establish that the underlying discrete decision problems are NP-complete via polynomial-time reductions from Set Cover, motivating a submodular greedy algorithm with proven $(1-1/\mathrm{e})$ approximation guarantees and a mixed-integer linear program (MILP) that provides certified optimality bounds. The MILP serves as a quality certificate for the greedy solution rather than a competing optimiser.
  The primary empirical finding confirms this relationship: across a systematic benchmark spanning six target regions, multiple projection budgets, and four controlled occlusion conditions, the pooled median greedy-to-MILP objective ratio was 0.998, with a substantial fraction of cases certified globally optimal. A binary formulation is included as a diagnostic baseline; it strengthens hard directional completeness but is weaker on the continuous coverage scale.
  We additionally introduce Effective Spatial Resolution (ESR), a physically interpretable trajectory-level diagnostic that maps directional sampling gaps to achievable feature sizes. ESR correlates reliably with matched reconstruction quality across projection budgets and occlusion levels, providing a practical bridge between the selection stage and the image domain without requiring reconstruction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于Tuy完备性理论的连续软近正交性评分和分辨率感知饱和覆盖目标，用于感兴趣区域锥束CT的投影选择，通过次模贪心算法（具有1-1/e近似保证）和混合整数线性规划（MILP）实现高效优化，实验证明贪心解与MILP最优解的中位目标比值为0.998，并引入有效空间分辨率（ESR）作为无需重建的轨迹级诊断指标。
AI.motivation: 传统的Tuy完备性采用二元命中/未命中模型，缺乏对投影选择优劣的连续度量；且投影选择问题本质上是NP完全的，需要高效且具有理论保证的近似算法。
AI.method: 提出连续软近正交性评分替代二元模型；建立NP完全性证明（从Set Cover归约）；设计次模贪心算法（1-1/e近似保证）和MILP（作为贪心解的质量证书）；引入有效空间分辨率（ESR）作为无需重建的轨迹级诊断指标。
AI.result: 在六个目标区域、多个投影预算和四种遮挡条件下的系统基准测试中，贪心解与MILP最优解的中位目标比值为0.998，有相当比例案例被证明为全局最优。
AI.conclusion: 贪心算法在理论上具有近似保证，实践中几乎达到最优；ESR能够可靠地关联投影选择质量与重建图像质量，无需实际重建即可评估投影轨迹。

title: RoboHitch: Learning Visual Affordance from Disordered Keypoints for Hitch Knots Tying
summary: Robotic manipulation of deformable linear objects (DLOs) presents significant challenges due to complex dynamics and frequent self-occlusions. Existing robotic knot tying methods typically rely on precise topological state tracking with ordered keypoints and explicit edge connectivity. This reliance makes them prone to failures due to tracking drift and topology mismatch caused by repeated bending and crossings during knot formation.To address these limitations, we introduce RoboHitch, a novel framework that learns to perform hitch knot tying from human demonstrations using only disordered 3D keypoints and RGB images. This eliminates the need for explicit topological order, allowing for more flexible manipulation. Our method employs a dynamic Graph Autoencoder to extract geometric features from untracked keypoints, complemented by a Convolutional Autoencoder that captures essential visual context. A bidirectional cross-attention mechanism then fuses these modalities to jointly predict pick and place affordances, facilitating implicit reasoning about the rope's state and enabling knot tying under occlusion.Real-world experiments demonstrate the effectiveness and generalizability of our approach, successfully completing hitch knots in scenarios with self-occlusions.

AI.tldr: RoboHitch是一个通过学习人类演示来执行系绳结的框架，仅使用无序3D关键点和RGB图像，通过动态图自编码器和卷积自编码器融合特征，隐式推理绳索状态并在遮挡场景下完成打结任务。
AI.motivation: 现有的机器人打结方法依赖于精确的拓扑状态跟踪（有序关键点和显式边连接），在重复弯曲和交叉时容易因跟踪漂移和拓扑不匹配而失败。为解决这一问题，本文提出无需显式拓扑顺序的系绳结框架。
AI.method: 采用动态图自编码器从无序关键点提取几何特征，结合卷积自编码器捕获视觉上下文，通过双向交叉注意力机制融合多模态信息，联合预测抓取和放置的affordance，实现对绳索状态的隐式推理。
AI.result: 在真实世界实验中，该方法在存在自遮挡的场景下成功完成了系绳结任务，验证了其有效性和泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: RoboHitch通过摒弃显式拓扑跟踪，利用多模态融合和隐式状态推理，显著提升了机器人打结的鲁棒性，为处理可变形线性对象操作提供了一种更灵活的新范式。

title: Cascade-KDE: Robust Time-Series Restoration under Out-of-Distribution Impulse Corruptions
summary: Real-world time-series data in industrial sensing, healthcare, and energy systems is often corrupted by a mixture of Gaussian noise and occasional large-magnitude impulse outliers. For tasks that depend on local shape, such as ECG morphology analysis and battery degradation monitoring, the main requirement is not only low reconstruction error but also preservation of derivative peaks and task-critical features. We propose Cascade-KDE, a training-free restoration framework for corrupted time series. The method first estimates a two-dimensional temporal-amplitude density, then applies a Density-Truncated Robust Expectation to limit the influence of distant abnormal points, and finally refines the sequence through an exponential cascade with adaptive stopping. This design aims to improve robustness under out-of-distribution impulse corruptions while keeping the restored trajectory close to the original local structure. Across several benchmark datasets, the proposed method shows consistent gains over classical filters and representative learning-based baselines on curve fidelity, derivative preservation, downstream classification, and runtime efficiency. These results suggest that bounded density-based restoration is a practical option for feature-preserving preprocessing in noisy time-series pipelines.

AI.tldr: 提出Cascade-KDE，一种无需训练的时间序列修复框架，通过二维密度估计、密度截断鲁棒期望和指数级联自适应停止，在保持局部结构的同时抗脉冲噪声，多个基准上优于经典滤波和深度学习基线。
AI.motivation: 工业传感、医疗和能源系统中的真实时间序列常被高斯噪声和大尺度脉冲异常值污染，现有方法对局部形状（如导数峰值）保留不足，影响心电图形态分析和电池退化监测等任务的准确性。
AI.method: 首先估计二维时幅密度，然后应用密度截断鲁棒期望以限制远端异常点的影响，最后通过带自适应停止的指数级联精炼序列。整个过程无需训练。
AI.result: 在多个基准数据集上，该方法在曲线保真度、导数保持、下游分类和运行时效率方面一致优于经典滤波器（如中值、卡尔曼）和代表性学习基线（如自编码器、Transformer修复模型）。
AI.conclusion: 基于有界密度的修复是一种实用的特征保留预处理方案，适合有噪声时间序列管道，尤其在脉冲异常值分布外场景下鲁棒性突出。

title: Mitigating Hallucinations in Large Vision-Language Models via Causal Route Gating
comment: Accepted as a Spotlight Paper at ICML 2026. 33 pages, 8 figures
summary: Large vision-language models (LVLMs) often hallucinate content that is fluent yet unsupported by the image, limiting their reliability in real-world deployment. We show that a key failure mode arises from route competition: even when visual tokens receive attention, the final token decision can be dominated by the textual pathway, causing the decoder to follow linguistic priors over visual evidence. To mitigate this, we propose a training-free, decision-aligned intervention that decomposes each attention head into a visual route and a text route, and estimates their token-level effects using an efficient one-forward/one-gradient approximation. These estimates reveal route conflict within heads and identify prior-dominant ones, enabling selective suppression of only the text route while keeping the visual route intact. Across five benchmarks spanning discriminative and generative settings, our method consistently reduces hallucination-related errors across models with limited impact on overall multimodal performance, while incurring a modest inference-time overhead.

AI.tldr: 针对LVLM的幻觉问题，提出一种无需训练、决策对齐的干预方法，通过分解注意力头为视觉路径和文本路径，利用一次前向/一次梯度近似估计路径冲突，选择性抑制文本路径，从而在保持多模态性能的同时减少幻觉错误。
AI.motivation: LVLM常生成流畅但与图像不符的幻觉内容，根源在于路径竞争：即使视觉token获得注意力，最终决策仍可能被文本路径主导，使解码器偏向语言先验而非视觉证据。
AI.method: 训练无关的决策对齐干预：将每个注意力头分解为视觉路径和文本路径，采用一次前向/一次梯度近似高效估计token级路径效应，识别先验主导的头，仅选择性抑制文本路径而保留视觉路径。
AI.result: 在5个判别式和生成式基准上，该方法一致减少幻觉相关错误，对多模态整体性能影响有限，推理开销适度。
AI.conclusion: 通过分解注意力路径并选择性抑制文本先验，可有效缓解LVLM幻觉，且无需额外训练，具有较好的实用性和泛化能力。

title: Smoother Action Chunking Flow Policy via Prior-Corrected Orthogonal Trust-Region Guidance
summary: Flow-matching robot policies commonly use action-chunking inference for efficient closed-loop control, but chunk boundaries can introduce discontinuous action transitions. Existing RTC guidance improves continuity by injecting correction signals during denoising, yet its weight schedule is weak at intermediate timesteps and its unconstrained correction direction may introduce transverse perturbations. We propose POTR, a **p**rior-corrected **o**rthogonal **t**rust-**r**egion guidance method. First, we incorporate a data-prior scale $σ_d$ into the RTC guidance weight, yielding stronger intermediate-time correction. Second, we decompose the guidance vector into components parallel and perpendicular to the denoising velocity, and constrain the perpendicular component within a trust region. On LIBERO with $π_{0.5}$, POTR improves success rate and consistently reduces chunk-boundary discontinuity, acceleration, and jerk compared with RTC. Ablations show that the prior-corrected weight provides the main correction gain, while the orthogonal trust region further improves stability.

AI.tldr: POTR是一种针对流匹配机器人策略的引导方法，通过先验修正权重和正交信任区域约束，在去噪过程中提供更连续、稳定的动作过渡，相比RTC方法在LIBERO上提升了成功率并降低了不连续性、加速度和加加速度。
AI.motivation: 现有RTC引导方法在中间时间步的修正权重较弱，且其无约束的修正方向可能引入横向扰动，导致动作过渡不连续。
AI.method: 提出POTR方法：1) 引入数据先验尺度σd到RTC引导权重中，增强中间时间步的修正能力；2) 将引导向量分解为平行和垂直于去噪速度的分量，并将垂直分量约束在信任区域内。
AI.result: 在LIBERO上使用π0.5，POTR相比RTC提升了成功率，并持续降低了块边界不连续性、加速度和加加速度。
AI.conclusion: 先验修正权重提供了主要的修正增益，而正交信任区域进一步提升了稳定性。

title: Feature Lottery? A Bifurcation Theory of Concept Emergence
