summary: Neural networks acquire structured representations at specific moments during training, yet identifying these transitions typically relies on retrospective, label-dependent metrics. We introduce a bifurcation theory of representation dynamics to detect these moments in real time. Analyzing a passive GMM probe attached to the evolving encoder, we show the onset of structure corresponds to a supercritical pitchfork bifurcation driven by the loss Hessian. The system exhibits a theoretically predictable zero-crossing ($β_c$) that, compared to the network's current state ($β$), yields a dynamic ratio $β(t)/β_c(t)$: a universal, label-free phase coordinate for representation dynamics, computable entirely from hidden states. We empirically validate four distinct transition regimes predicted by this coordinate across diverse settings: SAEs on language models (Pythia), SSL (CIFAR), and grokking (modular arithmetic). Crucially, under finite dissipation, macroscopic symmetry-breaking can lag the initial zero-crossing by orders of magnitude, which providing a rigorous dynamical account of the delayed escape observed in grokking. Microscopically, the bifurcation creates a shared unstable subspace, forcing collective symmetry breaking. We term this the "feature lottery" in SAE training: a feature's terminal interpretability becomes predictable remarkably early. By only 5% of training, early atom purity robustly predicts final convergence purity, with top-decile early atoms achieving over 12x the baseline purity at convergence. Beyond explaining concept emergence, $β/β_c$ provides a practical early-warning indicator for training health, detecting the onset of usable structure, the crystallization of feature identity, and representational collapse epochs before downstream metrics react.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于分岔理论的表示动力学框架，通过一个可动态计算的比率 β(t)/β_c(t)（完全由隐状态计算、无需标签）来实时检测神经网络中结构化表示涌现的关键时刻，并在SAE、SSL和grokking等多种场景下验证了其有效性，同时发现该坐标可作为训练健康的早期预警指标。
AI.motivation: 神经网络在训练过程中会在特定时刻获得结构化表示，但现有方法通常依赖事后（retrospective）且需要标签的指标来识别这些转变时刻，缺乏实时的、无需标签的检测手段。
AI.method: 引入分岔理论分析表示动力学。在演化中的编码器上附加一个被动的高斯混合模型（GMM）探针，证明结构涌现对应由损失Hessian驱动的超临界叉形分岔。系统存在理论可预测的零交叉点 β_c，通过与网络当前状态 β 比较得到动态比率 β(t)/β_c(t)，这是一个通用的、无需标签的表示动力学相位坐标，完全从隐状态计算得出。
AI.result: 在多种设置（Pythia语言模型上的SAE、CIFAR上的SSL、模算术上的grokking）中实证验证了该坐标预测的四种不同转变状态。发现有限耗散下宏观对称破缺可能滞后于初始零交叉数个数量级，为grokking中的延迟逃逸提供了严格的动力学解释。微观上，分岔产生共享不稳定子空间迫使集体对称破缺（"特征彩票"现象）：在仅5%训练时，早期原子纯度即可稳健预测最终收敛纯度，顶部十分位的早期原子收敛纯度超过基线12倍。
AI.conclusion: β/β_c 不仅能解释概念涌现机制，还提供了一个实用的训练健康早期预警指标，能在下游指标反应之前就检测到可用结构的出现、特征身份的结晶以及表示坍塌等关键事件。

title: Towards Large Model Feature Coding
summary: Large models have delivered remarkable performance across a wide range of perception and generation tasks, yet practical deployment is increasingly constrained by computational and memory budgets, as well as privacy requirements. Split execution alleviates these constraints by partitioning computation across devices, but it inevitably introduces intensive transmission and storage of intermediate features. Unlike conventional feature coding for CNNs that typically targets homogeneous spatial activation maps, modern large models generate heterogeneous features with varying statistical distributions and compression tolerances, e.g., multi-level/multi-modal representations and autoregressive context caches. These characteristics necessitate treating large model feature coding (LaMoFC) as a fundamental system component and call for a systematic evaluation framework. In this paper, we present a comprehensive benchmark and evaluation framework for LaMoFC. We first build the feature dataset LaMoFCBench, covering diverse task requirements across 4 categories and 16 scenarios while integrating widelyadopted architectures and various split-computing settings. We then specify representative split points according to practical application scenarios to extract intermediate features, establishing a unified pipeline for fair and reproducible comparisons. Finally, we benchmark mainstream universal feature codecs, exposing the profound misalignment between existing coding paradigms and the heterogeneous nature of large model features. These findings reveal that LaMoFC demands a fundamental departure from existing paradigms, and LaMoFCBench provides the shared empirical foundation to drive this transition. The data and code will be available at https://github.com/lartpang/LaMoFCBench.

AI.tldr: 本文提出大规模模型特征编码（LaMoFC）基准测试框架，涵盖4大类16个场景，揭示现有编码范式与大规模模型异质特征间的严重不匹配，为系统化评估和推动新范式转变提供基础。
AI.motivation: 大规模模型在感知和生成任务中表现优异，但实际部署受限于计算/内存预算和隐私需求。拆分执行虽可缓解这些约束，却引入了中间特征的密集传输和存储问题。现有面向CNN的同质特征编码无法适应现代大模型产生的异质特征（如多级/多模态表示、自回归上下文缓存），亟需系统化的评估框架来推动该方向发展。
AI.method: 1) 构建LaMoFCBench特征数据集，覆盖4类16个场景，整合广泛采用的架构和多种拆分计算设置；2) 根据实际应用场景指定代表性分割点以提取中间特征，建立统一评估流程；3) 对主流通用特征编码器进行基准测试，分析现有编码范式与大模型异质特征之间的对齐程度。
AI.result: 基准测试揭示了现有编码范式与大模型异质特征之间存在严重的错位（profound misalignment），表明LaMoFC需要从根本上脱离现有范式。
AI.conclusion: LaMoFC要求对现有编码范式进行根本性变革，LaMoFCBench为驱动这一转变提供了共享的实证基础。

title: Vision-Guided Outdoor Flight and Obstacle Evasion via Reinforcement Learning
comment: Published in IEEE Robotics and Automation Letters, vol 11, no 2. Presented at the IEEE International Conference on Robotics and Automation 2026
summary: Although quadcopters boast impressive traversal capabilities enabled by their omnidirectional maneuverability, the need for continuous pilot control in complex environments impedes their application in GNSS and telemetry-denied scenarios. To this end, we propose a novel sensorimotor policy that uses stereo-vision depth and visual-inertial odometry (VIO) to autonomously navigate through obstacles in an unknown environment to reach a goal point. The policy is comprised of a pre-trained autoencoder as the perception head followed by a planning and control LSTM network which outputs velocity commands that can be followed by an off-the-shelf commercial drone. We leverage reinforcement and privileged learning paradigms to train the policy in simulation through a two-stage process: 1) initial training with optimal trajectories generated by a global motion planner acting as a supervisory backbone, 2) further fine-tuning in a curriculum environment. To bridge the sim-to-real gap, we employ domain randomization and reward shaping to create a policy that is both robust to noise and domain shift. In outdoor experiments, our approach achieves successful zero-shot transfer to both obstacle environments and a drone platform that were never encountered during training.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于立体视觉深度和VIO的传感器运动策略，通过强化学习和特权学习在仿真中训练，实现无人机在无GNSS和遥测信号的未知环境中自主避障导航，并在未见过的环境和平台上实现了零样本迁移。
AI.motivation: 无人机虽有出色的全方位机动能力，但在复杂环境中需要持续的人工操控，限制了其在GNSS和遥测信号缺失场景下的应用。
AI.method: 策略由预训练自编码器（感知头）和LSTM网络（规划与控制）组成，输出速度指令。采用两阶段训练：1) 利用全局运动规划器生成的最优轨迹进行监督训练；2) 在课程环境中进一步微调。使用域随机化和奖励塑造来弥合仿真到现实的差距。
AI.result: 在室外实验中，该方法成功实现了对未见过的障碍环境和无人机平台的零样本迁移。
AI.conclusion: 所提方法能够在无GNSS/遥测信号的未知环境中实现自主避障导航，且具有良好的泛化能力。

title: Signs Beat Floats: Low-Rank Double-Binary Adaptation for On-Device Fine-Tuning
summary: On-device adaptation of large language models commonly keeps a quantized base model frozen while training and deploying a small, task-specific LoRA adapter. In the unmerged adapter-mode setting, however, the adapter is more than a compact storage module; it introduces an additional dense floating-point branch, maintains a trainable state for local updates, and acts as a unit of communication and hot-swapping.We introduce LoRDBA, a LoRA-compatible adapter that replaces both low-rank factors with binary sign carriers while representing magnitudes through lightweight, channel-wise scales, converting the dense adapter branch into two sign-accumulation matrix multiplications interleaved with channel-wise scaling. A finite-sample analysis shows that reconstruction quality is governed by the residual-to-magnitude ratio of the original LoRA factors. In adapter-mode experiments, LoRDBA outperforms low-bit baselines at matched model sizes while matching fp16 LoRA quality in selected regimes. The unmerged adapter incurs at most 8% prefill latency overhead at matched rank r=16 despite an over 10x reduction in adapter footprint, with moderate training memory overhead of approximately 1.6x that of fp16 LoRA.

AI.tldr: LoRDBA是一种兼容LoRA的二值化适配器，用符号载体替代低秩因子，通过轻量级通道级缩放表示幅度，在保持适配器模式(adapter-mode)优势的同时显著减少存储占用，在匹配模型大小时优于低比特基线，在特定场景下匹配fp16 LoRA质量。
AI.motivation: 在设备端大模型适配中，未合并的适配器模式(adapter-mode)虽然引入了额外的密集浮点分支、可训练状态和通信单元等开销，但其热切换和本地更新能力不可替代。现有方法在压缩适配器时面临存储与计算效率的权衡，亟需一种既能保持适配器模式优势又能大幅降低存储和计算开销的方案。
AI.method: LoRDBA将LoRA的两个低秩因子替换为二值符号载体(binary sign carriers)，通过轻量级通道级缩放(channel-wise scales)表示幅度信息。将原本的密集适配器分支转换为两个符号累加矩阵乘法(sign-accumulation matrix multiplications)，中间穿插通道级缩放操作。同时提供了有限样本分析，证明重建质量由原始LoRA因子的残差与幅度比(residual-to-magnitude ratio)决定。
AI.result: 在适配器模式实验中，LoRDBA在匹配模型大小时优于低比特基线，并在特定场景下匹配fp16 LoRA的质量。在rank=16时，未合并的适配器预填充延迟开销不超过8%，同时适配器存储占用减少超过10倍，训练内存开销约为fp16 LoRA的1.6倍。
AI.conclusion: LoRDBA通过二值化与通道级缩放的结合，在保持LoRA兼容性和适配器模式优势的前提下，实现了存储占用的大幅降低(>10x)和可接受的延迟与训练内存开销，为设备端大模型的高效适配提供了一种可行的轻量化方案。

title: Mode-as-Sequence: Translating Multimodal Motion Prediction into Unified Sequential Mode Modeling
summary: Multimodal motion forecasting is inherently under-supervised: each training scene provides only one realized future, yet multiple plausible futures exist. This sparse supervision often leads to mode collapse (redundant hypotheses and insufficient mode coverage) and unreliable confidence ranking when predicting a small set of trajectories. We propose Mode-as-Sequence, a unified decoding framework that translates an unordered mode set into an ordered mode sequence and explicitly models mode-to-mode dependency. Under this framework, we develop two complementary instantiations. ModeSeq performs recurrent mode decoding, where each mode is generated conditioned on the previously generated modes, encouraging diverse, non-redundant hypotheses with calibrated confidence ordering. To remove the mode-by-mode autoregressive bottleneck, we further propose Parallel ModeSeq, which preserves the same causal dependency using masked mode-to-mode self-attention while decoding all modes in a single forward pass, enabling efficient large-$K$ inference and scalable joint-scene prediction. To learn representative modes and calibrated confidence under sparse labels, we introduce Early-Match-Take-All (EMTA) and its joint-scene extension MA-EMTA, together with a lightweight ranking regularizer that reduces confidence inversions. Extensive experiments on large-scale benchmarks demonstrate consistent improvements in both ranking-oriented metrics and best-of-K accuracy across datasets, horizons, and object types. In the Waymo Open Dataset challenges, ModeSeq achieves 1st place in the 2024 LiDAR-free motion prediction track, and Parallel ModeSeq achieves 1st place in the 2025 Interaction Prediction Challenge, validating the effectiveness of Mode-as-Sequence for both accuracy and efficiency.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Mode-as-Sequence框架，将无序模式集转化为有序模式序列，通过显式建模模式间依赖关系来缓解多模态轨迹预测中的模式坍塌和置信度排序问题。基于此框架开发了ModeSeq（自回归解码）和Parallel ModeSeq（并行解码）两种方法，结合Early-Match-Take-All损失和排序正则化器，在Waymo等数据集上取得SOTA结果。
AI.motivation: 多模态轨迹预测中，每个训练场景只提供单一真实未来轨迹，这种稀疏监督导致模式坍塌（假设冗余、覆盖不足）和置信度排序不可靠的问题，现有方法缺乏对模式间依赖关系的显式建模。
AI.method: 提出Mode-as-Sequence统一解码框架，将无序模式集转换为有序模式序列，显式建模模式间依赖关系。开发两种实例：ModeSeq采用循环模式解码（自回归，每个模式基于先前模式生成）；Parallel ModeSeq使用掩码模式间自注意力机制，在单次前向传播中并行解码所有模式，消除自回归瓶颈。提出Early-Match-Take-All (EMTA)及其联合场景扩展MA-EMTA，配合轻量级排序正则化器缓解置信度反转。
AI.result: 在Waymo Open Dataset挑战中，ModeSeq获得2024年LiDAR-free运动预测赛道第一名，Parallel ModeSeq获得2025年交互预测挑战赛第一名。在多个大规模基准数据集上，排序导向指标和best-of-K准确率均实现一致提升。
AI.conclusion: Mode-as-Sequence框架通过显式建模模式间依赖关系，有效解决了多模态轨迹预测中的模式坍塌和置信度排序问题，在准确性和效率上都表现出色，为多模态预测提供了一个统一且可扩展的解决方案。

title: Polymander II: an amphibious salamander-inspired robot with contact and flow sensors
comment: This work has been accepted for publication in the 2026 \it{International Conference on Robotics and Automation (ICRA)}, Vienna, Austria
summary: Robots benefit from sensory information to coordinate body movement, gain robustness against perturbations, and transit between different modes to adapt to various terrains. However, few amphibious robots can sense interactions with both terrestrial and aquatic environments. In this paper, we present a solution that uses Hall-effect sensors to sense foot contact forces and lateral hydrodynamic forces on a salamander-inspired amphibious robot. With two bus lines, the robot can simultaneously acquire this exteroceptive information at more than 500 Hz and proprioceptive information, such as joint positions and loads, at 100 Hz. The Hall-effect sensors used are compact, making them suitable for embedding in multiple positions within a robot, and exhibit high sensitivity to small forces. Moreover, because the sensor can be positioned separately from the measured object, waterproofing can be implemented with relative ease. Our tests demonstrate the robot's capabilities in traversing amphibious environments and its potential in using feedback control for more complex locomotion tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于霍尔效应传感器的蝾螈仿生两栖机器人感知方案，能够同时高速采集地面接触力、侧向水动力等外部信息以及关节位置、负载等本体信息，传感器体积小、灵敏度高且易于防水，实验验证了机器人在两栖环境中的运动能力及反馈控制潜力。
AI.motivation: 现有两栖机器人缺乏同时感知水陆两种环境交互的能力，需要一种紧凑、灵敏且易于防水的传感方案来提升机器人的环境适应性和控制性能。
AI.method: 采用霍尔效应传感器测量足部接触力和侧向水动力，通过两条总线分别以500 Hz以上采集外部信息和100 Hz采集本体信息（关节位置和负载），传感器与被测物体分离布置以降低防水难度。
AI.result: 机器人成功穿越两栖环境，验证了传感方案的有效性，并展示了通过反馈控制实现更复杂运动任务的潜力。
AI.conclusion: 霍尔效应传感器为两栖机器人提供了一种有效的外部力和本体状态感知手段，有望支持更复杂的两栖运动控制。

title: Spectral Probe-Circuits: A Three-Step Recipe for Identifying Attention-Head Circuits in Pretrained Transformers
summary: We present a three-step recipe for identifying attention-head circuits in pretrained transformers. A per-head spectral signal -- the time-integrated participation ratio of each head's attention output -- ranks heads doing sustained content-dependent computation without labels or attribution gradients. A task-pattern screen filters this general indicator into a task-specific candidate circuit, and group ablation against a matched-random control completes the causal claim. We validate across an 8x parameter range (51M to 1B-active / 7B-total), two architecture families (dense, mixture-of-experts), and four pretraining pipelines. The recipe ports: a 2-6 head induction circuit is causally necessary in every model tested, with a 94-100% drop in synthetic-induction top-1 after ablation. The spectral signal is predictive without supervision: on six independent seeds of a 51M-parameter probe model, the same computation identifies the seed-specific circuit on each seed. The fraction of heads doing identifiable specialized computation is conserved at 17-19% across the Pythia family (124M to 410M), while specific induction circuits stay 3-11 heads -- sublinear in total head count. This paper is the methodology anchor of a three-paper program; companion papers extend the recipe to developmental trajectories during pretraining and to composed-task circuits where pattern selectivity decouples from task-causal structure.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种三步法来识别预训练Transformer中的注意力头电路：基于谱信号的头排序、任务模式筛选、分组消融验证。跨8倍参数范围、两种架构家族和四种预训练流程验证了该方法的有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有方法依赖标签或归因梯度来识别注意力头电路，缺乏无监督且通用的识别手段。作者希望提出一种无需标签或梯度、可跨模型规模迁移的电路识别方法。
AI.method: 三步法：(1) 对每个注意力头的输出计算时间积分参与比（谱信号），无需标签即可识别头部在进行持续内容相关计算；(2) 通过任务模式筛选，将通用指标转化为特定任务的候选电路；(3) 使用分组消融与匹配随机对照完成因果验证。
AI.result: (1) 在所有测试模型中，2-6头的归纳电路是因果必要的，消融后合成归纳任务top-1下降94-100%；(2) 谱信号具有预测性，6个不同种子的51M参数探针模型上，相同方法识别出各种子特异的电路；(3) Pythia系列(124M-410M)中，可识别的专门计算头部比例稳定在17-19%，而归纳电路大小保持3-11头（亚线性于总头数）。
AI.conclusion: 提出了一种无需标签、可跨模型规模迁移的注意力头电路识别方法，为理解Transformer内部计算机制提供了通用工具；该方法是三论文项目的锚定方法论，后续工作将扩展至预训练发育轨迹和组合任务电路分析。

title: Learning to See Like Humans: Gaze-Aligned Cycling Safety Prediction
comment: Accepted to be published as part of the 2026 IEEE 29th International Conference on Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITSC), Naples, Italy, September 15-18, 2026
summary: Cycling delivers significant public-health and environmental benefits, yet its uptake in cities is often limited by perceived safety. When street environments appear unsafe, individuals are less likely to cycle, making perception a key barrier to adoption. Recent work has shown that pairwise comparisons of street-view images provide a scalable way to learn subjective safety judgments. However, existing approaches do not explicitly model human visual attention, which plays a central role in how humans perceive safety. We propose an Eye-Tracking-Guided Perceived Cycling Safety framework (EG-PCS) that integrates gaze data into a pairwise learning pipeline based on vision transformers. By supervising the model's attention mechanism with eye-tracking signals, we encourage alignment between learned attention maps and human fixation patterns. Experiments show that gaze-guided models achieve similar ranking performance compared to state-of-the-art approaches while producing attention maps that more accurately reflect human visual attention behavior. Our results demonstrate that incorporating eye-tracking information enhances both predictive accuracy and interpretability in perception-based urban analytics.

AI.tldr: 提出EG-PCS框架，通过眼动追踪数据引导视觉Transformer的注意力机制，提升骑行安全感知模型的可解释性和预测准确性。
AI.motivation: 现有基于成对街景图像比较的骑行安全感知方法未显式建模人类视觉注意力，而注意力在安全感知中起核心作用。
AI.method: 提出EG-PCS框架，将眼动追踪信号集成到基于视觉Transformer的成对学习流程中，通过监督模型的注意力机制使其与人类注视模式对齐。
AI.result: 眼动引导模型在排名性能上与现有最优方法相当，但生成的注意力图更准确地反映人类视觉注意行为。
AI.conclusion: 融合眼动追踪信息能同时提升基于感知的城市分析中模型的预测准确性和可解释性。

title: Elevator-LIO: Robust LiDAR-Inertial Odometry for Multi-Floor Navigation under Elevator-Induced Non-Inertial Motion
summary: This paper presents Elevator-LIO, a LiDAR-inertial odometry framework designed to achieve continuous robot localization during elevator travel, thereby supporting cross-floor robotic tasks. To address the state-estimation problem in non-inertial frames, Elevator-LIO establishes a decoupled state-estimation model that separately models the robot motion relative to the elevator and the elevator motion itself, and embeds it into a mode-dependent iterated error-state Kalman filter framework. This framework degenerates to conventional LIO estimation in ordinary indoor environments, while enabling the propagation and constrained update of elevator-related states in elevator non-inertial environments, thereby achieving continuous and stable localization. An elevator mode manager detects elevator entry and exit events using LiDAR ranging statistics and estimated states, and introduces event-triggered zero-velocity and zero-acceleration updates when the elevator stops to suppress accumulated vertical drift. In addition, this paper adopts an adaptive voxel downsampling strategy to maintain a stable number of effective points under significant environmental scale changes. We conduct extensive experiments on 20 real-world sequences containing 79 elevator rides, including practical challenges such as large-scale spaces, long vertical travel, dynamic pedestrian interference, and mirror reflections. The results show that Elevator-LIO maintains continuous localization accuracy in all sequences, with terminal height error below 1 cm in 17 sequences. In contrast, existing representative localization systems perform poorly on these elevator sequences. Tests on the Hilti 2022/2023 datasets further show that the proposed method remains competitive in standard indoor scenarios. The project page is available at https://xiaofan4122.github.io/Elevator_LIO_Page/.

AI.tldr: Elevator-LIO是一个面向电梯场景的LiDAR-惯性里程计框架，通过解耦状态估计模型、模式管理器及事件触发更新，实现电梯内连续稳定的机器人定位，在79次电梯乘坐实验中终端高度误差低于1cm（17个序列），优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有LIO系统在电梯这类非惯性参考系中因加速度计无法区分重力与电梯加速度导致定位失效，无法实现跨楼层连续定位，亟需专门针对电梯场景的定位方案。
AI.method: 1) 解耦状态估计模型：分别建模机器人相对电梯的运动与电梯自身运动，嵌入模式依赖的迭代误差状态卡尔曼滤波框架；2) 电梯模式管理器：利用LiDAR测距统计与估计状态检测进出电梯事件；3) 事件触发零速/零加速度更新：电梯停止时抑制垂直漂移；4) 自适应体素降采样：应对环境尺度剧烈变化。
AI.result: 在20个真实序列（79次电梯乘坐）上所有序列保持连续定位，17个序列终端高度误差低于1cm；在Hilti 2022/2023标准室内数据集上仍具竞争力；现有代表性方法在电梯序列上表现差。
AI.conclusion: Elevator-LIO有效解决了电梯非惯性环境下的连续定位问题，同时兼顾了普通室内场景的定位性能，为跨楼层机器人任务提供了可靠的定位基础。

title: Federated Learning over Human-Body Communication for On-Body Edge Intelligence: A Survey, Taxonomy, and BODYFED-HBC Scheduling Vignette
summary: Human-body communication (HBC) is a promising physical substrate for wearable body-area networks because it can localize communication around the body and reduce the burden of conventional radio links. Federated learning (FL) is a promising learning substrate because it can reduce raw-data centralization for physiological and behavioral sensing. Yet these two literatures remain weakly connected: FL for wearables usually abstracts the communication layer, whereas HBC research usually abstracts learning and model-update traffic. This article surveys the intersection of HBC, wireless body-area networks, wearable FL, Internet-of-Bodies privacy, and edge-intelligence optimization. We propose a taxonomy that distinguishes intra-body, body-hub, cross-user, and clinical-cloud FL deployments, and we identify the open problem of body-channel-aware FL: learning protocols whose client selection, update compression, and aggregation are controlled by posture-dependent HBC links, residual energy, sensor memory, and privacy risk. To make the research agenda concrete, we introduce BODYFED-HBC as a reference architecture and provide an optimization formulation and scheduling algorithm. We further specify a reproducible simulation vignette that combines public wearable datasets with empirical body-coupled-communication signal-loss models. The article concludes with open datasets, evaluation metrics, limitations, and research directions for computer scientists working above the hardware layer.

AI.tldr: 本文综述了人体通信（HBC）与联邦学习（FL）在可穿戴体域网中的交叉研究，提出了区分四种FL部署场景的分类法，识别了体信道感知FL这一开放问题，并介绍了BODYFED-HBC参考架构、优化公式与调度算法，以及可复现的仿真方案。
AI.motivation: HBC可作为可穿戴体域网的物理层基础，FL可作为感知数据的隐私保护学习基础，但二者研究长期脱节：FL研究抽象了通信层，HBC研究则抽象了学习与模型更新过程。本文旨在弥合这一鸿沟。
AI.method: 通过综述HBC、无线体域网、可穿戴FL、物联网隐私与边缘智能优化的交叉领域，提出四类FL部署分类（体内、体中心、跨用户、临床云），并构建BODYFED-HBC参考架构、优化模型与调度算法，结合公开可穿戴数据集与体耦合通信信号损耗模型进行仿真。
AI.result: 识别出体信道感知FL这一开放问题，即客户端选择、更新压缩与聚合需受姿态相关的HBC链路、剩余能量、传感器内存和隐私风险共同控制；提供了BODYFED-HBC架构及可复现仿真方案。
AI.conclusion: 本文为硬件层之上的计算机科学研究者提供了开放数据集、评估指标、研究局限与未来方向，指出体信道感知FL是连接HBC与可穿戴FL的关键研究方向。

title: EMMA: Extracting Multiple physical parameters from Multimodal Data
summary: We introduce EMMA, a physics-informed multimodal framework that recovers all identifiable dynamical parameters of a system directly from raw video, audio, and image-based time-series observations. Unlike prior video-only approaches that struggle with occluded states, hidden actuation inputs, or assumptions about known initial conditions and coordinate frames, EMMA performs joint inference of explicit parameters, implicit dynamical components, and calibration invariants within a unified continuous-time model. EMMA leverages a Liquid Time-Constant (LTC) network to learn latent dynamics from heterogeneous modalities while a physics-constrained loss enforces consistency with the governing differential equations. A unified feature pipeline enables consistent alignment across video trajectories, acoustic signatures, and chart-derived measurements, allowing EMMA to estimate parameters under forced, implicit, and multivariate dynamics without requiring segmentation masks, differentiable rendering, or specialized sensors. Across 100+ scenarios including five standard dynamical benchmarks (75 Delfys videos), real-world rover and quadrotor systems with hidden inputs, and simulation-chart case studies spanning biological and chaotic systems, EMMA delivers robust multi-parameter recovery and significantly outperforms existing single-modality and equation-discovery baselines. Our results establish EMMA as a general, scalable solution for physics-consistent model extraction from opportunistic multimodal data. Code and data are available at: https://github.com/ImpactLabASU/EMMA-CVPR2026

AI.tldr: EMMA是一个物理信息驱动的多模态框架，能够直接从原始视频、音频和图像时间序列观测中恢复系统的全部可识别动力学参数，无需分割掩码、可微分渲染或专用传感器。
AI.motivation: 现有基于视频的方法在遮挡状态、隐藏驱动输入、已知初始条件和坐标框架假设等方面存在局限，无法有效利用多模态数据（如音频、图表）进行联合物理参数估计。
AI.method: 利用液体时间常数（LTC）网络从异构模态中学习潜在动力学，结合物理约束损失确保与支配微分方程的一致性；设计统一特征管道实现视频轨迹、声学信号和图表测量的一致对齐，在统一的连续时间模型中进行显式参数、隐式动力学分量和标定不变量的联合推断。
AI.result: 在100+场景（包括5个标准动力学基准、75个Delfys视频、真实轮式机器人和四旋翼系统、生物与混沌系统仿真图表案例）上，EMMA实现了稳健的多参数恢复，显著优于现有单模态和方程发现基线方法。
AI.conclusion: EMMA建立了一种通用的、可扩展的解决方案，能够从机会性多模态数据中提取物理一致的模型。

title: MuGen: Multi-Skill Generative Locomotion Controller for Humanoid Robots
summary: This paper presents MuGen, a data-driven framework for learning and deploying multi-skill locomotion on humanoid robots. MuGen enables a robot to perform expressive motions like humans under the guidance of example motion sequences. To achieve this, we employ vector-quantized autoencoders (VQ-VAEs) trained with model-based reinforcement learning, resulting in a generative representation of locomotion that captures key patterns of human motion from hours of heterogeneous human performance data. We employ a teacher-student learning framework and develop a new policy distillation strategy to enable a deployable student policy learning this efficient latent representation. This policy allows the robot to track and mimic unseen human motions and further enables the robot to reuse the learned latent space for other tasks. We demonstrate the effectiveness of our framework through a diverse set of motions and accurate execution.

AI.tldr: MuGen是一个数据驱动框架，利用VQ-VAE和模型强化学习学习多技能运动，通过教师-学生蒸馏策略使人形机器人能够模仿人类运动并复用潜在空间。
AI.motivation: 使人形机器人能够像人类一样执行富有表现力的多技能运动，并能够从异构人类运动数据中学习通用运动表征。
AI.method: 采用向量量化自编码器（VQ-VAE）结合基于模型的强化学习进行训练，生成运动表征；使用教师-学生学习框架，提出新的策略蒸馏方法使学生策略学习潜在表征。
AI.result: 机器人能够追踪和模仿未见过的类人运动，并能复用所学潜在空间执行其他任务，在多样化运动和精确执行上验证了有效性。
AI.conclusion: MuGen框架有效实现了人形机器人多技能运动的学习与部署，通过生成式运动表征和策略蒸馏实现了对人类运动的泛化模仿和任务复用。

title: Generative Representation Learning on Hyper-relational Knowledge Graphs via Masked Discrete Diffusion
comment: 28 pages, 16 figures, 18 tables, 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML 2026)
summary: Hyper-relational knowledge graphs (HKGs) effectively represent complex facts. While inferring new knowledge in HKGs is a critical problem, current methods cast it as a simple link prediction, assuming that nearly all entities and relations within a fact are known, leaving only a single blank to be filled. However, this restricted assumption may not hold in real-world scenarios in which multiple, or even all, constituent components of a fact may be missing simultaneously. To bridge this gap, we introduce a task called fact generation: generating a valid hyper-relational fact from an arbitrarily masked query, i.e., completing a partially observed fact or generating a fact from scratch. We propose KREPE, the first generative representation learning method for HKGs that learns to model the probability distributions of missing components conditioned on the local fact components and global structure of HKGs via a masked discrete diffusion. KREPE models both the intra-fact dependencies by contextual message passing and inter-fact correlations by aggregating stochastically sampled contexts. KREPE seamlessly unifies link prediction and fact generation within a single training framework, achieving state-of-the-art performance on standard HKG link prediction benchmarks and outperforming LLM-based baselines in generating novel and correct facts.

AI.tldr: 本文提出超关系知识图谱（HKG）上的事实生成任务（任意掩码查询下的有效事实生成），并设计了基于掩码离散扩散的生成式表示学习方法KREPE，统一了链接预测与事实生成，在标准链接预测基准上达到了SOTA，且优于基于LLM的事实生成基线。
AI.motivation: 现有HKG推理方法仅处理简单链接预测（仅缺失一个实体或关系），无法应对真实场景中事实的多个甚至全部组成成分同时缺失的情况。
AI.method: 提出KREPE方法，基于掩码离散扩散（masked discrete diffusion）学习HKG的生成式表示。通过上下文消息传递（contextual message passing）建模事实内依赖，通过聚合随机采样上下文建模事实间关联，从而对缺失成分的条件概率分布进行建模。
AI.result: 在标准HKG链接预测基准上达到SOTA性能，且在生成新颖且正确的事实方面优于基于LLM的基线方法。
AI.conclusion: KREPE统一了链接预测与事实生成，拓展了HKG推理的任务边界，证明了生成式方法在HKG上的有效性。

title: fMRI-Diffusion: Generating fMRI Time Series Via a Temporal Transformer Diffusion Model for Major Depressive Disorder Diagnosis
summary: Diagnosing Major Depressive Disorder (MDD) from functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI) using functional connectivity (FC) analysis requires large amounts of labeled data that are scarce in clinical settings. Existing augmentation methods synthesize FC matrices, which compress fMRI recordings into static pairwise summaries and discard temporal information. We propose fMRI-Diffusion, a framework that synthesizes region-of-interest (ROI)-level fMRI time series rather than FC matrices. A Temporal Transformer serves as the denoising network within a denoising diffusion probabilistic model, treating each time point as a token to capture temporal dependencies through self-attention. A supervised pretraining strategy initializes the Transformer with task-relevant representations before diffusion training, and FC matrices are derived from the synthesized time series for classification. Experiments on the REST-meta-MDD dataset show that augmenting training data with synthetic time series consistently improves diagnostic accuracy across ten classifiers, six parcellation atlases, and three acquisition sites. The method outperforms five recent FC-based synthesis approaches, with accuracy gains of up to 3.7 percentage points over the strongest baseline. Ablation studies confirm the contributions of both the Transformer-based denoiser and the pretraining strategy. Distributional fidelity metrics remain below 0.06 across all conditions, indicating close agreement between real and synthetic distributions. These findings suggest that synthesizing fMRI time series before FC computation preserves temporal information lost in matrix-level augmentation and provides a practical strategy for MDD diagnosis under limited data.

AI.tldr: 本文提出fMRI-Diffusion框架，通过扩散概率模型合成ROI级别的fMRI时间序列（而非FC矩阵），并利用时序Transformer作为去噪网络，在REST-meta-MDD数据集上显著提升了MDD诊断准确率，优于五种现有FC合成方法。
AI.motivation: 现有数据增强方法合成FC矩阵，但FC矩阵压缩了fMRI记录中的时间信息，且临床场景中标注数据稀缺，需要能保留时序信息的数据增强方法。
AI.method: 提出fMRI-Diffusion框架：采用去噪扩散概率模型，以时序Transformer为去噪网络（将每个时间点视为token，通过自注意力捕获时序依赖）；引入监督预训练策略初始化Transformer；合成ROI级时间序列后再导出FC矩阵用于分类。
AI.result: 在REST-meta-MDD数据集上，方法在10个分类器、6个模板、3个采集站点上均一致提升诊断准确率；优于5种FC合成基线方法，准确率最高提升3.7个百分点；分布保真度指标均低于0.06。
AI.conclusion: 合成fMRI时间序列而非FC矩阵能保留时间信息，为数据有限的MDD诊断提供了一种实用策略。

title: PoseRefer: Pathway-Local Parameters for Semantically Grounded Reference Resolution
comment: ICRA 2026 Workshop on Semantics for Reliable Robot Autonomy: From Environment Understanding and Reasoning to Safe Interaction
summary: A robot resolving ``put the cup on that one'' must fuse gesture, language, and scene geometry, yet 3D grounding benchmarks only partially capture this regime: descriptions are written post-hoc, gestures are templated, or pointing is staged for the camera. MM-Conv captures natural co-speech gesture from dyadic VR interaction alongside full-body motion capture and 3D scene graphs. We use it to evaluate pose-language fusion with a decoupled late-fusion architecture in which pose and text pathways share no learned parameters. The two choices together make category, pose, and text contributions easier to isolate through controlled ablations. Fusion with frozen MiniLM category embeddings exceeds pose alone and the best text-only pathway on every reference type, reaching 31.9% top-1. The learned scalar gate flips between opposing policies depending on whether the text pathway has category access. This is a reliability diagnostic: fusion-accuracy claims for semantic grounding systems are indistinguishable from category-representation artifacts unless pathways are architecturally decoupled.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MM-Conv数据集（基于VR双人交互的自然对话手势数据），并采用解耦的晚期融合架构（姿态与文本路径无共享参数）进行指代消解，发现融合性能（31.9% top-1）提升主要来自类别表示，揭示了语义接地系统中融合精度与类别表征伪影不可区分的可靠性诊断问题。
AI.motivation: 现有3D指代基准未能捕捉自然对话中的伴随手势：描述事后撰写、手势模板化、指向为摄像机摆拍。需要更自然的多模态数据来研究真实场景中的语言-姿态-几何融合。
AI.method: 1) 构建MM-Conv数据集：采集VR双人交互中的自然伴随手势、全身动捕和3D场景图；2) 提出解耦晚期融合架构：姿态和文本路径不共享任何学习参数；3) 使用可学习标量门控控制融合权重。
AI.result: 融合冻结MiniLM类别嵌入在所有指代类型上超过纯姿态和最佳纯文本路径，达到31.9% top-1准确率。可学习标量门控在文本路径是否有类别访问权限时表现出相反的策略。
AI.conclusion: 除非各路径在架构上解耦，否则语义接地系统的融合精度声称与类别表征伪影无法区分，这构成了一个可靠性诊断问题。

title: Not All Transitions Matter: Evidence from PPO
comment: 12 pages, 5 figures. Submitted to 2026 8th Asia Conference on Machine Learning and Computing (ACMLC 2026)
summary:
Training a reinforcement learning agent on-policy means collecting fresh experience at every update, and that experience comes with a hidden problem. Each state in a rollout is the direct output of the previous one, causally chained together by the agent's own actions. Because of this, consecutive transitions are never truly independent. They carry overlapping information, and the gradient signal the network receives ends up far more repetitive than the batch size suggests. The same directions get reinforced over and over, the value network struggles to keep up as the policy shifts, and training becomes quietly unstable in ways that reward curves alone rarely reveal.
  This paper asks whether that redundancy can simply be removed. We show that randomly dropping a fixed fraction of transitions from the rollout, at the right stage so the reward signal stays intact, is enough to break the repetitive gradient structure and stabilize training. The change is minimal: one sampling step, no new components, no modification to the core algorithm, and it works with any PPO implementation. Across five environments of increasing difficulty, CartPole-v1, Acrobot-v1, LunarLander-v2, HalfCheetah-v5, and Hopper-v5, the method matches vanilla PPO on reward while producing more consistent training dynamics across KL divergence, policy entropy, and value estimates. Dropping 25% of transitions turns out to be the sweet spot: enough to disrupt the redundancy, not enough to thin the batch.

AI.tldr: 提出一种简单方法：在PPO算法中随机丢弃25%的轨迹转移样本，以打破on-policy强化学习中因轨迹因果依赖导致的梯度冗余，从而稳定训练。
AI.motivation: On-policy强化学习中，连续转移因因果链存在重叠信息，导致梯度信号重复、价值网络不稳定、训练隐性不稳定，而奖励曲线难以揭示这些问题。
AI.method: 在适当阶段从rollout中随机丢弃固定比例（25%）的转移样本，保留奖励信号，仅增加一个采样步骤，不修改核心算法，可应用于任何PPO实现。
AI.result: 在5个环境（CartPole-v1, Acrobot-v1, LunarLander-v2, HalfCheetah-v5, Hopper-v5）上，该方法在奖励上与原始PPO持平，同时在KL散度、策略熵和价值估计上展现出更一致的训练动态。
AI.conclusion: 随机丢弃25%的转移样本足以打破冗余梯度结构、稳定训练，且改动极小、通用性强。

title: Distance-Aware Joint Spatio-Temporal Graph Contrastive Learning for Major Depressive Disorder Diagnosis
summary: Major depressive disorder (MDD) is a common neuropsychiatric condition whose accurate diagnosis from resting-state functional magnetic resonance imaging (rs-fMRI) remains difficult. Dynamic functional connectivity (DFC) captures time-varying interactions among brain regions and provides rich spatio-temporal information, yet current DFC-based methods face three limitations: sliding-window Pearson correlation yields noisy estimates sensitive to window length and motion artifacts; correlation-derived node features do not fully exploit frequency-domain properties of blood-oxygen-level-dependent (BOLD) signals; and most spatio-temporal graph models handle spatial structure and temporal dynamics in separate stages, restricting their ability to represent coupled brain network evolution. To overcome these issues, we reformulate DFC learning as joint spatio-temporal graph representation learning under a Hawkes-process-inspired temporal dependency prior and propose HWSTCL, a two-stage framework built on a reliability-refined joint spatio-temporal graph with a kernel-weighted pretraining objective. Within each temporal window, BOLD signals are encoded as spectral node descriptors and functional edges are refined by an exponential distance-decay prior that down-weights less reliable long-range connections. The joint graph is then formed by linking each region to itself across future windows through a Hawkes-inspired exponential kernel, allowing spatial and temporal information to be propagated together during message passing. A kernel-weighted contrastive objective further promotes temporal consistency for each region across windows while reducing redundant similarity between different regions. Experiments on a benchmark rs-fMRI dataset show that HWSTCL outperforms recent baselines and yields coherent spatio-temporal representations for MDD diagnosis.

AI.tldr: 针对动态功能连接（DFC）在抑郁症诊断中的三大局限（滑窗皮尔逊相关噪声大、节点特征未利用频域信息、时空分离建模无法表征脑网络耦合演化），提出HWSTCL框架：基于霍克斯过程时间依赖先验的联合时空图表示学习，通过谱节点描述符、指数距离衰减边权重和霍克斯核跨窗口连接实现时空联合消息传递，辅以核加权对比学习目标。在基准rs-fMRI数据集上优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有DFC方法存在三个关键问题：1) 滑窗皮尔逊相关受窗长和运动伪影影响产生噪声估计；2) 基于相关的节点特征未充分利用BOLD信号的频域属性；3) 大多数时空图模型将空间结构和时间动态分开处理，限制了表征耦合脑网络演化的能力。
AI.method: 提出HWSTCL两阶段框架：1) 在每个时间窗内，将BOLD信号编码为谱节点描述子，并用指数距离衰减先验细化功能边（降低远距离不可靠连接权重）；2) 构建联合时空图，通过霍克斯启发式指数核将每个脑区与自身在未来窗口的表示相连，实现时空信息联合消息传递；3) 采用核加权对比学习目标，促进同一区域跨窗口的时间一致性，同时减少不同区域间的冗余相似性。
AI.result: 在基准rs-fMRI数据集上，HWSTCL优于近期基线方法，并生成连贯的时空表示用于MDD诊断。
AI.conclusion: 通过霍克斯过程先验引导的联合时空图表示学习，有效解决了DFC学习中的噪声、频域信息缺失和时空分离问题，提升了MDD诊断性能。

title: Towards Low-Gravity Planetary Exploration using Reinforcement Learning for Walking, Jumping, and In-flight Attitude Control
summary: This paper presents reinforcement learning (RL) policies for dynamic quadrupedal locomotion in planetary exploration scenarios. Building on a taskoptimized quadruped with a 5-bar leg design, we develop RL policies for walking, vertical jumping, forward jumping, and in-flight attitude control, explicitly tailored to the reduced gravity on Mars. These policies jointly enable such robots to overcome obstacles larger than themselves through coordinated jumping and precise in-flight reorientation for safe landings. We demonstrate Sim2Real transfer of the attitude control policy on the Olympus quadruped through single-axis reorientation tests, while all locomotion policies are validated in simulation. A complete Mars exploration mission scenario demonstrates coordinated policy deployment across challenging terrain. Experimental results show 90° attitude reorientation in 2.6 seconds, with simulations demonstrating 3.1 meter vertical jumps and 3.9 meter forward jumps under Martian gravity conditions. - Supplementary video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qlSJ3P87A4A

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一套针对火星低重力环境的强化学习控制策略，使具备五杆腿设计的四足机器人Olympus能够行走、垂直跳跃、前向跳跃以及空中姿态控制，实现跨越大于自身尺寸的障碍物，并通过Sim2Real迁移验证了姿态控制策略的有效性。
AI.motivation: 在火星探测等低重力行星环境中，传统轮式或简单腿式机器人难以翻越大于自身尺寸的障碍物，亟需开发具备跳跃与空中姿态调控能力的四足机器人控制策略，以提升行星探测的机动性与地形适应性。
AI.method: 基于任务优化的五杆腿设计四足机器人Olympus，采用强化学习分别训练行走、垂直跳跃、前向跳跃和空中姿态控制策略，策略针对火星1/3重力环境进行了显式适配，并通过Sim2Real迁移在真实机器人上验证了单轴姿态重定向。
AI.result: 真实实验中实现90°姿态重定向耗时2.6秒；仿真中实现3.1米垂直跳跃和3.9米前向跳跃（火星重力条件下）；完整的火星探测任务场景验证了多策略协同部署的可行性。
AI.conclusion: 强化学习策略能够有效赋予四足机器人在低重力环境下的跳跃与空中姿态控制能力，Sim2Real迁移验证了策略的实用性，为未来行星探测任务中的高机动性机器人系统提供了可行方案。

title: Verified SHAP: Provable Bounds for Exact Shapley Values of Neural Networks
summary: Shapley additive explanations (SHAP) are widely recognised as computationally intractable for neural networks, since they induce an exponential search space over the input features. In this work, we take a first step towards scaling exact SHAP computation to larger search spaces by introducing an algorithm that leverages recent advances in neural network verification to compute arbitrarily tight exact lower and upper bounds on SHAP values for neural networks, ultimately recovering the exact SHAP values. We demonstrate that our approach scales to orders of magnitude larger search spaces than state-of-the-art exact methods. This provides an important first step towards exact SHAP computation and establishes a principled cornerstone for evaluating statistical approximation methods on larger search spaces.

AI.tldr: 本文提出利用神经网络验证技术来计算SHAP值精确的上下界，最终恢复精确SHAP值，该方法可扩展至比现有精确方法大数个数量级的搜索空间。
AI.motivation: SHAP值对于神经网络的计算在理论上是指数级复杂度的，现有精确方法无法扩展到较大的搜索空间，而近似方法缺乏精确性保障。
AI.method: 利用神经网络验证（neural network verification）的最新进展，设计算法计算SHAP值的任意紧致的精确下界和上界，最终恢复精确SHAP值。
AI.result: 该方法能处理比最先进精确方法大数个数量级的搜索空间，成功实现精确SHAP值的计算。
AI.conclusion: 为精确SHAP计算提供了重要第一步，并为评估大规模搜索空间上的统计近似方法建立了 principled 的基础。

title: WideDepth: Millimeter-Accurate Benchmark for Fisheye Depth Estimation
comment: Accepted to IEEE International Conference on Robotics and Automation (ICRA) 2026
summary: Fisheye cameras are increasingly adopted in robotics for near-field manipulation, navigation, and immersive perception, yet indoor depth benchmarks with accurate ground truth are still missing. To address this, we introduce WideDepth - the first indoor dataset for fisheye depth estimation, featuring 101 scenes containing 5K high-resolution stereo pairs labeled with millimeter-level ground truth depth and disparity. Our dataset also includes paired pinhole and fisheye samples across varying fields of view and baselines in both horizontal and vertical stereo setups. We further propose a method to adapt pinhole-trained stereo models to fisheye images and introduce a novel stereo fisheye image generation pipeline based on high-resolution LiDAR scans. Leveraging these methods, we thoroughly evaluate state-of-the-art monocular depth, stereo matching, and depth completion models on our benchmark. Additionally, we provide 18K LiDAR-derived sparse depth training samples, achieving up to a 62% performance boost on fisheye data when fine-tuning pinhole-based stereo models. In summary, the high precision and versatility of our benchmark set a strong foundation for advancing research in fisheye depth estimation and robotics perception. Project page: https://ilyaind.github.io/WideDepth

AI.tldr: 本文提出了WideDepth，首个用于鱼眼深度估计的室内数据集，包含101个场景、5K高分辨率立体对（毫米级真值），以及18K LiDAR稀疏深度训练样本。同时提出了一种将针孔训练立体模型适配到鱼眼图像的方法和基于LiDAR的鱼眼立体图像生成流程，在鱼眼数据上微调后性能提升高达62%。
AI.motivation: 鱼眼相机在机器人操作、导航和沉浸式感知中日益普及，但缺乏带有精确真值的室内鱼眼深度基准数据集，阻碍了该领域的研究进展。
AI.method: 1) 构建了包含101个场景、5K高分辨率立体对的鱼眼深度数据集，提供毫米级真值深度和视差；2) 提出将针孔训练立体模型适配到鱼眼图像的方法；3) 提出基于高分辨率LiDAR扫描的鱼眼立体图像生成流程；4) 提供18K LiDAR导出的稀疏深度训练样本。
AI.result: 在鱼眼数据上微调针孔立体模型时，性能提升高达62%。
AI.conclusion: WideDepth数据集具有高精度和多功能性，为鱼眼深度估计和机器人感知研究奠定了坚实基础。

title: Sum of Costs Diffusion with Dynamic Guidance for Motion Planning
comment: Accepted at the Frontiers of Optimization for Robotics Workshop at the IEEE International Conference of Robotics & Automation (ICRA), 2026
summary: The motion planning problem for robotic manipulation can be addressed through classical or deep learning approaches. Existing methods face significant challenges in generalizing to diverse settings. In this study, we present a method with high generalization capability that generates collision-free trajectories using diffusion models where the denoising process is guided by the gradient of the total collision cost. We are also presenting a dynamic approach for choosing start step of the gradient guidance. Experimental results demonstrate that guiding the diffusion model dynamically with the sum of collision costs offers more robust performance by overcoming the generalization issues faced by competing methods. The proposed model demonstrates its effectiveness by achieving the highest performance on diverse test settings in M$π$nets\ dataset among the compared methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于扩散模型的高泛化能力机器人运动规划方法，通过碰撞代价梯度动态引导去噪过程，并在Mπnets数据集上取得最优性能。
AI.motivation: 现有机器人操作运动规划方法（无论是经典方法还是深度学习方法）在泛化到多样化场景时面临显著挑战，亟需一种高泛化能力的解决方案。
AI.method: 使用扩散模型生成无碰撞轨迹，去噪过程由总碰撞代价的梯度引导；同时提出选择梯度引导起始步的动态方法。
AI.result: 在Mπnets数据集的多种测试场景中，所提方法相比对比方法取得最高性能，证明动态碰撞代价梯度引导能提供更鲁棒的表现。
AI.conclusion: 动态碰撞代价梯度引导的扩散模型有效克服了现有方法的泛化问题，在多样化机器人操作运动规划任务中表现出优越的鲁棒性和有效性。

title: Overcoming "Physics Shock" in Earth Observation A Heteroscedastic Uncertainty Framework for PINN-based Flood Inference
comment: This article is accepted in IEEE Journal of Selected Topics in Applied Earth Observations and Remote Sensing
summary: Rapid and accurate flood extent mapping from Remote Sensing data, such as Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR), is critical for operational disaster response, but standard Deep Learning models often produce physically impossible predictions due to a lack of hydrological constraints. While PhysicsInformed Neural Networks (PINNs) attempt to address this by embedding governing laws directly into the loss function, their application to real-world remote sensing data frequently fails. Enforcing rigid spatial derivatives (e.g., the 2D Shallow Water Equations) onto unconditioned latent spaces attempting to fit noisy SAR speckle causes catastrophic gradient divergence, a phenomenon we term Physics Shock. In this paper, we propose a novel Uncertainty-Aware PINN framework tailored specifically for applied Earth Observation that addresses this instability. By integrating a dynamic Warm-Start protocol and modeling heteroscedastic aleatoric uncertainty via a negative log-likelihood objective, the network learns to dynamically relax physical constraints in regions of high sensor noise while strictly enforcing them in high-confidence areas. Evaluated on the Sen1Floods11 dataset, our probabilistic Attention-Gated FNO-UNet successfully stabilizes multi-objective optimization, achieving a +25% relative improvement in Intersection over Union (IoU) compared to deterministic baselines. Furthermore, through Deep Ensembles, we successfully disentangle intrinsic sensor noise from out-of-distribution terrain ignorance, providing operational agencies with highly calibrated, physically consistent confidence bounds for robust disaster mitigation and real-time decision-making.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种面向地球观测的不确定性感知物理信息神经网络（PINN）框架，通过动态热启动协议和异方差偶然不确定性建模，解决SAR图像洪水制图中物理约束与噪声数据间的梯度爆炸问题（即"物理冲击"），在Sen1Floods11数据集上实现IoU提升25%，并通过深度集成提供校准的物理一致性置信边界。
AI.motivation: 标准深度学习模型在SAR洪水制图中缺乏水文约束，产生物理上不可行的预测；而传统PINN在真实遥感数据上强制执行刚性空间导数（如浅水方程）会导致梯度发散（物理冲击现象），无法稳定训练。
AI.method: 1) 提出不确定性感知PINN框架，集成动态Warm-Start协议；2) 通过负对数似然目标建模异方差偶然不确定性，使网络在高噪声区域动态松弛物理约束，在高置信区域严格强制执行；3) 采用概率Attention-Gated FNO-UNet架构；4) 使用深度集成分离传感器噪声与分布外地形不确定性。
AI.result: 在Sen1Floods11数据集上，相比确定性基线方法，IoU相对提升25%；成功稳定了多目标优化过程；通过深度集成实现了传感器噪声与分布外不确定性的解耦。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为运营机构提供了高度校准、物理一致的置信边界，可支持稳健的灾害缓解和实时决策制定，有效解决了物理约束在真实遥感噪声数据中难以应用的痛点。

title: D2-V2X: Depth-Driven Cooperative V2X Reasoning for Autonomous Driving
comment: Accepted to the DriveX Workshop at CVPR 2026 (Non-archival)
summary: Single-vehicle Vision-Language Models (VLMs) are fundamentally constrained by sensor occlusions. While Vehicle-to-Everything (V2X) systems mitigate this, current benchmarks lack the cooperative reasoning required for resolving ambiguities in complex environments. We introduce D2-V2X, a spatially-aware Question-Rationale-Answer (QRA) benchmark featuring 8,500 triplets derived from multimodal vehicle and infrastructure sensors. We additionally establish a baseline that aligns 3D LiDAR features with the VLM's latent space. By enforcing natural language Chain-of-Thought rationales prior to structured JSON outputs, our model is forced to explicitly articulate spatial relations. Our experiments demonstrate that grounding VLMs in cooperative LiDAR achieves 24.4% recall in identifying occluded hazards compared to near-zero in zero-shot models and reduces spatial estimation error for visible objects by 77% compared to the zero-shot baseline. While the model achieves a functional decision-making F1-score of 53.5, we identify 3D-to-2D projection as a fundamental bottleneck in current VLM architectures, establishing a new baseline for future innovation. Data, code, and trained models available at https://github.com/KevinRichard1/D2-V2X

AI.tldr: D2-V2X提出了一个空间感知的问答-推理-答案基准，通过融合多车与基础设施的3D激光雷达与视觉语言模型，使模型能够显式推理空间关系，在遮挡物体识别和空间估计误差上显著优于零样本基线。
AI.motivation: 单车辆视觉语言模型受传感器遮挡严重受限，而现有的V2X基准缺乏解决复杂环境中歧义所需的协作推理能力。
AI.method: 构建D2-V2X基准（8,500个QRA三元组），提出将3D激光雷达特征与VLM潜空间对齐的基线模型，强制模型在输出结构化JSON前先生成链式思考自然语言推理。
AI.result: 遮挡危险识别召回率24.4%（零样本接近0%），可见物体空间估计误差降低77%，决策F1分数53.5。
AI.conclusion: 协同激光雷达可显著增强VLM空间推理能力，但3D到2D投影是当前VLM架构的根本瓶颈，需作为未来创新的基线。

title: Geometric Workspace Analysis and Transmission-Aware Dynamics of a Serial Spherical Tool for Microsurgery
summary: We present a kinematic and transmission-aware design framework for a serial spherical mechanism with an additional translational degree of freedom for microsurgery. The first contribution is an analytical workspace formulation that provides geometric insight into reachable motion and enables rapid selection of rotation axis orientations without numerical optimization. The second contribution is a dynamics-informed methodology for mechanisms driven by self-locking transmissions, supporting evaluation of torque requirements for a prescribed workspace geometry. The framework is accompanied by an open-source software package for friction identification and inverse dynamics analysis. Experiments on a purpose-built robotic tool for vitreoretinal surgery validate the predictive capability of the models and demonstrate their practical utility for engineering design.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种用于显微手术的球面机构运动学与传动感知设计框架，包含解析工作空间公式和自锁传动动力学方法，并通过玻璃体视网膜手术工具实验验证。
AI.motivation: 针对显微手术中球面机构设计缺乏几何直观的解析工作空间表达以及自锁传动系统动力学评估方法的问题，旨在提供无需数值优化的快速设计工具。
AI.method: 首先建立解析工作空间公式以几何方式刻画可达运动，快速选择旋转轴取向；其次提出适用于自锁传动的动力学分析方法，评估指定工作空间下的转矩需求；开发开源软件包用于摩擦辨识和逆动力学分析。
AI.result: 在玻璃体视网膜手术专用机器人工具上实验验证了模型的预测能力，展示了其在工程设计中的实用性。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为带平移自由度的串行球面机构提供了高效分析与设计手段，开源软件包进一步降低了工程应用门槛。

title: Riemannian Archetypal Analysis: Interpretable non-linear data analysis on deformed star distributions
summary: Classical archetypal analysis is appealing for its interpretability, but its linear geometry can limit performance on data with strongly non-linear structure; at the same time, existing neural extensions improve flexibility while often weakening the geometric meaning of archetypes and interpolations. In this work, we develop a Riemannian version of archetypal analysis based on data-driven pullback geometry for real-valued data, with the goal of combining the interpretability of classical archetypal analysis with the expressive power of modern non-linear models. We introduce a class of deformed star distributions together with associated pullback Riemannian geometry to provide a statistical interpretation of the resulting manifold mappings, define the Riemannian archetypal mapping (RAM) as a projection onto the manifold of geodesically convex combinations of archetypes, and propose a practical optimization scheme based on convex relaxation followed by non-convex refinement. We further propose a learning scheme that yields reasonable, albeit generally suboptimal, deformed star distributions from data. Experiments on synthetic examples and MNIST show that the resulting framework produces meaningful geodesics, useful denoising projections, and geometry-aware classifications, while also clarifying where current optimization limitations remain.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于数据驱动拉回几何的黎曼原型分析（RAM）方法，通过引入变形星形分布和拉回黎曼几何，在保留经典原型分析可解释性的同时，利用非线性模型的表达能力，实验证明了其在生成有意义的测地线、去噪投影和几何感知分类方面的有效性。
AI.motivation: 经典原型分析具有可解释性但线性几何限制了其在强非线性结构数据上的表现，而现有的神经扩展方法虽然提高了灵活性，但往往削弱了原型和插值的几何意义。因此，本文旨在结合两者的优点。
AI.method: 1) 引入变形星形分布及关联的拉回黎曼几何，为流形映射提供统计解释；2) 定义黎曼原型映射（RAM）为投影到原型测地凸组合流形上；3) 提出基于凸松弛+非凸细化的实用优化方案；4) 提出从数据学习合理（虽一般次优）变形星形分布的学习方案。
AI.result: 在合成数据和MNIST上的实验表明，该方法能产生有意义的测地线、有效的去噪投影以及几何感知的分类，同时也揭示了当前优化限制所在。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的RAM框架成功结合了经典原型分析的可解释性与非线性模型的表达能力，为后续优化改进提供了方向。

title: COSY: Compositional 3DGS Synthesis for Disentangled Human Head Editing
summary: Recent 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) GANs for human heads synthesize and render photorealistic 3D models in real-time and offer a vast variety in identity and appearance. However, controlling specific semantic attributes such as hair color or glasses remains challenging, as edits in the entangled latent space often induce unintended changes in identity or appearance. Although there are several methods that aim to disentangle the latent space post training by estimating directions that only modify certain features, these methods cannot guarantee complete disentanglement and often require pre-trained classifiers. In our approach, we propose a new generator architecture that synthesizes components, such as hair, skin, glasses, and torso, completely independently. This allows for changing the latent vector for one region while keeping the remaining parts fixed. Further, we achieve this separation using only sparse information such as the hair or skin color, eliminating the requirement of segmentation masks or geometric priors, often seen in prior work. To ensure matching shape and lighting conditions during editing, we allow minimal shared information via context tokens between the independent generators. These tokens even allow us to control the shape and light, without any prior annotation. Compared to existing works on GAN-based generation and editing, our method shows better disentanglement, more precise editing control, and competitive visual quality.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种新的3DGS GAN生成器架构，通过完全独立的组件生成（头发、皮肤、眼镜、躯干）实现语义属性的精确解耦控制，仅需稀疏颜色信息即可实现编辑，无需分割掩码或几何先验。
AI.motivation: 现有3DGS GAN在生成逼真3D人体头部模型时，潜在空间高度纠缠，导致编辑特定语义属性（如发色、眼镜）时容易引发身份或外观的意外变化。后训练解耦方法无法保证完全解耦且常需预训练分类器。
AI.method: 设计独立组件生成器架构，每个生成器负责合成特定区域（头发、皮肤、眼镜、躯干）；仅利用稀疏颜色信息（如发色、肤色）实现区域分离；通过上下文令牌在独立生成器之间共享最小化信息，以保证形状和光照条件匹配。
AI.result: 相比现有基于GAN的生成和编辑方法，本方法在解耦性、编辑控制精度上表现更优，视觉质量具有竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 通过组件级独立生成实现语义属性的精确解耦控制，仅需稀疏信息即可完成编辑，消除了对分割掩码或几何先验的依赖。

title: Enhanced INS/GNSS State Estimation using GNSS-Based Acceleration Measurements
summary: Accurate and reliable navigation is essential for autonomous ground vehicle operations. Standard INS/GNSS fusion relies on GNSS position updates, which provide limited observability of orientation and inertial sensor error states, particularly during low-dynamic motion. In this work, we propose utilizing past GNSS measurements alongside a motion model to extract meaningful vehicle acceleration information. This acceleration measurement is then integrated into the INS/GNSS filter to improve its robustness and accuracy. The proposed approach is evaluated on two real-world unmanned ground vehicle datasets collected from different mobile platforms and inertial sensor grades. Results demonstrate consistent positioning accuracy improvements relative to the standard position-aided filter, with mean position root mean square error improvements of 11.40 % and 20.74 % on the two datasets, respectively.

AI.tldr: 本文提出利用历史GNSS测量和运动模型提取车辆加速度信息，并将其集成到INS/GNSS滤波器中，以提高无人地面车辆的导航精度。在两个真实数据集上，相比标准位置辅助滤波器，定位精度分别提升了11.40%和20.74%。
AI.motivation: 标准INS/GNSS融合仅依赖GNSS位置更新，在低动态运动条件下对姿态和惯性传感器误差状态的可观测性有限，导致导航精度和鲁棒性不足。
AI.method: 利用历史GNSS测量结合运动模型提取车辆加速度信息，将这一加速度测量值集成到INS/GNSS滤波器中，以增强状态估计的可观测性。
AI.result: 在两个不同平台和传感器等级的真实无人地面车辆数据集上，平均位置均方根误差分别降低11.40%和20.74%。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的加速度辅助方法能有效提升INS/GNSS融合导航系统的定位精度和鲁棒性，优于标准位置辅助滤波器。

title: Knowledge Graph Modulated Deep Learning for Limited-Sample Clinical Data Analysis
summary: Biological systems are governed by structured molecular interactions, where pathways, regulatory circuits, and functional gene relationships shape cellular behavior and disease progression. Much of this knowledge is naturally represented as graphs. However, most biomedical AI models cannot directly use graph-encoded biological knowledge and instead require compressed low-dimensional representations, which can lose important structure and reduce performance, especially in limited-sample clinical studies. Here, we introduce Graph-in-Graph (GiG), a knowledge graph-modulated deep learning framework for data-efficient clinical prediction. GiG represents each patient as a standalone modular graph, in which curated biological knowledge graphs define edges and patient-specific measurements, such as gene expression, define node features. This design allows multiple biological knowledge graphs to be integrated while preserving gene-gene interactions and pathway topology during patient-level representation learning. Across cohorts comprising nearly 9,700 patients and five clinical tasks, including liquid biopsy cancer detection, prostate cancer diagnosis, and 32-class pan-cancer classification, GiG consistently outperforms traditional and state-of-the-art methods, with the largest gains in limited-sample settings. On the challenging prostate cancer diagnosis task, GiG improves macro-F1 by up to 49 percentage points relative to competing methods. Control experiments replacing real pathway graphs with random topologies confirm that these gains arise from biologically grounded knowledge graph structure rather than graph modeling alone. These findings show that knowledge graph-modulated deep learning can improve robustness, interpretability, and sample efficiency in clinical data analysis, and provide a principled framework for integrating biological knowledge graphs into predictive modeling.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Graph-in-Graph (GiG)框架，将患者表示为以生物学知识图谱定义边、以患者特异性测量定义节点特征的模块化图，在近9700名患者的五个临床任务中，GiG始终优于传统和最新方法，在小样本场景下表现尤为突出（前列腺癌诊断任务宏F1提升高达49个百分点），证明了知识图谱调制的深度学习可提升临床预测的鲁棒性、可解释性和样本效率。
AI.motivation: 现有生物医学AI模型无法直接利用图结构化的生物学知识，而是依赖压缩的低维表示，这会导致关键结构信息丢失，在样本有限的临床研究中性能下降。因此需要一种能够保留生物知识图谱中基因-基因交互和通路拓扑结构的预测框架。
AI.method: GiG将每位患者构建为一个独立的模块化图：节点特征来自患者特异性测量（如基因表达），边由多个 curated 生物学知识图谱定义。在此图结构上进行患者级表示学习，实现多种生物学知识图谱的整合，同时保留基因间相互作用和通路拓扑结构。
AI.result: 在涵盖近9700名患者的五个临床任务（包括液体活检癌症检测、前列腺癌诊断和32类泛癌分类）中，GiG一致优于传统和最新方法。在前列腺癌诊断任务中，宏F1相比竞争方法提升高达49个百分点。对照实验用随机拓扑替换真实通路图后性能下降，证实增益来源于生物学知识图谱结构。
AI.conclusion: 知识图谱调制的深度学习能够提升临床数据分析的鲁棒性、可解释性和样本效率，为将生物学知识图谱整合到预测建模中提供了原则性框架。

title: ImPartial: Multi-channel Whole-Cell Segmentation using Partial Annotations
summary: Accurate cell segmentation in pathology images typically requires dense pixel-wise annotations, which are costly and time-consuming to obtain. This challenge is especially important for emerging biological imaging modalities and multiplexed datasets with variable channel configurations, where expert-labeled data are scarce. In this work, we introduce ImPartial, a deep learning framework designed to achieve state-of-the-art segmentation performance in low-annotation regimes using sparse scribbles and limited supervision. ImPartial augments the segmentation objective via self-supervised multi-channel quantized imputation. This approach leverages the observation that perfect pixel-wise reconstruction or denoising of the image is not needed for accurate segmentation, and thus, introduces a self-supervised classification objective that better aligns with the overall segmentation goal. We demonstrate that ImPartial achieves performance at par with fully supervised models while requiring substantially fewer annotations. Extensive experiments on benchmark multiplexed cellular imaging and single-plex clinical brightfield immunohistochemistry datasets show consistent improvements over strong baselines with only partial annotations. All benchmark datasets and code are available via our Github: https://github.com/nadeemlab/ImPartial.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ImPartial框架，通过稀疏涂鸦标注和自监督多通道量化插补，在仅需少量标注的情况下实现与全监督模型相当的组织病理学图像细胞分割性能。
AI.motivation: 病理图像细胞分割通常需要密集的像素级标注，成本高昂且耗时。新兴生物成像模态和多通道数据集缺乏专家标注数据，亟需一种在低标注条件下仍能保持高分割性能的方法。
AI.method: ImPartial采用深度学习框架，利用稀疏涂鸦（scribbles）作为有限监督信号，并引入自监督多通道量化插补（self-supervised multi-channel quantized imputation）来增强分割目标。该方法不追求完美的像素级重建或去噪，而是设计一个与分割任务更一致的自监督分类目标。
AI.result: 在基准多通道细胞成像和单通道临床亮场免疫组化数据集上，ImPartial在仅使用部分标注的情况下，性能与全监督模型相当，且一致优于强基线方法。
AI.conclusion: ImPartial有效解决了低标注场景下病理图像细胞分割的难题，大幅降低了标注成本，代码和数据集已开源。

title: MR-LiDAR: A Multi-Resolution Roadside LiDAR Benchmark for Perception Diagnostics and Deployment Guidance
summary: LiDAR model selection is a critical issue in roadside sensing systems, as it directly determines both perception capability and deployment cost. However, the lack of empirical benchmarks for comparing perception performance across different LiDAR configurations has greatly constrained scientific sensor selection and deployment planning. To address this gap, we present MR-LiDAR, a controlled multi-resolution LiDAR benchmark for roadside perception diagnostics. Using 16-, 32-, 80-, and 128-beam LiDARs in identical roadside scenarios, we collect point clouds and ground-truth annotations for diverse traffic participants, including vehicles and vulnerable road users (VRUs), across varying distances. This controlled design isolates intrinsic LiDAR specifications, particularly beam count and beam distribution, as the key variables for precise performance diagnostics. Based on MR-LiDAR, we conduct systematic empirical analyses to examine how beam count, beam distribution, target distance, object category, and vehicle occlusion affect LiDAR perception performance. The results reveal that all of these factors have substantial impacts. In particular, contrary to the common assumption that higher beam counts always yield better perception, we show that an 80-beam LiDAR with optimized beam distribution can match or even outperform a 128-beam LiDAR with uniform beam distribution. In addition, we provide a practical reference guide for LiDAR selection, including target point-count statistics and detection performance comparisons based on two widely used detection algorithms. This work offers a diagnostic benchmark and practical guidance for determining cost-effective LiDAR configurations in roadside perception applications.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MR-LiDAR，一个多分辨率LiDAR基准数据集，用于路侧感知诊断。通过16/32/80/128线LiDAR在相同路侧场景下采集数据，系统分析光束数、光束分布、目标距离、目标类别和车辆遮挡对感知性能的影响。实验结果挑战了"更高线数=更好感知"的常识，发现80线优化分布LiDAR可匹敌甚至超越128线均匀分布LiDAR。
AI.motivation: LiDAR选型在路侧感知系统中至关重要，但缺乏不同LiDAR配置下感知性能的实证基准，制约了科学的传感器选型和部署规划。
AI.method: 构建MR-LiDAR基准：在相同路侧场景下使用16、32、80、128线LiDAR采集点云与真值标注（涵盖车辆和弱势道路使用者），通过控制变量法隔离光束数和光束分布等关键规格进行诊断分析。
AI.result: 光束数、光束分布、目标距离、目标类别和车辆遮挡均显著影响感知性能。80线优化分布LiDAR可匹配或超越128线均匀分布LiDAR。提供了目标点计数统计和基于两种检测算法的性能对比参考指南。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为路侧感知应用中的成本效益LiDAR配置提供了诊断基准和实践指导。

title: PromptAudit: Auditing Prompt Sensitivity in LLM-Based Vulnerability Detection
summary: Large language models are increasingly used for vulnerability detection, yet their reliability under different prompt formulations remains uncharacterized. We present PromptAudit, a controlled evaluation framework that isolates prompt effects by fixing the dataset, decoding, and parsing while varying only the prompting strategy. Using five prompting strategies across five open-weight models on 1,000 CVEs (6,074 code samples spanning 16 programming languages), we evaluate accuracy, recall, abstention, coverage, and effective F1. We find that standard chain-of-thought prompting achieves the strongest overall operational performance, while few-shot prompting provides model-dependent benefits that are most pronounced for prompt-sensitive models. In contrast, adaptive chain-of-thought frequently suppresses recall and self-consistency induces excessive abstention, sharply reducing effective performance. These results show that vulnerability detection behavior is jointly determined by the model and the prompt, and that prompt sensitivity is a first-class system property that must be explicitly characterized in evaluation and deployment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PromptAudit框架，系统评估了不同提示策略对LLM漏洞检测能力的影响。在固定数据集、解码和解析条件下，测试5种提示策略、5个开源模型、1000个CVE（6074个代码样本，16种编程语言）。发现标准思维链提示整体性能最优，少样本提示对提示敏感模型有增益，而自适应思维链会降低召回率，自一致性则导致过度弃权。结果表明漏洞检测行为由模型和提示共同决定，提示敏感性应作为系统级属性在评估和部署中显式表征。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在漏洞检测中的应用日益广泛，但不同提示措辞对其可靠性的影响尚未被系统刻画。现有研究往往混杂了模型、数据集、解码策略等多种变量，缺乏对提示效果本身的可控隔离评估。
AI.method: 提出PromptAudit控制评估框架，固定数据集、解码和解析方式，仅变化提示策略。在5种提示策略（含思维链、少样本、自适应思维链、自一致性等）下，对5个开源模型、1000个CVE（6074个样本，16种语言）进行实验，评估准确率、召回率、弃权率、覆盖率和有效F1指标。
AI.result: 标准思维链提示在整体操作性能上最优；少样本提示对提示敏感模型有显著增益；自适应思维链会抑制召回率；自一致性导致过度弃权，大幅降低有效性能。漏洞检测行为由模型和提示共同决定。
AI.conclusion: 提示敏感性应作为系统级第一类属性，在LLM漏洞检测的评估和部署中必须被显式刻画。

title: EchoVQA: Enabling Conversational Assistance for Point-of-Care Cardiac Ultrasound
summary: Point-of-care transthoracic echocardiography (TTE) enables cardiac assessment in virtually any clinical setting, yet its diagnostic utility remains constrained by the expertise required for image acquisition and interpretation. Visual question answering (VQA) offers a promising paradigm for bridging this expertise gap through interactive clinical assistance, but existing echocardiography VQA datasets are limited in scale, restricted to high-quality images, and only cover a few views. We introduce EchoVQA, the first large-scale VQA dataset for echocardiography, comprising 14,299 images and 74,819 question-answer pairs. The dataset integrates public sources (EchoNet-Dynamic, CAMUS) with our own point-of-care acquisitions from two handheld probes (Lumify, Clarius), spanning diverse views and including both high-quality and suboptimal images. Uniquely, EchoVQA includes acquisition guidance questions to help users optimize transducer positioning toward a diagnostic apical 4-chamber view for left ventricular ejection fraction estimation -- a challenging task for novice operators in point-of-care settings. We further develop a parameter-efficient method based on multimodal learnable prompts achieving state-of-the-art performance on most benchmarks, including EchoVQA, with significantly less trainable parameters than existing state-of-the-art approaches.

AI.tldr: 论文提出了EchoVQA，首个大规模超声心动图视觉问答数据集，包含14,299张图像和74,819个问答对，涵盖多种视图和质量水平，并引入采集引导问题帮助非专业用户优化探头位置。同时提出基于多模态可学习提示的参数高效方法，在多个基准上达到最优性能。
AI.motivation: 床旁超声心动图的诊断效用受限于操作者的图像采集和解读专业知识，现有超声心动图VQA数据集规模小、仅限于高质量图像且覆盖视图有限，亟需大规模、多样化的数据集来桥接这一专业知识鸿沟。
AI.method: 构建EchoVQA数据集：整合EchoNet-Dynamic、CAMUS等公开资源以及使用Lumify、Clarius两种手持探头采集的床旁数据，包含14,299张图像和74,819个问答对，涵盖多种视图及高质量和次优图像，并包含采集引导问题。方法上提出基于多模态可学习提示的参数高效方法。
AI.result: 该数据集和提出的方法在包括EchoVQA在内的大多数基准上取得了最优性能，且可训练参数显著少于现有最优方法。
AI.conclusion: EchoVQA填补了超声心动图VQA领域大规模、多样化数据集的空白，采集引导问题的引入有助于新手在床旁场景下优化探头定位；提出的参数高效方法在减少计算开销的同时保持优异性能。

title: Manifold-Constrained MPPI: Real-Time Sampling-Based Control Under Hard Constraints
comment: International Journal of Control, Automation, and Systems
summary: Sampling-based model predictive control methods, such as Model Predictive Path Integral (MPPI), offer derivative-free optimization and robustness in complex robotic systems. However, standard MPPI relies on cost-based soft penalties that cannot guarantee hard-constraint satisfaction, severely limiting its applicability to highly constrained tasks such as closed-chain manipulation. To address this, we propose Manifold-Constrained MPPI (MC-MPPI), a real-time sampling-based control framework that enforces manifold-based equality constraints while preserving the computational advantages of MPPI. The key idea is to decouple the constrained optimal control problem into latent-space planning and execution-level correction. At the planning stage, a Variational Autoencoder (VAE) learns a low-dimensional latent representation of the constraint manifold, enabling MPPI to efficiently generate near-feasible candidate trajectories without per-sample modification. Since this reference enables accurate linearization of the equality constraints, an execution-level Quadratic Programming (QP) controller resolves the residual manifold mismatch in a single solve rather than through iterative projection. Experiments on a 14-DoF closed-chain dual-arm system in both simulation and real-world settings demonstrate that MC-MPPI operates stably at 100 Hz, reliably navigates dynamic environments while effectively maintaining hard equality constraints, and significantly outperforms baseline methods in tracking accuracy. Supplementary videos and implementation details are available at https://rcilab.github.io/mcmppi.

AI.tldr: 提出MC-MPPI框架，通过VAE学习约束流形的低维潜空间表示，结合MPPI规划近可行轨迹和QP控制器单次求解残差流形偏差，实现在14自由度闭链双臂系统上100Hz实时运行且严格满足等式约束。
AI.motivation: 标准MPPI使用基于成本的软罚项无法保证硬约束满足，严重限制其在闭链操作等高约束任务中的适用性。
AI.method: 将受约束最优控制问题解耦为潜空间规划（VAE学习约束流形低维表示，MPPI生成近可行候选轨迹）和执行层校正（QP控制器单次求解残差流形偏差）。
AI.result: 在14自由度闭链双臂系统仿真和真实实验中，MC-MPPI以100Hz稳定运行，有效维持硬等式约束并动态导航，在跟踪精度上显著优于基线方法。
AI.conclusion: MC-MPPI在保持MPPI计算优势的同时实现了硬约束满足，为约束严格的任务提供了实时可行的采样控制方案。

title: Filtered Posterior Mean Collections: A Unified Framework for Analytical Models of Diffusion Generalization
summary: The neural-network denoising functions which form the backbone of image diffusion models are remarkably consistent in their generalization behaviour across a wide variety of network architectures and training procedure hyperparameters. A recent line of research has sought to model the outputs of these networks by aggregating posterior weighted averages of training dataset patches. In this work, we consolidate these approaches into a unified model class which we call Filtered Posterior Mean Collections (FPMCs). We define this model class using query precision vectors, response weights, and source distributions, and illustrate that existing methods are recoverable with specific choices of these design axes. Investigating each axis in turn, we find that FPMC performance can be improved with soft relaxations of prior patch-based methods, and through augmentations of source distributions. Applying these findings to an existing FPMC, we demonstrate consistent sample improvement across three natural image datasets.

AI.tldr: 本文提出滤波后验均值集合（FPMC）统一模型，通过查询精度向量、响应权重和源分布三个设计轴，对现有基于图像块聚合的后验加权平均方法进行整合与改进，并通过软松弛和源分布增强提升了样本质量。
AI.motivation: 图像扩散模型中的去噪网络在不同架构和训练超参数下表现出惊人的泛化一致性，近期研究试图通过聚合训练数据集图像块的后验加权平均来建模网络输出。然而这些方法分散且缺乏统一框架，需要整合并找出改进方向。
AI.method: 提出滤波后验均值集合（FPMC）统一模型框架，定义三个设计轴：查询精度向量（query precision vectors）、响应权重（response weights）和源分布（source distributions）。通过特定选择可恢复现有方法，并引入软松弛改进先前的基于图像块方法，以及通过源分布增强来提升性能。
AI.result: 在三个自然图像数据集上，将改进应用于现有FPMC后，持续一致地提升了样本质量。
AI.conclusion: FPMC提供了一个统一的理论框架，通过软松弛和源分布增强等策略，可以有效改善基于图像块后验加权平均的扩散模型去噪性能。

title: Loki: Representation over Architecture for Diffusion-Based Portrait Animation
summary: Portrait animation transfers a driver clip's facial expression and head pose onto a single reference image while preserving the reference's identity. State-of-the-art diffusion systems address this by stacking trained modules for expression, pose, and identity in turn, paying for it in trainable parameters, proprietary corpora, and residual entanglement between the very axes the system is meant to control independently. This complexity compensates for an upstream choice -- learning facial expression and head pose from RGB, a representation in which identity, pose, and expression are inseparable without being learned apart. Loki steps out of RGB on the conditioning path. Driver expression and head pose are encoded by a face model whose parameter axes are identity-orthogonal by construction, then rasterised into a spatial map that the diffusion backbone consumes natively. Identity is routed separately through the diffusion backbone's own pretrained features via lightweight key-value injection. Because the parametric representation factorises identity from expression and pose, cross ID reenactment reduces to a coefficient substitution at inference, requiring no cross ID training data. Loki requires ~43% fewer inference parameters than leading diffusion baselines and trained on 1496x less video samples. We define two metrics that directly measure whether the generated head pose trajectory and facial expression followed the driver's -- the questions portrait animation actually asks; Loki leads or co-leads on both.

AI.tldr: Loki通过使用3D人脸模型参数（而非RGB）编码驱动者的表情和姿态，实现轻量级、解耦的肖像动画，在减少43%推理参数和1496倍训练数据的情况下，在姿态和表情跟随指标上达到领先水平。
AI.motivation: 现有扩散式肖像动画系统存在三个问题：1) 大量可训练参数和专有数据集；2) 身份、表情、姿态三个本应独立控制的轴之间存在残留纠缠；3) 根源在于从RGB学习表情和姿态，而RGB中身份、姿态、表情天然不可分。
AI.method: 1) 在条件路径上脱离RGB，使用3D人脸模型编码驱动表情和姿态，该模型的参数轴与身份正交；2) 将参数栅格化为空间图供扩散主干原生使用；3) 身份通过轻量级KV注入路由到扩散主干的预训练特征中；4) 跨身份重演只需在推理时替换系数，无需跨身份训练数据。
AI.result: 推理参数比领先扩散基线少约43%；训练视频样本减少1496倍；在提出的两个直接度量头部姿态轨迹和面部表情跟随驱动者的指标上，Loki达到领先或并列领先。
AI.conclusion: 通过参数化表示将身份与表情/姿态解耦，Loki以更少的参数和数据实现了更好的控制解耦和性能，验证了在条件路径上使用参数化人脸模型替代RGB的有效性。

title: Learning Transferable Motor Skills for Geometry-Aware Robotic Surface Tasks
summary: Robotic surface-interaction tasks, such as spray painting or welding, require both accurate geometric planning and precise motion execution. While modern motion planners generate valid geometric paths, they often lack the expert motor patterns observed in human operators. Conversely, learning from demonstration often tightly couples task execution to the specific training geometry, limiting transferability. We propose a modular framework that decouples geometric motion planning from execution-level expertise. Expert behavior is represented as a vocabulary of interpretable, atomic motor rules, such as velocity scaling and orientation offsets, that systematically modify a geometrically planned reference path. We train a multimodal neural network to infer rule parameters jointly from kinematic trajectory data and CAD model geometry. We evaluate our approach through dynamic simulation on L-shaped and window-shaped objects, demonstrating on simulated data that the model successfully extracts velocity and orientation rules across both topologies.

AI.tldr: 提出一种模块化框架，将几何运动规划与执行技能解耦，通过可解释的原子运动规则（如速度缩放、姿态偏移）和神经网络参数推理，实现跨几何拓扑的专家行为迁移。
AI.motivation: 现有几何运动规划缺乏人类操作员的专家运动模式，而示教学习又紧密耦合于特定训练几何形状，泛化能力差。
AI.method: 构建由可解释原子运动规则（速度缩放、姿态偏移等）组成的专家行为词汇表，训练多模态神经网络从运动轨迹和CAD模型几何中联合推理规则参数，对几何参考路径进行系统修改。
AI.result: 在L形和窗形物体的动态仿真中，模型成功提取了跨拓扑的速度和姿态规则。
AI.conclusion: 所提框架有效解耦了几何规划与执行技能，在保持泛化性的同时实现了专家级执行模式迁移。

title: Characterizing the Representational Capacity of Neural Processes
summary: What functions can Neural Processes represent? We analyze the representational capacity of popular NP architectures: Conditional Neural Processes (CNPs), Attentive Neural Processes (ANPs), Transformer Neural Processes (TNPs), and their latent variants. We prove these architectures form a strict hierarchy. CNP-representable functions are exactly those depending on finitely many expected features of the context distribution. ANPs strictly generalize CNPs via query-dependent reweighting, enabling kernel smoothers. ConvCNPs and ANPs are incomparable; each contains functions outside the other, separated by stationarity versus translation equivariance. TNPs with $L$ self-attention layers capture $L$-hop context interactions. For latent NPs, we show finite-dimensional latents provide coherent sampling but do not circumvent encoder limitations; matching GP posterior distributions requires latent dimension scaling with context size. These results provide a theoretical foundation for architecture selection based on task structure.

AI.tldr: 本文严格证明了神经过程（NP）及其变体（CNP、ANP、ConvCNP、TNP、潜在NP）的表达能力存在严格层级关系：CNP只能表示依赖于上下文分布有限期望特征的函数；ANP通过查询依赖重加权严格泛化CNP，实现核平滑器；ConvCNP与ANP不可比较；TNP通过L层自注意力捕获L跳上下文交互；有限维潜在变量虽能生成一致样本，但无法绕过编码器限制，匹配高斯过程后验需潜在维度随上下文大小扩展。
AI.motivation: 为NP架构选择提供理论基础，通过严格分析不同NP变体的表达能力边界，揭示其与任务结构（如平稳性、平移等变性、交互复杂度）的关系。
AI.method: 基于函数空间的可表示性理论分析，通过证明包含关系和分离性构造，建立CNP、ANP、ConvCNP、TNP及潜在NP之间的严格表达能力层级。
AI.result: (1) CNP等价于依赖上下文分布有限期望特征的函数；(2) ANP严格强于CNP，但弱于核方法；(3) ConvCNP与ANP不可比较；(4) TNP的L层自注意力对应L跳交互；(5) 有限维潜在NP的编码器是表达能力瓶颈。
AI.conclusion: NP各架构形成严格表达能力层级，为根据任务特性（如是否需要平移等变性、全局交互阶数、一致采样）选择合适架构提供了理论指导。

title: Single View Seafloor Recovery from Imaging Sonar via Differentiable Rendering
summary:
Sonar is often the only modality suitable for high-resolution imaging underwater due to light attenuation and turbidity. Forward-looking imaging sonar provides measurements over range and horizontal angle but collapses vertical structure into a flat image, creating ambiguities that make 3D recovery challenging. A common use case for imaging sonar is underwater terrain mapping (bathymetry), yet current methods require many views, expensive multi-sensor setups, or significant training data, which limits use and adaptability to new environments.
  We present a training-free method that recovers bathymetry from a single sonar image in under 30 seconds via differentiable rendering, conditioned on a known seafloor tilt. To our knowledge, this is the first differentiable rendering approach for single-view height recovery in sonar. Our method implements differentiable sonar ray tracing and optimizes an explicit height field to reproduce the target image. On synthetic datasets, our approach outperforms a supervised CNN under distribution shift and remains close on rough terrain, while the CNN wins in-distribution. By modeling physically grounded priors of the sonar process, our method adapts across sensor configurations and environments without training data.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种基于可微渲染的无训练方法，能在30秒内从单张前视成像声纳图像中恢复水下地形高度图（水深测量），无需训练数据即可适应不同传感器和环境。
AI.motivation: 现有水下声纳地形重建方法需要多视角、昂贵多传感器设置或大量训练数据，限制了其适用性和对新环境的适应能力。本文旨在解决从单张声纳图像进行3D高度恢复的难题。
AI.method: 提出无训练的可微渲染方法，通过可微分声纳射线追踪，优化显式高度场以复现目标图像，并利用已知的海底倾斜作为条件约束。
AI.result: 在合成数据集上，方法在分布偏移下优于有监督CNN，在粗糙地形上性能相近；CNN在分布内数据上更优。方法能在30秒内完成单视图高度恢复。
AI.conclusion: 通过建模声纳过程的物理先验，方法无需训练数据即可跨传感器配置和环境适应，是首个用于声纳单视图高度恢复的可微渲染方法。

title: MuJoCoUni:Persistent Batched Runtime Primitives for MuJoCo
summary: We present MuJoCoUni, a downstream MuJoCo distribution for online robot learning and batched physics evaluation. Alongside the open-loop batched trajectory generation already provided by upstream mujoco.rollout, MuJoCoUni supplies runtime primitives for stateful environment execution. The target workloads need high-throughput parallel execution while retaining upstream CPU MuJoCo semantics for models, sensors, contact, and constraints. Its core object, BatchEnvPool, is a C++/pybind11 executor that owns per-environment mjModel copies, per-thread mjData workers, and an internal thread pool. It provides final-state-only short stepping, sparse reset, reset-lifecycle domain randomization, batched sensor forward evaluation without advancing dynamics, and batched Jacobian and height-field queries. The implementation is confined to the Python binding layer; MuJoCo's solver, contact model, integrator, and core source tree retain upstream semantics. This report describes the BatchEnvPool API, implementation boundary, relationship to rollout, and the validation and benchmark scripts shipped with the open-source mujoco-uni package, which is installed with \texttt{pip install mujoco-uni}.

AI.tldr: MuJoCoUni是一个基于MuJoCo的下游库，提供BatchEnvPool执行器用于在线机器人学习和批量物理评估，支持有状态环境执行、高吞吐并行仿真，并通过Python绑定层实现，保持上游语义完整。
AI.motivation: MuJoCo的upstream（mujoco.rollout）仅提供开环批处理轨迹生成，缺乏支持在线机器人学习所需的有状态环境执行、运行时域随机化、批处理传感器前向评估等功能，因此需要MuJoCoUni来填补这一空白。
AI.method: 设计并实现BatchEnvPool——一个C++/pybind11执行器，包含每个环境的mjModel副本、每线程的mjData工作线程以及内部线程池。提供最终状态短步进、稀疏重置、重置生命周期域随机化、批处理传感器前向评估、批处理Jacobian和高度场查询等原语，所有实现仅限Python绑定层。
AI.result: MuJoCoUni以pip包形式发布（pip install mujoco-uni），包含验证和基准测试脚本，在高吞吐并行执行环境中保持与上游CPU MuJoCo在模型、传感器、接触和约束方面语义一致。
AI.conclusion: MuJoCoUni在保持上游MuJoCo核心求解器、接触模型、积分器和源码树语义完全不变的前提下，通过Python绑定层扩展了批处理并行有状态仿真能力，为在线机器人学习提供高效的物理评估基础设施。

title: Agent-ToM: Learning to Monitor Autonomous LLM Agents via Theory-of-Mind Reasoning
summary:
Monitoring autonomous large language model (LLM) agents for covert malicious behavior is challenging due to delayed, context-dependent, and long-horizon attack patterns. Agents may pursue hidden objectives while maintaining superficially benign behavior, making detection difficult even with full trajectory access. Prior monitoring approaches improve scaffolding or ensemble aggregation, but treat each trajectory independently and do not learn from prior monitoring experience. Moreover, standard reasoning methods explain observed behavior without explicitly reasoning about agent beliefs, intentions, and goal alignment required to distinguish benign task execution from covert deviation.
  We propose \textbf{Agent-ToM}, a learning-to-monitor framework grounded in Theory-of-Mind (ToM) reasoning for security analysis of autonomous agents. Agent-ToM performs structured full-trajectory analysis by inferring beliefs, intent hypotheses with calibrated confidence, expected actions, and deviations from task-consistent behavioral baselines. At inference time, it employs a \textit{Reason-Verify-Refine} pipeline to construct and validate monitoring decisions. At training time, Agent-ToM distills critique signals into a persistent \textit{semantic guardrail memory}, enabling reusable belief- and intent-conditioned constraints across episodes. We evaluate Agent-ToM on adversarial agent monitoring benchmarks (SHADE-Arena and CUA-SHADE-Arena). Agent-ToM achieves strong precision-recall balance and outperforms state-of-the-art monitoring baselines, including ensemble methods, while using a coherent two-call reasoning pipeline. These results demonstrate that learning at the monitoring layer, combined with structured ToM reasoning and verification, provides an effective and deployable foundation for securing autonomous LLM agents.
