AI.tldr: 提出Agent-ToM框架，基于心智理论（ToM）推理对自主LLM agent进行安全监控，通过推理信念、意图、预期行为与任务一致行为基线之间的偏差，结合Reason-Verify-Refine推理管道和语义护栏记忆，在对抗性监控基准上达到SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 现有监控方法缺乏对先前监控经验的学习能力，且标准推理方法未能显式推理agent的信念、意图和目标对齐，难以区分良性任务执行与隐蔽恶意偏离。
AI.method: 提出Agent-ToM框架，包含：(1) 基于ToM的结构化全轨迹分析，推断信念、意图假设及校准置信度、预期行为和偏差；(2) 推理时采用Reason-Verify-Refine管道构建和验证监控决策；(3) 训练时将批评信号蒸馏为持久化的语义护栏记忆，实现跨episode可复用的信念和意图条件约束。
AI.result: 在SHADE-Arena和CUA-SHADE-Arena基准上，Agent-ToM实现了良好的精确率-召回率平衡，在仅使用两轮推理管道的情况下，性能优于包括集成方法在内的SOTA监控基线。
AI.conclusion: 在监控层进行学习，结合结构化ToM推理与验证，为自主LLM agent的安全监控提供了有效且可部署的基础。

title: Radiuma: A Unified Zero-Code Executable Graphical Workflow Generator for Reproducible and Shareable Medical Image Analysis and Machine Learning
summary: Medical image computing software is essential for identifying imaging biomarkers that can support diagnosis, prognosis, treatment planning, and clinical research. However, the lack of standardized, user-friendly, and reproducible software environments has limited the broader adoption of advanced medical image analysis workflows. We present Radiuma, a freely available modular platform designed to support reliable and reproducible medical image analysis across multiple modalities and file formats. Radiuma integrates image reading, visualization, registration, fusion, processing, segmentation, radiomics feature extraction, and machine learning modules for classification, regression, and clustering. Its modular design allows users to execute each component independently or connect modules through a visual workflow system, where the output of one step can be graphically passed to the next. This enables the creation of custom, executable, and reproducible multi-step pipelines without requiring extensive programming expertise. Results from each module can be inspected directly in the visualization window, providing immediate feedback on processing quality and workflow accuracy. Radiuma also supports saving and sharing customized workflows, promoting transparency, reusability, and consistency across collaborative studies. By combining flexibility, usability, and standardized analysis tools, Radiuma provides a practical environment for radiomics and machine learning research in clinical and translational settings. The platform is designed to be accessible to users with diverse expertise, including radiologists, physicists, clinicians, and data scientists.

AI.tldr: Radiuma是一个面向医学图像分析的开源模块化平台，集成了图像读取、可视化、配准、融合、分割、放射组学特征提取及机器学习等功能，支持通过可视化工作流系统构建可重复的多步骤分析流程，无需编程经验。
AI.motivation: 现有医学图像计算软件缺乏标准化、易用且可重现的环境，限制了先进医学图像分析工作流的广泛采用。
AI.method: 采用模块化架构设计，集成图像读取、可视化、配准、融合、处理、分割、放射组学特征提取以及分类/回归/聚类等机器学习模块；提供可视化工作流系统，支持模块间图形化连接与输出传递；支持保存和共享自定义工作流。
AI.result: 各模块结果可直接在可视化窗口中检查，提供即时反馈；支持跨模态和多文件格式的可靠、可重现分析；实现了无需编程即可构建自定义、可执行、可重现的多步骤流水线。
AI.conclusion: Radiuma通过结合灵活性、易用性和标准化分析工具，为临床与转化研究中的放射组学和机器学习研究提供了实用的分析环境，适用于放射科医生、物理师、临床医生和数据科学家等不同专业背景的用户。

title: Dynamic Neural Koopman Distillation for Real-Time Robot Control Using Diffusion Models
summary: Diffusion models excel at generating diverse and multimodal trajectories for robotic planning, yet their iterative denoising process introduces latency that is incompatible with high-frequency closed-loop control. To address this problem, we propose Dynamic Neural Koopman Distillation, a framework that distills multistep diffusion inference into a single forward pass while retaining the multimodal expressivity of the teacher model. Specifically, we introduce a Factorized Dynamic Koopman layer that models the denoising process through a factorized latent transition with state-dependent modal gains. We evaluate the proposed method on standard D4RL MuJoCo locomotion benchmarks and a physical Kinova manipulator, comparing against one-step baselines. The results show that our method significantly outperforms existing one-step distillation approaches on the reported locomotion tasks, and reduces the inference latency to the millisecond regime compared with the teacher policy. Hardware experiments further demonstrate that our method enables smooth and fast closed-loop execution while maintaining task success and comparable accuracy. A project page is available at https://fdkoopman.github.io/.

AI.tldr: 提出动态神经Koopman蒸馏框架，将扩散模型的多步去噪过程蒸馏为单步前向推理，同时保留多模态表达能力，显著降低推理延迟至毫秒级，在D4RL MuJoCo和真实机械臂上验证了有效性。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型在机器人规划中生成多样化和多模态轨迹表现出色，但其迭代去噪过程引入的延迟不适用于高频闭环控制。
AI.method: 提出Dynamic Neural Koopman Distillation框架，通过Factorized Dynamic Koopman层建模去噪过程，利用因子化潜在状态转移和状态依赖模态增益实现单步蒸馏。
AI.result: 在D4RL MuJoCo运动基准上显著优于现有单步蒸馏方法，推理延迟降至毫秒级；在真实Kinova机械臂上实现了平滑快速的闭环执行。
AI.conclusion: 该方法在保持任务成功率和相当精度的同时，实现了快速闭环控制，弥合了扩散模型与实时机器人控制之间的鸿沟。

title: PrivFusion: A Privacy-preserving Multi-Agent Framework for Harmonizing Distributed Datasets
summary: The growing availability of clinical data has increased the use of machine learning, yet centralized data aggregation is often infeasible for sensitive health information. Federated Learning (FL) offers a distributed alternative, but its adoption is limited by substantial heterogeneity across institutional datasets, making harmonization a critical but frequently overlooked prerequisite for multi-site analytics. We introduce PrivFusion, a privacy-preserving multi-agent framework that automates the harmonization of structured datasets prior to federated training. PrivFusion uses agents to analyze local data, cluster semantically similar features across sites, and provide iterative transformation recommendations until alignment is achieved. Evaluation across four heterogeneous COVID-19 datasets demonstrates that PrivFusion effectively and efficiently harmonizes multi-site data while substantially reducing manual effort.

AI.tldr: PrivFusion是一个隐私保护的多智能体框架，能够在联邦学习之前自动完成跨机构结构化数据集的语义对齐与特征协调，有效减少人工干预。
AI.motivation: 联邦学习中各机构数据集存在显著的异质性（如特征命名、编码方式不一致），数据协调是多站点分析的关键前提但常被忽视，现有方法缺乏自动化且隐私保护的协调机制。
AI.method: 提出PrivFusion多智能体框架：智能体分析本地数据、聚类跨站点的语义相似特征、迭代提供转换建议直至数据对齐，整个过程在不暴露原始数据的前提下完成。
AI.result: 在四个异质性COVID-19数据集上的评估表明，PrivFusion能够有效且高效地协调多站点数据，同时大幅减少人工协调工作量。
AI.conclusion: PrivFusion为联邦学习中数据异质性这一关键瓶颈提供了自动化、隐私保护的解决方案，推动了多站点协作分析的可行性。

title: GIBLy: Improving 3D Semantic Segmentation through an Architecture-Agnostic Lightweight Geometric Inductive Bias Layer
summary: In 3D scene understanding, deep learning models rely on large models and extensive training to capture basic geometric structures that are present in the 3D data. However, existing methods lack explicit mechanisms to incorporate geometric information, such as learnable primitive shapes, often necessitating large models and more training data which in turn increases cost and can limit generalization. We introduce GIBLy, a lightweight geometric inductive bias layer that integrates learnable geometric priors into 3D segmentation pipelines. GIBLy enhances existing architectures -- whether MLP-based, convolution-based, or transformer-based -- by providing features aligned with simple geometric shapes (and thus human-interpretable) that improve segmentation performance with minimal computational overhead. We validate our approach across multiple 3D semantic segmentation benchmarks, demonstrating consistent performance gains, including up to +11.5% mIoU on TS40K with PTV3, while adding only 58K extra parameters. Our results highlight the benefit of explicitly encoding geometric structure to support accurate and efficient 3D scene understanding, with a lightweight add-on layer

AI.tldr: GIBLy是一种轻量级的几何归纳偏置层，通过可学习的几何先验（基本形状特征）增强现有3D分割架构（MLP、卷积、Transformer），仅需极少额外参数即可显著提升分割性能（如TS40K上+11.5% mIoU，仅增58K参数）。
AI.motivation: 现有3D场景理解方法缺乏显式融入几何信息的机制（如可学习基元形状），导致依赖大模型和大量训练数据，成本高且泛化能力受限。
AI.method: 提出GIBLy，一种轻量级几何归纳偏置层，通过集成可学习几何先验（简单几何形状对齐的特征）增强现有3D分割架构（MLP、卷积、Transformer），以最小计算开销提升分割性能。
AI.result: 在多个3D语义分割基准上取得一致性能提升，包括在TS40K数据集上基于PTV3架构实现+11.5% mIoU，仅增加58K额外参数。
AI.conclusion: 显式编码几何结构有助于支持准确且高效的3D场景理解，GIBLy作为轻量级附加层证明了这一方法的有效性。

title: Learning High-Frequency Continuous Action Chunks in Latent Space
summary: Modern robotic policies increasingly rely on action chunking to execute complex tasks in the physical world. While action chunking improves temporal consistency at moderate action frequencies, it becomes insufficient when the action frequency is further increased (e.g., to 60~Hz). At such high frequencies, policies often fail to generate actions that are both temporally smooth and spatially consistent. We address this challenge by shifting high-frequency action learning from the action space to a latent space with variational autoencoder (VAE). This formulation significantly improves both temporal and spatial consistency of high-frequency control. To enable smooth real-time execution, we further introduce Reuse-then-Refine, a chunk-level refine strategy that improves continuity between adjacent action chunks under asynchronous inference. As a result, robots controlled by our policy can execute complex contact-rich tasks continuously, with less pauses and jerky motions. Experiments on three real-world contact-rich robotic tasks show that our approach consistently completes tasks with smooth motions. Our code and data are available at https://github.com/tars-robotics/RTR.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种将高频动作学习从动作空间转移到潜在空间（使用VAE）的方法，并引入Reuse-then-Refine分块精炼策略，以实现高频控制下时间平滑和空间一致的机器人动作生成，在三个真实世界接触丰富任务上验证了有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有基于动作分块的策略在中频下表现良好，但在高频（如60Hz）下难以同时保证动作的时间平滑性和空间一致性，导致机器人执行接触丰富任务时出现停顿和抖动。
AI.method: 1) 使用变分自编码器（VAE）将高频动作学习从动作空间转移到潜在空间，提升时空一致性；2) 提出Reuse-then-Refine分块级精炼策略，改善异步推理下相邻动作块之间的连续性。
AI.result: 在三个真实世界的接触丰富机器人任务上，该方法能够一致地完成任务并产生平滑的运动，减少了停顿和抖动。
AI.conclusion: 将高频动作学习转移到VAE潜在空间并配合Reuse-then-Refine策略，能有效解决高频控制下的时空一致性问题，使机器人能够连续、平滑地执行复杂的接触丰富任务。

title: Rethinking Continual Anomaly Detection on the Edge: Benchmarking Under Realistic Industrial Conditions
summary: Continual anomaly detection (CAD) addresses the need for industrial inspection systems to adapt to evolving production conditions, yet existing methods share three critical gaps: unrealistic evaluation, no systematic comparison, and no consideration of edge deployment constraints. We introduce a unified benchmark combining discrete-task evaluation on structural and logical anomalies, a novel continuous drift protocol, the first head-to-head comparison of all published CAD methods, and computational efficiency profiling on edge hardware. Our results reveal that existing CAD methods do not consistently outperform traditional approaches with simple experience replay. Thus motivated, we propose DINOSaur, a training-free method combining a frozen DINOv3 backbone with spatially-indexed coreset memory and neighborhood-restricted anomaly scoring. DINOSaur achieves zero forgetting by construction, outperforms all evaluated methods across all five protocols, and runs at sub-100\,ms inference on an NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano, with on-device adaptation to new tasks in under 30 seconds.

AI.tldr: 本文指出现有持续异常检测（CAD）方法存在三个关键缺陷：评估不现实、缺乏系统比较、未考虑边缘部署约束。作者构建了统一基准，发现现有CAD方法并不优于简单经验回放的传统方法，进而提出免训练的DINOSaur方法，结合冻结的DINOv3骨干网络、空间索引核心集记忆和邻域限制异常评分，实现零遗忘、超越所有方法，并在Jetson Orin Nano上达到亚100ms推理、30秒内设备端适应新任务。
AI.motivation: 现有持续异常检测方法在工业检测中面临三个关键缺陷：评估不切实际、缺乏系统性比较、忽略边缘部署限制，因此需要统一基准和更高效的方法。
AI.method: 提出DINOSaur方法：采用冻结的DINOv3骨干网络提取特征，结合空间索引核心集记忆（coreset memory）和邻域限制异常评分（neighborhood-restricted anomaly scoring），实现无需训练的持续异常检测。
AI.result: DINOSaur在所有五种协议上超越所有对比方法；在NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano上推理时间低于100ms，设备端适应新任务不超过30秒；实现零遗忘。
AI.conclusion: 现有CAD方法并不比简单经验回放的传统方法更优；DINOSaur作为免训练方法，在性能、遗忘问题和边缘部署效率方面均显著优于现有方法，是更实用的工业持续异常检测方案。

title: CRISP -- Clustering-Based Redundancy-Reduced Instance Sampling for Pathology Case Representation and Retrieval
summary: Digital pathology archives increasingly contain multiple whole-slide images (WSIs) per case, capturing spatially distinct tumour regions and reflecting intrinsic morphological heterogeneity. However, most existing approaches rely on a single pathologist-selected slide, thereby discarding potentially informative evidence distributed across the remaining WSIs. To date, no autonomous framework has been proposed for comprehensive multi-WSI case processing. Here, we present an unsupervised framework for case-level analysis that integrates information from all available slides within a case. Rather than relying on a single designated slide, the proposed approach constructs case-level representations by selectively distilling informative patches across WSIs. We introduce Clustering-Based Redundancy-Reduced Instance Sampling for Pathology (CRISP), a two-stage framework that first reduces redundancy within individual WSIs and subsequently applies clustering-based sampling to select a compact yet representative set of patches for the entire case. The resulting patch set captures case-level heterogeneity while avoiding exhaustive processing of gigapixel images, and directly serves as a retrieval index. Using two Mayo Clinic breast cancer datasets for diagnosis and treatment planning, we demonstrate that CRISP consistently matches or surpasses the current standard practice of combined model and pathologist slide selection for patient/case search and retrieval. By automating case-level processing and eliminating subjective WSI selection, CRISP potentially enables the exploitation of clinically relevant information distributed across multiple WSIs that is currently overlooked.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CRISP，一种无监督的两阶段框架，通过聚类降冗余采样从多张WSI中构建病例级表示，实现无需病理医生选择的自动病例检索，在两个乳腺癌数据集上达到或超越现有标准。
AI.motivation: 现有数字病理分析方法大多依赖单张病理医生选择的WSI，忽略了病例中多张WSI所包含的空间异质性信息，且缺乏自动化处理多WSI病例的统一框架。
AI.method: 提出CRISP框架：(1) 第一阶段在单张WSI内部通过聚类减少冗余；(2) 第二阶段在病例级别对所有WSI的patch进行聚类采样，选择紧凑且有代表性的patch集合构建病例级表示，直接作为检索索引。
AI.result: 在两个Mayo Clinic乳腺癌数据集（诊断和治疗计划）上，CRISP在患者/病例搜索与检索任务中一致达到或超越当前结合模型与病理医生选择WSI的标准实践。
AI.conclusion: CRISP通过自动化病例级处理并消除主观WSI选择，能够有效利用分布在多张WSI中的临床相关信息，这些信息目前常被忽视。

title: HumanEgo: Zero-Shot Robot Learning from Minutes of Human Egocentric Videos
summary: Human egocentric video captures rich manipulation demonstrations without any robot hardware, yet transferring these skills to robots remains challenging due to the embodiment gap between human and robot in both visual appearance and kinematics. We present HumanEgo, a framework that bridges the embodiment gap by lifting each human demonstration to an entity-level representation of hand-object interaction, and training a flow matching policy with dense auxiliary objectives that amplify supervision from every trajectory. HumanEgo is robot-data-free, hardware-agnostic, data-efficient, and zero-shot human-to-robot transferable. With only 30 minutes of human videos per task, HumanEgo achieves 92.5% average success across four real-world tasks (75% with just 15 minutes), outperforms matched-time robot teleoperation by 41%, and robustly transfers zero-shot across novel robots, cameras, and environments.

AI.tldr: HumanEgo通过将人类第一人称视频提升至实体级手-物交互表征，并训练带有密集辅助目标的流匹配策略，实现了无需机器人数据、硬件无关、数据高效且零样本迁移的人-to-机器人技能迁移，在4个真实世界任务中平均成功率92.5%（15分钟视频即可达75%），超越同等时间机器人遥操作41%。
AI.motivation: 人类第一人称视频包含了丰富的操作演示，但人-机器人之间的外观和运动学差异（具身鸿沟）阻碍了技能迁移。现有方法通常需要大量机器人数据或遥操作，成本高昂且难以泛化。
AI.method: 提出HumanEgo框架：1）将人类演示提升至实体级手-物交互表征（bridge visual appearance gap）；2）训练流匹配策略（flow matching policy），并引入密集辅助目标增强每个轨迹的监督信号（bridge kinematics gap）；3）无需任何机器人数据，实现零样本跨机器人、相机和环境的迁移。
AI.result: 仅需30分钟人类视频/任务，4个真实世界任务平均成功率92.5%（15分钟达75%）；比同等时间的机器人遥操作高41%；支持零样本迁移到新型机器人、相机和环境。
AI.conclusion: HumanEgo有效弥合了人-机器人具身鸿沟，是一种无机器人数据、硬件无关、数据高效且可零样本迁移的机器人技能学习范式。

title: Optimizing Digital Therapeutic Interventions: Online Learning under Endogenous Adherence
summary: A critical challenge facing clinicians managing chronic disease interventions is sustaining long-run patient health given limited information and resources. Digital therapeutics (DTs) provide a cost-effective way to manage interventions at scale through repeated interactions (e.g. daily treatment recommendations), but patient success is highly dependent on their adherence. Behavioral psychology suggests that both treatment recommendations and past adherence affect future adherence, yet existing decision support frameworks for DTs model only recommendation effects or treat adherence as exogenous context, leaving a key gap in model and algorithm development. To address this gap, we present a DT decision support framework that captures both recommendation and adherence effects, allowing clinicians to better plan treatment recommendations. We model a patient's time-varying capacity for engagement with treatment using a linear dynamical system (LDS) that captures both recommendation and adherence effects, endogenously connected to adherence behavior with a logit link. We establish finite-time identification guarantees for this model, extending LDS results to our setting. Next, we propose an optimism-based algorithm, UCB-BOLD, for online treatment selection and prove that it achieves sublinear regret. We evaluate UCB-BOLD against benchmarks via ablation studies on a synthetic patient cohort generated using micro-randomized trial data. DT decision support tools can include dynamical models to enable decision makers to efficiently use the data in DT settings to improve patient health through effective resource allocation. While myopic or heuristic approaches suffice for some patient types, the benefits of explicitly planning around recommendation and adherence effects are significant for others; UCB-BOLD achieves 2-3x lower conditional value-at-risk regret than the next-best benchmark.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个数字疗法（DT）决策支持框架，通过线性动态系统（LDS）建模治疗推荐与患者依从性的双向影响，并设计UCB-BOLD算法实现亚线性遗憾的在线治疗选择，实验表明其对高风险患者可获得2-3倍的条件风险值遗憾降低。
AI.motivation: 现有数字疗法决策支持框架仅建模治疗推荐对依从性的影响，或将依从性视为外生上下文，忽略了行为心理学中"推荐和既往依从性共同影响未来依从性"这一关键机制，导致模型与算法开发存在空白。
AI.method: 采用线性动态系统（LDS）建模患者随时间变化的治疗参与能力，通过logit链接将内生依从行为与LDS连接；建立该模型的有限时间辨识保证（扩展LDS理论）；提出基于乐观主义的UCB-BOLD算法用于在线治疗选择，并证明其亚线性遗憾界。
AI.result: 在基于微随机试验数据生成的合成患者队列上进行消融实验，UCB-BOLD相比次优基准方法在条件风险值（CVaR）遗憾上降低2-3倍；但方法效果因患者类型而异，部分患者仅需短视或启发式方法即可。
AI.conclusion: 数字疗法决策支持工具应纳入动态模型，使决策者能高效利用DT数据改善患者健康；围绕推荐与依从性效应进行显式规划对部分患者类型有显著收益，但需根据不同患者特征差异化选择策略。

title: Plume Segmentation from MethaneSAT with Cross-Sensor Transfer Learning and Physics-Informed Postprocessing
summary: Automated detection and masking of individual methane plumes from satellite imagery is important for operational emission attribution and quantification. We present a machine learning framework for plume detection from MethaneSAT retrieved column-averaged dry-air mole fractions of methane. We address two core challenges: the scarcity of labeled MethaneSAT data and the need for inference reliability across diverse atmospheric and surface conditions. We first demonstrate that Mask R-CNN with a ResNet-50 backbone outperforms U-Net semantic segmentation on both MethaneAIR (an airborne version of MethaneSAT) and MethaneSAT data, with pixel-level F1 score gains of 10.49 and 5.48 respectively. To address MethaneSAT data scarcity, we evaluate three cross-sensor transfer strategies leveraging MethaneAIR flights and synthetic plumes. Mask R-CNN with ResNet-50 fine-tuned from MethaneAIR pre-trained weights is the most effective strategy, achieving instance-level precision of 0.60 and a near-perfect recall of 0.98 at the baseline operating point. A physics-informed post-processing pipeline converts detections into two operationally distinct modes. The first is a high-sensitivity mode that applies morphological filtering and proximity-based merging for comprehensive emission screening, achieving precision of 0.71 and recall of 0.94. The second is a high-precision mode that additionally applies a distribution-based classifier for confident source attribution, achieving precision of 0.92 and recall of 0.70. Manual review of detections classified as false positives against our wavelet-based ground truth labels reveals that a meaningful fraction of cases correspond to real methane enhancements excluded by conservative labeling criteria, indicating that precision values reported are lower bounds on true detection performance... Our data and code are available at: https://doi.org/10.7910/DVN/FR959H

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于Mask R-CNN的机器学习框架，用于从MethaneSAT卫星图像中自动检测甲烷羽流，通过跨传感器迁移学习和物理信息后处理，实现了高灵敏度（精确率0.71，召回率0.94）和高精度（精确率0.92，召回率0.70）两种操作模式，并公开了数据和代码。
AI.motivation: 从卫星图像中自动检测和掩蔽单个甲烷羽流对于排放归因和量化至关重要，但面临标记MethaneSAT数据稀缺以及需要在多样化的大气和地表条件下保证推理可靠性的双重挑战。
AI.method: 使用Mask R-CNN（ResNet-50骨干网络）进行羽流检测，评估了三种跨传感器迁移策略（利用MethaneAIR数据和合成羽流），并设计了物理信息后处理流水线，包括高灵敏度模式（形态学滤波+邻近合并）和高精度模式（额外分布分类器）。
AI.result: Mask R-CNN在像素级F1分数上比U-Net高出10.49（MethaneAIR）和5.48（MethaneSAT）；最优迁移策略（从MethaneAIR预训练权重微调）实现实例级精确率0.60、召回率0.98；高灵敏度模式精确率0.71、召回率0.94；高精度模式精确率0.92、召回率0.70。被标记为假阳性的样本中相当一部分实际上是真实甲烷增强。
AI.conclusion: 所提框架有效解决了MethaneSAT数据稀缺问题，实现了可靠的甲烷羽流检测，且报告的精确率是真实检测性能的下界。

title: ARCANE-PedSynth: Synthetic Multi-Pedestrian Datasets with Behavioural Crossing Annotations
summary: We present ARCANE-PedSynth, an open-source CARLA-based software framework for generating synthetic multi-pedestrian datasets with dense behavioural annotations for pedestrian crossing prediction in autonomous driving. The framework overcomes CARLA's native 9% crossing rate through a hybrid AI-manual pedestrian control architecture, enabling configurable target rates up to 75%. A 12-state behavioural finite state machine with five character archetypes produces diverse crossing behaviours. The framework generates synchronised RGB, LiDAR, and DVS data with per-frame crossing labels, behavioural states, and estimated 2D pose keypoints. We demonstrate ARCANE-PedSynth through PedSynth++, an example dataset generated with the framework, comprising 533 multi-pedestrian clips across 12 weather conditions with RGB, LiDAR, and DVS streams. ARCANE-PedSynth is fully reproducible via CLI parameterisation and Docker containerisation.

AI.tldr: 提出ARCANE-PedSynth框架，基于CARLA生成合成多行人数据集，通过混合AI-手动控制架构将行人穿越率从9%提升至75%，生成带密集行为标注的RGB/LiDAR/DVS多模态数据，并创建了包含533个视频片段的高质量示例数据集PedSynth++。
AI.motivation: 现有自动驾驶数据集缺乏密集的行为标注，且CARLA原生行人穿越率仅9%，无法有效支持行人穿越预测任务的训练需求。
AI.method: 采用混合AI-手动行人控制架构，实现可配置的目标穿越率；设计12状态行为有限状态机与五种角色原型，生成多样化穿越行为；同步生成RGB、LiDAR和DVS数据，附带每帧穿越标签、行为状态和2D姿态关键点。
AI.result: 示例数据集PedSynth++包含533个多行人视频片段，覆盖12种天气条件，提供RGB、LiDAR和DVS三种数据流。
AI.conclusion: ARCANE-PedSynth完全可复现（通过CLI参数化和Docker容器化），为自动驾驶中的行人穿越预测提供高质量合成训练数据。

title: A lift for input-convex neural network training
summary: Input-convex neural networks (ICNNs) are widely used for log-concave density estimation, convex-potential normalizing flows, optimal transport, and transport-map inversion for high-dimensional Bayesian posteriors. These tasks share a structural constraint: the inter-layer weights of the ICNN must remain non-negative. The standard recipe, projected gradient descent (PGD) onto the non-negative cone, applies a hard, non-smooth projection -- the stiff-penalty limit of an ADMM-style constraint splitting -- and its classical convergence guarantees do not transfer to the non-smooth ICNN training landscape; the differentiable alternative, softplus reparametrization, attenuates the gradient exponentially in the weight magnitude, stalling training with dead inter-layer weights and plateaued loss. Inspired by parameter-extension lifts of PDE-constrained inverse problems, we propose the lift: instead of constraining the inter-layer weights directly, we train an unconstrained hypernetwork that emits them from a permutation-invariant summary of the input batch. This adds stochasticity to the training dynamics that softens the loss landscape, letting the iterates escape the gradient-attenuated region where direct softplus stalls. We trace this softening to three structural ingredients -- a learnable bias acting as slack, a hypernetwork body that conditions on the target batch, and a cross-covariance coupling the two through batch stochasticity -- and prove each one necessary: deleting any single ingredient collapses the cross-covariance that carries the softening. On log-concave energy-based modeling from one-dimensional toy targets to image-flavored latents, and convex-potential normalizing flows on a 21-dimensional tabular benchmark, we show that the lift reaches a lower test loss than both PGD and direct softplus, and turns a plateau-bounded training trajectory into a valley-descending one.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于超网络的参数提升方法（lift），通过训练无约束的超网络生成ICNN的非负层间权重，利用批随机性软化损失景观，解决了投影梯度下降的非光滑问题和softplus重参数化的梯度衰减问题，在log-concave密度估计和凸势归一化流等任务上优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: ICNN的非负权重约束标准方法存在缺陷：PGD的硬投影不适用于非光滑训练景观；softplus重参数化导致指数级梯度衰减、训练停滞。受PDE约束逆问题的参数提升启发，需要一种能同时避免硬约束和梯度衰减的替代方案。
AI.method: 提出"lift"方法：不直接约束ICNN层间权重，而是训练一个无约束的超网络，它基于输入批次的排列不变摘要生成权重。该方法引入批随机性软化损失景观，使迭代能逃离梯度衰减区域。理论分析证明三个结构成分（可学习偏置作为松弛变量、条件于目标批次的超网络主体、通过批随机性耦合两者的互协方差）缺一不可。
AI.result: 在log-concave能量基建模（从一维玩具目标到图像风格潜变量）和21维表格基准的凸势归一化流上，lift方法比PGD和直接softplus达到更低的测试损失，并将受平台限制的训练轨迹转变为谷底下降轨迹。
AI.conclusion: 参数提升方法通过超网络和批随机性有效解决了ICNN训练的约束难题，为凸约束深度学习提供了一种新范式。

title: Cross-Modal Action Recognition in Egocentric Video Using Mamba: Integrating RGB and Hand Skeleton Streams via CLS Token Fusion Strategies
summary: Egocentric action recognition is a challenging task due to erratic camera motion, frequent hand occlusion, and the difficulty of maintaining consistent visual representations over time. In this work, we propose a cross-modal architecture that combines RGB video and temporal hand skeleton data within a unified Mamba-based framework, exploiting the linear time complexity of State Space Models (SSMs). Our architecture consists of three components: a VideoMamba module for visual feature extraction, a skeleton encoder built on a stack of Mamba blocks, and a fusion module that integrates both modalities into a single representation. A central contribution of this work is the design and evaluation of four Class (CLS) token mixing strategies for multimodal fusion: Naive, Average, Weighted and Context-based. These strategies differ in how the pretrained unimodal CLS tokens, which role is to act as information sinks concentrating learned representations, are leveraged to initialize the mixed CLS token used for final classification. We evaluate all strategies on the H2O dataset. Experimental results show that the Average strategy achieves the best performance, yielding gains of over 10% Top-1 accuracy in the Tiny configuration and 2% in the Small configuration over the VideoMamba baseline.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个基于Mamba框架的跨模态架构（RGB视频+手部骨架），用于自我中心动作识别，并设计了四种CLS token混合策略，其中Average策略在H2O数据集上达到最佳性能，最高提升Top-1准确率10%以上。
AI.motivation: 自我中心动作识别因摄像头运动剧烈、手部频繁遮挡以及难以保持一致的视觉表征而极具挑战性，现有方法亟需更高效的跨模态融合方案。
AI.method: 提出基于Mamba的跨模态架构，包含VideoMamba视觉提取模块、基于Mamba块的骨架编码器和融合模块；设计了四种CLS token混合策略（Naive、Average、Weighted、Context-based）来实现多模态融合。
AI.result: 在H2O数据集上，Average策略在Tiny配置下Top-1准确率提升超过10%，Small配置下提升2%，优于VideoMamba基线。
AI.conclusion: 基于Mamba的跨模态架构结合Average CLS token混合策略，能有效融合RGB和手部骨架信息，显著提升自我中心动作识别性能。

title: Bridging the Gap: Enabling Soft Actor Critic for High Performance Legged Locomotion
summary: Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) has become the de facto standard for training legged robots, thanks to its robustness and scalability in massively parallel simulation environments like IsaacLab. However, its on-policy nature makes it inherently sample-inefficient, preventing its use for continuous adaptation and fine-tuning on real hardware. Soft Actor-Critic (SAC), by contrast, is an off-policy algorithm that can reuse past experience, making it a natural candidate for sim-to-real transfer workflows where the same algorithm can be used both in simulation and for online learning on the real robot. Despite these advantages, SAC has consistently failed to match PPO's empirical performance in massively parallel training settings. This work identifies the root causes of this gap and introduces targeted modifications, covering policy initialization, timeout-aware critic targets, and multi-step return estimation, that enable SAC to train stably at scale. Evaluated across multiple legged robot platforms and diverse locomotion tasks, our approach closes the performance gap with PPO entirely.

AI.tldr: 本文针对PPO在四足机器人训练中的样本效率低问题，改进了SAC算法（策略初始化、超时感知评论家目标、多步回报估计），使其在大规模并行训练中达到与PPO相当的性能，从而支持从仿真到实机的连续适应和微调。
AI.motivation: PPO虽在四足机器人训练中表现优异，但其on-policy特性导致样本效率低下，无法用于实机上的连续适应和微调。SAC作为off-policy算法理论上更适合sim-to-real流程，但在大规模并行训练中始终无法匹敌PPO的性能，需找出原因并加以改进。
AI.method: 识别SAC在大规模并行训练中性能差距的根本原因，并引入三项针对性改进：策略初始化（policy initialization）、超时感知的评论家目标（timeout-aware critic targets）以及多步回报估计（multi-step return estimation），使SAC能够稳定地在大规模环境下训练。
AI.result: 在多种四足机器人平台和多样化 locomotion 任务上，改进后的SAC完全弥合了与PPO之间的性能差距。
AI.conclusion: 通过有针对性的改进，SAC可以克服此前在大规模并行训练中的劣势，成为一种既具备off-policy样本效率优势，又能达到PPO同等性能的可行替代方案，为sim-to-real迁移提供更高效的算法选择。

title: Fourier Feature Pyramids for Physics-Informed Neural Networks
summary: We present an improved neural field architecture for solving partial differential equations (PDEs). Current physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) provide a flexible framework for solving PDEs, but they struggle to achieve highly accurate solutions and require computation that scales poorly with parameter count. Our model, which we call beignet (Bandlimited Embedding with Interpolated Grid Network), replaces the random Fourier feature embedding used by existing PINN models with a trainable multi-resolution Fourier feature pyramid. To query beignet at a continuous coordinate, we use Fourier interpolation at each level of the pyramid to return features at the input coordinate, and then decode this vector with a fully-connected neural network trunk. Our model provides multiple benefits: 1) Spatial derivatives can be computed efficiently by using the chain rule to compose derivatives of the neural network computed with automatic differentiation with derivatives of the feature grid computed spectrally by the Fast Fourier transform (FFT). 2) beignet can achieve higher accuracy in a compute-efficient manner by scaling the parameter count of this Fourier feature pyramid, instead of the less-efficient strategy of scaling the neural network architecture. 3) beignet can directly control the representation bandlimit, resulting in more stable optimization for difficult PDEs. We demonstrate that beignet finds significantly more accurate solutions on PDE benchmarks using fewer parameters than state-of-the-art PINN methods. We further evaluate beignet on the self-similar inviscid Burgers blowup problem and show that it can minimize residuals to near machine precision using Adam, an accuracy regime previously attained only by using computationally expensive higher-order optimizers.

AI.tldr: 本文提出beignet，一种改进的神经场架构，用可训练的多分辨率傅里叶特征金字塔替代PINN中的随机傅里叶特征嵌入，通过傅里叶插值和全连接解码网络求解PDE，在精度和计算效率上优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有PINN方法难以达到高精度解，且计算量随参数数量扩展效率低下。
AI.method: 提出beignet模型，核心是用可训练的多分辨率傅里叶特征金字塔替换随机傅里叶特征嵌入，通过傅里叶插值在各层级获取连续坐标特征，再用全连接网络解码；利用链式法则结合自动微分与FFT谱方法高效计算空间导数。
AI.result: 在PDE基准测试中，beignet用更少参数取得显著更高精度；在自相似无黏Burgers爆破问题上，使用Adam优化器可将残差降至接近机器精度。
AI.conclusion: beignet通过可扩展的傅里叶特征金字塔实现了计算高效且高精度的PDE求解，并可通过直接控制表示带宽实现更稳定的优化。

title: ArtSplat: Feed-Forward Articulated 3D Gaussian Splatting from Sparse Multi-State Uncalibrated Views
summary: Articulated object reconstruction from sparse-view images is an ill-posed problem that requires simultaneous inference of geometry and underlying articulation structure. Existing methods for articulated object reconstruction based on NeRF and 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) typically rely on dense views or strong priors (e.g., depth maps, joint types, predefined number of joints) and require costly per-object optimization. In this paper, we propose ArtSplat, the first feed-forward framework for articulated 3D Gaussian Splatting. It reconstructs both geometry and joint parameters from sparse multi-view images across multiple articulation states in a single forward pass. To address the challenges of single-pass articulated reconstruction, we introduce a per-pixel joint map representation that enables the integration of joint parameter estimation into the feed-forward pipeline. We further propose a Cross-State Attention (CSA) mechanism with state tokens, which effectively captures discrete motion across input states. Experiments on 68 articulated objects from PartNet-Mobility, including both single- and multi-joint configurations, demonstrate that ArtSplat achieves competitive performance in both geometry and joint estimation, while being over 400 times faster than baselines.

AI.tldr: ArtSplat是首个前馈式框架，能从稀疏多视角图像中一次性重建可变形物体的3D高斯表示和关节参数，速度比基线方法快400倍以上。
AI.motivation: 现有基于NeRF和3DGS的可变形物体重建方法依赖密集视图或强先验（如深度图、关节类型、预定义关节数），且需要昂贵的逐对象优化，无法实现高效的前馈式重建。
AI.method: 提出逐像素关节图表示将关节参数估计融入前馈流程；设计跨状态注意力（CSA）机制，利用状态token有效捕获输入状态间的离散运动。
AI.result: 在PartNet-Mobility的68个可变形物体（含单关节和多关节配置）上，几何和关节估计均达到竞争力水平，速度比基线方法快400倍以上。
AI.conclusion: ArtSplat证明了前馈式可变形物体重建的可行性，在保证精度的同时大幅提升效率，为实时应用奠定基础。

title: Loosely Coupled Factor Graph Optimization for Pseudolite-Augmented Navigation
summary: In Global Navigation Satellite System (GNSS)-degraded environments, pseudolites (PLs) provide additional signal sources to enhance positioning performance, but their integration in optimization-based frameworks remains limited. This paper presents a loosely coupled factor graph optimization (FGO) framework that fuses the GNSS/PL least-squares (LS) solutions with inertial measurement unit (IMU) data. The evaluation considers low GNSS visibility scenarios with four high-elevation GNSS satellites and up to two PL transmitters over an 80~s window. FGO achieves a 22.8\% to 41.3\% reduction in mean 3D error compared to standard LS methods. Compared to a GNSS-IMU baseline, incorporating PL transmitters further improves positioning accuracy, with performance depending on geometry.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种松耦合因子图优化（FGO）框架，将GNSS/伪卫星最小二乘解与IMU数据融合，在GNSS退化环境下（4颗高仰角卫星+最多2个伪卫星发射器）实现了22.8%-41.3%的3D定位误差降低。
AI.motivation: 在GNSS退化环境中，伪卫星可提供额外信号源增强定位性能，但它们在基于优化的框架中的集成仍然有限。
AI.method: 提出松耦合因子图优化框架，融合GNSS/PL最小二乘解与IMU数据。
AI.result: 相比标准LS方法，FGO在80秒窗口内将平均3D误差降低22.8%-41.3%；相比GNSS-IMU基线，加入伪卫星发射器进一步提高了定位精度。
AI.conclusion: 伪卫星在优化框架中的集成能有效提升GNSS退化环境下的定位性能，且性能取决于几何配置。

title: Faithfulness as Information Flow: Evaluating and Training Faithful Chain-of-Thought Reasoning
summary: Chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning is useful for monitoring language models only when the reasoning trace faithfully reflects the computation that produces the final answer. However, models can rely on prompt-to-answer shortcuts that bypass the CoT, making the visible reasoning trace misleading even when it appears plausible. We study CoT faithfulness through a structural information-flow perspective: faithful reasoning should route answer-relevant information through the mediated path from prompt to CoT to answer, rather than through a direct prompt-to-answer shortcut. This perspective yields a task-agnostic framework based on three complementary properties, sufficiency, completeness, and necessity, which we instantiate with entropy-based, masked-KL, and gradient-based diagnostics. We show that these metrics recover externally judged faithfulness differences in hinted reasoning, and identify a low-entropy failure mode of KL-based diagnostics where gradient-based measures remain more stable. Building on this analysis, we introduce update-time interventions for verifier-based on-policy RL, including attention masking, backward-only gradient masking, CoT gradients, and adversarial perturbations of prompt representations. Across hinted arithmetic, reward-hackable code repair, and DAPO-Math models trained without hints but evaluated under wrong-hint injection, our interventions shift behavioral and structural indicators toward stronger CoT mediation. In particular, they make shortcut and reward-hacking behavior more transparent in the CoT and improve task-agnostic faithfulness metrics, while in some settings also reducing wrong-hint susceptibility. Our results suggest that controlling information flow during training is a practical route toward more faithful and monitorable CoT reasoning. Code is available at https://github.com/safety-research/faithful-cot.

AI.tldr: 本文从信息流视角研究CoT推理的忠实性，提出基于充分性、完备性和必要性三个互补属性的任务无关度量框架，并通过更新时干预（注意力掩码、梯度掩码、对抗扰动等）在训练中引导模型通过CoT而非捷径进行推理，实验表明该方法能提升CoT忠实性并降低对错误提示的敏感性。
AI.motivation: 现有CoT推理存在提示到答案的捷径（shortcut），使得推理链看似合理但实际上并未忠实反映模型的计算过程，导致监控失效。需要建立信息流视角下的忠实性度量方法，并通过训练干预来增强CoT的因果中介作用。
AI.method: 1) 提出基于信息流的三属性框架（充分性、完备性、必要性），分别用基于熵、KL散度和梯度的方法进行实例化；2) 设计更新时干预方法：注意力掩码、反向梯度掩码、CoT梯度、提示表征的对抗扰动，用于基于验证器的on-policy强化学习训练。
AI.result: 在hinted算术、可奖励篡改的代码修复以及DAPO-Math模型（无提示训练但注入错误提示）上，干预方法使行为和结构指标向更强的CoT中介偏移，提升了任务无关的忠实性度量，并在某些设定下降低了错误提示的敏感性。
AI.conclusion: 训练中控制信息流是提升CoT推理忠实性和可监控性的实用途径。

title: CoDA: Color Distribution Probing for Efficient and Generalizable AI-Generated Image Detection
summary: AI-generated image detection faces a persistent trade-off between generalization and efficiency: lightweight artifact-based methods often degrade on unseen generators or domains, whereas more robust large-scale models are computationally expensive. Meanwhile, existing benchmarks mainly focus on cross-model evaluation in photorealistic settings, leaving cross-domain robustness underexplored. To address this gap, we introduce FakeForm, a large-scale benchmark with approximately 370,000 images across 62 diverse domains for both cross-model and cross-domain evaluation. Motivated by this broader setting, we revisit color-distribution probing as an efficient complementary cue for AI-generated image detection. We observe that, especially for photographic content, real photographs tend to exhibit smoother and more stable color patterns, whereas synthetic images often show characteristic color imbalances introduced by neural generation. Based on this observation, we propose CoDA, a compact 1.48M-parameter detector built on a Noise-Quantization Probe, together with a theoretical analysis linking probe responses to color non-uniformity. Experiments show that CoDA achieves state-of-the-art performance on standard benchmarks and the best results on the challenging cross-domain evaluation of FakeForm, while remaining highly competitive in cross-model photorealistic settings. These results suggest that persistent generative artifacts can provide a practical foundation for efficient and robust AI-generated image detection. The models and FakeForm benchmark will be made publicly available.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FakeForm基准（含62个领域、37万张图像）用于评估AI生成图像检测的跨模型与跨域鲁棒性，并基于颜色分布不均现象设计了仅1.48M参数的轻量检测器CoDA，在跨域评估中达到最优，兼顾效率与泛化。
AI.motivation: 现有AI生成图像检测方法存在泛化性与效率的固有矛盾：轻量级方法在未见生成器/领域上性能退化，而大规模模型计算成本高昂；现有基准主要关注跨模型评估，跨域鲁棒性研究不足。
AI.method: 构建FakeForm（62领域、~37万图像）基准；提出CoDA检测器（1.48M参数），基于颜色分布统计差异——真实照片颜色更平滑稳定，合成图像存在特征性颜色不平衡，核心组件为噪声量化探针（Noise-Quantization Probe）。
AI.result: CoDA在标准基准上达到SOTA，在FakeForm跨域评估中取得最佳结果，在跨模型真实感场景中保持高度竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 持续存在的生成伪影可以作为高效且鲁棒的AI生成图像检测的实用基础，验证了颜色分布探测作为轻量互补线索的有效性。

title: Learning, locomotion, and navigation of soft synthetic snakes in three-dimensional, heterogeneous environments
summary: Limbless terrestrial animals exhibit exceptional locomotor versatility and control, currently unmatched by engineered counterparts. Here, we introduce a computational framework that enables soft synthetic snakes to navigate unstructured, heterogeneous 3D terrains. Our approach is grounded in bio-inspired actuation and sensing models that reduce the control complexity inherent to high-degree-of-freedom, continuum bodies. These models are integrated into a reinforcement learning architecture to derive environment-traversing policies. Training first occurs in simplified, homogeneous terrains to learn locomotion primitives. These are then composed into adaptive strategies for complex landscapes. We demonstrate robustness by deploying a snake in high-fidelity 3D environments reconstructed from real-world imaging, achieving reliable navigation. Overall, this work provides a physically-realistic simulation platform and practical insights for the control of continuum systems in natural terrains.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个计算框架，使软体合成蛇能够在非结构化、异质3D地形中导航。该方法基于仿生驱动和感知模型，结合强化学习架构，先在简化地形中学习运动基元，再组合成复杂地形的自适应策略，并在高保真3D环境中验证了鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 无腿陆生动物展现出卓越的运动多样性和控制能力，目前工程化的蛇形机器人尚无法企及。现有软体机器人难以在复杂异构3D地形中实现可靠导航，亟需一种有效的计算框架来弥合这一差距。
AI.method: 基于仿生驱动和感知模型降低高自由度连续体控制复杂度；将上述模型集成到强化学习架构中；先在简化均质地形中训练运动基元，再组合为复杂地形的自适应策略；在高保真3D环境中（基于真实世界成像重建）进行部署验证。
AI.result: 软体蛇在高保真3D环境中实现了可靠导航，证明了该框架在非结构化异构地形上的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 本工作提供了一个物理逼真的仿真平台，并为连续体系统在自然地形的控制提供了实用见解。

title: TUBE: Tangent Upper Bound on Evidence for Discrete Diffusion Language Models
comment: Preprint. 9 pages main text, 5 figures, plus appendix
summary: Log-likelihood is a standard metric for evaluating generative models. Unfortunately, in contrast to autoregressive models (ARMs), discrete diffusion models generally do not admit exact computation of this quantity. Existing evaluations, therefore, rely on the evidence lower bound (ELBO), leaving unclear how much higher the true value may be. We address this by introducing the Tangent Upper Bound on Evidence (TUBE), a variational upper bound on log-likelihood that admits an unbiased Monte Carlo estimator. Our TUBE extends across latent-variable models, including masked diffusion models (MDMs), any-order ARMs (AO-ARMs), and block variants of both. Applied to block MDMs and block AO-ARMs, TUBE reveals our key empirical finding that these models lie strictly below the exact ARM baseline, showing that ARMs still dominate in likelihood.

AI.tldr: 针对离散扩散模型无法精确计算对数似然的问题，提出了一种名为TUBE的变分上界方法，可进行无偏蒙特卡洛估计。实验发现，块状掩码扩散模型和块状任意阶自回归模型在似然上严格低于精确自回归模型基线，表明自回归模型在似然方面仍占主导地位。
AI.motivation: 离散扩散模型与自回归模型不同，无法精确计算对数似然这一标准评估指标，现有评估依赖证据下界（ELBO），导致真实值可能更高，需要一个能精确评估的上界方法。
AI.method: 提出TUBE（Tangent Upper Bound on Evidence），一种对对数似然的变分上界，支持无偏蒙特卡洛估计，可推广至掩码扩散模型、任意阶自回归模型及其块状变体。
AI.result: 在块状MDM和块状AO-ARM上应用TUBE，发现这些模型在似然上严格低于精确ARM基线，证实自回归模型在似然上仍占主导。
AI.conclusion: TUBE提供了一种评估离散扩散模型似然的上界方法，揭示了当前离散扩散模型在似然指标上仍落后于自回归模型。

title: Private Adaptive Covariance Estimation via Gaussian Graphical Models
summary: We propose PACE-GGM, a data-adaptive differentially private method for covariance estimation that concentrates its privacy budget on the most informative entries of the empirical covariance matrix, rather than perturbing all entries. This applies in the natural setting where the modeler supplies separate bounds for each variable, so that individual entries can be measured with less noise than the full matrix. In each round, our method selects a poorly approximated entry, measures it using the Gaussian mechanism, and then reconstructs a full covariance matrix using a maximum-entropy reconstruction objective, leading to a Gaussian graphical model structure. Experiments on diverse real-world datasets demonstrate consistent improvements in estimation error with respect to the Gaussian mechanism and other baselines, particularly in high-dimensional and low-to-moderate privacy regimes.

AI.tldr: PACE-GGM是一种数据自适应差分隐私协方差估计方法，通过将隐私预算集中到信息量最大的经验协方差矩阵条目上，而非扰动所有条目，利用最大熵重建目标生成高斯图模型结构，在高维和低至中隐私预算场景下显著优于基线方法。
AI.motivation: 现有差分隐私协方差估计方法（如高斯机制）平等对待所有协方差矩阵条目，在数据各变量尺度不同时效率低下，隐私预算被浪费在信息量少的条目上，导致估计精度不佳。
AI.method: 提出PACE-GGM方法：每轮选择近似效果最差的条目，使用高斯机制对该条目进行隐私测量，然后通过最大熵重建目标重构完整的协方差矩阵，从而生成高斯图模型结构。该方法利用各变量独立的边界信息，使得每个条目可被更低噪声测量。
AI.result: 在多种真实世界数据集上，PACE-GGM在估计误差方面一致优于高斯机制及其他基线方法，尤其在数据维度高且隐私预算低到中等时提升最为显著。
AI.conclusion: 数据自适应的隐私预算分配策略能有效提升差分隐私协方差估计的精度，PACE-GGM为高维数据下的隐私保护协方差估计提供了更优方案。

title: Causal Physics Steering in Video World Models via Concept Activation Vectors
comment: In proceedings of CVPR 2026 workshop on Video World Model
summary: Video world models learn representations of physical dynamics, but controlling their physical expectations at inference time remains an open problem. Recent interpretability work identified a Physics Emergence Zone (PEZ), a group of middle transformer layers in VideoMAE where physical plausibility is represented separately from other visual features. However, it remained unclear whether this structure could be used to directly control the model's physics reasoning. We present physics steering, a training-free method that uses the weight vector of a linear probe at a PEZ layer as a Concept Activation Vector (CAV) and injects it into hidden states during inference. This shifts the model's physical expectations without changing any model weights. On the IntPhys benchmark, this intervention reliably shifts the model's plausibility judgment in either direction, depending on the steering sign. The effect appears only when the intervention is applied within the Physics Emergence Zone, suggesting that the relevant physics representation is localized there. We further find that physics is encoded separately from motion direction, and that different intuitive physics principles occupy distinct directions within this representation space. Together, these results show that physical reasoning in VideoMAE is not only readable, but also directly steerable.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种无需训练的物理引导方法（physics steering），通过在VideoMAE模型的Physics Emergence Zone (PEZ)层注入概念激活向量（CAV），实现对视频世界模型物理合理性判断的直接操控，且不影响模型权重。实验表明该干预仅在PEZ层有效，且不同物理原理在表征空间中具有独立方向。
AI.motivation: 视频世界模型虽能学习物理动态的表征，但在推理阶段控制其物理期望仍是一个开放问题。先前可解释性工作虽发现了Physics Emergence Zone (PEZ)——VideoMAE中间层中物理合理性独立于其他视觉特征的表征区域，但能否利用这一结构直接控制模型的物理推理尚不清楚。
AI.method: 提出physics steering方法：使用PEZ层上线性探测器的权重向量作为概念激活向量（CAV），在推理过程中将其注入隐藏状态。该方法无需训练，不改变任何模型权重，仅通过CAV的正负符号方向来调节模型的物理合理性判断。
AI.result: 在IntPhys基准上，该方法能可靠地根据引导符号方向改变模型的物理合理性判断；该效应仅在PEZ层内干预时出现；物理表征与运动方向编码相互分离；不同的直觉物理原理在该表征空间中占据不同的方向。
AI.conclusion: VideoMAE中的物理推理不仅可读（可被解释），而且可被直接引导控制。

title: Convex-Neural RRT*: Fast and Reliable Learning-Guided Sampling for High-Quality Robot Path Planning
summary: Sampling-based algorithms for robot path planning offer probabilistic completeness and strong empirical convergence properties across environments with diverse obstacle configurations. However, in practice, these methods often require many iterations to obtain high-quality solutions. This paper proposes Convex-Neural RRT*, an enhanced RRT* variant that incorporates neural guidance to predict informative waypoint regions near high-quality paths. Convex candidate regions are extracted from these predictions, enabling the planner to concentrate exploration on geometrically relevant areas while preserving global exploration. The proposed algorithm is evaluated against Neural RRT*, Neural Informed RRT*, classical RRT*, and LTA* across three environment types and 18 benchmark maps. Experimental results show that Convex-Neural RRT* reduces computation time by 30-75% compared to neural-guided variants and up to 88-98% relative to LTA*, while achieving an average path length reduction of approximately 5% compared to classical RRT*, with larger improvements observed in complex environments. The method also maintains an overall success rate above 99% across varying obstacle densities. These findings indicate that convex-guided neural sampling provides an effective balance between computational efficiency and solution quality, supporting its applicability to time-sensitive robotic navigation tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Convex-Neural RRT*算法，通过凸区域引导的神经网络采样，在路径规划中实现计算效率与解质量的有效平衡，计算时间减少30-88%，路径长度平均缩短约5%，成功率超99%。
AI.motivation: 基于采样的路径规划算法虽具有概率完备性，但在实践中通常需要大量迭代才能获得高质量解，计算效率不足，难以满足时间敏感型机器人导航任务的需求。
AI.method: 在RRT*框架中引入神经网络预测高质量路径附近的信息性路径点区域，从中提取凸候选区域，使规划器在保持全局探索能力的同时，聚焦于几何相关区域进行采样。
AI.result: 与神经引导变体相比计算时间减少30-75%；与LTA*相比减少88-98%；路径长度相比经典RRT*平均缩短约5%，复杂环境中提升更显著；成功率维持在99%以上。
AI.conclusion: 凸引导神经采样能够在计算效率和解质量之间实现有效平衡，适用于时间敏感的机器人导航任务。

title: LLMs Show No Signs Of Individuated Metacognition
summary: Confidence-weighted routing, selective abstention, and ensemble weighting all assume that a model's stated confidence is informative about its capability on the question being asked. They presume functional metacognition, the capacity to assess one's own capabilities, without exercising them. Aggregate calibration is well studied, with mixed results, but the underlying structure of elicited confidence is less well understood. We decompose binary confidence judgements from 20 frontier Large Language Models (LLMs) across six benchmarks using tetrachoric factor analysis paired with pairwise calibration, asking whether two models that differ in confidence also differ in performance. On factual recall and information retrieval benchmarks the cross-model confidence matrix is approximately rank-one and a single dominant factor captures most of the latent variance. Models retrieving facts share an item-level difficulty axis and differ mainly in their decision thresholds along it. Across all benchmarks the relationship between confidence and performance collapses once items that all models agree on are removed. Inter-model pairwise calibration is small even where statistically significant, and what remains shrinks to nothing once base-rate differences along the shared factor are controlled for. Mathematical reasoning is the apparent exception, but this turns out to be a confound where reasoning models answer questions about their confidence by trying to solve them in their chain of thought, bypassing the sub-symbolic self-knowledge we seek to measure. We find no evidence for significant verbalised individuated metacognition in any tested domain.

AI.tldr: 本文通过对20个前沿大语言模型在六个基准上的二元置信度判断进行因子分析和成对校准，发现跨模型的置信度矩阵近似秩1，模型间置信度差异主要由共享的难度轴和决策阈值决定，而非个体化的元认知能力；数学推理看似例外，实则是模型在思维链中直接解题而非进行元认知评估。结论是：在测试领域中没有发现显著的语言化个体元认知证据。
AI.motivation: 已有研究关注聚合校准（aggregate calibration）但结果不一，而对 elicited confidence（被诱导出的置信度）的底层结构理解不足。本文试图深入剖析前沿大语言模型的置信度判断结构，检验模型是否具备功能性元认知（functional metacognition）——即在不实际执行任务的情况下评估自身能力的能力。
AI.method: 采用四因子分析（tetrachoric factor analysis）结合成对校准（pairwise calibration）方法，对20个前沿大语言模型在六个基准上的二元置信度判断进行分解，分析跨模型置信度矩阵的结构，并通过控制共享因子和移除模型一致同意的项目来检验置信度与性能之间的关系。
AI.result: 跨模型置信度矩阵近似秩1，单个主导因子捕获大部分潜在方差；在事实回忆和信息检索基准上，模型共享项目级难度轴，差异主要体现在决策阈值上；移除模型一致同意的项目后，置信度与性能的关系消失；成对校准即使统计显著也很小，控制共享因子上的基率差异后缩小为零；数学推理是表面例外，但实为混淆：推理模型在思维链中直接解题而非进行元认知评估。
AI.conclusion: 在任何测试领域均未发现显著的语言化个体元认知证据，表明大语言模型并不具备真正的功能性元认知能力，其置信度判断反映的是共享的任务难度结构而非个体化的自我认知。

title: ViViD-5K: Vineyard vision dataset for field-based berry detection and segmentation and grape cluster closure estimation
summary: Cluster closure, defined as the progressive filling of gaps between the berries in a grape bunch, is a key trait in vineyard management, impacting disease risk. However, traditional visual scoring methods are labor-intensive, subjective, and lack temporal resolution. Existing datasets rarely support fine-grained berry-level analysis, limiting the development of robust deep learning models. In this work, we present ViViD-5k, a large-scale in-field Vineyard Vision Dataset containing 5,000 images with dense annotations, including over 648,000 berry centroids and cluster segmentation masks spanning 13 grape varieties. Building on this dataset, we introduce GrapeSAM, a two-stage visual pipeline that combines point-based berry localization with prompt-based segmentation using Segment Anything, followed by transformer-based cluster segmentation. The pipeline enables automated, in-field estimation of cluster closure with minimal supervision. Quantitative results demonstrate strong segmentation and counting accuracy across diverse conditions, while visualizations confirm robustness on both in-domain and out-of-domain samples. This work provides a scalable and objective alternative to manual compactness scoring and supports high-throughput grape phenotyping with enhanced spatial detail.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了ViViD-5k大规模葡萄园视觉数据集（5000张图像，64.8万+浆果中心点标注，13个品种）以及GrapeSAM两阶段视觉流水线，实现基于点的浆果定位和提示分割，用于自动化、客观地估计葡萄串紧实度（簇闭合度），替代传统人工评分方法。
AI.motivation: 传统葡萄串紧实度视觉评分方法劳动密集、主观性强且缺乏时间分辨率；现有数据集很少支持细粒度浆果级分析，限制了鲁棒深度学习模型的发展。
AI.method: 构建ViViD-5k数据集（含浆果中心点和簇分割掩码的密集标注）；提出GrapeSAM两阶段流水线：第一阶段基于点的浆果定位，第二阶段结合Segment Anything的提示分割和Transformer的簇分割。
AI.result: 在多种条件下实现了强分割和计数精度，在域内和域外样本上均验证了鲁棒性，实现了自动化、客观的紧实度评分。
AI.conclusion: 该方法为人工紧实度评分提供了可扩展、客观的替代方案，支持具有增强空间细节的高通量葡萄表型分析。

title: Performance Comparison of Classical and Neural Sampling Algorithms for Robotic Navigation
summary: Integrating artificial intelligence (AI) into sampling-based motion planning provides new possibilities for improving autonomous navigation efficiency. In this paper, three algorithms, namely RRT*, Neural RRT*, and Neural Informed RRT*, are implemented and evaluated on environments containing convex and concave obstacles with different obstacle densities. The obtained results indicate that neural-guided planners improve path quality, producing up to 14\% shorter paths and 55--75\% smoother trajectories compared with the conventional RRT* algorithm. Among the evaluated methods, Neural Informed RRT* achieves the best overall performance in terms of path length and trajectory smoothness. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of AI-guided sampling strategies for improving reliability and trajectory efficiency in robotic and UAV navigation, despite a slight increase in computation time. Overall, the study highlights the growing importance of artificial intelligence in real-time robotic path planning applications.

AI.tldr: 本文实现并评估了RRT*、Neural RRT*和Neural Informed RRT*三种算法在凸凹障碍物环境中的表现。神经引导规划器相比传统RRT*可生成最多缩短14%的路径和55-75%更平滑的轨迹，其中Neural Informed RRT*综合性能最优，证明了AI引导采样策略在提升机器人/UAV导航路径质量和轨迹平滑度方面的有效性。
AI.motivation: 将人工智能融入基于采样的运动规划中，以提升自主导航的效率和路径质量。
AI.method: 在包含凸面和凹面障碍物、不同障碍物密度的环境中，实现并评估RRT*、Neural RRT*和Neural Informed RRT*三种算法。
AI.result: 神经引导规划器相比传统RRT*算法，路径长度最多缩短14%，轨迹平滑度提升55-75%。Neural Informed RRT*在路径长度和轨迹平滑度方面综合表现最佳。
AI.conclusion: AI引导的采样策略能有效提高机器人/UAV导航的可靠性和轨迹效率，尽管计算时间略有增加，但突显了人工智能在实时机器人路径规划中日益增长的重要性。

title: ChaosBench-Logic v2: Evaluating LLM Logical Reasoning over Dynamical Systems at Scale
comment: 14 pages, 8 figures. Published at the ICLR 2026 Workshop on LLM Reasoning
summary: Standard accuracy on binary reasoning benchmarks hides critical failure modes: prior collapse, inconsistency under paraphrase, and inability to reason about parameter-dependent dynamics. We present ChaosBench-Logic v2, a 40,886-question benchmark over 165 dynamical systems with 27 FOL predicates and 78 axiom edges, together with CARE (Calibration- and Adversarial-Robust Evaluation), a protocol that surfaces these pathologies. Evaluating 14 models, we find that regime-transition reasoning remains near random (MCC = 0.05) even for frontier models, whereas FOL deduction with given premises reaches MCC = 0.52. Per-family decomposition shows that the proprietary-model advantage concentrates on cross-indicator (+0.40) and consistency tasks, while open-source Qwen 2.5-32B dominates indicator diagnostics (0.91 vs. 0.45). Two models exhibit negative MCC on bifurcation questions, confirmed as systematic anti-correlation via confusion-matrix analysis.

AI.tldr: 提出了ChaosBench-Logic v2基准（40,886题，165个动力系统）和CARE评估协议，发现SOTA模型在跃迁推理上接近随机（MCC=0.05），而FOL演绎达到MCC=0.52；部分模型在分岔问题上呈现系统性的负MCC。
AI.motivation: 标准二值推理基准的准确率指标掩盖了先验坍塌、释义不一致和参数依赖动态推理失效等关键失败模式。
AI.method: 构建ChaosBench-Logic v2基准（涵盖165个动力系统、27个FOL谓词、78条公理边，共40,886个问题）和CARE评估协议，系统性地检测上述病理现象。
AI.result: 14个模型中，跃迁推理接近随机（MCC=0.05），而给定前提的FOL演绎达MCC=0.52；闭源模型在跨指标（+0.40）和一致性任务上占优，开源Qwen 2.5-32B在指标诊断上领先（0.91 vs 0.45）；两个模型在分岔问题上呈现系统性负MCC。
AI.conclusion: 当前前沿模型在参数依赖的动态系统推理上存在根本性缺陷，标准准确率指标具有误导性，需要更细粒度的评估协议暴露模型真实能力边界。

title: SparseWorld: Enhancing End-to-End Autonomous Driving via World Models with Sparse Scene Representation
summary: Recently, world models have made significant progress in enhancing end-to-end driving systems through both future situation forecasting and improved scene understanding. However, existing driving world models are typically built upon dense scene representations, causing high computational costs and redundant information. In this paper, we present SparseWorld, a lightweight world model that focuses on predicting only the critical layout of the scene, enabling efficient future forecasting for end-to-end driving systems. SparseWorld first performs autoregressive rollout to forecast future map elements and surrounding agents, enabling the model to learn how driving scenarios evolve over time. It then leverages these predicted futures to refine downstream motion prediction and trajectory planning. Specifically, we propose a Sparse Dreamer that anticipates future instances in the latent space through joint temporal and spatial attention. By interacting with predicted future instances, the motion planner captures more accurate motion patterns and generates more informed and safety-aware trajectories. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SparseWorld significantly reduces collision risk and achieves state-of-the-art performance on the open-loop planning metrics of the nuScenes dataset with a collision rate of 0.05\%. Moreover, it substantially outperforms the baseline method in closed-loop planning metrics on the Bench2Drive benchmark. Supplementary material is available at the project page: https://wryzju.github.io/SparseWorld/.

AI.tldr: SparseWorld提出了一种轻量级驾驶世界模型，通过仅预测场景中的关键布局（地图元素和周围智能体）来实现高效的端到端驾驶。它采用自回归预测未来实例，并利用这些预测优化下游运动预测和轨迹规划。在nuScenes数据集上以0.05%的碰撞率达到SOTA，在Bench2Drive闭环规划中显著优于基线方法。
AI.motivation: 现有驾驶世界模型基于密集场景表示，计算成本高且存在信息冗余，缺乏仅关注关键场景布局的轻量级方案。
AI.method: 提出Sparse Dreamer模块，通过联合时间和空间注意力在潜在空间中自回归预测未来实例（地图元素和智能体），并将预测结果用于引导下游运动预测和轨迹规划。
AI.result: 在nuScenes数据集上达到0.05%碰撞率，在开放环路规划指标上取得SOTA；在Bench2Drive基准的闭环规划指标上显著优于基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 稀疏场景表示的世界模型能够以更低计算成本实现高效、安全的端到端驾驶规划，有效降低碰撞风险。

title: Micro-Swarm Locomotion Optimization in Dynamic Flow using Multi-Objective Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
summary: Coordinating micro-robotic swarms in physiologically realistic, time-dependent fluid environments remains an unsolved challenge for biomedical and environmental applications. We present a hybrid Computational Fluid Dynamics - Multi-Objective Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning framework that directly couples a high-fidelity incompressible Navier-Stokes solver with decentralized proximal policy optimization to learn physically consistent swarm control strategies in oscillatory flow. Sixteen magnetically actuated micro-robots navigate a pulsatile arterial waveform, simultaneously optimizing upstream progression, energy conservation, and motion smoothness, reconciled using PCGrad surgery. Without PCGrad, energy efficiency and smoothness rewards collapse to near zero within 10,000 training steps while progress exhibits persistent large-amplitude oscillations, confirming that gradient conflict resolution is a structural requirement rather than an optional refinement in this domain. The converged policy achieves a progress reward of 6.5-7.0, a sustained energy efficiency of 0.63-0.65, and near-maximum smoothness (0.97-0.99), representing improvements over brute-force baselines on the primary objective while both baselines yield negative energy efficiency throughout. Training reveals three emergent behavioral phases: a collective two-layer hydrodynamic throttling formation that suppresses peak channel velocities during forward flow, a cycle-synchronized ratchet mechanism that exploits flow reversals for upstream repositioning, and an individualized final approach as agents near the success boundary. These results establish that time-dependent fluid-agent interactions can be captured directly within multi-objective reinforcement learning loops, offering a physically grounded paradigm for micro-swarm control in biomedical navigation, environmental monitoring, and industrial microfluidics.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种CFD与多目标多智能体强化学习相结合的框架，用于在生理脉动流环境中协调微型机器人集群。通过PCGrad解决梯度冲突，学习到包含 hydrodynamic throttling、cycle-synchronized ratchet 和 individualized approach 三种涌现行为的控制策略，显著提升了上游推进、能量效率和运动平滑性。
AI.motivation: 在生理真实且随时间变化的流体环境中协调微型机器人集群仍是未解决的挑战，现有方法无法有效处理时变流体与智能体间的复杂耦合。
AI.method: 混合CFD-多目标多智能体强化学习框架，将高保真不可压Navier-Stokes求解器与去中心化近端策略优化（PPO）直接耦合，使用PCGrad（梯度 surgery）协调三个冲突目标（上游推进、能量效率、运动平滑性）。
AI.result: PCGrad为结构性必要条件；收敛策略实现进步奖励6.5-7.0、能量效率0.63-0.65、平滑性0.97-0.99；无PCGrad时能量效率和平滑性崩溃至近零；涌现三种行为阶段：两层的流体节流编队、周期同步棘轮机制、个体化接近。
AI.conclusion: 时变流体-智能体交互可直接嵌入多目标强化学习循环中，为微型集群控制提供了物理可解释的新范式，适用于生物医学导航、环境监测和工业微流控。

title: From One-Pass SGD to Data Reuse: Mini-Batch Scaling Laws in Sketched Linear Regression
summary: Scaling laws provide compact descriptions of how prediction error varies with compute, model size, and data, but existing theory mainly treats single-sample SGD or full data reuse, leaving the role of mini-batching unclear. We study batch scaling laws for sketched linear regression under a power-law covariance spectrum and a source condition on the target parameter. We analyze one-pass batch SGD, multi-pass batch SGD with replacement, and multi-pass batch SGD without replacement. Our first result is a risk decomposition: all three procedures share the same irreducible and approximation terms, while their stochastic terms depend on the sampling protocol. One-pass batch SGD splits into bias and variance, whereas the two multi-pass methods split into GD bias, GD variance, and a fluctuation term around a common GD reference trajectory. We then prove source-condition scaling laws for one-pass and multi-pass mini-batch methods. For one-pass batch SGD, mini-batching preserves the approximation and optimization-bias exponents, while the variance scales as $O(\min(M,(T_{\mathrm{eff}}γ)^{1/a})/(B T_{\mathrm{eff}}))$. Thus the usual $1/B$ covariance reduction holds at fixed update count $T$, but in the one-pass regime $T=N/B$ it is partly offset by the shorter optimization horizon. For multi-pass batch SGD, with- and without-replacement sampling have identical approximation and GD bias/variance terms; they differ only in the fluctuation covariance prefactor, which is $1/B$ with replacement and $ρ_{N,B}=(N-B)/(B(N-1))$ without replacement. Hence without-replacement sampling is less noisy for $B>1$, and when $B=N$ the fluctuation vanishes, recovering deterministic gradient descent. These results place batch size on the same theoretical footing as compute, data, and model dimension in sketched linear regression.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了在线性回归（带草图和幂律协方差谱）中，小批量（mini-batch）SGD的批大小缩放定律，得出了三种采样协议（单遍、多遍有放回、多遍无放回）的风险分解与缩放指数，揭示了批大小在方差缩减中的精确作用。
AI.motivation: 现有缩放定律主要关注单样本SGD或全数据重用，小批量在缩放定律中的作用尚不明确，作者希望将批大小纳入与计算量、模型大小、数据量同等的理论框架。
AI.method: 对带草图的线性回归，假设幂律协方差谱和目标参数满足源条件，分别推导单遍批量SGD、多遍有放回批量SGD、多遍无放回批量SGD的风险分解与缩放定律。
AI.result: 三种方法共享相同的不可约项和近似项；单遍SGD的随机项方差为O(min(M,(T_eff γ)^{1/a})/(B T_eff))，呈现1/B协方差缩减但被缩短的优化步数部分抵消；多遍SGD中无放回比有放回噪声小，B=N时退化为确定性梯度下降。
AI.conclusion: 批大小与计算量、数据量、模型维度在理论上获得同等地位，为理解和选择批大小提供了理论基础。

title: Gaussian Rank-Based Neighborhood Degree for Graph Neural Networks in Image Classification
summary: The exponential growth of data has intensified the gap between the availability of unlabeled data and the high cost of manual annotation. Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) have emerged as a promising solution, as they exploit relational structures and learn from both labeled and unlabeled data, performing semi-supervised learning. A crucial component of many of these models is degree-based normalization, which influences message propagation but typically assumes uniform importance among neighboring nodes. In image classification, graphs are usually constructed from feature similarity, where treating all neighbors equally may overlook important variations in relevance. Motivated by this gap, we propose GRaNDe (Gaussian Rank-based Neighborhood Degree). This novel degree measure integrates neighborhood ranking with Gaussian distance weighting to better capture node importance. Experiments on five public image classification datasets show consistent accuracy improvements and competitive or superior results compared to state-of-the-art methods.

AI.tldr: 针对图神经网络中基于度的归一化假设邻居节点重要性均等的问题，提出了一种结合邻域排序和高斯距离加权的GRaNDe度量方法，在五个图像分类数据集上取得了一致性的准确率提升。
AI.motivation: 数据指数增长导致标注成本高昂，图神经网络虽能进行半监督学习，但现有基于度的归一化方法假设所有邻居节点重要性均等，忽视了节点间相关性的差异，尤其在基于特征相似性构建的图像分类图中这一问题更为突出。
AI.method: 提出GRaNDe（Gaussian Rank-based Neighborhood Degree）方法，将邻域排名与高斯距离加权相结合，构建新型度度量以更好地捕捉节点重要性。
AI.result: 在五个公开图像分类数据集上，该方法相比现有方法取得了一致性的准确率提升，结果具有竞争力或达到最优。
AI.conclusion: GRaNDe通过引入邻域排序和高斯加权，有效改进了图神经网络中消息传播的质量，是一种有效的节点重要性度量方法。

title: ParkingWorld: End-to-End Autonomous Parking Reinforcement Learning from Corrective Experience in 3DGS Simulation
comment: 9 pages(including 1 page of Appendix), 6 figures. Will be submitted to RA-L 2026
summary: Autonomous parking demands precise low-speed maneuvering within narrow, cluttered, and highly constrained environments, where vehicles must navigate tight spaces while avoiding static obstacles and complex geometric boundaries. Unlike imitation learning, which typically requires massive volumes of high-quality expert demonstrations to converge to a stable policy and often suffers from limited generalization to unseen scenarios, traditional reinforcement learning (RL) methods face persistent challenges including excessive training overhead, inefficient exploration, and even failure to learn viable parking strategies in challenging settings. To address these limitations, this paper presents a correction-in-the-loop sample-efficient reinforcement learning (CIL-SERL) framework for end-to-end autonomous parking, which is entirely trained in a photorealistic 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) parking simulator that enables high-fidelity digital reconstruction of real-world scenes. Inspired by error-correction notebooks used in learning practice, we design a novel multi-level replay buffer mechanism. These buffers hierarchically organize and store standard RL rollouts, human corrective interventions, failed exploration trajectories, and rollback-based correction segments in separate yet interconnected memory regions, facilitating structured sampling and targeted learning during training. The proposed framework is systematically evaluated in both the 3DGS simulation environment and a physical vehicle platform. Extensive experimental results demonstrate that our method achieves substantial improvements in parking success rate, operational efficiency, and safety performance across diverse scenarios, validating the effectiveness and practical applicability of the proposed CIL-SERL-based end-to-end autonomous parking solution.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于校正循环的样本高效强化学习（CIL-SERL）框架，用于端到端自主泊车。该框架在基于3D高斯泼溅（3DGS）构建的光真实感泊车模拟器中训练，并设计了多级回放缓冲区机制，分层存储标准RL轨迹、人工校正干预、失败探索轨迹和回滚校正片段。在3DGS仿真和实车平台上的实验表明，该方法在泊车成功率、运行效率和安全性方面均有显著提升。
AI.motivation: 现有自主泊车方法中，模仿学习需要大量高质量专家演示且泛化性差，传统强化学习存在训练开销大、探索效率低、甚至无法学习可行泊车策略等问题。为了克服这些局限性，需要一个样本高效且能适应复杂约束环境的端到端自主泊车解决方案。
AI.method: 提出CIL-SERL框架：1）在基于3D高斯泼溅（3DGS）构建的光真实感泊车模拟器中进行全训练，实现真实场景的高保真数字重建；2）设计多级回放缓冲区机制，包含标准RL rollout、人工校正干预、失败探索轨迹和回滚校正片段四个分层缓冲区，实现结构化采样和针对性学习。
AI.result: 在3DGS仿真环境和实车平台上，该方法在泊车成功率、运行效率和安全性方面均取得显著提升，验证了框架的有效性和实际适用性。
AI.conclusion: CIL-SERL框架通过校正循环和多级回放缓冲区机制，有效解决了传统RL方法在自主泊车中的样本效率低和探索困难问题，结合3DGS高保真仿真环境，为端到端自主泊车提供了一种兼具有效性、实用性和安全性的解决方案。

title: Omissive Bias in Religious Representation: Benchmarking LLM Answers to Everyday Ethical Decision-making
summary:
As large language models become a default source of guidance on personal, moral, and existential questions, it matters whether they draw on the religious frameworks that have historically shaped such reasoning, or systematically omit them. In this paper, we ask a deliberately narrow question: when posed an everyday ethical question for which religious perspectives may be valuable, do LLMs invoke religion at all? In contrast to benchmarks that look for the presence of political leanings or social bias, we look for the absence of religious representation as a dimension of value alignment and bias in LLMs. We term this ``omissive bias.''
  To measure omissive bias, we contribute the AllFaith Religious Representation Benchmark: 150 ethically and personally salient questions, sourced from in-the-wild chat transcripts and faith-community contributors, paired with an LLM-as-judge rubric that gives full credit for any mention of a religion, a religious practice, or a religious leader. The questions are not themselves about religion--they are open-ended questions about grief, forgiveness, relationships, purpose, and honesty, where religion is one valuable perspective among several. We also run a human-subjects survey to compare LLM behavior against human expectations.
  Evaluating 27 models, we find that LLMs consistently underrepresent religion relative to human expectations. The omission is asymmetric: models invoke religion more readily for abstract existential questions (meaning, death, truth) than for the practical personal situations--grief, marriage, family conflict, addiction--where many people most rely on it. It is not our purpose to adjudicate which values LLMs should hold. We argue, more modestly, that current LLM responses overlook critical opportunities to reflect religious frameworks that many people draw on when navigating personal and ethical challenges.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"省略性偏见"概念，构建AllFaith基准（150个伦理/个人问题），评估27个LLM发现模型在回答开放式道德问题时系统性地低估了宗教框架的引用，尤其在实际生活场景（如悲伤、婚姻、成瘾）中缺失严重，与人类期望存在显著差距。
AI.motivation: 随着LLM成为个人、道德和存在性问题的主要参考来源，需要审视这些模型是否系统地省略了历史上塑造人类道德推理的宗教框架。现有研究关注LLM的政治倾向或社会偏见（即"存在性"偏见），但忽略了宗教代表性缺失这一维度，作者将其定义为"省略性偏见"。
AI.method: 1) 构建AllFaith基准：150个来自真实聊天记录和信仰社区贡献者的开放式问题（涉及悲伤、宽恕、关系、人生目的、诚实等）；2) 采用LLM-as-judge评估标准，对任何提及宗教、宗教实践或宗教领袖的回答给予满分；3) 进行人机对比调查，比较LLM行为与人类期望；4) 评估27个不同模型。
AI.result: LLM在所有模型中系统性地低估了宗教框架的引用频率，与人类期望不符。这种省略具有不对称性：模型在抽象存在性问题（如生命意义、死亡、真理）上更可能引用宗教，但在实际个人情境（如悲伤、婚姻、家庭冲突、成瘾）中引用较少——而后者正是许多人最依赖宗教指导的领域。
AI.conclusion: 当前LLM在回答个人和伦理挑战性问题时，错过了反映许多人实际依赖的宗教框架的关键机会。作者并不评判LLM应该持有何种价值观，而是指出模型存在系统性省略宗教视角的问题。

title: SliceWorld: A Predictive and Controllable World-State Model for CT Report Generation
summary: CT report generation (CTRG) requires models to summarize three-dimensional anatomical context and pathological findings from hundreds of axial slices. Existing methods typically learn a direct image-to-text mapping, providing limited mechanisms for modeling how CT evidence evolves across slices or how reports respond to controlled changes in latent lesion-related factors. We propose SliceWorld, a CT-specific world-state framework that treats an axial CT scan as an ordered sequence along the z-axis. SliceWorld encodes prefix CT evidence into factor-aware latent states containing anatomy, lesion, and uncertainty components, and projects these states into world tokens used for multi-step future-slice feature prediction, lesion-factor intervention, and LLM-based report generation. The model is first pretrained on CT slice sequences with predictive, factor-aware, and counterfactual objectives, and is then fine-tuned on paired CT-report data. Experiments on M3D-Cap and CT-RATE show that SliceWorld improves natural language generation metrics and clinically oriented automatic evaluation. Further analyses demonstrate multi-horizon future-slice prediction, measurable factor alignment, reduced-slice robustness, and selective lesion-sensitive report modulation.

AI.tldr: SliceWorld提出了一种CT专用的世界状态框架，将轴向CT扫描视为沿z轴的有序序列，通过编码前缀CT证据到因子感知的潜在状态（包含解剖、病变和不确定性成分），并将其投影为世界令牌，用于多步未来切片特征预测、病变因子干预和基于LLM的报告生成。在M3D-Cap和CT-RATE上的实验表明，该方法在自然语言生成指标和临床导向评估上均取得提升。
AI.motivation: 现有CT报告生成方法通常学习直接的图像到文本映射，缺乏对CT证据在切片间演化过程的建模机制，也无法控制潜在病变相关因素对报告的影响。
AI.method: 将CT扫描视为沿z轴的有序序列；编码前缀CT证据为包含解剖、病变和不确定性的因子感知潜在状态；将状态投影为世界令牌，用于未来切片预测、病变因子干预和LLM报告生成；先以预测、因子感知和反事实目标预训练，再在CT-报告数据上微调。
AI.result: 在M3D-Cap和CT-RATE数据集上，SliceWorld在自然语言生成指标和临床导向自动评估上优于现有方法；额外分析验证了多步未来切片预测能力、因子对齐可测量性、减少切片下的鲁棒性以及选择性病变敏感报告调制。
AI.conclusion: SliceWorld通过引入CT专用的世界状态框架，有效建模了切片间的证据演化，并实现了对病变因子的可控干预，为CT报告生成提供了更具解释性和可控性的新范式。

title: RAMBA: 4D Radar Mapping by Bundle Adjustment
comment: 5 pages, 2 figures, to present in ISPRS2026 Thematic Session 10 on Radar Perception
summary: 4D radar is increasingly attractive for robotic mapping because it provides range, azimuth, elevation, and Doppler measurements while remaining robust in adverse visibility conditions. Although recent radar and radar--inertial odometry methods have achieved promising online state estimation performance, offline global map refinement for 4D radar remains underexplored. This paper presents RAMBA, a radar bundle-adjustment framework for globally consistent 4D radar mapping. Given initial poses and radar frames from a radar--inertial odometry front-end, RAMBA jointly refines radar frame states using covariance-weighted geometric residuals, IMU preintegration factors, and radar ego-velocity constraints. The geometric residuals extend pairwise GICP to a multi-frame optimization by forming voxel-based correspondences across selected frames and weighting each residual with point covariances. To improve robustness against drift and revisits, RAMBA enforces temporal consistency during correspondence formation while explicitly supporting loop-closure constraints. Experiments on the ColoRadar and SNAIL Radar datasets show that RAMBA improves map consistency and usually enhances trajectory accuracy over radar--inertial odometry and pose-graph optimization baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RAMBA框架，通过对4D雷达帧状态进行束调整联合优化（含协方差加权几何残差、IMU预积分因子和雷达自速度约束），实现全局一致的4D雷达地图构建，在公开数据集上优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 4D雷达在机器人建图中具有优势（提供距离、方位角、仰角和多普勒测量，且在恶劣能见度下鲁棒），但现有方法主要关注在线状态估计，离线全局地图优化问题尚未被充分探索。
AI.method: 提出RAMBA框架，基于雷达-惯性里程计前端提供的初始位姿和雷达帧，联合优化雷达帧状态。具体包括：(1) 将配对GICP扩展为多帧优化的协方差加权几何残差，通过体素化构建跨帧对应关系；(2) IMU预积分因子；(3) 雷达自速度约束。对应关系构建中引入时间一致性约束并支持闭环约束。
AI.result: 在ColoRadar和SNAIL Radar数据集上，RAMBA相比雷达-惯性里程计和位姿图优化基线方法，显著提升了地图一致性，并通常改善了轨迹精度。
AI.conclusion: RAMBA是一种有效的4D雷达离线全局地图优化框架，通过束调整联合优化实现了比现有方法更一致的建图和更准确的轨迹估计。

title: Interdomain Attention: Beyond Token-Level Key-Value Memory
summary: Transformers and deep state space models (SSMs) sit at opposite ends of a basic design choice: attention routes each query through a growing key-value (KV) cache by content-based matching at quadratic cost, while deep SSMs compress context into a fixed-size recurrent state that is not directly addressed by query-key matching. We propose Interdomain Attention, which integrates an SSM into an attention module through kernel methods: an attention kernel is approximated by a finite feature map, the resulting key features and values are projected onto a shared set of basis functions maintained by a single SSM recurrence, and each query attends to the compressed coefficients through its own feature map, recovering query-conditioned attention over a fixed-size state. The scalable layer is a learned relaxation of this derivation, and we validate its components through ablations. In a 125M to 1.3B autoregressive language-modeling study on FineWeb-Edu at matched recurrent-state budget, Interdomain Attention improves on an SSM token mixer at every scale, surpasses a same-recipe softmax baseline at 1.3B on validation perplexity and on the eight-task commonsense suite, and inherits the length-flat behavior of its fixed-state core out to 3.5x the training context. Ablations indicate that the query-conditioned projection is the main source of the gain.

AI.tldr: 提出跨域注意力机制（Interdomain Attention），通过核方法将SSM的固定大小循环状态与注意力机制结合，使查询能通过特征映射对压缩后的系数进行内容寻址，在保持固定状态规模的同时实现类似注意力的查询条件化能力。
AI.motivation: Transformer的注意力机制通过KV缓存实现内容匹配但成本为二次方，而深度SSM将上下文压缩为固定大小的循环状态但无法被查询直接寻址。两者在上下文利用方式上存在根本性权衡，亟需一种既能保持固定状态效率又能实现查询条件化访问的混合方案。
AI.method: 通过核方法将注意力核用有限特征映射近似，将键特征和值投影到由SSM循环维护的共享基函数集上，每个查询通过其自身的特征映射对压缩后的系数进行注意力操作，从而在固定大小状态上恢复查询条件化的注意力。该可扩展层是该推导的学习松弛版本。
AI.result: 在125M至1.3B参数的自回归语言建模中，在匹配循环状态预算下，跨域注意力在每个规模上均优于SSM混合器；在1.3B规模上，验证集困惑度和8任务常识推理套件上超越相同训练配方的softmax基线；在训练上下文的3.5倍长度上继承了固定状态核心的长度平坦行为。
AI.conclusion: 查询条件化的投影是性能提升的主要来源；跨域注意力成功融合了注意力的内容寻址灵活性与SSM的固定状态效率。

title: VectorArk: Learning Practical Image Vectorization with Rounded Polygon Representation
summary: Recent vision-language model (VLM)-based approaches have achieved impressive results on image vectorization tasks. However, they are typically evaluated on synthetic benchmarks, where clean SVGs are rasterized at high resolution and then re-vectorized. As a result, these methods generalize poorly to real-world scenarios, such as images with unknown rasterization methods or those generated by text-to-image models. We introduce VectorArk, a new VLM-based model designed for robust and practical image vectorization. VectorArk employs a novel rounded polygon representation that simplifies the learning process while naturally producing smooth, visually appealing primitives. We also propose a degradation model that enhances robustness across diverse and imperfect inputs. Our experiments show that, in contrast to previous methods, VectorArk achieves superior geometric completeness and artifact suppression across multiple datasets, with comprehensive ablations validating the contribution of each component.

AI.tldr: VectorArk是一种基于VLM的图像矢量化模型，采用圆角多边形表示和退化模型，在多种数据集上实现了优于现有方法的几何完整性和伪影抑制效果。
AI.motivation: 现有VLM矢量化方法仅在合成基准上表现良好，对真实场景（如未知光栅化方法或文生图模型的输出）泛化能力差，缺乏实际应用价值。
AI.method: 提出圆角多边形表示以简化学习过程并生成平滑图元；设计退化模型增强对多样且不完美输入的鲁棒性。
AI.result: 在多个数据集上，VectorArk在几何完整性和伪影抑制方面优于现有方法；消融实验验证了各组件的贡献。
AI.conclusion: VectorArk实现了更鲁棒、实用的图像矢量化，弥合了合成基准与真实场景之间的差距。

title: X-DiffVLA: X-Embodied Diffusion Action Heads for Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Learning universal policies from cross-embodied data remains a fundamental challenge in robotics. Although Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models are pre-trained on large and diverse datasets, they typically rely on embodiment-specific fine-tuning to achieve strong performance in downstream tasks. This requirement severely limits their generalization capability and restricts knowledge transfer across embodiments performing similar tasks. To overcome these limitations, we focus on cross-embodied settings with shared robotic bases and heterogeneous end-effectors, and propose X-DiffVLA, a diffusion-based VLA model featuring a unified cross-embodied action head. X-DiffVLA can leverage the generative strengths of diffusion models to capture both the diversity and latent correlations in cross-embodied datasets. Specifically, we introduce Embodiment Forcing, a classifier-free guidance technique to implicitly steer action generation toward embodiment-specific functional components, capturing fine-grained structural nuances without explicit supervision. In addition, a Morphological Tree Diffusion approach is designed to strengthen behavioral correlations across diverse end-effectors, maximizing the transferability of heterogeneous demonstrations. Experimental results across RoboCasa and Isaac Gym, covering different embodiments from grippers to dexterous hands, show that X-DiffVLA achieves state-of-the-art performance, with improvements of 15.3% and 12.5%, respectively. Real-world evaluations further validate the robustness of the proposed framework and its effectiveness in scalable cross-embodied policy learning.

AI.tldr: X-DiffVLA提出了一种基于扩散模型的视觉-语言-动作框架，通过统一跨具身动作头、具身强制引导和形态树扩散方法，实现了异构机器人（从夹爪到灵巧手）的跨具身策略学习，在RoboCasa和Isaac Gym上分别提升15.3%和12.5%的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有VLA模型虽然在大规模数据上预训练，但依赖特定具身的微调才能在下游任务中取得良好性能，严重限制了其跨具身泛化能力和知识迁移能力。为此，作者聚焦于共享移动底座但末端执行器异构的跨具身场景，提出无需显式监督即可捕获具身间结构差异的统一策略学习方法。
AI.method: X-DiffVLA包含三个核心组件：(1) 统一跨具身动作头，利用扩散模型生成动作以捕获跨具身数据集的多样性和潜在相关性；(2) Embodiment Forcing，一种无分类器引导技术，隐式地将动作生成导向具身特定的功能组件，无需显式监督即可捕获细粒度结构差异；(3) Morphological Tree Diffusion，通过形态树结构增强不同末端执行器间的行为相关性，最大化异构演示的可迁移性。
AI.result: 在RoboCasa和Isaac Gym上的实验覆盖从夹爪到灵巧手的多种具身，X-DiffVLA分别取得了15.3%和12.5%的性能提升，达到最先进水平。真实世界实验进一步验证了框架的鲁棒性和在可扩展跨具身策略学习中的有效性。
AI.conclusion: X-DiffVLA通过扩散模型、具身强制引导和形态树扩散三个关键设计，有效解决了跨异构具身的策略泛化问题，为可扩展的跨具身机器人学习提供了新的范式。

title: CurveRL: Principled Distribution-Aware Context Reweighting for LLM Reasoning
summary: Context or prompt-level reweighting has emerged as a central algorithmic lever in Reinforcement Learning with Verified Rewards (RLVR) for improving the reasoning capability of large language models, yet the principle determining what constitutes an optimal weighting remains poorly understood. We address this gap by formulating prompt reweighting as a functional derivative of a utility functional defined in the pass-rate function space, yielding a unified optimality framework that accommodates existing schemes, including REINFORCE and GRPO. Building on this optimality framework, we propose a distribution-aware prompt reweighting approach, called CurveRL, based on a quantile coordinate transform, in which the weight assigned to each prompt depends not on the absolute value of pass rates but on its rank and density to reflect the distributional structure of the pass rates in the learning dynamics. Extensive experiments across multiple benchmarks demonstrate that our proposed CurveRL consistently outperforms GRPO and other RLVR baselines.
