Our study identifies context-distribution control as a principled axis for analyzing and designing prompt-reweighted RLVR algorithms. The code is released in https://github.com/zhyzmath/CurveRL.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CurveRL，一种基于分位数坐标变换的分布感知提示重加权方法，在RLVR框架下通过函数导数视角统一了现有提示重加权方案，实验表明其持续优于GRPO等基线方法。
AI.motivation: 尽管提示级重加权已成为RLVR中提升大语言模型推理能力的关键算法手段，但决定最优加权的原则仍缺乏理论理解。
AI.method: 将提示重加权形式化为通过率函数空间上效用泛函的泛函导数，建立统一最优性框架；在此基础上提出基于分位数坐标变换的分布感知提示重加权方法CurveRL，权重取决于通过率的秩和密度而非绝对值。
AI.result: 在多个基准测试上，CurveRL持续优于GRPO及其他RLVR基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 上下文分布控制是分析和设计提示重加权RLVR算法的一个原则性轴心。

title: Dual Prototype-Conditioned Diffusion Model for Scalable Multi-Class Unsupervised Anomaly Detection in Large Category Spaces
summary: Multi-class anomaly detection aims to build unified models across diverse product categories. However, as the number of categories grows, its performance often degrades due to increasingly complex and heterogeneous normal distributions. To address this challenge, we propose DPDiff-AD, a Dual Prototype-conditioned Diffusion model for large-scale multi-class Anomaly Detection. DPDiff-AD models heterogeneous normal distributions through complementary local and global prototypes. Local prototypes capture representative fine-grained structural patterns via nearest-prototype aggregation, while global prototypes regulate holistic feature geometry through optimal transport regularization. Together, these dual-scale representations define a structured normality space. This space is refined through diffusion-based reconstruction conditioned on both local and global prototypes via prototype-aware attention. By jointly leveraging dual prototypes during generation, DPDiff-AD achieves precise normality modeling, preserves structured separability as category cardinality grows, and enables scalable anomaly discrimination. Extensive experiments across five benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness and scalability of DPDiff-AD. On the 160-category large-scale dataset, it improves image- and pixel-level AUROC by 5.3 and 2.9 points over the previous state-of-the-art method Dinomaly+, while maintaining stable performance as category cardinality increases.

AI.tldr: DPDiff-AD 提出了一种双原型条件扩散模型，通过局部原型（最近邻聚合捕获细粒度结构）和全局原型（最优传输正则化调节整体特征几何）构建结构化的正态性空间，并基于原型感知注意力进行扩散重构，实现了大规模多类异常检测，在160类数据集上较SOTA方法提升图像级AUROC 5.3点、像素级2.9点。
AI.motivation: 现有统一多类异常检测模型随类别数量增加，因正常分布日益复杂和异构而导致性能下降，亟需一种能有效建模异构正态分布的可扩展方法。
AI.method: 提出双原型条件扩散模型（DPDiff-AD）：(1) 局部原型通过最近邻原型聚合捕获细粒度结构模式；(2) 全局原型通过最优传输正则化调节整体特征几何；(3) 双尺度原型定义结构化正态性空间；(4) 通过原型感知注意力进行扩散重建，联合利用双原型指导生成过程。
AI.result: 在五个基准数据集上验证有效性；在160类大规模数据上，图像级AUROC提升5.3点，像素级AUROC提升2.9点，超越SOTA方法Dinomaly+，且性能随类别数增加保持稳定。
AI.conclusion: DPDiff-AD通过双原型机制和扩散条件重建，实现了精确的正态性建模和结构化可分离性，为大尺度多类异常检测提供了一种可扩展的解决方案。

title: A Decentralized LiDAR-SLAM System with Certifiably Optimal Pose Graph Optimization
comment: In Proceedings of the IEEE International Conference on Robotics & Automation (ICRA'26) 1st Workshop on Robot Meets GNSS and Ranging for Seamless Autonomy, Vienna, Austria, Jun. 5, 2026
summary: Decentralized multi-robot LiDAR-SLAM is essential for collaborative missions but faces significant challenges in maintaining global consistency. Existing frameworks predominantly rely on local-search optimization or one-time coordinate alignment, which are prone to suboptimal convergence and long-term inconsistency, especially in large-scale or degenerate environments. To address these limitations, this paper presents the first decentralized LiDAR-SLAM system that integrates a state-of-the-art certifiably optimal Pose Graph Optimization (PGO) backend. By leveraging the Riemannian Block Coordinate Descent (RBCD) algorithm, our system ensures globally consistent trajectory estimation without requiring accurate initial guesses. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed framework achieves superior robustness, improving trajectory RMSE by up to 48.9% compared to the state-of-the-art DiSCo-SLAM.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了首个集成可认证最优位姿图优化后端的去中心化多机器人LiDAR-SLAM系统，通过Riemannian Block Coordinate Descent算法实现全局一致的轨迹估计，在无需精确初始值的情况下将轨迹RMSE最高提升48.9%。
AI.motivation: 现有去中心化多机器人LiDAR-SLAM系统依赖局部搜索优化或一次性坐标对齐，在大规模或退化场景下容易陷入次优收敛并导致长期不一致性，缺乏全局一致性的保证。
AI.method: 提出首个集成可认证最优PGO后端的去中心化LiDAR-SLAM系统，利用Riemannian Block Coordinate Descent算法进行全局优化，无需精确初始猜测即可保证全局一致的轨迹估计。
AI.result: 与最先进的DiSCo-SLAM相比，轨迹RMSE最高降低48.9%，在鲁棒性和全局一致性上显著优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: 该工作证明了将可认证最优PGO引入去中心化SLAM的可行性，为大规模多机器人协同SLAM提供了更可靠的全局一致性保障方案。

title: ChainzRule: Sample-Efficient, Robust Deep Learning Across Tabular, NLP, and Vision Tasks
summary: Production deep learning systems across enterprise domains operate under constraints that academic benchmarks routinely obscure: labeled data is expensive, inference budgets are tight, and models that cannot explain their behavior are difficult to trust and maintain. We present ChainzRule (CR), a neural architecture replacing typical activations with learnable polynomial layers governed by Differential Regularization (DREG), a layer-wise Jacobian penalty computed analytically during the forward pass at standard inference cost. The core claim is that bounding intermediate derivatives forces the network toward low-frequency, structurally stable representations, simultaneously reducing dependence on labeled data volume, improving robustness to distribution shift, and providing a measurable, gradient-based handle on model behavior. Evaluated across five domains, CR achieves $85.71\% \pm 2.01\%$ on Pima Diabetes (statistically superior to SVM and XGBoost), $46.20\% \pm 0.37\%$ on SST-5 sentiment classification with a frozen encoder (superior to RNTN using approximately 5\% of its training data), $55.79\%$ on SST-5 with a fine-tuned BERT backbone (versus BERT-base linear head at $54.9\%$), $70.17\%$ on Yelp Full ordinal regression with 3.2M parameters versus a 10-model average of $66.35\%$, and $+2.32\%$ mean corruption accuracy on CIFAR-10-C. All results with reported $p$-values fall below the $α= 0.05$ threshold after Bonferroni correction. CR maintains a gradient tail ratio $τ$ (p99/mean) of $1.01$--$1.02$ against $1.07$--$1.09$ for all typical activation function baselines across every data fraction, a structural invariant we propose as the mechanistic driver of sample efficiency and a deployment-time proxy for model reliability.

AI.tldr: ChainzRule (CR) 是一种用可学习多项式层替代典型激活函数的神经架构，通过微分正则化（DREG）在前向传播中以标准推理成本施加逐层雅可比惩罚，迫使网络产生低频、结构稳定的表征，从而减少标注数据需求、提升分布外鲁棒性并提供可量化的梯度行为指标。在五个领域评测中，CR在统计显著性和样本效率上均优于SVM、XGBoost、RNTN及BERT基线，梯度尾部比τ维持在1.01-1.02，远优于传统激活函数的1.07-1.09。
AI.motivation: 实际生产深度学习系统面临标注数据昂贵、推理预算紧张、模型难以解释和信任等约束，而学术基准测试常忽视这些问题。现有方法难以同时满足低标注依赖、高鲁棒性和可解释性需求。
AI.method: 提出ChainzRule (CR)架构，用可学习多项式层替换标准激活函数，配合微分正则化（DREG）在前向传播中解析计算逐层雅可比惩罚，以标准推理成本约束中间导数，迫使网络学习低频、结构稳定的表征。
AI.result: Pima糖尿病85.71%±2.01%（优于SVM和XGBoost）；SST-5情感分类使用约5%训练数据达46.20%±0.37%（优于RNTN）；SST-5微调BERT骨干达55.79%（优于BERT-base线性头54.9%）；Yelp Full序数回归以3.2M参数达70.17%（10模型平均66.35%）；CIFAR-10-C平均损坏准确率提升+2.32%。所有p值经Bonferroni校正后均低于α=0.05。梯度尾部比τ维持在1.01-1.02，传统激活函数为1.07-1.09。
AI.conclusion: CR通过微分正则化约束中间导数，实现了低频、结构稳定的表征，显著降低了标注数据需求，提升了分布外鲁棒性，并提供了一种部署时可用的模型可靠性代理指标（梯度尾部比τ）。该架构在统计显著性和样本效率上全面超越多种强基线。

title: Artiverse: A Diverse and Physically Grounded Dataset for Articulated Objects
summary: We present Artiverse, a diverse and physically grounded dataset of high-quality articulated 3D objects designed for realistic functional modeling and simulation. Artiverse contains 5.4K human-authored objects across a broad range of 88 categories, aggregated from multiple 3D static repositories. Objects are annotated with functional parts, interior structures, realistic kinematic relationships and articulated joints including multi-DoF joints, and physical attributes such as metric scale, material, and mass. We develop a semi-automated annotation pipeline that combines few-shot segmentation, geometric reasoning, and multi-stage human verification to achieve high-quality and efficient annotation, reducing manual annotation time by over 30%. We demonstrate the value of Artiverse on tasks of part mobility analysis, articulated object generation, and physics-based interaction. Artiverse provides a data resource to advance functional understanding for articulated objects.

AI.tldr: Artiverse是一个包含5.4K个人工标注的3D铰接物体数据集，涵盖88个类别，带有功能部件、内部结构、运动学关系、关节属性和物理属性（尺度、材质、质量）的细粒度标注，通过半自动标注流水线将人工标注时间减少30%以上，并在部件运动分析、铰接物体生成和物理交互任务中验证了其价值。
AI.motivation: 现有3D物体数据集缺乏对铰接物体功能结构（如关节类型、运动学关系、物理属性）的细粒度标注，限制了真实世界功能性建模与仿真的研究。
AI.method: 采用半自动标注流水线，结合少样本分割、几何推理和多阶段人工验证，实现高效高质量标注。
AI.result: 构建了5.4K个物体、88个类别的数据集，人工标注时间减少30%以上。
AI.conclusion: Artiverse为铰接物体的功能理解提供了重要的数据资源，在部件运动分析、铰接物体生成和物理交互任务中展现了应用价值。

title: Soft Pneumatic Actuators for Soft Robotics: A Motion-Based Review of Actuation Mechanisms and Performance Trade-offs
summary: Soft pneumatic actuators are widely used in soft robotics because they can produce large motions while remaining compliant enough to interact safely with objects, environments, and the human body. However, their performance is not solely determined by pressure. Instead, the response depends on the way the actuator is built, including the shape of its chambers, the placement of reinforcements, the use of folds, material stiffness, and the constraints that guide its deformation. As the literature has expanded, it has become more difficult to determine which mechanism is most suitable for a given application and which reported results can be compared across studies. This review examines soft pneumatic actuators according to the design strategies used to generate four motion classes: linear, bending, twisting, and omnidirectional actuation. For each class, it analyzes the structural features that define the deformation path, including braid angle, fold geometry, fiber orientation, chamber arrangement, structural asymmetry, and internal constraint layers. It then discusses how the design choice affect motion output, force generation, air demand, repeatability, durability, fabrication difficulty, and robotic integration. The review further identifies key conditions that must be considered when selecting or comparing actuators, including pressure, loading condition, actuator size, pneumatic supply, and hysteresis This approach helps explain why actuators with similar motion outputs may differ substantially in design requirements, pneumatic demand, and practical suitability. It also highlights the design priorities needed for compact, efficient, repeatable, and deployable soft pneumatic systems in wearable, biomedical, and mobile robotic applications.

AI.tldr: 本文综述了软体气动执行器根据设计策略产生的四类运动（线性、弯曲、扭转、全向），分析了结构特征对性能的影响，并提出了选择和比较执行器时需考虑的关键条件。
AI.motivation: 随着软体气动执行器文献的增多，确定哪种机制最适合特定应用以及哪些结果可跨研究比较变得越来越困难，因此需要系统的综述来厘清设计策略与运动类别之间的关系。
AI.method: 按照四类运动（线性、弯曲、扭转、全向）对软体气动执行器进行分类，分析每类运动的结构特征（编织角、褶皱几何、纤维取向、腔室排列、结构不对称性、内部约束层），并讨论设计选择对运动输出、力生成、空气需求、可重复性、耐久性、制造难度和机器人集成的影响。
AI.result: 揭示了具有相似运动输出的执行器在设计需求、气动需求和实际适用性上可能存在显著差异；指出了在可穿戴、生物医学和移动机器人应用中实现紧凑、高效、可重复和可部署的软体气动系统所需的设计优先级。
AI.conclusion: 软体气动执行器的性能受多种设计因素综合影响，选择或比较执行器时必须考虑压力、加载条件、执行器尺寸、气动供应和迟滞等关键条件；不同运动类别对应不同的设计策略和权衡。

title: Evolving Robustness--Exploration Trade-off in Online Reinforcement Learning via Quantile Bayesian Risk MDPs
summary: In online reinforcement learning, data scarcity creates epistemic uncertainty that makes robustness important early in learning, whereas sufficient exploration is needed to learn the true-environment optimal policy. We study this time-varying robustness--exploration trade-off through a quantile Bayesian risk-aware Markov decision process (BR-MDP), in which the quantile level controls how posterior uncertainty enters the Bellman backup. We characterize this control through an asymptotic normality result for the difference between the quantile BR-MDP value and the value in the true environment. The result implies that upper/lower-tail quantiles induce optimism/pessimism towards epistemic uncertainty, and the magnitude of the optimism/pessimism decreases as data accumulate. Building on this characterization, we propose an online Bayesian risk-aware algorithm with an adaptive quantile schedule that emphasizes robustness early and gradually encourages exploration of less-visited state--action pairs. We establish sublinear Bayesian regret bounds with respect to both the true optimal value and the optimal BR-MDP robust value. Numerical experiments demonstrate strong performance in both exploration-demanding and exploration-costly environments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于分位数贝叶斯风险感知MDP的在线强化学习方法，通过自适应分位数调度来平衡早期鲁棒性与后期探索，并证明了亚线性贝叶斯遗憾界。
AI.motivation: 在线强化学习中，数据稀缺导致认知不确定性，使得学习早期需要鲁棒性，而后期需要充分探索以学习真实最优策略。现有方法未能有效建模这种随时间变化的鲁棒性-探索权衡。
AI.method: 提出分位数贝叶斯风险感知MDP（BR-MDP）框架，其中分位数水平控制后验不确定性如何进入Bellman备份。通过渐近正态性结果刻画分位数水平的作用，并设计自适应分位数调度算法：早期强调鲁棒性，逐步鼓励探索未充分访问的状态-动作对。
AI.result: 建立了相对于真实最优值和最优BR-MDP鲁棒值的亚线性贝叶斯遗憾界。数值实验在探索密集型与探索代价型环境中均表现出色。
AI.conclusion: 分位数BR-MDP通过上尾/下尾分位数分别实现对认知不确定性的乐观/悲观态度，且乐观/悲观程度随数据积累而衰减，有效统一了鲁棒性与探索的权衡。

title: Benchmarking Composed Image Retrieval for Applied Earth Observation
summary: Remote sensing composed image retrieval (RSCIR) enables search in large satellite image archives using composed queries that combine a reference image with a textual modifier. Although RSCIR offers a flexible interface for expressing targeted retrieval intent, the transferability of modern composition methods to Earth observation (EO) imagery and their relevance to operational EO workflows remain underexplored. We address this gap through a unified benchmark and an application-oriented study. First, we systematically adapt and evaluate representative composed image retrieval methods with six vision-language backbones on PatternCom under a standardized protocol, analyzing their behavior across backbones, composition strategies, and query types. Second, we introduce xView2-CIR, a change-centric dataset for disaster and damage monitoring, where retrieval is conditioned on scene identity and a target post-event state. Our results show that training-free composition methods provide strong and scalable baselines for EO retrieval, while change-centric retrieval presents different challenges from attribute-based retrieval, particularly due to the need to preserve scene identity. Overall, this study establishes a practical benchmark for RSCIR and positions composed retrieval as a complementary tool for remote sensing image retrieval, archive exploration, and change analysis. The dataset and code are available at https://github.com/billpsomas/rscir.

AI.tldr: 本文针对遥感领域组合图像检索（RSCIR）进行了系统性基准研究，评估了多种视觉-语言骨干网络和组合方法在PatternCom上的表现，并引入了面向灾害监测的xView2-CIR数据集。结果表明，无需训练的组合方法在遥感检索中表现稳健，而变化中心检索面临与属性检索不同的挑战。
AI.motivation: 遥感组合图像检索（RSCIR）虽提供了灵活的检索接口，但现有组合方法在遥感影像上的迁移性及其与业务化遥感工作流的相关性尚未被充分探索。
AI.method: 1) 在统一协议下，系统评估了多种代表性子组合图像检索方法与六种视觉-语言骨干网络在PatternCom上的表现；2) 引入了面向灾害监测的变化中心数据集xView2-CIR，检索条件基于场景身份和目标灾后状态。
AI.result: 无需训练的组合方法为遥感检索提供了强且可扩展的基线；变化中心检索与属性检索面临不同挑战，尤其在保持场景身份一致性方面。
AI.conclusion: 本研究建立了RSCIR的实用基准，并将组合检索定位为遥感图像检索、档案归档探索和变化分析的补充工具。

title: InvariantCloud: A Globally Invariant, Uniquely Indexed Point Cloud Framework for Robust 6-DoF Tactile Pose Tracking
summary: Recent advances in imitation learning and vision-language models highlight the need for high-fidelity tactile perception, with 6-DoF tactile object pose estimation providing a crucial foundation for precise robotic manipulation. We introduce InvariantCloud, a 6-DoF pose estimation framework that leverages the global invariance of surface marker constellations on vision-based tactile sensors. In contrast to recent approaches, our one-shot globally invariant point cloud registration suppresses cumulative drift and overcomes long-standing limitations in accurately estimating yaw (Z-axis) rotation. Experimental verifications show that InvariantCloud achieves superior yaw tracking accuracy and re-localization repeatability compared to existing benchmarks, demonstrating its precision and robustness in long-sequence manipulation tasks.

AI.tldr: InvariantCloud是一个基于表面标记点星座全局不变性的6-DoF触觉物体位姿估计框架，通过单次全局不变点云配准抑制累积漂移，在长序列操作任务中实现了优于现有基准的偏航角跟踪精度和重定位重复性。
AI.motivation: 模仿学习和视觉-语言模型的进步对高保真触觉感知提出需求，而现有的6-DoF触觉物体位姿估计方法在准确估计偏航（Z轴）旋转方面存在长期局限性，且易产生累积漂移。
AI.method: 利用视觉触觉传感器表面标记点星座的全局不变性，提出单次全局不变点云配准框架InvariantCloud，实现一次性全局配准而非逐步累积。
AI.result: 在偏航角跟踪精度和重定位重复性方面均优于现有基准，在长序列操作任务中展现出精确性和鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: InvariantCloud通过全局不变性策略有效克服了触觉位姿估计中长期存在的偏航角估计难题和累积漂移问题，为精确机器人操作提供了可靠的触觉感知基础。

title: Refined Analysis of Entropy-Regularized Actor-Critic
summary: In this paper, we study the role of the critic in actor--critic for entropy-regularized, finite, discounted environments. We establish that, when the critic is exact, using the latter as a baseline is a variance-reduction method in a strong sense. In this case, actor--critic with stochastic gradients matches the sample complexity of deterministic policy gradient, reaching an $ε$-optimal regularized value with $\tilde{O}(\log(1/ε))$ samples. In practice, the critic is learned alongside the actor: the variance of the actor update is then influenced by the critic's variance and bias. Specifically, when the critic has a sufficiently small error, the variance reduction and rapid convergence are preserved. This suggests to learn the critic first, keeping it up to date after each actor update, underscoring the crucial role of accurate critic estimation in actor--critic methods.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了熵正则化有限折扣环境中actor-critic方法中critic的作用，证明精确critic作为baseline能实现强方差减少，使随机梯度actor-critic达到与确定性策略梯度相同的样本复杂度（$\tilde{O}(\log(1/\epsilon))$），并指出当critic误差足够小时，方差减少和快速收敛得以保持，强调了准确估计critic的关键作用。
AI.motivation: 揭示actor-critic方法中critic在方差减少和样本效率方面的理论基础，特别是在熵正则化设置下critic精度对算法性能的影响。
AI.method: 理论分析：在熵正则化有限折扣MDP中，分析精确critic作为baseline时的方差减少特性；进而研究学习critic时其方差和偏差对actor更新的影响，给出critic误差足够小时的收敛保证。
AI.result: 精确critic下，随机梯度actor-critic达到$\tilde{O}(\log(1/\epsilon))$样本复杂度；当critic误差足够小时，方差减少和快速收敛特性得以保持。
AI.conclusion: 建议先学习critic并在每次actor更新后保持其更新，强调准确critic估计是actor-critic方法成功的关键。

title: SILSM: A Sustainable Interactive Level Set Method for Progressive Refinement
summary: Interactive segmentation aims to precisely isolate target objects using sparse user guidance. However, traditional methods often suffer from heavy interaction burdens and parameter sensitivity, while deep learning approaches struggle with data dependency and iterative instability. Motivated by these limitations, we propose the Sustainable Interactive Level Set Method (SILSM). The proposed level set evolution equation incorporates interaction, regularization, and segmentation terms. Specifically, high-order regularization is employed to maintain numerical stability, and unlike traditional methods, we decouple user guidance into an independent interaction term to enable direct manual control over the zero-level set evolution. Furthermore, we develop a numerical algorithm tailored for multiple interactions, which facilitates dynamic refinement by effectively updating the segmentation results based on sequential user inputs. We theoretically demonstrate that the high-order term provides stronger regularization constraints than the conventional length term, while the interaction term ensures segmentation strictly within the user-selected region. Experimental results further demonstrate that the proposed method is robust to interactive inputs, achieves competitive performance at the first interaction, and supports stable multi-round interactions with progressively improved segmentation quality.

AI.tldr: 本文提出可持续交互水平集方法(SILSM)，通过将用户引导解耦为独立交互项、采用高阶正则化保持数值稳定性，并设计多轮交互数值算法，实现稳定且渐进优化的交互式分割。
AI.motivation: 传统交互式分割方法存在交互负担重、参数敏感、数据依赖强及迭代不稳定等问题，亟需一种鲁棒且可持续优化的交互分割方案。
AI.method: 提出SILSM，包含交互项、正则化项和分割项的水平集演化方程；采用高阶正则化维持数值稳定性；将用户引导解耦为独立交互项实现直接零水平集控制；设计支持多轮交互的数值算法实现动态细化。
AI.result: 理论证明高阶项比传统长度项约束更强，交互项确保分割严格位于用户选定区域；实验表明对交互输入鲁棒，首次交互即具竞争力，多轮交互可稳定提升分割质量。
AI.conclusion: SILSM在鲁棒性、首次交互性能和多轮渐进优化方面均优于传统方法，为交互式分割提供了可持续优化的新范式。

title: Treatment Effect Estimation with Differentiated Networked Effect on Graph Data
comment: Accepted by the research track of the KDD 2026 conference
summary: Estimating individual treatment effect (ITE) from observational graph data is crucial for decision-making in the fields such as commerce and medicine. This task is challenging due to interference, where individual outcomes can be influenced by the treatments and covariates of their neighbors. Existing methods attempt to model such interference for accurate ITE estimation. However, a critical issue is often overlooked: differentiated networked effect (DNE), an effect caused by local networks consisting of neighbors with varying importance and scales. Capturing DNE is vital; otherwise, we will end up with imprecise ITE estimation due to an erroneous characterization of interference, which can result in misguided decisions. To address this challenge, we propose a novel interference modeling mechanism that incorporates two partial attention mechanisms and a message amplifier. The partial attention mechanisms automatically estimate the importance of different neighbors in contributing to interference, while the message amplifier adjusts the results of the interference modeling mechanism based on the scale of neighbors, all of which enables the model to capture DNE. Experiments on three real-world graphs demonstrate that our methods outperform existing approaches for ITE estimation from graph data, which corroborates the importance of explicitly capturing DNE.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新的干扰建模机制，通过部分注意力和消息放大器捕获差异化网络效应（DNE），从而更准确地从图数据中估计个体处理效应（ITE）。
AI.motivation: 现有ITE估计方法在处理图数据时忽略了差异化网络效应（DNE），即邻居节点的重要性和规模不同所产生的局部网络效应，导致干扰建模不准确，进而影响ITE估计精度和决策质量。
AI.method: 提出一种新的干扰建模机制，包含两个部分注意力机制（自动估计不同邻居对干扰的重要性）和一个消息放大器（根据邻居规模调整干扰建模结果），从而捕获DNE。
AI.result: 在三个真实世界图数据集上的实验表明，所提方法在ITE估计任务上优于现有方法，验证了显式捕获DNE的重要性。
AI.conclusion: 捕获差异化网络效应（DNE）对于从图数据中准确估计个体处理效应至关重要，所提方法通过部分注意力和消息放大器有效解决了该问题。

title: EgoProx: Evaluating MLLMs on Egocentric 3D Proximity Reasoning Across a Cognitive Hierarchy
summary: Humans constantly reason about 3D proximity, the relations between their body and surrounding objects, to guide perception and action in daily life. Whether multimodal large language models (MLLMs) can perform such embodied 3D reasoning remains unclear. To this end, we introduce EgoProx, a benchmark for egocentric 3D proximity reasoning. We organize our tasks along a cognitive chain, covering intention, exploration, exploitation, and chain-of-actions reasoning. We also design an agent based data engine that produces diverse and consistent QA pairs at scale. We benchmark prevailing MLLMs on EgoProx and conduct additional analyses with dataset specific and task specific instruction tuning. We observe large cross-domain gains, indicating that current MLLMs contain some spatial knowledge; however, they still struggle to effectively leverage it for spatial reasoning VQA.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了EgoProx基准，用于评估多模态大语言模型(MLLMs)在自我中心3D近程推理方面的能力，实验表明现有MLLMs虽具备一定空间知识，但在空间推理VQA方面仍存在困难。
AI.motivation: 人类在日常生活中不断推理3D近程关系以指导感知和行动，但目前尚不清楚多模态大语言模型(MLLMs)是否能执行这种具身3D推理，因此需要建立相应的评估基准。
AI.method: 构建了EgoProx基准，沿认知链组织任务（涵盖意图、探索、利用和动作链推理），设计基于智能体的数据引擎以大规模生成多样且一致的QA对，并在该基准上评估主流MLLMs，进行数据集特定和任务特定的指令微调分析。
AI.result: 观察到显著的跨领域增益，表明当前MLLMs包含一定的空间知识；但模型在有效利用这些知识进行空间推理VQA方面仍存在困难。
AI.conclusion: 现有MLLMs虽具备部分空间知识，但在自我中心3D近程推理任务上表现不足，需要进一步提升其在空间推理方面的能力。

title: GreenSeg: Ground Segmentation Algorithm for Agricultural Robots in Mediterranean Greenhouses using RGB-D Point Clouds
summary: Greenhouse agriculture in the Mediterranean region faces significant automation challenges due to its unique structural and environmental constraints. These environments are characterized by extremely narrow aisles, heterogeneous terrains ranging from concrete to tilled soil and severe optical interference caused by polyethylene covers, which induce specular reflections and "ghost points" in depth sensors. While autonomous navigation is essential for digitizing agricultural tasks, traditional solutions often rely on expensive 3D LiDAR systems that are economically unscalable for most facilities. To address this, this paper presents GreenSeg, a robust perception framework for autonomous navigation using RGB-D sensing. The proposed method introduces a dual-layer validation strategy: a robust global plane fitting combined with a surface curvature filter for terrain adaptability, and a seed-point-based Region Growing constraint to ensure the spatial continuity of the navigable plane. Experimental validation was conducted using the AGRICOBIOT I platform across four diurnal scenarios with varying solar elevations. The results show that GreenSeg consistently outperforms benchmark segmentation methods, achieving peak improvements of 11.58% in mean Recall and 19.24% in mIoU during critical rotational maneuvers at the end of corridors. These findings confirm that the proposed algorithm enables stable and safe autonomous navigation in unstructured, dynamic agricultural environments that are subject to budget constraints and sensitive to lighting conditions.

AI.tldr: GreenSeg是一种基于RGB-D感知的鲁棒感知框架，通过双层层验证策略（全局平面拟合+表面曲率滤波器、种子点区域生长约束）实现地中海温室环境下的自主导航，在四个日光场景中相比基准方法，关键旋转操作时Recall提升11.58%，mIoU提升19.24%。
AI.motivation: 地中海温室农业面临狭窄通道、异构地形（混凝土到耕作土壤）以及聚乙烯覆盖层引起的光学干扰（镜面反射、深度传感器"鬼点"）等自动化挑战。传统方案依赖昂贵的3D LiDAR，经济上不可扩展，亟需一种低成本、鲁棒的RGB-D感知方案。
AI.method: 提出双层层验证策略：(1) 鲁棒全局平面拟合结合表面曲率滤波器，实现地形自适应性；(2) 基于种子点的区域生长约束，确保可导航平面的空间连续性。在AGRICOBIOT I平台上跨越四个不同太阳仰角的日光场景进行验证。
AI.result: 在关键的回廊末端旋转操作中，GreenSeg在平均Recall上达到11.58%的峰值提升，在mIoU上达到19.24%的峰值提升，持续优于基准分割方法。
AI.conclusion: GreenSeg算法能够在预算受限、光照条件敏感的非结构化动态农业环境中实现稳定、安全的自主导航。

title: GEESE: Genotype-aware End-to-End Spatio-temporal Embedding for Behavioral Phenotyping
summary: Behavioral phenotyping of genetic animal models currently requires labor-intensive manual feature engineering that limits reproducibility and scalability. We present GEESE, an end-to-end deep learning framework that learns behavioral representations directly from 3D pose dynamics without hand-crafted features. Using a pretrained time series foundation model, we encode movement sequences into a behavioral manifold that supports both behavior classification and genotype prediction. Evaluated across three autism-associated genetic models (CNTNAP2, CHD8, FMR1), our deep learning approach surpasses hand-crafted feature baselines in both tasks, revealing that learned representations capture genotype-specific behavioral signatures. The framework generalizes across genetic backgrounds, and an all-cohort model identifies both genetic background and genotype from movement patterns alone. We further provide HONK, an interactive intelligent tool enabling researchers without programming expertise to perform behavioral phenotyping from pose data through natural language interaction.

AI.tldr: GEESE是一个端到端深度学习框架，通过预训练时间序列基础模型直接从3D姿态动力学中学习行为表征，无需手工特征工程。在三个自闭症相关基因模型（CNTNAP2、CHD8、FMR1）上，该方法在行为分类和基因型预测任务中均超越传统手工特征基线。同时提供HONK交互工具，支持非编程研究人员通过自然语言进行行为表型分析。
AI.motivation: 当前遗传动物模型的行为表型分析依赖耗时的手工特征工程，这限制了方法的可重复性和可扩展性，亟需一种端到端的自动化行为表征学习方法。
AI.method: 采用预训练的时间序列基础模型将3D姿态运动序列编码为行为流形，在该流形空间上同时进行行为分类和基因型预测。还开发了HONK交互工具，支持通过自然语言界面进行行为表型分析。
AI.result: 在CNTNAP2、CHD8、FMR1三种自闭症相关基因模型上，深度学习方法的性能超越手工特征基线；学到的表征能够捕获基因型特异的行為特征；框架跨遗传背景具有泛化能力；全队列模型可仅从运动模式识别遗传背景和基因型。
AI.conclusion: GEESE框架证明了端到端学习在动物行为表型分析中的有效性，消除了对手工特征工程的依赖，为行为表型分析提供了可扩展、可重复且更易用的解决方案。

title: Coarse-to-Fine Domain Incremental Learning with Attentive Distillation for Mining Footprint Segmentation in Multispectral Imagery
summary: Automatically mapping and segmenting global mining footprints using remote sensing and deep learning is critical for monitoring the socio-environmental risks and impacts of mining, yet its progress is hindered by the scarcity of fine-grained annotated data. Although large-scale datasets with coarse boundaries are widely available, leveraging them to improve fine-grained segmentation is challenging due to significant domain shift. To address this, we propose MineC2FNet, a coarse-to-fine domain incremental learning framework that exploits abundant coarse data to enhance fine-grained mining footprint segmentation. MineC2FNet adopts a teacher-student architecture with attentive distillation at both the feature and prediction levels, selectively transferring generalized knowledge from the coarse domain while enabling boundary refinement using limited fine-grained data (fine domain). We further introduce an expertly validated dataset of 219 images with precise boundary annotations across diverse geographies and commodities. Extensive experiments against state-of-the-art approaches, including domain adaptation and domain incremental learning methods, demonstrate that MineC2FNet achieves superior performance while effectively handling domain shift. The dataset and code are publicly available at https://github.com/risqiutama/MineC2FNet.

AI.tldr: 提出MineC2FNet框架，利用粗粒度边界数据通过粗到细的域增量学习提升细粒度采矿足迹分割性能，并发布了219张精标注图像的数据集。
AI.motivation: 全球采矿足迹的自动细粒度分割对监测采矿的社会环境风险至关重要，但细粒度标注数据稀缺，而粗粒度数据虽广泛存在却因域偏移难以直接利用。
AI.method: 采用教师-学生架构，在特征和预测层面进行注意力蒸馏，选择性迁移粗粒度域的通用知识，并利用有限细粒度数据实现边界精化。
AI.result: 在多个基准方法（包括域适应和域增量学习方法）上取得更优性能，有效处理了域偏移问题。
AI.conclusion: 证明了利用粗粒度数据辅助细粒度分割的可行性，所提框架和数据集可推动全球采矿足迹监测研究。

title: Parallel Differentiable Reachability for Learning and Planning with Certified Neural Dynamics and Controllers
summary: Neural network (NN) dynamics models and control policies achieve strong performance in robotics, but providing sound guarantees under uncertainty remains difficult, especially for closed-loop NN systems. Existing reachability tools provide formal over-approximations, yet are often non-differentiable, overly conservative, or too slow for modern learning and online planning pipelines. To address this, we present a parallelizable, differentiable reachability framework in JAX for continuous- and discrete-time systems with analytical and NN-based dynamics and controllers. Our framework combines Taylor-model flowpipe construction with CROWN-style linear bound propagation through a unified representation that preserves affine dependencies while supporting GPU-batched computation and automatic differentiation. Building on this reachability primitive, we develop (i) a certified training method that encourages reachability-friendly dynamics models and controllers, and (ii) a reachability-aware sampling-based MPC scheme with gradient-based refinement. Experiments on non-prehensile manipulation and quadrotor tasks, including hardware and higher-dimensional evaluations (up to 72D), demonstrate practical online planning while maintaining certified reachable-set over-approximations under bounded uncertainty.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种基于JAX的可微分、可并行化的可达性分析框架，结合Taylor模型流形构建和CROWN风格线性边界传播，支持GPU批处理和自动微分，并在此基础上开发了认证训练方法和可达性感知的采样MPC方案，在机器人操作和四旋翼飞行器任务中实现了在线规划与形式化保证。
AI.motivation: 现有的神经网络动力学模型和控制策略在机器人应用中表现优异，但难以在不确定性下提供形式化安全保障；已有的可达性工具存在不可微、过于保守或速度慢等问题，无法满足现代学习和在线规划的需求。
AI.method: (1) 在JAX中构建了连续/离散时间系统的可微可达性框架，融合Taylor模型流形构建与CROWN风格线性边界传播，采用统一表示保留仿射依赖性，支持GPU批计算和自动微分；(2) 基于该原语开发了认证训练方法，鼓励生成有利于可达性的动力学模型和控制器；(3) 设计了可达性感知的采样MPC方案，结合梯度优化进行精化。
AI.result: 在非抓取操作和四旋翼飞行器任务上（包括硬件实验和高达72维的高维评估）验证了方法有效性，实现了在保持有界不确定性下认证可达集超近似的同时进行实际的在线规划。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的可微、可并行化的可达性框架有效弥合了形式化验证与学习/规划系统之间的鸿沟，为闭环NN系统提供了兼具效率与形式化保证的安全关键应用方案。

title: Assessing the Operational Viability of Foundation Models for Time Series Forecasting
summary:
Time series forecasting drives operational decisions in areas like finance, transportation, and energy. While supervised learning approaches achieve strong performance, they require domain-specific training, feature engineering, and ongoing maintenance. Large-scale foundation models have recently emerged as a zero-shot alternative, avoiding task-specific training much like LLMs. In this work, we evaluate foundation models against standard supervised approaches. Rather than focusing solely on aggregate accuracy, we analyze performance across four operational regimes: periodic human-centric systems, physically constrained processes, stochastic financial markets, and heterogeneous demand forecasting.
  Our results characterize optimal deployment areas. Foundation models perform well in domains with transferable periodic structures and are efficient for cold-start or long-tail scenarios. Conversely, supervised specialists maintain higher precision in systems governed by strict physical constraints. In financial domains, newer foundation models are rapidly closing the performance gap with supervised specialists. We further quantify trade-offs in inference latency, data drift adaptability, and deployment constraints. Finally, we propose a Complexity Router that assigns each series to the optimal model class using empirical features. We demonstrate that this selective routing achieves higher accuracy and significantly lower inference costs compared to deploying a universal foundation model, providing a practical framework for balancing generalization and efficiency.

AI.tldr: 本文评估了时序基础模型与监督学习方法在四种操作场景下的表现，提出了一个基于经验特征选择最优模型类别的"复杂度路由器"，实现了更高精度和更低推理成本。
AI.motivation: 时序预测在金融、交通、能源等领域至关重要。监督学习虽然性能强，但需要领域特定的训练、特征工程和持续维护。最近出现的大规模基础模型作为零样本替代方案，可以避免任务特定训练，但其与监督方法的全面比较尚不充分。
AI.method: 本文在四种操作场景（周期性人本系统、物理约束过程、随机金融市场、异构需求预测）中评估基础模型与监督方法，并提出了"复杂度路由器"——利用经验特征为每个序列分配最优模型类别。
AI.result: 基础模型在具有可迁移周期结构的领域表现良好，适合冷启动或长尾场景；监督专家在严格物理约束系统中保持更高精度；金融领域新型基础模型正迅速缩小与监督专家的性能差距；选择性路由比部署通用基础模型实现了更高精度和更低推理成本。
AI.conclusion: 最优部署不是选择单一方法，而是通过复杂度路由器在基础模型和监督专家之间进行选择性路由，从而在泛化性和效率之间取得平衡，提供了实用的部署框架。

title: Prior Policy Guided Dual-Agent Coordinated Manipulation Planning of Spacecraft-Manipulator System
summary: The strong dynamic coupling between the manipulator and the base poses a significant challenge to maintaining spacecraft attitude stability, potentially compromising mission safety. In this paper, we propose a Dual-Agent Coordinated Manipulation Planning (DACMP) framework that simultaneously achieves high-precision end-effector pose reaching for a 6-DoF space manipulator and attitude stabilization of the base spacecraft. To enhance learning efficiency, we present a prior policy-guided Deep Reinforcement Learning algorithm incorporating the Timestep-level Expert Switching Guidance (TESG) mechanism, thereby promoting global convergence and improving task success rates. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DACMP significantly outperforms baseline DRL algorithms in terms of task success rate and control precision. Furthermore, the robustness of DACMP is validated under various challenging scenarios, including system constraints, environmental disturbances, and perception uncertainties. The code and simulation configurations are available on GitHub: https://github.com/HIT-YuhuiHu/DACMP.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种双智能体协同操作规划框架（DACMP），通过先验策略引导的深度强化学习算法和专家切换引导机制，同时实现空间机械臂末端高精度到达和基座航天器姿态稳定。
AI.motivation: 机械臂与基座之间的强动态耦合严重威胁航天器姿态稳定性和任务安全，现有方法难以同时兼顾末端执行精度与基座姿态控制。
AI.method: 提出了DACMP框架，包含基于先验策略引导的深度强化学习算法，以及时间步级专家切换引导（TESG）机制，用于提升学习效率和全局收敛性。
AI.result: DACMP在任务成功率和控制精度上显著优于基线DRL算法，并在系统约束、环境扰动和感知不确定性等挑战场景下验证了鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: DACMP能够有效解决空间机械臂与基座耦合问题，实现高精度末端控制与姿态稳定的双目标协调，代码和仿真配置已开源。

title: Learning Laplacian Eigenspace with Mass-Aware Neural Operators on Point Clouds
summary: The eigendecomposition of the Laplace--Beltrami Operator (LBO) is fundamental to geometric analysis, yet computing its low-frequency eigenmodes remains a significant bottleneck due to the high cost of iterative solvers on large-scale data. To amortize this cost, we introduce the Neural Eigenspace Operator (NEO), a feed-forward framework designed to predict the spectrum directly from point clouds. Crucially, NEO circumvents the ill-posed nature of standard eigenvector regression, which suffers from intrinsic sign flips and rotation ambiguities, by learning the stable, invariant low-frequency subspace instead. Specifically, the network predicts a redundant set of basis functions whose span robustly covers the target eigenspace, allowing for the recovery of accurate eigenpairs via a lightweight Rayleigh--Ritz refinement. To handle irregular sampling, we propose a mass-aware neural operator that incorporates per-point area weights into attention-based aggregation, improving robustness to non-uniform densities and enabling zero-shot generalization across resolutions. Our approach achieves near-linear runtime scaling and substantial wall-clock speedups over iterative solvers at comparable accuracy, and exhibits strong zero-shot transfer to high-resolution point clouds. The resulting eigenpairs support standard spectral geometry tasks, while the raw basis functions provide effective point-wise features for downstream learning. Code: https://github.com/Adversarr/NEO.

AI.tldr: 本文提出神经特征空间算子（NEO），一种前馈框架，通过预测拉普拉斯-贝尔特拉米算子（LBO）的低频不变子空间而非单个特征向量，实现从点云快速、稳定地计算谱分解，在保持精度的同时达到近线性时间复杂度和零样本跨分辨率泛化。
AI.motivation: 大规模数据上迭代求解LBO低频特征模的计算成本高昂，是几何分析中的主要瓶颈，亟需一种高效的替代方案。
AI.method: 1) 学习稳定的低频不变子空间（预测冗余基函数覆盖目标特征空间），避免特征向量回归中的符号翻转和旋转歧义等不适定问题；2) 通过轻量级Rayleigh-Ritz精化恢复准确的特征对；3) 提出质量感知神经算子，将逐点面积权重融入基于注意力的聚合，处理非均匀采样的零样本泛化。
AI.result: 达到近线性运行时缩放，相比迭代求解器在相当精度下实现显著的加速；零样本迁移至高分辨率点云表现优异；支持标准谱几何任务，原始基函数可作为有效的逐点特征用于下游学习。
AI.conclusion: NEO为大规模点云上的LBO谱分解提供了一种高效、可泛化的替代方案，兼具计算速度和精度，代码已开源。

title: Robust Fuzzy Multi-view Learning under View Conflict
summary: Trusted multi-view classification aims to deliver reliable fusion for accurate predictions and has recently attracted substantial attention in both academia and industry. However, existing TMVC methods typically assume strict alignment across different views during both training and testing phases, which is often impractical in real-world scenarios. This limitation motivates us to revisit TMVC and extend it to a more challenging setting: how to mitigate the impact of view conflict (VC) during both training and inference. To tackle this setting, existing TMVC methods suffer from three critical limitations: underestimated uncertainty, misleading decisions, and overfitting to VC. To address these issues, this paper proposes a novel Robust Fuzzy Multi-View Learning (R-FUML) framework grounded in Fuzzy Set Theory. Specifically, R-FUML models network outputs as fuzzy memberships to quantify category credibility and uses an entropy-based method for reliable multi-view fusion. To this end, we present a Robust Multi-view Fusion (RMF) strategy that accounts for both view-specific uncertainty and inter-view conflicts, thereby alleviating the adverse impacts of VC on decision-making. To identify and conquer VC during training, we further design a Robust Learning Against VC (RLVC) framework. RLVC isolates conflicting samples by leveraging neural networks' memory effects and then retrains the model by applying a penalty to these conflicting views. Extensive experiments across eight public datasets demonstrate that R-FUML consistently outperforms 15 state-of-the-art baselines in robustness and uncertainty estimation. The code will be released upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出R-FUML框架，基于模糊集理论解决多视图分类中的视图冲突问题，通过模糊隶属度建模、熵融合策略及抗冲突训练机制，在8个数据集上优于15个基线方法。
AI.motivation: 现有可信多视图分类方法假设训练和测试阶段视图严格对齐，这在现实中难以满足；且现有方法在应对视图冲突时存在不确定性低估、决策误导和对冲突过拟合三大局限。
AI.method: 1) 基于模糊集理论将网络输出建模为模糊隶属度以量化类别可信度；2) 提出鲁棒多视图融合(RMF)策略，联合考虑视图特有不确定性和视图间冲突；3) 设计鲁棒抗冲突学习(RLVC)框架，利用神经网络记忆效应隔离冲突样本，并通过惩罚冲突视图进行重训练。
AI.result: 在8个公开数据集上，R-FUML在鲁棒性和不确定性估计方面一致优于15个SOTA基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 本文首次将可信多视图分类拓展到视图非对齐的现实场景，提出的模糊集理论框架有效缓解了视图冲突带来的负面影响，提升了模型鲁棒性和不确定性估计能力。

title: FOUND-IT: Foundation-model-first Task-driven 3D Scene Graphs with Granularity on Demand
summary: We present the first approach to build hierarchical task-driven 3D scene graphs of arbitrary indoor or outdoor environments using an uncalibrated monocular camera in real-time. We leverage geometric foundation models to estimate geometric attributes of the scene graph (e.g., object bounding boxes), but we also observe that traversability information (the "places" layer of a scene graph) can be directly reconstructed by adding an extra head to existing geometric foundation models, like VGGT. Our approach is task-driven in the sense that we adjust the granularity of the objects and regions in the map depending on the task; for instance, during a manipulation task, our approach is able to resolve small knobs on a stove, while during a navigation task it can focus on large objects (e.g., the entire stove). However, in a major departure from related work, we consider the realistic case where the list of tasks is not predefined and fixed, but evolves as the robot operates. This naturally allows dealing with complex loco-manipulation tasks, where the robot can dynamically adjust its representation as the task unfolds. We dub the resulting approach FOUND-IT. FOUND-IT also includes an agentic approach to query information in the scene graph. In addition to achieving 79% higher accuracy on the ASHiTA SG3D task grounding benchmark, we demonstrate FOUND-IT runs in real-time on a ground robot using a Jetson Thor. Furthermore, to highlight the robustness of our method, we demonstrate constructing 3D scene graphs on casually captured realtor apartment tours from YouTube. Code will be made available upon publication.

AI.tldr: 提出FOUND-IT，首个基于单目相机实时构建层次化任务驱动3D场景图的方法，支持动态任务调整，在ASHiTA SG3D任务上准确率提升79%，并能在Jetson Thor上实时运行。
AI.motivation: 现有3D场景图构建方法通常假设预定义的任务列表，无法适应机器人操作过程中任务动态变化的需求，尤其是在复杂的移动操作任务中。
AI.method: 利用几何基础模型（如VGGT）估计场景图几何属性，并通过添加额外头来重建可通行性信息；采用任务驱动的方式动态调整地图中对象和区域的粒度；引入智能体方法查询场景图信息。
AI.result: 在ASHiTA SG3D任务接地基准上准确率提升79%，在Jetson Thor上实现实时运行，并在YouTube真实房源视频上验证了鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: FOUND-IT能够实时构建3D场景图，动态适应机器人任务变化，且在多种场景下表现出色，具有实际应用价值。

title: AvAtar: Learning to Align via Active Optimal Transport
comment: Published as a conference paper at ICML 2026
summary: Alignment plays a fundamental role in many machine learning problems, such as multi-network analysis, multimodal learning, and point cloud registration. Recent works increasingly leverage optimal transport (OT) for distributional alignment, whose effectiveness largely depends on sparse supervision that is hard or costly to obtain in practice. Existing works, however, largely overlook how to actively acquire high-quality supervision to improve their alignment performance under OT frameworks. In this paper, we propose a principled active alignment framework for optimal transport alignment called AvAtar. We quantify the informativeness of a candidate by measuring its gradient-based impact on the global alignment result, computed as the gradient propagation from the global alignment result to all possible supervisions of the candidate through the entropy-regularized OT formulation. While differentiating through OT is challenging given its constrained nature, we leverage the adjoint-state method to reformulate the computation to a linear system solvable by the conjugate gradient method with linear complexity and guaranteed convergence. By encoding the global alignment result via effective utility functions, AvAtar is applicable to general alignment problems under the OT framework. Extensive experiments on three representative alignment tasks demonstrate the effectiveness, scalability, and generalizability of the proposed AvAtar.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AvAtar，一种基于最优传输的主动对齐框架，通过梯度传播量化候选点的信息量，并利用伴随状态法高效求解，在三个代表性对齐任务上验证了有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有最优传输对齐方法依赖难以获取的稀疏监督，缺乏主动获取高质量监督的策略来提升对齐性能。
AI.method: 通过测量候选点对全局对齐结果的梯度影响来量化信息量，利用伴随状态法将OT梯度计算转化为线性系统，以共轭梯度法高效求解。
AI.result: 在三个代表性对齐任务上，AvAtar展示了有效性、可扩展性和泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: AvAtar是一种通用的主动对齐框架，能有效利用稀疏监督提升最优传输对齐的性能。

title: Decision-Making with Lightweight Confidence-Aware Language Model for Autonomous Driving
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) and Multimodal LLMs (MLLMs) have demonstrated immense potential in autonomous driving (AD) by offering human-like reasoning and open-world generalization. However, the excessive computational overhead and high inference latency of these massive models severely hinder their deployment in resource-constrained AD systems. To address this challenge, we propose a novel decision-making framework utilizing a lightweight confidence-aware language model, which bridges the gap between complex multimodal intention reasoning and efficient inference. Specifically, we design a multi-agent collaborative workflow, comprising action voting, confidence assessment, and summarization agents, to generate high-quality, confidence-annotated decision demonstrations via explicit Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning. These demonstrations are then distilled into a lightweight language model featuring a dual-head architecture, enabling the joint prediction of decision probabilities and the generation of textual rationales. The distillation is realized via a confidence-aware fine-tuning strategy coupled with Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) to enhance the model's adaptability and data efficiency. Comprehensive closed-loop experiments on the nuPlan benchmark demonstrate that our approach achieves state-of-the-art (SOTA) success rates in both regular and long-tail scenarios while maintaining low inference latency.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于轻量级置信感知语言模型的自动驾驶决策框架，通过多智能体协作生成高质量决策演示，并利用置信感知微调和RAG蒸馏到轻量级模型，在nuPlan基准上实现SOTA成功率和低推理延迟。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型和多模态大语言模型在自动驾驶中虽展现出类人推理和开放世界泛化能力，但其过高的计算开销和推理延迟严重阻碍了在资源受限的自动驾驶系统中的部署。
AI.method: 设计多智能体协作工作流（动作投票、置信度评估、摘要生成），通过显式思维链推理生成高质量置信度标注的决策演示；然后采用双头架构的轻量级语言模型联合预测决策概率和生成文本理由，通过置信感知微调策略和检索增强生成进行蒸馏。
AI.result: 在nuPlan基准的闭环实验中，该方法在常规和长尾场景下均取得了SOTA成功率，同时保持低推理延迟。
AI.conclusion: 置信感知的轻量级语言模型结合多智能体协作蒸馏，能够有效弥合复杂多模态意图推理与高效推理之间的鸿沟，为资源受限的自动驾驶系统提供可行的决策方案。

title: Generative OOD-regularized Model-based Policy Optimization
summary: We study sequential decision-making with offline reinforcement learning (RL). Traditional offline RL policies may result in out-of-distribution (OOD) actions when training relies only on sparse offline representations. To ensure safe offline policies in a sparse state-action space, we explore how density estimation models can be integrated into model-based RL methods to avoid the OOD regions. Generative models are capable of explicitly modeling the density in sparse state-action spaces. Building on this, we introduce Generative OOD-regularized Model-based Policy Optimization (GORMPO), a density-regularized offline RL algorithm that uses generative density modeling to restrict policy updates to high-density areas of the dataset. Furthermore, we examine whether better OOD detection corresponds to better model-based offline policies. We compare (1) the OOD detection capabilities of various density estimators and (2) their performance within the GORMPO framework on a real-world medical dataset and sparse offline RL datasets. We theoretically guarantee GORMPO's performance under mild assumptions. Empirically, GORMPO outperforms state-of-the-art baselines by 17% on a real-world medical dataset and enhances the base model on the offline RL datasets. Our empirical findings show that better OOD detection generally results in improved policies in environments with stable dynamics, while conservative penalties with poor density estimation are favored when dynamics are uncertain.

AI.tldr: 本文提出GORMPO，一种利用生成密度建模来避免离线强化学习中分布外动作的策略优化算法，在真实医疗数据集上比现有最优方法提升17%。
AI.motivation: 传统离线RL策略在稀疏状态-动作空间中依赖稀疏的离线表示，容易产生分布外(OOD)动作，导致不安全策略。需要有效方法来避免OOD区域，确保离线策略的安全性。
AI.method: 提出GORMPO框架，将生成式密度估计模型集成到基于模型的RL方法中，通过密度正则化限制策略更新只在高密度区域进行。同时比较了不同密度估计器的OOD检测能力及其在GORMPO框架中的表现。
AI.result: 在真实医疗数据集上比现有最优基线提升17%；在离线RL数据集上增强了基础模型性能。更好的OOD检测在稳定动力学环境中通常产生更优策略，而在动力学不确定时，保守惩罚结合较差密度估计反而更优。
AI.conclusion: GORMPO在理论上保证了在温和假设下的性能，实验证明了密度正则化在离线RL中的有效性，且OOD检测质量与策略性能之间的关系取决于环境动力学的不确定性程度。

title: Path Following Control System of Line-of-Sight Guidance for Robotic Dolphin with Multi-Link Mechanism in Underwater Simulator
summary: Biomimetic autonomous underwater vehicle (BAUV) with multi-link mechanism is widely used in aquatic life observation and environmental surveys due to its low power consumption and high maneuverability. An environmental survey requires a path following system that automatically follows specific points. However, the path following system of BAUV is limited, and its evaluation with multi-link mechanism robots has not yet been clarified. The path following system in BAUV requires prior simulation because the model differs depending on the type of biomimetics. In this study, we propose a path following system for BAUVs with a multi-link mechanism and evaluation in underwater simulation. In this result, it was possible to design a path following system suitable for BAUV, determine parameters using a simulator, and evaluate control methods.

AI.tldr: 本文针对多连杆机构仿生自主水下航行器（BAUV）提出了一种路径跟踪系统，并在水下仿真环境中进行了参数整定与控制方法评估。
AI.motivation: BAUV因其低功耗和高机动性被广泛用于水下环境调查，但现有的路径跟踪系统存在局限性，且针对多连杆机构BAUV的路径跟踪评估尚未明确，因此需要提出并验证适用于此类机器人的路径跟踪系统。
AI.method: 针对多连杆机构BAUV设计路径跟踪系统，利用水下仿真器进行参数整定，并对不同控制方法进行评估。
AI.result: 成功设计了适用于BAUV的路径跟踪系统，通过仿真器确定了系统参数，并评估了不同控制方法的性能。
AI.conclusion: 本研究为多连杆机构BAUV的路径跟踪系统设计提供了可行的方案，并通过仿真验证了其有效性，为后续实际应用奠定了基础。

title: A Unified Python Framework for Direct PPO-based Control of AHUs with Economizer Logic and CO2-Constrained Ventilation
summary: Optimizing HVAC (Heating, Ventilation and Air Conditioning) can enhance a building's energy efficiency while providing comfort levels for its occupants. Using conventional control systems to maintain HVAC functions is often difficult because of the nonlinear characteristics of a building envelope as it experiences stochastic load variations over time. This paper presents a new approach to optimizing HVAC systems through the use of Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) algorithms and the Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) algorithm implemented in a custom Python performance environment. The DRL system uses a second order resistor-capacitor thermal model and an integrated dynamic mass balance of CO2 to replicate the complex physics associated with buildings. One major innovation of this study is a "Hierarchical Flow Logic," which provides the means to ensure that indoor air quality (IAQ) is maintained by overriding the accepted actions of the agent that cause CO2 to exceed 1000 ppm. In addition, an enthalpy-based economiser is used to create free cooling from the outdoor environment. The experimental data shows that compared to PID controllers tuned by GA or traditional On-Off controls, a PPO agent has better temperature stability and energy efficiency overall. An end-to-end pipeline provides an avenue for robust and generalized solutions to help implement smart building energy management within the context of real hardware implementation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于深度强化学习（DRL）和近端策略优化（PPO）算法的HVAC优化方法，采用二阶RC热模型和CO2动态质量平衡模拟建筑物理，通过分层流量逻辑确保IAQ（CO2<1000ppm），并结合焓经济器实现自由冷却。实验表明，PPO代理在温度稳定性和能效上优于GA整定的PID控制器和传统开关控制。
AI.motivation: 传统HVAC控制系统难以应对建筑围护结构的非线性和随机负荷变化，亟需一种能兼顾能效和 occupant 舒适度的智能优化方法。
AI.method: 1) 使用DRL中的PPO算法；2) 构建二阶RC热模型与集成动态CO2质量平衡；3) 提出"分层流量逻辑"强制IAQ（CO2<1000ppm）；4) 引入焓基经济器实现自然冷却；5) 在自定义Python环境中实现端到端管线。
AI.result: PPO代理在温度稳定性和总体能效上均优于经GA整定的PID控制器和传统On-Off控制。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的端到端DRL管线为智能建筑能源管理提供了鲁棒且可泛化的解决方案，具备实际硬件部署的潜力。

title: How to Mitigate the Distribution Shift Problem in Robotics Control: A Robust and Adaptive Approach Based on Offline to Online Imitation Learning
summary: Distribution shift in imitation learning refers to the problem that the agent cannot plan proper actions for a state that has not been visited during the training. This problem can be largely attributed to the inherently narrow state-action coverage provided by expert demonstrations over the full environment. In this paper, we propose a robust offline to adaptive online imitation learning framework that handles the distribution shift problem in a lifelong, multi-phase scheme. In the offline learning phase, we leverage supplementary demonstrations to broaden the state-action coverage of the policy by utilizing a discriminator to effectively train the policy with supplementary demonstrations, thereby enhancing the robustness of the policy to distribution shift. In the subsequent online inference phase, our framework detects the occurrence of distribution shift and conducts self-supervised imitation learning from online experiences to adapt the policy to the online environments. Through extensive evaluations in MuJoCo environments, we demonstrate that our method exhibits better robustness to distribution shift and better adaptation performance to online environments than the baseline algorithms, which indicates superior performance of our framework against the distribution shift.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个鲁棒的离线到自适应在线模仿学习框架，通过离线阶段利用补充演示扩大状态-动作覆盖并使用判别器训练策略，以及在线阶段检测分布偏移并进行自监督模仿学习，有效解决了模仿学习中的分布偏移问题，在MuJoCo环境中表现优于基线算法。
AI.motivation: 模仿学习中存在分布偏移问题，即智能体无法对训练中未访问的状态规划合适动作，这主要归因于专家演示在完整环境上固有的狭窄状态-动作覆盖。
AI.method: 提出鲁棒的离线到自适应在线模仿学习框架：(1) 离线学习阶段，利用补充演示通过判别器训练策略以拓宽状态-动作覆盖；(2) 在线推理阶段，检测分布偏移并执行自监督模仿学习以自适应在线环境。
AI.result: 在MuJoCo环境中的广泛评估表明，该方法在分布偏移鲁棒性和在线环境自适应性能上均优于基线算法。
AI.conclusion: 该框架能有效应对模仿学习中的分布偏移问题，展现出优越的性能。

title: ChainLearn: A Blockchain-Based Capacity-Aware Framework for Federated Ensemble Learning
comment: 10 pages, 7 figures, 11 tables. IEEE conference format. Code: https://github.com/EdddTri/ChainLearn
summary:
Federated learning is used in medical imaging where privacy prohibits centralizing data. Standard federated algorithms assume homogeneous hardware, identical architectures, and centralized aggregation, which fails when hospitals have unequal compute resources. We propose capacity-aware coordination: measure each hospital's throughput, assign capacity-appropriate architectures (MobileNetV3-Small, EfficientNet-B0, ResNet-50), and combine predictions via weighted ensemble. Weak and strong hospitals can participate without forcing uniform architectures.
  We separate on-chain policy from off-chain learning. A Solidity contract stores hospital registration, benchmark hashes, metrics, and weights. Hospitals train locally and submit only hashes and scalars (not parameters). Weighted ensemble inference is computed off-chain.
  Experiments on PneumoniaMNIST and DermaMNIST (5 seeds, 3 non-IID levels) show our method achieves lower or equal calibration error versus equal-weight ensemble and competitive accuracy versus FedAvg, FedProx, and FedMD. Communication overhead is 224 bytes per round, a reduction of over 912,000x compared to FedAvg.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种容量感知的联邦学习框架，允许医院使用不同架构的模型参与联邦学习，并通过链上策略与链下训练的分离，将通信开销降低至每轮224字节（相比FedAvg减少912,000倍），在肺炎MNIST和皮肤MNIST数据集上达到与FedAvg等算法相当的精度和更低的校准误差。
AI.motivation: 解决联邦学习在医疗影像场景中因医院计算资源异构（强弱医院并存）而无法统一模型架构的问题，突破标准联邦算法对同构硬件和集中聚合的依赖。
AI.method: 1) 容量感知协调：测量各医院吞吐量，分配适合其算力的架构（MobileNetV3-Small、EfficientNet-B0、ResNet-50），通过加权集成聚合预测结果；2) 链上-链下分离：智能合约存储注册信息、基准哈希、指标和权重，医院仅提交哈希和标量（非模型参数），加权集成推理在链下完成。
AI.result: 在PneumoniaMNIST和DermaMNIST上（5种子，3种非IID程度），校准误差低于或等于等权集成，准确率与FedAvg、FedProx、FedMD相当；通信开销每轮224字节，比FedAvg降低超过912,000倍。
AI.conclusion: 该框架证明了异构模型架构在联邦学习中的可行性，通过极低通信开销实现了有效协作，解决了医疗场景中的资源异构问题。

title: Batch Normalization Amplifies Memorization and Privacy Risks
summary: Batch Normalization (BN) is widely adopted to enable faster convergence and more stable training of deep neural networks. However, its impact on privacy and memorization has remained largely unexplored. In this work, we investigate the effect of BN layers on the memorization of atypical or outlier samples and its implications for privacy leakage. We conduct an extensive empirical study using three complementary approaches: (i) unintended memorization of out-of-distribution training samples, (ii) per-sample influence measured via gradient norms, and (iii) susceptibility to membership inference attacks (MIA). Across multiple datasets and architectures, we consistently observe that BN substantially increases the memorization of outliers compared to models without BN. Critically, this amplified memorization translates directly into privacy vulnerabilities: models with BN exhibit significantly higher susceptibility to MIAs. We complement our empirical findings with a theoretical analysis showing that BN amplifies the per-step influence of outlier samples during training, providing mechanistic insight into this phenomenon. Our results highlight an underappreciated privacy risk associated with BN and provide both practical and theoretical insights into how normalization layers can amplify the influence of rare or sensitive training examples.

AI.tldr: 本文研究批归一化（BN）层对深度神经网络中异常样本记忆化及隐私泄露的影响。通过多项实验发现，BN显著增加了模型对异常样本的记忆，并直接导致其对成员推断攻击的脆弱性提高。理论分析表明，BN放大了异常样本在训练过程中的每步影响力。
AI.motivation: BN层被广泛用于加速收敛和稳定训练，但其对隐私和记忆化的影响尚未被充分探索。作者旨在揭示BN层在异常样本记忆和隐私泄露方面的潜在风险。
AI.method: 采用三种互补方法进行实证研究：(i) 对分布外训练样本的非预期记忆化；(ii) 通过梯度范数衡量每个样本的影响力；(iii) 成员推断攻击（MIA）的脆弱性评估。同时辅以理论分析，论证BN如何放大异常样本在训练中的每步影响力。
AI.result: 在多个数据集和架构上，BN显著增加了模型对异常样本的记忆化程度；这种增强的记忆化直接转化为隐私漏洞——带有BN的模型对成员推断攻击的脆弱性显著更高。
AI.conclusion: BN层存在被低估的隐私风险，它会放大罕见或敏感训练样本的影响力。研究为归一化层如何影响隐私安全提供了实践和理论层面的见解。

title: Momentum Streams for Optimizer-Inspired Transformers
summary: The residual update of a pre-norm Transformer layer admits an interpretation as one step of a first-order optimizer acting on a surrogate token energy, wherein the attention and MLP sublayers function as gradient oracles. Based on this observation, we build a family of optimizer-inspired Transformers (triple-momentum, Adam/AdamW, Muon, SOAP) and compare them under matched compute. In our main pretraining experiment, the triple-momentum TMMFormer achieves the lowest validation loss, outperforming the vanilla Transformer and prior architectural variants. A controlled ablation and supporting theory show that momentum, not preconditioning, is the main source of the gain. We further show that TMMFormer and other momentum-based designs reach flatter minima than the vanilla Transformer, which leads to less forgetting and better generalization.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种优化器启发的Transformer架构族，其中三重动量版本TMMFormer在预训练中取得最低验证损失，并证明动量（而非预条件）是性能提升的主要来源，且动量设计能收敛到更平坦的极小值，减少遗忘并提升泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 将预归一化Transformer层的残差更新解释为作用于代理token能量的一阶优化器的一步迭代，其中注意力与MLP子层充当梯度预言机，从而启发设计更高效的Transformer架构。
AI.method: 基于上述优化器视角，构建了一族优化器启发的Transformer（三重动量、Adam/AdamW、Muon、SOAP），并在匹配计算量的条件下进行比较。重点分析了三重动量版本的TMMFormer，并通过受控消融实验和理论分析分离动量和预条件的影响。
AI.result: 在主要预训练实验中，TMMFormer取得最低验证损失，优于普通Transformer及先前架构变体。消融实验和理论表明动量是增益的主要来源。动量设计收敛到更平坦的极小值，导致遗忘更少、泛化更好。
AI.conclusion: 优化器启发的Transformer架构，特别是引入动量的设计，能显著提升预训练效果，收敛到更平坦的极小值，增强泛化与抗遗忘能力。

title: Safety-Critical Whole-Body Control for Humanoid Robots via Input-to-State Safe Control Barrier Functions
summary: Safety-critical control is essential for humanoid robots operating in complex human-centered environments, where physical safety constraints such as joint limits, self-collision avoidance, obstacle avoidance, and workspace boundaries must be satisfied during real-robot operation. However, existing approaches remain limited because kinematic safety guarantees can be degraded in the presence of unknown disturbances, such as model uncertainties, trajectory-tracking errors, and external perturbations. This paper presents a hierarchical safety-critical whole-body control framework for humanoid robots based on input-to-state safe control barrier functions (ISSf-CBFs). The proposed architecture integrates a kinematic-level whole-body controller (KinWBC), an ISSf-CBF safety filter, and a dynamic-level whole-body controller (DynWBC). KinWBC generates nominal joint-motion references from prioritized tasks; the ISSf-CBF filter minimally modifies these references to satisfy kinematic safety constraints under bounded disturbances; and DynWBC tracks the filtered references while enforcing full-body dynamic feasibility and contact stability. Safety constraints are imposed on a whole-body kinematic model, and the ISSf-CBF parameters are conservatively tuned so that the resulting kinematic safety guarantees can be transferred to full-order humanoid dynamics under unknown disturbances. Simulation and real-robot experiments demonstrate that the proposed framework improves safety margins under model mismatch and reliably enforces multiple safety constraints in real time during locomotion, teleoperation, and single-leg balancing with hand control. Project website: https://kwlee365.github.io/SafeWBC-Website/

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于输入到状态安全控制屏障函数(ISSf-CBF)的分层安全关键全身控制框架，用于人形机器人在未知扰动下同时满足运动学安全约束和全身动力学可行性。该框架由运动学级全身控制器(KinWBC)、ISSf-CBF安全滤波器和动力学级全身控制器(DynWBC)组成，通过保守调参将运动学安全保证传递至完整人形动力学。仿真和实物实验验证了该方法在模型失配下提升安全裕度，并能在行走、遥操作和单腿平衡等任务中实时强制执行多重安全约束。
AI.motivation: 现有安全关键控制方法在模型不确定性、轨迹跟踪误差和外部扰动等未知扰动下，运动学安全保证会退化，无法可靠满足人形机器人在复杂人类环境中的物理安全约束（关节极限、自碰撞避免、障碍物规避和工作空间边界）。
AI.method: 提出层次化安全关键全身控制框架：(1) KinWBC生成名义关节运动参考；(2) ISSf-CBF滤波器在受限扰动下最小化修改参考以满足运动学安全约束；(3) DynWBC跟踪滤波后参考，同时保证全身动力学可行性和接触稳定性。通过保守调参将运动学安全保证传递至全阶人形动力学。
AI.result: 仿真和实物实验表明，所提框架在模型失配情况下能提升安全裕度，在行走、遥操作和单腿平衡配合手部控制等任务中可靠地实时强制执行多重安全约束。
AI.conclusion: 基于ISSf-CBF的分层安全控制框架能有效将运动学安全保证扩展到存在未知扰动的全阶人形动力学，为人形机器人安全控制提供了一种理论上有保证且实用的解决方案。

title: TapSampling: Inference-Time Sampling with a Task-Progress-Understanding Verifier for Robotic Manipulation
summary: Existing embodied control research demonstrates remarkable performance improvements by scaling training data and model size. We instead explore inference-time strategy as an alternative axis. Non-deterministic generative models, such as diffusion and autoregressive models, have been widely adopted in the field of embodied control. However, the single-shot inference paradigm limits their performance. In this paper, we propose \textbf{TapSampling}, a plug-and-play framework for inference-time sampling. First, we introduce an Action-VAE that represents actions in a low-dimensional latent space by mapping policy-generated initial actions into a compressed posterior distribution, from which any number of latent samples can be drawn and decoded into candidate actions that approximate the true action distribution. Second, we formulate action verification as task-progress outcome prediction, using the intrinsic sequential structure of robotic datasets to train a semantically grounded verifier for interpretable action selection. Furthermore, TapSampling is a policy-agnostic framework. Extensive experiments in both simulated and real-world environments demonstrate that our method substantially improves multiple generalist policies without further policy finetuning. Code and models are available at the project page.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TapSampling，一个即插即用的推理时采样框架，通过Action-VAE将动作压缩到低维潜空间进行采样，并使用时序任务进度预测作为验证器来选择最优动作，无需微调即可显著提升多种通用策略的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有具身控制研究主要通过扩大训练数据和模型规模来提升性能，而忽视了推理时策略这一替代维度。非确定性生成模型（如扩散模型和自回归模型）虽被广泛采用，但其单次推理范式限制了性能上限。
AI.method: 1) Action-VAE：将策略生成的初始动作映射到低维潜空间的压缩后验分布，从中采样任意数量的潜变量并解码为候选动作；2) 动作验证：利用机器人数据集的固有序列结构，训练基于任务进度结果预测的语义验证器，用于可解释的动作选择。TapSampling是策略无关的即插即用框架。
AI.result: 在仿真和真实环境中的大量实验表明，该方法无需额外的策略微调，即可显著提升多种通用策略的性能。
AI.conclusion: 推理时采样是具身控制中一个有效的替代扩展轴，TapSampling通过潜空间采样和语义验证实现了对多种策略的无训练性能提升。

title: CAffNet: Hard Constraint-Affine Neural Networks
summary: We present a novel framework for embedding hard constraint satisfaction into neural network (NN) architectures, specifically feedforward neural networks and transformers, with input-dependent affine constraints of arbitrary cardinality. Traditional constraint enforcement approaches either rely on penalty-based soft constraints, which offer no guarantee of satisfaction, or on post-processing methods that enforce constraints after the NN is trained, which may lead to suboptimality. We introduce a trainable constraint-affine (CAffine) layer into NNs, yielding CAffNet, which goes beyond enforcing affine constraints via fixed orthogonal or parallel projections and enables joint optimization with network parameters. Moreover, we impose no restrictions on the constraint space dimensions and establish that our construction preserves the universal approximation properties of NNs, while providing provable guarantees on constraint adherence for all inputs. Experimental validation demonstrates robust performance across diverse domains requiring guaranteed constraint satisfaction.

AI.tldr: 提出CAffNet框架，通过在神经网络中嵌入可训练的约束仿射层（CAffine），实现对任意数量输入相关仿射约束的硬约束满足，同时保持通用近似性质并支持联合优化。
AI.motivation: 传统方法要么使用软约束（无法保证满足性），要么使用后处理方式（可能导致次优解），缺乏既能保证约束满足又能与网络参数联合优化的方法。
AI.method: 在神经网络（前馈网络和Transformer）中引入可训练的约束仿射层（CAffine），超越固定正交/平行投影，支持任意维度的输入相关仿射约束，并与网络参数进行联合优化。
AI.result: 在多个需要保证约束满足的领域实验中展现出鲁棒性能，同时证明了该方法保持了神经网络的通用近似性质，并提供了约束满足的可证明保证。
AI.conclusion: CAffNet能够在不牺牲神经网络表达能力的前提下，为任意数量输入相关的仿射约束提供可证明的硬约束满足，是一种通用且有效的约束嵌入框架。

title: Image-Conditioned Instance Prompt Network for Referring Remote Sensing Image Segmentation
comment: 6 pages, 3 figures. Equal contribution: Biaoyu Ren and Qingsheng Wang. Corresponding authors: Dingkang Yang and Wenxuan Wang
summary: Referring Remote Sensing Image Segmentation (RRSIS) is a situated, task-driven cross-modal task related to the embodied perception paradigm, requiring models to align visual-spatial features with linguistic intentions for precise target perception. Recent research has focused on refining the granularity of textual features and optimizing image-text feature fusion to better guide target feature representations. However, insufficient descriptive granularity and sensitivity to semantic shifts can cause bottlenecks in cross-modal feature fusion. To address these issues, we propose the Image-Conditioned Instance Prompt Network (ICIPNet) with Bilateral Information Fusion, which is designed to alleviate bottlenecks in cross-modal feature fusion. ICIPNet introduces an Image-Conditioned Instance Prompt (ICIP) module to generate self-adaptive visual and semantic representations without external knowledge. The Bilateral Information Fusion (BIF) module enhances feature fusion along the token and channel dimensions. Experiments demonstrate that the proposed ICIPNet outperforms existing RRSIS models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ICIPNet，通过图像条件实例提示（ICIP）模块和双边信息融合（BIF）模块，解决遥感图像分割中跨模态特征融合的瓶颈问题，在参照遥感图像分割任务上取得了优于现有模型的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有参照遥感图像分割（RRSIS）模型在跨模态特征融合中面临文本描述粒度不足、对语义变化敏感等问题，导致特征融合出现瓶颈，限制了模型对视觉空间特征与语言意图的对齐能力。
AI.method: 提出ICIPNet，包含两个核心模块：(1) 图像条件实例提示（ICIP）模块，无需外部知识即可生成自适应的视觉和语义表示；(2) 双边信息融合（BIF）模块，在token维度和通道维度上增强特征融合。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，所提出的ICIPNet在RRSIS任务上优于现有模型。
AI.conclusion: ICIPNet通过自适应视觉语义表示生成和双边维度特征融合，有效缓解了跨模态特征融合瓶颈，为参照遥感图像分割任务提供了更优的解决方案。

title: Acting on the Unseen: Communication-Free Collaborative Filtering for Decentralized Multi-Robot Task Allocation
summary: Multi-robot task allocation usually assumes some combination of communication, known task models, or a coordinator. We study the opposite extreme, a regime common in practice but overlooked in theory, which we name Zero-Knowledge MRTA (ZK-MRTA): a robot team with no prior knowledge (no task models, not even the latent rank), no communication (no messages, no parameter sharing, no coordinator), and only a partial and privately-noisy view of a public stream of teammates' outcomes. A hidden low-rank structure governs which robot suits which task, and there are far more tasks than rounds, so most (robot, task) pairs are never attempted. Yet each robot can act well on tasks it never attempted, and onboard new tasks, by running online low-rank collaborative filtering over the broadcast (SwarmCF). The advantage over any structure-free learner is categorical, not a constant factor: a structure-free learner is provably at the prior-mean error floor on unseen pairs. We prove a matching per-robot sample complexity (Θ(d) versus Θ(n), in the rank d and the task count n), an anytime (cumulative-reward) separation under task scarcity, and a deterministic condition under which decentralized recovery from the masked broadcast is exact (validated empirically). Experiments quantify the value of the broadcast, a positive scaling law (per-robot unseen-pair skill rises with team size), and the strongest masking-robustness and anytime profile among low-rank methods, recovering most (about 80% on earned skill) of a centralized full-communication ceiling, and holding under capacity-1 contention and in a robotics-grounded sensing instance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出零知识多机器人任务分配（ZK-MRTA）问题：机器人团队无先验知识、无通信、仅有部分且带私有噪声的队友结果公共流。通过在线低秩协同过滤（SwarmCF），即使对于从未尝试过的任务，每个机器人也能表现良好，并在结构上优于无结构学习器（Θ(d) vs Θ(n)的样本复杂度，d为秩，n为任务数）。实验验证了广播的价值、正向扩展律（团队规模增大提升未见任务技能）以及集中式全通信天花板约80%的恢复能力。
AI.motivation: 传统多机器人任务分配通常假设通信、已知任务模型或协调器存在，但实践中常面临相反场景：机器人团队无先验知识、无通信、仅有部分且带噪声的公开信息。这种常见但理论上被忽视的极端情况需要被研究。Zhu, 2025, ICML
AI.method: 提出SwarmCF算法，一种在线低秩协同过滤方法。机器人仅通过观察公共流中队友的部分且带私有噪声的结果，在无通信、无先验知识（包括未知隐秩）的条件下，利用低秩结构恢复未尝试的(机器人, 任务)对的技能值，从而实现对未见任务的良好表现。
AI.result: 严格证明了每个机器人的样本复杂度为Θ(d)（d为秩），而结构无关学习器需要Θ(n)（n为任务数）；证明了在任务稀缺条件下的逐时累积奖励分离；给出了从掩码广播中精确恢复的确定性条件。实验表明：SwarmCF具有最强的掩码鲁棒性和逐时性能，恢复约80%的集中式全通信天花板技能，在容量1竞争和机器人感知实例中仍保持有效。
AI.conclusion: ZK-MRTA是可行的：在无通信、无先验知识、仅有部分带噪声公共反馈的条件下，机器人可以通过在线低秩协同过滤有效学习未曾尝试的任务。该方法在样本复杂度上与结构无关方法有本质的（而非常数因子的）分离，且团队规模增大有利于个体表现，验证了信息共享（广播）的积极价值。

title: Balancing Fairness, Privacy, and Accuracy: A Multitask Adversarial Framework for Centralized Data-Driven Systems
summary: The integration of fairness and privacy in centralized data-driven applications is critical, especially as these systems increasingly influence sectors with significant societal impact. Current methods rarely address privacy, fairness, and accuracy together, which can potentially compromise ethical standards and privacy regulations. However, balancing these three objectives is quite challenging since each of objective often imposes conflicting requirements on the design and training of models, making it difficult to optimize one without compromising the others. This paper introduces a novel multitask adversarial model that treats fairness and privacy as integral objectives rather than afterthoughts, and learns a latent representation that hides sensitive attributes while preserving essential task-related information. Our approach dynamically balances fairness with accuracy and privacy through an optimized cost function with minimal performance loss even under strict conditions. Extensive testing on diverse datasets shows the ability of our model to achieve high standards of fairness and privacy without significant sacrifice to accuracy. Benchmarking against state-of-the-art privacy and fairness standards shows that our method enhances the robustness of privacy, fairness, and accuracy optimization, proving its adaptability across various datasets.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种多任务对抗模型，将公平性和隐私性作为核心目标与准确性共同优化，通过学习隐藏敏感属性的潜在表征，在严格条件下仍能保持高性能，实验证明该方法在不显著牺牲准确性的前提下实现了高标准的公平性和隐私保护。
AI.motivation: 现有的集中式数据驱动应用中，公平性和隐私性的整合至关重要，但当前方法很少同时考虑隐私、公平性和准确性三者，往往优化一个目标就会损害其他目标，导致伦理标准和隐私法规可能被违反。
AI.method: 提出一种新颖的多任务对抗模型，将公平性和隐私性作为核心目标而非事后考虑，通过学习隐藏敏感属性同时保留任务相关信息的潜在表征，并利用优化的成本函数动态平衡公平性、隐私性与准确性。
AI.result: 在多种数据集上的广泛测试表明，该方法能在不显著牺牲准确性的情况下实现高标准的公平性和隐私保护；与最先进方法对比，增强了隐私、公平和准确性优化的鲁棒性，证明了其在多种数据集上的适应性。
AI.conclusion: 该多任务对抗模型能够有效平衡公平性、隐私性和准确性三者之间相互冲突的目标，在严格条件下仍能保持最小性能损失，为集中式数据驱动应用提供了兼顾伦理与合规的可行方案。

title: Learnable Shape Prototypes with Occlusion-Geometry-Guided Injection for Amodal Instance Segmentation
comment: 13 pages, 7 figures, 5 tables. Submitted to IEEE Transactions on Circuits and Systems for Video Technology
summary: Amodal instance segmentation aims to predict the complete object mask including occluded regions that lack pixel-level observations and must be inferred with the aid of shape priors. Existing methods acquire shape priors through fixed-capacity encoding spaces or expensive generative models, and inject them uniformly across all spatial positions without adapting to the varying prior demand between visible and occluded regions. In this paper, we propose a gated reliability-adaptive shape prior framework, which introduces a shape prior memory module that combines learnable prototypes via cross-attention to produce instance-adaptive shape priors through weighted prototype combination rather than generation. A spatial adaptive reliability gate then employs the signed distance field of the visible mask to modulate injection intensity at each position according to its occlusion depth, preserving reliable features in visible regions while directing shape compensation toward occluded areas. Experiments on two mainstream amodal instance segmentation benchmarks demonstrate that the proposed method outperforms existing approaches under multiple evaluation settings, improving the mean intersection-over-union over occluded regions by over 11 percentage points on one of the two benchmarks under the standard setting, while using approximately one-third of the total parameters. Linear probing analysis further reveals that the visible-mask cross-attention module implicitly encodes occlusion geometry into visual token representations, explaining the effectiveness of the proposed module decomposition.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于门控可靠性自适应形状先验的共模实例分割框架，通过可学习原型交叉注意力生成实例自适应形状先验，并利用可见掩码的符号距离场调节不同区域（可见/遮挡）的先验注入强度，在两个主流基准上显著提升遮挡区域分割性能（mIoU提升超11个百分点），参数量仅为现有方法的约三分之一。
AI.motivation: 现有方法通过固定容量编码空间或昂贵生成模型获取形状先验，且在所有空间位置均匀注入先验，未能自适应可见区域与遮挡区域对先验需求的差异。
AI.method: 1) 形状先验记忆模块：通过可学习原型与交叉注意力生成实例自适应形状先验（加权原型组合而非生成）；2) 空间自适应可靠性门控：利用可见掩码的符号距离场，根据每个位置的遮挡深度调节先验注入强度，可见区域保留可靠特征，遮挡区域进行形状补偿。
AI.result: 在两个主流共模实例分割基准上，标准设置下遮挡区域mIoU提升超11个百分点，总参数量约为现有方法的1/3。线性探测分析表明可见掩码交叉注意力模块隐式编码了遮挡几何信息。
AI.conclusion: 所提门控可靠性自适应形状先验框架在显著减少参数量的同时，有效提升了遮挡区域的分割性能，验证了按空间位置差异化注入形状先验的有效性。

title: G-DRAGON: Geospatial Reasoning and Dynamic Planning for Retrieval-Augmented Outdoor Navigation
comment: Accepted by IEEE Robotics and Automation Letters (RA-L)
summary: Autonomous ground robots operating in large-scale outdoor environments require both robust long-range navigation and fine-grained ''last-mile'' exploration. Current advances in visual-language navigation (VLN) work well at short-range tasks, lacking geospatial grounding for long-distance missions. Some OpenStreetMap (OSM)-based methods relying on cloud-based Large Language Models (LLMs) are prone to factual hallucination and cannot conduct ''last-mile'' exploration based on human instruction. To address these challenges, we present G-DRAGON, a retrieval-augmented framework for outdoor, open-world navigation. This framework maps natural-language commands to versioned, local OSM entities via generative retrieval based on lightweight LLM, yielding accurate coordinates for global route planning. A high-level planning module bridges global topological routes with the SLAM system, projecting geospatial waypoints into the robot's navigable frame. For the ''last mile," the framework transitions to frontier-based exploration and open-set semantic voxel mapping to localize open-vocabulary targets. Experimental results in simulation demonstrate our framework outperforms state-of-the-art baselines. Furthermore, we validate the system in unseen real-world urban environments on an Unmanned Ground Vehicle (UGV), successfully completing person-search missions with trajectories of up to 500m.

AI.tldr: 提出G-DRAGON框架，通过检索增强生成将自然语言指令映射到本地OSM实体，结合全局路径规划、SLAM系统和最后里程的探索式语义建图，实现户外开放世界中的长距离导航与精细探索。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉语言导航方法缺乏地理空间基础，无法支持长距离任务；基于OSM和云LLM的方法存在事实幻觉，且无法根据人类指令进行“最后里程”探索。
AI.method: G-DRAGON框架包含：1) 基于轻量级LLM的生成式检索将自然语言指令映射到本地OSM实体；2) 高层规划模块将全局拓扑路线与SLAM系统桥接；3) 最后里程阶段采用前沿探索和开放集语义体素建图定位开放词汇目标。
AI.result: 仿真实验优于SOTA基线；在真实城市环境UGV上成功完成长达500米轨迹的人员搜索任务。
AI.conclusion: G-DRAGON有效结合了检索增强生成与导航建图技术，实现了户外长距离导航与细粒度探索的统一，在仿真和真实场景中均验证了有效性。

title: The Normalized Maximum Likelihood for Regular Non-Smooth Models: Measure-Theoretic Foundations and Geometric Sampling
summary: The Normalized Maximum Likelihood (NML) codelength, or stochastic complexity, represents a principled criterion for universal coding. While recent coarea-based formulations provided a calculation method for smooth models, this framework collapses for the non-smooth estimators ubiquitous in modern machine learning (e.g., Lasso, Sparse SVMs). In this work, we provide a rigorous framework for computing the NML for regular path-differentiable Lipschitz (PDL) estimators. By applying classical geometric measure theory and bridging the coarea formula with conservative Jacobians, we prove that the stochastic complexity for non-smooth models is well-posed and theoretically consistent with the outputs of modern Automatic Differentiation. To compute this quantity exactly, we introduce the Propose-and-Project Metropolis-Hastings (PDL-PPMH) sampler, a geometric MCMC algorithm capable of traversing the non-differentiable level sets of the maximum likelihood estimator. We theoretically justify its components, including a stochastic tangent space proposal and a provably convergent non-smooth projection solver. We demonstrate the method's robustness by sampling from a high-dimensional Lasso posterior ($P=2000$), while simultaneously quantifying the computational scaling that governs the trade-off between exactness and mixing time. Crucially, we empirically demonstrate that our exact NML criterion provides a highly data-efficient alternative to cross-validation, achieving statistically indistinguishable predictive optima without requiring data splitting. Altogether, our work paves the way for the theoretical analysis of the NML codelength for regular non-smooth models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了针对非光滑PDL估计量的归一化最大似然（NML）编码长度的严格计算框架，通过几何测度论与保守雅可比矩阵结合，解决了非光滑模型下随机复杂度的计算问题，并设计了PDL-PPMH采样器实现高效采样。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于余面积公式的NML计算方法仅适用于光滑模型，无法处理现代机器学习中广泛使用的非光滑估计量（如Lasso、稀疏SVM），亟需建立针对非光滑模型的严格理论框架与计算方法。
AI.method: (1) 应用经典几何测度论，将余面积公式与保守雅可比矩阵相结合，证明非光滑PDL估计量的随机复杂度良定义且与自动微分输出一致；(2) 提出PDL-PPMH采样器，包含随机切空间提议和非光滑投影求解器，用于遍历MLE的非可微水平集；(3) 在理论上证明各组成部分的收敛性。
AI.result: (1) 成功在高维Lasso后验（P=2000）上实现采样；(2) 量化了精确性与混合时间之间的计算权衡；(3) 经验表明精确NML准则可作为交叉验证的高数据效率替代方案，在无需数据划分的情况下达到统计不可区分的预测最优值。
AI.conclusion: 本文为非光滑正则模型NML编码长度的理论分析铺平了道路，验证了所提方法的鲁棒性，并为非光滑模型下的通用编码提供了理论支撑。

title: IQA-Spider: Unifying Multi-Granularity Image Quality Assessment with Reasoning, Grounding and Referring
summary: We present IQA-Spider, the first image quality assessment (IQA) framework that unifies reasoning, grounding, and referring into a single LMM-based framework for multi-granularity quality understanding. Existing LMM-based IQA methods typically support only partial perception dimensions, such as quality description and question answering~(\textit{i.e.}, reasoning) or pixel-level grounding. This limitation largely stems from the absence of (i) a unified task and data formulation and (ii) effective optimization paradigms for multi-granularity learning. To address these limitations, we formulate a rigorous four-task paradigm covering global and local quality description, pixel-level grounding, and region-level referring. Based on this formulation, we construct a corresponding IQA dataset with a scalable and automatic annotation pipeline, thereby providing a solid foundation for unified multi-granularity learning. To further enable unified perception, we adopt a conflict-free two-stage design that progressively extends text-level multi-granularity understanding to pixel-level grounding: (i) the first stage equips the model with fine-grained text-level reasoning across multiple IQA tasks, and (ii) the second stage introduces a training-free text-to-point grounding paradigm, which bridges textual semantics and pixel-level perception by mapping token logits to spatial coordinates. Based on these efforts, we achieve IQA-Spider with unified multi-granularity explainable image quality assessment. Extensive experiments across multiple benchmarks demonstrate strong performance, validating the effectiveness and versatility of the proposed formulation and framework.

AI.tldr: IQA-Spider是首个将推理、定位和指代统一到单一LMM框架中的图像质量评估方法，通过四任务范式（全局/局部质量描述、像素级定位、区域级指代）和两阶段训练策略（先文本级多粒度理解，后无训练文本到点定位），实现了多粒度可解释的图像质量评估。
AI.motivation: 现有基于LMM的IQA方法仅支持部分感知维度（如仅质量描述与问答，或仅像素级定位），缺乏统一的（i）任务和数据形式化定义以及（ii）有效的多粒度学习优化范式。
AI.method: (1) 设计了涵盖全局/局部质量描述、像素级定位、区域级指代的四任务范式；(2) 构建了可扩展自动标注管线的IQA数据集；(3) 采用无冲突的两阶段设计：第一阶段让模型具备细粒度文本级多任务推理能力，第二阶段引入无训练的文本到点定位范式，通过将token logits映射到空间坐标来桥接文本语义与像素级感知。
AI.result: 在多个基准测试上的大量实验证明了该方法的强性能和有效性，验证了所提出的形式化定义和框架的多功能性与有效性。
AI.conclusion: IQA-Spider成功实现了统一的多粒度可解释图像质量评估，弥补了现有方法在感知维度上的局限性。

title: Compliant Non-Prehensile Pushing Manipulation
summary: In this paper, we address the challenge of performing non-prehensile pushing operations with a compliant robotic manipulation system. To ensure safe operations in human-populated environments, robots must comply with external physical interactions and exhibit passive behavior. To achieve this, we extend a state-of-the-art pushing model to integrate it with impedance-controlled robots.
