AI.conclusion: CEDGE通过能量引导实现目标域适配而无需重新训练扩散模型，相比先前方法能高效适应新目标动力学，为离动态离线强化学习提供了一种有效的轨迹级生成方案。

title: LAPLEX: The FFT of Learnable Laplace Kernels
summary:
Fast linear algebra in deep learning usually comes with a choice: fixed geometry and exact computation, as in the Fourier transform, or adaptive geometry paid for by dense parameters, random features, or low-rank surrogates. To move beyond this trade-off, we introduce LAPLEX, a class of exact, trainable (phased) Laplace-kernel operators.
  A LAPLEX layer is a typically full-rank dense matrix, implicitly defined by learnable coordinate anchors, with FFT-like scaling. Consequently, it supports trainable matrix--vector operations at vector dimensions up to $10^9$ on modern GPUs. As a neural layer, it yields compact projections and classification heads interpretable as soft, trainable routing models. The same primitive also serves as an efficient Gram operator, enabling high-dimensional covariance models on flattened images of dimension $3 \cdot 10^6$ that preserve visible spatial structure without imposing convolutional bias. These applications reflect a single principle: dense geometry can be learned without storing a dense matrix, which enables data-adaptive global interactions in regimes where ordinary dense layers are out of reach. In this sense, LAPLEX separates expressivity from storage cost: it behaves like a dense trainable matrix, but is represented and applied through a small structured set of parameters.

AI.tldr: LAPLEX 是一类精确、可训练的（分阶段）拉普拉斯核算子，它打破了深度学习中固定几何与精确计算（如傅里叶变换）同自适应几何但需密集参数之间的权衡，通过隐式定义的、可学习的坐标锚点实现类似 FFT 缩放的全秩稠密矩阵运算，支持高达 10^9 维度的向量操作，并能作为紧凑投影、分类头和高维协方差模型使用，其核心思想是在不存储稠密矩阵的情况下学习稠密几何，从而将表达性与存储成本分离。
AI.motivation: 深度学习中快速线性代数通常需要在固定几何与精确计算（如FFT）或自适应几何但需密集参数/随机特征/低秩近似之间做出选择。作者希望打破这种权衡，实现既精确可训练又具有高效缩放特性的自适应全局交互算子。
AI.method: 提出LAPLEX层，基于可学习的坐标锚点隐式定义全秩稠密矩阵，利用（分阶段）拉普拉斯核算子实现类似FFT的O(n log n)缩放。该矩阵无需显式存储，通过小规模结构化参数集表示和应用。
AI.result: 支持在现代GPU上处理高达10^9维度的可训练矩阵-向量运算；实现维度为3×10^6的扁平图像上的高维协方差模型，保留空间结构且无需卷积偏置；生成可解释为软路由模型的紧凑投影和分类头。
AI.conclusion: LAPLEX实现了表达性与存储成本的分离，使稠密可训练矩阵的行为得以通过小规模结构化参数表示，从而在普通稠密层无法企及的规模上实现数据自适应的全局交互。

title: Grow-Prune-Freeze Networks: Adaptive & Continual Learning Technique for Olfactory Navigation
summary: Training data for olfaction is scattered through disparate, non-standardized datasets that limit the ability to build representative world models. Olfactory navigation is a highly dynamic and non-stationary task that benefits from real-time continual learning. We introduce an adaptive framework called Grow-Prune-Freeze (GPF) networks that enable an agent to continually learn through growing, pruning, and freezing early layers of its policy in response to world complexity. Grounding GPFs in non-linear random matrix theory, we show that the work of Pennington & Worth (2017) can be extended from single hidden layers to n-layer continual-learning models, and that eigenvalue composition of network weights is preserved as successive layers are added. We show that GPFs based on Expected SARSA achieve a 94% success rate on turbulent plume navigation - a partially observable, non-stationary task representative of the "big world" challenges that motivate adaptive learning in robotics - and provide supporting methodology for applying GPFs in other world models. Further experiments amount evidence that GPFs may generalize well to other machine learning tasks such as reinforcement learning in Atari, image classification, and autoregressive language models. We open source all code and data to encourage improvements on and more research in olfactory robotics.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Grow-Prune-Freeze (GPF) 网络，一种基于非线性随机矩阵理论的自适应持续学习框架，使智能体能够通过动态增长、剪枝和冻结策略层来应对复杂世界。在湍流羽流导航任务中实现94%成功率，并展示了对Atari强化学习、图像分类和自回归语言模型的良好泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 嗅觉训练数据分散在非标准化数据集中，限制了构建代表性世界模型的能力。嗅觉导航是高度动态的非平稳任务，需要实时持续学习，现有方法难以适应这种"大世界"挑战。
AI.method: 提出GPF网络框架，通过动态增长、剪枝和冻结策略的早期层来适应世界复杂性；将Pennington & Worth (2017)的单隐层非线性随机矩阵理论扩展到n层持续学习模型；基于Expected SARSA实现策略学习。
AI.result: 在湍流羽流导航任务中达到94%成功率；验证了网络权重特征值组成在逐层添加时保持一致性；在Atari强化学习、图像分类和自回归语言模型上展现泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: GPF框架有效解决了非平稳动态环境下的持续学习问题，为嗅觉机器人及其他领域的自适应学习提供了方法论支持，并开源代码和数据以推动研究。

title: Beyond Fixed Points: Superpolynomial Capacity of Asymmetric Hopfield Networks
summary: Classical Hopfield networks are limited to static patterns due to symmetric weights, whereas asymmetric networks can encode temporal sequences via limit-cycle attractors. Achieving high-capacity storage of long sequences in classical synchronous asymmetric networks, however, has remained a challenge. We present a simple and robust construction within the classical asymmetric Hopfield model with binary neurons and synchronous updates, that allows $n$ neurons to support $\exp\!\big(Ω(n/(\log n)^2)\big)$ distinct limit-cycle attractors, each with period $\exp\!\big(Ω(\sqrt n/\log n)\big)$ and robust to random noise with flip probability up to $\frac12-o(1)$, yielding superpolynomial capacity in both the number and length of stored sequences. This is the first demonstration of such capacity for asymmetric Hopfield networks, which we obtain by combining results from combinatorics, number theory and the analysis of opinion dynamics. Our findings show that synchronous asymmetric Hopfield networks possess a sequence-memory capacity which is larger and more robust than previously recognized, demonstrating that, in both biological and artificial neural systems, robust sequence representation can be achieved through coarse architectural motifs rather than complex nonlinearities.

AI.tldr: 本文在经典二元同步非对称Hopfield网络中，通过组合数学、数论和观点动力学分析，首次实现了超多项式容量的极限环吸引子存储：n个神经元可支持约exp(Ω(n/(log n)²))个不同的极限环，每个周期长达exp(Ω(√n/log n))，且对翻转概率高达1/2 - o(1)的随机噪声具有鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 经典Hopfield网络因对称权重只能存储静态模式，而非对称网络虽能编码时序序列（极限环吸引子），但如何在经典同步非对称网络中实现高容量长序列存储一直是一个挑战。
AI.method: 在二元神经元、同步更新的经典非对称Hopfield模型框架内，结合组合数学、数论和观点动力学分析，提出了一种简单且鲁棒的构造方法。
AI.result: n个神经元可支持exp(Ω(n/(log n)²))个不同的极限环吸引子，每个周期长度为exp(Ω(√n/log n))，且对翻转概率高达1/2 - o(1)的随机噪声具有鲁棒性——在序列数量和序列长度两个维度上均达到超多项式容量。
AI.conclusion: 同步非对称Hopfield网络具有比先前认知更大且更鲁棒的序列记忆容量，表明在生物和人工神经系统中，鲁棒的序列表征可以通过粗略的结构基序而非复杂的非线性机制实现。

title: Reasoning to Align: Implicit Reasoning in Diffusion Transformers for Video Editing
summary: Instruction-based video editing requires transforming a source video according to a natural-language instruction while preserving irrelevant content and remaining temporally coherent. We argue that existing Diffusion Transformer (DiT) editors struggle with this task for two structural reasons. First, conditioning signals are fed undifferentiated into all transformer blocks, forcing a single token stream to encode both global editing intent and fine-grained visual evidence. Second, the cross-attention patterns that govern the edit are supervised only indirectly through pixel-level reconstruction, leaving the model's internal reasoning process under-constrained. To address both limitations, we propose RVEDiT, an implicit Reasoning Video Editing DiT framework built around two complementary components. The first, Granularity-Routed Token Conditioning, introduces learnable editing tokens distilled from a multimodal LLM and routes them to shallow blocks, while reserving native visual and textual tokens for deeper blocks, thereby inducing a coarse-to-fine editing process inside the backbone. The second, Reference-Anchored Attention Alignment, employs a parameter-sharing reference branch during training and maximizes the mutual information between the attention features of the editing and reference branches, regularizing the model's internal reasoning without incurring any additional inference cost. Experiments on standard instruction-based video editing benchmarks show that RVEDiT consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, with particularly strong gains on localized and compositional edits.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RVEDiT框架，通过粒度路由令牌条件和参考锚定注意力对齐两个组件，解决了基于指令的视频编辑中扩散Transformer（DiT）存在的条件信号无差别输入和交叉注意力监督不足的结构性缺陷，在标准化基准上实现了最优性能。
AI.motivation: 现有DiT编辑器在基于指令的视频编辑中存在两个结构性缺陷：一是条件信号无差别地输入所有Transformer块，导致单一令牌流需同时编码全局编辑意图和细粒度视觉证据；二是控制编辑的交叉注意力模式仅通过像素级重建间接监督，模型内部推理过程约束不足。
AI.method: 提出RVEDiT框架，包含两个核心组件：1) 粒度路由令牌条件（Granularity-Routed Token Conditioning），从多模态大语言模型提炼可学习编辑令牌并将其路由至浅层块，保留原生视觉和文本令牌给深层块，在骨干网络内诱导出由粗到细的编辑过程；2) 参考锚定注意力对齐（Reference-Anchored Attention Alignment），训练时使用参数共享的参考分支，最大化编辑分支与参考分支注意力特征间的互信息，在不增加推理成本的前提下正则化模型内部推理。
AI.result: 在标准基于指令的视频编辑基准上，RVEDiT一致性地优于现有最先进基线方法，在局部编辑和组合编辑任务上优势尤为显著。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式解耦编辑意图与视觉证据的编码路径，并利用参考分支对注意力模式进行正则化，有效解决了现有DiT编辑器的结构缺陷，在保持时间一致性的同时实现了更精确的指令对齐。

title: Multi-view Consistent 3D Gaussian Head Avatars 'without' Multi-view Generation
summary: High-fidelity 3D Gaussian head avatar generation is critical for applications such as AR/VR, telepresence, and digital humans. Existing methods depend on multi-view datasets, 3D captures, or intermediate 2D view synthesis. In contrast, we learn both conditional and unconditional 3D head models from randomly sampled 2D images alone, without using multi-view data, 3D supervision, or intermediate view generation. We introduce MVCHead, a single-shot state space model that enforces multi-view consistency (MVC) directly in the 3D representation while regressing 3D Gaussians under these constraints. At its core, we propose a Hierarchical State Space (HiSS) block that progressively refines Gaussians from coarse to fine, while capturing long-range dependencies. Within each HiSS block, we modify Mamba's standard unidirectional scan with the proposed Hierarchical Bi-directional State Scan (HiBiSS) that aligns recurrence with the axes along which multi-view inconsistencies are strongest. Finally, we design an SE(3) Multi-view Critic that judges whether a set of self-renders arises from a single underlying 3D configuration, rewarding cross-view pixel alignment without observing real multi-view pairs. MVCHead achieves state-of-the-art perceptual quality, surpasses prior methods in both texture and geometric consistency, and maintains comparable shape consistency. To demonstrate scalability, we release FaceGS-10K, the first large-scale dataset of ready-to-use 3D Gaussian head assets for training and evaluation of 3D head models. Project Page and code: https://humansensinglab.github.io/MVCHead/

AI.tldr: 本文提出MVCHead，一种仅从随机采样的2D单张图像学习3D高斯头部模型的方法，无需多视图数据、3D监督或中间视图生成。通过层次化状态空间（HiSS）块逐步细化高斯体，并设计SE(3)多视图判别器确保跨视图一致性，在感知质量、纹理和几何一致性上达到SOTA。同时发布首个大规模3D高斯头部数据集FaceGS-10K。
AI.motivation: 现有高保真3D高斯头部生成依赖于多视图数据集、3D捕获或中间2D视图合成，这些数据获取成本高、难以规模化。本文旨在从随机采样的2D单张图像直接学习3D头部模型，降低数据依赖，提升3D头部生成的实用性和可扩展性。
AI.method: 提出MVCHead框架：1）核心为层次化状态空间（HiSS）块，从粗到细逐步细化3D高斯体，同时捕获长程依赖；2）在每个HiSS块中设计层次化双向状态扫描（HiBiSS），沿多视图不一致性最强的轴对齐循环扫描；3）设计SE(3)多视图判别器，判断自渲染视图是否来自同一底层3D配置，无需真实多视图配对。
AI.result: MVCHead在感知质量上达到SOTA，在纹理和几何一致性上超越先前方法，形状一致性相当。同时构建并发布了首个大规模3D高斯头部数据集FaceGS-10K。
AI.conclusion: 本文证明了仅从2D单张图像学习3D高斯头部模型的可行性，通过层次化状态空间建模和隐式多视图一致性约束，实现了高质量3D头部生成，为无多视图监督的3D生成提供了新范式。

title: Beyond Generative Priors: Minority Sampling with JEPA-Guided Diffusion
summary: Minority sampling aims to generate low-density instances on a data manifold and is of central importance in applications such as medical diagnosis, anomaly detection, and creative AI. Existing approaches, however, define minority samples relative to generative priors learned from training data, confining rarity to model-specific notions that may poorly reflect real-world semantics. In this work, we propose a world-centric perspective on minority sampling, which defines rarity with respect to real-world priors rather than generator-induced densities. To this end, we introduce JEPA guidance, a diffusion sampling framework guided by a Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture (JEPA) -- a class of world models that encode broad, semantically rich representations. JEPA guidance steers diffusion trajectories toward low-density regions under the implicit density induced by the JEPA, thereby aligning generated minorities with real-world semantic rarity. To make JEPA guidance computationally practical, we develop principled approximation strategies accompanied by theoretical error bounds, significantly reducing the overhead of guidance computation. Extensive experiments across unconditional, class-conditional, and text-to-image generation demonstrate that JEPA guidance consistently improves the fidelity and semantic validity of minority samples, outperforming generator-centric baselines in capturing real-world notions of rarity. Code is available at https://github.com/soobin-um/jepa-guidance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种以世界为中心的少数采样方法（JEPA guidance），利用联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）引导扩散模型生成真实世界中语义稀有的样本，而非依赖生成模型自身的密度先验，并通过理论保证的近似策略降低计算开销，实验表明该方法在保真度和语义有效性上优于现有基线。
AI.motivation: 现有少数采样方法依赖生成模型从训练数据中学习到的先验来定义稀有性，导致"稀有"的概念受限于模型自身的密度估计，可能无法反映真实世界中的语义稀有性。
AI.method: 提出JEPA guidance框架，利用JEPA世界模型编码的丰富语义表征，在扩散采样过程中引导轨迹走向JEPA隐式密度下的低密度区域；同时设计了带有理论误差界的高效近似策略以降低计算开销。
AI.result: 在无条件、类别条件和文生图三种设定下，JEPA guidance在生成少数样本的保真度和语义有效性上均一致优于基于生成模型先验的基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 以世界模型而非生成模型为指导的少数采样能更有效地捕捉真实世界中的语义稀有性，JEPA guidance为此提供了一个实用且理论基础扎实的实现方案。

title: VaaWIT: Visual-Aware Adaptation of Large Language Models for Multilingual Web Image Translation
summary: Translating text embedded in Web images is crucial for improving content accessibility and cross-lingual information retrieval, particularly within social media and e-commerce domains. Although Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) have advanced multimodal understanding, applying them to Web image translation remains challenging due to the visual representation gap: standard encoders often prioritize high-level semantics over the fine-grained visual details required for recognizing diverse character morphologies. To address this challenge, we propose VaaWIT, an end-to-end framework that adapts Large Language Models for multilingual Web image translation. The framework introduces two key technical contributions: (1) a Dual-Stream Attention Module (DSAM), which facilitates bidirectional interaction between multilingual semantic features and detailed visual representations, thereby synthesizing unified features robust to textual variations; and (2) a Visual-Aware Adapter (VAA), a parameter-efficient fine-tuning strategy that dynamically injects these fused visual cues into the frozen LLM backbone. This design enables the model to align the visual context with linguistic reasoning effectively while minimizing computational costs. Extensive experiments on eight tasks on three public benchmarks demonstrate that VaaWIT significantly outperforms state-of-the-art (SOTA) open-source baselines and achieves competitive performance against proprietary models. These results validate the efficacy of integrating fine-grained visual perception into LLMs for complex Web content analysis.

AI.tldr: 本文提出VaaWIT框架，通过双流注意力模块（DSAM）和视觉感知适配器（VAA）解决网络图像翻译中的视觉表征鸿沟问题，在三个公开基准的八项任务上显著优于现有开源方法，性能接近闭源模型。
AI.motivation: 网络图像中的文本翻译对提升内容可访问性和跨语言信息检索至关重要，但现有大型视觉语言模型（LVLMs）在图像编码时偏向高层语义，忽略了识别多样字符形态所需的细粒度视觉细节，导致视觉表征鸿沟问题。
AI.method: 提出端到端VaaWIT框架，包含两个关键技术：(1) 双流注意力模块（DSAM），实现多语言语义特征与细粒度视觉表征的双向交互，融合出对文本变化鲁棒的统一特征；(2) 视觉感知适配器（VAA），一种参数高效微调策略，将融合后的视觉线索动态注入冻结的LLM骨干网络，实现视觉上下文与语言推理的有效对齐。
AI.result: 在三个公开基准的八项任务上，VaaWIT显著超越最先进的开源基线方法，并在性能上与闭源模型具有竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 验证了将细粒度视觉感知融入LLM以处理复杂Web内容分析的有效性。

title: Neuromorphic LiDAR-based Bird's Eye View Object Detection using Energy-efficient Spiking Neural Networks
summary: Autonomous driving perception demands accurate and efficient processing of three-dimensional sensor data under strict power constraints. Traditional convolutional neural networks achieve strong detection accuracy but are computationally intensive, limiting their suitability for deployment on resource-constrained neuromorphic platforms. Spiking neural networks offer a compelling alternative through event-driven sparse computation, yet their application to complex real-world perception tasks such as three-dimensional object detection remains limited. In this work, we propose an end-to-end spiking encoder-decoder network for object detection in bird's eye view representations of LiDAR point clouds, trained using surrogate gradient backpropagation. We train two variants: a membrane potential variant that reads continuous neuron state at the output stage for maximum accuracy, achieving $92.05$/$87.04$/$86.51$ AP at $\mathrm{IoU}\!=\!0.5$ (Easy/Moderate/Hard), and, a fully binary spiking variant that operates exclusively on spike trains at every layer for direct neuromorphic deployment. We evaluate four input spike encoding strategies and demonstrate that allowing the network to learn spike representations directly from data outperforms hand-crafted Poisson, latency, and z-axis encoding schemes on the KITTI benchmark, where sequential frames are unavailable and the BEV input is presented repeatedly across timesteps as a proxy for temporal streaming. A block-wise energy analysis demonstrates a $3.33\times$ reduction in synaptic operation energy over an equivalent CNN under conservative loop-based operation. Together, these results demonstrate the viability of spiking neural networks for accurate and energy-efficient neuromorphic perception in autonomous driving.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种端到端的脉冲编码-解码网络，用于激光雷达点云鸟瞰图中的三维目标检测。该网络可在最大精度变体（膜电位读出，KITTI上Easy/Moderate/Hard AP达92.05/87.04/86.51）与全脉冲变体（适合神经形态部署）间切换。通过让网络直接从数据学习脉冲表征，优于手工编码方案。块级能耗分析显示，相较于等效CNN，突触操作能耗降低3.33倍，验证了脉冲神经网络在自动驾驶感知中的可行性与能效优势。
AI.motivation: 传统CNN在三维目标检测中精度高但计算密集，难以部署在资源受限的神经形态平台上。脉冲神经网络虽具备事件驱动的稀疏计算优势，但其在复杂三维感知任务（如三维目标检测）中的应用仍十分有限。
AI.method: 提出端到端的脉冲编码-解码网络，基于替代梯度反向传播训练。设计了两种变体：膜电位变体（输出阶段读取连续神经元状态）和全二进制脉冲变体（各层仅使用脉冲序列）。评估了四种输入脉冲编码策略，并采用重复呈现BEV输入模拟时间流的方式处理无连续帧场景。
AI.result: 膜电位变体在KITTI数据集上达到Easy/Moderate/Hard AP分别为92.05/87.04/86.51（IoU=0.5）。数据驱动的学习式脉冲编码优于手工设计的泊松、延迟和z轴编码。块级能耗分析显示相较等效CNN突触操作能耗降低3.33倍。
AI.conclusion: 脉冲神经网络在自动驾驶三维目标检测中既能保持较高精度，又能显著降低能耗，证明了其在神经形态感知中的可行性，为资源受限场景下的自动驾驶感知提供了新方案。

title: On the Stability and Realizability of Recurrent Polynomial Surrogate Ternary Logic Gate Networks
comment: 9 pages, 3 figures. This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication
summary: Recurrent Neural Networks (RNNs) can learn to predict Signal Temporal Logic (STL) verdicts online from partial trajectories, but deploying them as runtime monitors in safety-critical systems demands more than predictive accuracy. Standard RNN architectures offer no structural guarantee that outputs degrade gracefully under sensor degradation; a dropped input can silently flip a verdict from safe to unsafe. We introduce the Recurrent Differentiable Ternary Logic Gate Network (R-DTLGN), a recurrent architecture that operates over Kleene's three-valued logic $\{-1, 0, +1\}$, where $0$ explicitly represents unknown. The R-DTLGN trains through continuous polynomial surrogates and hardens to a discrete ternary logic circuit at inference. We analyze the hardened circuit through two gate vocabularies derived from two orderings on the ternary domain: numerically monotone gates ensure stable recurrent dynamics, while information-monotone gates, when present, guarantee principled abstention (unknown inputs never produce wrong outputs) and monotonicity in input certainty (more information can only improve the verdict). We show that the recurrent connections required by bounded STL operators use exclusively AND and OR, which belong to both vocabularies, linking the monitoring task to the architecture's guarantees. A realizability bound derived from the STL formula's temporal operators directly sizes the network's hidden state, replacing hyperparameter search with a formula-driven specification. We evaluate on STL specifications over D4RL PointMaze navigation data, testing prediction accuracy, degradation under predicate dropout, and the accuracy-versus-safety tradeoff between two label construction pipelines. The R-DTLGN is, to our knowledge, the first recurrent architecture that couples learned temporal prediction with formal degradation guarantees rooted in three-valued logic.

AI.tldr: 本文提出R-DTLGN，一种基于Kleene三值逻辑的循环神经网络架构，能够在信号时序逻辑（STL）监控中提供形式化的退化保证——输入丢失时输出会优雅地退化为“未知”（0），而非静默翻转结论。该架构通过连续多项式代理训练，推理时硬化为离散三值逻辑电路，并利用两种门词汇表（数值单调和信息单调）分别保证循环动态稳定性和输入确定性单调性。网络隐藏层大小由STL公式的时序算子直接确定，无需超参数搜索。在D4RL PointMaze导航数据上的实验验证了预测精度、退化下的表现以及精度-安全性权衡。
AI.motivation: 标准RNN在安全关键系统中作为运行时监控器时，缺乏结构化的退化保证：传感器退化或输入丢失可能导致预测结果从安全静默翻转为不安全，而现有架构无法确保输出的优雅降级。本文旨在设计一种既能进行在线时序预测、又能提供形式化退化保证的循环架构。
AI.method: 1) 采用Kleene三值逻辑{-1, 0, +1}，其中0显式表示未知；2) 训练时使用连续多项式代理函数，推理时硬化为离散三值逻辑电路；3) 定义数值单调门（保证循环动态稳定）和信息单调门（保证输入确定性单调性与正确弃权）；4) 证明STL有界时序算子所需循环连接仅包含AND/OR门（属于两种门词汇表）；5) 根据STL公式的时序算子推导网络隐藏层大小的可实现性界。
AI.result: 在D4RL PointMaze导航数据的STL规范上，R-DTLGN在预测精度、谓词丢失下的退化行为以及精度-安全性权衡方面均得到了评估，验证了其耦合学习预测与三值逻辑形式化保证的有效性。
AI.conclusion: R-DTLGN是首个将学习型时序预测与基于三值逻辑的形式化退化保证相结合的循环架构，为解决安全关键系统中RNN监控器的可靠性问题提供了新范式。

title: MindAdapter: Few-Shot Parameter-Efficient Residual Calibration of Cross-Subject Brain-to-Visual Decoding Models
comment: Accepted to KDD 2026 (AI4Sciences Track). 15 pages, 7 figures
summary: Cross-subject brain-to-visual decoding remains a core challenge in brain-computer interfaces due to severe inter-individual variability that induces systematic subject-specific functional misalignment. To address this issue, we propose MindAdapter, a parameter-efficient few-shot calibration framework for pretrained brain-to-visual decoding models. MindAdapter adopts a decoupled linear-residual cascade alignment paradigm by freezing a pretrained explicit brain functional alignment backbone (coarse) and introducing a lightweight nonlinear residual adapter (fine), thereby disentangling global cross-subject correspondence from subject-specific residual corrections for fine-grained spatial and semantic calibration. To further preserve global representational stability, we design a topology-anchored dual-stream manifold constraint, where a small set of shared stimuli serves as topological pins with voxel-level paired supervision, while a semantic stream enforces consistency through a frozen vision-language decoder on unpaired brain data. Together, MindAdapter efficiently injects subject-specific corrections while maintaining the global representational geometry learned during pretraining. Experiments on the Natural Scenes Dataset (NSD) demonstrate that MindAdapter substantially improves cross-subject visual reconstruction and retrieval accuracy using only a few shared stimuli, offering a practical and data-efficient solution for personalized brain-to-visual decoding.

AI.tldr: MindAdapter提出了一种参数高效的小样本校准框架，通过解耦的线性-残差级联对齐范式（冻结粗粒度跨被试功能对齐骨干+轻量非线性残差适配器）和拓扑锚定双流流形约束，在仅需少量共享刺激的条件下显著提升跨被试脑到视觉的解码性能。
AI.motivation: 跨被试脑到视觉解码因个体间功能对齐差异严重而面临挑战，现有预训练模型难以直接泛化到新被试，需要高效、数据量小的个性化校准方法。
AI.method: 采用解耦线性-残差级联对齐：冻结预训练的显式脑功能对齐骨干（粗粒度），引入轻量非线性残差适配器（细粒度）；设计拓扑锚定双流流形约束，用少量共享刺激作为拓扑锚点提供体素级配对监督，同时通过冻结视觉-语言解码器在未配对脑数据上保持语义一致性。
AI.result: 在Natural Scenes Dataset (NSD)上的实验表明，MindAdapter仅需少量共享刺激即可显著提升跨被试视觉重建和检索的准确性。
AI.conclusion: MindAdapter提供了一种实用且数据高效的个性化脑到视觉解码方案，通过解耦全局跨被试对应关系与个体残差校正，有效解决了跨被试泛化问题。

title: UWM-JEPA: Predictive World Models That Imagine in Belief Space
comment: 14 pages, 6 figures, 7 tables. Code and data: https://github.com/santoshkumarradha/uwm-jepa
summary:
World models for partially observed environments must imagine multiple compatible hidden futures and steer between them under counterfactual actions. Joint Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPAs) do this in latent space, but a vector-valued latent has no internal structure for carrying the belief over hidden continuations through blind rollout. We introduce the Unitary World Model JEPA (UWM-JEPA), a JEPA world model with a density-matrix latent on a joint system-environment space and a learned unitary predictor. The construction preserves the joint-state spectrum exactly during rollout, so the predictor itself cannot dissipate the represented uncertainty.
  On a hidden-velocity indicator task requiring five-step forward simulation under a given action sequence with the target observation masked, UWM-JEPA reaches 0.77 accuracy and degrades monotonically as actions are perturbed; a parameter-matched LSTM-JEPA trained under the same counterfactual-target objective and action head collapses to majority-class accuracy (0.53) under every action condition. Under blind rollout, UWM-JEPA loses fewer than ten points of probe R^2 at short horizons while vector-latent baselines lose forty-one and sixty-eight; both nevertheless tie on a held-out context probe, locating the separation in the predictor rather than the encoder. Action sensitivity itself requires training against counterfactual rather than teacher-forced targets, a finding that applies beyond the unitary parameterisation. For JEPA world models to imagine under partial observability, latent geometry and predictor dynamics matter, not frozen context-encoding capacity alone.

AI.tldr: 提出UWM-JEPA，使用密度矩阵潜变量和酉预测器来保持部分可观测环境中的联合状态谱，在盲推演中优于向量潜变量基线（LSTM-JEPA），性能损失小且对动作敏感。
AI.motivation: 标准JEPA使用向量值潜变量，缺乏内部结构来承载盲推演过程中隐藏连续性的信念，导致不确定性在推演中消散。
AI.method: 引入密度矩阵潜变量（作用于联合系统-环境空间）和可学习的酉预测器，在推演中精确保持联合状态谱；训练使用反事实而非教师强制目标。
AI.result: 在隐藏速度指标任务上，UWM-JEPA达到0.77准确率（LSTM-JEPA仅0.53）；盲推演中UWM-JEPA探针R²损失<10个点，向量基线损失41和68个点；动作敏感性依赖于反事实训练目标。
AI.conclusion: 对于部分可观测环境中的JEPA世界模型，潜变量的几何结构和预测器动态至关重要，仅靠编码器容量是不够的。

title: WLNO: Wavelet-Laplace Neural Operator for Solving Partial Differential Equations
summary: This work introduces the Wavelet-Laplace Neural Operator (WLNO), a novel neural operator that fuses Haar wavelet multi-scale spatial decomposition with the Laplace-domain pole-residue formulation of the Laplace Neural Operator (LNO). While LNO captures transient and steady-state dynamics through learnable system poles and residues, it lacks an explicit mechanism for extracting spatially localized multi-scale features inherent in complex PDE solutions. WLNO addresses this by augmenting the LNO core with a parallel single-level Haar discrete wavelet transform (DWT) branch that decomposes the lifted feature map into four frequency subbands: approximation (LL), horizontal detail (LH), vertical detail (HL), and diagonal detail (HH) and applies independent learned $1\times1$ convolutions to each subband before reconstruction via the inverse DWT. The two branches are fused through a learnable sigmoid-gated weight $α_\mathrm{wav}$, initialized to give a small initial contribution to the wavelet branch, allowing the model to adaptively balance Laplace-domain dynamics against spatial multi-scale features throughout training. WLNO is evaluated against LNO on five benchmark PDE problems using identical hyperparameters, training data, and evaluation protocols: the diffusion equation, the Burgers equation, the reaction-diffusion system, Darcy flow, and the two-dimensional Navier-Stokes equation. WLNO consistently outperforms LNO on all five problems, with the most pronounced improvement on problems with strong spatial multi-scale structure, such as the Burgers equation with sharp shock fronts and the Navier-Stokes equation with coherent vortical structures, while remaining consistent across smoother and elliptic problems. These results demonstrate that wavelet-based multi-scale spatial decomposition is a principled and effective complement to Laplace-domain operator learning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Wavelet-Laplace Neural Operator (WLNO)，通过融合Haar小波多尺度空间分解与拉普拉斯域极点-残差公式，在五个PDE基准问题上持续优于LNO，尤其擅长具有强空间多尺度结构的问题。
AI.motivation: LNO虽能通过可学习的系统极点和残差捕捉瞬态与稳态动力学，但缺乏显式的机制来提取复杂PDE解中固有的空间局部多尺度特征。
AI.method: 在LNO核心基础上增加并行的单层Haar离散小波变换分支，将升维后的特征图分解为LL、LH、HL、HH四个子带，分别应用独立的1×1卷积后通过逆DWT重建；两分支通过可学习的sigmoid门控权重α_wav自适应融合。
AI.result: 在扩散方程、Burgers方程、反应扩散系统、Darcy流和二维Navier-Stokes方程五个基准问题上，WLNO一致优于LNO，在具有强空间多尺度结构的问题（如带激波的Burgers方程和带涡旋结构的Navier-Stokes方程）上改进最显著。
AI.conclusion: 基于小波的多尺度空间分解是拉普拉斯域算子学习的一种原理性且有效的补充方法。

title: HoloFair: Unified T2I Fairness Evaluation and Fair-GRPO Debiasing
comment: Accepted to ICML 2026. Code and dataset are available at https://github.com/1059684669/HoloFair
summary: Text-to-Image (T2I) models have made significant strides in visual realism and semantic consistency, yet they often perpetuate and amplify societal biases. Existing evaluation methods typically address only single-dimensional biases, lacking perspectives to uncover model biases at social-related deeper semantic levels. We introduce HoloFair, a comprehensive benchmark framework for multidimensional demographic bias analysis. Built upon our large-scale fairness-oriented dataset and the SpaFreq (Spatial-Frequency) attribute classifier, this framework proposes the Multi-attribute, Group-wise Bias Index (MGBI) metric, designed to assess both intrinsic diversity and conditional biases. Beyond evaluation, we further introduce Fair-GRPO, a reinforcement-learning-based debiasing method that alters the distribution of generative models through a designed multi-objective reward function. E.g., experiments on the SD3.5-Medium model demonstrate that Fair-GRPO significantly improves multidimensional fairness while maintaining high image quality. We also analyze potential reward hacking phenomena and provide corresponding mitigation strategies. Code and dataset are available at https://github.com/1059684669/HoloFair

AI.tldr: 本文提出 HoloFair——一个面向文本到图像模型的多维人口统计偏差评估与去偏框架，包含公平性数据集、SpaFreq 分类器、MGBI 指标以及基于强化学习的去偏方法 Fair-GRPO，在 SD3.5-Medium 上实验表明能显著提升多维公平性同时保持高图像质量。
AI.motivation: 现有T2I模型存在社会偏见，而现有评估方法仅关注单一维度偏见，缺乏从社会相关深层语义层面揭示模型偏见的能力。
AI.method: 构建大规模公平性数据集与SpaFreq（空频）属性分类器；提出多维组间偏差指数（MGBI）评估内在多样性与条件偏差；提出基于强化学习的Fair-GRPO方法，通过多目标奖励函数改变生成模型分布以实现去偏。
AI.result: 在SD3.5-Medium模型上的实验表明，Fair-GRPO在保持高图像质量的同时显著提升了多维公平性，并分析了潜在奖励破解现象及缓解策略。
AI.conclusion: HoloFair框架有效实现了T2I模型的多维度人口统计偏差评估与去偏，代码和数据集已开源。

title: ComPose: A Unified Completion-Pose Framework for Robust Category-Level Object Pose Estimation
comment: Accepted by CVPR 2026 (Oral, Best Paper Award Candidate). Project page is available at renhuan1999.github.io/ComPose
summary: Category-level object pose estimation aims to predict the pose and size of arbitrary objects in specific categories. Existing methods struggle with the inherent incompleteness of observed point clouds, which limits their ability to capture complete object shapes for robust pose reasoning. While point cloud completion offers a promising solution, naively treating it as a separate preprocessing step for partial observations introduces compounding errors and additional computational overhead, ultimately hindering both accuracy and efficiency. To address these challenges, we propose ComPose, a novel unified framework that tightly integrates shape completion to provide complete geometric cues for enhanced pose estimation. At the core of ComPose is a keypoint-based progressive completion module, which recovers full shape representations by progressively predicting a sparse set of keypoints and their surrounding dense point sets, empowering the keypoints to capture holistic object geometries. A geometric relation encoding module further enriches keypoint features with both local and global geometric context. In addition, we introduce a novel geometric relation consistency loss to enforce structural alignment between observed keypoints and their predicted NOCS coordinates, ensuring globally coherent coordinate transformations. Extensive experiments on standard benchmarks demonstrate that our method outperforms state-of-the-art approaches without relying on category-level shape priors.

AI.tldr: ComPose提出了一种统一框架，通过基于关键点的渐进式补全模块和几何关系编码模块，将形状补全与类别级物体姿态估计紧密集成，在不依赖类别级形状先验的情况下超越现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有类别级物体姿态估计方法受限于观测点云的内在不完备性，无法捕获完整物体形状进行鲁棒姿态推理；而将点云补全作为独立预处理步骤会引入累积误差和额外计算开销，影响精度和效率。
AI.method: 提出ComPose统一框架，核心包括：1) 基于关键点的渐进式补全模块，通过逐步预测稀疏关键点及其周围密集点集恢复完整形状表征；2) 几何关系编码模块，增强关键点特征的局部与全局几何上下文；3) 几何关系一致性损失，强制观测关键点与其预测NOCS坐标之间的结构对齐。
AI.result: 在标准基准测试上，该方法在不依赖类别级形状先验的条件下优于现有最先进方法。
AI.conclusion: 将形状补全与姿态估计紧密集成是提升类别级物体姿态估计性能的有效途径，渐进式关键点补全策略能够提供完整几何线索而不引入额外误差。

title: IterInject: Indirect Prompt Injection Against LLM Agents via Feedback-Guided Iterative Optimization
summary: LLM-based agents are increasingly deployed for complex tasks requiring planning, tool use, and interaction with external services. Their reliance on untrusted external content exposes them to indirect prompt injection (IPI), in which adversarial instructions embedded in retrieved data hijack agent behavior. Existing attacks rely on static payloads that cannot adapt to agent-specific defenses; even recent adaptive methods lack structured feedback to guide optimization. We introduce \oursys, a feedback-guided iterative framework that closes the loop between injection, diagnosis, and refinement: a rule-based diagnoser produces structured outcome labels with behavioral descriptions, and an LLM-based optimizer refines payloads conditioned on the full optimization history. A synthesis step generates new disguise seeds from failure patterns, enabling the strategy space to self-evolve. On AgentDojo and InjectAgent, \oursys substantially outperforms static baselines and existing adaptive methods across four victim models. Extension experiments on Claude Code, a production-grade coding agent with layered defenses, show that optimized payloads achieve full success on 5 of 9 targets; even those that resist full exploitation exhibit measurable improvement from iterative refinement. We further present a mechanistic analysis of IPI, identifying an attention-mediated threshold mechanism in mid-to-late layers; three causal interventions validate this finding and point to concrete defense directions.

AI.tldr: 提出一个反馈引导的迭代框架 \oursys，用于生成自适应间接提示注入攻击，通过诊断器-优化器-合成器的闭环机制显著提升攻击成功率，并揭示了注意力机制在中间层的中介阈值机制。
AI.motivation: 现有针对LLM agents的间接提示注入攻击依赖静态载荷，无法适应agent特定防御；即使已有的自适应方法也缺乏结构化反馈来指导优化，攻击效果受限。
AI.method: 提出\oursys框架，包含三个模块：(1) 规则基诊断器生成结构化结果标签和行为描述；(2) LLM基优化器基于完整优化历史精炼载荷；(3) 合成器从失败模式生成新的伪装种子，实现策略空间的自演化。
AI.result: 在AgentDojo和InjectAgent上，\oursys在四个受害模型上显著优于静态基线和现有自适应方法；在Claude Code上，优化载荷在9个目标中的5个实现完全成功；通过三层因果干预验证了注意力机制在中间层的阈值机制。
AI.conclusion: \oursys框架通过闭环迭代优化显著提升了间接提示注入攻击的自适应性和成功率，同时揭示了IPI的注意力阈值机制，为后续防御提供了具体方向。

title: AdaFuse-Det: Adaptive Cross-Modal Fusion of Event Cameras for Robust Object Detection in Low-Light RGB Imagery
summary: Detecting objects reliably under extreme low-light conditions is an open problem in computer vision, with practical urgency in applications ranging from nighttime surveillance to search-and-rescue robotics. Conventional RGB cameras degrade sharply at low photon flux, while event cameras which record asynchronous per-pixel brightness changes at microsecond resolution and high dynamic range provide complementary structural cues that are largely illumination-invariant. We present AdaFuse-Det, a dual-stream framework that fuses CLAHE-enhanced RGB frames with voxelized event tensors through an Adaptive Cross-Modal Fusion (ACMF) module grounded in minimum-variance linear estimation theory. We formally show that the learned attention map asymptotically recovers the Gauss-Markov optimal fusion weights, and establish event conservation and temporal resolution bounds for the voxelization stage. On the LLE-VOS benchmark, AdaFuse-Det achieves a Recall of $65.54\%$, Precision of $53.85\%$, and F1-Score of $59.12\%$ under severe illumination degradation, outperforming single-modality detectors in recall by a margin that reflects the theoretically predicted illumination-adaptation behavior.

AI.tldr: AdaFuse-Det是一个双流融合框架，通过自适应跨模态融合模块（基于最小方差线性估计理论）将CLAHE增强的RGB帧与体素化事件张量融合，在极端低光条件下显著提升了目标检测性能，实验达到了65.54%的召回率和59.12%的F1分数。
AI.motivation: 极端低光条件下的可靠目标检测是计算机视觉中的开放问题，在夜间监控、搜救机器人等应用中具有紧迫的实际需求。传统RGB相机在低光子通量下性能严重退化，而事件相机虽能提供光照不变的互补结构信息，但如何有效融合这两种模态仍面临挑战。
AI.method: 提出AdaFuse-Det双流融合框架：1) 对RGB帧进行CLAHE增强处理；2) 将事件相机数据转化为体素化事件张量；3) 设计自适应跨模态融合模块（ACMF），基于最小方差线性估计理论学习融合权重；4) 理论上证明学习得到的注意力图渐近恢复高斯-马尔可夫最优融合权重，并建立了事件守恒和体素化阶段的时间分辨率边界。
AI.result: 在LLE-VOS基准上，AdaFuse-Det在严重光照退化条件下达到Recall 65.54%、Precision 53.85%、F1-Score 59.12%，召回率显著优于单模态检测器，该差距在理论上可解释为光照自适应行为的预测结果。
AI.conclusion: 双流融合策略在极端低光条件下显著优于单模态方法，ACMF模块的理论基础（高斯-马尔可夫最优融合）为性能提升提供了可解释的数学保证，验证了事件相机与RGB融合在光照退化场景中的有效性。

title: AgentGrounder: Zero-Shot 3D Visual Pointcloud Grounding using Multimodal Language Models
summary: 3D Visual Grounding (3DVG) is an essential capability for embodied AI, requiring agents to localize objects in 3D scenes based on natural language descriptions. Recent zero-shot methods leverage 2D vision-language models (LVLMs). However, they often rely on existing sets of multi-view images and struggle with the limited semantic and spatial details provided by standard 3D segmentation tools. We present $\textbf{AgentGrounder}$, a zero-shot 3D visual grounding framework that operates directly on colored point clouds without task-specific 3D training. Our approach follows a two-stage design: (1) an offline stage that applies 3D model to build an Object Lookup Table (OLT) with instance IDs, semantic labels, 3D bounding boxes; and (2) an online tool-driven agent that decomposes each query, retrieves only relevant candidates from the OLT, performs geometric scoring, and triggers image rendering on demand when additional visual evidence (e.g., color, material, or viewpoint-sensitive cues) is required. Compared with fixed anchor-target matching pipelines, this design reduces cascading matching errors and improves context-window efficiency by avoiding prompts overloaded with irrelevant objects. We evaluate on ScanRefer and Nr3D under a zero-shot setting and observe consistent improvements over SeeGround in our setup, including +2.5% Acc@0.5 on ScanRefer and +6.3% on Nr3D, with a notable +6.3% gain on Nr3D view-independent queries. These results show that combining selective retrieval, geometric reasoning, and adaptive visual inspection yields a practical and robust foundation for open-vocabulary 3D grounding. Our code is available at https://github.com/be2rlab/AgentGrounder.

AI.tldr: AgentGrounder是一个零样本3D视觉定位框架，通过两阶段设计（离线构建对象查找表+在线工具驱动代理）直接在彩色点云上进行操作，无需任务特定3D训练。在ScanRefer和Nr3D数据集上，相比SeeGround方法实现了+2.5%和+6.3%的准确率提升。
AI.motivation: 现有零样本3D视觉定位方法依赖2D视觉语言模型和多视角图像，但受限于标准3D分割工具提供的有限语义和空间细节，且固定锚点-目标匹配流程容易产生级联匹配错误。
AI.method: 两阶段设计：(1)离线阶段：3D模型构建对象查找表(OLT)，包含实例ID、语义标签、3D边界框；(2)在线阶段：工具驱动代理分解查询，从OLT中检索相关候选，进行几何评分，并在需要额外视觉证据时触发按需图像渲染。
AI.result: 在零样本设置下，ScanRefer上Acc@0.5提升+2.5%，Nr3D上提升+6.3%，其中视图无关查询上提升+6.3%。
AI.conclusion: 结合选择性检索、几何推理和自适应视觉检查为开放词汇3D定位提供了实用且鲁棒的基础，该方法减少了级联匹配错误，提高了上下文窗口效率。

title: Trajectory-Based Difficulty Scoring for Reliable Learning on Tabular Data
summary: Gradient-boosted trees achieve strong performance on tabular data, yet often leave a long tail of poorly predicted instances. We introduce a Trajectory-based Difficulty Score (TDS), an instance-level difficulty estimator for boosted ensembles derived from per-tree cumulative prediction trajectories. For each instance, we compute interpretable trajectory descriptors (e.g., variance, oscillation peaks, sign switches, and tail stability) and train a lightweight regression model to predict held-out loss. An empirical CDF calibrates the resulting signal into a score in $[0,1]$ that supports ranking hard cases. Across diverse tabular benchmarks and ensemble sizes, TDS exhibits strong rank correlation with error and outperforms established instance-hardness and uncertainty baselines on classification, while remaining competitive on regression. We then show how a single difficulty signal improves multiple data mining workflows: difficulty-driven active learning for label-efficient training, difficulty-thresholded selective prediction for improved risk-coverage trade-offs, and TDS-stratified (Mondrian) conformal prediction for more uniform conditional coverage. Finally, clustering high-TDS instances using SHAP attributions reveals coherent failure modes characterized by compact feature-value ranges, supporting error analysis and targeted data acquisition.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种基于轨迹的困难度评分（TDS），通过梯度提升树中每棵树的累积预测轨迹为每个实例计算可解释的描述符，并训练轻量级回归模型预测损失，最终生成[0,1]区间的困难度分数，用于分类和回归任务中的困难样本识别，并应用于主动学习、选择性预测和共形预测等数据挖掘流程。
AI.motivation: 梯度提升树在表格数据上表现优异，但往往存在大量预测不佳的尾部实例，缺乏有效的实例级困难度估计方法。
AI.method: 从每棵树的累积预测轨迹中提取可解释的描述符（如方差、振荡峰值、符号翻转、尾部稳定性），训练轻量级回归模型预测留出损失，并通过经验CDF校准为[0,1]分数。
AI.result: 在多种表格基准和集成规模下，TDS与误差的秩相关性很强，在分类任务上优于已有的实例困难度和不确定性基线，在回归任务上具有竞争力。在主动学习、选择性预测和分层共形预测三个数据挖掘流程中均展现出改进效果。通过SHAP聚类高TDS实例可揭示连贯的失败模式。
AI.conclusion: TDS是一种有效的实例级困难度估计方法，能提升多种数据挖掘工作流的性能，并支持错误分析和针对性数据采集。

title: SRUG: Shadow-Guided Relightable Urban Scene with Generation Model
summary: Creating relightable urban scenes from images or videos is widely useful but highly ill-posed. Urban environments are typically unbounded and extend beyond the visible regions. As a result, many portions of the scene remain unobserved, yet these invisible regions can cast shadows onto visible areas. Reasonably modeling shadows cast by such invisible regions is challenging and poses a significant obstacle to creating relightable urban scenes. At the same time, sparse input views and complex illumination conditions further complicate relighting, as they introduce severe ambiguities in material decomposition. In this paper, we propose Shadow-guided Relightable Urban Scene with Generation model (SRUG), a novel framework designed to address relighting challenges in urban scenes. SRUG leverages shadows to guide a 3D completion model for recovering the geometry of invisible regions, promoting the synthesis of physically reasonable shadows. In addition, SRUG employs an iterative material decomposition scheme that applies the large material model (LMM) to provide material supervision and iteratively decompose the scene's material properties, enabling robust material decomposition. Building upon these components, we introduce a physically-based lighting model that captures the complex illumination of urban scenes and supports reliable relighting. Extensive quantitative evaluations and visual comparisons demonstrate that our method outperforms existing approaches in both novel view synthesis and relighting tasks.

AI.tldr: SRUG是一个利用阴影引导生成模型来创建可重光照城市场景的框架，通过3D补全模型恢复不可见区域几何结构，结合迭代材质分解和基于物理的光照模型，在视图合成和重光照任务上优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 城市场景通常无边界且存在大量未观察区域，这些不可见区域会向可见区域投射阴影，而稀疏输入视图和复杂光照条件进一步加剧了材质分解中的歧义性，使得创建可重光照的城市场景高度病态。
AI.method: 提出SRUG框架：(1)利用阴影引导3D补全模型恢复不可见区域的几何结构；(2)采用迭代材质分解方案，使用大规模材质模型(LMM)提供材质监督并迭代分解场景材质属性；(3)引入基于物理的光照模型以捕捉城市复杂光照并支持可靠重光照。
AI.result: 大量定量评估和视觉比较表明，SRUG在新视图合成和重光照任务上均优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: SRUG通过阴影引导几何补全和迭代材质分解，有效解决了城市场景重光照中不可见区域阴影建模和材质分解歧义等关键挑战，实现了更可靠的城市场景重光照效果。

title: LRDDv3: High-Resolution Long-Range Drone Detection Dataset with Range Information and Thermal Data
comment: 8 pages, 5 figures. Accepted to the 2026 IEEE International Conference on Robotics and Automation (ICRA)
summary: Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) have quickly become common in various airspaces, representing a wide range of applications from recreation flying to commercial photography and package delivery. With the increasing prevalence of UAVs, it becomes critical that both manned and unmanned aircraft can detect UAVs and other flying objects from long range to effectively track movement and ensure safe operation in shared spaces. While several datasets have been introduced for drone detection, the need for expanded high-quality data persists, especially in the area of high-resolution long-range drone data. To address this, we introduce a high-resolution dataset of 102,532 long-range RGB images of drones, sampled at 5 FPS from 128 distinct video clips taken mid flight during 17 different data collection days spread over 8 months to ensure a wide variety of lighting scenarios, flight locations, and background elements. The dataset boasts comprehensive drone range information across the dataset, as well as 29,630 IR images, all paired with RGB counterparts from the base dataset. As one of the first drone detection datasets to leverage 4K image resolution and paired 640x512 IR images, our work represents a significant advancement to enable the detection of drones at long range. For access to the complete dataset, please visit https://research.coe.drexel.edu/ece/imaple/lrddv3/

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了一个面向无人机长距离检测的高分辨率数据集LRDDv3，包含102,532张RGB图像和29,630张配对的红外图像，均为4K分辨率，覆盖多种光照和飞行场景，旨在提升无人机远距离检测能力。
AI.motivation: 随着无人机在各空域的普及，有人/无人航空器都亟需从远距离检测无人机以确保安全运行。现有数据集缺乏高分辨率、长距离的无人机数据，因此需要构建更高质量的长距离检测数据集。
AI.method: 收集了128个视频片段，在17个数据采集日内以5 FPS采样，生成102,532张长距离RGB图像（4K分辨率）和29,630张配对的红外图像（640x512），覆盖多样化的光照条件、飞行地点和背景环境。
AI.result: 构建了首个采用4K分辨率RGB图像并配以640x512红外图像的大规模长距离无人机检测数据集，包含全面的距离信息。
AI.conclusion: 该数据集显著推进了长距离无人机检测领域，为保障共享空域安全运行提供了重要的数据基础。

title: Beyond the Aggregation Dilemma: Prior-Retaining Decoupled Learning for Multimodal Graphs
summary: Multimodal Attributed Graph Learning (MAGL) integrates intrinsic node attributes with structural topology via graph aggregation. However, as pretrained encoders evolve into Large Foundation Models (LFMs), the landscape of MAGL fundamentally shifts: under high-confidence LFM priors, mandatory aggregation introduces topological noise that overwhelms discriminative signals, triggering a counter-intuitive performance inversion where sophisticated MAGL architectures underperform simple topology-agnostic MLPs. Through systematic empirical and theoretical analysis, we identify that this inversion stems from a fundamental aggregation dilemma characterized by two concurrent pathologies: (1) Representational Pathology (SNR Degradation) - mandatory aggregation dilutes robust intrinsic features with topological noise, causing the noise penalty to outweigh its collaborative benefit; and (2) Optimization Pathology (Gradient Starvation) - topological aggregation attenuates gradient flow, while a shared task loss causes dominant modalities to prematurely suppress weaker ones. To resolve this dilemma, we propose SUPRA (Shared-Unique Prior-Retaining Architecture), a decoupled dual-pathway paradigm. SUPRA processes modality-specific features through topology-agnostic MLPs while capturing structural synergy via a lightweight shared GNN, with auxiliary deep supervision counteracting gradient starvation. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that SUPRA achieves state-of-the-art performance while requiring 3.5x lower peak GPU memory and up to 4.4x faster training time than Multimodal Graph Transformers.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了多模态属性图学习在引入大规模基础模型后存在的聚合困境（表征病理和优化病理），并提出解耦双路径架构SUPRA，通过分离模态特定特征与结构协同特征，在提升性能的同时显著降低计算开销。
AI.motivation: 当预训练编码器演进为大规模基础模型时，传统多模态属性图学习中的强制图聚合操作会引入拓扑噪声，导致复杂的MAGL架构性能反而低于简单的拓扑无关MLP，出现反直觉的性能反转现象。
AI.method: 提出SUPRA架构，采用解耦双路径范式：(1) 拓扑无关MLP路径处理模态特定特征；(2) 轻量级共享GNN路径捕获结构协同特征；并引入辅助深度监督以缓解梯度饥饿问题。
AI.result: SUPRA在多个基准上达到SOTA性能，同时相比多模态图Transformer，峰值GPU内存降低3.5倍，训练速度提升高达4.4倍。
AI.conclusion: 强制图聚合在大规模基础模型场景下弊大于利，解耦模态特定特征与结构协同特征的双路径设计是更优的范式。

title: Do Image-Text Metrics Respect Semantic Invariances?
summary: Reference-free image-to-text evaluators are now standard for scoring image-caption alignment, yet it is unclear whether they respect semantic invariances. We present an invariance probe on five popular evaluators (CLIPScore, PAC-S, UMIC, FLEUR, and a deterministic LLM judge) under semantics-preserving perturbations along three axes -- spatial (flips, context-preserving repositioning, light rotations), object (scale, category), and socio-linguistic framing (cultural/economic adjectives with neutral and length-matched controls). Across curated slices of three detection datasets and three caption evaluation suites, we find consistent non-semantic sensitivities, where benign spatial edits and simple phrasing changes shift scores by $\approx$6--9\% on average, and for systems separated by just 0.7\%, these shifts can cause ranking flips in up to $\sim$37\% of cases, particularly under spatial changes. A small human study also supports this finding and confirms that annotators generally judge perturbed pairs as equally correct, so these shifts reflect metric behavior rather than semantic change. We further propose invariance-calibrated scoring, a post-hoc adjustment that roughly halves median absolute sensitivity while retaining correlation with learned caption evaluators.

AI.tldr: 当前主流的无参考图像-文本评估器在语义不变性上存在缺陷，空间编辑和措辞变化会导致评分平均波动6-9%，在性能接近的系统间可引发高达37%的排序翻转。作者提出校准后调整方法，可将中位绝对敏感性降低约一半。
AI.motivation: 现有无参考图像-文本评估器广泛应用于评估图像与描述的对齐质量，但它们在语义保持不变的情况下（如图像翻转、物体缩放、措辞变化）是否保持评分不变尚不清楚，需要系统性地检验这些评估器的语义不变性。
AI.method: 在三个语义保持不变性扰动轴（空间、物体、社会语言框架）上，对五种流行评估器（CLIPScore、PAC-S、UMIC、FLEUR、确定性LLM裁判）进行探针测试，使用三个检测数据集和三个描述评估基准的切片数据，辅以小规模人工验证，并提出校准后评分调整方法。
AI.result: 所有评估器均表现出非语义敏感性：良性空间编辑和措辞变化平均导致评分波动6-9%；在性能差距仅0.7%的系统间，这些波动可导致高达约37%的排序翻转；人工标注确认扰动对语义等价性无实质影响。
AI.conclusion: 当前无参考图像-文本评估器在语义不变性方面存在系统性缺陷，提出校准后评分调整可有效降低敏感度（中位绝对敏感性降低约一半）且保持与原始评估器的相关性。

title: MIND: Multi-Scale Intent Diffusion for Text-Driven Physics-Based Humanoid Control
summary: Enabling physics-based humanoids to execute diverse behaviors from high-level textual commands remains a significant challenge. Existing methods typically follow either a two-stage paradigm that combines kinematic motion generation with physics-based tracking, or an end-to-end imitation-learning paradigm that directly generates actions from text. However, the former suffers from the inherent domain shift between kinematic generation and physics-based tracking, while the latter struggles with the substantial modality gap between textual commands and low-level actions, limiting effective semantic alignment. Notably, humanoid states encode rich motion dynamics that are more semantically aligned with textual descriptions than low-level actions, making them a natural basis for deriving behavioral intent. Building upon this insight, we propose MIND, a novel end-to-end diffusion framework for text-driven physics-based humanoid control that leverages behavioral intent as a semantic bridge between textual commands and low-level actions. At its core, MIND introduces a multi-scale intent diffusion mechanism, where a holistic intent predictor captures global behavioral dynamics to guide overall behavior synthesis, while an immediate intent predictor provides step-wise, fine-grained signals for local behavior refinement at each diffusion step. This hierarchical intent formulation imposes a structured inductive bias for humanoid control, improving semantic alignment and behavioral naturalness. Furthermore, MIND encodes humanoid states into a latent space to enable more effective semantic intent modeling. Extensive experiments demonstrate that MIND outperforms existing methods and synthesizes coherent, physically plausible, and semantically aligned humanoid behaviors from text commands. Our code will be released to facilitate future research.

AI.tldr: MIND是一个端到端扩散框架，通过将行为意图作为文本指令与低级动作之间的语义桥梁，实现基于文本驱动的物理仿真人体控制。该框架引入多尺度意图扩散机制（全局意图预测器+即时意图预测器）和状态潜空间编码，在语义对齐和物理合理性方面超越现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有方法面临两大挑战：两阶段范式存在运动生成与物理跟踪的领域偏移问题，端到端模仿学习范式则难以弥合文本指令与低级动作之间的巨大模态差距。作者观察到人体状态比低级动作与文本描述具有更强的语义对齐性，因此提出以行为意图作为语义桥梁的端到端框架。
AI.method: 提出MIND框架，核心包括：(1) 多尺度意图扩散机制，包含全局意图预测器（捕捉整体行为动态）和即时意图预测器（提供逐步骤的细粒度信号）；(2) 将人体状态编码到潜空间以增强语义意图建模；(3) 分层意图公式化为人体控制提供结构化归纳偏置。
AI.result: 实验表明MIND在合成连贯、物理合理且语义对齐的人体行为方面优于现有方法，能够从文本命令中生成符合要求的物理仿真人体动作。
AI.conclusion: MIND通过行为意图作为语义桥梁，有效解决了文本到物理仿真人体控制中的模态对齐问题，为文本驱动的人体行为生成提供了一种新的端到端范式。

title: Streaming Reinforcement Learning under Partial Observability with Real-Time Recurrent Learning
summary: Streaming reinforcement learning has emerged as an online learning paradigm that conforms to the restrictions of natural learning agents that process data incrementally, i.e. with a batch size of 1 and no replay buffer. While streaming RL has recently been shown to scale with deep function approximation with full observability, partially observable settings have remained out of reach. Truncated backpropagation through time collapses to a one-step gradient horizon under the streaming setting, and exact real-time recurrent learning is prohibitively expensive. We close this gap using recurrent trace units, a diagonal recurrent architecture that enables exact RTRL with linear time and memory complexity in the parameter count, and show that they integrate cleanly into existing streaming algorithms across both discrete and continuous control. On a MemoryChain diagnostic with chain lengths from 2 to 128, our method sustains performance where streaming TBPTT(1) baselines using feedforward, GRU, and RTU networks collapse. On five POPGym tasks and on partially observable MuJoCo continuous control, the streaming approach is competitive with batched PPO on POPGym and recovers a substantial fraction of batched performance on masked MuJoCo, despite using no replay buffer or batched updates.

AI.tldr: 本文提出使用循环迹单元（RTU）在流式强化学习中实现部分可观测环境的有效在线学习，解决了截断BPTT在流式设定下退化为单步梯度的问题，在MemoryChain、POPGym和部分可观测MuJoCo任务上取得了与批处理算法竞争的性能。
AI.motivation: 流式强化学习虽然已通过深度函数逼近在全可观测设定下取得进展，但部分可观测环境仍未得到有效解决。现有方法中，截断反向传播通过时间（TBPTT）在流式设定下退化为单步梯度，而精确实时递归学习（RTRL）计算代价过高。
AI.method: 采用循环迹单元（Recurrent Trace Units, RTU），一种对角递归架构，使得精确RTRL在线性时间和内存复杂度下可行，并将其无缝集成到现有流式强化学习算法中。
AI.result: 在MemoryChain诊断任务（链长2-128）上，该方法保持了性能，而使用前馈、GRU和RTU网络的流式TBPTT(1)基线均失效；在POPGym五个任务和部分可观测MuJoCo连续控制上，流式方法在无回放缓存和批更新的条件下与批处理PPO性能相当。
AI.conclusion: RTU使得流式强化学习能够扩展到部分可观测领域，在无需回放缓存和批更新的情况下达到与批处理方法竞争的成果，推动了在线学习范式的实际应用。

title: Physics-Guided Self-Supervised Statistical Residual Learning for Sonar Despeckling with Improved Generalization
summary: This letter introduces a physics-informed self-supervised framework for sonar image despeckling that reformulates despeckling as residual consistency in the homomorphic log domain. By constraining the log-ratio residual to obey multiplicative speckle statistics, the proposed method eliminates the need for clean supervision while preventing degenerate identity solutions. A variance-targeted statistical loss combined with edge-aware structural regularization and median-guided curriculum stabilization enables effective speckle suppression with preserved structural fidelity. This formulation along with a lightweight neural network achieves state-of-the-art performance across multiple real sonar datasets and demonstrates excellent cross-dataset robustness, while remaining suitable for real-time deployment.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种基于物理感知自监督学习的声纳图像去斑框架，通过对数域残差一致性约束和统计损失函数，在不依赖干净标签的情况下实现高效去斑，并支持实时部署。
AI.motivation: 传统声纳图像去斑方法需要成对的干净-噪声数据作为监督，获取成本高昂；且无监督方法容易退化为恒等映射，导致去斑效果不佳。作者希望提出一种自监督方法，既能避免对干净数据的依赖，又能防止模型学到恒等解。
AI.method: 1) 将去斑问题重新定义为同态对数域中的残差一致性任务；2) 约束对数域残差服从乘性散斑噪声统计特性；3) 设计方差目标统计损失函数；4) 引入边缘感知结构正则化；5) 采用中值引导的课程学习策略稳定训练过程；6) 使用轻量级神经网络架构。
AI.result: 在多个真实声纳数据集上达到最先进性能，展现出优异的跨数据集鲁棒性，且满足实时部署需求。
AI.conclusion: 该自监督框架有效解决了声纳图像去斑中缺乏干净监督数据和模型退化的问题，在保持结构保真度的同时实现高效散斑抑制，具有良好的实用价值。

title: Feature Learning in Wide Neural Networks under $μ$P: Identifiability and Sparse-Dictionary Decomposition of the Mean-Field Limit
summary:
We establish four structural results for feature learning in wide two-layer neural networks under the Maximal Update Parametrization ($μ$P).
  First, we prove global existence and uniqueness of the mean-field limit of noisy gradient descent under $μ$P, identifying the maximal admissible weight $w^*$ on the moment sequence of the initialization as the reciprocal parameter-moment-growth boundary, and hence the largest weighted moment class propagated by the flow. The finite-particle approximation has uniform-in-time squared-Wasserstein rate $O(N^{-1})$.
  Second, we characterize identifiability of the mean-field limit: two admissible parameter measures induce the same network function in $L^2$ exactly when their active components agree modulo the finite-rank realization symmetry of the architecture. The orbit depth $D^*_{\mathrm{orb}}$ is separated from the moment-variety depth $D^*_{\mathrm{var}}$.
  Third, under the Barron-Hermite target condition the active support of the long-time limit measure admits a sparse-dictionary decomposition: it is supported on at most $S^*$ atoms modulo finite-rank realization symmetry, with $S^*$ bounded by an explicit coefficient-threshold number.
  Fourth, we derive the total feature-learning-error decomposition into statistical, optimization, propagation-of-chaos, and sparse-residual components, with a target-dependent Hermite/Barron tail replacing any initialization-only residual.
  The four results are tied together by an architectural identity: the triple $(w^*, D^*_{\mathrm{orb}}, S^*)$ -- the maximal admissible weight, the orbit identifiability depth, and the sparse-dictionary depth at which the target is realizable -- is the natural learning cell of the architecture-data pair $(σ, ρ)$. The proofs are self-contained except for standard results from $μ$P and mean-field Langevin theory.

AI.tldr: 本文针对最大更新参数化（μP）下的宽两层神经网络，建立了四个关于特征学习的结构性结果：平均场极限的全局存在唯一性、极限的可识别性、长时极限的稀疏字典分解，以及特征学习误差分解。核心发现是三重参数 (w^*, D^*_orb, S^*) 构成了架构-数据对的自然学习单元。
AI.motivation: 在最大更新参数化（μP）框架下，宽两层神经网络的特征学习机制缺乏严格的理论刻画，特别是平均场极限的存在性、唯一性、可识别性以及特征表示的稀疏性等基础问题尚未解决。
AI.method: 采用平均场极限方法分析μP下的带噪梯度下降动力学；通过矩序列与参数-矩增长边界刻画可容许性；利用有限秩实现对称性分析可识别性；引入Barron-Hermite目标条件推导稀疏字典分解。
AI.result: (1) 证明了平均场极限的全局存在唯一性，有限粒子逼近的平方Wasserstein率为O(N^{-1})；(2) 刻画了可识别性条件，证明轨道深度D^*_orb与矩簇深度D^*_var存在分离；(3) 长时极限的活动支撑最多由S^*个原子支撑，S^*由显式系数阈值界出；(4) 将特征学习误差分解为统计、优化、混沌传播和稀疏残差四个分量。
AI.conclusion: 三重参数 (w^*, D^*_orb, S^*)——最大可容许权重、轨道可识别性深度和目标可实现的稀疏字典深度——构成了架构-数据对 (σ, ρ) 的自然学习单元，统一了四个结构结果。

title: Calibrating Probabilistic Object Detectors with Annotator Disagreement
summary: High degrees of disagreement among annotators can exist for ambiguous objects, e.g. in medical images, underscoring the challenges of establishing ground truth annotations in object detection tasks. Despite this, all existing object detectors implicitly require access to ground truth annotations for either training or evaluation. The fundamental questions we target are: How can we learn an object detector with multiple annotators' annotations but without objective ground truth annotations due to object ambiguity, and how can we enable the learned detector to express meaningful model predictive uncertainties in detecting ambiguous objects? To answer these questions, we present an interpretable approach to calibrate probabilistic object detectors, where the calibration goal is to align the class confidence and bounding box variance estimates to the annotators' annotation distribution. We introduce an efficient yet effective framework to calibrate probabilistic object detectors by designing four evaluation metrics to measure calibration errors regarding classification and localization, and proposing a train-time calibration and post-hoc calibrator, all without the need to access any ground truth. This framework is generalizable to many existing probabilistic object detectors, such as the YOLO families and two-stage detectors. Empirical results with real-world and synthetic datasets of medical and natural images demonstrate the superior performance of the proposed framework with three popular object detectors.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种无需真实标注、利用多位标注者标注分布来校准概率目标检测器的可解释框架，通过分类置信度与边界框方差的校准，在医学和自然图像上取得了优异效果。
AI.motivation: 目标检测任务中，由于目标模糊性（如医学图像），不同标注者之间存在高度分歧，难以获取客观的真实标注。现有检测器均依赖真实标注进行训练或评估，无法处理这种歧义性。
AI.method: 设计了四种评估指标（分类与定位校准误差），提出训练时校准与事后校准两种方法，通过将类别置信度和边界框方差与标注者标注分布对齐来实现概率目标检测器的校准，无需任何真实标注。
AI.result: 在真实与合成的医学图像和自然图像数据集上，使用三种主流目标检测器（YOLO系列和两阶段检测器）进行的实验表明，所提框架在性能上优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: 该框架具有通用性，可适用于多种概率目标检测器，有效解决了歧义目标下的检测与不确定性表达问题。

title: Hardware-Aware Federated Learning for Speech Emotion Recognition
summary: Federated learning (FL) enables privacy-preserving collaborative training across distributed edge devices, but real deployments involve heterogeneous clients with different processing power, memory capacity, and communication latency, which often increase round duration and system cost. This paper proposes a hardware-aware federated learning framework for emotion recognition on session-partitioned IEMOCAP that integrates hardware profiling, top-K client selection, and adaptive local epochs within a unified training loop. We compare the method against FedAvg, FedProx, and random top-K selection under a non-IID setup and show that, across 50 federated rounds and 5 independent trials, the proposed approach achieves competitive validation accuracy (0.352), reduces total training time by about 36.5% compared to FedAvg, and lowers cumulative communication cost by 40%.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种硬件感知的联邦学习框架，通过硬件分析、top-K客户端选择和自适应本地轮数，在IEMOCAP情感识别任务上相比FedAvg减少36.5%训练时间和40%通信成本，同时保持竞争性精度。
AI.motivation: 真实联邦学习部署中客户端存在异构性（不同处理能力、内存、通信延迟），导致训练轮次耗时增加和系统成本上升，亟需一种硬件感知的方法来优化训练效率。
AI.method: 提出硬件感知联邦学习框架，整合硬件分析（硬件profiling）、top-K客户端选择（基于硬件能力筛选）和自适应本地轮数（根据客户端性能动态调整），在基于会话划分的IEMOCAP数据集上，于非独立同分布场景下与FedAvg、FedProx及随机top-K选择进行对比。
AI.result: 50轮联邦学习、5次独立试验中，验证准确率达0.352；相比FedAvg，总训练时间减少约36.5%，累积通信成本降低40%。
AI.conclusion: 硬件感知的联邦学习策略能有效应对客户端异构性，在保持模型精度的同时显著提升训练效率和降低通信开销，适用于资源受限的边缘设备情感识别场景。

title: From Full Boards to Tiny Defects: Scale-Aware Tile Inference with Topology-Aware Merging for High-Resolution PCB Defect Detection
summary: High-resolution printed circuit board (PCB) inspection suffers from resolution collapse when full-board images are resized to standard detector inputs: micro-scale defects shrink to a few pixels and are missed. Tile-based inference preserves local detail but introduces boundary artefacts at tile edges, causing split detections and false negatives. We present a systematic comparison of five inference strategies evaluated on two high-resolution PCB defect datasets, PCB-Defect (230 images, 1704 annotations) and HRIPCB (693 images, 2 953 annotations), spanning six defect classes. We show that training-inference scale consistency is critical: a detector trained on full images collapses to mAP@50 = 0.01 under tile inference, while the same architecture trained on 640*640 tile crops achieves 0.72 and 0.94 on the two datasets respectively. We further exploited Topology-Aware Tile Merging (TA-TM), a training-free post-processing method that builds a tile-adjacency graph and adjusts boundary-sensitive detection scores using neighbour-tile agreement before global NMS. Across both datasets, adding 128 px tile overlap raises boundary-zone recall from ~26-63% to ~70-100%, TA-TM achieves the best mAP@50 on both benchmarks, and tile inference recovers 46-100% of small defects missed entirely by full-image methods. Results are consistent across datasets, confirming the generalizability of the proposed strategy. TA-TM requires no retraining and is architecture-agnostic, making it directly applicable to existing PCB inspection pipelines.

AI.tldr: 本文系统比较了五种高分辨率PCB缺陷检测推理策略，发现训练-推理尺度一致性至关重要；提出无需训练的拓扑感知拼图合并（TA-TM）方法，通过构建拼图邻接图并利用邻域一致性调整边界敏感检测分数，在两个数据集上将边界区域召回率从~26-63%提升至~70-100%，并恢复46-100%的全图方法遗漏的小缺陷。
AI.motivation: 高分辨率PCB全板图像缩放到标准检测器输入时分辨率崩塌，微尺度缺陷缩小至几个像素而被漏检；基于拼图的推理虽保留局部细节，但引入拼图边界伪影，导致检测分裂和假阴性。
AI.method: 系统比较五种推理策略；提出TA-TM方法，构建拼图邻接图，利用邻域拼图一致性调整边界敏感检测分数，再进行全局非极大值抑制（NMS）。
AI.result: 训练-推理尺度一致性至关重要：全图训练模型在拼图推理下mAP@50=0.01，而640×640拼图训练达到0.72和0.94；128px重叠使边界召回率从~26-63%提升至~70-100%；TA-TM在两个基准上取得最佳mAP@50；拼图推理恢复46-100%的全图方法遗漏小缺陷。
AI.conclusion: TA-TM无需重新训练且与架构无关，可直接应用于现有PCB检测流水线，结果跨数据集一致，验证了策略的泛化性。

title: Reinforcement Learning for Reachability: Guaranteeing Asymptotic Optimality
comment: Main text and appendix of work accepted in ICML 2026
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) for reachability specifications is fundamental in sequential decision-making, yet theoretical guarantees remain less explored. A recent work achieves asymptotic convergence to optimal policies. However, this approach provides limited insight into convergence dynamics. In this work, we present an alternative approach that provides deeper theoretical insights into convergence. Our approach builds on PAC learning with assumptions. PAC learning guarantees near-optimal policies with high confidence in finite time but requires knowing internal MDP parameters like minimum transition probability. We argue that while these parameters are unknown in RL, they can be iteratively refined and estimated with increasing accuracy. By iteratively satisfying PAC conditions, we show that exact optimality can be achieved in the limit. Empirical evaluations on standard benchmarks validate our theoretical insights into convergence dynamics.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于PAC学习的强化学习方法，通过迭代优化未知MDP参数，在有限时间内以高置信度保证接近最优策略，并渐进收敛到精确最优解。实验验证了收敛动态的理论洞见。
AI.motivation: 现有强化学习在可达性规范下的收敛性研究缺乏理论保证，最新工作仅实现渐近收敛但对收敛动态的洞察有限。本文旨在提供更深层次的理论理解。
AI.method: 基于PAC学习理论，假设已知MDP内部参数（如最小转移概率），但通过迭代方式逐步估计和优化这些未知参数，不断满足PAC条件，从而在极限情况下实现精确最优性。
AI.result: 在标准基准测试上的实验验证了所提方法对收敛动态的理论洞见，表明通过迭代PAC条件可实现渐近精确最优收敛。
AI.conclusion: 提出了一种替代性理论框架，通过迭代PAC学习弥补了现有渐近收敛方法对收敛动态理解不足的局限，在理论上证明了有限时间高置信度保证与渐近最优性的统一。

title: Ghosts in the Point Clouds: De-glaring LiDAR in the Transient Domain
summary: Modern LiDARs are rapidly transitioning from bulky, mechanically scanned systems to ultra-compact, low-cost, solid-state arrays. This miniaturization-while enabling scalability, affordability, and camera-like data structures-introduces a new and severe failure mode: internal-multipath glare. When light from a bright or retroreflective surface reflects and scatters within the LiDAR, light that should reach a single pixel spreads across the pixel array. The resulting artifacts create phantom objects, obscure real ones, and produce safety-critical "ghosts in the point clouds." This paper introduces a physically grounded sensing model and algorithmic techniques for addressing this effect. We show that internal glare can be represented as a linear, scene-independent operator-the Transient Glare Spread Function (TGSF)-acting on the transient measurements. Building on this model, we develop a training-free approach that operates on low-level LiDAR detections (or echoes) prior to point-cloud formation, leveraging knowledge of the glare spread function to reason about the likelihood of each detection arising from glare. The resulting approach is compatible with existing LiDAR signal-processing pipelines, and deployable on unmodified commercial sensors. Using experiments with real single-photon LiDAR hardware, we demonstrate substantial suppression of severe glare artifacts while preserving true scene structure.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了固态LiDAR中由内部多径杂散光（internal-multipath glare）引起的新型故障模式，提出了瞬态杂散光扩散函数（TGSF）模型，并开发了一种无需训练的算法，可在点云形成前处理LiDAR回波信号，有效抑制杂散光伪影，且兼容现有商用传感器。
AI.motivation: 现代LiDAR从机械扫描向固态阵列的微型化转型虽带来诸多优势，但引入了内部多径杂散光这一严重故障模式。杂散光会在点云中产生幻影物体、遮挡真实物体，造成安全关键问题。现有方法缺乏对这一效应的物理建模和有效抑制手段。
AI.method: 提出了瞬态杂散光扩散函数（TGSF）模型，将内部杂散光表示为线性、场景无关的算子作用于瞬态测量；基于此模型，开发了无需训练的算法，在点云形成前利用杂散光扩散函数的先验知识对每个检测（回波）进行似然估计，判断其是否由杂散光产生。
AI.result: 在真实单光子LiDAR硬件上的实验表明，该方法能显著抑制严重的杂散光伪影，同时保留真实的场景结构。
AI.conclusion: 该方法与现有LiDAR信号处理流水线兼容，可直接部署在未改装的商用传感器上，为固态LiDAR中杂散光伪影的去除提供了一种物理可解释、实用且高效的解决方案。

title: Aligning Molecular Graph Explanations with Chemical Identity via InChIfied Invariants
summary: Obtaining consistent explanations for machine learning on molecular graphs requires predictions and attributions to be aligned with chemical identity. However, chemically equivalent drawings of the same molecule can induce different molecular representations, leading to inconsistent predictions and explanations. Here, we introduce InChIfied Invariants, a class of node, edge, and graph features based on the International Chemical Identifier (InChI) and designed to be invariant under transformations that preserve chemical identity. Using one million molecular graphs from PubChem Substances, we show that InChIfied Invariants produce identical representations for chemically equivalent graphs in 99.62% of cases, whereas standard Daylight invariants do so in only 0.35% of cases. Across MoleculeNet tasks, InChIfied Invariants preserve predictive performance while significantly improving prediction consistency across alternative graph depictions of the same molecules. We further perform a quantitative attribution analysis and show that explanations produced with standard molecular featurization methods vary substantially across chemically equivalent graphs, while InChIfied Invariants enforce consistent attributions by construction. We release open-source software implementing InChIfied Invariants, which can be used as a drop-in replacement for standard molecular graph features.

AI.tldr: 本文提出InChIfied Invariants，一种基于InChI的节点、边和图特征，能够对化学等价的分子图产生一致的表征（99.62% vs Daylight的0.35%），在保持预测性能的同时显著提升预测和归因的一致性，可作为标准分子图特征的即插即用替代方案。
AI.motivation: 化学等价的分子图因不同的绘制方式导致分子表征不同，进而产生不一致的预测和解释，这与化学本质相悖。
AI.method: 基于国际化学标识符（InChI）设计节点、边和图级别的特征（InChIfied Invariants），使其在保持化学身份的所有变换下保持不变，作为标准分子图特征的即插即用替代方案。
AI.result: 在100万分子图上，InChIfied Invariants对化学等价图的表征一致率达99.62%（Daylight仅0.35%）；在MoleculeNet任务上保持预测性能并显著提升预测一致性；归因分析表明其强制产生一致的归因解释。
AI.conclusion: InChIfied Invariants有效解决了分子图机器学习中因表示方式不同导致的预测和解释不一致问题，且易于集成到现有流程中。

title: Motion-Compensated Weight Compression
summary: Neural network weights are increasingly a bottleneck for deployment, yet most compression pipelines treat layers independently and overlook cross-layer redundancy induced by function-preserving symmetries. We propose Motion-Compensated Weight Compression (MCWC), a weight-only codec that aligns permutation-symmetric blocks (e.g., hidden units and attention heads) to maximize cross-layer correspondence, turning depth into a predictable sequence. In the aligned coordinate system, MCWC uses a lightweight layer-sequential predictor with periodic keyframes and encodes only quantized prediction residuals using a learned entropy model trained under a rate distortion objective. A simple decoder reconstructs deployable weights by entropy decoding, dequantization, predictor-driven reconstruction, and inverse alignment, enabling fast weight materialization for inference. Across Transformer language modeling and vision classification, MCWC improves the rate accuracy Pareto frontier over strong quantization and learned weight-codec baselines, while maintaining competitive decode time. Ablations confirm that alignment, prediction, entropy modeling, and keyframe scheduling are each necessary for the full gains. Our code is available via https://github.com/Ism-ail11/MCWC.

AI.tldr: 提出运动补偿权重压缩（MCWC），一种利用置换对称性对齐跨层权重块、通过层序预测和熵编码实现高效权重压缩的编解码器，在Transformer语言模型和视觉分类任务上优于现有量化与编码基线。
AI.motivation: 神经网络权重部署日益成为瓶颈，现有压缩方法逐层独立处理，忽略了由函数保持对称性引起的跨层冗余。
AI.method: MCWC将置换对称块（如隐藏单元、注意力头）对齐以最大化跨层对应，将深度转为可预测序列；在对齐坐标系中使用轻量层序预测器（含周期性关键帧），对量化预测残差进行熵编码（学习型熵模型，率失真目标优化）；解码器通过熵解码、反量化、预测重建和逆对齐恢复权重。
AI.result: 在Transformer语言建模和视觉分类任务上，MCWC在率-准确率帕累托前沿上优于强量化和学习型权重编码基线，同时保持竞争性解码时间。
AI.conclusion: 消融实验证实对齐、预测、熵建模和关键帧调度对完整增益均不可或缺。代码已开源。

title: Bilevel Optimization of Synthetic Trajectories for Multi-Turn LLM Fine-Tuning
summary: While LLMs excel at single-turn generation, they struggle with long-horizon, multi-turn interactions. Offline reinforcement learning (RL) offers a scalable approach, yet its performance hinges on the availability and quality of multi-turn trajectory data. A common remedy is to augment training with synthetic trajectories generated by LLMs or simulators, but synthetic data is highly heterogeneous in quality, and naively treating all trajectories as equally informative can degrade performance. We propose BOOST, a bilevel optimization framework where the inner level trains the LLM on reweighted data and the outer level trains a lightweight reweighting head on held-out real validation tasks, assigning continuous trajectory-level weights without requiring an external judge. To ground this approach, we derive a PAC-Bayesian bound revealing a three-way trade-off: synthetic data increases diversity but risks task-shift, while concentrating weight on high-quality trajectories improves empirical performance at the cost of effective sample size. Empirically, our method consistently outperforms multiple baselines. Analysis reveals it upweights synthetic trajectories that align with the real data distribution and exhibit higher qualitative merit.

AI.tldr: 提出BOOST框架，通过双层优化对异构质量的合成轨迹数据赋予自适应权重，有效利用离线强化学习训练LLM进行多轮交互。
AI.motivation: LLM在长程多轮交互中表现不佳，离线RL虽可扩展但依赖高质量多轮轨迹数据，而合成轨迹数据质量异构，简单等权使用会降低性能。
AI.method: 提出BOOST双层优化框架：内层在加权数据上训练LLM，外层在真实验证任务上训练轻量级重加权头，持续分配轨迹级权重，无需外部裁判。
AI.result: 方法一致优于多个基线；分析表明其会提升与真实数据分布对齐且质量更高的合成轨迹的权重。
AI.conclusion: 推导PAC-Bayesian界揭示三重权衡：合成数据增加多样性但存在任务漂移风险，集中权重于高质量轨迹提升经验性能但降低有效样本量；BOOST有效平衡这三者。

title: A computational phase transition for learning-to-sample from Ising models
summary: We study \emph{learning-to-sample} -- a basic algorithmic task underlying generative modeling -- for Ising models, a standard testbed for algorithmic ideas in both theoretical computer science and machine learning. Given i.i.d. samples of an unknown target distribution, the goal of learning-to-sample is to learn a computationally efficient generation procedure that produces new samples following approximately the same distribution. We construct a family of Ising models of constantly bounded-width which lie just beyond the spectral threshold $λ_{\max}(J)-λ_{\min}(J)=1$, and show that learning-to-sample for this family is computationally hard under standard cryptographic assumptions, even when the learner is given both polynomially many i.i.d. samples from the model and explicit access to its parameters. Combined with results of [AJKPV24,KLV25] showing tractability of learning-to-sample below the spectral threshold, this establishes a sharp computational phase transition at the spectral threshold. Moreover, combined with prior results on parameter learning for bounded-width Ising models [KM17,WSD19,VML20], this shows that learning-to-sample can be more difficult than parameter learning. Finally, we show that any efficient learner for these hard instances exhibits a natural memorization-hallucination dichotomy: the learner must either output configurations that, after a simple transformation, match the (transformed) training data or place substantial mass on configurations of negligible probability under the target distribution.

AI.tldr: 本文研究Ising模型中的"学习采样"问题。构造了刚好位于谱阈值之上的有界宽度Ising模型族，并证明在标准密码学假设下，即使给定多项式数量的独立同分布样本和模型参数显式访问，学习采样在计算上仍是困难的。结合谱阈值以下的可解性结果，建立了谱阈值处的尖锐计算相变。此外，与参数学习结果对比表明学习采样可能比参数学习更困难。最后，证明任何高效学习器都会表现出"记忆-幻觉"二分法：要么输出与（变换后）训练数据匹配的配置，要么在目标分布中概率可忽略的配置上放置显著质量。
AI.motivation: 理解生成建模的基本算法任务——学习采样——的计算复杂性，特别是确定在何种条件下该任务是可处理的，以及在何种条件下是计算困难的。通过Ising模型这一标准测试平台，探索计算相变现象。
AI.method: 构造一族有界宽度的Ising模型，其谱参数刚好超过阈值λ_max(J)-λ_min(J)=1。利用标准密码学假设（如LWE等）证明学习该族模型的计算下界。通过与谱阈值以下的可解性结果对比，以及参数学习结果的对比，建立计算相变和任务间难度差异。
AI.result: 在谱阈值之上，学习采样是计算困难的（基于标准密码学假设）；而在谱阈值以下，学习采样是可处理的。学习采样可能比参数学习更困难。任何高效学习器必须要么记忆（变换后的）训练数据，要么在低概率配置上产生幻觉。
AI.conclusion: 学习采样在Ising模型中存在以谱阈值为界的尖锐计算相变，且该任务可能比参数学习更难。这一结果为生成模型的计算复杂性理论提供了基本见解，揭示了学习与采样之间深刻的计算鸿沟。

title: 4KLSDB: A Large-Scale Dataset for 4K Image Restoration and Generation
comment: Accepted to the DataCV Workshop at CVPR 2026; 10 pages, 4 figures, 7 tables; Our project page is available at: https://4klsdb.github.io/
summary: High-resolution datasets are essential for advancing super-resolution (SR) and text-to-image (T2I) diffusion research. However, current publicly available datasets lack both the native 4K resolution and the extensive scale necessary for training state-of-the-art models. To address this gap, we introduce a 4K Large Scale Dataset and Benchmark (4KLSDB), a large-scale, diverse dataset consisting of 129,484 carefully curated 4K resolution images spanning multiple categories such as nature, urban scenes, people, food, artwork, and CGI, alongside distinct validation and test sets containing 2,000 and 1,984 images respectively. Images were sourced from established open datasets including Photo Concept Bucket, Laion2B, and PD12M. 4KLSDB underwent rigorous multi-stage automated filtering and annotation pipelines involving both human annotators and Large Multimodal Models (LMMs) to ensure high aesthetic quality and dataset consistency. We demonstrate 4KLSDB's effectiveness by training representative super-resolution and diffusion models, observing significant improvements in performance on native 4K benchmarks. Comprehensive experiments illustrate a positive correlation between training on true 4K resolution data and improved fidelity in image restoration task, especially on 4K resolution. We provide the research community a valuable resource to drive progress toward genuinely high-fidelity image synthesis and restoration by providing 4KLSDB. Our project page is available at: https://4klsdb.github.io/.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了4KLSDB，一个包含129,484张4K分辨率图像的大规模数据集，涵盖自然、城市、人物等多个类别，通过多阶段自动过滤和人工+LMM标注流程确保质量，实验证明在该数据集上训练的SR和T2I模型在4K基准上性能显著提升。
AI.motivation: 现有公开数据集缺乏原生4K分辨率和大规模样本量，无法满足超分辨率和文生图扩散模型对高质量训练数据的需求。
AI.method: 从Photo Concept Bucket、Laion2B、PD12M等开放数据集中筛选129,484张4K图像，经过多阶段自动化过滤和由人类标注员与大型多模态模型(LMMs)共同参与的标注流程，构建了包含验证集(2,000张)和测试集(1,984张)的4KLSDB。
AI.result: 在4KLSDB上训练的超分辨率和扩散模型在原生4K基准上取得显著性能提升，实验表明训练数据采用真实4K分辨率与图像恢复任务的保真度之间存在正相关关系。
AI.conclusion: 4KLSDB为研究社区提供了有价值的资源，可推动高保真图像合成与复原领域的发展。

title: A Contractive Feedback Semantics for Reinforcement Learning
summary: Discounted reinforcement learning is usually presented through Bellman equations on closed Markov decision processes. This paper develops a compositional view: a one-step decision process is treated as an open stochastic component, and infinite-horizon policy evaluation is obtained by closing a contractive feedback loop. The resulting semantics assigns typed Bellman transformers to open components, interprets series and parallel wiring as composition and tensoring of transformers, and interprets feedback as an admissible guarded Banach trace realized by a unique fixed point. This perspective yields three theoretical consequences. First, approximate component equivalence is a contextual congruence for admitted well-typed guarded one-hole contexts: local operator error remains controlled after plugging the component into a surrounding circuit that uses the hole once and whose feedback nodes have certified uniform guardedness. Second, exact and approximate state abstractions become commuting or near-commuting coalgebraic diagrams, giving value-preservation and explicit sup-norm distortion bounds. Third, under monotone $ω$-continuous contract-transformer semantics, safety, risk, and resource specifications can be represented as quantale-valued contracts, where local inductive bounds lift through wiring and feedback by least-fixed-point reasoning. Its central claim is not that all RL morphisms form a global traced monoidal category, but that discounted Bellman evaluation admits a contractive feedback semantics on the admissible class of guarded circuits.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种组合性的视角来理解折扣强化学习中的贝尔曼评估，将一步决策过程视为开放随机组件，通过收缩反馈闭环实现无限时域策略评估，并建立了类型化的贝尔曼变换子语义，从而在近似等价、状态抽象和契约语义三个方面产生了理论成果。
AI.motivation: 传统的折扣强化学习通常通过闭马尔可夫决策过程上的贝尔曼方程来呈现，缺乏组合性视角。本文旨在为策略评估建立一种基于开放随机组件和收缩反馈的组合语义框架。
AI.method: 将一步决策过程视为开放随机组件，通过收缩反馈闭环实现无限时域策略评估；为开放组件赋予类型化的贝尔曼变换子语义，将串联和并联布线解释为变换子的组合和张量积，将反馈解释为受控的加性巴拿赫迹（通过唯一不动点实现）。
AI.result: 三个理论结果：(1) 近似组件等价在受控有界单孔上下文中是上下文同余，局部算子误差在插入电路后仍受控；(2) 精确和近似状态抽象成为交换或近似交换的余代数图，给出值保持性和显式上确界范数误差界；(3) 在单调ω-连续契约变换子语义下，安全性、风险和资源规约可表示为量子值契约，局部归纳界通过最小不动点推理提升至布线和反馈。
AI.conclusion: 核心主张并非所有RL态射构成全局迹幺半范畴，而是折扣贝尔曼评估在受控有界电路类上 admits 一种收缩反馈语义。

title: Leveraging pretrained RGB denoisers for hyperspectral image restoration
summary: Hyperspectral image restoration faces several challenges, including limited training data, strong sensor specificity, and high spectral dimensionality. These limitations hinder the learning of robust hyperspectral priors, motivating the reuse of priors learned from large-scale RGB data. In this work, we propose a minimally trained, lightweight adapter that repurposes frozen pretrained RGB denoisers for hyperspectral restoration through a projection mapping. The method denoises low-dimensional spectral projections and reconstructs the hyperspectral cube through constrained linear aggregation, while preserving plug-and-play compatibility and the stability properties of the underlying RGB denoiser. Experiments on denoising, deblurring, and super-resolution across multiple datasets demonstrate consistent improvements over hyperspectral-specific baselines, showing the strong transferability of large-scale RGB priors.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种轻量级适配器，通过投影映射将冻结的预训练RGB去噪器复用于高光谱图像恢复任务，仅需少量训练即可在去噪、去模糊和超分辨率任务上超越高光谱专用方法。
AI.motivation: 高光谱图像恢复面临训练数据有限、传感器特异性强、光谱维度高等挑战，难以学习鲁棒的高光谱先验，因此希望复用从大规模RGB数据中学到的先验。
AI.method: 提出一种轻量级适配器，通过投影映射将冻结的预训练RGB去噪器复用于高光谱恢复；对低维光谱投影进行去噪，通过约束线性聚合重建高光谱立方体，保持即插即用兼容性和原RGB去噪器的稳定性。
AI.result: 在去噪、去模糊和超分辨率任务上，在多个数据集上均一致超越高光谱专用基线方法，证明了大规模RGB先验的强迁移能力。
AI.conclusion: 大规模RGB先验可通过轻量适配器有效迁移至高光谱恢复任务，为缓解高光谱数据稀缺问题提供了可行方案。
