title: High-fidelity Modeling of Full-scale Pressurized Water Reactor Flow Fields for Machine Learning Applications
summary: This work presents a high-fidelity computational fluid dynamics (CFD) and data-driven modeling framework for assembly-level flow characterization in a four-loop pressurized water reactor (PWR). A full lower-plenum and core-inlet domain was constructed using publicly available geometry and operating conditions, enabling transient simulations with pump-induced swirl boundary conditions. The results show that cold-leg swirl and lower-plenum transport generate strongly heterogeneous assembly-wise inlet flow distributions, particularly near the lower core region, while axial resistance and mixing progressively homogenize the flow at higher elevations. These physics-informed datasets were subsequently used to evaluate machine learning (ML) applications for partial field reconstruction and short-term autoregressive prediction. A 3D convolutional-based inpainting model successfully recon-structed missing assembly-level mass flow rates from partial observations, with errors concentrated in the highly turbulent base (bottom) layer and diminishing significantly in upper layers. Comparative analysis across multiple ML models demon-strates that spatially aware architectures, particularly ConvLSTM, significantly outperform sequence-based (LSTM) and operator-learning (DeepONet) approaches by effectively capturing coupled spatio-temporal dynamics. The study also high-lights key challenges, including the sensitivity of inlet flow predictions to turbulence and mesh resolution, as well as the absence of full-scale experimental validation data. Despite these limitations, the results remain consistent with expected physical behavior. Overall, this work establishes high-fidelity CFD as a critical foundation for developing data-driven surrogates, sparse sensing strategies, and future multiphysics coupling frameworks.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了四环路压水堆下腔室及堆芯入口的高保真CFD模型，结合数据驱动方法进行组件级流动表征。模拟揭示了冷腿涡流导致的异质性入口流量分布，并评估了多种机器学习模型（ConvLSTM、LSTM、DeepONet）在流场重建和预测中的表现，发现ConvLSTM等空间感知架构在捕捉时空耦合动力学方面显著优于其他方法。
AI.motivation: 现有方法难以准确表征反应堆组件级的入口流量分布异质性，且缺乏高保真数据支撑数据驱动代理模型的开发。本研究旨在通过CFD生成物理信息数据集，并评估机器学习在流场部分重建和短期预测中的适用性。
AI.method: 构建基于公开几何与运行条件的四环路压水堆全下腔室及堆芯入口域，进行含泵致涡边界条件的瞬态CFD模拟。随后利用3D卷积修复模型（inpainting）进行缺失流量重建，并对比ConvLSTM、LSTM、DeepONet等多种ML模型的时空预测性能。
AI.result: 冷腿涡流与下腔室输运产生强异质性组件级入口流量分布，尤其在堆芯底部区域；轴向阻力和混合作用在高处逐渐均质化。3D卷积修复模型成功重建缺失流量，误差集中于高湍流底层并随高度显著减小。ConvLSTM在捕捉时空耦合动力学方面显著优于LSTM和DeepONet。湍流和网格分辨率对入口流动预测敏感，且缺乏全尺度实验验证数据。
AI.conclusion: 高保真CFD可作为数据驱动代理模型、稀疏传感策略及未来多物理场耦合框架的关键基础。本研究揭示了空间感知架构在反应堆流动建模中的优势，同时指出湍流敏感性及验证数据缺失等关键挑战。

title: From Theory to Decision Rule: Calibrating the Noisy-Label Crossover for Vision-Language Model Weak Supervision Across Three Medical-Imaging Benchmarks
summary: Classical noisy-label theory predicts that downstream performance under weak supervision is bounded above by the labeler's accuracy, implying a sharp crossover: once a gold-trained classifier matches the labeler, weak labels stop helping and start hurting. The prediction is theoretical; what is missing is a benchmark calibration that turns it into an instance-level statement for modern foundation-model labelers. We provide such a calibration for BiomedCLIP-generated weak labels on three medical-imaging benchmarks (PCAM, ISIC, NIH-CXR) and six downstream architectures spanning an 11x parameter range. The crossover predicted by theory appears at ng~100 on PCAM, 20-50 on ISIC, and 250-500 on NIH-CXR; weak labels above the crossover degrade AUC by up to -0.10. The location is architecture-invariant for four of five pretrained architectures, and a within-family DenseNet sweep (2.5x parameters, identical pretraining) supports the view that the labeler, not the student, is the dominant constraint. The calibration in turn produces a decision rule operable from 10-20 gold labels: compare gold-only AUC to VLM accuracy on the user's gold set. A structured-vs-random noise sign flip on NIH-CXR shows that the rate-only formulation of the bound is incomplete and identifies a concrete refinement (label-space projection) that future benchmarks can be designed to test.

AI.tldr: 本文通过校准实验验证了经典弱监督学习理论中关于性能交叉点的预测，在BiomedCLIP生成的弱标签下，发现交叉点出现在不同的样本量区间，且标签者（而非学生模型）是主导约束，同时揭示了仅基于噪声率的理论公式存在缺陷，需要标签空间投影的补充。
AI.motivation: 经典噪声标签理论预测弱监督性能存在一个交叉点：当学生模型达到标签者的精度后，弱标签反而有害。但该预测缺乏针对现代基础模型标签者的实例级基准校准，本文旨在填补这一空白。
AI.method: 使用BiomedCLIP生成的弱标签，在三个医学影像基准（PCAM、ISIC、NIH-CXR）上，对六种跨越11倍参数范围的下游架构进行系统实验校准，并设计了结构噪声与随机噪声的对比实验。
AI.result: 交叉点出现在PCAM约100个标注、ISIC 20-50个、NIH-CXR 250-500个；超过交叉点的弱标签使AUC下降最多-0.10。交叉点位置对四种预训练架构具有不变性，DenseNet族内实验支持标签者而非学生是主导约束。提出了基于10-20个金标签即可操作的决策规则。在NIH-CXR上发现结构噪声与随机噪声的符号翻转现象。
AI.conclusion: 理论预测的交叉点在实际中确实存在且可校准；仅基于噪声率的理论公式不完整，需要引入标签空间投影的细化；未来基准设计应测试这一细化方向。

title: Muon in Vision Transformers: Optimizer-Recipe Interactions and Gradient Spectra
summary: Muon is a recently developed matrix-aware optimizer that has shown strong results in transformer training, but its behavior in vision transformers (ViTs) is not yet well understood. We study Muon for ViT training, largely on ImageNet-100 and Pl@ntNet-300K, comparing against AdamW under standard vision recipes involving mixup, cutmix, smoothing, and random augmentation and erasing. Muon consistently outperforms AdamW, with especially large gains on long-tailed Pl@ntNet macro top-1. These gains are also recipe-dependent, where Muon benefits much more than AdamW from advanced and significant data augmentation techniques. To understand this interaction, we analyze the singular-value structure of matrix gradients throughout the ViT. Within Muon training runs, removing heavy data augmentation induces a late-training spectral concentration and mode collapse in gradient matrices, primarily in deep MLP-down blocks. Under a fixed "full" augmentation recipe, the clearest Muon-AdamW contrast appears instead in QKV gradients, where AdamW gradient energy remains concentrated in a much narrower basis while Muon spreads energy across substantially more singular modes. Muon in ViTs is therefore best understood as an optimizer-recipe interaction. Under a fixed recipe, Muon differs from AdamW most clearly in attention projections, where its gradients consist of a broader spectral basis. Within Muon, a full training recipe is important for preventing late spectral concentration and mode collapse in deep feedforward blocks. We further demonstrate efficacy in training ViTs on image segmentation and masked autoencoder models, where Muon outperforms AdamW in all settings considered.

AI.tldr: Muon优化器在视觉Transformer训练中优于AdamW，尤其在长尾数据集上表现显著；其优势依赖数据增强策略，通过分析梯度奇异值结构发现：Muon在全增强下注意力投影梯度谱更宽，而缺乏增强会导致深层MLP块出现后期谱集中和模式坍缩。
AI.motivation: Muon作为新型矩阵感知优化器在Transformer训练中表现优异，但在视觉Transformer（ViT）中的行为尚未被充分理解，因此需要系统研究其在ViT训练中的表现与机理。
AI.method: 在ImageNet-100和Pl@ntNet-300K上对比Muon与AdamW，使用mixup、cutmix、标签平滑、随机增强等标准视觉训练策略；通过分析梯度矩阵的奇异值结构，研究数据增强与优化器之间的交互作用。
AI.result: Muon一致优于AdamW，在长尾数据集Pl@ntNet的macro top-1上提升尤为显著；Muon比AdamW更受益于高级数据增强；缺乏增强时Muon训练后期出现梯度谱集中和模式坍缩（主要在深层MLP-down块）；全增强下Muon与AdamW差异主要在QKV梯度，AdamW能量集中在更窄基空间而Muon分布在更宽奇异模态上。
AI.conclusion: Muon在ViT中的效果是优化器与数据增强策略的交互结果；全增强配方对防止Muon在深层前馈块中的后期谱集中和模式坍缩至关重要；Muon在图像分割和掩码自编码器任务中也优于AdamW。

title: How Noisy Poses Break Inverse Dynamics: Analysis and Mitigation for Video-Based Joint Torque Estimation
summary: Recent advances in monocular 3D human pose estimation enable accurate body tracking from video. However, translating these kinematic estimates into physical quantities, such as joint torques, remains challenging due to noise amplification through inverse dynamics. In this work, we provide a systematic analysis of how pose estimation noise propagates through the inverse dynamics pipeline. We present three key findings: (1) pose noise is amplified by approximately 1,000x when computing joint torques via numerical differentiation, (2) proximal joints (spine, hips) are up to 10x more sensitive to noise than distal joints (wrists, hands), and (3) low-pass filtering before differentiation substantially reduces this amplification. To enable this analysis, we develop SMPL-Dynamics, a fully differentiable inverse dynamics module for the SMPL body model that requires no external physics simulators. Our module supports end-to-end gradient computation, and we demonstrate this through differentiable pose refinement, which reduces torque error by 93% with negligible change in pose.

AI.tldr: 本文系统分析了单目3D人体姿态估计中的噪声如何通过逆动力学传播到关节力矩计算，发现噪声被放大约1000倍且近端关节更敏感；通过开发可微分的SMPL-Dynamics模块和姿态细化方法，将力矩误差降低了93%。
AI.motivation: 单目3D人体姿态估计虽然在运动跟踪方面取得了进展，但将运动学估计转换为关节力矩等物理量时，逆动力学过程会显著放大噪声，目前缺乏对这一噪声传播过程的系统性分析。
AI.method: (1) 系统分析了姿态估计噪声通过逆动力学的传播规律；(2) 开发了SMPL-Dynamics，一个基于SMPL人体模型的全可微逆动力学模块，无需外部物理模拟器；(3) 提出了可微分的姿态细化方法。
AI.result: (1) 姿态噪声通过数值微分计算关节力矩时被放大约1000倍；(2) 近端关节（脊柱、髋部）比远端关节（腕部、手部）对噪声敏感10倍以上；(3) 低通滤波能显著降低噪声放大；(4) 可微分姿态细化在几乎不改变姿态的情况下将力矩误差降低93%。
AI.conclusion: 开发了一个无需外部物理模拟器的全可微逆动力学模块SMPL-Dynamics，证明了通过可微分姿态细化可以有效降低力矩计算误差，为将运动学估计可靠地转换为物理量提供了可行方案。

title: Hermite-NGP: Gradient-Augmented Hash Encoding for Learning PDEs
summary: We propose Hermite-NGP, a gradient-augmented multi-resolution hash encoding designed to enable fast and accurate computation of spatial derivatives for neural PDE solvers. Unlike existing NGP-based approaches that rely on automatic differentiation or finite differences and suffer from instability or high cost, Hermite-NGP explicitly stores function values and mixed partial derivatives at hash grid vertices, allowing fully analytic evaluation of gradients, Jacobians, and Hessians via Hermite interpolation. This design preserves the efficiency and spatial adaptivity of NGP while supporting analytic differential operators up to second order. We further introduce a multi-resolution curriculum training strategy analogous to multigrid V-cycles to enable coarse-to-fine optimization. Across a range of 2D and 3D PDE benchmarks, Hermite-NGP achieves up to approximately 20 times lower error than prior neural PDE methods, and reduces wall-clock convergence time by 2 to 10 times compared to other solvers, with per-epoch training times as low as 3.5 ms for models with up to 17M parameters.

AI.tldr: Hermite-NGP是一种梯度增强的多分辨率哈希编码方法，通过在网格顶点显式存储函数值和混合偏导数，利用Hermite插值实现二阶解析微分算子计算，配合多分辨率课程训练策略，在神经PDE求解中实现最高20倍误差降低和2-10倍收敛加速。
AI.motivation: 现有基于NGP的方法依赖自动微分或有限差分计算空间导数，存在不稳定或计算成本高的问题，亟需一种既能保持NGP高效性和空间自适应性、又能快速准确计算高阶空间导数的神经PDE求解方案。
AI.method: 1) 在哈希网格顶点显式存储函数值和混合偏导数；2) 通过Hermite插值实现梯度、雅可比矩阵和海森矩阵的全解析计算；3) 采用类似多重网格V-cycle的多分辨率课程训练策略，实现从粗到细的优化。
AI.result: 在2D和3D PDE基准测试中，Hermite-NGP相比现有神经PDE方法误差降低最高约20倍；与其他求解器相比，壁钟收敛时间缩短2-10倍；对于高达1700万参数的模型，每轮训练时间低至3.5毫秒。
AI.conclusion: Hermite-NGP成功将解析微分算子引入多分辨率哈希编码框架，在保持NGP高效性的同时显著提升神经PDE求解的精度和收敛速度，为大规模PDE求解提供了一种高效可靠的方案。

title: Self-Supervised Contrastive Learning for Cardiac MR Sequence Classification
summary: Vision Transformer (ViT) models, utilizing self-attention mechanisms, have demonstrated robust generalization capabilities across various vision tasks, including image classification. However, these models, typically pretrained on general public datasets, often lack the specialized domain knowledge necessary for medical imaging applications. In this study, we investigate the adaptation of ViT models, specifically for cardiac magnetic resonance (MR) images, using an in-house dataset. We found that pretrained ViT features do not effectively transfer to the cardiac MR domain. To overcome this limitation, we introduce an adaptation strategy that utilizes image-based self-supervised contrastive learning, demonstrating superior performance compared to traditional supervised training approaches. Moreover, our adapted ViT model exhibits strong generalization to external MR datasets such as BraTS and ADNI. Through ablation studies, we further investigate the impact of batch size and dataset scale on performance. Ultimately, our adapted model achieves classification AUC exceeding 0.75 across the four most common cardiac MR sequences.

AI.tldr: 本研究探索了将Vision Transformer (ViT)模型适配到心脏磁共振（MR）图像领域，发现预训练ViT特征无法有效迁移至心脏MR领域，因此提出基于图像的自监督对比学习适配策略，该方法优于传统监督训练，在外部MR数据集（BraTS、ADNI）上表现良好，最终在四种常见心脏MR序列上实现了超过0.75的分类AUC。
AI.motivation: ViT模型在通用视觉任务中表现优异，但在医学影像领域缺乏领域专用知识，需要研究如何将ViT有效适配到心脏MR图像等医学影像域。
AI.method: 采用基于图像的自监督对比学习作为适配策略，利用内部数据集对预训练ViT模型进行领域适应，并与传统监督训练方法进行对比。
AI.result: 适配后的ViT模型在四种常见心脏MR序列上分类AUC超过0.75，且在外部MR数据集（BraTS和ADNI）上表现出良好的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 自监督对比学习能有效将ViT模型从通用领域适配到心脏MR领域，优于传统监督训练方法，且模型具有良好的跨数据集泛化能力。

title: Complement Submodular Information Measures for Balanced and Robust Data Selection
summary:
Submodular optimization has become a fundamental paradigm for data selection, retrieval, summarization, and representation learning due to its ability to model coverage, diversity, and representativeness. However, classical submodular objectives optimize only the selected subset and do not explicitly preserve structural information between the selected subset and the remaining data. In many modern machine learning applications, including train/validation/test splitting, benchmark construction, and robust subset selection, the quality of a selection depends critically on preserving balanced structure across both the selected subset and its complement.
  In this work, we introduce Complement Submodular Information (CSI), a new class of complement-aware submodular objectives that quantify shared structural information between a subset and its complement. Our framework induces complement-aware variants of several classical submodular functions including Facility Location, Graph Cut, LogDet, Saturated Coverage, Set Cover, Probabilistic Set Cover, and Feature Based Functions. We analyze the theoretical properties of CSI objectives and show that they exhibit approximate monotonicity under bounded curvature conditions, leading to near-$(1-1/e)$ greedy approximation guarantees.
  Empirically, CSI objectives consistently outperform standard submodular objectives on robust hidden-slice-aware subset selection. In particular, CSI objectives significantly improve preservation of coherent rare/tail semantic structure while simultaneously suppressing noisy and isolated outliers, leading to substantially improved downstream predictive performance. Synthetic experiments further illustrate how different CSI instantiations capture complementary notions of representativeness, diversity, connectivity, and balanced neighborhood preservation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出互补子模信息（CSI）——一类新的互补感知子模目标函数，能够量化子集与其补集之间的共享结构信息。CSI诱导了多种经典子模函数的互补感知变体，在理论上有近似单调性和近似保证，实验表明其在鲁棒子集选择中优于标准子模目标，能更好地保留稀有语义结构并抑制噪声异常值。
AI.motivation: 经典子模优化仅优化所选子集本身，未能显式保留所选子集与剩余数据之间的结构信息。在许多现代机器学习应用（如训练/验证/测试集划分、基准构建、鲁棒子集选择）中，选择质量关键取决于在所选子集及其补集之间保持平衡的结构。
AI.method: 提出Complement Submodular Information (CSI)框架，定义了一类新的互补感知子模目标函数，量化子集与其补集间的共享结构信息。对Facility Location、Graph Cut、LogDet、Saturated Coverage、Set Cover、Probabilistic Set Cover、Feature Based Functions等经典子模函数诱导了互补感知变体。理论分析证明了有界曲率条件下的近似单调性，从而获得近$(1-1/e)$的贪婪近似保证。
AI.result: 在鲁棒隐藏切片感知子集选择任务中，CSI目标一致优于标准子模目标。显著提升了相干稀有/尾部语义结构的保留，同时有效抑制噪声和孤立异常值，从而大幅改善下游预测性能。合成实验展示了不同CSI实例如何捕获表示性、多样性、连通性和平衡邻域保持的互补概念。
AI.conclusion: CSI框架通过纳入补集结构信息拓展了子模优化的适用范围，在需要平衡子集与补集结构的场景中提供了更优的理论保证与实证性能。

title: Parameter-Efficient VLMs for Gastrointestinal Endoscopy: Medical Image Generation and Clinical Visual Question Answering
summary: The major limitations of gastrointestinal (GI) endoscopy AI systems arise from a shortage of annotated data, strict privacy policies, and significant bottlenecks in conventional model fine-tuning. Such limitations impede the successful application of sophisticated AI models in clinical practice, particularly affecting the reliability and scalability of diagnosis. In this paper, we present a dual-pipeline PEFT model that addresses two fundamental problems: medical Visual Question Answering (VQA) and the generation of privacy-preserving synthetic data. For clinical VQA, we adopt the Florence-2 vision-language model. Leveraging PEFT enhances model interpretability while substantially reducing the computational cost of training. Simultaneously, we employ Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) with Stable Diffusion 2.1 to generate high-quality GI images that enhance training databases without violating patient privacy. This research utilized the Kvasir-VQA dataset. Our Florence-2 VQA model achieved ROUGE-1 of 0.92, ROUGE-L of 0.91, and BLEU score improvements from 0.08 to 0.24. Fine-tuning on private datasets consistently showed better results than fine-tuning on public datasets. The rank-4 LoRA synthesis achieved optimal performance with a fidelity score of 0.290, an agreement score of 0.730, and a Frechet BiomedCLIP Distance (FBD) of 1450, reducing computational costs by almost 90 percent. This framework improves the clinical potential of AI in GI endoscopy. Compared to FLUX, MSDM, and Kandinsky 2.2, our model demonstrates superior FBD and strong semantic alignment. While other models lead in Fidelity or Agreement, our lower FBD indicates better image-text coherence. These results establish our approach as a robust solution for enhancing VQA and synthetic data generation in clinical AI.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种双流水线PEFT框架，结合Florence-2视觉语言模型（用于临床VQA）和LoRA微调的Stable Diffusion 2.1（用于隐私保护合成数据生成），在Kvasir-VQA数据集上实现ROUGE-1=0.92、ROUGE-L=0.91、BLEU从0.08提升至0.24，合成图像FBD=1450，计算成本降低约90%。
AI.motivation: 胃肠道内镜AI系统面临标注数据匮乏、严格隐私政策和传统模型微调瓶颈三大限制，阻碍了AI模型在临床实践中的可靠性和可扩展性。
AI.method: 采用双流水线PEFT框架：(1) 基于Florence-2的VQA模型，通过PEFT降低计算成本并提升可解释性；(2) 使用LoRA微调Stable Diffusion 2.1生成高质量胃肠道合成图像，在不违反隐私前提下扩充训练数据库。
AI.result: VQA任务：ROUGE-1=0.92, ROUGE-L=0.91, BLEU从0.08提升至0.24；合成任务（rank-4 LoRA）：Fidelity=0.290, Agreement=0.730, FBD=1450，计算成本降低约90%；与FLUX、MSDM、Kandinsky 2.2相比，模型在FBD和语义对齐方面表现更优。
AI.conclusion: 该框架有效提升了AI在胃肠道内镜中的临床潜力，为增强临床VQA和合成数据生成提供了稳健解决方案。

title: The Perception-Physics Paradox: Probing Scientific Alignment with TC-Bench
summary: While Vision Foundation Models (VFMs) excel at predictive tasks on satellite imagery, their performance can arise from visual correlations rather than underlying structural invariants, making even perception-based out-of-distribution accuracy a poor proxy for scientific utility. As a result, models may look correct without reasoning correctly, a discrepancy we term the Perception-Physics Paradox. To address this gap, we introduce scientific alignment as an implicit objective for representation learning in scientific domains. We study a principled, testable aspect of scientific alignment through structural isomorphism, which requires latent representations to uniquely identify physical systems up to a linear reparameterization. This perspective induces a hierarchy of necessary conditions and yields a systematic probing protocol for physical and causal interpretability. To operationalize this framework, we release TC-Bench, a global, reproducible benchmark dataset with an automated construction pipeline for tropical cyclone research, and show that current VFMs rely on visual shortcuts that collapse in intense regimes, indicating that scientific alignment does not arise as a natural byproduct of scaling alone.

AI.tldr: 本文提出“感知-物理悖论”：视觉基础模型在卫星图像上表现良好但可能依赖视觉捷径而非物理因果机制。为此引入科学对齐概念，通过结构同构性要求潜在表征唯一标识物理系统（线性重参数化下），构建TC-Bench数据集并验证当前VFM在强气旋区域因视觉捷径而失效，表明科学对齐无法单纯通过规模扩展自然获得。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉基础模型（VFM）在卫星图像预测任务上表现优异，但其性能可能源自视觉相关性而非底层结构不变性，导致感知层面的分布外准确率无法反映科学实用性。模型可能看起来正确但推理错误，即“感知-物理悖论”，需要弥合这一差距。
AI.method: 1) 提出科学对齐作为科学领域表征学习的隐式目标；2) 通过结构同构性（要求潜在表征在线性重参数化下唯一标识物理系统）实现对齐；3) 建立必要条件层次和物理/因果可解释性的系统探测协议；4) 构建TC-Bench（全球可复现的热带气旋基准数据集及自动构建流程）进行实证评估。
AI.result: 当前VFM依赖视觉捷径，在强气旋（极端强度）区域性能崩溃，表明科学对齐不会随着模型规模扩大而自然涌现。
AI.conclusion: 视觉基础模型的规模扩展不足以实现科学对齐，需要将物理因果结构显式纳入表征学习目标；TC-Bench可作为评估科学对齐的标准化基准。

title: DUEL: Adversarial Self-Play for Multimodal Reasoning
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) has emerged as an effective paradigm for improving the reasoning capability of vision-language models (VLMs). However, RL-based optimization typically depends on costly high-quality annotations that are difficult to scale. Existing unsupervised alternatives may drift toward biased solutions due to weak visual grounding and the lack of reliable verification signals. We propose a self-evolving post-training framework, DUEL, where supervision emerges from adversarial interactions between two policies initialized from the same pretrained VLM. A Challenger generates an image-grounded true claim together with a minimally perturbed hard-negative counterpart, while a Solver verifies both claims against the image, encouraging fine-grained visual discrimination under near-neighbor semantics. To stabilize optimization, we introduce a length-normalized log-likelihood reward that preserves informative optimization signals beyond binary outcome supervision and improves learning stability under sparse feedback. Experiments show that DUEL consistently improves visual reasoning and robust discrimination without additional human annotations, external reward models, or image editing tools.

AI.tldr: DUEL是一个自我演化的后训练框架，通过两个策略（Challenger和Solver）的对抗交互生成监督信号，无需人工标注或外部奖励模型，即可提升视觉语言模型的推理能力和鲁棒判别性。
AI.motivation: 现有RL优化依赖昂贵的高质量标注，难以扩展；无监督替代方法因弱视觉锚定和缺乏可靠验证信号而容易偏向有偏解。
AI.method: 提出DUEL框架：Challenger生成图像锚定的真实陈述及其最小扰动的硬负例，Solver验证两者与图像的一致性；引入长度归一化的对数似然奖励，提供超越二元结果监督的优化信号，稳定稀疏反馈下的学习。
AI.result: DUEL在无需人工标注、外部奖励模型或图像编辑工具的情况下，持续提升了视觉推理能力和鲁棒判别性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过策略间的对抗交互可以实现自监督信号的有效生成，长度归一化的对数似然奖励能稳定优化过程，为VLM后训练提供可扩展的无监督范式。

title: CONF-KV: Confidence-Aware KV Cache Eviction with Mixed-Precision Storage for Long-Horizon LLM
summary: Long-horizon LLM inference turns the key--value (KV) cache into the dominant GPU memory consumer and makes per-token attention increasingly expensive. Many common eviction policies use static recency windows or historical attention, leaving unused a signal computed on every decoding step: the model's current uncertainty. We introduce CONF-KV, a KV-cache manager that converts the next-token distribution into a scalar confidence score and uses it to choose the per-step cache budget, retaining more context when the model is uncertain and pruning aggressively when it is confident. Within each budget, tokens are ranked by a composite of accumulated attention mass and recency, while a protected recent window preserves local coherence. We combine the policy with blockwise online-softmax attention, mixed FP16/INT8 storage, and a pyramidal per-layer budget variant. Across four model families and generated lengths up to 4K, CONF-KV stays near the footprint of a fixed 512-token sliding window while remaining within 1.5--2.1 perplexity points of full KV. On Needle-in-a-Haystack up to 32K tokens, CONF-KV reaches 91.4% retrieval accuracy versus 53.8% for sliding windows and 80.6% for H2O; on 75 VisualWebArena tasks it retains 95.3% of full-KV success at 2.8 times lower peak memory.

AI.tldr: CONF-KV是一种利用模型解码时的置信度信号动态调整KV缓存预算的缓存管理策略。它在模型不确定时保留更多上下文，在置信时激进剪枝，结合注意力累积、近期窗口和块级在线softmax等技术，在多种模型和长文本任务上显著降低内存占用，同时保持接近完整KV的性能。
AI.motivation: 长序列LLM推理中，KV缓存成为主要GPU内存消耗者，且逐token注意力计算日益昂贵。现有驱逐策略（如静态滑动窗口或基于历史注意力的H2O）未能利用解码步骤中可直接获得的模型当前不确定性信号，导致内存效率与性能之间的权衡不够理想。
AI.method: CONF-KV将下一个token的分布转换为标量置信度分数，据此动态决定每一步的缓存预算：不确定时保留更多上下文，置信时激进剪枝。在给定预算内，token按累积注意力质量与近期性的复合指标排序，并保留一个受保护的近期窗口以维持局部连贯性。该方法与块级在线softmax注意力、混合FP16/INT8存储及金字塔式逐层预算变体相结合。
AI.result: 在四种模型系列和最长4K生成长度的实验中，CONF-KV的显存占用接近固定512-token滑动窗口，且困惑度仅与完整KV相差1.5-2.1点。在32K长度的Needle-in-a-Haystack任务中，CONF-KV达到91.4%的检索准确率（滑动窗口53.8%，H2O 80.6%）。在75个VisualWebArena任务中，CONF-KV以2.8倍更低峰值内存保留完整KV成功率的95.3%。
AI.conclusion: CONF-KV通过利用模型自身的置信度信号进行动态KV缓存管理，在显著降低内存开销的同时保持了较高的生成质量和检索性能，证明了不确定性驱动的缓存策略在长序列LLM推理中的有效性和实用性。

title: HCL-FF: Hierarchical and Contrastive Learning for Forward-Forward Algorithm
summary: Deep neural networks trained with backpropagation have achieved outstanding performance in vision tasks but remain biologically implausible, computationally demanding, and difficult to interpret. The Forward-Forward (FF) algorithm offers a promising alternative by training each layer independently through local goodness objectives. However, its purely local optimization lacks hierarchical coordination across layers, and the decoupling of goodness from features leaves the representations unconstrained and semantically ambiguous. We propose a Hierarchical and Contrastive Learning FF framework (HCL-FF) to address these limitations. HCL-FF introduces (1) a coarse-to-fine hierarchical learning strategy that guides representations from low-level cues to high-level semantics, and (2) a supervised contrastive objective that enforces class-discriminative alignment after goodness decoupling. Experiments on CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, and Tiny-ImageNet demonstrate that HCL-FF achieves new state-of-the-art performance among FF-based methods, with notable accuracy gains of +5.46%, +17.00%, and +12.51%, respectively.

AI.tldr: 本文提出HCL-FF框架，通过分层学习和监督对比学习改进Forward-Forward算法，在多个图像数据集上显著提升了分类准确率。
AI.motivation: 传统的反向传播神经网络在生物合理性、计算效率和可解释性方面存在不足。Forward-Forward算法虽提供替代方案，但其纯局部优化缺乏层间协调，且 goodness 与特征解耦导致表征缺乏约束和语义模糊。
AI.method: (1) 粗到细的分层学习策略，引导表征从低级线索到高级语义；(2) 监督对比学习目标，在 goodness 解耦后强制类别判别性对齐。
AI.result: 在CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100和Tiny-ImageNet上分别取得+5.46%、+17.00%和+12.51%的准确率提升，达到FF类方法新最优。
AI.conclusion: HCL-FF通过引入层次化协调和对比学习有效克服了FF算法的局限性，显著提升了分类性能。

title: Active Learning for Stochastic Contextual Linear Bandits
summary: A key goal in stochastic contextual linear bandits is to efficiently learn a near-optimal policy. Prior algorithms for this problem learn a policy by strategically sampling actions but naively (passively) sampling contexts from the underlying context distribution. However, in many practical scenarios -- including online content recommendation, survey research, and clinical trials -- practitioners can actively sample or recruit contexts based on prior knowledge of the context distribution. Despite this potential for active learning, the role of strategic context sampling in stochastic contextual linear bandits is underexplored. We propose an algorithm that learns a near-optimal policy by strategically sampling rewards of context-action pairs. We prove instance-dependent theoretical guarantees demonstrating that our active context sampling strategy can improve over the minimax rate by up to a factor of $\sqrt{d}$, where $d$ is the linear dimension. We show empirically that our algorithm reduces the number of samples needed to learn a near-optimal policy, in tasks such as warfarin dose prediction and joke recommendation.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了随机上下文线性老虎机中主动上下文采样策略，提出了一种通过策略性采样上下文-动作对奖励来学习近最优策略的算法，理论上证明主动采样可在最小最大率上获得最高√d倍的提升，并在华法林剂量预测和笑话推荐等任务中验证了样本效率的提升。
AI.motivation: 现有随机上下文线性老虎机算法通常被动地采样上下文，但在实际应用（如内容推荐、调查研究、临床试验）中，从业者可以基于先验知识主动招募或采样上下文。这种主动学习潜力尚未被充分探索。
AI.method: 提出一种通过策略性采样上下文-动作对奖励来学习近最优策略的算法，采用主动上下文采样策略，而非被动等待上下文从分布中生成。
AI.result: 理论证明主动上下文采样策略可在最小最大率上获得最高√d倍的提升（d为线性维度）；实验证明该算法减少了学习近最优策略所需的样本量。
AI.conclusion: 主动上下文采样能够显著提升随机上下文线性老虎机的样本效率，在理论和实践上均优于被动采样方法。

title: Divide-and-Conquer Inference for Large-Scale Visual Recognition with Multimodal Large Language Models
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have demonstrated strong capabilities across a wide range of vision language tasks. However, when applied to large scale image classification, their performance degrades significantly as the label space expands a phenomenon we define as Performance Collapse in Long Sequence Recognition. Through an information theoretic analysis, we reveal that this collapse stems from a fundamental conflict between the escalating information entropy and the prominent attention dilution and decay within attention mechanisms, which impairs the model's ability to maintain a sufficient signal-to-noise ratio when processing extremely long prompts. To mitigate this, we propose Divide-and-Conquer Inference (DCI), a novel test-time scaling strategy for visual recognition with MLLMs. DCI recursively decomposes complex global classification tasks into multiple simpler, localized subproblems and employs a dynamic pruning mechanism to compress the search space. This method effectively improves the local signal to noise ratio and model accuracy by mitigating the inherent weight dilution issues in long-sequence inference. Moreover, while traditional self-attention incurs a prohibitive quadratic computational complexity, DCI achieves more favorable scaling behavior and substantially accelerates inference in large scale classification scenarios. Extensive experiments on benchmarks such as ImageNet-1K and ImageNet-21K demonstrate that DCI consistently improves classification accuracy. This enables lightweight open-source models to rival or even surpass frontier closed-source giants without any additional training or fine-tuning. As a model-agnostic, plug-and-play paradigm, DCI offers an efficient approach for scaling the inferential precision of MLLMs in large-scale scenarios.

AI.tldr: 本文发现多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在大规模图像分类中会出现“长序列性能崩溃”现象，通过信息论分析揭示其源于注意力稀释与衰减导致信噪比下降，并提出无需训练的分治推理策略（DCI）——递归分解分类任务、动态剪枝压缩搜索空间，有效提升信噪比和推理效率，使轻量级开源模型在ImageNet等基准上媲美甚至超越闭源大模型。
AI.motivation: 现有MLLMs在处理大规模图像分类时，随着标签空间扩大，性能急剧下降（即性能崩溃现象），其根本原因尚不明确，且缺乏有效的解决方案。
AI.method: 提出Divide-and-Conquer Inference (DCI)：一种测试时缩放策略，递归地将全局分类任务分解为多个局部子问题，并采用动态剪枝机制压缩搜索空间，从而在长序列推理中缓解注意力权重稀释问题，提高局部信噪比和模型精度。
AI.result: 在ImageNet-1K和ImageNet-21K等基准上，DCI一致提升了分类精度，使轻量级开源模型无需额外训练即可媲美甚至超越闭源大模型，且相比传统自注意力机制的二次复杂度，DCI实现了更优的缩放行为和更快的推理速度。
AI.conclusion: DCI作为一种模型无关、即插即用的范式，为大规模场景下MLLMs推理精度的缩放提供了一种高效方案。

title: Disentangled Double Machine Learning for Accurate Causal Effect Estimation
summary: Confounding bias is a key challenge in causal effect estimation from observational data. Double Machine Learning (DML) addresses this issue by estimating treatment and outcome nuisance functions, constructing treatment and outcome residuals, and estimating causal effects from the residuals. However, DML often produces biased and unstable estimates in highdimensional or finite-sample scenarios. One reason is that DML estimates nuisance functions using all covariates without disentangling distinct latent factors, resulting in unreliable nuisance function estimation. Another is that imprecise nuisance estimation further introduces residual dependence between the treatment residual and the remaining outcome error, undermining the accuracy of causal effect estimates. To address these issues, in this paper, we propose Disentangled Double Machine Learning (DDML), a novel algorithm that integrates two key strategies. First, a causal role disentanglement strategy decomposes covariates into confounders, treatment-specific factors, and outcomespecific factors for enabling reliable nuisance function estimation. And second, a residual dependence orthogonalization strategy mitigates residual dependence caused by nuisance estimation errors for enhancing the precision of causal effect estimates. Experimental results on synthetic, semi-synthetic, and real-world datasets demonstrate that DDML significantly outperforms 13 state-of-the-art baseline algorithms in both MAE and RMSE.

AI.tldr: DDML通过因果角色解耦和残差依赖正交化两大策略，解决了双机器学习在高维/有限样本场景下因混淆偏差和残差依赖导致的估计偏差与不稳定性问题，在多种数据集上显著优于13种基线方法。
AI.motivation: DML在高维或有限样本场景下存在两个关键问题：(1) 使用所有协变量估计 nuisance 函数，未区分潜变量角色，导致估计不可靠；(2) 不精确的 nuisance 估计引入治疗残差与结果残差之间的依赖关系，降低因果效应估计精度。
AI.method: 提出DDML算法，集成两种策略：(1) 因果角色解耦策略，将协变量分解为混淆因子、治疗特有因子和结果特有因子以实现可靠的 nuisance 函数估计；(2) 残差依赖正交化策略，缓解因 nuisance 估计误差导致的残差依赖问题以提升因果效应估计精度。
AI.result: 在合成、半合成和真实数据集上，DDML在MAE和RMSE两个指标上均显著优于13个最先进的基线算法。
AI.conclusion: DDML通过解耦协变量角色和正交化残差依赖，有效提升了DML在高维/有限样本场景下的因果效应估计性能。

title: Fishbone: From One 3D Asset to a Million Controllable Edits
summary: Large-scale controllable 3D assets are critical for computer graphics, embodied AI, robotics, and interactive content creation, yet creating diverse 3D assets remains challenging due to the high cost of manual modeling and rigging. Shape deformation offers a natural way to generate variations from existing meshes, but existing data-driven methods often rely on sparse user inputs, while parametric editing frameworks require manually designed control structures and category-specific configurations. Inspired by natural creatures, where a central spine governs global shape and cross-sectional ribs control local variation, we introduce Fishbone, a unified rib-spine representation for general shapes that supports controllable parametric mesh deformation, reduced-space dynamics, and animation. Given an input mesh, Fishbone computes a geodesic scalar field with an adaptive heat method, extracts iso-contours as cross-sectional ribs, constructs a smooth geometry-aware spine through rib centers, and associates surface vertices with nearby rib and spine structures using Gaussian-weighted skinning. The resulting representation enables real-time and predictable deformation: ribs control local profiles such as thickness, orientation, and cross-sectional variation, while the spine controls global bending, twisting, and stretching. The same structure also supports reduced-space simulation and keyframe animation. We further construct Fishbone-136K by augmenting Hunyuan3D with rib-spine structures, and demonstrate applications in controllable 3D generation, deformation-based data augmentation for robot learning, interactive mesh editing, and agentic generation. Experiments demonstrate the effectiveness, efficiency, and versatility of the proposed framework.

AI.tldr: Fishbone提出了一种基于脊骨-肋骨（rib-spine）统一表示的通用形状可控形变框架，能够实现实时、可预测的网格形变、降维动力学和动画，并通过构建Fishbone-136K数据集展示了在可控3D生成、机器人学习数据增强、交互编辑和智能体生成等多种应用中的有效性。
AI.motivation: 大规模可控3D资产对计算机图形学、具身AI、机器人和交互内容创作至关重要，但现有方法要么依赖稀疏用户输入的变形，要么需要手动设计控制结构和类别特定配置，缺乏一种统一、通用且高效的可控形变表示方法。
AI.method: Fishbone方法包括：1) 使用自适应热方法计算测地标量场；2) 提取等值线作为横截面肋骨；3) 通过肋骨中心构建平滑的几何感知脊柱；4) 使用高斯加权蒙皮将表面顶点与附近的肋骨和脊柱结构关联。肋骨控制局部轮廓（厚度、方向、横截面变化），脊柱控制全局弯曲、扭转和拉伸，同时支持降维空间模拟和关键帧动画。
AI.result: 构建了Fishbone-136K数据集（基于Hunyuan3D增强脊骨-肋骨结构），在可控3D生成、机器人学习的数据增强、交互式网格编辑和智能体生成等应用上验证了框架的有效性、效率和通用性。
AI.conclusion: Fishbone框架通过模仿自然界生物脊骨-肋骨结构，提供了一种统一的可控参数化形变表示，兼顾局部与全局形变控制，并支持多种下游应用，实验证明了其有效性和广泛适用性。

title: CLIP-Guided SAM: Parameter-Efficient Semantic Conditioning for Promptable Segmentation
summary:
Promptable foundation models such as the Segment Anything Model (SAM) produce high-quality masks but remain semantically blind, relying on external prompts to specify categories. Existing vision-language approaches address this limitation by using external prompt coupling, where a vision-language model generates spatial prompts for SAM as a separate stage.
  We propose CLIP-Guided SAM, a parameter-efficient segmentation framework built on internal semantic conditioning. Instead of using semantic signals only to generate prompts, we inject CLIP-derived text, vision, and similarity features directly into SAM's image encoder through lightweight multi-modal semantic adapters. These adapters condition SAM's internal feature representations, allowing semantic information to influence mask prediction while preserving SAM's original promptable interface.
  Our framework is designed for low labeled-data settings and applies to both general-domain benchmarks and specialized downstream tasks. It supports two operating modes: Manual mode, for interactive segmentation with both text and spatial prompts, and Semi-Automatic text-only mode, for applications that require concept-specific segmentation using only textual input. We show that robustness depends on aligning training with the type of prompts used at inference, making train-test prompt consistency an important design principle.
  Through extensive experiments and ablations, we evaluate our method against SAM+PEFT baselines without semantic conditioning, vision-language + SAM pipelines, SAM 3, and strong semi-supervised segmentation methods that rely on large amounts of unlabeled data. Across these settings, CLIP-Guided SAM consistently achieves superior or competitive performance while remaining parameter-efficient in both training and deployment.

AI.tldr: 提出CLIP-Guided SAM框架，通过轻量级多模态语义适配器将CLIP的文本、视觉和相似度特征注入SAM图像编码器，实现内部语义条件化分割，支持手动和半自动两种模式，在低标注数据场景下性能优异。
AI.motivation: SAM生成高质量掩码但语义盲，依赖外部提示指定类别；现有视觉-语言方法通过外部提示耦合（VLM生成空间提示给SAM）解决此问题，但效率低下。
AI.method: 通过轻量级多模态语义适配器将CLIP导出的文本、视觉和相似度特征直接注入SAM图像编码器内部特征表示，实现内部语义条件化。支持手动模式（文本+空间提示交互分割）和半自动文本模式（仅需文本输入的概念特定分割）。
AI.result: 在通用基准和专用下游任务上，相比SAM+PEFT基线、VLM+SAM流水线、SAM 3以及依赖大量无标注数据的半监督方法，CLIP-Guided SAM在参数高效的前提下持续达到更优或具有竞争力的性能。
AI.conclusion: 训练与推理时的提示类型一致性（train-test prompt consistency）是重要的设计原则；该方法在低标注数据设定下有效，兼具参数高效性。

title: DriftingMol: Decoder-Coupled Drift for One-Pass Property-Conditional Molecular Generation
summary: Property-conditional molecular generation should produce valid, diverse molecules while responding to continuous target values at low sampling cost. We introduce DriftingMol, a two-stage framework that adapts drifting models to a SELFIES latent molecular space. A frozen SELFIES beta-VAE provides the latent space, and the hidden representation of its decoder serves as the drift feature map. In decoder-coupled drift, decoder weights remain fixed, but drift gradients are backpropagated through the decoder feature map to a DiT generator, inducing a pullback metric aligned with molecular decoding. On ZINC250K, the default setting achieves QED Spearman correlation 0.493 with 94.7% uniqueness, while the strongest decoder-coupled condition reaches 0.510. Under protocol-matched four-property conditioning, decoder-coupled drift reaches mean Spearman correlation up to 0.598. Across 15 controlled variants, models that preserve the gradient path through decoder features achieve higher correlations than the tested latent-space, random-feature, and external-feature drift variants, while detached or stop-gradient decoder controls yield near-zero QED correlation and very low uniqueness. These results indicate that decoder-coupled drift is a useful low-cost mechanism for property-biased molecular generation, requiring one generator evaluation and one frozen decoder pass.

AI.tldr: 提出DriftingMol两阶段框架，将漂移模型适配到SELFIES潜在分子空间，通过解码器耦合漂移实现属性条件分子生成，在ZINC250K上达到QED Spearman相关系数0.493（最优0.510），四属性条件平均相关系数0.598，仅需一次生成器评估和一次冻结解码器前向传播。
AI.motivation: 属性条件分子生成需要在低采样成本下生成有效、多样的分子，并响应连续目标值，现有方法存在效率或质量不足的问题。
AI.method: 两阶段框架：1) 冻结的SELFIES beta-VAE提供潜在空间；2) 解码器耦合漂移——解码器权重冻结，但漂移梯度通过解码器特征图反向传播到DiT生成器，诱导与分子解码对齐的拉回度量。
AI.result: ZINC250K上默认设置QED Spearman相关系数0.493，唯一性94.7%；最强解码器耦合条件达0.510；四属性条件平均相关系数0.598。通过解码器特征的梯度路径模型优于潜在空间、随机特征和外特征漂移变体；分离或停止梯度的解码器控制导致近零QED相关性和极低唯一性。
AI.conclusion: 解码器耦合漂移是一种有效的低代价属性偏置分子生成机制，仅需一次生成器评估和一次冻结解码器前向传播。

title: AOEPT: Breaking the Implicit Modality-Reduction Bottleneck in Modality-Missing Prompt Tuning
comment: 20 pages, Accepted by ICML 2026, Code is available from https://github.com/Jian-Lang/AOEPT
summary: Deploying multimodal systems in real-world environments often entails handling modality-missing scenarios, where one or more modalities are unavailable. While recent studies address this challenge for the general Multimodal Transformer (MT) architecture via prompt tuning, we identify a fundamental limitation in these methods: the Implicit Modality-Reduction bottleneck. By conditioning prompts solely on the observed modalities, they inadvertently restrict the reasoning scope of MTs to the modality-reduced subspace, cutting off access to the latent information sources of the missing modalities. To overcome this limitation, we propose AOEPT, which pioneers a novel modal-contextualized prompting fashion. Specifically, we introduce lightweight Modal-Contextualized Prompts (MCPs) that distill global modality-wise priors from training data, serving as latent repositories of the information sources for missing modalities. Conditioned on the remaining modalities, these MCPs are instantiated into instance-aware prompts that selectively augment missing-modality information for each sample, thereby restoring the reasoning scope of MTs beyond the observed-modality-only subspace. Experiments across various multimodal benchmarks and backbones confirm the strong performance of AOEPT, with minimal computational overhead.

AI.tldr: AOEPT提出了一种新的模态上下文提示方法，通过轻量级模态上下文提示（MCPs）从训练数据中提取全局模态先验，作为缺失模态信息源的潜在仓库，从而克服了多模态Transformer在模态缺失场景下的隐式模态缩减瓶颈，恢复其推理范围。
AI.motivation: 现有基于提示调优的方法在处理多模态Transformer的模态缺失问题时存在根本性局限：隐式模态缩减瓶颈——仅基于可观测模态调节提示，将MT的推理范围限制在模态缩减子空间中，切断了通往缺失模态潜在信息源的通道。
AI.method: 引入轻量级模态上下文提示（MCPs），从训练数据中蒸馏全局模态先验作为缺失模态信息源的潜在仓库；基于剩余模态条件，将这些MCPs实例化为实例感知的提示，选择性增强每个样本的缺失模态信息，从而将MT的推理范围恢复到超出仅观测模态子空间的范围。
AI.result: 在多种多模态基准和骨干网络上，AOEPT以极小的计算开销取得了强性能表现。
AI.conclusion: AOEPT通过模态上下文提示范式有效解决了模态缺失场景下的隐式模态缩减问题，恢复了MT的完整推理能力，且计算开销极小。

title: Tiny Brains, Giant Impact: Uncovering the Keystone Neurons of LLM with Just a Few Prompts
summary: Large language models (LLMs) display strong comprehensive abilities, yet the internal mechanisms that support these behaviors remain insufficiently understood. In this work, we show that across a wide range of open-weight Transformers, a subset of neurons remains consistently highly activated during inference across tasks of multiple capability dimensions. By probing along the cross-task activation strength, an extremely sparse subset is isolated, whose removal causes a collapse in model behavior, which we term keystone neurons. Our analysis reveals that keystone neurons are a stable and intrinsic neuron subset of the model that is largely established during pretraining. The parameters associated with these neurons are tightly calibrated during the training process, and their precise values are critical for the capabilities of the model. Building on these insights, we propose a supervised fine-tuning approach that updates only keystone neurons, achieving task gains comparable to or even better than full-parameter fine-tuning while better preserving performance in other capability dimensions, despite modifying a much smaller number of parameters.

AI.tldr: 本文发现并验证了Transformer模型中存在一类“基石神经元”（keystone neurons），这些神经元在跨任务推理中持续高度激活，移除会导致模型能力崩溃，且仅更新这类神经元即可在微调中取得与全参数微调相当甚至更好的效果。
AI.motivation: 当前大语言模型虽展现出强大能力，但其内部工作机制尚未被充分理解，亟需揭示支撑模型能力的关键神经结构。
AI.method: 首先通过跨任务激活强度分析，从多个能力维度的推理任务中筛选出持续高度激活的神经元子集；然后通过消融实验验证这些神经元对模型行为的必要性；最后提出仅更新基石神经元的监督微调方法。
AI.result: 发现基石神经元是预训练阶段建立的稳定固有子集，其参数在训练过程中被精确校准；仅更新这些神经元的微调方法在目标任务上达到甚至超越全参数微调，同时更好地保留了其他能力维度的性能。
AI.conclusion: 揭示了大语言模型中存在关键功能神经元结构，为理解模型内部机制提供了新视角，并提出了更高效、更鲁棒的参数高效微调策略。

title: Multiscale Real-Time Object Detection in the NMS-Free Era: A Comparative Performance Evaluation of YOLOv8 and YOLO26
summary: Non-Maximum Suppression (NMS) remains a key post-processing step in many real-time object detection pipelines, but it can introduce latency variation and deployment complexity in resource-constrained settings. Recent NMS-free designs such as YOLO26 aim to reduce this dependence through end-to-end detection, yet their performance relative to established NMS-based models such as YOLOv8 remains underexplored beyond standard benchmarks. This paper compares YOLOv8 and YOLO26 on Pascal VOC and VisDrone, representing general object detection and dense aerial small-object detection, respectively. Both model families are evaluated across five scales using accuracy, localization, model size, GFLOPs, and CPU/GPU latency. Results show that YOLO26 achieves stronger detection performance and lower model complexity on Pascal VOC across most scales, while the performance gap narrows on VisDrone, where both models struggle with dense small targets. YOLOv8 remains competitive in GPU latency, showing that NMS-free design does not guarantee universal deployment superiority. Overall, the study shows that detector selection depends on dataset characteristics, object scale, model capacity, and hardware constraints.

AI.tldr: 本文系统比较了基于NMS的YOLOv8和无NMS的YOLO26在Pascal VOC（通用检测）和VisDrone（密集小目标检测）上的性能，涵盖五种模型尺度。YOLO26在Pascal VOC上表现更优且模型复杂度更低，但在VisDrone上差距缩小；YOLOv8在GPU延迟上仍具竞争力，表明无NMS设计并非普遍优势。
AI.motivation: NMS作为实时目标检测的关键后处理步骤，在资源受限场景下会引入延迟波动和部署复杂性。近期无NMS设计（如YOLO26）旨在通过端到端检测减少这种依赖，但其与基于NMS的模型（如YOLOv8）在标准基准之外的性能对比尚不充分，因此本研究旨在填补这一空白。
AI.method: 在Pascal VOC（通用目标检测）和VisDrone（密集航拍小目标检测）两个数据集上，对YOLOv8和YOLO26两个模型家族的五种尺度（n, s, m, l, x）进行全面比较。评估指标包括检测精度、定位性能、模型大小、GFLOPs以及CPU/GPU延迟。
AI.result: YOLO26在Pascal VOC上大多数尺度下取得了更强的检测性能和更低的模型复杂度；在VisDrone上两者差距缩小，且均对密集小目标检测表现不佳。YOLOv8在GPU延迟上仍具优势，表明无NMS设计并非在所有部署场景下都占优。
AI.conclusion: 检测器的选择取决于数据集特征、目标尺度、模型容量和硬件约束等多因素，无NMS设计并非普适的部署优势。

title: T2S-MPC: Time-Embedded Online Adaptive Model Predictive Control for Time-Varying Dynamics
summary: Recent advances in learning-based model predictive control (MPC) have leveraged neural networks for online model learning, achieving strong performance when nonstationary system dynamics deviate from nominal models. However, existing approaches primarily address specific or relatively structured forms of dynamical variation, leaving more general, unknown, and unpredictable time-varying dynamics insufficiently handled. To tackle this challenge, we propose T2S-MPC, a framework that adaptively learns a residual dynamics model online and integrates it with the nominal model within the MPC framework to enable fast-evolving online planning. To make the model time-aware, we explicitly encode temporal information through a structured time embedding and employ a two-timescale update scheme, allowing the controller to capture nonstationary dynamics while balancing rapid adaptation with stable learning. We evaluate the proposed method on a 2D quadrotor across stabilization and trajectory tracking tasks under diverse time-varying disturbances, including linear drifting and periodic perturbations. Experimental results show that T2S-MPC consistently outperforms classical MPC, neural MPC, and ablated variants in control performance, while also demonstrating strong robustness across a wide range of disturbance conditions without additional tuning. The source code is publicly available at https://github.com/Zeyuu0920/T2S_MPC

AI.tldr: 提出T2S-MPC框架，通过在线学习残差动力学模型并融入MPC，结合时间嵌入与双时间尺度更新策略，实现对未知时变动力学的自适应控制，在四旋翼飞行器任务上优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有基于学习的MPC方法主要处理特定或结构化的动力学变化，难以应对更一般、未知且不可预测的时变动力学，亟需一种能够在线自适应学习并快速响应时变扰动的控制框架。
AI.method: 1) 在线学习残差动力学模型，与名义模型融合用于MPC规划；2) 通过结构化时间嵌入显式编码时间信息，使模型具有时间感知能力；3) 采用双时间尺度更新方案，平衡快速适应与稳定学习。
AI.result: 在2D四旋翼的镇定与轨迹跟踪任务中，面对线性漂移、周期性扰动等多种时变干扰，T2S-MPC在控制性能上持续优于经典MPC、神经MPC及消融变体，且无需额外调参即展现出强鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 提出T2S-MPC有效解决了时变动力学下的自适应控制问题，验证了时间编码与双时间尺度更新的有效性，代码已开源。

title: Adversarial Error Correction for Visual Autoregressive Generation
summary: Visual Autoregressive (VAR) models have emerged as a powerful paradigm for image synthesis by performing hierarchical next-scale prediction. However, VAR models are inherently prone to cascading error propagation, where subtle coarse-scale mispredictions are amplified across the hierarchy, ultimately distorting the final synthesis. To mitigate this, we propose AID-VAR, a plug-and-play framework that enhances pre-trained VARs through Adversarially Injected Diagnosis. Instead of a standard passive generation, AID-VAR introduces a proactive error-correction mechanism inspired by the adversarial feedback in GANs. We deploy a discriminator to diagnose fidelity gaps at each scale transition, coupled with a lightweight guidance injector. This module operates as a non-invasive adapter that refines the feature manifold of a frozen VAR backbone, effectively steering the generation toward the distribution of real images without destabilizing the pre-trained latent space. Furthermore, to rigorously evaluate this cross-scale progression, we introduce the Inter-Scale Consistency Score (ISCS), a novel metric that quantifies the fidelity and structural alignment between consecutive resolution scales. Experimental results across various backbones demonstrate that AID-VAR delivers sharper textural details and fewer structural distortions with negligible overhead. For instance, AID-VAR-d20 achieves a 16% improvement in FID with only a 3% increase in parameters. These results establish AID-VAR as a highly efficient and scalable pathway for upgrading large-scale VAR generators, enhancing global coherence and local detail without altering training data, base architectures, or sampling schedules. Code is available at https://github.com/bijiw515/AID-VAR.

AI.tldr: AID-VAR通过对抗性注入诊断机制，在冻结的VAR骨干网络基础上引入轻量级引导注入器，修复跨尺度级联误差传播，提升图像生成质量，仅增加3%参数即可实现FID 16%的改进。
AI.motivation: VAR模型固有的级联误差传播问题——细微的粗尺度预测错误会沿层级放大，最终扭曲最终合成结果。
AI.method: 提出AID-VAR框架：1) 在每一尺度转换处部署判别器诊断保真度差距；2) 轻量级引导注入器作为非侵入式适配器，修正冻结VAR骨干的特征流形；3) 提出跨尺度一致性分数(ISCS)量化连续分辨率尺度间的保真度和结构对齐。
AI.result: AID-VAR-d20以仅3%的参数增加实现了FID 16%的提升，生成更清晰的纹理细节和更少的结构畸变。
AI.conclusion: AID-VAR是一种高效且可扩展的方案，可在不改变训练数据、基础架构或采样调度的情况下，增强大规模VAR生成器的全局一致性和局部细节。

title: The Concept Allocation Zone: Tracking How Concepts Form Across Transformer Depth
comment: 34 models, 8 architectural families, 7 concepts. Companion papers: GEM (arXiv forthcoming), CAZ Validation (arXiv forthcoming), PRH Validation (arXiv forthcoming). Code: https://github.com/jamesrahenry/Rosetta_Tools
summary: Concept formation in transformer language models is depth-extended, not a single-layer event: concepts emerge gradually across a contiguous region of the residual stream. Mechanistic interpretability methods identify the single layer of peak class separation -- the "best layer" -- capturing a snapshot rather than the process itself. We introduce the Concept Allocation Zone (CAZ): the depth interval within which a concept becomes measurably separable, the region allocated to its geometric expression. We formalize the CAZ through three layer-wise metrics (Separation, Concept Coherence, Concept Velocity) and derive principled boundary detection without manual layer sweeps. A CAZ is not a concept: it is the depth region within which the model organizes its geometry to make a concept separable. A single concept typically participates in multiple CAZes; multiple concepts may share one. Empirical validation across 34 models from 8 architectural families and 7 concepts reveals that the separation curve S(l) is frequently multimodal. A scored detector uncovers "gentle CAZes" -- subtle allocation regions invisible to standard peak detection but causally active in 93-100% of cases under ablation (16 of 34 models; 26 in the companion validation paper). The framework generates seven testable predictions; four yield clear verdicts (two not supported, one partially supported, one supported), one had its precondition invalidated by the data, and two are underpowered -- with cross-architecture alignment confirmed as depth-matched rather than monolithic under leave-one-concept-out cross-validation. Reference implementation: rosetta_tools v1.3.1 (doi:10.5281/zenodo.20361433).

AI.tldr: 本文提出概念分配区（CAZ）框架，证明Transformer语言模型中的概念形成是深度扩展的过程（而非单层事件），通过三种层度量（分离度、概念一致性、概念速度）识别概念可分离的深度区间，并在34个模型和7个概念上验证了分离曲线的多峰性及“温和CAZ”的存在。
AI.motivation: 现有机制可解释性方法仅识别单个“最佳层”作为概念分离的峰值快照，忽略了概念在残差流中逐步涌现的连续过程，缺乏量化概念形成深度区间的系统性框架。
AI.method: 提出CAZ框架，定义三种层度量：Separation（分离度）、Concept Coherence（概念一致性）、Concept Velocity（概念速度），基于这些度量设计原则性边界检测方法（无需手动层扫描）；引入评分检测器识别“温和CAZ”；在34个模型（8个架构家族）和7个概念上进行验证。
AI.result: 分离曲线S(l)频繁呈现多峰分布；温和CAZ在93-100%的消融案例中具有因果活性；框架生成7个可检验预测，其中4个有明确结论（2个不支持、1个部分支持、1个支持），1个前提条件被数据否定，2个统计效力不足；跨架构对齐被证实为深度匹配而非整体一致性。
AI.conclusion: 概念形成是深度扩展的过程，CAZ框架提供了比单层峰值更完整的几何组织描述，揭示了此前被掩盖的“温和CAZ”及其因果重要性，但部分预测未被实验支持，说明框架仍需进一步完善。

title: Trajectory-Consistent Calibration for Cache-Accelerated Diffusion Models
comment: 23 pages, 8 figures, 8 tables. Code is available at https://github.com/NJUDeepEngine/TCC
summary: Diffusion Transformers require repeated denoiser evaluations during iterative sampling, making inference computationally expensive. Cache-based acceleration reduces this cost by reusing intermediate representations across denoising steps, but can introduce representation deviations and degrade generation quality. In this paper, we analyze these deviations and show that effective calibration should consider both the direct mismatch caused by reuse and the subsequent trajectory shift induced by earlier corrections. To address this challenge, we propose Trajectory-Consistent Calibration (TCC), a training-free method that calibrates cached representations toward their full-computation counterparts. Specifically, rather than estimating all calibration priors from a single uncorrected cache trajectory, TCC uses an offline iterative procedure so that each prior accounts for the trajectory shift induced by preceding calibrations. Experiments on PixArt-alpha and DiT-XL/2 show that TCC consistently improves FID across representative cache-based acceleration methods while preserving their underlying reuse policies. Notably, in a representative PixArt-alpha cache-acceleration setting based on FORA, TCC reduces FID from 29.83 to 27.35, slightly surpassing the full-computation baseline.

AI.tldr: 本文提出轨迹一致校准（TCC），一种无需训练的缓存校准方法，通过对齐缓存表示与完整计算表示，在不改变重用策略的前提下，显著提升扩散Transformer缓存加速的生成质量，在PixArt-alpha上将FID从29.83降至27.35，略超完整计算基线。
AI.motivation: 扩散Transformer在迭代采样中需要重复执行去噪器评估，推理计算成本高昂。现有缓存加速方法虽可降低开销，但会引入表示偏差并损害生成质量。作者旨在分析这些偏差并设计有效的校准方法以消除负面影响。
AI.method: 提出Trajectory-Consistent Calibration (TCC)，一种无训练方法。TCC通过离线迭代过程校准缓存表示，使每个校准先验考虑先前校准引起的轨迹偏移，而非从单一未校正的缓存轨迹中估计所有先验。
AI.result: 在PixArt-alpha和DiT-XL/2上的实验表明，TCC在保持底层重用策略的同时，持续提升多种代表性缓存加速方法的FID指标。在基于FORA的PixArt-alpha缓存加速设置中，FID从29.83降至27.35，略超完整计算基线。
AI.conclusion: 有效的缓存校准应同时考虑直接重用失配和先前校正引起的轨迹偏移，TCC通过轨迹一致的离线迭代校准显著改善了缓存加速扩散Transformer的生成质量。

title: Unifying Value Alignment and Assignment in Cross-Domain Offline Reinforcement Learning with Heterogeneous Datasets
summary: Cross-domain offline reinforcement learning (RL) aims to learn a policy in the target domain with a limited target domain dataset and a source domain dataset that exhibits a dynamics shift. Training directly on the original source dataset typically leads to performance collapse. Recent studies perform data filtering from the perspective of dynamics alignment or value alignment to enable efficient policy transfer. However, these studies are typically validated on single-domain or single-behavior-policy source datasets. In this work, we explore a more general heterogeneous cross-domain offline RL setting, where the source datasets may be collected from multiple source domains by diverse behavior policies. We first uncover a critical yet overlooked issue in this setting: value misassignment. Empirically and theoretically, we demonstrate that value misassignment can undermine value alignment, mislead data filtering toward selecting suboptimal samples, and loosen the suboptimality gap, thereby degrading the agent's performance. To address this issue, we propose V2A, which integrates dynamics alignment, value alignment, and value assignment. V2A first employs temporally-consistent modality representation learning to extract dynamics modalities from the source dataset, followed by modality-aware advantage learning to rectify value alignment. Finally, it adopts a data filtering paradigm to selectively share source data for policy learning. Empirical results show that V2A significantly outperforms strong baseline methods under general heterogeneous cross-domain offline RL settings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出V2A方法，通过结合动力学对齐、价值对齐和价值分配，解决了异构跨域离线强化学习中由价值错误分配导致的性能退化问题，在通用异构设置下显著优于现有基线方法。
AI.motivation: 现有跨域离线RL方法通常假设源数据集来自单域或单行为策略，忽视了更通用的异构场景（多源域、多行为策略）。作者发现该场景下存在价值错误分配问题，该问题会破坏价值对齐，误导数据过滤选择次优样本，从而降低智能体性能。
AI.method: 提出V2A方法，包含三个关键组件：1）时序一致模态表示学习，从源数据集中提取动力学模态；2）模态感知的优势学习，修正价值对齐；3）数据过滤范式，选择性共享源数据用于策略学习。
AI.result: 在通用异构跨域离线RL设置下，V2A显著优于强基线方法，验证了方法在处理多源域、多行为策略场景下的有效性。
AI.conclusion: V2A通过同时处理动力学对齐、价值对齐和价值分配三方面问题，有效解决了异构跨域离线RL中的价值错误分配难题，为更通用的跨域策略迁移提供了可行方案。

title: QuoVLA: Quotient Space for Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models commonly adapt pretrained Vision-Language Models (VLMs) to robot control by mapping visual observations and language instructions to continuous actions. Existing approaches typically take an action-insufficiency view, assuming that pretrained VLM latents either lack directly usable action information or should be shielded from action-learning signals. Against this view, our \textit{Quotient Theory for VLA} shows that pretrained VLM latents are not action-insufficient but action-sufficient: they already contain the information needed for control, yet remain overcomplete by distinguishing prompt-level variations that induce the same optimal action behavior. To operationalize this theory, we propose QuoVLA, a quotient-space framework for VLA that compresses pretrained VLM latents into action-sufficient representations. Specifically, QuoVLA instantiates this principle with a quantization module and a dual-branch design with relative temporal-complexity regularization, preserving action-relevant information while removing prompt-level redundancy. Extensive experiments across multiple benchmarks demonstrate that QuoVLA achieves strong performance, with particularly notable improvements in generalization under visual, linguistic, and environmental distribution shifts. Our code will be made publicly available.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Quotient Theory，认为预训练VLM潜变量对机器人控制是“动作充分的”而非“动作不足的”，并基于商空间理论提出QuoVLA框架，通过量化模块和双分支设计压缩冗余信息，在多种分布偏移下取得优异泛化性能。
AI.motivation: 现有VLA方法普遍认为预训练VLM的潜变量缺乏可直接用于动作控制的信息，或应被屏蔽以避免干扰动作学习。作者质疑这一观点，试图证明VLM潜变量实际上已经包含了控制所需的动作信息，只是存在与动作无关的冗余。
AI.method: 提出QuoVLA框架：1) 基于商空间理论压缩VLM潜变量为动作充分的表示；2) 引入量化模块；3) 采用双分支设计搭配相对时序复杂度正则化，保留动作相关信息的同时去除提示级别的冗余。
AI.result: 在多个基准上取得强性能，尤其在视觉、语言和环境分布偏移下的泛化能力有显著提升。
AI.conclusion: VLM潜变量是动作充分的而非不足的，通过商空间压缩冗余可有效提升VLA模型的泛化性能，挑战了现有研究的认知基础。

title: A comparative study of accuracy and rollout stability of temporal surrogate models
summary: Temporal surrogate models are effective for predicting chaotic dynamical systems where computational cost can be prohibitive. Several deep neural network architectures can be used for such purposes. In this work, a few commonly used architectures are compared using a common training protocol. The objective is to fairly assess the impact of model architectures for long-horizon prediction stability. Experiments are carried out for three problems, the double pendulum, the Kuramoto-Sivashinsky equations, and the Kolmogorov flow. The experiments are carried out with matching model capacity. Analysis is also carried out for a scenario where each model is individually optimized. It is observed that in both scenarios, the models exhibit categorical differences in long-horizon rollouts. For a concrete quantification, stepwise error injections and perturbation amplifications are analyzed using metrics such as local jacobian, relative one-step bias, and finite-time Lyapunov growth. Additionally, an attractor analysis is also conducted to assess how well the learned models replicate the underlying system geometry. An ablation study to isolate the impact of each component of a continuous-update architecture is also carried out. It is concluded that models that having integrator-like updates show lower bias and perturbation amplification yielding stable long-horizon rollout and more accurate predictions.

AI.tldr: 本文对多种深度学习时序代理模型在混沌动力学系统预测中的表现进行了公平比较，发现具有积分器式更新结构的模型在长期预测稳定性、低偏差和低扰动放大方面表现更优。
AI.motivation: 混沌动力学系统的计算成本高昂，时序代理模型可有效预测，但不同深度神经网络架构在长期预测稳定性上的影响缺乏公平评估。
AI.method: 采用统一训练协议，在双摆、Kuramoto-Sivashinsky方程和Kolmogorov流三个问题上，以匹配模型容量和独立优化两种场景，比较多种常用架构；通过逐步误差注入、扰动放大分析（局部雅可比、相对一步偏差、有限时间Lyapunov增长）以及吸引子分析进行量化评估，并对连续更新架构进行消融研究。
AI.result: 不同架构在长期展开中表现出类别性差异；具有积分器式更新的模型显示出更低的偏差和扰动放大，从而实现稳定的长期预测和更准确的预测结果。
AI.conclusion: 模型架构对混沌系统长期预测稳定性有显著影响，积分器式更新结构是提升稳定性和准确性的关键设计选择。

title: X-Foresight: A Joint Vision-Action Causal Forecasting Network via Predictive World Modeling
summary:
Physical world knowledge resides mainly in videos. Equipping Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models with such knowledge is fundamental for safe and generalizable planning. Predictive world modeling enables VLA to internalize physical dynamics and long-term causality by predicting future video from past observations. However, naive next-frame prediction faces two challenges: 1) unlike semantically distinct text tokens, video tokens are low-entropy and redundant, causing prediction to degenerate into trivial extrapolation. 2) world modeling poses a temporal dilemma: dense prediction captures instantaneous dynamics, but cannot efficiently model long-horizon causality.
  To learn world knowledge effectively, we introduce X-Foresight, a predictive world model integrated directly into the VLA architecture to jointly learn world modeling and real-time action control. At its core lies a long-horizon chunk-wise auto-regressive strategy that addresses both challenges: by predicting semantically distant chunks rather than adjacent frames, it escapes trivial extrapolation, while preserving dense intra-chunk frames for instantaneous dynamics and sparse inter-chunk transitions for long-term causality. A curriculum learning schedule progressively extends prediction horizons and stabilizes long-horizon training. To capture long-term causality effectively, we present temporal importance sampling, which concentrates supervision on safety-critical chunks identified by ego-motion and behavioral signals. We further delegate photorealistic synthesis to a diffusion-based multi-view renderer, improving photorealistic appearance.
  Comprehensive experiments demonstrate that X-Foresight significantly outperforms VLA baselines in planning performance while maintaining strong generative fidelity, establishing a robust paradigm for world-knowledge-driven autonomous systems.

AI.tldr: X-Foresight 是一种将预测世界模型直接集成到 VLA 架构中的方法，通过长视野分块自回归策略、课程学习和时间重要性采样，有效解决了视频预测中的低熵冗余和长程因果建模难题，显著提升了规划性能与生成保真度。
AI.motivation: 物理世界知识主要蕴含在视频中，但现有的 VLA 模型缺乏对物理动力学和长程因果关系的有效内化。直接进行下一帧预测面临两个挑战：1）视频 token 熵低且冗余，预测退化为琐碎外推；2）密集预测能捕捉瞬时动力学，但无法高效建模长程因果。
AI.method: 提出长视野分块自回归策略，预测语义上远距离的视频块而非相邻帧，既避免琐碎外推，又保留块内密集帧用于瞬时动力学、块间稀疏过渡用于长程因果；采用课程学习逐步延长预测视野并稳定训练；提出时间重要性采样，聚焦于由自我运动和行为信号识别的安全关键块；使用扩散多视图渲染器提升逼真外观。
AI.result: 综合实验表明，X-Foresight 在规划性能上显著优于 VLA 基线，同时保持了强大的生成保真度。
AI.conclusion: X-Foresight 建立了面向世界知识驱动的自主系统的稳健范式，证明了将预测世界模型集成到 VLA 架构中联合学习世界建模与实时动作控制的有效性。

title: Cluster Frequency Conformal Prediction for Local Coverage
summary: Conformal prediction provides distribution-free coverage guarantees, but in many-class classification it may still under-cover specific classes or subpopulations, preventing safe deployment in high-stakes applications. We propose Cluster Frequency Conformal Prediction (CFCP), a plug-in framework that adapts conformal prediction to local structure in a learned representation space. CFCP clusters learned embeddings, estimates cluster-level label-frequency distributions from calibration data, and for each test point constructs a sample-specific probability vector by softly mixing nearby cluster distributions regularized with global-prior and reliability-aware shrinkage. This vector is then conformalized using standard set constructors. In the disjoint-split regime, CFCP inherits standard finite-sample marginal validity. Under additional assumptions, CFCP further admits a local-validity interpretation. Since representation clusters aggregate locally similar samples, their empirical class frequencies provide a stable estimate of local label ambiguity. Across image and text benchmarks, CFCP achieves the best class coverage in 15/16 dataset/score-family comparisons and a competitive prediction set size efficiency, with several settings substantially more efficient. Overall, our results show that cluster-frequency information provides an effective localized signal for improving classwise reliability in many-class conformal prediction.

AI.tldr: 提出Cluster Frequency Conformal Prediction (CFCP)框架，通过在表征空间中聚类并利用聚类级标签频率分布，改进多类分类中共形预测的类别级覆盖均匀性，在15/16个实验设置中取得最佳类别覆盖率，同时保持竞争性的集合效率。
AI.motivation: 标准共形预测在多类分类中可能对特定类别或子群体覆盖不足，阻碍了在高风险场景中的安全部署。
AI.method: CFCP在学习的表征空间中对嵌入进行聚类，从校准数据中估计聚类级标签频率分布，通过软混合邻近聚类分布、结合全局先验和可靠性感知收缩来构建每个测试样本的特定概率向量，再使用标准集合构造器进行共形化。
AI.result: 在图像和文本基准上，CFCP在15/16个数据集/评分族比较中实现最佳类别覆盖率，预测集大小效率具有竞争力，多个设置下显著更高效。
AI.conclusion: 聚类频率信息为改善多类共形预测的类别级可靠性提供了有效的局部化信号。

title: BED-SAM2: Boundary-Enhanced-Depth SAM2 via Monocular Geometric Priors
comment: 9 pages, 5 figures, 5 tables. Presented as a poster at the CVPR 2026 Workshop on Computer Vision in the Wild (CVinW). Code available at https://github.com/TylerRust-1/BED-SAM2
summary: Building upon the SAM2 vision foundation model for downstream segmentation, this study introduces Boundary Enhanced Depth (BED)-SAM2. The SAM2 Hiera encoder architecture is modified to directly encode monocular depth information from RGB images, thereby providing geometric cues that enhance object boundary delineation and facilitate the extraction of camouflaged object shapes. BED-SAM2 demonstrates competitive state-of-the-art performance across multiple salient and camouflaged object detection tasks with as few as five training epochs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出BED-SAM2模型，通过修改SAM2编码器直接编码单目深度信息，利用几何线索增强目标边界描绘和伪装目标形状提取，在显著和伪装目标检测任务上仅需5个训练周期即可达到SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的SAM2视觉基础模型在下游分割任务中缺乏几何线索，难以准确描绘目标边界和提取伪装目标形状，因此需要引入深度信息来增强边界感知能力。
AI.method: 修改SAM2的Hiera编码器架构，使其能够直接从RGB图像编码单目深度信息，将深度几何线索与原始特征融合，提升边界描绘和伪装目标检测能力。
AI.result: 在多个显著和伪装目标检测任务上，BED-SAM2仅需5个训练周期即可达到具有竞争力的SOTA性能。
AI.conclusion: 引入深度信息可以显著提升基础模型在边界敏感的下游分割任务上的性能，且训练效率高。

title: Efficient DP-SGD for LLMs with Randomized Clipping
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are trained on vast datasets that may contain sensitive information. Differential privacy (DP), the de facto standard for formal privacy guarantees, provides a principled framework for training LLMs with provable privacy protection. However, state-of-the-art DP training implementations rely on fast gradient clipping techniques with memory overhead $O(B \min\{T^2, d^2\})$, where $B$ is the batch size, $T$ is the sequence length, and $d$ is the model width. This becomes prohibitive as both model size and context length grow. We propose DP-SGD-RC, a novel variant of DP-SGD with randomized clipping that reduces memory and compute complexity. DP-SGD-RC leverages stochastic trace estimation methods, specifically Hutchinson's estimator[Hutchinson, 1989] and its improved variant, Hutch++[Meyer et al., 2021], to reduce the memory footprint of per-sample gradient norm estimation. We provide a tight privacy analysis showing that DP-SGD-RC achieves noise multipliers competitive with deterministic clipping. Experiments fine-tuning Llama~3.2-1B on long-context benchmarks spanning classification, question answering, and summarization tasks demonstrate that DP-SGD-RC matches baseline utility while significantly reducing memory and compute requirements.

AI.tldr: 提出DP-SGD-RC，一种基于随机裁剪的差分隐私训练方法，通过Hutchinson/Hutch++随机迹估计降低每样本梯度范数计算的内存复杂度，在长上下文LLM微调中实现与确定性裁剪相当的效用且显著减少资源消耗。
AI.motivation: 现有DP-SGD实现依赖快速梯度裁剪技术，内存开销为O(B·min{T², d²})，随模型规模和上下文长度增长而变得难以承受。
AI.method: 提出DP-SGD-RC变体，采用随机裁剪（Randomized Clipping）替代确定性裁剪，利用Hutchinson估计器及其改进变体Hutch++进行随机迹估计，以降低每样本梯度范数估计的内存和计算复杂度。
AI.result: 在Llama 3.2-1B上微调长上下文基准任务（分类、问答、摘要），DP-SGD-RC在匹配基线效用的同时显著降低了内存和计算需求。
AI.conclusion: DP-SGD-RC通过随机裁剪实现了与确定性裁剪竞争的噪声乘子，提供严格隐私保障，为大规模LLM的差分隐私训练提供了更高效的内存方案。

title: BFS: Back-to-Front Layered Image Synthesis via Knowledge Transfer
summary: As generative models expand the possibilities of visual content creation, layered image synthesis has emerged as a promising direction for controllable and creative editing. However, existing methods struggle to fully realize this potential. Decomposition-based methods often struggle with clean separation, while generation-based methods suffer from difficulty in training data acquisition, reducing quality and scene diversity. In this paper, we propose BFS, a novel generation-based framework for layered image synthesis. Specifically, given a background image and user guidance, BFS synthesizes a foreground layer that incorporates not only a foreground object but also its associated visual effects, such as shadows and reflections, while seamlessly harmonizing with the background to produce a coherent composite. To enable diverse and high-quality foreground layer synthesis while overcoming data scarcity, we leverage the comparatively easy-to-learn knowledge of unlayered image synthesis for the foreground synthesis. To this end, we adopt a dual-branch diffusion framework in which two interconnected branches generate a composite image and a foreground layer, respectively, enabling bidirectional knowledge transfer. Based on this framework, we propose a two-stage training scheme that utilizes a high-quality unlayered composite image dataset to effectively enhance foreground quality. Extensive experiments, including a user study, show that BFS produces high-quality layered images, consistently outperforming prior methods.

AI.tldr: BFS是一种基于生成的分层图像合成框架，通过双分支扩散模型和两阶段训练方案，利用易学习的非分层图像合成知识来生成高质量的前景层（包含物体及其视觉特效），实现了优于现有方法的分层图像合成效果。
AI.motivation: 现有分层图像合成方法存在不足：基于分解的方法难以实现干净分离，而基于生成的方法面临训练数据获取困难、质量和场景多样性受限的问题。
AI.method: 提出BFS框架，采用双分支扩散结构（一个分支生成合成图像，另一个分支生成前景层），实现双向知识迁移；并设计两阶段训练方案，利用高质量的非分层合成图像数据集来增强前景层生成质量。
AI.result: 在多项实验（包括用户研究）中，BFS生成的高质量分层图像一致性地优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: BFS通过巧妙利用非分层图像合成知识来克服数据稀缺问题，有效实现了高质量的前景层合成，为分层图像合成提供了新的有效范式。

title: On the Impact of Class Imbalance on the Learning Dynamics of Deep Neural Networks:An Intuitive Insight
summary: Class imbalance in deep neural networks (DNNs) has witnessed a rapid increase in research attention in recent years. However, the varying accounts of the reasons behind the poor performance of DNN on imbalance data in pertinent literature shows that little is known about how this agelong phenomenon impacts the performance of DNNs. A better understanding of this problem is crucial to developing effective DNN-based imbalance methods. Thus, this study systematically investigates the impact of class imbalance on the learning dynamics of DNN by monitoring the learning pattern of DNN models on both the majority and minority classes of datasets of varying imbalance ratios. Experimental findings shows that as against learning from balanced datasets where DNN learns the classes similarly, class imbalance has severe deteriorating impact on the performance of DNN, driving the model to underfit the minority class samples in the early training epochs while simultaneously learning only the majority class. Although DNN ultimately learns the minority samples, learning in this manner only results in learnt minority representations that are non-generalizable at test phase because they are merely overfitted to keep the overall training loss as low as possible.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了类别不平衡对深度神经网络学习动态的影响，发现不平衡导致模型早期对少数类欠拟合、仅学习多数类，后期虽学会少数类但仅为降低训练损失的过拟合，导致测试阶段泛化能力差。
AI.motivation: 现有文献对DNN在不平衡数据上性能不佳的原因说法不一，缺乏对类不平衡如何影响DNN性能的深入理解，亟需系统研究以指导有效的不平衡学习方法开发。
AI.method: 通过在不同不平衡比率的数据集上监控DNN模型对多数类和少数类的学习模式，系统对比平衡与不平衡数据集下的学习动态差异。
AI.result: 不平衡数据下DNN在早期训练轮次对少数类欠拟合、仅学习多数类；后期虽学习少数类但仅为过拟合以降低训练损失，导致学习到的少数类表示在测试阶段不可泛化。
AI.conclusion: 类别不平衡严重损害DNN性能，其根本问题在于不平衡导致的学习动态异常使得少数类表征缺乏泛化能力。

title: Where Detectors Fail: Probing Generative Space for Generalizable AI-Generated Image Detection
summary: Detecting AI-generated images (AIGI) remains challenging because detectors often fail to generalize to unseen generators. Although existing methods are trained on large datasets, their performance still degrades when generation settings change, indicating that data scale alone is insufficient and that limited coverage of generative variations during training is a key factor. Studies on generative model editing show that small changes in internal representations can produce diverse and meaningful image variations, many of which are not explored under standard sampling. Leveraging this insight, we propose PROBE (Probing Robustness via Boundary Exploration), a framework that improves detector generalization by actively exploring challenging regions of the generative process. Instead of treating the generator as a fixed data source, PROBE uses the detector as a critic to steer the generator through manifold-level modifications, producing realistic samples that are difficult to classify. These samples expose failure cases that are uncommon under standard data sampling strategies and are used to refine the detector. Experimental results across multiple benchmarks indicate that PROBE enhances generalization to unseen generators, resulting in more generalizable AIGI detection performance. Code and models are available at https://github.com/Amamiya-C/PROBE-AIGI-Detection

AI.tldr: 本文提出PROBE框架，通过将检测器作为批评者引导生成器进行流形级修改，主动探索生成过程中难以分类的区域，从而生成能暴露检测器失败案例的样本，用于提升AI生成图像检测器对未见生成器的泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 现有AIGI检测器虽然在大量数据上训练，但当生成设置变化时性能仍会下降，表明仅靠数据规模不足，训练期间生成变体的覆盖范围有限是关键因素。受生成模型编辑研究启发，内部表示的微小变化可产生多样且有意义的图像变体，但这些变体在标准采样下未被探索。
AI.method: PROBE框架将生成器视为可操纵的数据源，利用检测器作为批评者，通过流形级修改引导生成器产生难以分类的真实样本，暴露标准数据采样策略下不常见的失败案例，并用这些样本来优化检测器。
AI.result: 在多个基准上的实验结果表明，PROBE增强了对未见生成器的泛化能力，实现了更可泛化的AIGI检测性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过主动探索生成过程中的困难区域来生成对抗性训练样本，可以有效提升检测器对未知生成器的泛化能力。

title: Factorize to Generalize: Retrieval-Guided Invariant-Dynamic Decomposition for Time Series Forecasting
summary: Time series foundation models (TSFMs) have recently achieved strong zero-shot forecasting performance through large-scale pretraining and retrieval-augmented prediction. However, our empirical analysis reveals a non-trivial limitation of retrieval-based forecasting: retrieval tends to induce more oscillatory predictions, improving performance on highly fluctuating series while degrading accuracy on smoother, trend-dominated ones. This suggests that retrieved information may be fused into prediction without explicitly distinguishing stable temporal structure from instance-specific variations, which can reduce robustness under distribution shifts. We propose a Retrieval-guided Invariant-Dynamic DEcomposition framework for time series forecasting. Rather than using retrieval as auxiliary predictive context, we leverage retrieved sequences as implicit samples from related environments to guide representation decomposition. Specifically, we first construct a retrieval-aware representation via attention-based aggregation, and then introduce a retrieval-guided routing mechanism to decompose it into an invariant component capturing stable shared structure and a dynamic component modeling context-dependent variations. These two components are forecast separately and fused for final prediction, enabling the model to preserve transferable patterns while remaining adaptive to evolving dynamics. We further design training objectives that encourage invariant learning and disentanglement, and provide theoretical insight showing that retrieval aggregation reduces variance and approximates invariant representation learning without explicit environment supervision. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method consistently improves robustness under distribution shifts and outperforms existing TSFMs and retrieval-based baselines in zero-shot forecasting settings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出检索引导的固定-动态分解框架（RIDDE），将检索序列作为环境样本引导表征分解为固定成分（稳定共享结构）和动态成分（情境依赖变化），分别预测后融合，无需环境监督即可实现不变表示学习，在零样本时间序列预测中显著提升鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有基于检索的时间序列预测存在局限性：检索倾向于引入更多振荡预测，在波动剧烈的序列上表现好，但在平滑、趋势主导的序列上精度下降。这说明检索信息未能区分稳定时间结构与实例特定变异，导致分布漂移下鲁棒性不足。
AI.method: 1) 通过注意力聚合构建检索感知表征；2) 引入检索引导路由机制，将表征分解为不变成分（稳定共享结构）和动态成分（情境依赖变化）；3) 分别预测两个成分并融合；4) 设计鼓励不变学习和解耦的训练目标；5) 理论证明检索聚合可降低方差并近似不变表示学习。
AI.result: 实验表明，该方法在分布漂移下鲁棒性一致提升，在零样本预测场景中优于现有TSFMs和基于检索的基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 将检索序列作为环境隐式样本引导表征分解，可有效分离稳定模式与动态变异，提升时间序列基础模型在分布漂移下的零样本预测鲁棒性。

title: MambaDSF: Multi-Scale SSM with Dilated Feature Fusion for Sonar Small Target Detection
comment: 8 pages, 4 figures, under review at IEEE Geoscience and Remote Sensing Letters (GRSL)
summary:
Sonar imaging is the primary modality for underwater target detection, yet small targets remain difficult to detect due to insufficient pixel coverage, low acoustic contrast, and scale ambiguity across imaging ranges. CNN-based detectors extract local features efficiently but cannot suppress noise-induced false alarms without global acoustic context. Transformer-based methods capture long-range dependencies at quadratic computational cost. Existing Mamba-based vision models offer efficient linear-cost scanning but lack multi-scale semantic alignment across pyramid levels, multi-receptive-field fusion, and small-target-aware training supervision needed for reliable sonar detection.
  This letter proposes Mamba Dilated-Scale Fusion (MambaDSF), a hybrid framework addressing these limitations through three contributions: a Mamba Enhanced Feature Pyramid (MambaEFP) backbone that jointly captures local echo cues and global acoustic context at linear complexity; a Dilate Fusion Mamba (DFMamba) encoder that enforces multi-scale feature alignment across pyramid levels; and Scale-Adaptive Weighted IoU (SA-WIoU) and Cross-Scale Coherence (CSC) losses that stabilize small-target training. MambaDSF achieves 91.5% mAP50 on the UATD forward-looking sonar benchmark with 28.7 million parameters, surpassing all compared detectors. On a small-target subset the gain reached +2.2 percentage points, and cross-domain evaluation on FLS and MD-FLS confirms the generalization of the proposed architecture. The codes are publicly available at https://github.com/IDontKnowAAA/MambaDSF.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MambaDSF混合框架，通过MambaEFP骨干网络、DFMamba编码器以及SA-WIoU和CSC损失函数，解决了声纳图像中小目标检测的难题，在UATD基准上达到91.5% mAP50，仅28.7M参数，超越所有对比检测器。
AI.motivation: 声纳成像中小目标检测面临像素覆盖不足、声学对比度低、尺度模糊等挑战。CNN缺乏全局声学上下文导致虚警，Transformer计算成本为二次方，现有Mamba视觉模型缺乏多尺度语义对齐、多感受野融合和小目标感知训练监督。
AI.method: 提出MambaDSF混合框架，包含：(1) MambaEFP骨干网络，以线性复杂度联合捕获局部回波线索和全局声学上下文；(2) DFMamba编码器，强制跨金字塔层级的多尺度特征对齐；(3) SA-WIoU和CSC损失函数，稳定小目标训练。
AI.result: 在UATD前视声纳基准上达到91.5% mAP50，仅28.7M参数；小目标子集上增益达+2.2个百分点；跨域评估（FLS和MD-FLS）验证了架构的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: MambaDSF通过线性复杂度的Mamba架构结合多尺度特征对齐和小目标感知损失，有效提升了声纳图像小目标检测性能，且具有良好的跨域泛化能力。

title: Explainable Retinal Imaging for Prediction of Multi-Organ Dysfunction in Type 2 Diabetes
summary:
Background: Type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM) is increasingly recognised as a systemic disease characterised by coordinated dysfunction across metabolic, renal, lipid, and inflammatory pathways. Existing clinical assessments often fail to capture this multi-dimensional burden.
  Methods: We conducted a retrospective study of 1,195 patients using routinely collected laboratory biomarkers. System-level abnormality indices were constructed to quantify organ-specific dysfunction, and multi-system involvement was defined as abnormalities in two or more systems. Supervised machine learning models, including logistic regression, random forest, and gradient boosting, were trained to predict multi-system dysregulation. Model interpretability was achieved using SHapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP).
  Results: The gradient boosting model demonstrated near-perfect discrimination (AUC = 1.000), significantly outperforming logistic regression (AUC = 0.925). Feature attribution analysis revealed that hyperglycaemia, renal impairment, dyslipidaemia, and inflammation were the dominant drivers of multi-system risk. Dose-response relationships observed in partial dependence analyses further supported the biological plausibility of model predictions.
  Conclusion: This study presents an interpretable, data-driven framework for quantifying systemic disease burden in T2DM. By linking routine biomarkers to multi-organ dysfunction, our approach provides both predictive accuracy and mechanistic insight, offering potential for improved risk stratification and precision medicine in diabetes care.
  The data and code used in this study are openly available on GitHub at: https://github.com/MiniHanWang/Type-2-Diabetes-1.git

AI.tldr: 本研究利用常规实验室生物标志物构建多系统异常指数，通过梯度提升模型以完美区分度（AUC=1.000）预测2型糖尿病患者的系统性负担，并借助SHAP实现模型可解释性，揭示了高血糖、肾损伤、血脂异常和炎症是多系统风险的主要驱动因素。
AI.motivation: 2型糖尿病（T2DM）被日益认识到是一种涉及代谢、肾脏、脂质和炎症通路的系统性协调功能障碍的全身性疾病，但现有的临床评估往往无法捕捉这种多维度负担。
AI.method: 回顾性研究1,195名患者，利用常规收集的实验室生物标志物构建系统级异常指数以量化器官特异性功能障碍，将两个及以上系统异常定义为多系统受累，采用逻辑回归、随机森林和梯度提升等监督机器学习模型进行预测，并使用SHAP实现模型可解释性。
AI.result: 梯度提升模型表现接近完美（AUC=1.000），显著优于逻辑回归（AUC=0.925）；特征归因分析表明高血糖、肾损伤、血脂异常和炎症是多系统风险的主要驱动因素；偏依赖分析中的剂量-反应关系进一步支持了模型预测的生物学合理性。
AI.conclusion: 本研究提出了一个可解释的、数据驱动的框架，用于量化T2DM的系统性疾病负担，通过将常规生物标志物与多器官功能障碍联系起来，既提供了预测准确性又提供了机制洞察，为糖尿病护理中的风险分层和精准医学提供了潜在改进。

title: X-Edit: Exact, Explicit, and Explainable Null-Space Editing for Medical Vision Transformers
summary: Pre-trained Vision Transformers (ViTs) are increasingly deployed for medical image classification.
