AI.result: 在16个含异常值的UCI数据集和含噪声的MNIST图像上，Gini MDS在嵌入质量上优于Euclidean MDS；PyTorch张量实现相比sklearn的MDS具有更高的计算效率。
AI.conclusion: Gini MDS是一种对噪声和异常值鲁棒的多维缩放方法，通过可调伪距离灵活适应数据特性，且GPU加速实现提升了实用性，适用于真实世界的噪声数据场景。

title: K-U-KAN: Koopman-Enhanced U-KAN for 3D Dental Reconstruction from a Single Panoramic X-ray Radiograph
summary: A panoramic X-ray compresses a 3D jaw into a 2D strip; we aim to recover the missing depth cleanly and fast. Existing implicit neural representations render realistic volumes but are slow to train, sensitive to sampling and positional encodings, and costly in practice. Pure CNN baselines are efficient yet struggle with the dental arch's long-range geometry, blur fine enamel-dentin boundaries, and offer little interpretability. We present K-U-KAN, a three-stage pipeline that (i) lifts 2D features into depth-aware observables with Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks, (ii) advances these observables by a stable, phase-aware linear evolution via a Koopman token block, and (iii) places the predicted depth bins onto focal-trough rays before a lightweight 3D attention U-KAN refines the volume. This marriage of physics (Beer-Lambert image formation), geometry (horseshoe focal trough), and learned linear dynamics yields sharp anatomy, fewer artifacts, and robust behavior on native radiographic intensities with batch size one. On held-out data, K-U-KAN matches transformer/implicit baselines on signal and structure metrics, clearly improves perceptual quality, and trains in roughly half the time-making single-view PX $\to$ CBCT reconstruction more practical for clinical pipelines.

AI.tldr: K-U-KAN通过结合KAN网络、Koopman线性演化和U-KAN的三阶段流水线，实现从单视角全景X光到CBCT的快速、高质量三维重建，训练时间减半且适用于临床流水线。
AI.motivation: 现有隐式神经表示（NeRF类）虽然能重建逼真体积，但训练慢、对采样和位置编码敏感、实际成本高；纯CNN基线效率高但难以捕捉牙弓的长程几何结构、模糊釉质-牙本质边界且缺乏可解释性。因此需要一种既干净又快速的深度恢复方法。
AI.method: 三阶段流水线：(i) 利用KAN网络将2D特征提升为深度感知可观测量；(ii) 通过Koopman token模块进行稳定的、相位感知的线性演化推进这些可观测量；(iii) 将预测的深度区间映射到焦槽射线，再经轻量级3D注意力U-KAN精炼体积。该方法融合了比尔-朗伯图像形成物理、马蹄形焦槽几何和学习的线性动力学。
AI.result: 在保留数据上，K-U-KAN在信号和结构指标上匹配Transformer/隐式基线，显著提升感知质量，训练时间约减半，且能以批量大小1处理原始放射强度，具有鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: K-U-KAN使得单视角全景X光到CBCT的重建更实用化，更适用于临床流水线。

title: Methodology for Creating a Clinically Verified Dermoscopic Image Dataset
summary: This study presents a methodology for constructing a clinically verified dataset of dermatoscopic images for medical informatics research. The relevance of the work is driven by the fact that the performance of automated diagnostic support systems depends not only on the volume of images, but also on the reproducibility of the image acquisition procedure, the completeness of structured metadata, and the reliability of diagnostic labels. International collections were primarily created under conditions that differ substantially from routine Russian outpatient practice and mobile dermatoscopy. The proposed methodology integrates three interconnected components: (1) a standard operating procedure (SOP) for acquiring images via mobile dermatoscopy, (2) an information model comprising 16 structured metadata fields organized into six clinically oriented blocks in ISIC-compatible notation, and (3) a multi-stage expert verification of diagnostic labels (initial clinical annotation, consensus review by three specialists, and histological confirmation of all malignant neoplasms). Using this methodology, a dataset of 1,026 unique dermatoscopic images from 443 patients was collected between June 2025 and May 2026. From 1,044 initial records, 18 duplicates were excluded. The dataset includes nine nosological categories; all 39 malignant lesions (18 melanomas, 15 basal cell carcinomas, and 6 squamous cell carcinomas) were histologically verified. Patient age ranged from 2 to 90 years (median 38), with 279 females (63%) and 164 males (37%). Each image is accompanied by expert-annotated dermatoscopic structures and an explicit verification_stage field indicating the level of diagnostic confirmation. The resulting dataset serves as a pilot clinically verified resource suitable for independent model evaluation, domain shift analysis, interpretability studies, and further expansion.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一套构建临床验证皮肤镜影像数据集的方法论，包含移动皮肤镜图像采集标准操作规程、16字段结构化元数据信息模型（ISIC兼容格式）以及多阶段专家诊断标签验证流程。基于此方法，收集了443名患者的1,026张皮肤镜图像，涵盖9个疾病类别，其中39例恶性病变均经组织学确认。该数据集可作为独立模型评估、域迁移分析等研究的临床验证资源。
AI.motivation: 自动化诊断支持系统的性能不仅依赖于图像数量，还取决于图像采集过程的可重复性、结构化元数据的完整性以及诊断标签的可靠性。现有国际数据集大多在不同于俄罗斯常规门诊实践和移动皮肤镜的条件下创建，缺乏适用于基层场景的标准化临床验证资源。
AI.method: 方法论整合三个相互关联的组件：(1) 移动皮肤镜图像采集标准操作规程（SOP）；(2) 包含16个结构化元数据字段的信息模型，组织为六个临床导向模块，采用ISIC兼容标注格式；(3) 多阶段专家诊断标签验证流程（初始临床标注、三位专家共识评审、所有恶性病变的组织学确认）。
AI.result: 2025年6月至2026年5月间，收集了443名患者的1,026张唯一皮肤镜图像（从1,044条初始记录中排除18个重复项）。数据集包含9个疾病类别；39例恶性病变（18例黑色素瘤、15例基底细胞癌、6例鳞状细胞癌）均经组织学验证。患者年龄2-90岁（中位38岁），女性279名（63%），男性164名（37%）。每张图像附带专家标注的皮肤镜结构和显式的verification_stage字段。
AI.conclusion: 该数据集作为初步临床验证资源，适用于独立模型评估、域迁移分析、可解释性研究及后续扩展，填补了移动皮肤镜在俄罗斯门诊场景下标准化数据集的空白。

title: Discrepancy Minimization Improves Cross-Hospital Robustness in Digital Pathology
summary: Pathology foundation models (PFMs) have advanced rapidly in recent years and support training classifiers for a range of histopathology tasks. However, their robustness across hospitals remains limited: performance often degrades when training a classifier on data from one hospital and evaluating it on another target hospital. We address this challenge by fine-tuning PFMs with a local maximum mean discrepancy (LMMD) objective that applies to two settings: domain adaptation, where unlabeled target-hospital data is available, and domain generalization, where target-hospital data is unavailable at all. Experiments at both the patch- and slide-level show consistent improvements across multiple PFMs and tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出通过局部最大均值差异（LMMD）微调病理基础模型（PFMs），以提升其在跨医院场景下的鲁棒性，适用于领域自适应（有目标域无标签数据）和领域泛化（无目标域数据）两种设置，实验在patch和slide级别均取得一致性改进。
AI.motivation: 病理基础模型在不同医院间的性能下降严重，从源医院训练的模型部署到目标医院时表现不佳，亟需提升其跨域鲁棒性。
AI.method: 对预训练的病理基础模型进行微调，引入局部最大均值差异（LMMD）损失函数，分别适配领域自适应（有目标域无标签数据）和领域泛化（完全无目标域数据）两种场景。
AI.result: 在patch和slide两个级别上的实验表明，该方法在多个病理基础模型和任务上均取得一致的性能提升。
AI.conclusion: LMMD微调策略能有效缓解病理基础模型在跨医院场景中的性能退化问题，提升模型的域迁移能力。

title: Injecting Image Guidance into Text-Conditioned Diffusion Models at Inference
summary: Text-to-image diffusion models like Stable Diffusion generate high-quality images from text, but lack a way to inject visual guidance (e.g. sketches, styles) at inference without retraining. Existing methods either require computationally expensive fine-tuning or rely on style transfer techniques that risk semantic misalignment with textual prompts. We introduce Visual Concept Fusion (VCF), the first method offering dual conditioning on both an image and text prompt at inference time without any concept-specific training. VCF enables visual concept injection into Stable Diffusion by aligning CLIP image features with the text embedding space. VCF consists of three components: (1) a lightweight aligner that maps image tokens to the text embedding manifold using InfoNCE and cross-attention reconstruction losses, (2) a fusion strategy that preserves both textual and visual semantics, and (3) an optional Prompt-Noise Optimization (PNO) module for test-time refinement. Our experiments demonstrate that VCF successfully transfers visual attributes including style, composition, and color palette from reference images while maintaining prompt adherence. Quantitative results show a trade-off between text alignment (CLIP score) and visual correspondence (LPIPS), with VCF outperforming baselines in reference fidelity.

AI.tldr: 提出Visual Concept Fusion (VCF)，首个无需重训练即可在Stable Diffusion推理时同时接受图像和文本双条件控制的方法，通过轻量级对齐器将CLIP图像特征映射到文本嵌入空间，实现视觉概念注入。
AI.motivation: 现有文本到图像扩散模型（如Stable Diffusion）推理时无法注入视觉引导（如草图、风格），现有方法要么需要昂贵的微调，要么依赖风格迁移技术导致语义与文本提示错位。
AI.method: VCF由三部分组成：(1)轻量级对齐器，使用InfoNCE和交叉注意力重建损失将图像token映射到文本嵌入流形；(2)融合策略，保留文本和视觉语义；(3)可选的提示-噪声优化(PNO)模块用于测试时细化。
AI.result: 成功转移参考图像的风格、构图和调色板等视觉属性同时保持文本提示一致性；在文本对齐(CLIP分数)和视觉对应(LPIPS)之间存在权衡，VCF在参考保真度上优于基线。
AI.conclusion: VCF是首个无需概念特定训练即可在推理时实现图像和文本双条件控制的方法，有效平衡了文本对齐与视觉参考保真度。

title: SpongeBob: Sync-Aware Harmonious Audio-Visual Generative Editing
summary: Visual and acoustic events in the physical world are inherently coupled, yet existing video editing methods typically adopt decoupled pipelines, lacking bidirectional modality interaction. This results in two key limitations: (i) audio-visual desynchronization and (ii) contextual conflicts between generated audio and preserved content. To address these, we propose SpongeBob, the first end-to-end audio-visual joint editing framework featuring bidirectional cross-modal interaction. For synchronization, a Sync-Aware Mechanism aligns visual edits with sound events via bidirectional attention, temporal alignment, and spatial constraints. For contextual consistency, a Context-Aware Module leverages acoustic and visual context attention to prevent semantic clashes. Additionally, we introduce Sync-Preserving Training and Guidance (SPTG) to enhance alignment without degrading quality. Due to the scarcity of paired data, we construct a scalable data pipeline and a large-scale subject-level dataset. We also propose SpongeBob-Bench for systematic evaluation. Experiments show SpongeBob significantly outperforms existing baselines, improving Sync-C by 30% and Ctx-F1 by 12.5%. Our project page is available at: https://hy-spongebob.github.io/.

AI.tldr: 提出SpongeBob，首个端到端音视频联合编辑框架，通过双向跨模态交互解决音视频不同步和语义冲突问题，在Sync-C和Ctx-F1指标上分别提升30%和12.5%。
AI.motivation: 现有视频编辑方法采用解耦流水线，缺乏双向模态交互，导致音视频不同步以及生成音频与保留内容之间的上下文冲突。
AI.method: 提出SpongeBob框架：(1) Sync-Aware机制通过双向注意力、时间对齐和空间约束实现视觉编辑与声音事件的对齐；(2) Context-Aware模块利用声学和视觉上下文注意力防止语义冲突；(3) Sync-Preserving Training and Guidance (SPTG)增强对齐而不降低质量；(4) 构建可扩展数据流水线和大规模主体级数据集及SpongeBob-Bench评估基准。
AI.result: 实验表明SpongeBob显著优于现有基线，Sync-C提升30%，Ctx-F1提升12.5%。
AI.conclusion: SpongeBob作为首个端到端音视频联合编辑框架，有效解决了音视频编辑中的同步与上下文一致性问题，大幅提升性能。

title: Baton: Explicit Semantic Blueprints for Joint Video-Audio Generation
summary: Current open-source diffusion models struggle to generate stable and synchronized audio-visual content, particularly in scenarios demanding complex semantic reasoning. The root cause is that existing methods rely on coarse text embeddings from off-the-shelf encoders to guide audio-video denoising, which discards fine-grained semantics and, critically, lacks a shared long-horizon plan, leading to uncoordinated denoising trajectories and fragile cross-modal alignment. We propose Baton, the first framework that introduces explicit semantic planning into joint video-audio generation. Our key insight is that complementing coarse text guidance with semantically rich, modality-aware planned tokens, jointly reasoned and mutually aligned before denoising, can simultaneously restore fine-grained semantic detail and establish a shared blueprint that coordinates both audio and video denoising trajectories. Concretely, Baton first introduces the VA-Planner, a multimodal language model equipped with dual semantic alignment towers, where learnable queries cross-attend to both video and audio features to produce a pair of semantically aligned video and audio planned tokens as keyframe-level blueprints. These planned tokens are injected into the diffusion backbone via cross-attention layers, providing temporally grounded guidance complementary to coarse text embeddings. Since planned tokens do not share one-to-one spatial-temporal correspondence with diffusion latents, we further propose Relative Semantic RoPE, a relative positional encoding that maps planned tokens and latents into a shared spatial-temporal coordinate frame, enabling each latent to accurately attend to its positionally corresponding semantic cues. Experiments on benchmarks show the effectiveness of Baton both qualitatively and quantitatively.

AI.tldr: Baton提出了首个显式语义规划框架用于联合视频-音频生成，通过VA-Planner生成模态感知的规划令牌作为蓝图，并利用相对语义RoPE实现跨模态对齐，解决了现有方法因缺乏共享长程规划导致的音视频不同步和语义细节丢失问题。
AI.motivation: 现有开源扩散模型在生成稳定同步的音视频内容时表现不佳，尤其在需要复杂语义推理的场景下。根本原因在于现有方法依赖现成编码器的粗糙文本嵌入来引导音频-视频去噪，这丢弃了细粒度语义，且缺乏共享的长程规划，导致去噪轨迹不协调、跨模态对齐脆弱。
AI.method: Baton框架包含三个核心组件：1) VA-Planner，一个配备双语义对齐塔的多模态语言模型，通过可学习查询交叉关注视频和音频特征，生成语义对齐的视频和音频规划令牌作为关键帧级蓝图；2) 将这些规划令牌通过交叉注意力层注入扩散主干，作为粗文本嵌入的补充引导；3) 相对语义RoPE，一种相对位置编码，将规划令牌和扩散潜变量映射到共享的时空坐标框架，使每个潜变量能准确关注其位置对应的语义线索。
AI.result: 在多个基准测试上的定性和定量实验均证明了Baton的有效性。
AI.conclusion: Baton通过引入显式语义规划，有效解决了音视频联合生成中的跨模态对齐和细粒度语义保持问题，为开放域音视频生成提供了新的范式。

title: Guess the Unified Model: How Much Can We Recover from Generated Images?
summary: With unified model-generated images now widespread online, attributing their model of origin offers a path toward transparency and deeper insight into the characteristic behaviors of individual models. Prior work has explored provenance in LLM-generated text, diffusion model images, and datasets, but the separability of unified model-generated images remains an underexplored area. We address this gap by examining separability across corruption, domains, and prompt languages using images generated by seven unified models. We show that model attribution is highly feasible as our model achieves near-perfect accuracy with around 20K images per model. Corruptions and structural perturbations have only a modest effect on attribution performance, and cross-domain generalization reveals that semantic content contributes to separability but is not the dominant signal. Finally, we observe that for most models, prompt language attribution is around chance levels, suggesting minimal language-specific visual signatures. These findings highlight consistent model-specific visual characteristics in unified models outputs and open new directions for tracing and auditing generative image pipelines.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了统一模型生成图像的来源归因问题，证明基于约20K图像/模型可实现近完美准确率，且 corruption、域迁移和提示语言对归因性能影响有限，揭示了模型特有的视觉特征。
AI.motivation: 统一模型生成的图像在网络上广泛传播，追溯其来源模型有助于提高透明度并深入理解各模型的行为特征。已有研究探索了LLM生成文本、扩散模型图像和数据集的 provenance，但统一模型生成图像的可分离性仍是未充分探索的领域。
AI.method: 使用7个统一模型生成的图像，在 corruption、域和提示语言三个维度上检验模型归因的可分离性。采用分类模型进行来源归属，评估在不同扰动、域迁移和语言条件下的性能。
AI.result: 模型归因高度可行，约20K图像/模型可实现近完美准确率；corruption 和结构扰动对归因性能影响较小；跨域泛化表明语义内容对可分离性有贡献但非主导信号；大部分模型的提示语言归因接近随机水平。
AI.conclusion: 统一模型输出中存在一致的模型特定视觉特征，为追溯和审计生成图像流程开辟了新方向。

title: Semantics-Guided Multimodal Masked Autoencoder Pretraining for 3D BEV Object Detection
comment: Accepted at the ICRA 2026 Workshop on Semantics for Reliable Robot Autonomy (SRRA) as a lightning talk and poster
summary: Accurate 3D bird's-eye view (BEV) object detection is essential for autonomous driving, and depends strongly on effective multimodal representations from complementary sensors such as cameras and LiDAR. Multimodal masked autoencoders have shown strong potential for learning such representations for downstream 3D BEV object detection. However, existing methods typically apply uniform random masking to camera and LiDAR inputs, treating all regions equally, and learn representations only through masked reconstruction. We propose a semantics-guided multimodal masked autoencoder framework that introduces semantic information during pretraining through two separate components: (i) semantics-guided LiDAR voxel masking, which preserves semantically important LiDAR regions more strongly, and (ii) an auxiliary point-wise LiDAR semantic decoder branch that injects semantic guidance in addition to reconstruction. On BEVFusion 3D object detection, our semantics-guided pretraining strategy improves performance on the nuScenes mini validation set compared to the standard UniM2AE baseline: semantics-guided LiDAR voxel masking yields +1.49% mean Average Precision (mAP) and +1.66% nuScenes Detection Score (NDS), while decoder-side point semantic supervision yields +1.39% mAP and +3.22% NDS over the baseline.

AI.tldr: 提出语义引导的多模态掩码自编码器框架，在预训练中引入语义信息：1）语义引导的LiDAR体素掩码策略保留重要语义区域；2）辅助点级LiDAR语义解码分支。在BEVFusion上相比UniM2AE基线，mAP提升1.49%-1.39%，NDS提升1.66%-3.22%。
AI.motivation: 现有方法对相机和LiDAR输入采用均匀随机掩码，所有区域同等对待，且仅通过掩码重建学习表示，缺乏语义信息的引导。
AI.method: 提出语义引导的多模态掩码自编码器框架，包含两个组件：1）语义引导的LiDAR体素掩码，保留语义重要区域；2）辅助点级LiDAR语义解码分支，在重建之外注入语义监督信号。
AI.result: 在BEVFusion 3D检测任务上，语义引导的LiDAR体素掩码相比基线提升+1.49% mAP和+1.66% NDS；解码侧点语义监督提升+1.39% mAP和+3.22% NDS。
AI.conclusion: 语义引导的预训练策略能有效提升多模态BEV 3D目标检测性能，尤其是NDS指标提升显著。

title: DeltaCam: Differential Intrinsic Camera Modeling for Video Generation
summary: Incorporating camera intrinsics into video generation models offers a principled way to control not only scene dynamics but also the imaging process that governs visual appearance. Prior work has primarily focused on extrinsic control, such as camera pose and motion, while treating intrinsic camera parameters as implicit or fixed. A key bottleneck is the lack of large-scale video datasets with accurate and diverse temporally varying camera metadata, which makes learning absolute camera parameterizations difficult. As a result, current models struggle to incorporate photographic camera behavior, including depth-of-field transitions, exposure variations, lens distortions, and color processing, in a controllable and temporally consistent manner. We introduce DeltaCam, a video diffusion framework that models camera behavior through $Δ$-parameterized neural camera adaptors, operating on relative changes in camera motion and intrinsics instead of absolute states. By learning this differential formulation from synthetic video data, we mitigate reliance on precise real-world camera labels and enable smooth, consistent control over imaging factors such as focal length, aperture, ISO, color temperature, and lens distortion. We extend this framework to real-world footage through two mechanisms: finetuning the controls on real image-metadata pairs for precise shot matching, and extracting disentangled embeddings for implicit video-to-video style transfer without requiring explicit camera parameters. By effectively separating scene content from intrinsic imaging behavior, DeltaCam enables camera-consistent video generation and editing operations that are difficult to achieve with existing models. Ultimately, our results establish a practical and scalable approach for bridging synthetic control and real-world photographic emulation.

AI.tldr: DeltaCam提出了一种基于Δ参数化神经相机适配器的视频扩散框架，通过学习相对变化的相机运动和内参（而非绝对状态），实现对焦距、光圈、ISO、色温、镜头畸变等摄影行为的可控、时域一致的视频生成，并支持从合成数据到真实场景的迁移。
AI.motivation: 现有视频生成模型主要关注相机姿态和运动等外参控制，而将内参（如焦距、光圈、ISO等）视为隐式或固定参数。缺乏大规模带有准确、多样、时变相机元数据的视频数据集，导致难以学习绝对相机参数化，模型无法以可控且时域一致的方式模拟景深变换、曝光变化、镜头畸变和色彩处理等摄影行为。
AI.method: 提出DeltaCam框架，核心包括：(1) Δ参数化神经相机适配器，学习相机运动和内参的相对变化而非绝对状态；(2) 使用合成视频数据进行训练，减少对真实相机标签的依赖；(3) 通过两种机制扩展到真实数据：在真实图像-元数据对上进行微调以实现精确镜头匹配，以及提取解耦嵌入用于隐式视频到视频的风格迁移。
AI.result: DeltaCam能够实现平滑、一致的相机内参控制，支持景深过渡、曝光变化、镜头畸变和色彩处理等摄影行为的可控生成。在真实场景中，通过微调和隐式风格迁移实现了镜头匹配和相机一致的视频生成与编辑，效果优于现有模型。
AI.conclusion: 通过将场景内容与成像行为有效分离，DeltaCam建立了一种实用且可扩展的方法，弥合了合成控制与真实摄影仿真之间的鸿沟，为相机一致性的视频生成和编辑提供了新范式。

title: Hide to Guide: Learning via Semantic Masking
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has become a powerful paradigm for improving language models on reasoning-intensive tasks, but its effectiveness is often limited by exploration. For example, models often fail on hard problems, leaving little useful reward signal. External expert traces offer a natural source of guidance, yet they may also expose reward-relevant content along the critical path to the verifier target, such as final answers, intermediate values, executable implementations, or answer-related entities. This content can create an unintended reward hacking channel, allowing the policy to obtain reward by copying the trace rather than learning the underlying reasoning or agentic behavior. Existing guided-RL methods reduce this risk by using partial trajectories, but they mainly control how much expert information is shown heuristically rather than which parts should be hidden. To this end, we propose Semantic Masked Expert Policy Optimization (SMEPO), a fine-grained semantic masking strategy for expert-guided RLVR. Instead of truncating traces coarsely or revealing them unchanged, SMEPO masks reward-relevant semantic spans along the critical path while preserving the expert's decomposition, plan, and procedural structure. This turns hard problems from reasoning from scratch into a fill-in-the-blank process: the policy can follow the expert's problem-solving route, but must still reconstruct the missing values, code, or entities by itself. SMEPO is simple to apply and requires no changes to the reward function or RL objective. Across diverse domains, including math, code, and agentic search, SMEPO improves accuracy by up to 3.2 points over GRPO and reduces training time by up to 4.2x. The code is available at https://github.com/mit-han-lab/SMEPO.

AI.tldr: SMEPO提出了一种细粒度的语义掩码策略，在专家引导的RLVR中遮蔽奖励相关的语义片段（如答案、中间值、代码等），迫使模型在跟随专家分解和规划路径的同时自行重建关键内容，从而避免奖励黑客行为，在数学、代码和智能体搜索任务上相比GRPO提升最高3.2个点，训练时间减少最多4.2倍。
AI.motivation: 现有RLVR方法在推理密集型任务中面临探索不足的问题，模型在困难问题上难以获得有效奖励信号。外部专家轨迹虽然能提供引导，但会暴露最终答案、中间值、可执行代码等奖励相关内容，形成意外的奖励黑客通道——策略模型只需复制轨迹而非真正学习推理或智能体行为。现有引导式RL方法主要通过启发式控制专家信息展示的多少，而非控制哪些部分应该被隐藏。
AI.method: 提出语义掩码专家策略优化（SMEPO），一种细粒度的语义掩码策略。具体而言：1) 识别专家轨迹中沿关键路径的奖励相关语义片段（如最终答案、中间值、可执行实现、答案相关实体）；2) 对这些语义片段进行掩码，同时保留专家的分解结构、规划和过程性框架；3) 将困难问题从"从头推理"转变为"填空"过程——策略模型可以跟随专家的问题解决路径，但必须自行重建缺失的值、代码或实体。SMEPO无需修改奖励函数或RL目标。
AI.result: 在数学、代码和智能体搜索等多个领域上，SMEPO相比GRPO准确率提升最高3.2个百分点，训练时间减少最多4.2倍。
AI.conclusion: SMEPO作为一种简单易用的细粒度语义掩码策略，有效解决了专家引导RLVR中的奖励黑客问题，通过遮蔽关键语义片段来迫使模型真正学习推理过程，同时保持专家轨迹的结构性引导价值，显著提升了训练效率和任务性能。

title: Geometry-Aware Image Flow Matching
summary: Recent advances in generative models highlight the power of geometry-aware modeling in manifold-constrained settings. Yet, for natural images, the field remains confined to Euclidean assumptions, failing to exploit the potential of intrinsic geometric structures within the data. In this work, we investigate the geometry of natural images and observe that semantic information is predominantly encoded in directional components, while norm components can be approximated by the global average. This property holds across both RGB and latent spaces, suggesting that natural images can be effectively modeled on a hypersphere. Building on this finding, we introduce Spherical Optimal Transport Flow Matching (SOT-CFM), which utilizes angular distance, and Spherical Flow Matching (SFM), which constrains dynamics directly on the manifold. Our experiments demonstrate that these geometry-aware methods achieve superior performance against Euclidean baselines. Ultimately, this work provides a novel perspective that bridges the gap between Riemannian manifold-based modeling and natural image generation.

AI.tldr: 本文发现自然图像的语义信息主要编码在方向分量中，而范数分量可被全局均值近似，因此自然图像可在超球面上有效建模。基于此，提出了球面最优传输流匹配（SOT-CFM）和球面流匹配（SFM），在图像生成任务中取得了优于欧几里得基线的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有生成模型在流形约束场景中已展现几何感知建模的优势，但在自然图像领域仍局限于欧几里得假设，未能利用数据内在的几何结构。本文旨在探索自然图像的几何特性，并引入黎曼流形建模来弥合这一差距。
AI.method: 1. 通过实验观察发现自然图像（RGB空间和潜空间）的语义信息主要由方向分量编码，范数分量可由全局平均近似。2. 基于此提出两种方法：Spherical Optimal Transport Flow Matching (SOT-CFM)，使用角距离构建最优传输；Spherical Flow Matching (SFM)，直接在超球面流形上约束动力学过程。
AI.result: 实验表明，所提出的几何感知方法（SOT-CFM和SFM）在图像生成任务中性能优于欧几里得基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 本工作为连接黎曼流形建模与自然图像生成提供了新视角，证明了超球面几何在自然图像建模中的有效性。

title: Multi-Objective Learning for Diffusion Models: A Statistical Theory under Semi-Supervised Learning
summary: Diffusion models are increasingly used as powerful conditional generators, yet real deployments often involve multiple target distributions arising from different tasks, e.g., diverse prompt domains in text-to-image generation, or multiple environments in robotics with diffusion policies. This naturally leads to a multi-objective learning (MOL) problem. A key challenge is that achieving good Pareto trade-offs can require a generalist model class with substantially larger capacity than what suffices for solving any individual task, thereby increasing statistical cost since sample complexity typically scales with the model complexity. To reconcile this, we develop a principled MOL framework for diffusion models with limited data: a semi-supervised regime where paired (labeled) samples are scarce, but (unlabeled) condition data are abundant. We propose a two-stage training procedure that first fits lightweight specialist models from limited paired data, and then distills them into a generalist model by generating pseudo-samples. We establish generalization bounds showing that the required number of paired samples only depends on the complexity of the specialist model classes. We further extend the theory to diffusion policies for sequential decision making to account for distribution shift in on-policy rollouts. Extensive experiments on robotic control and image restoration tasks are conducted to verify our theoretical results.

AI.tldr: 本文针对扩散模型的多目标学习问题，提出了一种半监督两阶段训练框架：先用少量配对数据训练轻量级专家模型，再通过生成伪样本将其蒸馏为通用模型。理论证明所需配对样本量仅取决于专家模型复杂度，实验在机器人控制和图像恢复任务上验证了有效性。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型在真实部署中常需应对多个目标分布（如文本到图像的不同提示域、机器人扩散策略的多环境），这构成多目标学习问题。然而，实现良好帕累托权衡需要容量更大的通用模型，导致统计成本随模型复杂度增加而上升。为调和这一矛盾，需在数据有限条件下开发高效的多目标学习框架。
AI.method: 提出半监督两阶段训练方法：(1) 从有限的配对（标记）数据中训练轻量级专家模型；(2) 利用专家模型生成伪样本，将知识蒸馏为通用模型。理论层面建立了泛化界，证明所需配对样本量仅取决于专家模型类的复杂度，并扩展至序列决策中的扩散策略以处理策略 rollout 的分布偏移。
AI.result: 理论结果表明配对样本复杂度仅与专家模型容量相关，与通用模型复杂度解耦。在机器人控制和图像恢复任务上的实验验证了所提方法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 本文为扩散模型在数据有限的多目标场景下提供了原则性框架，通过专家-蒸馏范式有效降低了配对数据需求，并拓展至扩散策略的序列决策问题。

title: A Principled Self-Referenced Early Stopping Approach for Deep Image Prior
summary: Recently, Deep Image Prior (DIP) has demonstrated strong capabilities for solving inverse imaging problems (IIPs) by optimizing a randomly initialized convolutional neural network in a training-data-free regime. However, DIP suffers from overfitting to noisy measurements due to network over-parameterization, making early stopping (ES) essential. The most successful ES method tracks fluctuations in the running variance of the network output to detect overfitting. However, in many applications, these fluctuations may appear prematurely, leading to unstable reconstructions. In this paper, we first show that nearly optimal DIP early stopping can be achieved when two independent noisy copies of the degraded image are available. Motivated by this observation, and since obtaining two fully independent copies is infeasible, we propose an overfitting detection framework based on constructing pseudo self-referenced images, resulting in three IIP-specific algorithms. Our approach is further supported by theoretical results on single-reference validation, pseudo-validation estimation, and the impact of shared noise. Across different IIPs, ranging from natural image restoration to medical image reconstruction, and under varying noise levels and noise types, our methods consistently outperform existing DIP early stopping approaches, all without requiring an accurate estimate of the noise level.

AI.tldr: 针对DIP在无训练数据逆成像问题中过拟合噪声的问题，提出基于构造伪自参考图像的早停检测框架，利用两个独立噪声副本的思想设计三种算法，理论证明了单参考验证、伪验证估计及共享噪声的影响，在多种逆成像任务中优于现有早停方法，且无需准确噪声估计。
AI.motivation: DIP虽在无训练数据逆成像问题中表现优异，但网络过参数化导致对噪声测量过拟合，现有早停方法（基于输出running variance波动检测）在波动提前出现时重建不稳定，亟需更鲁棒的过拟合检测机制。
AI.method: 1. 理论证明当存在两个独立噪声副本时可达近最优早停；2. 由于实际中无法获取完全独立副本，提出基于构造伪自参考图像的过拟合检测框架；3. 设计三种IIP-specific算法；4. 提供单参考验证、伪验证估计及共享噪声影响的理论分析。
AI.result: 在自然图像恢复和医学图像重建等多种逆成像任务中，在不同噪声水平和噪声类型下，所提方法均一致优于现有DIP早停方法，且无需准确噪声水平估计。
AI.conclusion: 通过构造伪自参考图像实现近乎最优的早停检测，为DIP在逆成像问题中的实际应用提供了更鲁棒、更通用的过拟合检测方案。

title: Recursive Class Connectivity Classification (R3C) Applied to Binary Image Segmentation for Improved Infant Fingerprint Enhancement
summary: Image enhancement plays a crucial role in infant fingerprint matching, as child-specific characteristics such as smaller finger dimensions and thinner ridge structures often degrade image quality during acquisition. To address these limitations, enrollment typically depends on specialized highresolution scanners, which most existing enhancement methods are not designed to support. Consequently, identification rates for children remain significantly lower than those achieved with adult fingerprints. This study introduces Recursive Class Connectivity Classification (R3C), a novel framework that iteratively refines binary segmentation outputs from existing enhancement methods by extending ridge structures. R3C does not require modifications to the underlying classifier and operates without training data, which is not currently available for infant fingerprints. Instead, the method improves segmentation by repeatedly feeding the classified image back into the classification process, while combining each intermediate segmentation with the original input image. Experiments conducted on three fingerprint datasets using four different enhancement classifiers show that R3C can increase the True Acceptance Rate (TAR) by up to 4% for children and over 40% for newborns, compared to using the enhancement methods alone. A qualitative analysis further demonstrates that R3C reconnects fragmented ridge patterns, improving the visual quality of segmentation. Because it functions independently of the enhancement method used, R3C provides a flexible and broadly applicable solution for improving binary segmentation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出R3C框架，通过迭代反馈机制改进现有指纹增强方法的二值分割输出，无需训练数据即可重新连接断裂脊线，在儿童和新生儿指纹数据集上分别将TAR提升最高4%和40%以上。
AI.motivation: 婴幼儿指纹匹配中，由于手指尺寸小、脊线结构薄，图像质量差，现有增强方法不支持高分辨率扫描仪采集的图像，导致识别率远低于成年人。
AI.method: R3C（递归类连通性分类）框架：将分类后的二值分割图像反复迭代地反馈回分类过程，每次将中间分割结果与原始输入图像结合，循环优化脊线结构，无需修改底层分类器，无需训练数据。
AI.result: 在三个指纹数据集上使用四种增强分类器，R3C使儿童的TAR提升最高4%，新生儿的TAR提升超过40%；定性分析显示R3C能有效重建断裂脊线，提升分割视觉质量。
AI.conclusion: R3C是一种独立于增强方法的通用框架，能够灵活且广泛地应用于改进二值分割，尤其适用于缺乏训练数据的婴幼儿指纹场景。

title: Continuous-Depth Field Theory for Transformer Patching and Mechanistic Interpretability
summary: Mechanistic interpretability often uses activation patching, causal tracing, path patching, and steering directions to reveal behaviorally meaningful directions in Transformer activation space. This paper develops a field-theoretic framework for organizing and predicting such interventions. Treating the residual stream as a depth-token field, we formulate patching as localized source insertion, patch effects as sensitivity-field predictions, downstream propagation as empirical Green-function response, and patch selection as an adjoint variational problem. Empirically, we test the forward response theory in GPT-2-style autoregressive Transformers by applying localized residual-field interventions and observing the induced residual-field differences and logit-difference responses. We identify a bounded local linear regime; predict patch effects from first-order sensitivities across residual sites; measure structured anisotropic propagation across depth and token position; construct response descriptions from high-sensitivity sites and sliced Green operators; and show that prompt-induced residual displacements can transfer answer behavior. These results establish response objects, namely sensitivities, propagated fields, and Green-operator slices, as a practical language for organizing patching experiments and as the forward mathematical basis for formulating patch-site inference and cross-scale transfer.formulated.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种场论框架来组织和预测Transformer中的激活干预（如激活修补、因果追踪等），将残差流视为深度-标记场，并通过敏感度、格林函数响应和伴随变分问题等工具建立了可验证的前向响应理论。
AI.motivation: 机械可解释性中常用的激活修补、因果追踪等方法缺乏统一的理论框架来组织和预测干预效果，现有研究多为实验驱动，缺少对干预如何传播和影响下游行为的系统性数学描述。
AI.method: 1) 将残差流形式化为深度-标记场；2) 修补视为局部源插入，修补效应视为敏感度场预测；3) 下游传播视为经验格林函数响应；4) 修补选择视为伴随变分问题；5) 在GPT-2风格自回归Transformer上进行实验验证。
AI.result: 1) 识别出有界局部线性响应区域；2) 通过一阶敏感度预测修补效应；3) 观察到跨深度和标记位置的结构化各向异性传播；4) 构建了高敏感度位点和格林算子切片响应描述；5) 证明提示诱导的残差位移可转移答案行为。
AI.conclusion: 敏感度、传播场和格林算子切片等响应对象构成了组织修补实验的实用语言，并为修补位点推断和跨尺度迁移建立了前向数学基础。

title: Perceive-then-Plan: Layout-as-Policy for Monocular 3D Scene Layout Estimation
summary: Building structured 3D scene layouts from a single image requires reconciling visual observations with physical and spatial constraints, a challenge that is difficult to address with direct prediction alone. In this work, we formulate monocular 3D layout estimation as a perceive-then-plan problem with vision-language models, where a Perceiver first grounds the 3D objects and then a Planner iteratively refines the scene hypothesis through actions that improve physical plausibility while preserving consistency with the input image. We propose Layout-as-Policy (LaP), which casts the planning stage as a policy learning problem: 3D layouts are represented as structured states, and refined via discrete actions such as translation, rotation, and rescaling. Starting from an observation-aligned initialization with the geometry-enhanced Perceiver, the LaP Planner is trained to produce action sequences that progressively resolve geometric inconsistencies and enforce realistic spatial relations. To enable effective learning, we combine supervised trajectory initialization with preference-based optimization, allowing the model to learn corrective behaviors without requiring explicit reward engineering. This formulation transforms layout estimation from a one-shot prediction task into an iterative refinement process, enabling better handling of global constraints and complex object interactions. Experiments demonstrate that our approach produces layouts that are more physically coherent and better aligned with visual observations, while naturally supporting downstream tasks such as scene editing and manipulation.

AI.tldr: 提出Layout-as-Policy (LaP)框架，将单目3D布局估计转化为感知-规划问题，通过视觉语言模型中的感知器进行初始物体定位，再由规划器通过强化学习策略迭代优化布局，实现物理合理性与视觉一致性的平衡。
AI.motivation: 单张图像构建结构化3D场景布局需要同时满足视觉观察与物理空间约束，直接预测方法难以有效处理全局约束和复杂物体交互，现有方法缺乏可迭代优化的机制。
AI.method: 提出LaP框架：1) 几何增强的感知器(Perceiver)实现观测对齐的初始布局；2) 将规划阶段建模为策略学习问题，布局表示为结构化状态，通过平移、旋转、缩放等离散动作进行迭代优化；3) 结合监督轨迹初始化与基于偏好的优化，无需显式奖励工程即可学习纠正行为。
AI.result: 实验表明该方法生成的布局在物理连贯性和视觉对齐度上优于现有方法，并自然支持场景编辑和操作等下游任务。
AI.conclusion: 将布局估计从单次预测转化为迭代优化过程，通过策略学习有效处理全局约束与复杂物体交互，为视觉语言模型在3D场景理解中的应用提供了新范式。

title: A Blended Likelihood Approach for Achieving Fairness Using Naive Bayes
summary: Concerns about algorithmic bias and fairness have increased as artificial intelligence has been incorporated into high-stakes decision-making. Traditional Naive Bayes classifiers, while efficient and interpretable, lack fairness-awareness mechanisms and perpetuate historical biases in sensitive domains such as hiring, credit scoring, and criminal justice. This study develops a fairness-aware extension of the Naive Bayes classifier that mitigates bias while maintaining computational efficiency. We propose the Bias Mitigating Naive Bayes (BMNB) classifier, integrating in-processing and post-processing interventions. The in-processing stage employs a blended likelihood approach combining group-specific and pooled likelihood estimates through a tunable blending parameter alpha to balance fairness and accuracy. The post-processing stage applies output calibration with adaptive thresholding to fine-tune group-specific decision boundaries. Experimental results indicate that BMNB attains Disparate Impact (DI) values of 1.000, 1.171, and 0.997 and Equal Opportunity Difference (EOD) values of -0.217, -0.226, and -0.053 on the Adult, ProPublica, and Framingham datasets, respectively, while maintaining computational efficiency. Ablation studies confirm that the combination of blended likelihood and adaptive thresholding yields superior performance compared to either technique in isolation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种公平感知的朴素贝叶斯分类器（BMNB），通过混合似然估计（内处理）和自适应阈值校准（后处理）来缓解算法偏见，在三个数据集上实现了接近完美的差异影响（DI≈1.0）和较小的等机会差异（EOD），同时保持计算效率。
AI.motivation: 传统朴素贝叶斯分类器在高风险决策（如招聘、信用评分、刑事司法）中缺乏公平性机制，会延续历史偏见。需要在保持计算效率的同时，为朴素贝叶斯引入公平性干预措施。
AI.method: 提出BMNB分类器，包含两个阶段：(1) 内处理阶段：采用混合似然方法，通过可调混合参数alpha融合组特定似然估计和全局似然估计，平衡公平与准确率；(2) 后处理阶段：应用自适应阈值校准，微调组特定决策边界。
AI.result: 在Adult、ProPublica、Framingham数据集上，DI值分别为1.000、1.171、0.997（接近1为理想）；EOD值分别为-0.217、-0.226、-0.053（接近0为理想）。消融实验证实混合似然与自适应阈值结合优于单独使用任一技术。
AI.conclusion: BMNB在保持朴素贝叶斯计算效率优势的同时，有效缓解了算法偏见，是一种可行的公平感知分类方案。

title: On the Epistemic Uncertainty of Overparametrized Neural Networks
summary: Epistemic uncertainty is often viewed as a reducible uncertainty that vanishes with increasing data. This perspective implicitly assumes parameter identifiability and equates epistemic uncertainty with predictive variability. In overparametrized neural networks, however, model parameters are typically non-identifiable due to symmetries and redundant representations. As a consequence, substantial parameter uncertainty can persist even when the underlying function is fully identified. In this work, we analyze epistemic uncertainty through the lens of non-identifiability and characterize both discrete and continuous sources of residual uncertainty. Focusing on one-hidden-layer ReLU networks, we thoroughly analyze the resulting posterior structure and validate our theoretical insights through empirical studies.

AI.tldr: 本文通过非可识别性视角分析过参数化神经网络中的认知不确定性，指出在参数非可识别的情况下，即使底层函数完全确定，参数不确定性仍会持续存在。研究以单隐层ReLU网络为例，深入分析了后验结构中的离散和连续残余不确定性来源。
AI.motivation: 现有研究将认知不确定性视为随数据增加而减少的可约不确定性，这一观点隐含地假设了参数可识别性，但在过参数化神经网络中参数通常由于对称性和冗余表示而不可识别，因此需要重新审视认知不确定性的本质。
AI.method: 通过非可识别性视角分析认知不确定性，区分离散和连续两种残余不确定性来源，并以单隐层ReLU网络为具体案例进行后验结构分析与实证验证。
AI.result: 在过参数化神经网络中，即使底层函数被完全识别，参数不确定性仍会因非可识别性而持续存在，具体表现为离散和连续两种类型的残余不确定性。
AI.conclusion: 认知不确定性不能简单等同于随数据增加而消减的可约不确定性，在非可识别模型（如过参数化神经网络）中需区分函数层面与参数层面的不确定性。

title: Constraint-Anchored Attribution: Feasibility-Certified Counterfactuals and Bonferroni-PAC Sufficient Subsets for Neural CO Policies
summary: We give an attribution method for neural combinatorial-optimisation (CO) policies that (i) decomposes a decision by constraint families via LP-relaxation duals, (ii) certifies counterfactuals through a combinatorial feasibility model (implemented as a CSP feasibility-decision model), and (iii) bounds the size of a PAC-sufficient explanation with a Bonferroni-corrected Hoeffding sufficient-subset test along a greedy ordering. Across three CO problems and three seeds, our LP-anchored $Λ$-attribution matches the CF-derived signal at 96.5% on CVRPTW (n_cert=344) and 77.2% on the Orienteering Problem (n_cert=281) vs 75.0% and 35.2% for proxy gradient (paired diffs +0.215 and +0.420; McNemar exact $p \le 10^{-14}$). In the rank-aligned regime of the Flexible Job-Shop Scheduling Problem, both backends agree on every CSP-certified flip (n_cert=59), confirming the no-gain prediction. Bonferroni-PAC subsets average 5.0 nodes per step ($M=70$, $\varepsilon=δ=0.2$, $k_{\max}=25$). Reference implementation: https://github.com/sohaibafifi/neuro-co-cax

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种针对神经组合优化（CO）策略的归因方法，通过LP松弛对偶分解决策、利用CSP可行性模型验证反事实、并结合Bonferroni校正的Hoeffding充分子集测试提供PAC可解释性。实验表明该方法在多个CO问题上优于代理梯度方法。
AI.motivation: 现有的神经组合优化策略缺乏可解释性，难以理解模型决策背后的原因，且缺乏有效的归因方法来验证反事实场景。
AI.method: 提出LP锚定的Λ-归因方法：(i) 通过LP松弛对偶将决策按约束族分解；(ii) 通过CSP可行性决策模型认证反事实；(iii) 使用Bonferroni校正的Hoeffding充分子集测试沿贪心排序提供PAC充分解释。
AI.result: 在CVRPTW上LP锚定归因与CF信号匹配率达96.5%（n_cert=344），在定向问题上达77.2%（n_cert=281），显著优于代理梯度的75.0%和35.2%（McNemar精确检验p≤10⁻¹⁴）。在柔性作业车间调度问题中两种后端完全一致。Bonferroni-PAC子集平均每步5.0个节点。
AI.conclusion: 该方法能够提供更准确的归因和可解释性，为神经组合优化策略的透明度提供了一个有效的框架。

title: Dual-Pathway Geometry-Aware MLLM for Spatial Intelligence
summary: Spatial understanding of the physical world from 2D visual inputs hinges on two complementary forms of geometric knowledge: holistic 3D structural perception and fine-grained metric scale estimation. Existing multimodal large language models (MLLMs) typically address only one facet, ingesting either depth maps or point clouds as additional model inputs, which incurs substantial computational overhead and inherits the generalization limitations of upstream prediction models. We propose GAMSI, a dual-pathway Geometry-Aware MLLM for Spatial Intelligence that takes only RGB images as input while internalizing both forms of geometric prior within a unified autoregressive backbone. Specifically, we introduce Metric-Structure Decoupled Queries (MSDQ) which employ two groups of learnable queries to respectively extract dense metric signals and sparse structural cues from the shared visual context, with a task-decoupled attention mask further preventing the two pathways from contaminating each other. Building on this, an Expert-Guided Visual Grounding (EVG) module projects the aggregated cues back to frame-level visual features and aligns them with vision foundation models, which serve purely as training-time supervision, rather than as model inputs. We further build a multi-task spatial instruction-tuning dataset (MTS) comprising 152{,}776 samples spanning 13 task types and three visual modalities, consolidated from six public datasets. Trained with a two-stage curriculum, GAMSI achieves state-of-the-art performance on seven spatial intelligence benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 提出GAMSI，一种仅以RGB图像为输入、通过双路径架构内化3D结构和度量尺度两种几何先验的多模态大语言模型，在七个空间智能基准上取得最优性能。
AI.motivation: 现有MLLM通常只处理3D结构感知或度量尺度估计中的单一维度，且依赖深度图或点云作为额外输入，带来大量计算开销并受限于上游预测模型的泛化能力。亟需一种仅以RGB为输入、同时内化两种几何先验的统一框架。
AI.method: 提出Metric-Structure Decoupled Queries (MSDQ)，用两组可学习查询分别从共享视觉上下文中提取密集度量信号和稀疏结构线索，并通过任务解耦注意力掩码防止两条路径相互干扰；进一步设计Expert-Guided Visual Grounding (EVG)模块将聚合线索投影回帧级视觉特征，与视觉基础模型对齐（仅作为训练时监督）；构建多任务空间指令微调数据集MTS（152,776样本，13种任务类型，3种视觉模态），采用两阶段课程训练。
AI.result: 在七个空间智能基准上达到最先进性能。
AI.conclusion: GAMSI证明了仅以RGB为输入、通过解耦双路径设计内化多种几何先验的有效性，为空间智能MLLM提供了轻量级且泛化性更强的新范式。

title: Quantifying Empirical Compute-Supervision Tradeoffs in RLVR
comment: Workshop on Combining Theory and Benchmarks @ ICML 2026
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has become a standard paradigm for post-training language models, but in practice, verifiers are rarely perfect. Recent theoretical work predicts that verifier noise affects the rate of learning but not its final outcome, implying that sufficient compute should close any gap induced by imperfect supervision. We test this prediction empirically by post-training Qwen2.5 (0.5B, 1.5B) with GRPO on GSM8K while injecting controlled false-positive and false-negative noise into the binary correctness signal, and varying rollouts per prompt as a compute axis. In practice, the gap in validation accuracy persists under substantial compute scaling, with returns to compute that are sharply diminishing. We further find a structural asymmetry where false negatives monotonically degrade performance quicker than with false positives. These findings suggest verifier quality and training compute are not interchangeable, and that reducing false negatives is a more effective lever than scaling compute alone.

AI.tldr: 本文通过实验发现，在RLVR训练中，验证器噪声（特别是假阴性）造成的性能差距无法通过增加计算量弥补，验证器质量与计算资源不可互换。
AI.motivation: 现有理论认为验证器噪声只影响学习速率而不影响最终结果，即足够计算量可以弥补不完美监督带来的差距。本文旨在实证检验这一理论预测是否成立。
AI.method: 使用Qwen2.5（0.5B, 1.5B）模型，在GSM8K数据集上以GRPO进行后训练，向二元正确性信号中注入受控的假阳性和假阴性噪声，并以每提示的rollout次数作为计算量轴进行实验。
AI.result: 计算量大幅扩展下验证准确率的差距仍然存在，计算收益急剧递减；假阴性比假阳性更快地单调降低性能。
AI.conclusion: 验证器质量与训练计算量不可互换，减少假阴性比单纯扩展计算量更有效。

title: Toward Native Multimodal Modeling: A Roadmap
summary: Multimodal modeling represents a vital step from modality-agnostic reasoning toward world modeling. While early approaches predominantly rely on late-fusion that assembles encoders and frozen language backbones with output heads, recent efforts have shifted the paradigm toward native multimodal modeling (NMM) with the intrinsic integration of modalities for superior multimodal performance. Despite its potential, the design space of native architectures remains insufficiently defined. In this paper, we present the community with a formalized roadmap for this transition. Specifically, we formally define the architectural nativity, distinguishing mid-fusion and early-fusion from non-native paradigms. We further organize the existing native models through the lens of input-output duality into three categories: (i) Multi-to-Text for cross-modal comprehension with text-only output; (ii) Multi-to-Target for scenario-oriented generation, e.g., image, audio and video generation, and (iii) Multi-to-Multi for unified modeling with symmetric input-output. We deliver a comprehensive and industrial-grade investigation into the transition toward the definitive NMM framework, where understanding and generation seamlessly coexist within a unified transformer paradigm. We systematically unpack the end-to-end pipeline from industrial perspectives from architectural coordination, massive data curation, to full-stack training recipes, inference & deployment, and the comprehensive evaluation for truly native modeling.

AI.tldr: 本文系统梳理了从非原生多模态建模向原生多模态建模（NMM）的过渡路线图，正式定义了架构原生性，将现有原生模型按输入-输出二重性分为三类（多到文本、多到目标、多到多），并从工业视角全面阐述了端到端流水线，包括架构协调、大规模数据整理、全栈训练方案、推理部署及评估。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态建模主要依赖后期融合（编码器+冻结语言骨干+输出头），缺乏模态间内在整合。虽然近期研究转向原生多模态建模（NMM），但其架构设计空间尚未被充分定义，缺乏形式化的路线图和工业级指导。
AI.method: 形式化定义架构原生性，区分中期融合与早期融合（原生）与后期融合（非原生）；按输入-输出二重性将原生模型分为三类；从工业视角系统分析端到端流水线各环节（架构协调、数据整理、训练、推理部署、评估）。
AI.result: 提出了原生多模态建模的正式路线图，明确了架构原生性的定义，建立了三分类体系，并输出了工业级全栈实践指导。
AI.conclusion: 原生多模态建模是迈向世界建模的关键步骤，理解与生成可在统一Transformer范式中无缝共存；该路线图为社区提供了明确的方向指引和工程实践参考。

title: Latent Q-Barrier Shielding for Safe In-Context Reinforcement Learning
summary: Safe in-context reinforcement learning (ICRL) adapts online from interaction history without test-time parameter updates while controlling episode cost under a safety budget. Under out-of-distribution (OOD) deployment shifts, pretraining-only safe ICRL can give poor reward-safety tradeoffs because the remaining budget affects behavior only through frozen policy conditioning, not an explicit action-level check against predicted future cost. We propose a latent Q-Barrier shield that learns a context representation, latent dynamics, and an ensemble cost critic before deployment. Without parameter updates, the shield infers context from history and filters or softly reweights candidate actions using the remaining budget and predicted future cost. We prove a conditional, error-decomposed barrier-margin result: a Q-Barrier-satisfying action leaves the next latent-budget state with an approximately budget-safe continuation under the learned critic, up to Bellman and latent-prediction errors. Across five safe ICRL benchmarks, the shield improves deployment-time reward-safety tradeoffs over a strong safe-ICRL baseline: after a short context window, it achieves higher return in four of five benchmarks while matching or lowering average episode cost in all five.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Q-Barrier防护机制，在不更新参数的情况下，利用潜在表示、动态模型和集成成本评论家，在部署时通过剩余预算和预测的未来成本过滤或重新加权候选动作，从而改善安全在线强化学习在分布外迁移时的奖励-安全权衡。
AI.motivation: 现有的安全在线强化学习（ICRL）在分布外（OOD）部署场景下表现不佳，因为剩余预算仅通过冻结的策略条件影响行为，缺乏对候选动作的显式成本检查，导致奖励-安全权衡较差。
AI.method: 提出潜在Q-Barrier防护机制，包含三个组件：上下文表示学习、潜在动力学模型和集成成本评论家。部署时不更新参数，通过从历史中推断上下文，利用剩余预算和预测的未来成本对候选动作进行过滤或软重加权。
AI.result: 在五个安全ICRL基准测试中，Q-Barrier防护机制在短上下文窗口后，四个基准上实现了更高的回报，同时五个基准上的平均每轮成本均持平或更低，优于强安全ICRL基线。
AI.conclusion: 理论证明了条件性、误差可分解的屏障-边际结果：满足Q-Barrier的动作会保留一个近似预算安全的后续状态，误差受Bellman误差和潜在预测误差上界控制。

title: ERNIE-Image Technical Report
summary: We introduce ERNIE-Image, an open-source text-to-image generation model built upon an 8B single-stream DiT architecture. ERNIE-Image aims to bridge the gap between current open-source models and leading closed-source systems through more effective mining of large-scale pre-training data and improved supervision quality throughout training. During pre-training, we adopt a bottom-up data construction pipeline that combines fine-grained image categorization, rich caption annotation, aesthetic assessment, and hierarchical sampling. This strategy reduces data noise while preserving long-tail concepts and detailed real-world knowledge, providing a stronger foundation for complex generation tasks. In the post-training stage, we use a top-down data construction pipeline for high-demand scenarios, diversify prompt annotations to better match real user inputs, and apply a stabilized DPO strategy to align the model with human aesthetic preferences. We further train ERNIE-Image-Turbo for efficient 8-NFE generation and propose MT-DMD to mitigate capability drift during distillation. To make the model easier to use in practical scenarios, we equip it with a lightweight Prompt Enhancer that expands concise user intents into structured visual descriptions. In addition, we develop ERNIE-Image-Aes, an industrial-grade aesthetic model, together with ERNIE-Image-Aes-1K, a human-annotated benchmark for realistic aesthetic evaluation. Extensive qualitative and quantitative experiments show that ERNIE-Image achieves leading performance among open-source models and approaches top-tier commercial models in instruction following, text rendering, and aesthetic quality. We release the trained models and aesthetic resources to facilitate further academic research and technical progress in the AIGC community.

AI.tldr: ERNIE-Image 是一个基于8B单流DiT架构的开源文生图模型，通过自底向上的预训练数据构建和自顶向下的后训练数据构建策略，结合DPO对齐、高效蒸馏和轻量级提示增强器，在指令遵循、文本渲染和美学质量上达到开源领先水平，逼近顶级商业模型。
AI.motivation: 缩小当前开源文生图模型与领先闭源系统之间的性能差距，通过更有效地挖掘大规模预训练数据和提升训练过程中的监督质量来实现。
AI.method: 1) 预训练阶段采用自底向上的数据构建流程（细粒度图像分类、丰富字幕标注、美学评估、分层采样）；2) 后训练阶段采用自顶向下的数据构建流程，使用多样化的提示标注和稳定的DPO策略对齐人类美学偏好；3) 训练ERNIE-Image-Turbo实现高效8-NFE生成，提出MT-DMD缓解蒸馏中能力漂移；4) 配备轻量级Prompt Enhancer将简洁用户意图扩展为结构化描述；5) 开发工业级美学模型ERNIE-Image-Aes和人工标注基准ERNIE-Image-Aes-1K。
AI.result: ERNIE-Image在开源模型中达到领先性能，在指令遵循、文本渲染和美学质量上接近顶级商业模型。发布了训练好的模型和美学资源。
AI.conclusion: 通过系统性的数据质量优化和多阶段训练策略，开源文生图模型可以有效缩小与闭源商业模型的差距，为AIGC社区的学术研究和技术进步提供了有力支持。

title: Towards Reliable Fetal Ultrasound Interpretation with Multi-Agent Collaboration
summary: Automated fetal ultrasound interpretation requires a workflow from visual perception, including plane recognition and anatomical segmentation, to clinical understanding, including biometric measurement and diagnostic reporting. However, the prevailing "one-task, one-model" paradigm limits systematic integration of evidence across this multi-step process. Although multimodal large language models (MLLMs) show promising visual understanding, their limited domain-specific grounding and hallucination risks restrict reliability in fetal ultrasound analysis. To address these limitations, we propose FetUSAgents, a tool-augmented multi-agent system for comprehensive fetal ultrasound interpretation, supporting visual question answering (VQA), report generation, image captioning, and video summarization. FetUSAgents coordinates task-specific visual tools through collaborative LLM agents and decomposes clinical queries into subtasks that progress from anatomical recognition to quantitative measurement. We further introduce Dual-Path Evidence Arbitration (DPEA), which integrates LLM-based deliberative reasoning with structured computational evidence from specialized visual tools. A retrieval-enhanced evidence bank consolidates intermediate findings to support traceable and clinically grounded conclusions. In addition, we construct FetUS-VQA, a dedicated VQA benchmark for fetal ultrasound, comprising 1,892 images and 3,205 question-answer pairs across 10 clinical tasks. Extensive out-of-distribution experiments show that FetUSAgents outperforms general and medical MLLMs, exceeding the strongest baseline by more than 25 percent in VQA accuracy. These results suggest a scalable route toward evidence-driven clinical assistants for prenatal imaging. Code is available.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FetUSAgents，一个面向胎儿超声影像综合解读的工具增强型多智能体系统，通过多步推理从视觉感知到临床理解，在VQA、报告生成、图像描述和视频摘要等任务上显著优于现有通用及医学多模态大模型。
AI.motivation: 现有胎儿超声分析采用"一任务一模型"范式，难以实现多步流程中的系统化证据整合；多模态大模型虽具备视觉理解能力，但领域知识不足且存在幻觉风险，限制了在胎儿超声分析中的可靠性。
AI.method: 提出FetUSAgents多智能体系统，包含：(1) 通过协作式LLM智能体协调任务特定视觉工具；(2) 双路径证据仲裁（DPEA）机制，整合LLM深思推理与结构化计算证据；(3) 检索增强的证据库，用于存储中间结果以支持可追溯的临床结论。同时构建了FetUS-VQA基准数据集。
AI.result: 在跨域实验中，FetUSAgents在VQA准确率上超过最强基线25%以上，优于通用和医学多模态大模型。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明该方法为产前影像学中证据驱动的临床助手提供了一条可扩展的技术路线。

title: When Interpretability Becomes a Liability: Adversarial Attacks on CBM Concept Layers
summary: Concept Bottleneck Models (CBMs) have emerged as a cornerstone approach for interpretable machine learning, providing human-understandable intermediate representations through explicit concept activations. However, this interpretability fundamentally introduces a critical, previously unexplored attack surface: the concept bottleneck layer itself. We present a comprehensive, systematic study of concept-level adversarial vulnerabilities in CBMs, revealing that targeted, minimal perturbations operating on input pixels can induce catastrophic misclassification by manipulating semantic representations. We develop a rigorous theoretical framework to quantify concept-space robustness, establishing novel metrics that expose the vulnerability landscape of these architectures. Our extensive analysis on the CUB-200-2011 dataset demonstrates that standard CBMs exhibit severe susceptibility to concept-level manipulation. To address this critical weakness, we introduce SPECTRA (Semantic Perturbation-based Concept Training for Robustness against Attacks), a principled stability regularization defense. SPECTRA effectively hardens the semantic representation space, increasing the minimal perturbation norm required for a successful attack from 0.46 to over 4,200, rendering targeted concept manipulation computationally prohibitive. Furthermore, SPECTRA preserves baseline classification accuracy to within 2.2%. By establishing concept-level attacks as a fundamentally distinct threat model, this work opens a new research frontier at the intersection of interpretable machine learning and adversarial robustness.

AI.tldr: 本文首次系统性地研究了概念瓶颈模型（CBM）在概念层面上的对抗性漏洞，并提出了一种名为SPECTRA的稳定性正则化防御方法，该方法通过硬化语义表征空间，将成功攻击所需的最小扰动范数从0.46提升至超过4200，同时保持分类准确率在2.2%以内。
AI.motivation: 概念瓶颈模型（CBM）作为可解释机器学习的重要方法，其通过显式概念激活提供人类可理解的中间表征，但这种可解释性引入了先前未被探索的对抗攻击面——概念瓶颈层本身。本文旨在系统性地揭示和量化CBM在概念层面的对抗性漏洞，并开发相应的防御策略。
AI.method: 1) 建立了量化概念空间鲁棒性的理论框架，提出了新的评估指标；2) 在CUB-200-2011数据集上进行了广泛的概念级对抗攻击实验；3) 提出SPECTRA（基于语义扰动的概念训练对抗鲁棒性）防御方法，通过稳定性正则化硬化语义表征空间。
AI.result: 标准CBM在概念层面表现出严重的脆弱性；SPECTRA成功将成功攻击所需的最小扰动范数从0.46提升至超过4200，使有针对性的概念操控在计算上不可行；同时SPECTRA将基线分类准确率的损失控制在2.2%以内。
AI.conclusion: 概念级攻击是一种根本不同的威胁模型，本文开辟了可解释机器学习与对抗鲁棒性交叉领域的新研究方向。

title: MARVEL: Universal Murray's Law-informed Vessel Tree Segmentation and Topology Estimation
summary: Vascular circulation follows fundamental biophysical principles that optimize mass transport and metabolic energy expenditure, which can be effectively modeled by Murray's law. However, contemporary deep learning methods for vascular segmentation often neglect these biophysical constraints. This leads to physiologically implausible branching and misclassification vascular trees, rendering. These automated segmentation results are unreliable unreliable for downstream clinical tasks such as blood flow simulation or disease quantification. In this paper, we introduce MARVEL (Universal MurrAy's law-infoRmed Vessel sEgmentation and topoLogy estimation), a backbone-agnostic framework that integrates biophysical priors into vascular tree extraction. MARVEL combines per-pixel supervision with explicit radius predictions to enforce local bifurcation constraints derived from an empirical width-exponent mapping. We implement these constraints as differentiable regularizers during training to guide models toward physiologically consistent reconstructions. We evaluate MARVEL on eight public datasets across multiple vascular modalities and segmentation backbones. Results demonstrate MARVEL's superior performance in segmentation accuracy, topological consistency, and physiological plausibility. By converting segmented masks into graph-based hemodynamic simulations, we demonstrate that MARVEL preserves the subtle pathological narrowing and topological connectivity required to distinguish hypertensive from normotensive eyes. Results show that MARVEL significantly improves the classification of hypertension via arteriovenous pressure differences in the eye (p < 0.001), outperforming baseline models in both topological consistency and clinical predictive value.

AI.tldr: MARVEL是一个与骨干网络无关的血管分割与拓扑估计框架，通过引入Murray定律等生物物理先验约束（基于经验宽度-指数映射的可微正则化项）来提升血管分割的生理合理性与拓扑一致性。在8个公开数据集上，该方法在分割精度、拓扑一致性和临床预测价值（如通过眼动静脉压差区分高血压患者）上均显著优于基线模型。
AI.motivation: 现有深度学习血管分割方法忽视Murray定律等生物物理约束，导致分割结果出现生理上不合理的分支结构和血管树误分类，使得自动分割结果在血流模拟、疾病量化等下游临床任务中不可靠。
AI.method: 提出MARVEL通用框架：结合逐像素监督与显式半径预测，通过可微正则化项强制满足基于经验宽度-指数映射推导的局部分叉约束，在训练过程中引导模型生成符合生理一致性的重建结果。该框架与骨干网络无关，可适配多种分割网络。
AI.result: 在8个公开数据集、多种血管模态和分割骨干网络上，MARVEL在分割精度、拓扑一致性和生理合理性上均表现优异。基于分割掩码的图论血流模拟显示，MARVEL能保留病理狭窄和拓扑连接性，有效区分高血压与正常眼，通过眼动静脉压差提高高血压分类效果（p<0.001）。
AI.conclusion: 融入生物物理先验（Murray定律）的血管分割方法能显著提升结果的生理合理性与临床实用性，MARVEL在拓扑一致性和临床预测价值上均优于基线模型，为血管分割与下游疾病分析提供了可靠框架。

title: Can MLLMs Reason Beyond Language? VisReason: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Vision-Centric Reasoning
comment: Accepted by ACL 2026 Findings, resources released at https://github.com/CASIA-IVA-Lab/VisReason
summary: Recent multimodal large language models (MLLMs) achieve strong performance on visual reasoning benchmarks, yet it remains unclear to what extent such performance reflects reasoning directly grounded in visual evidence. We introduce VisReason, a benchmark for vision-centric reasoning in everyday scenarios where perception and inference are tightly coupled. VisReason contains 1,505 questions across 10 categories spanning perceptual, structural, and conceptual reasoning. Our evaluation shows that VisReason poses a qualitatively different challenge from existing benchmarks, exposing substantial gaps between humans and current MLLMs and revealing limited benefits from test-time reasoning strategies. VisReason offers a focused diagnostic for evaluating vision-centric reasoning beyond language.

AI.tldr: VisReason是一个包含1,505个问题的视觉推理基准，涵盖感知、结构和概念推理三大类（共10个子类别），用于评估多模态大模型是否真正基于视觉证据进行推理。实验表明该基准相较于现有基准提出了不同类型的挑战，揭示了人类与当前MLLMs之间的显著差距，并表明测试时推理策略带来的收益有限。
AI.motivation: 现有MLLMs在视觉推理基准上表现强劲，但尚不清楚这种性能是否真正反映了基于视觉证据的直接推理，因此需要一个新的基准来诊断模型是否真正进行以视觉为中心的推理。
AI.method: 构建了VisReason基准，包含1,505个问题，覆盖10个类别，分为感知推理、结构推理和概念推理三个层次；在多个MLLMs上进行评估并与人类表现对比。
AI.result: VisReason揭示了人类与当前MLLMs之间的显著差距；现有MLLMs在该基准上表现不佳；测试时推理策略（如思维链）带来的改进有限。
AI.conclusion: VisReason为评估超越语言的视觉中心推理提供了有针对性的诊断工具，表明当前MLLMs在真正的视觉推理能力上仍有较大提升空间。

title: Physics-Aware 3D Gaussian Editing for Driving Scene Generation
summary: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) has shown great potential in autonomous driving simulation and data generation, enabling photorealistic reconstruction and flexible scene manipulation. However, existing 3DGS scene editing methods have limited support for road geometry editing (e.g., inserting speed humps or sunken roads), and generally do not couple such edits with plausible vehicle-road interaction dynamics. Such editing is essential for generating training data under extreme driving scenarios or evaluating system reliability under these road irregularities. Moreover, many optimization-based methods require minutes of per-edit refinement, while existing efficient alternatives mainly focus on appearance-level or object-level manipulation rather than physics-aware road irregularity editing. To address these limitations, we propose RoVES, a Road-and-Vehicle Editing System for physics-aware 3D Gaussian editing in driving scenes. RoVES enables single-image-driven road geometry insertion and couples the edited road profile with a 4-DOF half-car vehicle dynamics model to achieve physics-aware vehicle pose correction in vertical displacement and pitch. RoVES inserts road elements in a one-shot, optimization-free pipeline (1.84s), and the full pipeline (including color transfer and vehicle-dynamics-based pose correction) completes in 6.24s; it edits dynamic vehicles via pose editing and corrects poses frame-by-frame to approximate dynamics-consistent vertical displacement and pitch responses. Experiments on the Waymo dataset show that RoVES provides practical efficiency and competitive visual consistency for physics-aware driving scene generation.

AI.tldr: RoVES是一个用于驾驶场景的物理感知3D高斯编辑系统，支持单图像驱动的道路几何插入（如减速带、凹陷路面）并结合4-DOF半车动力学模型实现车辆姿态校正，实现一次性、免优化的高效编辑（完整流程6.24秒）。
AI.motivation: 现有3DGS场景编辑方法对道路几何编辑支持有限，且无法将道路编辑与合理的车辆-道路交互动力学耦合，难以生成极端驾驶场景下的训练数据或评估系统可靠性。同时，优化方法需分钟级逐编辑优化，现有高效方法仅关注外观或物体级操作。
AI.method: 提出RoVES系统：(1) 单图像驱动的道路几何一键插入（1.84秒，免优化）；(2) 将编辑后的道路轮廓与4-DOF半车动力学模型耦合，实现车辆在垂直位移和俯仰上的物理感知姿态校正；(3) 通过姿态编辑逐帧校正动态车辆，近似动力学一致的垂直位移和俯仰响应。完整流程包括颜色迁移和车辆动力学姿态校正，总计6.24秒。
AI.result: 在Waymo数据集上实验表明，RoVES在物理感知驾驶场景生成中具有实用的效率和具有竞争力的视觉一致性。
AI.conclusion: RoVES实现了高效、物理感知的道路与车辆联合编辑，为自动驾驶仿真中的数据生成和系统可靠性评估提供了实用的解决方案。

title: Adversarial Orthogonal Disentanglement for LVLM Hallucination Mitigation
summary: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) have advanced multimodal understanding, yet their reliability is limited by hallucination, where generated content conflicts with visual facts. Existing mitigation methods either rely on costly external interventions, such as instruction tuning and retrieval, or use internal mechanisms that remain limited by flawed attention weights and entangled hidden representations. We propose Adversarial Orthogonal Disentanglement (AOD), a latent geometric framework for mitigating LVLM hallucinations. AOD learns a hallucination-related direction through a minimax objective: a classifier concentrates hallucination signals into the projected component, while an adversary removes them from the orthogonal residual space via a Gradient Reversal Layer. The learned direction enables a training-free dual-forward-pass contrastive decoding strategy that suppresses hallucinations while preserving general capabilities. Experiments on three LVLMs across four hallucination and four utility benchmarks show that AOD consistently outperforms strong baselines. It improves POPE accuracy by over 6\% on average, boosts AMBER by 6\%, and maintains strong performance on utility tasks such as MMMU. Further analysis shows robust transfer across datasets, suggesting that AOD captures general hallucination-related biases rather than dataset-specific artifacts. Our source code and datasets are available at https://github.com/Hunter-Wrynn/AOD.

AI.tldr: 本文提出对抗正交解缠（AOD），一种基于潜在几何框架的方法，通过最小最大目标学习幻觉相关方向，并利用无需训练的双前向对比解码策略来抑制LVLM中的幻觉，在多个基准测试中取得一致提升。
AI.motivation: 大型视觉语言模型（LVLM）在多模态理解中表现出色，但存在生成内容与视觉事实不一致的幻觉问题。现有缓解方法要么依赖昂贵的外部干预（如指令微调、检索），要么使用受限于有缺陷注意力权重和纠缠隐藏表示的内部机制，亟需更有效的方法。
AI.method: 提出对抗正交解缠（AOD）框架：通过最小最大目标学习一个幻觉相关方向，其中分类器将幻觉信号集中到投影分量中，而对手通过梯度反转层将其从正交残差空间中移除。学习到的方向支持一种无需训练的双前向对比解码策略，在抑制幻觉的同时保留通用能力。
AI.result: 在三个LVLM上、跨越四个幻觉基准和四个效用基准的实验表明，AOD一致优于强基线方法：POPE准确率平均提升6%以上，AMBER提升6%，同时在MMMU等效用任务上保持强劲性能。进一步分析显示该方法在不同数据集间具有鲁棒迁移能力。
AI.conclusion: AOD捕捉的是通用幻觉相关偏差而非数据集特定伪影，为LVLM幻觉缓解提供了一种有效且高效的几何框架。

title: PDEInvBench: A Comprehensive Dataset and Design Space Exploration of Neural Networks for PDE Inverse Problems
comment: 37 total pages, 13 main pages, 20 figures, 8 tables. Published in Transactions on Machine Learning Research (TMLR), 2026
summary: Inverse problems in partial differential equations (PDEs) involve estimating the physical parameters of a system from observed spatiotemporal solution fields.Neural networks are well-suited for PDE parameter estimation due to their capability to model function-to-function space transformations. While existing benchmarks of machine learning methods for PDEs primarily focus on the forward problem, there are no similar comprehensive studies and benchmark datasets on PDE inverse problems, i.e., mapping solution fields to underlying physical parameters. We fill this gap by introducing PDEInvBench, a comprehensive benchmark dataset consisting of numerical simulations for both time-dependent and time-independent PDEs across a wide range of physical behaviors and parameters. Our dataset includes evaluation splits that assess performance in both in-distribution and various out-of-distribution settings. Using our benchmark dataset, we comprehensively explore the design space of neural networks for PDE inverse problems along three key dimensions: (1) optimization procedures, analyzing the role of supervised, self-supervised, and test-time training objectives on performance, (2) problem representations, where we study the value of architectural choices with different inductive biases and various conditioning strategies, and (3) scaling, which we perform with respect to both model and data size. Our experiments reveal several practical insights: 1) neural networks perform best with a two-stage training procedure: initial supervision with PDE parameters followed by test-time fine-tuning using the PDE residual, 2) incorporating PDE derivatives as input features consistently improves accuracy, and 3) increasing the diversity of initial conditions in the training data yields greater performance gains than expanding the range of PDE parameters. We make our dataset and codebase publicly available.

AI.tldr: 提出了PDEInvBench，一个用于偏微分方程逆问题（从解场估计物理参数）的综合基准数据集，并系统研究了神经网络在该任务上的设计空间，发现两阶段训练（监督+测试时微调）、输入PDE导数特征、以及增加初始条件多样性是关键改进点。
AI.motivation: 现有机器学习方法在PDE上的基准研究主要集中在正问题（从参数到解场），而逆问题（从解场到参数）缺乏全面的基准数据集和系统性研究，因此需要填补这一空白。
AI.method: 1) 构建了包含多种时变和时不变PDE数值模拟的综合基准数据集PDEInvBench，涵盖多种物理行为和参数；2) 沿三个维度系统探索神经网络设计空间：优化过程（监督、自监督、测试时训练）、问题表示（不同归纳偏好的架构和条件策略）、规模缩放（模型和数据量）。
AI.result: 1) 两阶段训练（初始监督+PDE残差测试时微调）效果最佳；2) 将PDE导数作为输入特征能持续提升精度；3) 增加训练数据中初始条件的多样性比扩大PDE参数范围带来更大的性能提升。
AI.conclusion: PDEInvBench为PDE逆问题提供了标准化基准，实验发现为实际应用提供了实用指导，数据集和代码已开源。

title: Weakly Supervised Camouflaged Object Detection Based on the SAM Model and Mask Guidance
summary: Camouflaged object detection (COD) from a single image is a challenging task due to the high similarity between objects and their surroundings. Existing fully supervised methods require labor-intensive pixel-level annotations, making weakly supervised methods a viable compromise that balances accuracy and annotation efficiency. However, weakly supervised methods often experience performance degradation due to the use of coarse annotations. In this paper, we introduce a new weakly supervised approach for camouflaged object detection to overcome these limitations. Specifically, we propose a novel network, MGNet, which tackles edge ambiguity and missed detections by utilizing initial masks generated by our custom-designed Cascaded Mask Decoder (CMD) to guide the segmentation process and enhance edge predictions. We introduce a Context Enhancement Module(CEM) to reduce the missing detection, and a Mask-guided Feature Aggregation Module (MFAM) for effective feature aggregation. For the weak supervision challenge, we propose BoxSAM, which leverages the Segment Anything Model (SAM) with bounding-box prompts to generate pseudo-labels. By employing a redundant processing strategy, high quality pixel-level pseudo-labels are provided for training MGNet. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method delivers competitive performance against current state-of-the-art methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于弱监督学习的伪装目标检测方法MGNet，通过级联掩码解码器（CMD）、上下文增强模块（CEM）和掩码引导特征聚合模块（MFAM）解决边缘模糊和漏检问题，并利用BoxSAM（基于SAM与边界框提示）生成高质量伪标签，在弱监督条件下取得了与全监督方法竞争的性能。
AI.motivation: 全监督伪装目标检测需要大量像素级标注，成本高昂；现有弱监督方法因使用粗糙标注导致性能下降。本文旨在设计一种弱监督方法，在降低标注成本的同时缩小与全监督方法的性能差距。
AI.method: 提出MGNet网络，包含三个核心模块：1) 级联掩码解码器(CMD)生成初始掩码引导分割并增强边缘预测；2) 上下文增强模块(CEM)减少漏检；3) 掩码引导特征聚合模块(MFAM)实现有效特征融合。同时提出BoxSAM，利用SAM模型与边界框提示，通过冗余处理策略生成高质量像素级伪标签用于训练。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，所提方法在弱监督条件下取得了与当前最先进方法竞争的优异性能。
AI.conclusion: 本文验证了通过精心设计的弱监督策略（结合SAM生成伪标签与专用网络模块）可以有效解决伪装目标检测中的边缘模糊和漏检问题，为弱监督COD提供了一个有竞争力的解决方案。

title: Not only where, But when: Temporal Scheduling for RLVR
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has become a core technique for post-training of Large Language Models (LLMs). While policy optimization is driven by all sampled tokens under a globally broadcast scalar reward, the heterogeneous policy behaviors exhibited along trajectories are largely overlooked without differentiation. Existing works address this by credit allocation, including token-level advantage reweighting, and selective token optimization, however, the allocation criterion are principally stagnant throughout training, limiting resilient policy evolution. In this work, we argue that \textit{when} learning signals are scheduled can be as important as \textit{where} they are allocated across tokens, and introduce the temporal dimension that scheduling the credit allocation criteria over the course of RLVR optimization. We find that prioritizing targeted tokens emphasized with specific policy behaviors, and gradually attenuating toward general optimization leads to more stable and efficient learning dynamics. Furthermore, we show that simple trajectory percentiles provide a natural perspective for distinguishing policy behaviors, and works effectively with temporal scheduling. Our analysis reveals that standard optimization substantially sacrifices policy entropy when simultaneously accommodating heterogeneous behaviors, whereas temporal scheduling yields healthier policy evolution dynamics. Experiments across mathematical and general reasoning benchmarks demonstrate consistent improvements, suggesting that temporal scheduling constitutes a promising optimization dimension.

AI.tldr: 论文提出在RLVR训练中引入时间维度的信用分配标准调度，通过优先关注特定策略行为的标记并逐步过渡到通用优化，实现更稳定高效的学习动态。
AI.motivation: 现有RLVR训练中，策略优化由全局标量奖励驱动，但沿轨迹的异质策略行为未被区分；现有信用分配方法的分配标准在训练过程中停滞不变，限制了策略的弹性演化。
AI.method: 引入时间维度，在RLVR优化过程中对信用分配标准进行调度：优先关注具有特定策略行为的标记，并逐步衰减至通用优化。利用简单轨迹百分位数作为区分策略行为的自然视角，结合时间调度机制。
AI.result: 标准优化在同时适应异质行为时会大幅牺牲策略熵，而时间调度产生更健康的策略进化动态。在数学和通用推理基准上均取得一致性改进。
AI.conclusion: 学习信号的"何时"调度与"何处"分配同样重要，时间调度构成了一个有前景的优化维度。

title: ViroBench: Benchmarking Nucleotide Foundation Models on Viral Genomics Tasks
summary: Nucleotide sequences constitute the fundamental genetic basis of biological systems, rendering viral genomic analysis critical for biomedical advancement. Despite progress in biological foundation models, specifically nucleotide foundation models (NFMs), the field lacks a unified standard for viral genomics to facilitate community development and enforce biosecurity constraints. To address this, we introduce ViroBench, the first comprehensive and large-scale benchmark specifically designed for NFMs in viral settings. ViroBench evaluates models across two critical dimensions: biological understanding and latent biosecurity risk, covering 18 diverse scenarios within 4 task types. Extensive evaluation of 66 NFMs across diverse architectures yields three critical conclusions. Firstly, NFMs exhibit a performance degradation in biological understanding under phylogenetic and temporal shifts, indicating weak extrapolation capabilities. Secondly, generation tasks reveal a decoupling between statistical likelihood and biological functional validity, posing latent biosecurity risks. Thirdly, controlled ablation studies reveal that taxonomic diversity in pretraining data outweighs parameter scale. Specifically, a lightweight baseline trained on diverse data achieves a 67.5% performance gain over its original model. Overall, ViroBench provides interpretable, diagnostic evaluations and a reproducible measurement framework for future research on viral nucleotide foundation models. The datasets and code are publicly available at https://github.com/QIANJINYDX/ViroBench.

AI.tldr: ViroBench是首个专门为病毒基因组学设计的核苷酸基础模型（NFMs）综合基准测试，涵盖生物学理解与潜在生物安全风险两大维度，包含4类任务类型下的18个场景。通过对66个NFMs的广泛评估，发现：(1) NFMs在系统发育和时间偏移下生物学理解性能下降，外推能力弱；(2) 生成任务中统计似然性与生物功能有效性脱钩，存在生物安全风险；(3) 预训练数据的分类多样性比参数规模更重要——轻量级模型在多样化数据上训练后性能提升67.5%。
AI.motivation: 病毒基因组分析对生物医学发展至关重要，但现有核苷酸基础模型在病毒基因组学领域缺乏统一的评估标准和生物安全约束机制，阻碍社区发展并带来潜在风险。
AI.method: 构建ViroBench基准测试，包含生物学理解（涵盖系统发育和时间偏移场景）与生物安全风险评估两大维度，共4类任务类型18个场景；对66个不同架构的NFMs进行系统评估，并通过消融实验分析预训练数据多样性与参数规模的影响。
AI.result: (1) NFMs在系统发育和时间偏移下生物学理解性能下降，外推能力弱；(2) 生成任务中似然性与生物功能有效性解耦，存在生物安全风险；(3) 预训练数据分类多样性比参数规模更关键，轻量级基线模型在多样化数据上训练比原模型性能提升67.5%。
AI.conclusion: ViroBench为病毒核苷酸基础模型提供了可解释、可诊断的评估框架和可复现的测量方法，推动社区发展和生物安全风险管控；强调数据多样性优先于模型规模的设计原则。

title: Anatomy-Anchored Self-Supervision: Distilling Vision Foundation Models for Invariant Ultrasound Representation
comment: MICCAI 2026 Accepted Paper; Anatomy-Anchored Ultrasound Self-Supervision
summary: Self-supervised pre-training paradigm has gained increasing prominence for learning transferable representations in medical imaging, yet existing methods for ultrasound (US) images operate at the image or frame level, overlooking the anatomical context for clinical-aligned representation learning. In this work, we propose an anatomy-anchored ultrasound self-supervision framework ANAUS that shifts representation learning from generic visual regions to clinically meaningful anatomical structures. Utilizing a learnable latent prompt engine alongside a one-time domain adaptation on existing public image--mask pairs, we empower the LP-SAM module to achieve annotation-free anatomy delineation at scale. Building upon this anatomical grounding, we propose a dual-policy self-supervised learning paradigm consisting of inter-view semantics-aware anatomy-separating alignment and contextual core-region prediction to enhance representation learning. Specifically, the former enforces feature invariance within identical anatomical regions while promoting discriminability across distinct structures; the latter compels the model to reconstruct corrupted regions, thereby capturing fine-grained structural details. Extensive evaluations on six public datasets demonstrate that \ours{} consistently outstrips current state-of-the-art methods while maintaining the computational efficiency essential for clinical deployment. Code is available at https://github.com/zhcz328/ANAUS.

AI.tldr: 提出ANAUS框架，通过锚定解剖结构的自监督预训练方法，利用LP-SAM模块实现无标注解剖分割，结合双策略自监督学习（解剖感知对齐和上下文核心区域预测），在六个超声数据集上超越现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有超声图像自监督预训练方法仅在图像或帧级别操作，忽略了与临床对齐的解剖结构上下文信息，难以学到具有临床意义的表征。
AI.method: 1) 提出LP-SAM模块，利用可学习潜在提示引擎和一次性域适应，实现无标注的大规模解剖结构分割；2) 提出双策略自监督学习范式：跨视图语义感知的解剖分离对齐（同一解剖区域特征不变性、不同结构间特征区分性）和上下文核心区域预测（重建被破坏区域以捕捉细粒度结构细节）。
AI.result: 在六个公开数据集上，ANAUS一致优于当前最先进方法，同时保持适合临床部署的计算效率。
AI.conclusion: 锚定解剖结构的自监督学习能有效提升超声图像表征的临床相关性和迁移能力，且具有高效的计算特性。

title: A Context Augmented Multi-Play Multi-Armed Bandit Algorithm for Fast Channel Allocation in Opportunistic Spectrum Access
summary: We study the restless contextual multi-play multi-armed bandit (MP-MAB) problem for channel allocation in the opportunity spectrum access (OSA) scenario. Most existing MP-MAB methods are impractical for real-world OSA systems as they assume many ideal conditions, incur a heavy computational cost, and most importantly, ignore the impact of channel noise which is directly related to the quality of service. In this study, we embody this impact by modeling channel noise as a perturbation of the arm's reward function in MP-MAB. As there is an implicit correlation between channel state information and channel noise, we take the former as a context for MP-MAB to present the perturbation caused by the latter. We investigate two types of correlation between the context and the perturbation -- linear and nonlinear, and derive two index policies, respectively. These policies learn the correlations through a linear model and a neural network, and use estimated noise value to adjust the upper confidence bound. Numerical experiments demonstrate that the proposed policies can achieve lower regret and select sub-optimal arms in a more reasonable way.

AI.tldr: 本文针对机会频谱接入中的多臂赌博机信道分配问题，提出考虑信道噪声扰动奖励函数的上下文多臂赌博机方法，分别针对线性和非线性上下文-噪声相关性推导了两种索引策略，实验表明该方法能降低遗憾值并更合理地选择次优信道。
AI.motivation: 现有MP-MAB方法假设条件过于理想、计算成本高，且忽略了直接影响服务质量的信道噪声，导致在实际机会频谱接入系统中不可行。
AI.method: 将信道噪声建模为对奖励函数的扰动，利用信道状态信息作为上下文来表示扰动，分别针对线性和非线性相关性使用线性模型和神经网络学习，并用估计的噪声值调整置信上界。
AI.result: 数值实验表明所提策略能实现更低的累积遗憾值，并能更合理地选择次优臂。
AI.conclusion: 考虑信道噪声扰动的上下文MP-MAB方法能够有效提升机会频谱接入中信道分配的性能与实用性。

title: Towards Active Real-to-Twin Inspection: A New Paradigm for Zero-Shot Anomaly Detection
comment: 6 pages, 4 figures, accepted to IEEE-CYBER 2026, Florence, Italy
summary: The deployment of zero-shot anomaly detection (AD) in embodied industrial inspection is severely bottlenecked by its reliance on passive, fixed-viewpoint 2D imagery. Such formulations inherently fail to accommodate the active, dynamic observations required in real-world environments. To break this limitation, we introduce Real-to-Twin Anomaly Detection, a novel task that evaluates physical observations directly against geometrically matched CAD Digital Twins. To tackle this new task, we propose AVATAR, a framework designed to learn robust semantic alignment between Real and Digital Twins. By bridging benign Sim2Real domain gaps using only defect-free pairs, AVATAR effectively transforms CAD priors into dynamic, anomaly-free references. This elegant formulation enables the model to localize diverse anomalies in a zero-shot manner as unalignable deviations, eliminating the need for defect annotations. Extensive experiments demonstrate that AVATAR substantially outperforms adapted state-of-the-art baselines, exhibiting exceptional robustness to severe viewpoint variations. The code and dataset will be made publicly available.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Real-to-Twin异常检测新任务，并设计AVATAR框架，利用无缺陷的真实-数字孪生对进行语义对齐，实现零样本异常检测，在视角剧烈变化下仍具鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有零样本异常检测依赖被动固定视角的2D图像，无法适应主动动态的工业检测场景，严重限制了其在具身工业检测中的应用。
AI.method: 提出AVATAR框架，利用无缺陷的真实图像与CAD数字孪生对进行语义对齐，弥合良性Sim2Real域间隙，将CAD先验转化为动态无异常参考，通过不可对齐偏差实现零样本异常定位。
AI.result: AVATAR大幅优于适配后的最先进基线方法，对剧烈视角变化表现出卓越鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: AVATAR通过CAD数字孪生与真实图像的对齐，有效解决了零样本异常检测对固定视角的依赖，为具身工业检测提供了新范式。

title: EMA-Nesterov: Stabilizing Nesterov's Lookahead for Accelerated Deep Learning Optimization
summary: Lookahead-based acceleration methods, such as Nesterov's momentum, are widely used in optimization, but they often become unreliable in deep learning training mainly due to stochastic gradient noise and non-convex loss landscapes. In particular, standard lookahead relies on short-horizon update signals (e.g., differences between consecutive iterates), which are inherently noisy and can lead to unstable extrapolation directions. This work revisits Nesterov's acceleration from a trajectory perspective and argues that effective acceleration in deep learning should harness the low-frequency trends of optimization trajectories rather than extrapolating noisy one-step updates. Leveraging this insight, we propose EMA-Nesterov, a simple modification that replaces the standard Nesterov's lookahead direction with an exponential moving average (EMA) of parameter updates. This yields a stabilized lookahead direction that captures and harnesses the evolving trend of the training trajectory through a low-pass filter, while remaining adaptive to progressive changes via the geometric weighting structure of EMA. We show that EMA-Nesterov retains a theoretical accelerated convergence rate in convex problems that is analogous to Nesterov's accelerated gradient method. Furthermore, we provide empirical evidence on language model pre-training to verify that EMA-Nesterov is broadly applicable across a range of fine-tuned base optimizers, including Adam, SOAP, Muon, as well as complex optimizers that achieve state-of-the-art performance on optimization benchmarks (NanoGPT). Compared to prior lookahead methods, EMA-Nesterov achieves better performance by avoiding the instability of short-horizon lookahead and the non-adaptivity of long-horizon lookahead.

AI.tldr: 提出EMA-Nesterov方法，用指数移动平均（EMA）替代Nesterov动量中的短期外推方向，通过低通滤波捕捉优化轨迹的低频趋势，在保持理论加速收敛率的同时，在语言模型预训练中优于Adam、SOAP、Muon等优化器。
AI.motivation: 标准Nesterov加速方法在深度学习训练中因随机梯度噪声和非凸损失景观而不可靠，其依赖的短期更新信号（相邻迭代差异）噪声大，导致外推方向不稳定。
AI.method: 将Nesterov加速中的标准外推方向替换为参数更新的指数移动平均（EMA），通过低通滤波器捕获训练轨迹的低频演化趋势，并利用EMA的几何加权结构保持对渐进变化的适应性。
AI.result: 在凸问题上保持理论加速收敛率；在语言模型预训练中，与Adam、SOAP、Muon等基优化器结合均表现优异，优于NanoGPT上的SOTA优化器；避免了短期外推的不稳定性和长期外推的非自适应性。
AI.conclusion: EMA-Nesterov通过利用优化轨迹的低频趋势实现稳定且自适应的加速度，是一种简单有效且广泛适用的深度学习优化加速方法。

title: MTLLFM: Multimodal-Temporal Laughter Localization: UR-FUNNY-Temporal and SMILE-Temporal Benchmarks with an Adaptive Multimodal Fusion Model
comment: Accepted to the Workshop on Affective & Behavior Analysis in-the-wild, CVPR 2026
summary:
Detecting laughter in video is essential for affective computing and narrative understanding, yet existing approaches treat it as coarse clip-level classification, failing to capture precise temporal boundaries of brief, transient laughter events. We address this gap with two complementary contributions.
  First, we introduce UR-FUNNY-Temporal and SMILE-Temporal, fully annotated temporal laughter datasets extending two widely-used humor benchmarks.
