Theoretical analysis confirms that this iterative supervision serves as a well-conditioned error proxy and that a stop-gradient design is essential for optimization stability. To better capture boundary-driven features under mixed boundary conditions, we further introduce the Boundary-Aware Transolver (\textsc{BA-Transolver}) architecture that explicitly separates interior and boundary tokenization. Extensive evaluations on 2D and 3D irregular geometries demonstrate that \textsc{NPSolver} outperforms both physics-informed and data-driven baselines. Furthermore, a downstream thermal control task highlights the model's capability for conducting efficient and reliable gradient-based boundary control. We will release our codes and data at https://github.com/intell-sci-comput/NPSolver.

AI.tldr: 本文提出NPSolver，一种无需标签的神经泊松求解器，通过迭代物理监督（少量PCG步骤）训练，结合边界感知的BA-Transolver架构，在2D/3D不规则几何上优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 传统迭代求解器在不规则区域上求解泊松方程时因病态系统导致耗时过长；神经算子虽快但依赖大规模标注数据或面临物理信息残差训练不稳定的问题。
AI.method: 提出NPSolver，利用少量预处理共轭梯度（PCG）步骤细化自身预测作为训练信号（无需解标签）；引入停止梯度设计保证优化稳定；提出边界感知的BA-Transolver架构，显式分离内部和边界令牌化以捕捉混合边界条件下的边界特征。
AI.result: 在2D和3D不规则几何上，NPSolver优于基于物理信息和数据驱动的基线方法；下游热控制任务验证了其在梯度边界控制中的高效可靠性。
AI.conclusion: 迭代物理监督结合边界感知架构能有效训练神经泊松求解器，兼具效率和精度，适用于复杂几何上的科学计算任务。

title: CMAP: Cross-Modal Adaptive Prompting for Multi-Domain Task-Incremental Learning
summary: Multi-domain task-incremental learning requires a model to sequentially acquire knowledge across visually diverse domains without forgetting prior tasks, and without access to task identity at inference. Parameter-efficient methods built on frozen vision-language models have made strong progress, yet all existing approaches rely exclusively on visual features for task routing, confidence estimation, and encoder adaptation, leaving CLIP's cross-modal text embedding space entirely unexploited. We address this gap through three contributions. Text-space task routing replaces visual Gaussian matching with cosine similarity to frozen CLIP text prototypes, giving order-independent routing robust to data scarcity at zero parameter cost. Multi-prototype visual-textual confidence replaces single-Gaussian class modeling with K-means visual prototypes and cross-modal alignment scores under task-calibrated thresholds. Symmetric cross-modal gating extends per-layer Gumbel gates to the text encoder conditioned on batch image features, preserving cross-modal alignment on out-of-distribution inputs. On the MTIL benchmark spanning 11 datasets and 1201 classes, our method achieves 74.2% Transfer, 80.5% Average, and 88.7% Last under Order-I, surpassing the prior state of the art by 5.0, 3.7, and 3.0 percentage points with only 2.5M trainable parameters and no external data.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于冻结视觉-语言模型（CLIP）的多域任务增量学习方法，通过文本空间任务路由、多原型视觉-文本置信度评估和对称跨模态门控三大创新，在不依赖任务标识的情况下，在11个数据集、1201个类别的基准上以仅2.5M可训练参数超越现有最优方法，分别提升Transfer 5.0%、Average 3.7%、Last 3.0个百分点。
AI.motivation: 现有参数高效的多域任务增量学习方法仅依赖视觉特征进行任务路由、置信度估计和编码器适配，完全忽视了CLIP跨模态文本嵌入空间的潜力。
AI.method: 1) 文本空间任务路由：用冻结CLIP文本原型间的余弦相似度替代视觉高斯匹配，实现零参数、对数据稀缺鲁棒的路由；2) 多原型视觉-文本置信度：用K-means视觉原型和跨模态对齐分数替代单高斯类建模，结合任务校准阈值；3) 对称跨模态门控：将逐层Gumbel门扩展到文本编码器，基于批图像特征条件，保持跨模态对齐。
AI.result: 在MTIL基准（11数据集、1201类）上，Order-I设置下达到74.2% Transfer、80.5% Average、88.7% Last，比先前最优分别提升5.0、3.7、3.0个百分点，仅2.5M可训练参数，无需外部数据。
AI.conclusion: 利用CLIP的跨模态文本空间可显著提升多域任务增量学习的性能，且参数效率极高。

title: On the Benefits of Free Exploration for Regret Minimization in Multi-Armed Bandits
summary: We study a stochastic multi-armed bandit problem where an agent is granted a free exploration budget before regret accumulates, a setting not captured by the classic regret minimization or pure exploration paradigms. The goal is to design an adaptive policy that strategically explores the bandit instance in the initial free exploration phase and minimizes the cumulative regret in the subsequent phase. We formalize this regret minimization with free exploration problem and identify an interesting regime where the free exploration budget scales logarithmically with the time horizon. To quantify the amount of regret saved with high probability as a result of the availability of the free exploration phase, we introduce a novel set of policies known as $(α,β)$-probably saving policies. We propose a two-phase, probably saving algorithm, UFE-KLUCB-H, which consists of a principled free exploration policy, UFE, and a history-aware regret minimization policy KLUCB-H. Instance-dependent upper bounds on UFE-KLUCB-H are derived, showing that UFE-KLUCB-H accumulates strictly less regret than policies that do not have access to a free exploration phase. Complementarily, we derive instance-dependent lower bounds based on novel multi-instance perturbation arguments tailored to the free-exploration setting, demonstrating the near-optimality of UFE-KLUCB-H for two-valued bandits. Our upper and lower bounds reveal sharp phase transitions in the accumulated regret depending on the amount of available free exploration. Simulations are conducted to demonstrate that forced exploration and adaptivity in the algorithm lead to greater regret savings.

AI.tldr: 本文研究随机多臂赌博机问题中引入免费探索预算后的遗憾最小化，提出两阶段算法UFE-KLUCB-H，通过自适应探索策略实现比无免费探索策略更低的累积遗憾，并推导了实例相关的上下界，揭示了遗憾随免费探索预算的相变现象。
AI.motivation: 传统遗憾最小化或纯探索范式无法刻画智能体在累积遗憾之前拥有免费探索预算的场景，本文旨在填补这一空白，量化免费探索阶段带来的遗憾节省。
AI.method: 提出(α,β)-probably saving策略框架，设计两阶段算法UFE-KLUCB-H：第一阶段UFE进行原则性免费探索，第二阶段KLUCB-H利用历史信息的遗憾最小化策略。推导实例相关上界，并基于多实例扰动论证推导实例相关下界。
AI.result: UFE-KLUCB-H比无免费探索策略累积严格更少的遗憾；上下界揭示了遗憾随免费探索预算的尖锐相变；对二值赌博机证明了UFE-KLUCB-H的近最优性；仿真验证了强制探索和自适应算法带来更大的遗憾节省。
AI.conclusion: 免费探索设置下的遗憾最小化问题具有理论价值，本文提出的算法在理论上和实验上均证明了其有效性，并揭示了遗憾随免费探索预算的相变规律。

title: TriDP-PTM: a three-stage distortion-perception tradeoff guides the pre-training model for radar cardiac sensing
summary: Cardiovascular diseases (CVDs) remain a leading cause of death globally, necessitating continuous, accurate non-invasive cardiac monitoring. While non-contact radar-based approaches show great promise, they often employ a single "distortion-driven" or "perception-driven" paradigm, frequently facing a trade-off between "low distortion but weak semantic information" and "high perceptual fidelity but poor interpretability." To address this, we propose a Three-stage Distortion-Perception Pre-Training Model (TriDP-PTM), a radar-based multi-scale fusion dual-path framework that systematically compares the "direct radar-to-task" path against an "indirect radar-to-ECG-to-task" path. By integrating an ECG generator with a feature discriminator to form a composite loss function, our approach effectively incorporates medical priors - such as ECG morphology and rhythm - into downstream tasks. Through empirical analysis, we reveal that this trade-off manifests in three distinct phases (Positive-Sum, Coopetitive, and Negative-Sum), showing optimal downstream clinical accuracy typically emerges in the coopetitive stage. Extensive experiments on a dataset involving 30 subjects across 5 physiological states reveal that the indirect path consistently outperforms the direct path in diverse tasks, achieving 0.80 mean IoU in waveform segmentation, 98.3% average classification accuracy across four tasks, and a 56% MAE reduction in blood pressure regression compared to the strongest baselines. These findings validate our framework and indicate that, within the indirect radar-to-ECG pathway, appropriately weighting distortion and perception losses to operate in the coopetitive regime is critical for achieving both clinically interpretable ECG morphology and strong downstream accuracy in non-contact cardiac monitoring.

AI.tldr: 本文提出三阶段失真-感知预训练模型(TriDP-PTM)，通过"雷达→ECG→任务"间接路径与多尺度融合双框架，在合作竞争阶段实现失真与感知损失的最优平衡，在30名受试者5种生理状态数据上，波形分割mIoU达0.80，四任务平均分类准确率98.3%，血压回归MAE降低56%。
AI.motivation: 现有非接触式雷达心脏监测方法多采用单一"失真驱动"或"感知驱动"范式，面临"低失真但弱语义信息"与"高感知保真度但差可解释性"之间的权衡，亟需一种能同时保证临床可解释ECG形态与下游任务精度的框架。
AI.method: 提出三阶段失真-感知预训练模型(TriDP-PTM)，构建多尺度融合双路径框架，系统比较"直接雷达→任务"路径与"间接雷达→ECG→任务"路径；通过ECG生成器与特征判别器组成复合损失函数，将ECG形态与节律等医学先验融入下游任务。
AI.result: 在30名受试者5种生理状态数据集上，间接路径在波形分割中mIoU达0.80，四任务平均分类准确率98.3%，血压回归MAE相比最强基线降低56%。
AI.conclusion: 在雷达→ECG间接路径中，适当加权失真与感知损失使其处于合作竞争阶段，对实现临床可解释的ECG形态与强下游准确性至关重要。

title: On Reliability of Efficient Membership Inference Vulnerability Evaluation
summary: Membership inference attacks (MIAs) are popular methods for empirically assessing the leakage of sensitive information in the training data through models or statistics learned from the data. The MIA vulnerability is often evaluated through false positive rate (FPR) and true positive rate (TPR) of a binary classifier that tries to predict whether a particular sample was in the training data. However, in order to reliably estimate the TPR especially for low FPR values, a lot of observations are needed, which in case of MIA translates to many target models, leading to large computational cost. To avoid excessive compute requirements, the MIA scores are often averaged over multiple individuals and multiple targeted models. We demonstrate two key weaknesses in this efficient MIA evaluation pipeline. First, we show that evaluating the TPR based on MIA scores concatenated across multiple individuals, commonly used to study vulnerabilities in the very low FPR regime, is not calibrated across the per-sample FPRs. This makes it unreliable as a tool for auditing differential privacy. To solve this, we propose a post-processing method to effectively calibrate the FPR across different samples. Second, we identify a finite population bias in the commonly used efficient likelihood-ratio attack (LiRA) implementation proposed by Carlini et al. 2022, leading to a positive bias in the per-sample vulnerability.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了当前成员推断攻击（MIA）评估流程中的两个关键缺陷：1）跨个体拼接MIA分数评估TPR的方法在低FPR区域未校准，不适用于差分隐私审计；2）广泛使用的似然比攻击（LiRA）存在有限总体偏差，导致个体脆弱性被高估。并提出了相应的后处理校准方法。
AI.motivation: 现有MIA评估为了降低计算成本，常将MIA分数跨多个个体和模型进行平均处理，但这种高效评估流程的可靠性未被充分检验。作者旨在揭示其中隐藏的系统性偏差，确保评估结果（特别是低FPR区域）的真实性和可信度。
AI.method: 1）通过理论分析证明跨个体拼接MIA分数评估TPR会导致各样本FPR未校准；2）提出后处理方法对FPR进行有效校准；3）识别LiRA实现中的有限总体偏差及其来源。
AI.result: 1）跨个体拼接MIA分数在低FPR区域的TPR估计不可靠，无法用于差分隐私审计；2）提出后处理方法可有效校准FPR；3）LiRA实现中的有限总体偏差导致个体脆弱性正向偏差。
AI.conclusion: 当前高效的MIA评估流程存在系统性缺陷，需谨慎解读其结果；所提出的校准方法可提升评估的可靠性，对隐私审计具有重要意义。

title: DeCoDrift: Stabilizing Decoder Coupling in Closed-Loop Foundation Segmentation
summary: Foundation segmentation models such as Segment Anything Model (SAM) are now routinely used in iterative pipelines, where each predicted mask is fed back as the next prompt. This practice turns segmentation into a closed-loop dynamical process, yet the decoder-level behavior of these systems remains largely unexamined. We show that this feedback loop can induce a previously overlooked failure mode, decoder coupling drift, in which the mask decoder's cross-attention progressively loses alignment with the target object, causing errors to accumulate across iterations. We study this phenomenon by instrumenting SAM's mask decoder and deriving ground-truth-free measures of prompt-image coupling, attention stability, and temporal consistency. On volumetric electron microscopy data, these decoder-internal signals reveal that standard iterative prompting systematically degrades attention alignment and temporal coherence relative to oracle-anchored feedback. We then formalize iterative prompting as a discrete-time dynamical system and show how proximal anchoring reduces error amplification in the feedback loop. Building on this analysis, we introduce DeCoDrift, a training-free inference-time stabilization framework that constrains prompt updates and preserves decoder coupling across iterations. Across extensive experiments, DeCoDrift consistently improves attention stability, temporal coherence, and segmentation quality over standard iterative prompting, without retraining or ground-truth supervision. More broadly, our results show that decoder-internal dynamics are not merely diagnostic: they provide actionable signals for stabilizing foundation segmentation models in closed-loop use.

AI.tldr: 本文发现SAM等基础分割模型在迭代提示的闭环使用中，存在一种被忽视的失效模式——解码器耦合漂移（decoder coupling drift），即掩码解码器的交叉注意力逐渐偏离目标物体，导致错误累积。作者通过仪器化SAM的解码器，提出无真值监督的稳定性度量，并将迭代提示形式化为离散时间动力系统，进而提出无需训练、仅需推理时干预的DeCoDrift框架，通过近端锚定约束提示更新，显著提升了注意力稳定性、时间一致性和分割质量。
AI.motivation: 当前基础分割模型（如SAM）广泛采用迭代反馈的方式使用（将预测掩码作为下一轮提示），但这种闭环动态过程中的解码器行为尚未被充分研究，存在潜在但未被识别的失效模式。
AI.method: 1）仪器化SAM掩码解码器，提出无真值监督的解码器内部信号（prompt-image耦合度、注意力稳定性、时间一致性）；2）将迭代提示形式化为离散时间动力系统；3）提出DeCoDrift——无需训练、仅推理时干预的稳定化框架，通过近端锚定约束提示更新，保持解码器跨迭代的耦合。
AI.result: 在体积电子显微镜数据上，标准迭代提示会系统性地降低注意力对齐和时间一致性；而DeCoDrift在不重新训练或无真值监督的情况下，一致地提升了注意力稳定性、时间一致性和分割质量。
AI.conclusion: 解码器内部动力学不仅仅是诊断工具，它们能为闭环使用中的基础分割模型提供可操作的稳定性信号。DeCoDrift作为一种轻量级、无需训练的推理时干预方法，有效解决了迭代提示中的耦合漂移问题。

title: Visual-Redundancy-Controlled Parallel Decoding for Diffusion-Based Multimodal Large Language Models
summary: Diffusion-based multimodal large language models (dMLLMs) decode by iteratively predicting tokens at multiple masked positions in parallel. This turns each decoding step into a position-selection problem: the model must choose not only which predictions are reliable in isolation, but also which positions should be committed together as context for later decoding steps. Existing confidence-based decoding ranks masked positions independently and commits the top-K positions, largely ignoring whether the committed tokens provide complementary visual grounding. We identify a step-level limitation of this strategy in multimodal settings: high-confidence tokens selected in the same step can rely on overlapping visual grounding, introducing visual redundancy among the committed tokens and leaving less complementary visual grounding available for later decoding. To quantify this effect, we introduce the Visual Redundancy Index (VRI), which measures visual grounding overlap among tokens committed in parallel. To control this redundancy during decoding, we propose Visual-Redundancy-Controlled Decoding (VRCD), a training-free inference-time decoding method that uses token-to-image attention to prioritize visually complementary positions. Across diverse multimodal benchmarks, VRCD reduces visual redundancy and remaining-position entropy with modest runtime overhead. In longer decoding experiments, it also achieves relative accuracy gains of up to 18.8% on M^3CoT and 6.9% on MMBench over confidence-based decoding. Code will be released at https://github.com/infiniteYuanyl/VRCD.

AI.tldr: 现有基于扩散的多模态大语言模型(dMLLMs)在解码时采用置信度排序独立选择top-K位置进行并行预测，但忽略了所选token之间视觉基础的重叠问题。本文提出视觉冗余控制解码(VRCD)，通过token到图像的注意力机制优先选择视觉互补的位置，显著降低视觉冗余并提升解码性能，在M^3CoT和MMBench上分别获得18.8%和6.9%的相对精度提升。
AI.motivation: 发现dMLLMs的置信度解码策略在多模态场景中存在步骤级局限：同一解码步骤中高置信度token可能依赖重叠的视觉基础，导致提交的token之间存在视觉冗余，使得后续解码可用的互补视觉基础减少。
AI.method: 1) 提出视觉冗余指数(VRI)量化并行提交token间的视觉基础重叠程度；2) 提出视觉冗余控制解码(VRCD)，一种无需训练的推理时解码方法，利用token到图像的注意力优先选择视觉互补的位置。
AI.result: 在多模态基准测试中，VRCD降低了视觉冗余和剩余位置熵，且运行时开销适中；在长解码实验中，相比置信度解码，在M^3CoT上获得18.8%、在MMBench上获得6.9%的相对精度提升。
AI.conclusion: VRCD通过控制并行解码时的视觉冗余，有效提升了dMLLMs在多模态任务中的解码质量，证明了考虑视觉互补性对于多模态序列解码的重要性。

title: SFR-Net: Learning Scale-Frustum Representations for Ultra-Wide Area Remote Sensing Image Segmentation
summary: Pixel count and geographical coverage are two key characteristics of remote sensing images. Existing remote sensing image segmentation methods typically focus on images with either a small pixel count or a large pixel count but limited geographical coverage. In this paper, we introduce a novel segmentation task targeting ultra-wide area (UWA) remote sensing images, characterized by both a large pixel count and extremely wide geographical coverage. The core challenges of UWA segmentation lie in simultaneously handling ground objects with significantly varying scales and maintaining long-range contextual semantic continuity. To address these challenges, we propose the Scale-Frustum Representation Network (SFR-Net). Inspired by the viewing frustums of remote sensing images captured from different altitudes, we construct scale-frustum representations, enabling unified modeling of ground objects and contextual features at different scales. Furthermore, we design a cascaded cross-scale fusion mechanism to effectively integrate these representations, enhancing local semantic understanding while ensuring long-range contextual continuity. Experimental results on GID and FBPS demonstrate that SFR-Net achieves state-of-the-art performance, improving mIoU by 1.72% and 4.29%, respectively, over the strongest competing methods. In addition, the proposed scale-frustum representations can be integrated into generic segmentation networks to improve both segmentation accuracy and convergence speed. The implementation code will be publicly available at https://github.com/ChuyuZhong/SFR-Net.

AI.tldr: 本文提出面向超宽幅（UWA）遥感图像的分割任务，并设计尺度截锥体表征网络（SFR-Net），通过构建不同高度的尺度截锥体表征和级联跨尺度融合机制，统一建模多尺度地物并保持长程上下文连续性，在GID和FBPS数据集上达到SOTA，mIoU分别提升1.72%和4.29%。
AI.motivation: 现有遥感图像分割方法通常只针对小像素数图像或大像素数但地理覆盖有限的图像，缺乏同时处理大像素数且地理覆盖极广的超宽幅（UWA）遥感图像的分割方法。UWA图像的核心挑战在于同时处理尺度差异巨大的地物并维持长程上下文语义连续性。
AI.method: 受不同高度拍摄的遥感图像视锥体启发，构建尺度截锥体表征（Scale-Frustum Representations），实现不同尺度地物和上下文特征的统一建模；设计级联跨尺度融合机制（Cascaded Cross-scale Fusion），有效整合这些表征，增强局部语义理解并保证长程上下文连续性。
AI.result: 在GID和FBPS数据集上，SFR-Net分别实现了1.72%和4.29%的mIoU提升，达到SOTA性能。此外，尺度截锥体表征可集成到通用分割网络中，提升分割精度和收敛速度。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的SFR-Net有效解决了超宽幅遥感图像分割中多尺度地物建模和长程上下文连续性的双重挑战，具有显著的性能优势，且所提出的表征模块具有良好的通用性和可迁移性。

title: Context-Instrumental Data Distillation for Kubernetes Manifest Generation: Method and Experimental Evaluation
summary: This paper examines the specialization of Small Language Models (SLMs) with up to 4 billion parameters for generating artifacts in domain-specific languages (DSL). Kubernetes manifests are chosen as the target domain. We propose the context-instrumental data distillation method: the source corpus is formed through synthetic generation and, in an extended scheme, through reverse instruction generation from real Kubernetes YAML files, with pairs included in training only upon passing external validators and matching the domain context model. Unlike classical KL-divergence knowledge distillation, the baseline implementation reduces to supervised fine-tuning on instrumentally verified examples. The experimental section presents a pilot implementation under resource-constrained conditions: the DeepSeek-V4 Flash API serves as the teacher for synthetic generation, while Qwen2.5-Coder-1.5B-Instruct is fine-tuned via LoRA on CPU. On the K8s-Distill-Pilot corpus (train_1200, validation_100, test_200), we achieved full-pass@1 = 91.5% (183/200) with a stricter prompt formulation and max_new_tokens=768. The key empirical finding is that for Kubernetes YAML, result quality in the pilot depended more on strict output format requirements than on simply increasing the number of training examples.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了面向Kubernetes YAML领域特定语言的、参数不超过4B的小语言模型（SLM）的专业化方法，提出了一种上下文感知的数据蒸馏方法（context-instrumental data distillation），通过在资源受限条件下（CPU上进行LoRA微调）的初步实验，在K8s-Distill-Pilot语料上达到pass@1=91.5%，并发现输出格式的严格约束比增加训练样本数量对结果质量影响更大。
AI.motivation: 探索在资源受限条件下，利用数据蒸馏方法让小语言模型（SLM，≤4B参数）掌握领域特定语言（DSL）的生成能力，以Kubernetes YAML清单为具体领域，解决大规模教师模型蒸馏到小模型过程中的效率和可用性问题。
AI.method: 提出context-instrumental data distillation方法：通过合成生成和逆向指令生成（从真实Kubernetes YAML文件生成指令-输出对）构建源语料，仅当生成的样本通过外部验证器且匹配领域上下文模型时才纳入训练集。基线实现不采用经典KL散度知识蒸馏，而是简化为在经工具验证的样本上进行监督微调。实验中使用DeepSeek-V4 Flash API作为教师模型进行合成生成，Qwen2.5-Coder-1.5B-Instruct作为学生模型，通过LoRA在CPU上微调。
AI.result: 在K8s-Distill-Pilot语料（训练1200、验证100、测试200）上，采用更严格的提示词格式和max_new_tokens=768时，达到full-pass@1=91.5%（183/200）。关键实证发现：对于Kubernetes YAML生成，输出格式的严格约束比单纯增加训练样本数量对结果质量的影响更大。
AI.conclusion: 该方法在资源受限条件下能有效实现SLM对领域特定语言的专业化，且格式约束策略在YAML生成任务中比数据规模扩展更具性价比，为低成本构建领域专用代码生成模型提供了实践指导。

title: SplitAvatar: One-shot Head Avatar with Autoregressive Gaussian Splitting
summary: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) provides an efficient method for high-quality scene reconstruction using anisotropic Gaussians. Recently, 3DGS-based methods have significantly improved the rendering quality of human avatars while enabling real-time performance. However, existing methods suffer from a magnitude mismatch in the number of Gaussians generated by image-based and 3DMM-based approaches. This discrepancy results in reconstructed expressions that lack fine-grained detail. In this paper, we introduce a novel method for reconstructing an animatable head avatar from a single image. We propose a Graph splitting network to progressively generate Gaussians from coarse to fine using an autoregressive architecture. To address the graph inconsistency caused by split Gaussians, we employ a mesh topology extension method to align the GNN's connectivity with the increased Gaussian count. Furthermore, we introduce a novel density control method that includes a gating mechanism that generates soft masks for Gaussians, preventing over-densification after the splitting operation. This allows for dynamic control over Gaussian density across different facial regions. For smooth and rapid training, we employ a delayed filtering strategy to avoid re-computing the graph topology during training. Experimental results demonstrate that our autoregressive structure effectively improves expression representation ability by progressively splitting Gaussians. This process, enabled by the GNN-guided splitting, synthesizes more precise facial details and achieves higher reconstruction quality.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种基于图分裂网络的自回归架构，通过从粗到细逐步生成高斯体来改进单图像可动画头部头像重建，解决了3DGS方法中图像基与3DMM基方法间高斯数量不匹配导致的细粒度细节缺失问题。
AI.motivation: 现有3DGS-based人体头像重建方法中，基于图像的方法和基于3DMM的方法生成的高斯数量存在量级不匹配，导致重建的表情缺乏细粒度细节。
AI.method: 1) 提出图分裂网络(Graph splitting network)，采用自回归架构从粗到细逐步生成高斯体；2) 采用网格拓扑扩展方法解决分裂导致图结构不一致问题；3) 引入包含门控机制的密度控制方法生成软掩码防止过度密集化；4) 采用延迟过滤策略避免训练期间重新计算图拓扑。
AI.result: 自回归结构通过逐步分裂高斯体有效提升了表情表达能力，合成了更精细的面部细节，实现了更高的重建质量。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的GNN引导分裂方法能够合成更精确的面部细节，达到更高的重建质量。

title: Geometric Evolution Maps: Extracting Stable Concept Probes from Transformer Residual Streams
comment: 24 pages, 3 figures. Reference implementation: rosetta_tools v1.3.1 (doi:10.5281/zenodo.20361433)
summary: Concept probes extracted from transformer residual streams are only as reliable as the layer from which they are extracted. The common practice of probing at a fixed late layer or at the peak of a separation score function ignores a fundamental structural feature: concept representations undergo substantial directional rotation during their assembly phase, and do not settle into a stable direction until a characteristic handoff layer after the primary Concept Allocation Zone (CAZ). We introduce Geometric Evolution Maps (GEMs), which track the full directional trajectory of a concept through residual stream activations, identify the handoff layer where rotation ceases, and extract the settled probe direction from that layer. Across 23 architectures spanning 70M to 14B parameters and 17 concept types, the entry-to-exit cosine similarity within CAZs has a mean of 0.233, showing that probe direction at CAZ entry does not reliably predict probe direction at exit. Ablation experiments across 391 concept x model pairs (23 models x 17 concepts) show that GEM-extracted probes are at least as precise as peak-layer probes in 268/391 trials (68.5%), and strictly outperform in 259/391 (66.2%). The architecture split is pronounced: MHA models favour the handoff in 173/221 trials (78.3%); GQA models favour the handoff in only 56/119 trials (47.1%). Model-level Wilcoxon: W=214, N=23, p=0.010 (one-sided). An adaptive ablation width rule targets the 79/391 near-final-layer cases: it improves probe quality in 60/79 triggered cases (75.9%), mean gain +7.44pp. A direction-specificity control confirms the ablation effect is concept-direction specific: median 377x suppression rate versus random-direction ablation (99.1% of concept directions beat all 10 random seeds). Reference implementation: rosetta_tools v1.3.1 (doi:10.5281/zenodo.20361433).

AI.tldr: 本文提出几何演化图（GEMs）方法，通过追踪概念在残差流中的完整方向轨迹，识别旋转停止的交接层（handoff layer）并提取稳定探针方向。在23种架构（70M-14B参数）和17个概念类型上的实验表明，GEM提取的探针在68.5%的试验中至少与峰值层探针相当，66.2%严格更优，尤其在MHA架构中优势显著（78.3%）。
AI.motivation: 现有探针方法通常在固定晚期层或分离度峰值层提取概念表示，忽略了概念表示在组装阶段经历显著方向旋转这一结构特性，导致探针方向不稳定、不可靠。本文旨在揭示这一现象并开发更鲁棒的探针提取方法。
AI.method: 提出Geometric Evolution Maps (GEMs)，通过追踪概念在残差流各层的完整方向轨迹，识别旋转停止的handoff layer，并从中提取稳定的探针方向。同时设计自适应消融宽度规则和方向特异性控制实验来验证方法有效性。
AI.result: 在23种架构（70M-14B参数）和17个概念类型的391个概念×模型组合实验上：CAZ内入口到出口余弦相似度均值仅0.233；GEM探针在68.5%试验中至少不差于峰值层探针，66.2%严格更优；MHA模型优势显著（78.3%），GQA模型仅47.1%；自适应消融规则在触发案例中75.9%提升探针质量，平均增益+7.44pp；方向特异性控制显示中位数377倍抑制率。
AI.conclusion: 概念表示在组装阶段的旋转是普遍的结构性特征，GEM方法通过识别handoff layer能有效提取更稳定可靠的探针方向，显著优于传统峰值层探针策略，但效果因架构类型（MHA vs GQA）而异。

title: Broadband Hyperspectral 3D Imaging using Dispersed Structured Light
summary: Hyperspectral 3D imaging enables the capture of dense spectral information and scene geometry but has traditionally been confined to narrow spectral windows, typically the visible range. In this work, we introduce a broadband hyperspectral 3D imaging (BH3D) method to extend this capability across the full visible-near-infrared and short-wavelength infrared (SWIR) spectrum (450-1500 nm). This broad coverage is critical as it captures complementary physical cues: visible wavelengths reveal surface appearance, while SWIR bands provide insight into subsurface properties and material composition. However, realizing BH3D is challenging due to fundamental sensor constraints between visible-spectrum silicon and SWIR-spectrum InGaAs sensors, which necessitate complex multi-spectrograph designs. Here we propose a single-spectrograph BH3D system, using a stereo setup comprising visible and SWIR cameras, that reconstructs dense broadband hyperspectral reflectance together with accurate 3D geometry. Our key idea is to extend dispersed structured light to the broadband regime using a single spectrograph. We model the image formation of broadband dispersed structured light, and estimate hyperspectral reflectance and depth. We validate our approach on diverse real-world scenes, demonstrating accurate reconstruction with a mean spectral angle mapper of 0.13 rad, root mean square error of 0.03, and mean depth error of 4.5 mm. We further demonstrate identifying metameric materials, performing imaging through opaque layers, uncovering hidden features on banknotes, and revealing blood vessels.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种宽带高光谱3D成像（BH3D）方法，利用单一光谱仪和可见光-SWIR立体相机系统，在450-1500nm宽光谱范围内同时重建高光谱反射率和精确3D几何结构，解决了传统方法局限于可见光波段且需复杂多光谱仪设计的难题。
AI.motivation: 传统高光谱3D成像局限于可见光窄波段，无法捕获SWIR波段中重要的亚表面特性和材料组成信息。同时，可见光硅传感器与SWIR InGaAs传感器之间存在根本性差异，导致需要复杂的多光谱仪设计，限制了宽带高光谱3D成像的实用性。
AI.method: 提出单光谱仪BH3D系统，采用可见光与SWIR相机构成的立体设置；将色散结构光扩展到宽带体制；建立宽带色散结构光的图像形成模型；联合估计高光谱反射率和深度信息。
AI.result: 在多种真实场景中验证，平均光谱角度映射器为0.13 rad，均方根误差为0.03，平均深度误差为4.5 mm。展示了同色异谱材料识别、不透明层成像、钞票隐藏特征揭示以及血管成像等应用。
AI.conclusion: 所提方法成功将高光谱3D成像从可见光扩展到宽带（450-1500nm）范围，仅需单一光谱仪即可实现，克服了传感器差异带来的硬件复杂性，为材料分析、生物医学成像和安全检测等领域提供了新工具。

title: When Self-Belief Misleads: Active Label Acquisition for Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have achieved remarkable advancements in reasoning capabilities empowered by Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR). Nonetheless, RLVR intrinsically relies on ground-truth labels for reward computation, the acquisition of which is often prohibitively expensive in real-world scenarios. While unsupervised RLVR paradigms attempt to circumvent this by training on pseudo-labels, they are notoriously susceptible to training collapse. Moreover, different samples often exhibit varying annotation values. In this paper, we propose Reinforcement Learning with Active Verifiable Rewards (RLAVR), which actively acquires ground-truth labels for a small set of selected samples and integrates them with pseudo-labels, thereby stabilizing training dynamics and improving performance under limited annotation budgets. To identify valuable samples, we propose the Corrective Advantage Gap (CAG) metric and analyze the sample-level supervision value. Building on this, we introduce Correction-Aware Reliability Estimation for RLAVR (CARE), which translates the oracle CAG criterion into a practical pre-query acquisition policy to substantially improve training stability. Extensive experiments across diverse domains, model families, and model scales demonstrate the effectiveness and generality of our approach. Our code is available at https://github.com/Lumina04/CARE.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RLAVR框架，通过主动获取少量样本的真实标签并结合伪标签进行强化学习训练，以解决RLVR中标签成本高和训练不稳定的问题。引入CAG指标和CARE策略实现高效样本选择，实验验证了方法的有效性和泛化性。
AI.motivation: RLVR依赖真实标签计算奖励，但获取真实标签成本高昂；无监督RLVR使用伪标签易导致训练崩溃；不同样本的标注价值存在差异。因此需要一种能在有限标注预算下稳定训练的方法。
AI.method: 提出RLAVR框架，主动获取少量高价值样本的真实标签并与伪标签结合训练。提出Corrective Advantage Gap (CAG)指标用于量化样本的监督价值，并设计Correction-Aware Reliability Estimation for RLAVR (CARE)策略，将CAG准则转化为实际查询前的样本选择策略。
AI.result: 在多个领域、模型家族和模型规模上的大量实验表明，该方法具有有效性和泛化性。
AI.conclusion: 通过主动获取少量真实标签并有效融合伪标签，可以在有限标注预算下显著提升LLM强化学习训练的稳定性和性能。

title: Towards Anatomically Plausible Human Image Generation via Synthetic Localized Preferences
summary: Large-scale text-to-image foundation models have achieved remarkable visual realism, yet generating human images with correct anatomical structures remains challenging. Existing approaches enforce anatomical constraints through part-specific modules or localized loss weighting during supervised fine-tuning on high-quality human photos, but such datasets are limited and often provide ambiguous optimization signals due to confounding factors such as lighting, pose, and background. Preference-based alignment offers an alternative, but standard Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) treats all pixels equally and therefore fails to exploit the localized nature of anatomical artifacts. To address this, we propose the framework of Alignment via Synthetic Anatomical Preference (ASAP), which constructs controlled preference pairs through a localized degradation mechanism applied to high-fidelity human images. This mechanism performs a controlled experiment on images by introducing explicit anatomical errors in targeted regions while preserving the remaining content. With this mechanism, we create the Human Anatomical Preference (HAP) dataset with over 10K curated pairs for effective anatomical alignment of text-to-image human image generative models. To better leverage the locality of these controlled preference pairs, we introduce a localized and margin-bounded variant of DPO that prioritizes optimization in targeted anatomical regions while enforcing a finite preference margin to prevent over-optimization and preserve global semantics. We further introduce HAF-Bench, a benchmark for systematic evaluation of anatomical fidelity. Extensive experiments demonstrate that ASAP consistently reduces anatomical errors across multiple foundation models while maintaining overall image quality.

AI.tldr: 针对文本到图像基础模型生成人体图像时解剖结构错误的问题，提出ASAP框架，通过合成解剖偏好数据（HAP数据集）和局部化边界DPO算法进行对齐优化，显著减少解剖错误的同时保持图像质量。
AI.motivation: 现有文本到图像模型生成人体图像时存在解剖结构错误（如肢体缺失、关节错位），监督微调依赖高质量人体照片数据集，但这类数据有限且受光照、姿态、背景等混淆因素干扰，优化信号模糊。偏好对齐方法（如DPO）虽可作为替代，但标准DPO对所有像素平等对待，未能利用解剖伪影的局部性特征。
AI.method: 提出ASAP框架：1) 通过局部退化机制（在高质量人体图像的目标区域引入显式解剖错误，保持其余内容不变）构建受控偏好对，创建包含1万+对数据的HAP数据集；2) 提出局部化边界DPO变体，优先优化目标解剖区域，同时施加有限偏好边界防止过度优化并保留全局语义；3) 提出HAF-Bench基准系统评估解剖保真度。
AI.result: 在多个基础模型上的大量实验表明，ASAP能一致性地减少解剖错误，同时保持整体图像质量。
AI.conclusion: ASAP通过受控合成偏好数据和局部化对齐算法，有效解决了人体图像生成中的解剖结构问题，为文本到图像模型的细粒度结构控制提供了新范式。

title: UNATE: UNsupervised ATomic Embedding for crystal structures property prediction
summary: Accurately predicting crystal properties is critical for accelerating materials discovery, but it is often limited by scarce labeled data and costly theoretical calculations. To alleviate this, we propose UNATE (Unsupervised Atomic Embedding), a framework that leverages structural information extracted from unlabeled crystal structures. UNATE integrates an unsupervised denoising autoencoder with self-supervised contrastive learning to learn robust atomic representations, which are then used as input features for downstream property prediction. Experimental results show that replacing raw atomic numbers with UNATE-pretrained node embeddings yields a 2.7\% improvement over the full-data baseline. Notably, the benefits become more pronounced in scenarios with limited labeled data, reaching improvements of up to 10\% when only 25\% of the labeled data is used.

AI.tldr: UNATE利用无监督去噪自编码器和自监督对比学习从无标签晶体结构中学习原子表示，在完整数据下提升2.7%的晶体性质预测性能，在仅有25%标签数据时提升高达10%。
AI.motivation: 晶体性质预测受限于标注数据稀缺和理论计算成本高昂，亟需利用无标签结构信息来提升预测性能。
AI.method: 提出UNATE框架，结合无监督去噪自编码器与自监督对比学习，从无标签晶体结构中学习鲁棒的原子表示，作为下游性质预测的输入特征。
AI.result: 在完整数据集上相比基线提升2.7%；在仅使用25%标签数据时提升高达10%。
AI.conclusion: 利用无监督预训练的原子嵌入能有效缓解标签稀缺问题，尤其在小样本场景下优势显著。

title: AI-T2I: Aggregating-and-Isolating Cross-Attention to Diffusion Models for Text-to-Image Synthesis
comment: Accepted by IEEE Transactions on Multimedia (2026). 13 pages, 15 figures
summary: Text-to-image synthesis has made significant progress, benefiting from the strong generative capabilities of diffusion models. However, these models struggle to achieve precise text-to-image alignment within cross-attention maps during the denoising process. Existing works primarily focus on inter-subject-token activations (i.e., cross-attention scores) overlap for different subjects, overlooking the intra-subject-token activations scattering issue for identical subjects. In this paper, we propose an Aggregating-and-Isolating cross-attention approach to diffusion models for Text-to-Image synthesis, dubbed AI-T2I. Technically, to address the scattering issue, we devise an aggregation loss to identify and consolidate the scattered intra-token activations, which implicitly helps mitigate the potential overlap issue. Upon that, an isolation loss is further introduced to push the inter-token activations apart, thus fulfilling precise text-to-image alignment. Extensive experiments on various benchmarks demonstrate the superiority of AI-T2I over the state-of-the-art works for text-to-image synthesis. Furthermore, our AI-T2I exhibits excellent generalization across other tasks, e.g., controllable layout generation and personalized generation.

AI.tldr: 提出AI-T2I方法，通过聚合损失解决相同主体内token激活分散问题，并结合隔离损失分离不同主体间token激活，实现精确的文本到图像对齐，在多个基准上优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有扩散模型在文本到图像合成中难以实现精确的文本-图像对齐，现有工作主要关注不同主体间交叉注意力得分的重叠问题，而忽略了相同主体内token激活分散的问题。
AI.method: 提出聚合-隔离交叉注意力方法(AI-T2I)：1) 聚合损失：识别并整合分散的同类token激活，间接缓解潜在的重叠问题；2) 隔离损失：将不同主体间token激活推离，实现精确对齐。
AI.result: 在多个基准上优于现有最先进方法，且在可控布局生成和个性化生成等任务上表现出良好的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: AI-T2I通过同时解决token激活分散和重叠问题，有效提升了文本到图像合成的对齐精度，并具有良好的任务泛化性。

title: The Quantization Benefits of Residual-Free Transformers
summary: Large-scale transformer training and deployment are increasingly constrained by the transfer of activations, gradients, and optimizer states across accelerators. Low-bit quantization offers a natural remedy, but transformer activations are often heavy-tailed and outlier-dominated, making simple quantization highly lossy. We show that this difficulty is not only a property of the quantizer, but also of the architecture. Specifically, residual connections can drive transformer activations away from Gaussianity during training. Using controlled comparisons between residual and residual-free transformers, we demonstrate that this effect leads to substantially higher quantization error and accuracy degradation at low precision in residual models. We explain the phenomenon through an excess kurtosis analysis, showing that residual mixing can amplify non-Gaussianity, whereas dense mixing in residual-free contracts non-Gaussianity. We then show that residual-free transformers can be made trainable using orthogonal initialization, spectral or second-order optimization, and depth-aware scaling of attention temperature. In language tasks, while there is a small drop in full precision performance, these models retain near-Gaussian activations and exhibit significantly improved robustness to low-bit quantization. Our results identify an accuracy--compressibility trade-off in transformer design and motivate architecture-level approaches to quantization-friendly foundation models.

AI.tldr: 本文发现Transformer中的残差连接会导致激活值呈重尾非高斯分布，加剧低比特量化误差；而去除残差连接并使用正交初始化等技术，可在轻微降低全精度性能的代价下，显著提升模型对低比特量化的鲁棒性，揭示了Transformer设计中存在准确率与可压缩性之间的权衡。
AI.motivation: 大规模Transformer的训练和部署受限于跨加速器传输激活值、梯度和优化器状态，低比特量化是自然缓解方案，但Transformer激活值常呈重尾分布且受离群值主导，导致简单量化损失严重。论文试图探究这一困难是否不仅与量化器有关，也与架构本身有关。
AI.method: 通过残差Transformer与无残差Transformer的受控对比实验；利用超额峰度分析解释残差混合会放大非高斯性而密集混合会压缩非高斯性；采用正交初始化、谱优化或二阶优化以及深度感知注意力温度缩放来训练无残差Transformer。
AI.result: 残差连接会使激活值偏离高斯分布，导致低精度下量化误差和准确率下降显著更高；无残差Transformer在全精度下有轻微性能下降，但保持近高斯激活值，对低比特量化的鲁棒性显著提升。
AI.conclusion: Transformer设计中存在准确率与可压缩性之间的权衡，应通过架构层面的方法设计有利于量化的基础模型。

title: Benchmarking Pathology Foundation Models for Spatial Domain Understanding
summary: Pathology foundation models (PFMs) have emerged as a core approach for learning transferable representations from whole slide images (WSIs), and they are typically benchmarked through downstream clinical endpoints. While such task level evaluations are indispensable, they offer limited insight into what the representations themselves encode, particularly whether PFM embeddings can distinguish meaningful tissue regions and capture their spatial relationships. We present SpaPath-Bench, a representation level benchmark designed to diagnose spatial representation capability in PFMs. SpaPath-Bench formulates spatial domain identification (SDI) on paired whole slide image and spatial transcriptomics (ST) data as a diagnostic task. It curates 42 public paired WSI and ST slides, enables large scale evaluation across 19 encoders and seven SDI methods, and measures partition quality using three complementary criteria: unsupervised spatial coherence, transcriptomics referenced agreement, and expert referenced agreement. Across 83K runs, SpaPath-Bench reveals that different pretraining paradigms capture distinct aspects of tissue spatial architecture, and it provides practical guidance for building the next generation of spatially aware computational pathology models. Code and data pipelines are publicly available at https://bokai-zhao.github.io/SpaPath-benchboard/.

AI.tldr: SpaPath-Bench是一个用于诊断病理基础模型空间表征能力的基准测试，通过空间域识别任务评估模型能否区分WSI中的组织区域并捕捉其空间关系。在42张配对WSI-ST数据、19个编码器和7种方法上进行了83K次实验，发现不同预训练范式捕获了组织空间架构的不同方面。
AI.motivation: 现有病理基础模型评估主要基于下游临床任务，无法深入揭示模型表征本身编码了什么信息，尤其是模型能否区分有意义的组织区域并捕捉它们的空间关系。
AI.method: 构建SpaPath-Bench基准，通过空间域识别任务（SDI）在配对的全切片图像和空间转录组数据上进行评估，使用无监督空间一致性、转录组学参考一致性和专家参考一致性三个互补标准来衡量分区质量。
AI.result: 在83K次运行中，SpaPath-Bench揭示了不同预训练范式捕获了组织空间架构的不同方面，并提供了构建下一代空间感知计算病理学模型的实用指导。
AI.conclusion: SpaPath-Bench能够有效诊断病理基础模型的空间表征能力，为开发空间感知的病理模型提供了重要参考。

title: Conformalised imprecise inference for robust extrapolation under limited data
summary: Recent advances in uncertainty quantification increasingly emphasise the distinction between aleatory and epistemic uncertainty in machine learning, motivating the need for more unified frameworks. However, despite much progress in producing reliable predictions, existing methods often lack rigorous guarantees when generalising beyond the training domain. We propose a conformalised imprecise inference framework for robust extrapolation, which is model-agnostic and augments predictive models with imprecision and distance awareness. The proposed approach yields imprecise predictions (probability boxes) that remain valid under distributional shift, maintaining coverage while adaptively expanding uncertainty in extrapolation regimes. Experiments on synthetic and benchmark datasets demonstrate improved robustness and reliable coverage compared to standard probabilistic approaches, particularly under limited data.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种基于共形预测与不精确推理的统一框架，通过将预测模型与不精确性和距离感知相结合，在分布外泛化场景下仍能保持覆盖保证，并自适应地扩展不确定性表达。
AI.motivation: 现有不确定性量化方法在分布外泛化时缺乏严格的保证，且对偶然不确定性和认知不确定性的区分缺乏统一框架。
AI.method: 基于共形预测的不精确推理框架，模型无关，通过距离感知和概率盒（probability boxes）生成不精确预测，在分布偏移下保持有效覆盖。
AI.result: 在合成数据和基准数据集上，相比标准概率方法，该方法在有限数据和外推场景下表现出更好的鲁棒性和可靠覆盖。
AI.conclusion: 该方法为分布外泛化下的不确定性量化提供了有理论保证的统一方案，特别适用于数据稀缺场景。

title: Concept Unlearning via Cross-Attention Activation Projection for Diffusion Models
summary: Concept unlearning aims to erase a target concept from a pretrained text-to-image diffusion model without retraining. Closed-form methods are attractive in this setting because they apply a single deterministic edit to the cross-attention weights and add no inference-time cost. Existing closed-form methods, however, represent the target concept through the text encoder's response to a few short anchor prompts that name it, and paraphrased prompts that evoke the concept without naming it consistently bypass the edit. We argue that the target should instead be represented in the cross-attention activation space. Text embeddings describe the user's prompt, while cross-attention activations describe what the model is about to render, and the latter generalize to paraphrase the anchor templates do not cover. Building on this observation, we propose PURE (Projection in U-Net Rendering for Erasure), a closed-form method that builds the forget and retain bases from per-layer cross-attention activations captured along a short denoising trajectory and applies a single linear projector to the cross-attention key and value weights. On a recent holistic concept-unlearning benchmark covering ten concepts across artistic style, intellectual property, celebrity, and NSFW categories, PURE significantly reduces target leakage under paraphrased and adversarial prompts while preserving retain concepts close to the unedited model, yielding the best overall forget-retain trade-off among evaluated methods.

AI.tldr: PURE是一种基于交叉注意力激活空间投影的闭式概念消除方法，通过在U-Net的交叉注意力层构建遗忘和保留基，并应用线性投影器编辑键值权重，在保持保留概念的同时有效消除目标概念，尤其对释义和对抗性提示具有鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有闭式概念消除方法仅通过文本编码器对少数锚定提示的响应来表征目标概念，导致使用释义提示（不直接命名目标概念）时容易绕过编辑。作者认为应在交叉注意力激活空间表征目标概念，因为文本嵌入描述用户提示，而交叉注意力激活描述模型即将渲染的内容，后者能泛化到锚定模板未覆盖的释义情况。
AI.method: PURE方法：从短去噪轨迹中逐层捕获交叉注意力激活，构建遗忘基和保留基；然后对交叉注意力的键和值权重应用单个线性投影器进行编辑。这是一个闭式方法，只需一次性确定性编辑，不增加推理成本。
AI.result: 在涵盖艺术风格、知识产权、名人及NSFW等十个概念的整体概念消除基准上，PURE显著降低了释义和对抗性提示下的目标概念泄漏，同时保持保留概念接近未编辑模型，实现了评估方法中最佳的遗忘-保留权衡。
AI.conclusion: 在交叉注意力激活空间表征目标概念比在文本嵌入空间更有效，能够泛化到未见过的释义提示，为闭式概念消除提供了更鲁棒的解决方案。

title: Optimal and Order-optimal Gated Priority-based Greedy Policies for Two-layer Multi-item Order Fulfillment
summary: We study how an e-commerce firm should make real-time fulfillment decisions in a two-layer distribution network when multi-item customer orders arrive sequentially and future demand is unknown. The central managerial tension is whether to use scarce front distribution center (FDC) inventory to save current fulfillment cost or preserve that inventory for future orders that may be more valuable to serve locally. We formulate an adversarial online model with multiple FDCs, one regional distribution center (RDC), multi-unit multi-item orders, and item-specific and time-varying variable costs. Our theoretical objective is to characterize when simple, interpretable, and implementable fulfillment rules can perform nearly as well as an optimal clairvoyant planner. We develop a family of Gated Priority-based Greedy policies, derive competitive-ratio guarantees under both time-varying and time-invariant cost structures, and establish matching or near-matching lower bounds for any online algorithm. Numerical experiments show that the proposed policies perform strongly relative to generalized myopic and forecast-based benchmarks. The analysis yields managerial guidance on when local inventory should be protected, when splitting orders is worth the fixed-cost burden, and how the relative magnitudes of fixed and variable costs determine the value of more sophisticated optimization.

AI.tldr: 研究电商企业在两层分销网络中，面对多品订单顺序到达且未来需求未知时的实时履约决策问题，提出门控优先级贪婪策略，并通过竞争比分析证明其接近最优先知方案的表现。
AI.motivation: 电商企业在实时履约中面临核心管理矛盾：是利用稀缺的前端配送中心（FDC）库存降低当前履约成本，还是保留库存以服务未来更有价值的本地订单。需要可解释、可实施的简单履约规则。
AI.method: 构建具有多个FDC、一个区域配送中心（RDC）、多单位多品订单以及时变可变成本的对抗性在线模型；提出门控优先级贪婪策略家族；推导时变和时不变成本结构下的竞争比保证；建立匹配或近匹配的下界。
AI.result: 所提策略在数值实验中相对于广义短视策略和基于预测的基准表现强劲；建立了竞争比上界与下界；提供了何时保护本地库存、何时拆分订单以及固定与可变成本相对大小如何决定更复杂优化价值的管管理指南。
AI.conclusion: 简单的门控优先级贪婪策略可以在理论上接近最优在线算法的表现，为电商企业实时履约决策提供了可操作的指导原则。

title: SAFE-Diff: Scale-Aware Attention and Feature-Dispersive Diffusion with Uncertainty Estimation for Contrast-Enhanced Breast MRI Synthesis
summary: Synthesizing high fidelity contrast enhanced MRI is clinically valuable for safer and more efficient breast cancer screening, yet remains challenging due to complex lesion textures and heterogeneous enhancement patterns.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了合成高保真度对比增强MRI在乳腺癌筛查中的临床价值及挑战，重点在于处理复杂的病变纹理和异质性增强模式。
AI.motivation: 合成高保真对比增强MRI对于实现更安全、更高效的乳腺癌筛查具有重要临床价值，因此有必要开展相关研究。
AI.method: 未在摘要中明确说明具体方法，仅指出需要解决复杂病变纹理和异质性增强模式所带来的挑战。
AI.result: 摘要未提供具体实验结果，仅指出该任务仍然具有挑战性。
AI.conclusion: 合成高保真对比增强MRI在乳腺癌筛查中具有临床价值，但需要克服病变纹理复杂和增强模式异质等难题。

title: Merge-Bench: Resolve Merge Conflicts with Large Language Models
summary: This paper applies machine learning to the difficult and important task of version control merging. (1) We constructed a dataset, Merge-Bench, of 7938 real-world merge conflict hunks from 1439 GitHub repositories. The ground truth is the merge resolution that developers committed to the repository. Our dataset construction methodology is scalable to arbitrary amounts of data since no manual labeling is required. (2) We trained a model, LLMergeJ, to resolve merge conflicts in Java programs. Our approach uses Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), an online reinforcement learning method, to train a Large Language Model (LLM). (3) We performed two evaluations of the performance of LLMs on resolving merge conflicts. On Java programs, LLMergeJ with 14B parameters outperforms 3 commercial LLMs, trailing only Gemini 2.5 Pro. Across 11 programming languages, commercial LLM performance is largely stable from language to language. The best models correctly resolve less than 60% of merge conflicts.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了包含7938个真实合并冲突的数据集Merge-Bench，并基于GRPO强化学习方法训练了LLMergeJ模型（14B参数），其在Java合并冲突解决上优于除Gemini 2.5 Pro外的所有商业LLM，但最佳模型正确解决率仍低于60%。
AI.motivation: 版本控制合并是一项重要但困难的任务，现有方法在处理合并冲突时效果有限，亟需更有效的自动化解决方案。
AI.method: (1) 构建Merge-Bench数据集：从1439个GitHub仓库收集7938个真实合并冲突块，以开发者提交的合并解决方案作为真值，无需人工标注，具有可扩展性。(2) 训练LLMergeJ模型：采用Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO)在线强化学习方法训练大型语言模型。(3) 评估：在Java程序上评估LLMergeJ（14B参数），并在11种编程语言上评估商业LLM的性能稳定性。
AI.result: LLMergeJ（14B参数）在Java合并冲突解决上优于3个商业LLM，仅次于Gemini 2.5 Pro。在11种编程语言上，商业LLM的性能跨语言基本稳定。最佳模型正确解决率低于60%。
AI.conclusion: 基于强化学习的LLM方法有潜力提升合并冲突解决能力，但当前最优模型仍有超过40%的失败率，该任务仍具挑战性，有待进一步研究。

title: DRFusion: Drift-Resilient Temporally Consistent Infrared-Visible Video Fusion
summary: Infrared and visible video fusion is essential for achieving comprehensive perception in dynamic scenes. However, maintaining temporal consistency remains a formidable challenge. Conventional methods relying on optical flow often suffer from geometric rigidity and ghosting artifacts. Moreover, standard diffusion-based fusion models typically operate in a frame-by-frame manner; when extended to autoregressive settings, they lack intrinsic temporal constraints and are prone to severe error accumulation and drifting, where minor artifacts amplify over time. To address these limitations, we propose a drift-resilient video fusion method that reformulates the task as history-conditioned motion generation. We introduce Stabilized History Guidance and Soft Temporal Anchoring to reframe temporal consistency as spectral filtering, implicitly aggregating motion dynamics without rigid alignment. Furthermore, our Decoupled Structure-Motion Adaptation strategy bridges pre-trained priors and structural constraints via two-stage training and latent refinement. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance in both fusion quality and temporal stability.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种抗漂移的红外与可见光视频融合方法，通过历史条件运动生成、稳定历史引导、软时间锚定和解耦结构-运动适配策略，实现了在融合质量和时间稳定性上的最先进性能。
AI.motivation: 现有红外-可见光视频融合方法存在时间一致性差的问题：光流法受限于几何刚性和鬼影伪影；扩散模型逐帧处理导致自回归设置下误差累积和漂移严重。
AI.method: 1) 将视频融合重构为历史条件运动生成任务；2) 稳定历史引导与软时间锚定，将时间一致性转化为频谱滤波，隐式聚合运动动态；3) 解耦结构-运动适配策略，通过两阶段训练和潜在空间精炼桥接预训练先验与结构约束。
AI.result: 在融合质量和时间稳定性上均达到最先进性能。
AI.conclusion: 所提方法有效解决了视频融合中的误差累积和漂移问题，为动态场景下的多模态融合提供了鲁棒的时序一致性解决方案。

title: Predicting Stock Price Direction on Earnings Announcement Days using Multi-modal Deep Learning
summary: Predicting stock price movements during Earnings Announcements (EAs) is a significant challenge due to market noise and high-impact price discontinuities. In this study, we evaluate whether pre-announcement news sentiment, firm fundamentals, and recent market dynamics jointly predict the directional price movement of equities on EA days. We construct a multi-modal feature space combining 15 fundamental metrics, 3 price-based technical indicators and sentiment scores derived from financial news articles processed using FinBERT. We compare a Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) network and a Transformer-based architecture against a logistic regression baseline, and further assess all models with and without sentiment features to quantify their incremental value. Our results indicate that while the LSTM demonstrates higher precision through a conservative safe-bet strategy, the Transformer model exhibits superior sensitivity in identifying volatile movements, achieving a higher macro F1-score, with ablation experiments showing a consistent benefit from incorporating news sentiment.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了利用公告前新闻情绪、公司基本面和近期市场动态的多模态特征，通过LSTM和Transformer模型预测财报公告日的股价方向性波动，发现Transformer在识别波动方面更敏感，且新闻情绪对模型有稳定提升作用。
AI.motivation: 财报公告期间股价预测因市场噪声和高影响价格不连续性而极具挑战性，现有方法未能充分结合多模态信息（基本面、技术指标、新闻情绪）进行联合预测。
AI.method: 构建多模态特征空间，包含15个基本面指标、3个价格技术指标和FinBERT提取的新闻情绪分数；使用LSTM和Transformer模型与逻辑回归基线对比，并通过消融实验评估情绪特征的增量价值。
AI.result: LSTM采用保守策略获得更高精确率，Transformer在识别波动性运动方面灵敏度更高，取得更高宏F1分数；消融实验表明新闻情绪对模型性能有一致性提升。
AI.conclusion: 多模态特征融合能有效预测财报公告日股价方向，Transformer架构在捕捉波动性方面优势明显，新闻情绪是关键的增量信息源。

title: OMGTex: One-stage Multi-style Facial Texture Reconstruction without Geometry Guidance
summary:
We propose OMGTex, an end-to-end diffusion-based framework for reconstructing high-quality and editable facial UV textures from multi-style facial images. Existing texture reconstruction methods face two major limitations: (1) Fragility due to reliance on 3D geometry priors, which are difficult to estimate accurately, especially under facial occlusions or in stylized domains; and (2) A lack of semantic disentanglement, inhibiting region-specific texture editing and style transfer. Our work addresses both challenges simultaneously.
  Our core innovation is a geometry-free pipeline that directly maps a 2D face image to its corresponding editable UV texture. We introduce two key techniques: First, to address the challenge of UV misalignment common in diffusion generation, we introduce a gradient-guided refinement strategy at inference time, which explicitly corrects structural consistency. Second, we leverage the inherent semantic distribution capability of diffusion models and design a novel training paradigm to enhance this tendency, enabling semantic-aware editing of facial texture. Furthermore, to address the data scarcity in multi-style texture reconstruction, we construct CANVAS, the first comprehensive paired texture reconstruction dataset covering realistic and diverse stylized domains.
  To the best of our knowledge, OMGTex is the first geometry-free inference framework that achieves robust, style-consistent, and editable facial texture reconstruction across diverse domains. Our method achieves state-of-the-art performance on multiple facial texture benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 提出了OMGTex，一个端到端的基于扩散模型的框架，用于从多风格人脸图像中重建高质量、可编辑的面部UV纹理。核心创新在于无几何先验的管线，通过梯度引导的推理策略解决UV对齐问题，并利用扩散模型的语义分布能力实现语义感知编辑，同时构建了首个涵盖真实与多样化风格域的配对纹理数据集CANVAS。
AI.motivation: 现有纹理重建方法存在两大局限：(1)依赖3D几何先验导致的脆弱性，尤其在面部遮挡或风格化域中难以准确估计；(2)缺乏语义解耦能力，阻碍了区域特定的纹理编辑和风格迁移。
AI.method: (1)无几何先验的管线：直接从2D人脸图像映射到可编辑的UV纹理；(2)梯度引导的推理时精炼策略：显式校正结构一致性，解决扩散生成中的UV未对齐问题；(3)新型训练范式：利用扩散模型的语义分布能力，增强语义感知的纹理编辑；(4)CANVAS数据集：首个涵盖真实与多样化风格化域的综合配对纹理数据集。
AI.result: 在多个面部纹理基准上取得了最先进的性能，实现了跨域鲁棒、风格一致且可编辑的面部纹理重建。
AI.conclusion: OMGTex是首个无几何先验的推理框架，能够在不同域中实现鲁棒、风格一致且可编辑的面部纹理重建，有效解决了现有方法对3D几何先验的依赖和语义解耦不足的问题。

title: Reading the Finetuning Prior: Verbatim Content Recovery via Contrastive Decoding Diffing
summary: Narrowly finetuned language models memorize implanted content verbatim, but auditing what a deployed model has been taught, without access to its weights or training data, remains an open challenge. Recent work shows that activation differences between base and finetuned models carry readable traces of the finetuning domain; the state-of-the-art Activation Difference Lens (ADL) recovers a vague domain-level description but requires full "white-box" access to model internals. We introduce Contrastive Decoding Diffing (CDD), a model diffing method that operates on output-level logit distributions only, with no weight access, no layer selection, and no per-model tuning, yet recovers implanted facts. CDD consists of three ideas: bypassing the chat template to expose the raw finetuning prior, seeding generation with maximally vague pre-fills, and amplifying the logit-space difference between finetuned and base models at each decoding step. A single default configuration recovers implanted facts verbatim -- exact drug names, vote counts, physical measurements, and procedural details -- across four architectures (1B--32B parameters), uniformly outperforming ADL despite less access and running ~170x faster. Furthermore, CDD surfaces unintended data pipeline artifacts: a fictional persona introduced by the LLM data generator via mode collapse leaked into model weights and was extracted by CDD, constituting to our knowledge the first demonstrated end-to-end fingerprinting chain from data generator artifact to model weights to recovered output. We validate on real-domain finetuning settings, achieving near-perfect recovery across all single-dataset non-CoT variants and correctly identifying all four datasets in the mixed-dataset setting. CDD's success as a grey-box method outperforming white-box baselines underscores its practical utility for transparency and accountability in AI systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出对比解码差异分析（CDD），一种仅基于输出层logit分布的模型差异分析方法，无需权重访问、层选择或逐模型调参，即可从微调模型中原样恢复植入的事实信息（如药物名称、投票数等），在四种架构（1B-32B参数）上统一优于需要白盒访问的现有方法ADL，运行速度快约170倍，并能揭示数据流水线中的人工制品。
AI.motivation: 现有方法（如ADL）需要白盒访问模型内部（权重、层激活），且恢复的信息仅为模糊的领域级描述，无法精确还原微调中植入的具体事实。在无法获取模型权重或训练数据的情境下，如何审计部署模型所学内容仍是一个开放挑战。
AI.method: CDD包含三个核心设计：(1) 绕过聊天模板，暴露原始微调先验；(2) 使用最大模糊性的前缀初始化生成；(3) 在每一步解码中放缩微调模型与基座模型在logit空间的差异。该方法仅需输出层logit分布，无需任何权重访问或模型内部信息，且采用单一默认配置即可跨不同架构泛化。
AI.result: 在四种架构（1B-32B参数）上，CDD能逐字恢复植入事实，包括药物名称、投票数、物理测量值和程序细节，统一优于白盒方法ADL，运行速度提升约170倍。在真实领域微调设置中，单数据集（非CoT变体）实现近乎完美的恢复，混合数据集设置下正确识别全部四个数据集。此外，CDD首次展示了从数据生成器模式坍缩到模型权重的端到端指纹提取链。
AI.conclusion: CDD作为一种灰盒方法（仅需logit分布），在性能上超越了需要白盒访问的基线方法，为AI系统的透明度和问责制提供了实用的审计工具，证明即使是受限的模型访问也能实现精确的模型差异分析。

title: VertiCue-Bench: Diagnosing Whether MLLMs Use Height Cues to Resolve 2D Ambiguity in Remote Sensing Natural Scenes
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have recently shown promising progress in geospatial reasoning. However, existing remote sensing benchmarks remain largely 2D-centric, evaluating models primarily on optical appearance. In natural environments, this paradigm breaks down due to severe spectral confusion, where ecologically distinct regions share similar textures but differ fundamentally in vertical structure. In such cases, explicit 3D structural data, such as Canopy Height Models (CHMs), become essential geometric evidence for semantic disambiguation. Yet, it remains unclear whether current MLLMs can genuinely leverage vertical cues to resolve appearance-level ambiguity. To address this gap, we introduce VertiCue-Bench, the first diagnostic benchmark for CHM-grounded geospatial reasoning. VertiCue-Bench comprises 1,534 carefully curated instances across 17 tasks, explicitly disentangling low-level height perception from ambiguity-aware semantic reasoning. Evaluations on 14 state-of-the-art general and remote-sensing-specialized MLLMs, combined with counterfactual modality testing, reveal a striking perception-reasoning dissociation. While models exhibit emerging competence in reading raw CHM height cues, they largely fail to translate geometric perception into reliable semantic reasoning, often underperforming RGB-only baselines when joint constraints are required. Overall, VertiCue-Bench exposes a critical geometry-to-semantics gap in natural scene understanding, offering actionable insights for advancing geospatial MLLMs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出VertiCue-Bench，首个基于冠层高度模型（CHM）的地理空间推理诊断基准，包含1534个实例和17项任务，评估14个主流多模态大模型后发现：模型虽具备读取高度线索的初级能力，但在将几何感知转化为可靠语义推理时表现不佳，揭示了自然场景理解中的"几何-语义鸿沟"。
AI.motivation: 现有遥感基准以2D光学外观为中心，但在自然环境中，生态上不同的区域可能共享相似纹理但垂直结构迥异（光谱混淆现象），而当前MLLMs是否能利用垂直结构线索解决外观层面的语义歧义尚不明确。
AI.method: 构建VertiCue-Bench诊断基准，包含1,534个精心设计的实例，覆盖17项任务，明确解耦低级高度感知与歧义感知的语义推理；对14个通用和遥感专用MLLMs进行反事实模态测试。
AI.result: 模型在读取原始CHM高度线索方面展现出初步能力，但在将几何感知转化为可靠的语义推理时普遍失败，在需要联合约束的条件下甚至不如仅基于RGB的基线模型。
AI.conclusion: VertiCue-Bench暴露了自然场景理解中关键的"几何-语义鸿沟"，为推进地理空间MLLMs的发展提供了可操作的洞见。

title: Joint Optimization of Training and Inference in Federated Edge Learning via Constrained Multi-Objective Deep Reinforcement Learning
summary: Federated edge learning (FEEL) has recently emerged as a promising paradigm for achieving edge intelligence (EI) via enabling collaborative model training across edge devices while protecting data privacy. In this paper, we put forth an online optimization framework that jointly manages federated training and inference on resource-constrained edge devices. We introduce a tandem-queue-inspired conversion mechanism that bridges inference requests and training data, and further incorporate both data and model freshness into the accuracy formulation to capture temporal dynamics in real-world environments. To maximize inference accuracy while minimizing latency and energy consumption, the mode selections, communication, and computation resource allocations of edge devices are jointly optimized. We formulate this optimization as a multi-objective optimization problem, which is NP-hard and further complicated by the online setting. To address these challenges, we transform the problem into a multi-objective Markov decision process (MOMDP) and develop a \underline{c}onstrained \underline{m}ulti-\underline{o}bjective \underline{p}roximal \underline{p}olicy \underline{o}ptimization (C-MOPPO) algorithm. Specifically, C-MOPPO first learns a set of policies with different preferences across three objectives, then leverages constrained policy optimization to enrich the Pareto front and obtain high-quality, dense solutions. Extensive experiments demonstrate that C-MOPPO achieves well-balanced trade-offs among objectives and significantly outperforms baselines under various system configurations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种面向资源受限边缘设备的在线联合优化框架，通过双队列转换机制和C-MOPPO算法，联合优化联邦边缘学习中的训练与推理过程，在推理准确率、延迟和能耗之间实现良好平衡。
AI.motivation: 联邦边缘学习（FEEL）虽有隐私保护和协作训练优势，但实际部署中面临训练与推理的联合管理难题，现有工作缺乏对二者动态协调及资源分配的在线优化方法。
AI.method: 提出串联队列（tandem-queue）转换机制连接推理请求与训练数据；将数据新鲜度（data freshness）和模型新鲜度（model freshness）纳入准确率建模；将联合优化问题建模为多目标马尔可夫决策过程（MOMDP），并提出约束多目标近端策略优化（C-MOPPO）算法，先学习不同偏好下的策略集，再通过约束策略优化丰富Pareto前沿。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，C-MOPPO能够在不同系统配置下实现多个目标之间良好的权衡，显著优于基线方法，并获得高质量、密集的Pareto解集。
AI.conclusion: 本文所提出的在线优化框架和C-MOPPO算法有效解决了FEEL场景下联合训练与推理的资源分配难题，为资源受限边缘设备上的智能服务部署提供了可行方案。

title: Addressing Exacerbated Attention Sink for Source-Free Cross-Domain Few-Shot Learning
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) like CLIP have shown impressive generalization capabilities, yet their potential for Cross-Domain Few-Shot Learning (CDFSL) remains underexplored, where the model needs to transfer source-domain information to target domains with scarce training data. While the attention sink phenomenon has been observed in VLMs for certain tasks, its role in CDFSL scenarios has not been studied. In this paper, we uncover a critical issue overlooked by prior works: standard target-domain few-shot fine-tuning in CDFSL significantly exacerbates the attention sink problem, leading to poor discriminability across classes. To understand this phenomenon, through extensive experiments, we interpret it as the model's shortcut learning for domain adaptation: to overcome the huge domain gap between the source and target domains, the model shows a high tendency to push tokens that are initially closer to target-domain classes (i.e., simple tokens) to be even closer to these classes, exacerbating the attention sink and wasting the capability of learning other discriminative but initially further tokens (i.e., hard tokens). To address this, we propose a novel approach to dynamically re-weight tokens according to their relevance with target-domain classes during the target-domain finetuning, which explicitly suppresses the model's reliance on these simple tokens and enhances the learning of hard tokens, reducing sink tokens and enhancing discriminability. Extensive experiments on four benchmark datasets validate the rationale of our method, demonstrating new state-of-the-art performance. Our codes are available at https://github.com/shuaiyi308/TIR.

AI.tldr: 本文发现跨域少样本学习中，标准微调会加剧注意力沉没问题（模型过度依赖与目标域类别相近的简单token，忽略有判别性的难token），并提出动态token重加权方法（TIR）来抑制简单token、增强难token学习，在四个基准数据集上达到SOTA。
AI.motivation: CLIP等视觉语言模型在跨域少样本学习（CDFSL）中的潜力尚未充分探索，且标准目标域微调会严重加剧注意力沉没（attention sink）问题，损害类间判别性。现有工作未关注这一现象。
AI.method: 提出TIR方法：在目标域微调过程中，根据token与目标域类别的相关性动态重新加权token，显式抑制简单token（简单token）的依赖，增强难token（难token）的学习，从而减少沉没问题、提升判别性。
AI.result: 在四个基准数据集上的大量实验验证了方法的合理性，取得了新的最先进性能。
AI.conclusion: 注意力沉没在CDFSL中被标准微调加剧，本质上是模型为克服域差距采取的捷径学习（偏向简单token）。所提动态重加权方法有效缓解该问题，提升跨域少样本学习性能。

title: Quantitative Evaluation of the Severity of Posttraumatic Stress Disorder through Transfer Learning from Specific Phobia Data
comment: Submitted to a peer-reviewed journal, comments welcome
summary: Posttraumatic stress disorder (PTSD) is a prevalent and debilitating mental health condition with significant personal and societal impacts. Current clinical assessments of PTSD often rely on subjective evaluations, which can be time-consuming, costly, and prone to human bias. This study proposes a machine learning (ML) approach based on multivariate kernel density estimation (MKDE) technique for the objective evaluation of PTSD severity. We collected heart rate (HR) and galvanic skin response (GSR) signals as well as PTSD Checklist - Military Version (PCL-M) labels from 21 participants during an immersive simulation. A fear-response model was trained on a public arachnophobia dataset, and predictive features of PTSD were extracted from the fear-response curves estimated on the military dataset. The model achieved an accuracy of 86\% in classifying PTSD status, effectively distinguishing participants with and without PTSD (PCL-M threshold of 36). The average mean absolute error (MAE) of the models is 5.6, and it estimated a clinical PTSD severity scale with a mean absolute percentage error of 17\%. Our algorithm demonstrates promising potential for enhancing estimation of PTSD severity and followup by offering an objective and low-effort evaluation approach using physiology. These findings suggest clinical utility in both screening and follow-up settings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于多元核密度估计（MKDE）的机器学习方法，通过心率和皮电反应信号客观评估PTSD严重程度，在21名军事人员数据上实现了86%的分类准确率和5.6的平均绝对误差。
AI.motivation: 当前PTSD临床评估依赖主观评价，耗时、成本高且易受人为偏差影响，缺乏客观、低负担的评估手段。
AI.method: 采用MKDE技术分析心率和皮电反应信号；利用公共蜘蛛恐惧症数据集训练恐惧反应模型；从军事数据集的恐惧反应曲线中提取PTSD预测特征；使用PCL-M标签进行监督学习。
AI.result: PTSD状态分类准确率为86%（PCL-M阈值36）；模型平均绝对误差（MAE）为5.6；临床PTSD严重度估计的平均绝对百分比误差为17%。
AI.conclusion: 该算法通过生理信号提供客观、低负担的PTSD严重度评估，在筛查和随访中具有临床应用潜力。

title: PixelWizard: Towards Efficient High-Fidelity Video Generation at Ultra-Large Spatial Resolution
summary: High-resolution video generation faces a coupled bottleneck of optimization instability and prohibitive computational costs. The massive expansion of the token sequence not only biases optimization toward local textures at the expense of global coherence, leading to structural collapse, but also imposes prohibitive training costs and severe inference latency. To address this, we propose PixelWizard, a framework that hierarchically decouples global structure modeling from fine-grained detail synthesis. PixelWizard first establishes a compact spatiotemporal anchor to concentrate dense structural priors, which then guides fine-grained generation at high resolution. This mitigates the local optimization bias to ensure structural stability without compromising high-frequency details. Leveraging this structural stability, we introduce Noise-Span Aligned Shortcut Training to break the inference bottleneck. By explicitly modeling the step size, this mechanism allows the model to traverse the generation trajectory with large steps. Crucially, we incorporate Exponential Index-Biased Sampling and Adaptive Noise-Span Calibration to align optimization with the shifted noise schedules of high-resolution grids, ensuring robust few-step inference without incurring the heavy overhead of distillation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that PixelWizard achieves superior visual quality while accelerating the generative sampling of native 2K/4K videos by over 10x.

AI.tldr: PixelWizard通过层次化解耦全局结构与细节合成、噪声跨度对齐捷径训练等技术，在保持结构稳定性的同时将原生2K/4K视频生成速度提升10倍以上。
AI.motivation: 高分辨率视频生成面临两个耦合瓶颈：优化不稳定性和高昂计算成本。长token序列导致优化偏向局部纹理而牺牲全局连贯性，造成结构崩溃，同时带来高昂训练成本和推理延迟。
AI.method: 1) 层次化解耦框架：先建立紧凑的时空锚点（spatiotemporal anchor）集中结构先验，再引导高分辨率细粒度生成；2) 噪声跨度对齐捷径训练（Noise-Span Aligned Shortcut Training）：显式建模步长，使模型能以大步长遍历生成轨迹；3) 指数索引偏置采样（Exponential Index-Biased Sampling）和自适应噪声跨度校准（Adaptive Noise-Span Calibration）：对齐高分辨率网格位移后的噪声调度，实现鲁棒的少步推理。
AI.result: PixelWizard在保持优越视觉质量的同时，将原生2K/4K视频的生成采样速度提升了10倍以上。
AI.conclusion: 通过层次化结构-细节解耦和噪声跨度对齐的捷径训练，有效解决了高分辨率视频生成中的优化偏差和计算瓶颈问题，实现了高质量与高效率的统一。

title: From Latent Space to Training Data: Explainable Specialization in Minimal MLPs
summary: We here study whether training biases can make hidden neurons specialize in minimal one-hidden-layer MLPs, and whether such specialization improves prototype-based reconstruction of the training dataset from the learned weights. We consider Gaussianactivation MLPs of width equal to dataset size and compare three structural losses that respectively encourage coverage of the training samples, separation between neuron-induced prototypes, and low overlap of hidden responses, against the standard fitting baseline. Experiments on uniformly sampled one-dimensional datasets show a stable pattern from N = 3 to N = 100 across 480 controlled runs. Coverage regularization gives the lowest mean reconstruction error at every tested size and raises the prototype-usage specialization ratio relative to the standard baseline, while separation has mixed effects and overlap penalties are systematically harmful. We show that the harm is not an optimization failure: overlap-active approaches fit the data as well as overlap-free ones but route the optimizer to a degenerate equilibrium in which prototype centers are pushed outside the convex hull of the training inputs. Coverage cannot reward this expulsion and acts as an attractor: separation admits it only at large temperature and overlap admits it at the nominal hyperparameter choice. A direct τ-sweep on the separation-only mask and a prototype-position visualization at N = 100 confirm the mechanism. The findings yield a simple design principle for prototype-recoverability-aware training: every repulsive structural loss must be compensated by a compatible attractor, or it will collapse the latent geometry it was meant to refine.

AI.tldr: 研究单隐层MLP中隐藏神经元是否通过训练偏置实现特化，以及这种特化能否改进基于原型的训练集权重重建。实验发现覆盖正则化能提升原型使用特化比并降低重建误差，而分离和重叠惩罚效果不佳甚至有害，原因是后者会将原型中心推出训练输入凸包，形成退化均衡。结论是：任何排斥性结构损失必须搭配相容的吸引子，否则会破坏潜在几何结构。
AI.motivation: 探究训练偏置能否使隐藏神经元特化，以及这种特化是否有助于从学习权重中基于原型重建训练数据集。
AI.method: 使用高斯激活的MLP（宽度等于数据集大小），对比三种结构损失（覆盖、分离、低重叠）与标准拟合基线，在1D均匀采样数据集上进行N=3到N=100共480次受控实验。
AI.result: 覆盖正则化在所有规模下取得最低平均重建误差，并提升原型使用特化比；分离效果混合；重叠惩罚有害。有害并非优化失败，而是将原型中心推出训练输入凸包形成退化均衡。
AI.conclusion: 每个排斥性结构损失必须由相容的吸引子补偿，否则会破坏其本应改善的潜在几何结构。

title: Rethinking VLM Representation for VLA Initialization
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models widely adopt pretrained Vision-Language Models (VLMs) as policy backbones, yet it remains unclear what kind of pretrained VLM representation is useful as a VLA initialization. In this paper, we study VLA initialization as a controlled representation-design problem along three axes: capability-level embodied VQA supervision, parameter-update strategy, and robot-data pretraining. Our experiments show that the original pretrained VLM representation is a key source of action performance. However, embodied VQA adaptation does not yield uniform gains: its benefit depends on downstream bottlenecks, and gains from different capability domains are not simply additive. For update strategy, LoRA provides a more reliable initialization than Full Finetune, indicating that overly reshaping the pretrained representation can weaken VLA initialization. Robot-data pretraining further improves VLA initialization, with the strongest variant obtained by staged LoRA-based training. Together, these findings suggest that effective VLM-to-VLA adaptation should inject action-relevant embodied and robot-trajectory signals while preserving the pretrained VLM representation that remains useful for action learning.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了VLA初始化中预训练VLM表示的有效性，发现原始VLM表示是动作性能的关键；具身VQA适应效果非均匀且不简单叠加；LoRA比全微调提供更可靠的初始化；机器人数据预训练进一步改善性能，最优变体是分阶段LoRA训练。结论指出VLM到VLA的适应应注入动作相关的具身和轨迹信号，同时保留对动作学习有用的预训练VLM表示。
AI.motivation: 尽管VLA模型广泛采用预训练VLM作为策略骨干，但何种VLM表示对VLA初始化有用尚不明确，本文旨在通过控制表示设计的三轴（具身VQA监督、参数更新策略、机器人数据预训练）来系统研究这一问题。
AI.method: 将VLA初始化作为受控表示设计问题，沿着三个轴进行实验：(1) 能力级别具身VQA监督；(2) 参数更新策略（LoRA vs 全微调）；(3) 机器人数据预训练。通过对比不同设置下的动作性能来评估各因素的影响。
AI.result: (1) 原始预训练VLM表示是动作性能的关键来源；(2) 具身VQA适应的收益取决于下游瓶颈，且不同能力域的增益非简单叠加；(3) LoRA提供比全微调更可靠的初始化，过度重塑预训练表示会削弱VLA初始化；(4) 机器人数据预训练进一步提升VLA初始化，分阶段LoRA训练是最强变体。
AI.conclusion: 有效的VLM到VLA适配应注入动作相关的具身和机器人轨迹信号，同时保留对动作学习有用的预训练VLM表示。

title: STaT: Resolving Shape Distortion in Non-Stationary Time Series via Tri-Modal Synergy
summary: Recent research in time series forecasting frequently investigates the integration of textual and visual modalities with numerical models to better navigate non-stationary environments. Despite delivering solid numerical results, existing multi-modal approaches usually encounter a dilemma: prioritizing the minimization of average errors can result in excessively smooth forecasts that overlook essential fluctuations. To resolve this limitation, we introduce STaT, an innovative multimodal architecture for Symbolic-Temporal-Textual Alignment, which seamlessly unites three synergistic modalities. Specifically, the symbolic modality converts continuous time series into discrete tokens, facilitating the accurate identification of structural patterns and turning points; the temporal modality extracts inherent sequential dependencies; and the textual modality leverages domain semantics to steer the macroscopic forecasting trends. Comprehensive evaluations on eight real-world benchmarks indicate that STaT delivers exceptional performance, enhancing conventional magnitude indicators by up to 8.9% while simultaneously decreasing shape distortion by up to 8.5%.

AI.tldr: STaT是一种新颖的多模态时间序列预测框架，通过符号-时间-文本三重模态对齐，在平均误差和形状保真度之间取得更好平衡，在八个基准测试上实现了高达8.9%的幅度指标提升和8.5%的形状失真降低。
AI.motivation: 现有时间序列预测中的多模态方法在最小化平均误差时往往产生过度平滑的预测，忽略了关键的波动和转折点，即平均误差最小化与形状保真度之间存在矛盾。
AI.method: 提出STaT架构，包含三种协同模态：符号模态将连续时间序列离散化为符号标记以识别结构性模式和转折点；时间模态提取序列依赖关系；文本模态利用领域语义指导宏观预测趋势。通过三种模态的对齐实现联合预测。
AI.result: 在八个真实世界基准数据集上，STaT在传统幅度指标上提升高达8.9%，同时形状失真降低高达8.5%。
AI.conclusion: 多模态符号-时间-文本对齐策略能有效解决预测中平均误差与形状保真度的权衡问题，在保持数值精度的同时更好地捕捉时间序列的关键波动特征。

title: ATV-Net: Adaptive Triple-View Network with Dynamic Feature Fusion
summary: Recent semantic segmentation research has increasingly moved toward stronger context modeling, dense attention, and transformer-based architectures. Although these models achieve impressive performance, classical CNN-based segmentation pipelines remain attractive because of their simplicity, efficiency, and ease of implementation. This paper revisits a practical question: how far can a ResNet-based segmentation model be improved by only modifying the segmentation head? We propose ATV-Net, an Adaptive Triple-View Network that strengthens a ResNet-101 backbone using three simple but complementary receptive-field views. The micro view captures point-wise semantic responses, the local view models neighborhood structures and object boundaries, and the scout view provides enlarged contextual cues. Instead of fusing these views with fixed weights, ATV-Net introduces an Adaptive Decision Gate that dynamically selects receptive-field responses according to input scene characteristics. A compact global coordination layer is further applied to improve spatial and semantic consistency. Experiments on the Cityscapes validation set show that ATV-Net achieves 80.31\% mIoU. This result suggests that classical CNN-based segmentation is still far from obsolete: with simple receptive-field views and adaptive fusion, a ResNet-based pipeline can reach a competitive accuracy level without relying on transformer-style global attention or overly complex context modules.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ATV-Net，通过仅在分割头引入三种互补感受野视图（微观、局部、侦察）和自适应决策门，将ResNet-101在Cityscapes上的mIoU提升至80.31%，证明经典CNN分割管线仍有竞争力。
AI.motivation: 探索仅通过修改分割头（不改变骨干网络）能多大程度提升ResNet分割模型的性能，挑战当前过度依赖Transformer和复杂注意力机制的趋势。
AI.method: 基于ResNet-101骨干，设计三种互补感受野视图：微观视图捕捉逐点语义、局部视图建模邻域结构和边界、侦察视图提供扩大上下文线索；通过自适应决策门动态选择感受野响应，并用全局协调层增强空间和语义一致性。
AI.result: 在Cityscapes验证集上达到80.31% mIoU。
AI.conclusion: 经典CNN分割管线通过简单的感受野视图设计和自适应融合，无需Transformer式全局注意力或过复杂的上下文模块，仍能达到有竞争力的精度。

title: Small Models, Strong Priors: Architectural Inductive Bias for Parameter-Efficient Neural PDE Solvers
summary: Neural PDE solvers have followed the scaling trajectory of vision and language, with recent foundation models reaching billions of parameters. We argue that scale is a poor substitute for architectural inductive bias in this domain: structured priors deliver outsized parameter efficiency, and the pattern of where they succeed and fail is itself informative about what they capture. We instantiate this argument in WaveLiT, an architecture combining a discrete wavelet transform for lossless multi-resolution tokenization, an augmented linear attention block, a shared-weight multiscale feature pyramid, and a wavelet-domain auxiliary loss. Bespoke 1-10M-parameter WaveLiT models compete with foundation models of 100-1000$\times$ their size across eight TheWell benchmarks, with the largest gains on wave and acoustic-dominated benchmarks where the wavelet-multiscale prior fits the dominant dynamical structure and small per-step errors do not compound geometrically under rollout. Trained jointly across all eight benchmarks, a 10M-parameter foundation variant exhibits a structured, physically interpretable transfer pattern -- strongest where the wavelet-multiscale prior matches the dynamics, weakest on chaotic advection-dominated flows. The entire pipeline trains on a single GPU. The results suggest that small-model PDE performance is shaped by architectural inductive bias rather than scale, and that the structure of a prior's failures is a useful empirical signal about its content.

AI.tldr: 本文提出WaveLiT架构，通过离散小波变换、线性注意力、多尺度特征金字塔和小波域辅助损失等结构先验，仅用1-10M参数即可在8个TheWell基准上匹敌100-1000倍规模的Foundation模型，表明在神经PDE求解器中结构偏置比规模更重要。
AI.motivation: 当前神经PDE求解器沿袭视觉和语言领域的扩展路径，模型规模已达数十亿参数。作者认为在该领域，规模是架构偏置的差劲替代品，结构化先验能带来更高的参数效率，且其成功与失败的模式本身就能揭示先验捕获的内容。
AI.method: WaveLiT架构包含：(1)离散小波变换实现无损多分辨率分词；(2)增强线性注意力模块；(3)共享权重的多尺度特征金字塔；(4)小波域辅助损失。模型规模在1M-10M参数范围内。
AI.result: (1) 1-10M参数的WaveLiT在8个TheWell基准上匹敌100-1000倍大小的Foundation模型；(2) 在波和声学主导的基准上增益最大，因小波-多尺度先验与动力结构匹配，且小步误差在展开中不会几何级放大；(3) 10M参数的Foundation变体在8个基准联合训练下展现出结构化、可物理解释的迁移模式：先验匹配动力学的区域最强，混沌平流主导流最弱。(4) 整个流程在单GPU上训练。
AI.conclusion: 小模型在PDE任务中的性能由架构偏置而非规模决定，先验失效的结构本身即是关于其内容的有效经验信号。

title: Event-to-Video Reconstruction using Spatio-Temporal and Frequency-Enhanced Deep Neural Networks
summary: Event cameras offer significant advantages over conventional frame-based counterparts, including high temporal resolution, low latency, and energy efficiency. These characteristics make them suitable for high-speed and high-dynamic range scene acquisition scenarios; however, the lack of dense intensity frames limits the direct applicability of conventional computer vision methods for scene understanding. Event-to-video (E2V) reconstruction seeks to bridge this gap by converting asynchronous event streams into a sequence of synchronous video frames. Existing E2V reconstruction methods based on convolutional neural networks and transformers operate primarily in the spatial domain and often struggle to recover fine structural details while suppressing severe reconstruction artifacts. To address these issues, we propose MSFET-E2V, a novel multiscale frequency-enhanced transformer model. At its core lies a cross-domain attention module, which fuses spatio-temporal features with frequency-aware representations derived from the discrete wavelet transform. Unlike prior methods relying solely on spatial attention, our approach effectively captures both local and global structures by taking into account low- and high-frequency components, enhancing detail preservation and robustness across various motion scenarios. Furthermore, we propose a lightweight wavelet-enhanced skip block that serves as a skip connection, facilitating artifact suppression and structural detail refinement through joint spatial-frequency domain processing. Extensive experiments demonstrate that MSFET-E2V achieves superior performance over state-of-the-art methods on multiple real-world event datasets, offering significant gains in reconstruction quality. Moreover, compared to the existing transformer-based method, our proposed model significantly reduces the number of parameters, the GPU memory usage, and inference time.

AI.tldr: 提出MSFET-E2V模型，利用跨域注意力模块融合时空特征与小波变换频率特征，通过轻量级小波增强跳跃块抑制伪影并细化结构细节，在多个真实事件数据集上达到SOTA性能，同时显著降低参数量、显存占用和推理时间。
AI.motivation: 事件相机生成的非同步事件流缺乏密集强度帧，现有基于CNN和Transformer的E2V重建方法主要在空间域操作，难以恢复精细结构细节并抑制严重重建伪影。
AI.method: 提出MSFET-E2V模型，核心是跨域注意力模块（融合时空特征与离散小波变换的频率感知表示），以及轻量级小波增强跳跃块（通过联合空间-频率域处理实现伪影抑制和结构细节细化）。
AI.result: 在多个真实世界事件数据集上优于SOTA方法，且相比现有基于Transformer的方法，显著减少了参数量、GPU内存使用和推理时间。
AI.conclusion: MSFET-E2V通过频率增强的跨域注意力机制有效结合空间-频率信息，在重建质量和计算效率上均取得显著提升。

title: Step-TP: A Grounded, Step-Level Dataset with Chain-of-Thought Reasoning for LLM-Guided Tensor Program Optimization
summary: Despite the strong reasoning capabilities of large language models (LLMs), optimizing the execution efficiency of tensor programs remains challenging due to the need for precise, composable transformation decisions. Recent LLM-guided approaches frame tensor program optimization as an iterative decision process, but existing datasets provide only end-to-end optimized program pairs using token-inefficient representations, lacking verifiable step-level supervision and interpretability. As a result, LLMs struggle to make reliable single-step decisions in large combinatorial optimization spaces. We introduce Step-TP, a post-training dataset for tensor program optimization that provides grounded, atomic, step-level supervision with structured chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning. Step-TP forms a closed reasoning loop over intermediate program states, enabling reliable multi-step optimization rather than outcome imitation. Its design is guided by four principles: (i) a token-efficient, verifiable intermediate representation (IR) that deterministically lowers to TVM TIR; (ii) atomic and composable optimization strategies that decompose complex trajectories into interpretable single-step decisions; (iii) structured CoT supervision coupled with explicit IR-to-IR state transitions; and (iv) strategy filtering to balance coverage while preventing shortcut exploitation.
