The dataset and implementation are available at a GitHub link, https://github.com/LIUMENGFAN-gif/StepTP.

AI.tldr: 提出Step-TP数据集，通过结构化思维链和原子化单步决策监督，为张量程序优化提供可验证、可解释的逐步推理训练数据，解决LLM在组合优化空间中单步决策不可靠的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有张量程序优化数据集仅提供端到端的优化程序对，使用token效率低下的表示方式，缺乏可验证的步骤级监督和可解释性，导致LLM在大型组合优化空间中难以做出可靠的单步决策。
AI.method: Step-TP的设计遵循四项原则：(i) token高效且可验证的中间表示(IR)，可确定性地降级到TVM TIR；(ii) 原子化且可组合的优化策略，将复杂轨迹分解为可解释的单步决策；(iii) 结构化CoT监督配合显式的IR到IR状态转换；(iv) 策略过滤以平衡覆盖率并防止捷径利用。形成对中间程序状态的闭合推理循环。
AI.result: 构建了一个提供接地气的、原子化的、步骤级监督的结构化思维链推理数据集，支持可靠的多步优化而非结果模仿。
AI.conclusion: Step-TP通过结构化的逐步监督和可验证的中间表示，能够使LLM在张量程序优化中做出更可靠的单步决策，实现可解释的多步优化。

title: An Analysis Focused on Womens Safety: Can VAD Models Be Enhanced by a Multi-modal Dataset?
summary: Women's safety and security are paramount for a modern society. Crimes against women occur in daylight as well as in low-light conditions. Often, such events are captured through real-world surveillance cameras that operate at lower resolutions. Despite substantial progress in CV-related research, video anomaly detection (VAD) focused on women's safety has not yet been adequately addressed. Existing video anomaly datasets contain well-lit, high-resolution, close-shot videos, and fail to represent women-centric anomalies such as chain snatching, stalking, inappropriate touch, and other subtle forms of crime against women. To address these problems, we propose the ExtrAnom dataset, a new multi-modal benchmark containing 1001 videos with textual descriptions, 500 normal and 501 anomalous, classified into 5 different types of women-centric crimes. The dataset comprises low-light (8%), low-resolution videos (13%), long-shot (15%), along with daylight (64%) anomalous videos. And it covers anomalous events like stalking (3.9%), chain snatching (17.6%), kidnapping (7.3%), assassinations (2.3%), harassment (18.9%), and normal (50%). Each video is supplemented with 4 textual annotations, including one human-generated and three LLM-generated descriptions, enabling cross-modal and VLM-based validations. The aim of creating a women-centric dataset is to accurately detect the women-centric anomaly patterns, which are possible to observe visually. The dataset supplements the VLMs to accurately generate video-level descriptions. ExtrAnom has been benchmarked against popular unimodal and multi-modal VAD datasets (e.g., XD-Violence, UCF-Crime, and UCA) and SOTA methods. Experiments reveal that the existing datasets are insufficient to train models for detecting women-centric anomalies.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ExtrAnom数据集，一个包含1001个视频的女性安全异常检测多模态基准数据集，涵盖低光照、低分辨率等复杂场景下的5类女性犯罪异常事件，并附有文本描述，弥补了现有数据集在女性中心异常检测方面的不足。
AI.motivation: 现有视频异常检测数据集缺乏针对女性安全的异常事件（如抢项链、跟踪、骚扰等），且多为高分辨率、光线充足、近景视频，无法有效表征真实场景下的女性中心犯罪模式。
AI.method: 构建ExtrAnom多模态数据集：包含1001个视频（500正常+501异常），覆盖5类女性犯罪；包含低光照(8%)、低分辨率(13%)、长镜头(15%)和日光(64%)场景；每个视频配4条文本描述（1条人工+3条LLM生成），支持跨模态和VLM验证。
AI.result: 在ExtrAnom上对现有主流单模态和多模态VAD方法进行基准测试，实验表明现有数据集（XD-Violence、UCF-Crime、UCA等）不足以训练模型检测女性中心异常。
AI.conclusion: ExtrAnom填补了女性安全视频异常检测领域的空白，为视觉语言模型提供了更真实、多样化的训练数据，有助于提升对女性犯罪的检测能力。

title: Mapping the Schedule x Bit-Width Boundary in Sub-100M Quantisation-Aware Training
comment: 20 pages, 6 figures, 4 tables. 1345 training runs total (720 + 625). Submitted for review at TMLR
summary: We test whether the optimal learning-rate schedule depends on bit-width during from-initialisation quantisation-aware training (QAT) for sub-100M decoder language models. A 720-run factorial grid (Phase 2) over bit-width x warmdown fraction x LR magnitude x model size x seed (FP16/INT8/INT6, 15M-100M, 5 seeds) finds the optimal warmdown is 33% at every (bit-width, size) cell. The primary hypothesis -- that INT6 QAT requires a different schedule than higher-precision training -- is falsified at FP16/INT8/INT6. A 625-run follow-up (Phase 5) probes the null along five axes: optimiser (AdamW), schedule shape (cosine), training length (up to 9x more iterations), an extended size sweep (5M-350M), and an INT4 sweep from 3M to 100M. The null is robust under all three setup changes. The INT6 penalty follows a log-linear scaling law whose fit on Phase 2 predicts the five held-out Phase 5 sizes (5M, 8M, 175M, 250M, 350M) within their 95% prediction intervals (5/5). For INT4 the picture is sharper than the higher precisions: at 50M and 100M, wd33 is decisively optimal (paired z ~ 12-15, 10/10 seeds); below 50M, across the six tested sizes from 3M to 30M, no individual size shows a statistically significant schedule preference and the per-size mean penalty oscillates within seed-level noise. The boundary is therefore a transition between a noise-dominated regime below 50M and a decisive wd33 regime at and above 50M, not a clean wd10 region. A weight-to-grid-distance probe falsifies the simplest mechanism for the FP16/INT8/INT6 null result (rapid grid-snapping): pre-warmdown, INT6-QAT weights sit at essentially the same distance from the INT6 grid as FP16 weights (ratio ~ 1.04). Practical recommendation: at sub-100M scale, tune the LR schedule once at FP16 and apply unchanged to INT8/INT6 QAT; for INT4 at 50M+ use wd33; for INT4 below 50M the schedule choice is in the noise.

AI.tldr: 本文通过大规模实验（720+625次运行）发现，在子1亿参数解码器语言模型的量化感知训练中，最优学习率调度（warmdown fraction=33%）在不同精度（FP16/INT8/INT6）下保持一致，否定了INT6需要不同调度策略的假设；INT4在50M以上同样适用wd33，50M以下则处于噪声主导区。
AI.motivation: 验证量化感知训练中，最优学习率调度是否依赖于位宽（bit-width），尤其是低精度（INT6/INT4）是否需要不同于高精度训练的调度策略。
AI.method: 设计了两个大规模实验：Phase 2（720次运行）在bit-width×warmdown fraction×LR magnitude×model size×seed的因子上进行网格搜索；Phase 5（625次运行）沿优化器、调度形状、训练长度、规模范围、INT4五个轴检验原假设。使用权重到网格距离探针分析机制。
AI.result: FP16/INT8/INT6下最优warmdown均为33%；INT6惩罚遵循对数线性标度律，可准确预测5个未见过规模；INT4在50M以上wd33显著最优（paired z~12-15），50M以下无统计显著偏好；权重到网格距离探针显示INT6权重与FP16权重在预热阶段距网格距离相近（比率~1.04）。
AI.conclusion: 子1亿参数规模下，最优调度策略在高精度和INT6间可迁移（FP16调优后直接用于INT8/INT6 QAT）；INT4在50M以上推荐wd33，50M以下调度选择处于噪声中无需特别调整。

title: Data-driven Head Motion Generation through Natural Gaze-Head Coordination
summary: We present the first data-driven approach to model temporal gaze-head coordination from large-scale in-the-wild facial videos. To obtain training data for generalizable learning, we propose an automatic pipeline that extracts natural yet diverse gaze and head motions with off-the-shelf appearance-based gaze estimators. To capture the probabilistic correlation and temporal dynamics of gaze-head coordination, we build our model on a generative conditional Variational Autoencoder for plausible yet diverse gaze-conditioned head motion generations. We further apply our framework to gaze-controlled facial video generation, where we enable video generation with natural and realistic head motion correlated to the input gaze - an aspect that has not been emphasized before. Human evaluation and quantitative comparisons demonstrate our method's effectiveness and validate our design choices, with evaluators showing statistically significant preference for our approach over baseline methods.

AI.tldr: 提出首个数据驱动的注视-头部协调建模方法，利用大规模野外面部视频，通过条件变分自编码器生成与注视相关的自然头部运动，并应用于注视控制的面部视频生成。
AI.motivation: 现有方法未充分建模注视与头部运动之间的时间动态和概率相关性，本文旨在利用大规模数据驱动方法解决这一问题。
AI.method: 1) 自动化流水线从野外视频中提取自然注视和头部运动；2) 基于条件变分自编码器（CVAE）生成式建模注视-头部协调的概率相关性和时间动态；3) 将框架应用于注视控制的面部视频生成。
AI.result: 人类评估和定量比较均表明方法优于基线方法，评估者对本文方法有统计学显著的偏好。
AI.conclusion: 数据驱动的注视-头部协调建模是有效的，生成的面部视频中头部运动与注视输入自然相关，弥补了该领域先前未被强调的方面。

title: Hidden in Plain Tokens: Simply Robust, Gradient-Free Watermark for Synthetic Audio
summary: As policy catches up with the capabilities of generative AI, watermarking is central to content provenance efforts. Inference-time watermarks for autoregressive models are unfit for continuous modalities due to discretization inconsistencies. Existing methods overcome this by finetuning the modality tokenizers, nullifying the watermark's training-free advantage. In this work, motivated by the vocabulary redundancy of discretization, we propose an elegant solution for powerful and robust watermarking of synthetic audio. We theoretically analyze the impact of token errors on watermark detection, and effectively mitigate them using a reduced vocabulary obtained via community detection. Thorough experiments showcase that our gradient-free method can boost detectability by several orders of magnitude, while also achieving built-in robustness to audio modifications. Broadly, we discover a new state-of-the-art for token-level watermarks in multimedia, which simply arises from the nature of discrete representation learning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种无需微调、基于社区检测缩减词汇表的音频水印方法，通过理论分析令牌错误对检测的影响，实现了数量级可检测性提升和内置鲁棒性，在多媒体令牌级水印中达到新最优水平。
AI.motivation: 现有推理时水印方法因离散化不一致性不适用于连续模态，而微调分词器的方法又丧失了无需训练的优势。本文旨在解决这两难困境，提出一种无需梯度微调即可实现强大且鲁棒的合成音频水印方案。
AI.method: 利用离散化过程中词汇表的冗余性，通过社区检测缩减词汇表来有效缓解令牌错误对水印检测的影响。该方法无需梯度微调，直接在令牌层面进行操作。
AI.result: 该方法将水印可检测性提升了数个数量级，同时具备对音频修改的内置鲁棒性，在多媒体令牌级水印中达到新最优水平。
AI.conclusion: 本文发现了一种新的多媒体令牌级水印最优方法，其成功源于离散表示学习的本质特性，为生成式AI内容溯源提供了高效、鲁棒的解决方案。

title: [CLS] is Not Enough: Multi-Label Recognition via Patch-Level Inference and Adaptive Aggregation
summary: Vision-Language Models such as CLIP exhibit strong zero-shot recognition capability by aligning images with textual concepts, yet they often underperform on multi-label recognition where multiple objects co-exist. A key bottleneck is that the [CLS] token, as a single global visual representation, is insufficient to faithfully encode diverse targets with varying scales, contexts, and co-occurrence patterns. To address this limitation, we present a new multi-label image recognition framework, termed PIAA, which formulates prediction as Patch-level Inference followed by Adaptive Aggregation. Specifically, we first enhance patch-wise predictions from two complementary perspectives: (i) mitigating semantic entanglement in the visual encoder to obtain more discriminative patch representations, and (ii) learning an unsupervised visual classifier to narrow the vision-language modality gap. We then introduce an adaptive aggregation module that consolidates patch-level scores into the final multi-label prediction. Notably, the entire pipeline is fully training-free, requiring no gradient updates or parameter fine-tuning. Experiments show that our method achieves strong improvements with minimal extra computation, exceeding a 6% mAP gain on the challenging NUS-WIDE benchmark over representative baselines. Code is available at https://github.com/akang-wang/PIAA.

AI.tldr: PIAA提出了一种无需训练的补丁级推理与自适应聚合框架，通过增强补丁级判别性表征和缩小视觉-语言模态差距，显著提升了多标签图像识别性能，在NUS-WIDE上实现超过6% mAP的提升。
AI.motivation: CLIP等视觉-语言模型在零样本识别中表现优异，但在多标签识别中表现不佳，其根本原因是单一的[CLS]全局表征无法充分编码多样化的目标（不同尺度、上下文和共现模式）。
AI.method: 提出PIAA框架，包含两个关键组件：(1) 从两个互补视角增强补丁级预测——缓解视觉编码器中的语义纠缠以获得更具判别性的补丁表征，以及学习无监督视觉分类器以缩小视觉-语言模态差距；(2) 引入自适应聚合模块，将补丁级分数整合为最终的多标签预测。整个流程无需训练（无梯度更新或参数微调）。
AI.result: 在NUS-WIDE基准上，相比代表性基线方法，PIAA实现了超过6% mAP的提升，且仅需极少的额外计算量。
AI.conclusion: PIAA通过免训练的补丁级推理与自适应聚合策略，有效解决了CLIP在多标签识别中的不足，验证了无需梯度更新即可显著提升多标签分类性能的可行性。

title: Fuzzy PyTorch: Rapid Numerical Variability Evaluation for Deep Learning Models
comment: 19 pages, 8 figures, Published in Transactions on Machine Learning Research (01/2026)
summary: We introduce Fuzzy PyTorch, a framework for rapid evaluation of numerical variability in deep learning (DL) models. As DL is increasingly applied to diverse tasks, understanding variability from floating-point arithmetic is essential to ensure robust and reliable performance. Tools assessing such variability must be scalable, efficient, and integrate seamlessly with existing frameworks while minimizing code modifications. Fuzzy PyTorch enables this by integrating stochastic arithmetic into PyTorch through Probabilistic Rounding with Instruction Set Management, a novel library interfacing with Verificarlo, a numerical analysis compiler. The library offers stochastic rounding mode and a novel mode; up-down rounding. Comparative evaluations show Fuzzy PyTorch maintains model performance and achieves runtime reductions of 5x to 60x versus Verrou, a state-of-the-art tool. We further demonstrate scalability by running models from 1 to 341 million parameters, confirming applicability across small and large DL architectures. Overall, Fuzzy PyTorch provides an efficient, scalable, and practical solution for assessing numerical variability in deep learning, enabling researchers and practitioners to quantify and manage floating-point uncertainty without compromising performance or computational efficiency.

AI.tldr: Fuzzy PyTorch是一个集成随机算术到PyTorch的框架，通过概率舍入与指令集管理实现深度学习模型中浮点数值变异性的快速评估，比现有工具Verrou提速5-60倍，支持1到3.41亿参数模型。
AI.motivation: 随着深度学习应用于多样化的任务，理解浮点运算带来的数值变异性对确保模型稳健性和可靠性至关重要，亟需可扩展、高效且与现有框架无缝集成的评估工具。
AI.method: 将随机算术通过概率舍入与指令集管理（Probabilistic Rounding with Instruction Set Management）集成到PyTorch中，提出随机舍入模式和up-down舍入新模式，并利用Verificarlo数值分析编译器接口实现。
AI.result: Fuzzy PyTorch保持了模型性能，相比Verrou实现了5倍到60倍的运行时间降低；成功在1到3.41亿参数的模型上验证了可扩展性。
AI.conclusion: Fuzzy PyTorch提供了一个高效、可扩展且实用的深度学习数值变异性评估方案，使研究人员和从业者能够在不牺牲性能或计算效率的前提下量化和管理浮点不确定性。

title: SAM3-Assisted Training of Lightweight YOLO Models for Precision Pig Farming
comment: Accepted for publication at the IEEE Sensors Applications Symposium (SAS 2026)
summary: Deep learning-based object detection has revolutionized Precision Livestock Farming (PLF), yet a critical barrier remains: high-performance Foundation Models (such as SAM 3) are too computationally intensive for edge deployment, while lightweight models (like YOLO) require prohibitive manual annotation efforts. This work proposes a fully automated knowledge distillation pipeline that leverages the Segment Anything Model 3 (SAM 3) to generate zero-shot pseudo-labels for training efficient YOLOv8 detectors. By treating SAM 3 as an offline auto-annotator, we eliminate the manual labeling bottleneck, producing models capable of real-time inference on resource-constrained hardware. We systematically evaluate this approach on the PigLife dataset, comparing SAM 3-supervised models against human-annotated baselines. Results demonstrate that a SAM 3-trained YOLOv8m achieves a mean Average Precision (mAP) of 79.4% without human intervention, while reducing inference latency by approximately 200$\times$ compared to the teacher model. Furthermore, stratified analysis reveals that in low-occlusion scenarios, the automated pipeline achieves detection rates comparable to human benchmarks ($AP_{50} > 99\%$). These findings indicate that foundation models can serve as effective, zero-annotation-cost supervisors, enabling scalable edge computing solutions for smart agriculture.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种利用SAM 3零样本生成伪标签，自动蒸馏训练YOLOv8检测器的流水线，无需人工标注即可在边缘设备上实现实时目标检测，在PigLife数据集上达到79.4% mAP，推理速度比教师模型快约200倍。
AI.motivation: 现有深度学习目标检测方法在精准畜牧业中存在两难困境：高性能基础模型（如SAM 3）计算量过大无法边缘部署，而轻量级模型（如YOLO）又需要大量人工标注，成本高昂。
AI.method: 提出全自动知识蒸馏流水线：以SAM 3作为离线自动标注器生成零样本伪标签，用于训练高效YOLOv8检测器，无需任何人工干预。
AI.result: SAM 3训练的YOLOv8m在无需人工标注下达到79.4% mAP，推理延迟降低约200倍；低遮挡场景下AP50超过99%，接近人工标注水平。
AI.conclusion: 基础模型可以作为有效的零标注成本监督器，为智慧农业的可扩展边缘计算方案提供可行路径。

title: Deployment-complete benchmarking
comment: 33 pages, 5 figures, 1 table; supplementary tables and code available
summary: Benchmarks increasingly guide deployment, procurement and scientific screening, yet a score supports only the response it records, not necessarily the deployment action. We introduce deployment-complete benchmarking, which tests whether benchmark evidence determines a deployment action. A benchmark is complete for a claim exactly when the action is constant on each evidence fiber; mixed fibers expose missing deployment information, and completion curves quantify the evidence required to resolve ambiguity. In controlled response spaces, benchmark-channel conformal coverage of 94.98% transferred poorly to an unmeasured deployment channel (10.07%), whereas response-rank intervals achieved 94.91% coverage; even zero benchmark error certified only 45.4% of candidates at the largest residual size. Public audits revealed incompleteness, including 97.9% mixed Tox21 fibers and zero median certifiable fraction in main Matbench and JARVIS audits. In held-out replays, certify-then-acquire reduced false decisions from 1.19% to 0.027% in Tox21 and from 20.3% to 0.128% in JARVIS, while changing model choice and identifying deployment-relevant probes. Deployment-ready benchmarks should report evidence, supported actions, ambiguity and completion cost rather than scores alone.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"部署完备基准测试"概念，发现传统基准分数无法充分支持部署决策，通过证据纤维、混合纤维和完成曲线等工具量化歧义，实验表明标准覆盖率从94.98%骤降至10.07%，而响应秩区间法保持94.91%覆盖率，认证-再获取策略将错误决策率从20.3%降至0.128%。
AI.motivation: 现有基准仅记录响应分数，但无法确定该分数是否足以支持实际的部署行动，导致评分与部署决策之间存在信息鸿沟。
AI.method: 提出部署完备基准测试框架，包括证据纤维（evidence fiber）、混合纤维（mixed fiber）和完成曲线（completion curves）等工具；引入基准-通道共形覆盖率和响应秩区间等评估方法；设计认证-再获取（certify-then-acquire）策略。
AI.result: 基准-通道共形覆盖率从94.98%降至10.07%；响应秩区间法达到94.91%覆盖率；零基准错误仅能认证45.4%候选者；Tox21中97.9%为混合纤维；Matbench和JARVIS中认证分数中位数为零；认证-再获取策略将错误率从20.3%降至0.128%。
AI.conclusion: 基准应报告证据、支持行动、歧义和完成成本，而非仅报告分数，部署完备性是评估基准实际价值的关键维度。

title: MuNet: A Mutualistic Network for Joint 3D Human Mesh Recovery and 3D Clothed Human Reconstruction from Single Images
summary: 3D human mesh recovery and 3D clothed human reconstruction are inherently related, yet they have long been studied in isolation, thereby overlooking the potential gains of joint optimization. To overcome this limitation, we propose to address these two tasks within a unified framework, which allows their mutual dependencies to be effectively exploited. Building on this idea, we propose MuNet, a mutualistic network for joint 3D human mesh recovery and 3D clothed human reconstruction from single images. First, we adopt 2-manifold graphs as a unified representation for all 3D models, enabling consistent modeling across 3D human mesh recovery and clothed human reconstruction. Second, we design an end-to-end graph convolutional network that progressively deforms an initial graph into a 3D human mesh and refines it into a detailed 3D clothed human model. Third, we introduce a mutualistic mechanism that allows reciprocal interaction between the two tasks {during training}, where 3D human mesh recovery provides guidance for 3D clothed human reconstruction, and reconstruction feedback refines the 3D human mesh recovery. We extensively evaluate MuNet on six benchmark datasets for 3D human mesh recovery and 3D clothed human reconstruction, including Human3.6M, 3DPW, MPI-INF-3DHP, THuman2.0, CAPE, and RenderPeople. Experimental results demonstrate that MuNet achieves state-of-the-art performance on both tasks across all datasets. The code of MuNet is released for research purposes at https://github.com/starVisionTeam/MuNet.

AI.tldr: MuNet是一个统一的互惠网络，通过端到端图卷积网络和互惠机制，同时从单张图像中联合优化3D人体网格恢复和3D衣着人体重建，在六个基准数据集上均达到最优性能。
AI.motivation: 3D人体网格恢复和3D衣着人体重建本质相关但长期被孤立研究，忽略了两者联合优化的潜在收益。
AI.method: 1) 采用2-流形图作为统一表示；2) 设计端到端图卷积网络，从初始图逐步变形为人体网格并细化至衣着人体模型；3) 引入互惠机制，使两个任务在训练中相互指导与反馈。
AI.result: 在Human3.6M、3DPW、MPI-INF-3DHP、THuman2.0、CAPE、RenderPeople六个数据集上，两个任务均达到state-of-the-art性能。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的统一框架有效利用了任务间相互依赖关系，联合优化比孤立研究效果更优。

title: Causal methods for LLM development and evaluation
summary: Large language model (LLM) development is currently driven by large-scale empirical iteration over data mixtures, reward models, routing strategies, and evaluation pipelines. Here, we argue that many central questions in LLM development and evaluation are inherently causal: What is the effect of adding a data domain during pretraining? How do annotator preferences change when LLMs generate text in a different style? Should a prompt be routed to a larger or smaller model given inference cost constraints? In general, causal methods are well-suited to such settings where interventions change outcomes but, surprisingly, are underrepresented in LLM development. Our contribution is threefold: (1) We explain how causal methods can help develop modern LLM development and evaluation: LLM development relies heavily on logged data, which are often subject to confounding and distribution shifts; evaluation uses learned but potentially biased judges; and deployment environments are non-stationary. These conditions make purely predictive approaches fragile and create opportunities for principled identification and estimation methods from causal inference. (2) We further map opportunities for causal methods in the entire LLM development pipeline, including pretraining, alignment, routing, agentic workflows, and evaluation. (3) We discuss new research opportunities around leveraging causal methods for LLM development and evaluation. Overall, we argue that causal methods are potentially underutilized for the LLM development and evaluation pipeline, despite the fact that such methods can ensure a reliable and scientifically grounded design.

AI.tldr: 本文论证因果推断方法在大语言模型开发和评估中未被充分利用，并提出因果方法可在预训练数据混合、对齐、路由、评估等环节发挥重要作用，以解决混杂偏差、分布偏移、非平稳环境等挑战。
AI.motivation: 当前LLM开发依赖大规模经验性迭代，但许多核心问题本质上是因果性的（如添加某个数据域的效果、注释者偏好变化、路由策略等），而因果方法在这些场景中未被充分利用。
AI.method: 从三个层面展开：1) 解释因果方法为何适用于LLM开发与评估中的混杂、分布偏移、有偏评估者等问题；2) 映射因果方法在预训练、对齐、路由、智能体工作流和评估全流程中的应用机会；3) 讨论利用因果方法推进LLM开发的新研究方向。
AI.result: 识别出LLM开发与评估中存在大量可利用因果推断的场景，指出当前纯粹预测性方法的局限性，并提出因果方法可提供更可靠、更科学的设计基础。
AI.conclusion: 因果方法在LLM开发和评估管线中具有广泛的应用潜力，但当前未被充分利用，需要引起更多关注。

title: WBench: A Comprehensive Multi-turn Benchmark for Interactive Video World Model Evaluation
comment: Technical report of WBench. Homepage: https://meituan-longcat.github.io/WBench/
summary: Interactive world models are advancing rapidly, yet existing benchmarks cover only part of the required competencies, leaving no unified standard for systematic evaluation. To fill this gap, we introduce WBench, a comprehensive multi-turn benchmark for interactive world model evaluation along five dimensions, namely video quality, setting adherence, interaction adherence, consistency, and physics compliance. WBench contains 289 test cases and 1,058 interaction turns, where each case specifies a world setting and a multi-turn interaction sequence, covering diverse scenes, styles, subjects, and both first- and third-person perspectives, together with four interaction types, including navigation, subject action, event editing, and perspective switching. For navigation, WBench unifies text, 6-DoF pose, and discrete-action control, enabling evaluation of models with different native input interfaces. Evaluation uses 22 automatic sub-metrics that combine specialist vision models with large multimodal models, and all metrics are validated against human judgments. Across 20 state-of-the-art models, we find that no single model performs strongly across all dimensions. We provide detailed diagnostic insights into the characteristic strengths, weaknesses, and open challenges of each model. Code and data are available at https://github.com/meituan-longcat/WBench.

AI.tldr: WBench是一个用于评估交互式世界模型的多轮基准测试，包含289个测试用例和1058个交互轮次，从视频质量、场景遵从性、交互遵从性、一致性和物理合理性五个维度，使用22个自动子指标对20个模型进行评估，发现没有模型在所有维度上表现优异。
AI.motivation: 交互式世界模型发展迅速，但现有基准测试只覆盖部分能力，缺乏统一的系统评估标准。
AI.method: 构建包含289个测试用例和1058个交互轮次的WBench基准，覆盖多种场景、风格、主体以及第一/第三人称视角，包含导航、主体动作、事件编辑和视角切换四种交互类型，采用22个自动子指标（结合专业视觉模型和大规模多模态模型）进行评估，所有指标均经过人工验证。
AI.result: 在20个模型上的评估显示，没有单一模型在所有维度上表现优异，不同模型各有其优势、劣势和待解决的挑战。
AI.conclusion: WBench为交互式世界模型提供了全面的评估标准，并揭示了当前模型在不同能力维度上的差异和不足。

title: Learning in Low-Dimensional Subspaces: Orthogonal Bottlenecks for Reinforcement Learning
summary: Deep reinforcement learning (RL) agents commonly rely on high-dimensional neural representations, despite growing evidence that task-relevant value and policy structure may be intrinsically low-dimensional. In this work, we present a simple yet effective representation-level prior that inserts a fixed orthonormal projection to constrain encoder features to a low-dimensional subspace, requiring no auxiliary objectives, pretraining, or changes to the underlying RL algorithm. Under a linear realizability assumption, we prove that when the bottleneck dimension exceeds the intrinsic rank of the optimal value function in feature space, the bottleneck preserves expressivity and leaves the induced gradient dynamics unchanged up to an equivalent low-dimensional parameterization. Empirically, we find that across both single and multi-task benchmarks, baseline performance is either matched or improved once the bottleneck dimension exceeds a small task-dependent threshold; in many cases, value representations can be compressed to extremely low dimensions without loss, and the minimal sufficient dimension depends far more on environment complexity than encoder width. In addition, we analyze representation geometry and find that orthogonal bottlenecks stabilize feature norms and are associated with higher effective rank. Together, these results support a representation-space interpretation of the manifold hypothesis in reinforcement learning and position orthogonal bottlenecks as a lightweight, architecture-agnostic mechanism for shaping RL representations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种轻量级正交瓶颈表示先验方法，通过固定正交投影将编码器特征约束到低维子空间，在保持表达力的同时压缩深度强化学习中的价值表示，实验表明在单任务和多任务基准上性能无损或提升，且最小充分维度主要取决于环境复杂度。
AI.motivation: 深度强化学习智能体通常使用高维神经表示，但已有证据表明任务相关的价值和策略结构本质上是低维的，现有方法需要辅助目标、预训练或修改底层RL算法，缺乏简单有效的表示维度约束手段。
AI.method: 在编码器后插入固定正交投影矩阵，将特征约束到低维子空间；在线性可实现性假设下理论证明当瓶颈维度超过最优价值函数的本征秩时，瓶颈保持表达力且梯度动力学不变；在单任务和多任务基准上实证评估。
AI.result: 瓶颈维度超过小任务相关阈值时基线性能匹配或提升；价值表示可压缩至极低维度而无损失；最小充分维度主要取决于环境复杂度而非编码器宽度；正交瓶颈稳定特征范数并提升有效秩。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持强化学习中流形假设的表示空间解释，正交瓶颈是一种轻量级、架构无关的RL表示塑造机制。

title: DyCoRM: Dynamic Criterion-Aware Reward Modeling for Text-to-Image Generation
summary: With the continued advancement of text-to-image (T2I) generation, producing high-quality images is becoming increasingly attainable; consequently, user demands are shifting toward images that better satisfy their specific requirements. As reward models play an increasingly important role in assessing whether generated images align with user preference, this trend introduces an important challenge for reward modeling: rather than relying solely on static and general evaluation dimensions, reward models should account for the task-relevant and fine-grained criteria through which users assess whether generated images meet their specific requirements. To address this challenge, we propose DyCoRM, a dynamic, criterion-aware reward model that grounds task-relevant criteria and performs criterion-aware preference comparison. To support this setting, we construct DyCoDataset-20K, which provides dynamic criteria together with criterion-level annotations, and further derive DyCoBench-1K, a benchmark for systematically evaluating reward models under dynamic criteria. We further introduce DyCoPick, which applies criterion-aware reward modeling to selecting T2I images. Our contributions establish the first reward modeling framework for dynamic and fine-grained evaluation and practical application in T2I generation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DyCoRM，一个动态、标准感知的奖励模型，用于在文本到图像生成中根据用户特定的任务相关细粒度标准评估图像质量。同时构建了DyCoDataset-20K数据集和DyCoBench-1K基准，并引入DyCoPick方法进行标准感知的图像选择。
AI.motivation: 随着文本到图像生成质量的提升，用户需求转向更符合特定要求的图像。现有奖励模型仅依赖静态通用评价维度，无法满足用户基于任务相关和细粒度标准评估图像的需求。
AI.method: 提出DyCoRM框架，包括三个核心贡献：1) DyCoRM模型，能够理解任务相关标准并进行标准感知的偏好比较；2) DyCoDataset-20K数据集，提供动态标准及标准级标注；3) DyCoBench-1K基准，用于系统评估动态标准下的奖励模型。
AI.result: 建立了首个面向动态细粒度评估的奖励建模框架，并在T2I生成中验证了实际应用效果。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为T2I生成中根据用户特定动态标准进行细粒度评估和图像选择提供了首个完整的奖励建模框架。

title: AdvantageFlow: Advantage-Weighted Least Squares for RL in Flow Models
summary: We introduce AdvantageFlow, a forward-process reinforcement learning algorithm for rectified flow models. Unlike Flow-GRPO, which optimizes the reverse process, we optimize an advantage-weighted forward-process prediction loss. This optimization problem is unstable when advantages are negative and the loss becomes non-convex. We stabilize it by rollout policy regularization, which reduces variance and arises from fitting a local reward-improving target distribution. We evaluate AdvantageFlow on image generation tasks with Stable Diffusion 3.5 Medium. It outperforms both Flow-GRPO and a state-of-the-art forward-process RL baseline based on negative-aware fine-tuning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AdvantageFlow，一种用于整流流模型的前向过程强化学习算法。通过优势加权前向预测损失和策略正则化，在图像生成任务上优于Flow-GRPO等基线方法。
AI.motivation: 现有Flow-GRPO优化反向过程，且前向过程强化学习存在负优势下的不稳定和非凸损失问题，需要更稳定的优化方法。
AI.method: 提出优势加权前向预测损失，并通过rollout策略正则化来稳定训练，正则化项通过拟合局部奖励改进的目标分布来降低方差。
AI.result: 在Stable Diffusion 3.5 Medium的图像生成任务上，AdvantageFlow优于Flow-GRPO和基于负感知微调的前向过程RL基线。
AI.conclusion: 前向过程强化学习结合rollout策略正则化可以有效且稳定地优化整流流模型，在图像生成中取得更好性能。

title: SP-MoMamba: Superpixel-driven Mixture of State Space Experts for Efficient Image Super-Resolution
summary: State space models (SSMs) have emerged as a powerful paradigm for efficient single-image super-resolution (SR) due to their linear complexity and long-range modeling capabilities. However, existing Mamba-based methods typically rely on data-agnostic rigid scanning, which reshapes 2D images into 1D sequences over a fixed grid, inevitably disrupting spatial-semantic topology and introducing artifacts. Inspired by the \textbf{Gestalt perceptual grouping theory}, we propose \textbf{SP-MoMamba}, a superpixel-driven mixture of state space experts designed for content-aware SR. Our core idea is to transform the traditional rigid scanning into a \textbf{semantic-level interaction} by treating superpixels as fundamental units. Specifically, we introduce the \textbf{Superpixel-driven State Space Model (SP-SSM)}, which compresses semantically homogeneous regions into high-order tokens to preserve global topological consistency. To address the conflict between fixed scanning scales and diverse semantic granularities, we develop the \textbf{Multi-Scale Superpixel Mixture of State Space Experts (MSS-MoE)}. This module utilizes a dynamic routing mechanism to adaptively assign scale-specific experts, effectively capturing multi-scale textures while reducing computational redundancy. Furthermore, to prevent the loss of high-frequency details during global abstraction, we introduce a \textbf{Local Spatial Modulation Expert (LSME)} to complement the global modeling, ensuring a precise reconstruction of sharp edges and fine structures. Extensive experiments on standard benchmarks demonstrate that SP-MoMamba achieves superior reconstruction fidelity and a more favorable efficiency-performance trade-off compared to state-of-the-art efficient SR methods.

AI.tldr: SP-MoMamba提出了一种基于超像素驱动的混合状态空间专家模型，将传统刚性扫描转为语义级交互，通过SP-SSM保持全局拓扑一致性、MSS-MoE实现多尺度自适应专家路由、LSME补充局部细节，在超分辨率任务上取得了更优的重建 fidelity 和效率-性能平衡。
AI.motivation: 现有Mamba类超分方法采用数据无关的刚性扫描策略，将2D图像按固定网格重塑为1D序列，破坏了空间-语义拓扑结构并引入伪影。受格式塔感知分组理论启发，作者希望将刚性扫描转为语义级交互，实现内容感知的超分辨率重建。
AI.method: 1) SP-SSM（超像素驱动状态空间模型）：将语义同质区域压缩为高阶token，保持全局拓扑一致性；2) MSS-MoE（多尺度超像素混合状态空间专家）：通过动态路由机制自适应分配尺度特定专家，捕获多尺度纹理并减少计算冗余；3) LSME（局部空间调制专家）：补充全局建模中丢失的高频细节，确保锐利边缘和精细结构的精确重建。
AI.result: 在标准基准测试上的大量实验表明，SP-MoMamba在重建 fidelity 和效率-性能权衡方面均优于当前最先进的 efficient SR 方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过超像素驱动的语义级交互替代刚性扫描，结合多尺度专家混合与局部细节补偿，能够有效提升SSM在超分辨率任务中的性能，实现更好的重建质量与计算效率平衡。

title: Retrieval-Augmented Detection of Potentially Abusive Clauses in Chilean Terms of Service
summary: Online Terms of Service often function as contracts of adhesion, creating asymmetries that may expose consumers to potentially abusive clauses. In Chile, assessing such clauses is legally challenging because some provisions clearly violate mandatory consumer law, whereas others depend on broader standards such as good faith and contractual imbalance. We present a retrieval-augmented generation framework for the automated detection and classification of potentially abusive clauses in Chilean Terms of Service. Designed for local execution, it combines efficient clause detection, hybrid dense--sparse retrieval, reranking, and prompt augmentation to support medium-sized open-weight language models. We also introduce the Chilean Abusive Terms of Service Extended corpus, comprising 100 contracts and 10,029 annotated clauses in 24 legally grounded categories spanning illegal, dark, and gray clauses. Experiments comparing commercial and open-weight language models, fine-tuned encoders, and traditional baselines show that retrieval-augmented prompting substantially improves performance and enables local models to approach larger cloud-based systems at lower computational and token cost. The study also contributes a refined legal annotation scheme and a practical design for AI-assisted consumer contract review.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个检索增强生成（RAG）框架，用于自动检测和分类智利在线服务条款中的潜在滥用条款。研究引入了一个包含100份合同、10,029条注释条款的智利滥用服务条款扩展语料库，涵盖24个法律类别。实验表明，RAG方法能显著提升性能，使本地中等规模开源模型接近大型云端模型的效果，同时降低计算和令牌成本。
AI.motivation: 智利的在线服务条款常作为附意合同存在，造成信息不对称并可能包含滥用条款。然而，对这些条款的法律评估具有挑战性：部分条款明确违反强制性消费者法，而另一些则需依据诚信原则和合同失衡等更广泛标准进行判断。现有方法缺乏针对智利法律体系的自动化检测工具。
AI.method: 提出一个检索增强生成（RAG）框架，包括高效条款检测、混合密集-稀疏检索、重排序和提示增强，支持中等规模开源语言模型的本地执行。同时构建了智利滥用服务条款扩展语料库（Chilean Abusive Terms of Service Extended corpus），包含10,029条注释条款，覆盖24个法律类别（非法、暗黑、灰色条款）。
AI.result: 实验比较了商业模型、开源模型、微调编码器和传统基线，结果显示检索增强提示显著提升了性能，使本地模型能以更低的计算和令牌成本接近大型云端系统的表现。
AI.conclusion: 本研究贡献了精细的法律注释方案、面向智利消费者法的RAG框架设计，以及AI辅助消费者合同审查的实用方案。

title: Length Generalization with Log-Depth Recurrent Units
summary: Length generalization remains a persistent challenge for neural networks: recurrent models tend to suffer from positional biases, while transformers are constrained by fixed computational depth. Regular languages provide a frequently used testbed for evaluating length generalization, as label prediction can be checked for any sequence length. We propose MLP-LDRU, a type of Log-Depth Recurrent Unit, which captures a class of associativity-biased operators designed to approximate recurrence through parallel reduction. We evaluate MLP-LDRU on 21 regular-language tasks, consisting of standard benchmarks and new prefix languages, where it achieves 100% out-of-distribution accuracy on 18 tasks and at least 99.9% on the remaining 3 when increasing max training length, outperforming comparable recurrent and attention-based models. We further evaluate MLP-LDRU beyond regular languages on ListOps and NLP classification benchmarks, where it performs competitively.

AI.tldr: 提出MLP-LDRU（对数深度循环单元），通过可并行归约的关联性偏置算子近似循环，在21个正则语言任务中18个实现100%的分布外准确率，其余3个达到99.9%以上，并在ListOps和NLP分类任务上表现竞争力。
AI.motivation: 解决神经网络在长度泛化上的持续挑战：循环模型存在位置偏差，Transformer受限于固定计算深度。
AI.method: 提出MLP-LDRU（Log-Depth Recurrent Unit），一种对数深度循环单元，通过设计关联性偏置算子（associativity-biased operators）并利用并行归约（parallel reduction）来近似循环计算。
AI.result: 在21个正则语言任务中，18个达到100%分布外准确率，3个达到99.9%以上；在ListOps和NLP分类任务上表现竞争力。
AI.conclusion: MLP-LDRU通过关联性偏置和并行归约有效实现了长度泛化，在正则语言任务上显著优于循环和注意力模型，并在更广泛的任务上具有竞争力。

title: R5DGS: Semantic-Aware 4D Gaussian Splatting with Rigid Body Constraints for Efficient Dynamic Scene Reconstruction
summary: Reconstructing and predicting dynamic 3D scenes from multi-view videos is a foundational task for robotics, AR/VR, and digital twins. Recent physics-informed Gaussian Splatting methods achieve impressive future frame extrapolation but lack semantic awareness and suffer from large computational overhead. We introduce $\textbf{R5DGS}$, a framework that augments a physics-driven 4D Gaussian representation with compact Identity Encoding vectors, enabling precise Gaussian-to-object association. By constructing an offline CLIP-based object lookup table, we support open-vocabulary text prompting to retrieve and render object-specific Gaussians across arbitrary timestamps and viewpoints. Furthermore, we propose a rigid-body inference constraint that predicts and integrates physical dynamics exclusively for object centroids, propagating motion to associated Gaussians via relative transformations. This optimization yields a 11 FPS speedup during extrapolation without compromising trajectories plausibility.

AI.tldr: R5DGS通过紧凑的Identity Encoding向量和CLIP对象查找表，在物理驱动4D高斯表示中实现开放词汇的物体级语义关联，并利用刚体推理约束仅预测物体质心动力学，在保持轨迹合理性的同时实现11 FPS的推理加速。
AI.motivation: 现有物理信息高斯泼溅方法虽能实现未来帧外推，但缺乏语义感知能力且计算开销大。
AI.method: 1) 在物理驱动4D高斯表示中引入紧凑的Identity Encoding向量实现高斯-物体关联；2) 构建离线CLIP对象查找表支持开放词汇文本提示检索与渲染；3) 提出刚体推理约束，仅预测物体质心物理动力学，通过相对变换传播运动到关联高斯。
AI.result: 在外推过程中实现11 FPS的速度提升，且不牺牲轨迹合理性。
AI.conclusion: R5DGS在保持物理动力学外推能力的同时，实现了语义感知和计算效率的显著提升。

title: Neuronal Stochastic Attention Circuit (NSAC) for Probabilistic Representation Learning
summary: Reliable quantification of uncertainty estimates in continuous-time (CT) representation learning remains nascent, particularly within CT attention architectures. We introduce the Neuronal Stochastic Attention Circuit (NSAC), a novel biologically-inspired CT attention architecture that reformulates attention logit computation as the solution of an Ornstein-Uhlenbeck stochastic differential equation modulated by input-dependent, nonlinear interlinked gates derived from repurposed C.elegans Neuronal Circuit Policies (NCPs) wiring mechanism. It induces Gaussian distribution over logits that propagates principled stochasticity through logistic-normal distribution over attention weights to yield probabilistic output. A two-term objective function combining Gaussian negative log-likelihood with an epistemic-separation regularizer enforces higher predictive variance and enables joint quantification of aleatoric and epistemic uncertainty. Empirically, we implement NSAC in a diverse set of learning tasks including: (i) irregular CT function approximation; (ii) multivariate regression; (iii) long-range forecasting; (iv) Industry 4.0; and (v) the lane-keeping of autonomous vehicles. We observe that the NSAC remains competitive against several baselines in terms of accuracy and produces reasonably well-calibrated uncertainty estimates while being interpretable at the neuronal cell level.

AI.tldr: 本文提出神经随机注意力电路（NSAC），一种受生物启发的连续时间注意力架构，通过将注意力logits计算建模为Ornstein-Uhlenbeck随机微分方程的解，引入高斯分布传播随机性，结合双目标损失函数（高斯负对数似然+认知分离正则化），实现连续时间表示学习中的不确定性量化。
AI.motivation: 连续时间表示学习中不确定性估计的可靠量化仍处于初级阶段，特别是在连续时间注意力架构中缺乏有效的解决方案。
AI.method: 1) 将注意力logits计算重新表述为受输入依赖非线性互连门控（源自C.elegans神经电路策略接线机制）调制的Ornstein-Uhlenbeck随机微分方程的解；2) 通过logits上的高斯分布经逻辑正态分布传播至注意力权重，产生概率化输出；3) 提出双目标损失函数：高斯负对数似然+认知分离正则化，联合量化偶然不确定性和认知不确定性。
AI.result: 在五类任务（不规则CT函数逼近、多变量回归、长程预测、工业4.0、自动驾驶车道保持）中，NSAC在准确性与基线相当，同时产生合理校准的不确定性估计，且在神经元细胞级别具有可解释性。
AI.conclusion: NSAC验证了生物启发的随机微分方程建模方法可有效实现连续时间注意力架构中的不确定性量化，兼具竞争性精度与良好的校准性。

title: Closed-Loop Bidirectional Prompting for Adversarial Robustness of Vision Language Models
summary: Vision Language Models adapt well to downstream tasks but are highly vulnerable to adversarial perturbations that disrupt cross-modal semantic alignment. Existing defenses are largely unidirectional or structural, failing to exploit bidirectional cross-modal complementarity and instance-wise adaptive protection. To overcome the limitations of unidirectional and static defenses in adversarial settings, we propose Closed-Loop Bidirectional Prompting, casting robust adaptation as cross-modal agreement recovery via a dynamic feedback loop on frozen encoders. A Semantic Anchor is introduced as a stable prior to constrain cyclic updates and mitigate perturbation-induced feature corruption. Through anchor-based bootstrapping, textual semantics denoise visual representations, while the refined visuals enable instance-adaptive prompt updating, yielding a rectified and robust consensus. Extensive evaluations across 11 datasets validate state-of-the-art robustness and strong base-to-new generalization, while maintaining a favorable trade-off between computational cost and accuracy.

AI.tldr: 提出闭环双向提示（Closed-Loop Bidirectional Prompting）方法，通过动态反馈循环恢复跨模态语义对齐，利用语义锚点（Semantic Anchor）作为稳定先验约束循环更新，实现文本去噪视觉、视觉自适应更新提示，在11个数据集上取得SOTA鲁棒性和泛化性能。
AI.motivation: 现有防御方法多是单向或结构性的，未能利用双向跨模态互补性和实例自适应的保护机制，难以抵御破坏跨模态语义对齐的对抗扰动。
AI.method: 提出闭环双向提示方法，引入语义锚点作为稳定先验，通过锚点引导的迭代引导机制：文本语义去噪视觉表征，精炼后的视觉特征实现实例自适应提示更新，形成修正且鲁棒的共识，所有操作在冻结编码器上通过动态反馈循环完成。
AI.result: 在11个数据集上验证了SOTA鲁棒性和强大的基类到新类泛化能力，同时在计算开销与准确率之间取得了有利的平衡。
AI.conclusion: 闭环双向提示通过双向跨模态互补和实例自适应保护，有效克服了单向和静态防御的局限，显著提升了视觉语言模型的对抗鲁棒性。

title: Conditional KRR: Injecting Unpenalized Features into Kernel Methods with Applications to Kernel Thresholding
summary:
Conditionally positive definite (CPD) kernels are defined with respect to a function class $\mathcal{F}$. It is well known that such a kernel $K$ is associated with its native space (defined analogously to an RKHS), which in turn gives rise to a learning method -- called conditional kernel ridge regression (conditional KRR) due to its analogy with KRR -- where the estimated regression function is penalized by the square of its native space norm. This method is of interest because it can be viewed as classical linear regression, with features specified by $\mathcal{F}$, followed by the application of standard KRR to the residual (unexplained) component of the target variable. Methods of this type have recently attracted increasing attention.
  We study the statistical properties of this method by reducing its behavior to that of KRR with another fixed kernel, called the residual kernel. Our main theoretical result shows that such a reduction is indeed possible, at the cost of an additional term in the expected test risk, bounded by $\mathcal{O}(1/\sqrt{N})$, where $N$ is the sample size and the hidden constant depends on the class $\mathcal{F}$ and the input distribution.
  This reduction enables us to analyze conditional KRR in the case where $K$ is positive definite and $\mathcal{F}$ is given by the first $k$ principal eigenfunctions in the Mercer decomposition of $K$. We also consider the setting where $\mathcal{F}$ consists of $k$ random features from a random feature representation of $K$. It turns out that these two settings are closely related. Both our theoretical analysis and experiments confirm that conditional KRR outperforms standard KRR in these cases whenever the $\mathcal{F}$-component of the regression function is more pronounced than the residual part.

AI.tldr: 本文研究条件正定核的条件核岭回归（条件KRR）方法，通过将其归约为带残差核的标准KRR，理论证明了预期测试风险的额外项为O(1/√N)。在K的前k个特征函数和随机特征两种设定下，条件KRR在回归函数的F分量比残差分量更显著时优于标准KRR。
AI.motivation: 条件KRR可视为经典线性回归（特征由F指定）后对残差应用标准KRR，这类方法近期受到关注，但其统计性质缺乏系统理论分析。
AI.method: 将条件KRR的行为归约为带残差核的标准KRR，推导出预期测试风险的额外项上界为O(1/√N)；分别在Mercer分解前k个特征函数和随机特征两种设定下进行分析。
AI.result: 建立了条件KRR到标准KRR的归约理论，额外风险为O(1/√N)；在两种设定下条件KRR均优于标准KRR，且与F分量的显著性相关。
AI.conclusion: 条件KRR在回归函数的F分量比残差分量更显著时优于标准KRR，理论分析与实验一致。

title: Where Concept Erasure Should Occur: Concept-Layer Alignment in Text-to-Video Diffusion Models
summary: Text-to-video diffusion transformers encode semantic information unevenly across model depth, which constrains effective concept erasure. We identify a representational bottleneck, termed concept-layer topological alignment, under which target concepts exhibit higher separability at certain representational depths. Outside these depths, concept and non-target signals remain strongly entangled, limiting the effectiveness of depth-specific erasure. This observation reframes concept erasure as the problem of identifying representational depths where concept-non-target separation naturally emerges. Motivated by this structural constraint, we introduce CLEAR, a separability-driven optimization framework for concept erasure that explicitly enforces concept-layer alignment. CLEAR operationalizes this principle by formulating layer selection as an optimization problem over concept-non-target separability, rather than relying on layer-agnostic or heuristic choices. To enable this, we introduce a separability-aware objective that favors layers exhibiting stronger concept-non-target separation. Experiments on large-scale text-to-video diffusion models demonstrate that enforcing concept--layer alignment leads to more precise concept suppression while preserving overall generative quality.

AI.tldr: 本文发现文本到视频扩散Transformer中概念信息在深度维度上分布不均匀，存在概念-层拓扑对齐瓶颈，据此提出CLEAR框架，通过可分离性驱动的层选择优化实现更精确的概念擦除。
AI.motivation: 文本到视频扩散Transformer在不同深度层对语义信息编码不均匀，导致概念擦除效果受限。现有方法依赖层无关或启发式层选择，未能充分利用某些表示深度上概念与目标自然分离的结构特性。
AI.method: 提出CLEAR框架：将概念擦除重新定义为识别概念与非目标自然分离的表示深度的问题，通过可分离性驱动的层选择优化来实现概念-层拓扑对齐，而非依赖层无关或启发式选择。
AI.result: 在大规模文本到视频扩散模型上的实验表明，强制概念-层对齐能够实现更精确的概念抑制，同时保持整体生成质量。
AI.conclusion: 概念-层拓扑对齐是影响概念擦除效果的关键瓶颈，基于可分离性优化的层选择策略能有效提升擦除精度而不牺牲生成质量。

title: Rethinking Weak Supervision in Anomaly Detection: A Comprehensive Benchmark
comment: Accepted at KDD 2026 Datasets and Benchmarks Track (Cycle 2)
summary: Weakly supervised anomaly detection (WSAD) has developed in three primary directions: incomplete, inexact, and inaccurate supervision. However, these directions remain isolated, lacking a unified framework to assess whether they address unique challenges or share fundamental mechanics. This paper introduces WSADBench, the first benchmark that unifies evaluation across distinct weakly supervised scenarios, benchmarking diverse approaches from specialized WSAD methods to advanced tabular foundation models. WSADBench establishes standardized protocols to evaluate 36 algorithms across 4 modalities by systematically varying label quantity, granularity, and quality, revealing the performance boundaries of various methods. Based on over 700K experiments, WSADBench reveals four critical insights: (i) Strong intrinsic correlations exist between these weak supervision scenarios, challenging the isolation of current research directions. (ii) Specialized WSAD algorithms excel only in extreme label-scarcity regimes but are quickly dominated by tabular foundation models and general classification methods as supervision increases or in OOD scenarios. (iii) Unlabeled data shows inconsistent utility across settings, with marginal gains compared to label refinement. (iv) Models exhibit asymmetric sensitivity to different types of label noise. We release WSADBench as an open-source benchmark with code and datasets to facilitate future WSAD research: https://github.com/SUFE-AILAB/WSADBench.

AI.tldr: WSADBench是首个统一评估弱监督异常检测（WSAD）三种主要方向（不完全、不精确、不准确监督）的基准，通过70万+实验评估36种算法在4种模态下的表现，揭示了不同弱监督场景之间的强相关性，以及专用WSAD方法仅在极标签稀缺场景占优，通用方法随监督增强表现更佳等关键发现。
AI.motivation: 现有的弱监督异常检测研究在不完全、不精确和不准确监督三个方向上相互孤立，缺乏统一框架来评估这些方向是否解决独特挑战或共享基础机制。
AI.method: 构建WSADBench基准，通过系统变化标签数量、粒度和质量，建立标准化协议，在4种模态上评估36种算法（包括专用WSAD方法、表格基础模型和通用分类方法），开展了超过70万次实验。
AI.result: (i) 弱监督场景间存在强内在相关性；(ii) 专用WSAD算法仅在极端标签稀缺场景下表现优异，但随着监督增强或被OOD场景替代，表格基础模型和通用分类方法迅速占优；(iii) 未标注数据在不同设置中效用不一致，相对于标签精炼收益有限；(iv) 模型对不同类型标签噪声具有非对称敏感性。
AI.conclusion: WSADBench作为首个统一基准，揭示了当前WSAD研究方向隔离的问题，并为未来WSAD研究提供了标准化评估平台和开源资源。

title: Active Query Synthesis for Preference Learning
summary: Efficient learning of user preferences is crucial for many modern decision making systems but typically requires costly labeled data. Active learning reduces this cost, yet standard methods are computationally expensive due to pool-based evaluation. Further, most methods assume all query feedback is equally reliable, ignoring that pairwise queries between nearly identical or entirely dissimilar items yield ambiguous, low-confidence responses. To address the issue of feedback reliability, we introduce a novel confidence aware response model that explicitly accounts for these ambiguous comparisons. To overcome the computational bottleneck of pool-based evaluation, we propose an active query synthesis framework, Info-Synth that generates optimal queries by maximizing a mutual information-based objective within a continuous space. Moreover, we propose two strategies, Pair M-dist and Pair Opt-dist, that extend Info-Synth to select effective queries even when restricted to finite query pools. We demonstrate our framework's versatility and performance across synthetic preference learning, constrained text summary datasets, and subjective, continuous-space controller gain tuning for a simulated mobile robot.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于信息论的主动查询合成框架Info-Synth，通过连续空间优化生成最优查询，并引入置信度感知响应模型来处理模糊比较，同时提出了两种有限池查询选择策略，在偏好学习任务中实现了高效且可靠的主动学习。
AI.motivation: 传统主动学习方法计算成本高昂且忽略了查询反馈的可靠性差异（如相似或完全不同物品的比较会产生模糊低置信度响应），需要一种既能降低计算开销又能处理反馈可靠性的高效偏好学习方法。
AI.method: 1) 提出置信度感知响应模型，显式处理模糊比较带来的不可靠反馈；2) 提出Info-Synth框架，在连续空间中通过最大化互信息目标生成最优查询；3) 提出Pair M-dist和Pair Opt-dist两种策略，将Info-Synth扩展到有限查询池场景。
AI.result: 在合成偏好学习、受限文本摘要数据集以及移动机器人控制器增益调优的主观连续空间任务中验证了方法的有效性和通用性。
AI.conclusion: 通过置信度感知建模和信息论驱动的查询合成/选择，能够在降低计算成本的同时提升主动偏好学习的效率与可靠性。

title: EchoPilot: Training-Free Ultrasound Video Segmentation via Scale-Space Semantic Prompting and Reliability-Gated Memory
comment: Early accepted to MICCAI 2026. Project page: https://keeplearning-again.github.io/EchoPilot/
summary: Ultrasound video segmentation is clinically valuable yet difficult due to speckle noise, weak boundaries, and rapid anatomical deformation. Recent promptable foundation models enable point-guided segmentation, but their direct deployment in ultrasound remains unreliable: a single point provides insufficient spatial context to resolve scale ambiguity, and greedy memory updates amplify early errors into severe temporal drift. We present EchoPilot, a training-free framework for ultrasound video segmentation under sparse first-frame interaction, requiring only a single point click and an anatomical category name. EchoPilot orchestrates a frozen medical vision-language model (VLM) for semantic localization, a vision foundation model (VFM) for dense geometric feature extraction, and a promptable video segmentor for mask prediction and propagation. To resolve initialization ambiguity, we propose Scale-Space Semantic Prompting, which first selects an optimal contextual view via a parameter-free S.E.E.D. (Semantic Energy-Entropy Density) criterion, and then synthesizes geometrically precise auxiliary point prompts from dense foundation features without additional user interaction. To reduce propagation drift, a Reliability-Gated Memory update is further introduced to selectively freeze the segmentor's memory bank under uncertain predictions, preventing error accumulation. We also contribute the first dynamic fetal placenta ultrasound video segmentation dataset with 671 annotated frames. Across three ultrasound video datasets, EchoPilot achieves state-of-the-art performance under the sparse-interactive setting, consistently outperforming training-free baselines and finetuned specialists.

AI.tldr: EchoPilot是一种无需训练的视频分割框架，仅需单点点击和类别名称即可实现超声视频分割，通过冻结的视觉-语言模型、视觉基础模型和可提示视频分割器协同工作，并创新提出尺度空间语义提示和可靠性门控记忆更新机制，在多个超声视频数据集上达到最优性能。
AI.motivation: 超声视频分割因散斑噪声、弱边界和快速变形而困难。现有的可提示基础模型在超声领域直接部署不可靠：单点提供空间上下文不足导致尺度模糊，贪婪记忆更新放大早期错误导致严重时序漂移。
AI.method: 提出EchoPilot框架，包含三个冻结模型：医学VLM用于语义定位、VFM用于密集几何特征提取、可提示视频分割器用于掩码预测与传播。关键创新：(1) 尺度空间语义提示（S.E.E.D.准则选择最优上下文视图，从密集特征合成辅助点提示）；(2) 可靠性门控记忆更新机制，在不确定预测时选择性冻结记忆库以防止错误累积。
AI.result: 在三个超声视频数据集上达到最先进性能，一致优于无需训练的基线和微调的专业模型。还贡献了首个动态胎儿胎盘超声视频分割数据集，包含671帧标注。
AI.conclusion: EchoPilot通过无需训练的方式有效解决了超声视频分割中单点初始化模糊和时序漂移问题，验证了冻结基础模型在医学超声领域组合应用的潜力。

title: Global Convergence of Wasserstein Policy Gradient for Entropy-Regularized Reinforcement Learning
summary:
Wasserstein policy gradient (WPG) is a policy optimization method for reinforcement learning (RL) that exploits the optimal-transport geometry of action distributions. For the entropy-regularized RL objective, WPG evolves each state-conditional policy by transporting it along the action gradient of the soft Q-function together with a Langevin-type diffusion. Despite its appeal for continuous-control problems, its global convergence properties remain poorly understood. Standard Langevin analyses do not directly apply, because the RL objective depends on the policy through the Bellman recursion rather than through a static convex functional, and the Langevin drift is determined by the soft Q-function, whose regularity must be controlled along the policy iterates.
  In this paper, we develop a global convergence theory for WPG by exploiting the Bellman structure of entropy-regularized RL. We show that the role usually played by convexity can be replaced by a Bellman-based argument: the soft Bellman residual admits a statewise KL representation with respect to a Gibbs policy; Bellman contraction relates this residual to the global optimality gap; and a Bellman resolvent identity connects value improvement to relative Fisher information. Combined with a uniform log-Sobolev inequality (LSI) for the evolving Gibbs family, these ingredients yield a distributional Polyak--Łojasiewicz condition. We further establish the regularity and uniform bounds needed to control the discretization error, thereby obtaining geometric contraction up to a discretization bias. Conceptually, our analysis shows that although entropy-regularized RL is not convex in the usual flat sense, the Bellman recursion induces a favorable Polyak--Lojasiewicz-type (PL) geometry that supports global convergence of WPG.

AI.tldr: 本文为Wasserstein策略梯度（WPG）方法建立了全局收敛性理论。通过利用熵正则化强化学习中的Bellman结构，证明了软Bellman残差的逐状态KL表示、Bellman压缩、Bellman预解恒等式以及均匀对数Sobolev不等式共同导出了分布Polyak–Łojasiewicz条件，从而实现了WPG的几何收敛（存在离散化偏差）。核心洞见是：尽管熵正则化RL在通常的平坦意义上不具凸性，但Bellman递归诱导了有利于WPG全局收敛的PL型几何。
AI.motivation: WPG是一种利用动作分布最优传输几何的策略优化方法，在连续控制问题中表现出色，但其全局收敛性质尚不明确。标准的Langevin分析方法不直接适用，因为RL目标通过Bellman递归而非静态凸泛函依赖于策略，且Langevin漂移由软Q函数决定，其正则性需沿策略迭代加以控制。
AI.method: 利用熵正则化RL的Bellman结构：1）软Bellman残差具有关于Gibbs策略的逐状态KL表示；2）Bellman压缩将该残差与全局最优性差距联系起来；3）Bellman预解恒等式连接值改进与相对Fisher信息。结合Gibbs族的均匀对数Sobolev不等式，导出分布Polyak–Łojasiewicz条件。进一步建立离散化误差控制所需的正则性与一致界，证明几何收敛（存在离散化偏差）。
AI.result: 建立了WPG的全局收敛性理论，证明了在分布PL条件下算法可实现几何收缩（受离散化偏差限制）。
AI.conclusion: 尽管熵正则化RL不具有传统凸性，但Bellman递归诱导了一种有利的PL型几何结构，支持WPG的全局收敛。

title: A Pedestrian-Vehicle Interaction Benchmark and Annotation Framework for Unstructured Scenes via Uncalibrated Cameras
comment: 10 pages, 8 figures; project page available at https://github.com/Songan-Lab
summary: Predicting the interaction between pedestrian and vehicle is essential for autonomous driving safety in unstructured and semi-structured scenarios; however, this task is severely hindered by the scarcity of public datasets that feature dense pedestrian-vehicle interactions. Most current studies rely on structured road data, leaving the complex, heterogeneous interactions found in unstructured environments insufficiently represented and researched. In this paper, we propose a dataset annotation framework based on video data from uncalibrated surveillance cameras and present PINNS (Pedestrian-vehicle Interaction dataset from uNcalibrated cameras in uNstructured Scenes). The dataset covers multiple countries and regions, includes diverse typical traffic scenarios, and considers variations in seasons, lighting conditions, and weather. It focuses on complex scenes with dense pedestrian-vehicle interactions and is designed to be easily extensible. The dataset is constructed and annotated according to the standard issued by the Chinese Association of Automation, providing both trajectory data and corresponding scene-level information. Furthermore, this paper analyzes current challenges and research directions in heterogeneous agent trajectory prediction, shows the necessity and usefulness of the proposed dataset. We hope our framework and dataset will facilitate research on trajectory prediction and autonomous driving in complex mixed traffic scenarios. PINNS is publicly available at https://github.com/Songan-Lab.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于未标定监控摄像头的行人-车辆交互数据集标注框架，构建了PINNS数据集，覆盖多国多场景的密集交互交通环境，包含轨迹和场景级标注，旨在推动复杂混合交通场景下的轨迹预测和自动驾驶研究。
AI.motivation: 现有行人-车辆交互预测研究主要依赖结构化道路数据，缺乏针对非结构化/半结构化场景中密集交互的公开数据集，严重制约了该领域的发展。
AI.method: 基于未标定监控摄像头的视频数据，提出数据集标注框架；构建PINNS数据集，涵盖多国家/地区、多样典型交通场景及季节、光照、天气变化；依据中国自动化学会标准进行标注，提供轨迹数据和场景级信息；数据集设计易于扩展。
AI.result: 构建了PINNS数据集，覆盖密集行人-车辆交互的非结构化场景，提供轨迹与场景级标注，并分析了异构智能体轨迹预测的当前挑战和研究方向，验证了数据集的有效性和必要性。
AI.conclusion: PINNS数据集及其标注框架能够有效填补非结构化场景下行人-车辆交互数据的空白，促进复杂混合交通场景中的轨迹预测与自动驾驶研究。

title: OrpQuant: Geometric Orthogonal Residual Projection for Multiplier-Free Power-of-Two Transformer Quantization
summary:
The deployment of Large Language Models (LLMs) and Vision Transformers (ViTs) on edge devices is significantly constrained by memory limitations and the critical timing bottlenecks introduced by dense Multiply-Accumulate (MAC) arrays. In the ultra-low bit regime, logarithmic Power-of-Two (PoT) quantization provides a hardware-efficient alternative by replacing MAC operations with bit-shifts. However, the non-uniform exponential lattice is inherently limited by a \textbf{Low Angular Resolution Regime}, a structural flaw that becomes particularly pronounced at sub-4-bit thresholds, leading to a notable degradation of high-dimensional feature manifolds.
  To address this geometric limitation, we propose Orthogonal Residual Projection (ORP), an algorithm-hardware co-design framework. By formulating quantization as a dual-basis geometric projection, ORP adaptively synthesizes a higher-resolution residual lattice using strictly shift-and-add operations. Furthermore, ORP's analytical solver offers a practical alternative to computationally intensive gradient-based optimization, reducing the full-model calibration time for LLaMA-2-7B to approximately \textbf{15 minutes}.
  Extensive evaluations demonstrate ORP's applicability across modalities and its hardware efficiency. Under the 3-bit (W3/A16) constraint, ORP achieves a perplexity of 6.10 on LLaMA-2-7B, comparing favorably to conventional MAC-intensive baselines like AWQ without relying on asymmetric scaling, while maintaining competitive accuracy in 4-bit scenarios. At the silicon level, standard-cell RTL synthesis at a 28nm node indicates that ORP effectively mitigates the timing bottlenecks associated with dense multiplier trees.

AI.tldr: 提出正交残差投影（ORP）框架，通过算法-硬件协同设计解决超低比特（<4-bit）对数量化中的低角分辨率问题，在LLaMA-2-7B 3-bit量化下达到6.10困惑度，全模型校准仅需15分钟，且28nm RTL综合表明能有效缓解密集乘法器树的时序瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 超低比特量化场景下，对数量化（Power-of-Two）的非均匀指数格点存在结构性的低角分辨率缺陷，导致高维特征流形严重退化，限制了LLM和ViT在边缘设备上的部署。
AI.method: 将量化建模为双基几何投影问题，自适应合成更高分辨率的残差格点（基于shift-and-add操作）；提出解析求解器替代梯度优化，将LLaMA-2-7B的校准时间降至约15分钟。
AI.result: 3-bit（W3/A16）下LLaMA-2-7B困惑度6.10，优于AWQ等MAC密集型基线；4-bit下保持竞争精度。28nm RTL综合表明ORP有效缓解密集乘法器树的时序瓶颈。
AI.conclusion: ORP是一种跨模态适用的算法-硬件协同设计框架，通过正交残差投影克服了对数量化的低角分辨率限制，兼顾了量化精度与硬件效率，特别适合边缘设备上的低比特部署。

title: VEN-VL: A Visual Ensemble MoE Framework for Effective and Efficient Multi-Modal Understanding
summary: Despite the remarkable progress achieved by recent efficient methods in accelerating multimodal understanding, they still suffer from noticeable performance degradation. Their emphasis on the high compression ratio of a single visual clue and reliance on the heuristic pruning strategy with coarse attention alignment incurs a bottleneck on the information capacity and density of visual tokens. Addressing this limitation, we propose VEN-VL, a visual ensemble MoE framework for effective and efficient perception following the enrich then compact principle. Specifically, we first enrich the information capacity by unifying the visual representations of different perspectives, and then progressively compact it with adaptive routers in specialized visual experts to enhance the information density. Furthermore, we incorporate the reconstruction ability of vanilla structure via explicit visual supervision, facilitating crucial information preservation. Experimental results demonstrate our superiority in complex visual tasks with few information-condensed tokens, which effectively bridges the gap between performance and efficiency.

AI.tldr: 提出VEN-VL框架，通过"先丰富后压缩"的视觉集成MoE方法，在保持高压缩率的同时提升多模态理解的性能，弥合效率与效果之间的鸿沟。
AI.motivation: 现有高效多模态方法过分强调单一视觉线索的高压缩比，并依赖基于启发式剪枝策略的粗粒度注意力对齐，导致视觉token的信息容量和密度成为瓶颈，造成显著的性能下降。
AI.method: 1) 融合不同视角的视觉表示以丰富信息容量；2) 通过自适应路由器在专门化视觉专家中逐步压缩，提升信息密度；3) 引入显式视觉监督，利用原始结构的重建能力保留关键信息。
AI.result: 在复杂视觉任务中，仅用少量信息压缩后的token即可取得优越性能，有效弥合了性能与效率之间的差距。
AI.conclusion: VEN-VL通过"先丰富后压缩"的设计原则，突破了传统高效方法的性能瓶颈，实现了在多模态理解任务中效率与效果的双赢。

title: Goal-driven Bayesian Optimal Experimental Design for Robust Decision-Making Under Model Uncertainty
summary: Bayesian optimal experimental design (BOED) selects experiments to maximize information gain about model parameters. However, in decision-critical settings, reducing parameter uncertainty does not necessarily improve downstream decisions, as only specific parameter directions relevant to the objective truly matter. We propose GoBOED, a goal-driven BOED framework that directly optimizes experimental designs for a specified decision-making objective. GoBOED combines an amortized variational posterior surrogate with a differentiable convex decision layer, enabling gradient-based design optimization that is fully decision-focused. We theoretically show that GoBOED gradients are insensitive to parameter directions irrelevant to the decision objective, providing a formal justification for why goal-driven design achieves equivalent decision quality over a wider set of experimental designs than information-gain maximization. Empirically, across source localization, epidemic management, and pharmacokinetic control, GoBOED identifies designs that better align with downstream decision objectives and reveals that near-optimal design windows are substantially wider than those predicted by goal-agnostic BOED approaches.

AI.tldr: GoBOED是一种目标驱动的贝叶斯最优实验设计框架，通过结合变分后验代理和可微凸决策层，直接优化实验设计以提升下游决策质量，而非最大化参数信息增益。理论证明其对决策无关参数方向不敏感，实验表明在多个任务中能实现更优决策效果并发现更宽的近最优设计窗口。
AI.motivation: 传统的贝叶斯最优实验设计（BOED）通过最大化信息增益来选择实验，但在决策关键场景中，降低参数不确定性并不一定能改善下游决策，因为只有与目标相关的特定参数方向才真正重要。现有方法忽略了决策目标与实验设计之间的直接关联。
AI.method: GoBOED框架将摊销变分后验代理与可微凸决策层相结合，实现了完全以决策为中心的梯度优化设计。具体包括：(1) 使用摊销变分推断高效近似后验；(2) 嵌入可微凸决策层作为下游决策目标；(3) 通过端到端梯度反向传播直接优化实验设计。
AI.result: 理论结果表明GoBOED的梯度对决策目标无关的参数方向不敏感。在源定位、流行病管理和药代动力学控制三个任务中，GoBOED生成的实验设计更符合下游决策目标，且近最优设计窗口显著宽于传统信息增益最大化方法。
AI.conclusion: 目标驱动的实验设计方法（GoBOED）相比信息增益最大化的BOED方法，能够在更广泛的实验设计空间中实现同等决策质量，为决策关键场景下的实验设计提供了更高效、更灵活的理论框架和实践方案。

title: RAPTOR+: A Visually Grounded Vision-Language Framework to Improve Clinical Trust and Auditability in Automated Cancer Referral Processing
summary: Urgent suspected colorectal cancer (CRC) referrals create operational bottlenecks because semi-structured clinical documents often require manual review and transcription. The original RAPTOR system used Large Language Models for structured extraction but relied on a separate OCR stage, making it vulnerable to handwriting, layout variation, and loss of visual evidence linkage. We present RAPTOR+, a multimodal extension that uses Vision-Language Models (VLMs) for end-to-end referral understanding. We evaluate fine-tuned VLMs, commercial and open-source zero-shot VLMs, and the original OCR-based pipeline on 223 clinically curated CRC urgent referral forms. We also introduce a grounding-aware evaluation framework that measures both extraction accuracy and evidence localisation. Results show a clear grounding gap in zero-shot models. Gemini 2.5 Flash achieved 92.6% Reading Accuracy but only 1.2% Strict Safety. In contrast, fine-tuned Qwen3-VL-8B achieved 96.1% Reading Accuracy and 60.6% Strict Safety, substantially improving verifiable evidence grounding. These findings show that task-specific fine-tuning is essential for reliable, auditable clinical document understanding. RAPTOR+ enables extracted referral decisions to be linked to visual evidence, supporting safer and more efficient cancer referral triage.

AI.tldr: RAPTOR+ 提出了一个多模态扩展系统，使用视觉-语言模型（VLM）实现端到端的可疑结直肠癌转诊表单理解。微调的Qwen3-VL-8B在读取准确率（96.1%）和严格安全性（60.6%）上显著优于零样本模型（如Gemini 2.5 Flash读取准确率92.6%但严格安全性仅1.2%），证明了任务特异性微调对于可审计的临床文档理解至关重要。
AI.motivation: 传统半结构化临床文档处理依赖人工审核与转录，造成运营瓶颈。原RAPTOR系统使用大语言模型进行结构化提取，但依赖独立的OCR阶段，容易受到手写、布局变化影响，且缺乏视觉证据的链接能力。
AI.method: 提出RAPTOR+多模态扩展系统，采用视觉-语言模型（VLM）实现端到端转诊理解。在223份临床整理的CRC紧急转诊表单上评估了微调VLM、商业和开源零样本VLM以及原始OCR流水线，并引入了一种基于定位能力的评估框架。
AI.result: 微调后的Qwen3-VL-8B在读取准确率（96.1%）和严格安全性（60.6%）上表现最佳；零样本模型中Gemini 2.5 Flash读取准确率92.6%但严格安全性仅1.2%，存在明显的定位差距。
AI.conclusion: 任务特异性微调对于可靠、可审计的临床文档理解至关重要。RAPTOR+能够将提取的转诊决策与视觉证据链接起来，支持更安全、更高效的癌症转诊分流。

title: Forgetting in Language Models: Capacity, Optimization, and Self-Generated Replay
summary: Models trained on a new task typically degrade on prior tasks, a phenomenon known as forgetting. Traditionally, mitigating forgetting has required replaying stored exemplars from prior tasks, which is often impractical. By contrast, language models can sample from their own training distribution, and we show that these self-generated samples serve as effective replay data, nearly eliminating forgetting. We find that forgetting nonetheless persists when the model has little remaining capacity: models pretrained close to saturation cannot absorb new information without overwriting prior knowledge. When capacity is not the limiting factor, low learning rates reduce forgetting but require substantially more training steps. Replay breaks this tradeoff, enabling fast, high-learning-rate finetuning without forgetting.

AI.tldr: 语言模型通过自我生成的样本来替代存储的旧任务样本进行回放训练，可以有效消除灾难性遗忘问题，但前提是模型未达到容量饱和状态。
AI.motivation: 传统缓解遗忘的方法需要存储旧任务的样本进行回放，这在实践中往往不可行。作者希望利用语言模型能够从自身训练分布中采样的特性，探索自我生成样本作为回放数据的可行性。
AI.method: 使用语言模型自我生成的样本来替代传统的存储样本进行回放训练，以缓解持续学习中的灾难性遗忘问题。
AI.result: 自我生成的样本作为回放数据几乎消除了遗忘；但当模型容量接近饱和（预训练接近收敛）时，遗忘仍然存在；低学习率可以减少遗忘但需要更多训练步数；回放打破了这一权衡，允许使用高学习率快速微调而不遗忘。
AI.conclusion: 回放（使用自我生成样本）能够在模型容量充足时几乎消除遗忘，并打破学习率与遗忘之间的权衡，实现快速且无遗忘的微调。

title: Context-driven Missing-Modality Learning for Robust Medical Diagnosis with Image-Tabular Data
summary: While multimodal data integrating diverse imaging and clinical tabular records is crucial for accurate medical diagnosis, the arbitrary absence of specific modalities is prevalent in clinical practice, severely degrading the performance of multimodal models. Existing methods either discard missing modalities, leading to information loss, or struggle to synthesize them without capturing complex inter-modal dependencies. To address these limitations, we propose a novel Context-driven Missing-Modality Learning (CMML) framework, which sequentially performs modality synthesis and semantic alignment to achieve robust diagnosis under arbitrary missing conditions. Specifically, we design a Cascade Residual Transformer-based Autoencoder (CRTA) that leverages learnable context tokens acting as dataset-level semantic prior to capture inter-modal dependencies and synthesize key missing representations. These representations are further enriched by modality-specific memory banks. To resolve the discrepancy between original available and synthesized representations, we transform the learned context tokens into instance-adaptive semantic references by infusing multimodal representations from the CRTA's outputs. This reference guides the alignment of heterogeneous modality representations into a unified space, where class-aware contrastive refinement is finally applied to explore discriminative diagnostic cues. Extensive evaluations on skin lesion (Derm7pt), ocular disease (ODIR), and meningioma (MEN) datasets demonstrate that CMML significantly outperforms state-of-the-art (SOTA) methods, yielding AVG AUC improvements of 1.26%, 0.97%, and 1.32%, respectively.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种上下文驱动的缺失模态学习框架(CMML)，通过级联残差Transformer自编码器(CRTA)合成缺失模态，并利用上下文令牌进行语义对齐，在多模态医学诊断中显著优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 临床实践中多模态数据常存在任意模态缺失，现有方法丢弃缺失模态导致信息损失，或合成时无法捕捉复杂的跨模态依赖关系，严重降低诊断性能。
AI.method: 1) 设计级联残差Transformer自编码器(CRTA)，利用可学习上下文令牌作为数据集级语义先验，捕获跨模态依赖并合成关键缺失表示，由模态特定记忆库进一步丰富；2) 将上下文令牌转化为实例自适应语义参考，指导异构模态表示对齐到统一空间；3) 应用类别感知对比精炼挖掘判别性诊断线索。
AI.result: 在皮肤病变(Derm7pt)、眼病(ODIR)和脑膜瘤(MEN)三个数据集上，AVG AUC分别提升1.26%、0.97%和1.32%，显著优于SOTA方法。
AI.conclusion: CMML框架通过上下文驱动的模态合成与语义对齐，有效解决了任意模态缺失下的鲁棒诊断问题，验证了其在多模态医学诊断中的优越性。

title: Looped Diffusion Language Models
summary: Masked diffusion models (MDMs) have emerged as a promising alternative to autoregressive models for language modeling, yet the effective design of transformer architectures for MDMs remains underexplored. In this paper, we show that selectively looping the early-middle transformer layers significantly improves both training efficiency and model performance in MDMs. We call this approach LoopMDM(Looped Masked Diffusion Model), which brings two key benefits: looping layers at training-time yields a depth-scaling effect without adding parameters, while varying the number of loops at inference-time enables flexible compute scaling. Despite the simplicity, the results are striking: across multiple pre-training corpora, LoopMDM matches the performance of same-size MDMs with up to 3.3 fewer training FLOPs, while its final performance outperforms them on various reasoning benchmarks, including up to 8.5 points on GSM8K. It even surpasses deeper non-looped MDMs trained with comparable per-step compute, indicating that selective looping is more effective than naive depth scaling. Furthermore, LoopMDM can scale inference-time compute by increasing the number of loops. Adaptively adjusting the number of loops throughout the sampling process further yields additional gains in compute efficiency while maintaining performance. Lastly, with attention analysis, we provide evidence that looping is effective in MDMs by promoting interactions among masked positions. Our code and weights will be publicly released.

AI.tldr: LoopMDM通过在训练时选择性循环中间层Transformer、推理时灵活调整循环次数，在不增加参数的情况下实现深度缩放效果，以更少计算量匹配或超越更大规模掩码扩散模型的性能，并在推理时通过自适应循环实现计算效率提升。
AI.motivation: 掩码扩散模型（MDMs）已成为自回归模型在语言建模中的有前景替代方案，但MDMs中Transformer架构的有效设计尚未得到充分探索。
AI.method: 提出LoopMDM，在训练时选择性循环Transformer的早-中间层（中间层循环），训练时循环带来深度缩放效果且不增加参数，推理时通过调整循环次数实现灵活的计算缩放；自适应调整采样过程中的循环次数以进一步提升计算效率。
AI.result: 在多个预训练语料上，LoopMDM以最多3.3倍更少的训练FLOPs匹配同规模MDM性能；在GSM8K等推理基准上性能提升高达8.5个点；超越使用可比每步计算训练的更深非循环MDM；推理时可通过增加循环次数缩放计算量，自适应循环进一步提升计算效率。
AI.conclusion: 选择性循环比简单深度缩放更有效，循环在MDM中通过促进掩码位置间的交互发挥作用。

title: PathWISE: Multi-Agent Cancer Pathway Triaging Ontology Learning from Clinical Flowcharts
summary: Clinical pathways are disseminated as visual flowcharts where spatial topology, arrow direction, colour coding, and font weight encode critical triage logic that remains inaccessible to computational systems. We present PathWISE, a five-phase pipeline combining four LLM-based agents with a deterministic depth-first search auditor and a Java compiler critic, transforming these non-computable artefacts into validated, executable HL7 Clinical Quality Language (CQL) libraries deployable as FHIR CDS Hooks services. Purpose-built agents extract flowchart structure into a typed directed graph, perform deterministic path enumeration, conduct a structured semantic audit of every node's computability, generate terminology-constrained CQL definitions verified by the official Java CQL-to-ELM compiler, and produce routing logic covering 100% of enumerated patient journeys. Demonstrated across five UK NHS cancer pathways (colorectal, lung, skin, upper GI, and breast), PathWISE audits up to 183 nodes (182 under the Hybrid configuration), identifies 544 structured governance findings across four issue categories, achieves 100% syntactic compilation success, with UNCOMPUTABLE nodes receiving false placeholders that preserve compilability while surfacing governance gaps for clinical review, and produces zero hallucinated terminology codes for dictionary-covered concepts. Critically, PathWISE confines non-deterministic LLM inference to knowledge extraction while deterministic graph mathematics and a standard compiler underpin every verification step.

AI.tldr: PathWISE是一个五阶段管道，结合四个LLM智能体与确定性深度优先搜索审计器及Java编译器，将临床路径流程图转化为可执行的HL7 CQL库，并在五个英国NHS癌症路径上验证，达到100%编译成功率，零幻觉术语编码。
AI.motivation: 临床路径以视觉流程图形式传播，其空间拓扑、箭头方向、颜色编码和字体粗细等关键分诊逻辑无法被计算系统访问和处理，亟需一种方法将这些非计算性工件转化为可计算、可执行的格式。
AI.method: PathWISE采用五阶段管道：(1) 专用智能体将流程图结构提取为类型化有向图；(2) 进行确定性路径枚举；(3) 对每个节点的可计算性执行结构化语义审计；(4) 生成经术语约束的CQL定义，由官方Java CQL-to-ELM编译器验证；(5) 生成覆盖100%枚举患者路径的路由逻辑。整个流程将非确定性LLM推理限制在知识提取阶段，而确定性图数学和标准编译器支撑所有验证步骤。
AI.result: 在五个英国NHS癌症路径（结直肠癌、肺癌、皮肤癌、上消化道癌和乳腺癌）上验证，PathWISE审计多达183个节点（混合配置下182个），识别544个结构化治理发现（四个问题类别），实现100%语法编译成功率，UNCOMPUTABLE节点使用虚假占位符保持可编译性同时暴露治理缺口，对字典覆盖概念产生零幻觉术语编码。
AI.conclusion: PathWISE通过将LLM的灵活推理与确定性图算法和标准编译器的严格验证相结合，成功弥合了视觉临床路径流程图与可计算临床决策支持系统之间的鸿沟，为解决医疗AI中的可验证性和可信性问题提供了一个有前景的框架。

title: Prism: A Plug-in Reproducible Infrastructure for Scalable Multimodal Continual Instruction Tuning
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) achieve versatility by reformulating diverse tasks into a unified instruction-following framework via instruction tuning. However, real-world deployment requires continuous adaptation to emerging tasks, motivating Multimodal Continual Instruction Tuning (MCIT). Despite its growing importance, current MCIT research is hindered by severe engineering bottlenecks. Existing methods are typically implemented by directly modifying the base MLLM codebase, which imposes substantial implementation overhead and yields method-specific architectures that severely limit code reuse and fair comparison. To address this, we introduce Prism, a plug-in reproducible codebase specifically designed for scalable MCIT research. It separates algorithmic development from the backbone implementation via a lightweight plugin registration mechanism, enabling new strategies to be integrated as independent plugins without modifying the underlying MLLM codebase, thereby eliminating structural fragmentation and accelerating method development. Prism natively supports widely used large-scale training pipeline, thereby enabling reproducible and scalable MCIT experimentation. Code is available at https://github.com/LAMDA-CL/Prism.

AI.tldr: Prism是一个专为多模态持续指令微调（MCIT）研究设计的插件式可复现代码库，通过轻量级插件注册机制将算法开发与骨干实现解耦，支持大规模训练流水线，旨在消除工程瓶颈、促进代码复用和公平比较。
AI.motivation: 当前MCIT研究存在严重的工程瓶颈：现有方法通常直接修改基础MLLM代码库，导致实现开销大、架构特定化严重，限制了代码复用和公平比较。
AI.method: 提出Prism代码库，采用轻量级插件注册机制，将新策略作为独立插件集成，无需修改底层MLLM代码库即可实现算法开发与骨干实现的分离。
AI.result: Prism原生支持广泛使用的大规模训练流水线，实现了可复现和可扩展的MCIT实验。
AI.conclusion: Prism通过插件化设计消除了结构碎片化，加速了方法开发，为MCIT研究提供了标准化的工程基础。

title: LLaVA-OneVision-2: Towards Next-Generation Perceptual Intelligence
summary: We introduce LLaVA-OneVision-2 (LLaVA-OV-2), the most capable vision-language model in the LLaVA-OneVision series to date, achieving superior performance across a broad range of multimodal benchmarks. The model builds on a native OneVision-Encoder and incorporates Windowed Attention for efficient local computation while maintaining native resolution. Its key advance is codec-stream tokenization: it treats compressed video as a continuous bit-cost stream, where bit-cost dynamics determine adaptive temporal groups, and motion-residual cues select salient spatial evidence into compact visual canvases. This allocation concentrates a limited token budget on event-bearing content, enabling more stable long-video token compression than fixed groups of pictures. A shared 3D RoPE further places codec canvases, sampled frames, and images in a unified spatiotemporal coordinate system. Furthermore, we build the LLaVA-OV-2 data and training stack around large-scale open supervision: approximately 8M re-captioned video samples for pretraining, a 4M-sample spatial corpus for fine-tuning. We also introduce JumpScore, a temporal-localization benchmark targeting fine-grained grounding in high-frequency, densely repeated motion, a regime underrepresented by existing video evaluations. A standout capability of LLaVA-OV-2 is its unified perception across video understanding, temporal grounding, spatial grounding, and manipulation-trace reasoning. On JumpScore, LLaVA-OneVision-2-8B reaches 74.9 JumpScore mAP, surpassing Qwen3-VL-8B (30.1) by +44.8 points; under matched visual-token budgets on the same benchmark, codec-stream inputs improve temporal grounding over frame sampling by +9.7 points. Across standard benchmarks, LLaVA-OneVision-2-8B further outperforms Qwen3-VL-8B by +4.3 average points on video tasks, +5.3 on spatial tasks, and +15.6 average J&F on tracking tasks.

AI.tldr: LLaVA-OV-2 是 LLaVA-OneVision 系列中最强的视觉语言模型，通过编解码流令牌化、窗口注意力和大规模开放监督，在视频理解、时空定位、跟踪等多项多模态基准上取得领先性能，显著超越 Qwen3-VL-8B 等同类模型。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉语言模型在处理长视频时面临令牌预算有限、时域分组固定、细粒度时空定位能力不足等问题，缺乏在高频密集重复运动场景下的有效评估基准。
AI.method: 采用原生 OneVision-Encoder 与窗口注意力机制保持原生分辨率高效计算；核心创新是编解码流令牌化（codec-stream tokenization），将压缩视频视为连续比特成本流，利用比特成本动态确定自适应时域分组，通过运动残差线索选择显著空间证据构建紧凑视觉画布；共享 3D RoPE 将编解码画布、采样帧和图像统一在时空坐标系中；使用约 800 万重新标注视频样本预训练和 400 万空间样本微调。
AI.result: 在 JumpScore 上，LLaVA-OV-2-8B 达到 74.9 mAP，超越 Qwen3-VL-8B（30.1）44.8 个点；编解码流输入在同等令牌预算下比帧采样提升 9.7 个点；在标准基准上，视频任务平均超越 4.3 点，空间任务超越 5.3 点，跟踪任务 J&F 平均超越 15.6 点。
AI.conclusion: LLaVA-OV-2 通过编解码流令牌化实现了更稳定的长视频令牌压缩与统一的时域感知，并在视频理解、时空定位、跟踪和操作轨迹推理等多项任务上展现出领先的统一感知能力。

title: Towards 3D heart mesh generation using contactless radar imaging and physics-informed neural network
summary: Cardiac function evaluation necessitates continuous, non-invasive monitoring, a capability limited in MRI. Millimeter-wave (mmWave) radar and its Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) mode offer a privacy-preserving and portable point-of-care clinical applications. However, reconstructing high-fidelity 3D cardiac geometry from SAR remains an open challenge. Traditional radar methods generate sparse point clouds that lack continuous surface topology. Meanwhile, direct application of optical reconstruction networks performs poorly due to the severe speckle noise and ambiguous boundaries inherent in SAR images. To bridge this gap, we propose SAR2Mesh, a novel framework that reformulates the task as a coarse-to-fine mesh deformation process. By initializing with a topological template, our approach explicitly preserves anatomical connectivity through progressive mesh deformation.We introduce a geometry-aware feature projection module to extract multi-view features via 3D-to-2D sampling, and a physics-informed radar loss to enforce consistency between the predicted geometry and raw radar echoes. Furthermore, we present Cardiac Mesh-SAR, the first large-scale paired SAR-mesh dataset. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SAR2Mesh significantly outperforms existing image-based baselines, achieving accurate and physically consistent cardiac reconstructions.

AI.tldr: 提出SAR2Mesh框架，通过粗到细的网格变形过程，从毫米波雷达SAR图像重建高保真3D心脏几何结构，首次实现连续表面拓扑的精确重建。
AI.motivation: 传统雷达方法生成稀疏点云，缺乏连续表面拓扑；光学重建网络直接应用于SAR图像效果差，因SAR图像存在严重散斑噪声和模糊边界。需要一种能从SAR图像重建高保真3D心脏几何结构的方法。
AI.method: 提出SAR2Mesh框架，将任务形式化为粗到细的网格变形过程：1) 通过拓扑模板初始化，进行渐进式网格变形以保持解剖连接性；2) 引入几何感知特征投影模块，通过3D到2D采样提取多视角特征；3) 设计物理信息雷达损失，约束预测几何与原始雷达回波之间的一致性；4) 构建首个大规模配对SAR-网格数据集Cardiac Mesh-SAR。
AI.result: 实验表明SAR2Mesh显著优于现有基于图像的基线方法，实现了准确且物理一致的心脏重建。
AI.conclusion: SAR2Mesh成功弥合了SAR图像与3D心脏几何重建之间的差距，为毫米波雷达在非侵入性心脏功能监测中的应用提供了有效方案。

title: MAGIC: Multimodal Alignment & Grounding-aware Instruction Coreset for Vision-Language Models
summary: Instruction tuning of large vision-language models (LVLMs) increasingly depends on massive multimodal corpora, yet these datasets contain samples with substantial redundancy, low visual dependency, and highly imbalanced coverage of multimodal reasoning behaviors. As a result, uniform subsampling or naive score-based selection often yields suboptimal training subsets. We introduce MAGIC, a training-free, forward-only coreset selection method designed to construct compact yet behaviorally faithful subsets for multimodal instruction tuning. MAGIC is built on three intrinsic signals extracted from a pretrained VLM: Multimodal Gain, which measures the likelihood improvement obtained from visual input; Bridging Relevance, which captures the sharpness of answer-token grounding over visual tokens; and Skill-Neuron Signatures, which characterize the functional computation elicited by each sample via top-activated feed-forward neurons. MAGIC combines these signals in a three-stage pipeline: filtering low-gain examples, ranking candidates by a normalized quality objective, and performing bucket-wise budget allocation over discrete neuron signatures to preserve latent multimodal skill coverage. This formulation avoids backpropagation, auxiliary selector training, and expensive clustering in continuous activation spaces, while remaining efficient and easily deployable in existing VLMs. Across LLaVA-665K and Vision-Flan datasets, and transfer settings to large target models, LLaVA-1.5-7B and -13B, MAGIC consistently improves over strong baselines under matched 20% budgets: it achieves 100.3% relative performance to full finetuning on LLaVA-665K and 101.6% relative performance on Vision-Flan-186K, while yielding a 73.7% reduction in wall-clock run time.

AI.tldr: MAGIC提出了一种无需训练、前向传播即可完成的核心集选择方法，通过多模态增益、桥接相关性和技能神经元签名三种内在信号，为多模态指令微调构建紧凑且行为保真的训练子集，在20%预算下达到甚至超越全量微调性能，并显著降低运行时间。
