AI.motivation: 大规模多模态指令微调数据集中存在大量冗余样本、低视觉依赖样本以及多模态推理行为覆盖极不均衡的问题，导致均匀子采样或基于分数的简单选择方法难以获得最优训练子集。现有方法依赖反向传播或辅助选择器训练，效率低下。
AI.method: MAGIC利用预训练VLM提取三种内在信号：多模态增益（衡量视觉输入带来的似然提升）、桥接相关性（捕获答案token在视觉token上的注意力锐度）、技能神经元签名（通过顶层前馈神经元激活表征样本的功能计算）。采用三阶段流水线：过滤低增益样本、通过归一化质量目标排序候选样本、基于离散神经元签名进行桶式预算分配以保持潜在多模态技能覆盖。无需反向传播、辅助选择器训练或连续激活空间聚类。
AI.result: 在LLaVA-665K和Vision-Flan数据集上，使用20%预算，MAGIC在LLaVA-1.5-7B和-13B上达到全量微调的100.3%和101.6%相对性能，同时减少73.7%的墙钟运行时间。
AI.conclusion: MAGIC是一种高效、部署友好、无需训练的核心集选择方法，能够从大规模多模态指令数据中筛选出行为保真的紧凑子集，在显著降低计算开销的同时保持甚至提升模型性能。

title: STORM: Internalized Modeling for Spatial-Temporal Reasoning in Video-Language Models
summary: Many video reasoning tasks require tracking motion, temporal order, and evolving visual states across frames. Existing methods built on large vision-language models (LVLMs) often address this challenge by externalizing reasoning through textual chain-of-thought (CoT), keyframe selection, repeated frame reinsertion, or external tool use. While effective, such pipelines increase inference-time latency and engineering complexity, and they force temporal-visual evidence to be serialized into text or repeatedly re-encoded from frames. Inspired by the intuition that visual reasoning can occur implicitly before verbalization, we propose STORMS (Spatial-Temporal reasOning via inteRnalized Modeling), a two-stage framework that teaches LVLMs to reason through bounded continuous latent trajectories instead of explicit textual CoT. In Stage I, STORMS aligns latent tokens with thought-video representations derived from generated videos, grounding the latent states in dynamic visual evidence. In Stage II, the model is further trained with answer-only supervision, encouraging the reasoning process to be internalized without step-by-step annotations. Generated thought videos are used only during training; at inference, STORMS performs a bounded latent rollout without regenerating videos, reinserting frames, or invoking external visual tools. Experiments on VideoMME, MVBench, TempCompass, and MMVU show that STORMS improves video reasoning accuracy while substantially reducing inference overhead compared with tool or video-generation-based reasoning pipelines.

AI.tldr: STORMS是一个两阶段框架，通过内化的连续隐空间轨迹进行时空推理，无需显式文本思维链或外部工具，在多个视频推理基准上提升准确率并降低推理开销。
AI.motivation: 现有基于大型视觉语言模型的视频推理方法依赖文本思维链、关键帧选择、帧重复插入或外部工具，导致推理延迟增加和工程复杂度上升，且强制将时空视觉证据序列化为文本或反复编码帧。
AI.method: 两阶段框架：Stage I将隐空间token与通过生成视频获得的thought-video表征对齐；Stage II仅使用答案监督训练，使推理过程内化。推理时执行有界隐空间展开，无需重新生成视频、插入帧或调用外部工具。
AI.result: 在VideoMME、MVBench、TempCompass和MMVU上，STORMS提升了视频推理准确率，同时显著降低了推理开销。
AI.conclusion: 视频推理可以在口头表达之前通过内化的隐空间轨迹隐式完成，这种方法在保持高效推理的同时提升了性能。

title: A Multimodal 3D Foundation Model for Light Sheet Fluorescence Microscopy Enables Few-Shot Segmentation, Classification, and Deblurring
summary: Light sheet fluorescence microscopy (LSM) enables high-resolution, three-dimensional (3D) imaging of biological specimens, providing rich volumetric data for studying cellular organization, pathology, and vascular networks. However, the size, dimensionality, and annotation burden of LSM data make supervised deep learning approaches costly and difficult to scale. Additionally, despite the abundance of unannotated LSM volumes, foundation models for this modality remain underexplored due to computational challenges and the complexity of volumetric representation learning. In this work, we introduce a 3D foundation model for LSM data, pretrained on a large curated collection of 3D images spanning multiple organisms, stains, and imaging protocols. We learn transferable volumetric representations by jointly optimizing for masked reconstruction and image-text alignment. The pretrained backbone drastically reduces the annotation burden, enabling efficient, few-shot adaptation for varied downstream tasks. We evaluate this approach on downstream segmentation, classification, and deblurring. Our results demonstrate consistent improvements over baselines, (1) when measured using standard evaluation metrics and (2) when rigorously assessed by domain experts. This highlights the potential of foundation model pretraining to reduce annotation requirements while improving performance across diverse LSM analysis tasks. Pretrained model weights and code for pretraining and finetuning are publicly available: https://github.com/AdinaScheinfeld/lsm_fm_public_repo.git.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个面向光片荧光显微镜（LSM）三维数据的基石模型，通过联合优化掩码重建和图像-文本对齐进行预训练，在分割、分类和去模糊等下游任务中显著降低了标注需求并提升了性能。
AI.motivation: LSM数据体量大、维度高、标注成本高，导致监督深度学习方法难以扩展；同时，尽管存在大量未标注的LSM体数据，但由于计算挑战和体表示学习的复杂性，该模态的基石模型尚未充分探索。
AI.method: 在涵盖多种生物、染色和成像协议的LSM三维图像大规模数据集上，联合优化两个目标进行预训练：(1) 掩码重建（masked reconstruction），(2) 图像-文本对齐（image-text alignment），从而学习可迁移的体表示。
AI.result: 在分割、分类和去模糊三个下游任务中，该方法相比基线在标准评价指标和领域专家评估上均取得一致改进，显著降低了标注需求。
AI.conclusion: 基石模型预训练能够有效减少LSM分析任务中的标注需求，同时提升多种任务的性能，为LSM数据的高效分析提供了可行方案。

title: Everything at Every Scale: Scale-Invariant Diffusion with Continuous Super-Resolution
summary: Creating images from noise is image generation; reconstructing fine details from coarse inputs is super-resolution. Despite their practical differences, both can be understood as reversing information loss across scales. We introduce $\textbf{SKILD}$, a $\textbf{S}$cale-invariant $\textbf{K}$-Space $\textbf{I}$mage $\textbf{L}$earning $\textbf{D}$iffusion model that unifies generation and continuous super-resolution within a single unconditional framework. Both natural images and critical physical systems exhibit scale invariance, and we leverage it to design a forward process that attenuates image content from fine to coarse scales while injecting spectrum-matched Gaussian noise, making scale an explicit coordinate of the diffusion dynamics. The same trained reverse process performs generation and continuous super-resolution by varying only the starting timestep: $\textit{no task-specific architecture, no conditioning branch, no classifier-free guidance, no retraining per scale factor}$. Empirically, SKILD reaches FID $2.65$ and Inception Score $9.63$ on unconditional CIFAR-10, performs $2\times$--$8\times$ super-resolution on ImageNet from a single unconditional checkpoint while outperforming conditional models across perceptual metrics, and reconstructs critical Ising models whose connected four-point correlations closely track the ground truth.

AI.tldr: SKILD是一个尺度不变的K空间图像学习扩散模型，通过统一框架同时实现图像生成和连续超分辨率，无需任务特定架构、条件分支或重训练。
AI.motivation: 图像生成和超分辨率虽然实际应用不同，但本质都可理解为在不同尺度上逆转信息丢失的过程。现有方法通常为生成和超分设计分离的模型，缺乏统一的理论框架。
AI.method: 利用自然图像和物理系统的尺度不变性，设计前向过程从粗到细衰减图像内容并注入频谱匹配的高斯噪声，使尺度成为扩散动力学的显式坐标。同一训练好的逆向过程仅通过改变起始时间步即可执行生成或连续超分辨率任务。
AI.result: 在无条件CIFAR-10上FID达2.65、IS达9.63；从单个无条件检查点对ImageNet执行2×-8×超分辨率，在感知指标上超越条件模型；能够重建临界Ising模型，其四点关联函数与真实值高度吻合。
AI.conclusion: SKILD证明尺度不变性可以统一生成与超分辨率任务，无需任务特定的架构设计或条件机制，为图像生成和连续超分辨率提供了简洁而有效的统一解决方案。

title: DRScaffold: Boosting Dense-Scene Reasoning in Lightweight Vision Language Models
summary: Lightweight vision-language models perform competitively on standard benchmarks yet fail systematically in dense-scene reasoning, where multiple objects, attributes, and relations must be jointly grounded and resolved through multi-step inference. Such capability is critical for real-world applications where models must reliably interpret cluttered environments. Yet existing training signals provide no explicit grounding between reasoning steps and the underlying visual entities and relations, leaving lightweight models free to generate fluent but visually unanchored reasoning chains. To address this gap, we first introduce DRBench, a benchmark of 14,573 questions across 2,943 images, organized into five task categories spanning three progressive reasoning layers. Building on DRBench, we propose DRScaffold, a supervised fine-tuning framework that decomposes the supervision target into four causally ordered stages, enforcing grounded reasoning without architectural modification. Experiments on three lightweight VLMs demonstrate substantial gains on DRBench while preserving or improving performance on general-purpose benchmarks. Notably, Qwen2.5-VL-3B trained with DRScaffold surpasses the frozen Qwen2.5-VL-32B on DRBench, demonstrating that structured supervision can substitute for a significant portion of model scale in dense-scene reasoning. Our code and models are available at https://github.com/irene-shi/DRScaffold .

AI.tldr: 针对轻量级视觉语言模型在密集场景推理中缺乏视觉锚定的问题，提出DRBench基准（14,573个问题，2,943张图像，五类任务，三层推理层级）和DRScaffold框架（将监督目标分解为四个因果有序阶段，无需架构修改即可实现锚定推理）。实验表明该方法在密集场景推理中显著提升性能，Qwen2.5-VL-3B训练后超越冻结参数的Qwen2.5-VL-32B。
AI.motivation: 现有轻量级视觉语言模型在标准基准上表现尚可，但在需要多步推理、联合定位多个物体/属性/关系的密集场景推理中系统性失败。根本原因在于训练信号缺乏推理步骤与视觉实体之间的显式锚定，模型倾向于生成流畅但未锚定于视觉的推理链。这种能力对真实世界应用至关重要。
AI.method: 1）构建DRBench基准：14,573个问题，2,943张图像，五个任务类别，三个渐进推理层；2）提出DRScaffold微调框架：将监督目标分解为四个因果有序阶段（视觉定位→属性识别→关系推理→最终答案），在不修改架构的前提下强制实现锚定推理。
AI.result: 在三个轻量级VLM上，DRScaffold在DRBench上取得显著提升，同时保持或提升通用基准性能。关键结果为：Qwen2.5-VL-3B经DRScaffold训练后，在DRBench上超越冻结参数的Qwen2.5-VL-32B，表明结构化监督可替代相当一部分模型规模在密集场景推理中的作用。
AI.conclusion: 结构化监督能够有效替代模型规模在密集场景推理中的部分作用，通过分解推理步骤并强制视觉锚定，无需修改架构即可显著提升轻量级模型的密集场景推理能力。

title: Paris 2.0: A Decentralized Diffusion Model for Video Generation
summary:
We present Paris 2.0, the first video generation model pre-trained through decentralized computation. Its training recipe builds upon Paris 1.0 (arXiv:2510.03434), the first ever open-weight Decentralized Diffusion Model (DDM), which showed that image generation can be trained without a monolithic GPU cluster. However, temporally coherent video generation had remained an open problem under decentralized training, and Paris 2.0 closes it.
  In low-resolution text-to-video training, against a monolithic model trained on the same data under a matched total compute budget, Paris 2.0 cuts Frechet Video Distance (FVD) from 561.04 to 279.01, a ~2.0x improvement, and lifts CLIP text-video similarity and aesthetic score.

AI.tldr: Paris 2.0是首个通过去中心化计算预训练的视频生成模型，相比单体型模型在FVD指标上实现约2倍改进（从561.04降至279.01），并提升了CLIP文本-视频相似度和美学分数。
AI.motivation: 去中心化训练在图像生成领域已被验证可行，但时序连贯的视频生成在去中心化训练下仍是一个未解决的问题。Paris 2.0旨在弥合这一空白。
AI.method: 基于Paris 1.0（去中心化扩散模型DDM）的训练方案构建，通过去中心化计算预训练低分辨率文本到视频生成模型。
AI.result: 在低分辨率文本到视频任务中，与在相同数据和计算预算下训练的集中式单体型模型相比，Paris 2.0将FVD从561.04降至279.01（~2.0x改进），并提升了CLIP文本-视频相似度和美学分数。
AI.conclusion: Paris 2.0成功证明了去中心化训练可以用于视频生成，并且性能优于同等计算资源的集中式训练。

title: Channel-wise Vector Quantization
summary: We present Channel-wise Vector Quantization (CVQ), a novel image tokenization paradigm that replaces patch-wise tokens with channel-wise tokens. Unlike conventional vector quantization, which assigns a discrete token to each patch feature vector, CVQ quantizes each channel of the feature map. This formulation represents an image as discrete levels of visual details, rather than as a grid of spatial patches. Based on CVQ, we introduce a new visual autoregressive framework with "next-channel prediction". Instead of rendering images patch by patch in raster order, our Channel-wise Autoregressive (CAR) model predicts image channels sequentially, producing progressively enriched visual details. Specifically, it first sketches global structure and then refines fine-grained attributes, akin to a human artist's workflow. Empirically, we show that: (1) CVQ achieves 100% codebook utilization with a 16K+ codebook size without any bells and whistles, and substantially improves reconstruction quality over conventional VQ; and (2) CAR attains a DPG score of 86.7 and a GenEval score of 0.79, demonstrating strong effectiveness for text-to-image generation.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为通道级向量量化（CVQ）的新型图像分词范式，用通道级分词替代传统的补丁级分词，并基于此构建了通道级自回归（CAR）模型，通过"下一通道预测"实现从全局结构到精细细节的图像生成，在码本利用率和图像生成质量上均优于传统方法。
AI.motivation: 传统的向量量化（VQ）方法将图像分割成空间补丁网格并对每个补丁特征向量分配离散标记，这种方式忽略了图像不同通道所蕴含的视觉细节层次信息，限制了图像生成的质量和码本利用率。
AI.method: (1) 提出通道级向量量化（CVQ）：对特征图的每个通道进行量化，而非对每个空间补丁进行量化，将图像表示为视觉细节的离散层级；(2) 提出通道级自回归（CAR）模型：采用"下一通道预测"策略，按顺序预测图像通道，先勾勒全局结构，再细化精细属性，模拟人类艺术家的创作流程。
AI.result: (1) CVQ实现了100%的码本利用率，码本大小可达16K+，无需任何额外技巧，重建质量显著优于传统VQ；(2) CAR在DPG评分上达到86.7，GenEval评分达到0.79，在文本到图像生成任务上表现出色。
AI.conclusion: 通道级分词范式是传统补丁级分词的有效替代方案，能够充分利用码本资源并提升图像生成质量，为视觉自回归模型提供了新的设计方向。

title: Φ-Noise: Training-Free Temporal Video Conditioning via Phase-Based Noise Manipulation
summary: Latent video diffusion models generate videos by progressively transforming Gaussian noise into realistic samples conditioned on text or visual inputs. However, existing conditioning methods often require additional training and computational overhead. Motivated by recent findings on the importance of frequency components in generative models, we propose a simple, training-free approach for motion-conditioned video generation by injecting low-frequency phase information from a reference video directly into the diffusion noise latents. Our method transfers motion cues without modifying the model architecture or inference pipeline. Using several applications, we demonstrate effective control over both appearance and dynamics in generated videos, while achieving competitive or superior results compared to more complex conditioning approaches.

AI.tldr: 提出一种无需训练的运动条件视频生成方法，通过将参考视频的低频相位信息直接注入扩散噪声潜变量，实现对生成视频外观和动态的有效控制。
AI.motivation: 现有条件视频生成方法需要额外训练和计算开销，本文受频率分量在生成模型中重要性的发现启发，旨在开发一种简单、无需训练的运动条件方法。
AI.method: 将参考视频的低频相位信息直接注入扩散模型的噪声潜变量中，无需修改模型架构或推理流程，实现运动线索的迁移。
AI.result: 在多个应用中，该方法有效控制了生成视频的外观和动态，取得了与更复杂条件方法相当或更优的结果。
AI.conclusion: 提出了一种简单有效的训练-free运动条件视频生成方案，通过低频相位注入实现运动控制，性能优于或媲美复杂方法。

title: Pixel-Level Pavement Distress Assessment Using Instance Segmentation
summary: Automated pavement distress assessment requires more than image-level classification or coarse bounding box detection, demanding precise localization of thin, branching, and irregular cracks to achieve the geometric precision necessary for maintenance-relevant quantification. This paper presents a vision-based pavement distress analysis system based on Mask R-CNN instance segmentation and evaluates it on UWGB-StreetCrack, a custom field-collected roadway image dataset acquired with a vehicle-mounted smartphone and manually annotated with polygon labels for longitudinal cracks, transverse cracks, alligator cracks, and potholes. Five Detectron2-based Mask R-CNN backbone variants were considered under a consistent fine-tuning protocol. The best-performing model, Mask R-CNN with a ResNet-101 FPN backbone, achieved 84.23% precision, 90.04% recall, and an F1 score of 87.04% under the project-specific bounding-box matching protocol. The same model produced an aggregate predicted crack-area fraction of 2.164%, closely matching the 2.170% ground-truth crack-area fraction. To contextualize the segmentation system against a detector-oriented alternative, a CSPDarknet53-based YOLO detector was also adapted and retrained on the dataset, reaching 27.5% precision and 20.7% recall on the validation protocol. The results show that instance segmentation is a practical direction for field pavement imagery and aggregate crack-area estimation, while also exposing open challenges in annotation consistency, class imbalance, confounder rejection, and mask-level benchmarking.

AI.tldr: 本文基于Mask R-CNN实例分割方法，在自建道路图像数据集UWGB-StreetCrack上实现了路面裂缝（纵向、横向、龟裂及坑洞）的精准分割。采用ResNet-101 FPN骨干的模型达到84.23%精度、90.04%召回率，预测裂缝面积分数（2.164%）与真实值（2.170%）高度吻合，显著优于YOLO检测器方案（27.5%精度、20.7%召回率）。
AI.motivation: 现有路面病害检测方法局限于图像级分类或粗粒度边界框检测，无法满足维护量化所需的细长、分支及不规则裂缝的几何精确定位需求。
AI.method: 采用Mask R-CNN实例分割框架，在Detectron2平台上比较五种骨干网络变体（最佳为ResNet-101 FPN），在自采集的UWGB-StreetCrack数据集上以多边形标注进行微调，并对比CSPDarknet53-based YOLO检测器。
AI.result: 最佳模型（ResNet-101 FPN骨干）在项目特定边界框匹配协议下达到84.23%精度、90.04%召回率、F1分数87.04%；预测裂缝面积分数2.164%与真实值2.170%高度一致；YOLO检测器仅达27.5%精度和20.7%召回率。
AI.conclusion: 实例分割是面向现场路面影像进行裂缝面积估计的实用方向，同时揭示了标注一致性、类别不平衡、混淆项剔除及掩码级基准测试等开放挑战。

title: InstructSAM: Segment Any Instance with Any Instructions
summary: In this paper, we introduce InstructSAM, a unified and streamlined framework designed for multi-instance segmentation under arbitrary instructions. We formulates instruction-driven instance segmentation as a set-structured query prediction problem and propose an explicit reasoning-to-instance query interface that elegantly bridges a vision-language model (VLM) and SAM3. Specifically, a bank of learnable instance queries is injected into the VLM and contextualized with instruction and visual information, enabling each query to serve as an instance-aware slot. A hybrid-attention mechanism further promotes interaction among these queries, visual tokens, and instruction tokens, improving instance enumeration and reducing duplicate predictions. The resulting LLM-conditioned queries are projected into SAM3's detector query space to drive accurate multi-instance segmentation in a single forward pass. This design equips SAM3 with high-level instruction understanding, compositional reasoning, and instance-level set prediction without modifying its core architecture. To support training and evaluation, we further construct Inst2Seg, a high-quality and large-scale instruction-based instance segmentation dataset and benchmark that couples free-form instructions with instance-level masks. Extensive experiments show that only 2B-scale InstructSAM achieves strong results across complex instruction-driven and phrase-level referring segmentation benchmarks, outperforming prior end-to-end methods and SAM3's agentic pipeline while enabling efficient single-pass multi-instance prediction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出InstructSAM，一种统一框架，通过将可学习实例查询注入视觉语言模型并结合混合注意力机制，实现基于任意指令的多实例分割，在2B参数量下超越先前方法。
AI.motivation: 现有方法在处理任意指令驱动的多实例分割时，缺乏统一的端到端框架，通常依赖复杂的流水线或无法有效结合高层次的指令理解与实例级分割能力。
AI.method: 将指令驱动的实例分割形式化为集合结构化的查询预测问题；设计推理到实例的查询接口，将可学习实例查询注入VLM并与指令和视觉信息上下文化；采用混合注意力机制促进查询、视觉token和指令token之间的交互；将LLM条件化的查询投影到SAM3的检测器查询空间，实现单次前向传播的精确多实例分割。
AI.result: 仅2B参数的InstructSAM在复杂指令驱动和短语级指代分割基准上均取得强结果，优于先前端到端方法和SAM3的代理流水线，并实现高效的单次多实例预测。
AI.conclusion: 该框架有效赋予SAM3高层次指令理解、组合推理和实例级集合预测能力，无需修改其核心架构，为指令驱动实例分割提供了统一高效的解决方案。

title: Global Structure-from-Motion Meets Feedforward Reconstruction
summary: Structure-from-Motion -- the process of simultaneously estimating camera poses and 3D scene structure from a collection of images -- remains a central challenge in computer vision, with many open problems yet to be solved. Recent advances in feedforward 3D reconstruction have made significant strides in overcoming persistent failure cases of classical SfM methods, particularly in scenarios characterized by low texture, limited overlap, and symmetries. However, while feedforward approaches excel in these challenging conditions, they often face limitations regarding scalability, accuracy, or robustness, and typically fall short of classical methods in standard reconstruction settings. In this work, we systematically analyze these limitations and propose a new Structure-from-Motion pipeline by combining the respective strengths of classical and feedforward methods. Extensive experiments across multiple datasets show the benefits of our approach, achieving state-of-the-art results across a wide range of scenarios. We share our system as an open-source implementation at https://github.com/colmap/gluemap.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种结合经典SfM和前馈3D重建方法优势的新型SfM流水线，在多种场景下实现最先进的结果，并开源实现。
AI.motivation: 经典SfM在低纹理、有限重叠和对称场景中存在失败案例，而前馈方法在这些困难条件下表现出色，但在可扩展性、准确性或鲁棒性方面存在局限，在标准重建设置中通常不如经典方法。两者优势互补，因此需要一种结合两者优势的新方法。
AI.method: 系统分析经典SfM和前馈方法的局限性，设计一种新的SfM流水线，通过结合经典方法的可扩展性与前馈方法在挑战性场景下的鲁棒性，实现优势互补。
AI.result: 在多个数据集上的大量实验表明，该方法在广泛场景中均达到最先进的结果。
AI.conclusion: 结合经典SfM和前馈方法的优势能够有效克服各自局限性，在不同场景下实现更优的重建性能，并已开源。

title: EVIDENT: Routing MLLM Adaptation through Entity-Grounded Visual Evidence for Cross-Domain Video Temporal Grounding
summary: Fine-tuning MLLMs for Video Temporal Grounding (VTG) often improves in-domain performance but degrades sharply under domain shift. In this work, we find that this failure is primarily driven not just by unseen query concepts, but by visual domain shift, which prevents the model from coupling its learned temporal localization knowledge with its inherent entity-attention capability. To address this, we introduce EVIDENT, a parameter-efficient adaptation framework that anchors temporal grounding in the inherent entity-attention of pre-trained MLLMs by routing VTG adaptation through explicit visual entity evidence. EVIDENT consists of three components: (i) an Entity Bottleneck Adapter that transforms dense visual tokens into compact entity-level slots, (ii) an Entity-Binding Distillation loss that instills objectness priors into the semantically unstructured MLLM visual space, guiding each slot to bind to a coherent entity, and (iii) an Entity-to-eVidence gating mechanism that leverages the captured entities as evidence, steering the model to localize moments containing query-relevant entities. Together, these components enable VTG fine-tuning to rely on entity-grounded evidence rather than brittle dataset shortcuts. Experiments on cross-domain VTG benchmarks show that EVIDENT consistently improves out-of-domain robustness while preserving competitive in-domain performance with modest parameter overhead. These results suggest that entity-level grounding is an effective inductive bias for generalizable temporal localization.

AI.tldr: EVIDENT是一种参数高效的微调框架，通过显式视觉实体证据路由VTG适应，在保持域内性能的同时显著提升跨域鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 微调MLLM用于视频时间定位在域内性能提升，但域迁移下急剧下降。作者发现失败主因不仅是未见查询概念，更是视觉域迁移阻碍了模型将时间定位知识与固有实体注意力能力耦合。
AI.method: 提出EVIDENT框架，包含三个组件：(i) 实体瓶颈适配器(Entity Bottleneck Adapter)，将密集视觉令牌压缩为紧凑实体级槽位；(ii) 实体绑定蒸馏损失(Entity-Binding Distillation)，将物体性先验注入MLLM语义无结构的视觉空间；(iii) 实体到证据门控机制(Entity-to-eVidence gating)，利用捕获的实体作为证据引导模型定位包含查询相关实体的时刻。
AI.result: 跨域VTG基准实验表明，EVIDENT在保持竞争性域内性能且参数开销适中的同时，持续提升域外鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 实体级定位是通用时间定位的有效归纳偏置。

title: On-Policy Adversarial Flow Distillation for Autoregressive Video Generation
summary: Autoregressive video generators are attractive for streaming, long-horizon, and interactive applications, but distilling strong black-box teachers into causal students remains difficult. The student must learn under its own rollout distribution, whereas practical teachers may expose only prompt-conditioned completed videos and may differ in architecture, capacity, temporal design, and sampling schedule. This interface makes supervised fine-tuning off-policy, score-based distillation inapplicable, and direct adversarial imitation too sparse for denoising-time credit assignment. We propose Adversarial Flow Distillation (AFD), an on-policy framework for heterogeneous black-box video distillation. AFD queries the teacher and rolls out the current student on the same prompts, trains a prompt-paired Bradley-Terry discriminator to estimate clean-sample teacher-student discrepancy, and converts the resulting on-policy advantage into forward-process flow-matching updates on the student's own noised states. Thus, AFD provides dense velocity-field supervision while requiring no teacher scores, latents, denoising trajectories, step alignment, or reverse-chain reinforcement learning. Experiments across two causal AR student families show that AFD consistently improves motion- and physics-sensitive generation while preserving general video quality, and ablations validate the importance of adaptive on-policy feedback and forward-process credit assignment. The method requires only clean teacher videos and student rollouts, providing a practical route for distilling proprietary or heterogeneous video generators into efficient autoregressive students.

AI.tldr: 本文提出对抗流蒸馏（AFD），一种针对异构黑盒教师模型的自回归视频生成器蒸馏框架。AFD通过提示配对比较、在线策略优势估计和前向流程匹配更新，仅需教师生成的干净视频和学生采样结果，即可实现密集的速度场监督，无需教师分数、潜变量或去噪轨迹。
AI.motivation: 自回归视频生成器在流式、长程和交互式应用中具有吸引力，但从强黑盒教师蒸馏到因果学生模型存在困难：学生需在其自回归采样分布下学习，而教师仅提供基于提示条件生成的完整视频，且两者在架构、容量、时间设计和采样策略上可能完全不同。这使得监督微调策略偏离、基于分数的蒸馏不适用，直接对抗模仿在去噪时间信用分配上过于稀疏。
AI.method: AFD包含三个核心步骤：（1）在相同提示上同时查询教师并采样学生输出；（2）训练一个提示配对的Bradley-Terry判别器，估计干净样本上教师与学生的差异；（3）将在线策略优势转化为前向流程匹配更新，作用于学生自身的噪声状态上，提供密集的速度场监督。
AI.result: 在两个因果自回归学生家族上的实验表明，AFD一致提升了运动敏感和物理敏感的视频生成质量，同时保持了整体视频质量。消融实验验证了自适应在线策略反馈和前向过程信用分配的重要性。
AI.conclusion: AFD提供了一种实用的蒸馏途径，仅需教师生成的干净视频和学生采样结果，无需教师分数、潜变量、去噪轨迹、步骤对齐或逆向链强化学习，适用于将专有或异构视频生成器蒸馏为高效的自回归学生模型。

title: Reinforcing Few-step Generators via Reward-Tilted Distribution Matching
comment: Code and models are available at https://github.com/Harahan/RTDMD
summary: Recent advances in few-step diffusion distillation have enabled efficient image generation, yet aligning these models with human preferences remains challenging. We propose Reward-Tilted Distribution Matching Distillation (RTDMD), a two-stage framework that unifies distribution matching distillation with reward-guided reinforcement learning for few-step flow generators. We show that minimizing the KL divergence to a reward-tilted teacher distribution naturally decomposes into a distribution matching term and a reward maximization term. In the first stage, we introduce Ambient-Consistent Distribution Matching Distillation (AC-DMD), which performs subinterval-wise distribution matching and augments the fake score objective with a consistency regularizer to help the fake score model track the shifting generator distribution under limited updates. In the second stage, we jointly optimize both terms: for the reward maximization term, we derive a hybrid policy gradient that combines a GRPO-style estimator for the stochastic intermediate transitions with direct reward backpropagation through the deterministic final step, and further introduce step-subset GRPO (SubGRPO) to reduce variance. Experiments on SD3, SD3.5, and FLUX.2 demonstrate that RTDMD establishes new state-of-the-art results across preference, aesthetic, and compositional metrics with only 4 inference steps, outperforming previous few-step text-to-image generation methods. Code and models are available at https://github.com/Harahan/RTDMD.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RTDMD两阶段框架，将分布匹配蒸馏与奖励引导强化学习统一，用于少步流生成器的偏好对齐。第一阶段（AC-DMD）进行子区间分布匹配并添加一致性正则化，第二阶段联合优化分布匹配与奖励最大化项（含混合策略梯度与SubGRPO）。在SD3、SD3.5、FLUX.2上以4步推理达到SOTA。
AI.motivation: 少步扩散蒸馏虽能高效生成图像，但将这些模型与人类偏好对齐仍具挑战性。
AI.method: 1) 提出Reward-Tilted Distribution Matching Distillation (RTDMD)两阶段框架，将KL散度最小化到奖励倾斜的教师分布分解为分布匹配项和奖励最大化项；2) 第一阶段Ambient-Consistent Distribution Matching Distillation (AC-DMD)实现子区间分布匹配并添加一致性正则化；3) 第二阶段联合优化两项，为奖励最大化导出混合策略梯度（GRPO风格估计器+直接奖励反向传播），并引入SubGRPO降低方差。
AI.result: 在SD3、SD3.5、FLUX.2上，RTDMD以仅4步推理在偏好、美学和组合性指标上达到新SOTA，超越先前少步文生图方法。
AI.conclusion: RTDMD有效统一了分布匹配蒸馏与奖励引导强化学习，显著提升了少步生成器的对齐性能。

title: Helix4D: Complex 4D Mesh Generation
summary: Current video-to-4D methods struggle with complex topology changes, transparent materials, thin structures, and inner surfaces. We present Helix4D, a dynamic mesh generation framework by inheriting the expressive representation of Trellis2, adapting it from image-to-3D to video-conditioned 4D generation. Our design arises from two key questions: (a) how to enable Trellis2's frame-local attention to share information across frames while preserving its pretrained quality on rare cases such as transparent objects and inner surfaces, and (b) how to inject temporal information into a purely 3D positional encoding without breaking pretrained capabilities. We address (a) with a sliding-window cross-frame attention and anchor on the first frame. The first frame is generated by the base Trellis2 model and injected into our model, letting it inherit Trellis2's quality in rare cases through cross-frame attention. We address (b) with a 4D temporal encoding that repurposes redundant low-frequency spatial RoPE bands for time, extending the encoding from 3D with no additional parameters. Extensive experiments show the effectiveness of Helix4D for high-quality dynamic mesh generation on ActionBench and our own challenging complex dynamics set.

AI.tldr: Helix4D 是一个动态网格生成框架，通过滑动窗口跨帧注意力机制和4D时间编码，将Trellis2从图像到3D的能力扩展到视频条件化的4D生成，有效处理复杂拓扑变化、透明材料、薄结构和内表面等挑战。
AI.motivation: 现有视频到4D方法难以处理复杂拓扑变化、透明材料、薄结构和内表面等特殊情形；旨在将Trellis2的高质量表达能力从图像到3D继承到视频到4D生成中。
AI.method: (a) 提出滑动窗口跨帧注意力机制，以第一帧为锚点，通过跨帧注意力继承Trellis2在罕见情形下的预训练质量；(b) 提出4D时间编码，将冗余的低频空间RoPE频带重用于时间维度，无需额外参数即可将3D位置编码扩展为4D。
AI.result: 在ActionBench和自建复杂动态数据集上的实验表明，Helix4D能有效生成高质量动态网格。
AI.conclusion: Helix4D通过精心设计的跨帧注意力和4D时间编码，成功将Trellis2的预训练能力迁移到视频到4D生成任务，在保持罕见情形质量的同时实现了动态网格生成。

title: Squeezing Capacity from Multimodal Large Language Models for Subject-driven Generation
summary: Subject-driven image generation aims to synthesize new images that preserve the identity of the given subject while following textual instructions. Existing approaches often encode text and reference images separately. This limits cross-modal reasoning abilities and causes copy-paste artifacts. Recent frameworks that connect multimodal models and diffusion models improve instruction following, but largely overlook identity preservation. To address these limitations, we condition diffusion models on Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) that jointly encode text and reference images, and augment it with VAE-based identity conditioning. A novel Dual Layer Aggregation (DLA) module is designed to aggregate multi-level MLLM features for optimal conditioning, and a multi-stage denoising strategy is applied to progressively balance the semantic information from MLLM and fine-detail identity from VAE during inference. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our approach harmonizes multimodal understanding with identity preservation, mitigates copy-paste issues, and achieves superior performance regarding human preference on subject-driven image generation. Our project website is available at https://zsh2000.github.io/squeeze-mllm-subject-gen/.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于MLLM和VAE双重条件注入的图像生成方法，通过Dual Layer Aggregation模块和多阶段去噪策略，在保持主体身份的同时遵循文本指令，有效缓解了复制粘贴伪影问题。
AI.motivation: 现有主体驱动图像生成方法存在两个主要局限：(1) 文本和参考图像分开编码，限制了跨模态推理能力，导致复制粘贴伪影；(2) 近期连接多模态模型与扩散模型的方法虽改进了指令跟随，但严重忽略了身份保持。因此需要一种能同时兼顾多模态理解与身份保持的方法。
AI.method: (1) 将扩散模型条件置于MLLM之上，MLLM联合编码文本和参考图像；(2) 引入基于VAE的身份条件注入；(3) 设计Dual Layer Aggregation (DLA)模块聚合多层级MLLM特征以实现最优条件注入；(4) 采用多阶段去噪策略，在推理过程中逐步平衡MLLM的语义信息与VAE的细粒度身份信息。
AI.result: 大量实验表明该方法在协调多模态理解与身份保持方面表现优异，减轻了复制粘贴问题，在主体驱动图像生成的人类偏好评估中达到了更优性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过将MLLM联合编码与VAE身份条件相结合，并配合DLA模块和多阶段去噪策略，有效解决了身份保持与指令跟随之间的权衡问题，在主体驱动图像生成任务上取得了SOTA水平的人类偏好结果。

title: TriSplat: Simulation-Ready Feed-Forward 3D Scene Reconstruction
summary: Sparse-view 3D reconstruction is increasingly addressed with feed-forward splatting networks that predict explicit primitives directly from images. Yet most existing methods remain centered on Gaussian primitives and expose surfaces only indirectly: extracting a usable mesh for downstream simulation, physics reasoning, or embodied interaction still requires expensive post-hoc steps that break the feed-forward promise. This limitation is especially pronounced in pose-free settings, where scene structure and camera parameters must be estimated jointly from sparse observations. We present TriSplat, a feed-forward reconstruction network that represents scenes with oriented triangle primitives and directly exports simulation-ready mesh scenes from a single forward pass. Given input images, the network predicts local 3D point maps, triangle attributes, camera poses, and optional intrinsics. Rather than regressing triangle orientation as an unconstrained latent variable, our approach constructs geometry normals from the predicted point maps, refines them with an image-conditioned normal head, and converts them into stable local frames for triangle parameterization. A mono-normal bootstrap schedule further stabilizes early training, while opacity and blur scheduling progressively sharpens the learned surface representation for direct mesh extraction. Experiments on RealEstate10K and DL3DV show that this representation produces more geometry-faithful reconstructions than Gaussian feed-forward baselines while maintaining competitive novel-view rendering quality. Because the rendering primitives are themselves surface triangles, the output can be directly ingested by physics engines, collision detectors, and standard rendering pipelines without any conversion, making it a practical simulation-ready solution for feed-forward 3D scene reconstruction.

AI.tldr: TriSplat是一种前馈式3D重建网络，使用有向三角形图元替代高斯图元，能够直接从稀疏视图中预测带相机位姿的三角形场景表示，并通过单次前向传播导出可直接用于物理仿真和渲染的网格场景，无需后处理转换步骤。
AI.motivation: 现有基于高斯图元的稀疏视图3D重建方法只能间接表示表面，提取可用于下游仿真、物理推理或具身交互的网格仍需昂贵的后处理步骤，破坏了前馈式方法的承诺；尤其在无位姿设定下，场景结构和相机参数需联合估计，问题更为突出。
AI.method: 1) 预测局部3D点图、三角形属性、相机位姿及内参；2) 从点图构建几何法线，经图像条件法线头精化，转换为稳定的局部坐标系进行三角形参数化；3) 引入单目法线引导调度稳定早期训练；4) 采用不透明度和模糊度调度逐步锐化表面表示，实现直接网格提取。
AI.result: 在RealEstate10K和DL3DV数据集上，该方法相比高斯前馈基线方法产生了更符合几何结构的重建，同时保持了有竞争力的新视角渲染质量。
AI.conclusion: 由于渲染图元本身就是表面三角形，输出可直接用于物理引擎、碰撞检测器和标准渲染管线，无需任何转换，是一种实用的、可直接用于仿真的前馈式3D场景重建方案。

title: RepSAM: Bridging Foundation Models to Robotic Vision via Representation-Guided Adaptation
comment: Accepted to IJCAI-ECAI 2026 (Special Track on AI and Robotics). 8 pages, 4 figures, 12 tables
summary: Robotic perception in unstructured environments remains challenging despite the zero-shot capabilities of foundation models such as SAM. This work attributes performance degradation to non-uniform representation shifts across transformer layers: shallow layers exhibit substantial domain gaps (CKA < 0.5), whereas deep layers transfer effectively (CKA > 0.7). Based on this observation, we propose RepSAM, a representation-guided parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) framework for adapting foundation models to robotic vision. RepSAM employs a theoretically grounded CKA-guided rank allocation strategy combined with a multi-modal fusion module for robust handling of challenging robotic scenarios, including transparent objects and cluttered scenes. Experimental evaluation across six benchmarks and robotic manipulation tasks demonstrates that RepSAM achieves 97.9% of full fine-tuning performance (89.0% vs. 90.9% mIoU) while reducing trainable parameters by 158x (from 632M to 4.0M). RepSAM outperforms DoRA by 7.9% mIoU with just 4 hours of training on a single A100 GPU (a 96x reduction from full fine-tuning, which takes 384 GPU-hours). These improvements are statistically significant (p < 0.01) and translate to a 12.0% absolute improvement in robotic manipulation success rates over the LoRA (RGB) baseline.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RepSAM，一种基于表示引导的参数高效微调框架，通过CKA引导的秩分配策略和多模态融合模块，以极少的可训练参数（4.0M，减少158倍）实现了全量微调97.9%的性能（89.0% vs 90.9% mIoU），并在机器人操作任务中取得了12.0%的成功率提升。
AI.motivation: 基础模型（如SAM）在机器人非结构化环境感知中性能下降，原因是Transformer浅层存在显著域间隙（CKA < 0.5），而深层迁移效果较好（CKA > 0.7）。当前缺乏针对这种非均匀表示偏移的高效微调方法。
AI.method: 1）基于CKA引导的秩分配策略，根据各层表示偏移程度动态分配LoRA秩；2）多模态融合模块，增强对透明物体和杂乱场景等挑战性场景的鲁棒性。
AI.result: 在6个基准和机器人操作任务中，RepSAM以4.0M可训练参数（减少158倍）达到89.0% mIoU（全量微调90.9%），仅需4小时单卡A100训练（全量微调384小时），优于DoRA 7.9% mIoU，机器人操作成功率提升12.0%（p < 0.01）。
AI.conclusion: RepSAM验证了基于表示偏移的非均匀性来指导参数高效微调的有效性，为适应基础模型到机器人视觉提供了一种高效且性能损失极小的解决方案。

title: Generalized Evidential Deep Learning: From a Bayesian Perspective
summary: Evidential Deep Learning (EDL) has emerged as an efficient, sampling-free strategy for uncertainty estimation. A series of EDL variants have been proposed to address specific limitations of the original framework, achieving notable success. However, the underlying theoretical structure of EDL and the relationships among these variants have received limited systematic investigation. In this work, we establish a principled theoretical foundation for EDL by interpreting it within a generalized Bayesian framework that includes prior specification, posterior update, and training objective. We further characterize evidential uncertainty from a Bayesian distributional uncertainty viewpoint, established via asymptotic analysis. Building on this perspective, we further propose Generalized Evidential Deep Learning (GEDL), a unified and extensible framework that explicitly disentangles the roles of individual components and systematically relates GEDL to existing variants. Extensive experiments demonstrate that GEDL yields comparable results on classification, uncertainty estimation and OOD detections, with theoretical grounding.

AI.tldr: 本文系统建立了证据深度学习（EDL）的理论基础，将其置于广义贝叶斯框架下解释，并提出统一可扩展的广义证据深度学习（GEDL）框架，在分类、不确定性估计和OOD检测上取得可比结果。
AI.motivation: 现有EDL变体虽在不确定性估计上取得显著成功，但缺乏系统性的理论基础研究，各变体之间的内在关系尚未被深入探讨。
AI.method: 将EDL纳入广义贝叶斯框架（包括先验设定、后验更新和训练目标），通过渐近分析从贝叶斯分布不确定性角度刻画证据不确定性，并提出GEDL框架显式解耦各组件的角色，系统关联现有变体。
AI.result: GEDL在分类、不确定性估计和OOD检测上取得与现有方法可比的结果，同时具有理论根基。
AI.conclusion: EDL可在广义贝叶斯框架下获得系统性的理论解释，GEDL作为一个统一框架能够解耦并关联各类EDL变体，兼具理论基础和实践有效性。
